papers.title: FaceMoE: Mixture of Experts for Low-Resolution Face Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Low-resolution face recognition (LR-FR) remains a challenging task due to poor feature extraction and aggregation, as probe images often contain limited identity information resulting from extreme degradations such as blur, occlusion, and low contrast. Additionally, the domain gap between high-resolution (HR) gallery images and low-resolution (LR) probe images poses a significant challenge. A single feature encoder struggles to generalize effectively across both domains when fine-tuned on an LR dataset, and this issue is further magnified by catastrophic forgetting. To address these challenges, we propose FaceMoE, an effective adaptation of Mixture of Experts (MoE) transfomer architecture for low-resolution face-recognition . Specifically, we introduce multiple specialized feed-forward network (FFN) experts and incorporate a top-k router, which dynamically assigns tokens to appropriate experts. This design emergently promotes specialization across experts for different semantic regions of the face, which enables FaceMoE to perform resolution-aware feature extraction. Moreover, the top-k router facilitates sparse expert activation, enabling the model to preserve pretrained knowledge when finetuned on a LR dataset, while increasing model capacity without proportional computational overhead. FaceMoE is trained with a combined face recognition loss, router z-loss, and load balancing loss to ensure expert specialization and stable training. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work leveraging MoE for LR-FR. Extensive experiments across eleven datasets, spanning HR, mixed-quality, and LR benchmarks, demonstrate that FaceMoE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Code: https://github.com/Kartik-3004/FaceMoE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FaceMoE 是一种基于混合专家 (Mixture of Experts, MoE) Transformer 的低分辨率人脸识别方法。它引入多个前馈网络专家和 top-k 路由，根据人脸不同语义区域动态分配 token，实现分辨率感知特征提取，并缓解高分辨率图库与低分辨率探针之间的域差距。在十一个数据集上的实验表明，FaceMoE 显著优于现有方法。
Motivation: 低分辨率人脸识别面临特征提取困难和高-低分辨率域差距挑战，单一特征编码器在 LR 数据集上微调时泛化能力差，且易发生灾难性遗忘。现有方法并未有效利用 MoE 架构解决此问题。
Method: 提出 FaceMoE 架构，在 Transformer 中采用多个前馈网络专家和 top-k 路由器，动态将 token 分配给最相关的专家，并结合人脸识别损失、路由器 z-loss 和负载均衡损失进行训练，实现稀疏专家激活和分辨率感知特征提取。
Result: 在跨 HR、混合质量和 LR 基准的十一个数据集上，FaceMoE 显著优于现有最先进方法，且在不显著增加计算开销的情况下提升了模型容量。
Conclusion: FaceMoE 是首个将 MoE 应用于低分辨率人脸识别的工作，验证了专家稀疏激活在缓解域差距和灾难性遗忘方面的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GEAR: Guided End-to-End AutoRegression for Image Synthesis
papers.abstract_en: Visual generative models are typically trained in two stages. A tokenizer is first trained for reconstruction and then frozen, after which a generator is trained on its discrete indices or continuous latents. This decoupling leaves the tokenizer unaware of what the generator finds easy to model. We present GEAR (Guided End-to-end AutoRegression), which trains a vector-quantized (VQ) tokenizer and an autoregressive (AR) generator jointly and end-to-end, guided by representation alignment. The key obstacle is that the VQ index fed to the AR model is non-differentiable, so gradients cannot reach the tokenizer, and a straight-through estimator collapses. GEAR resolves this with a dual read-out of the codebook assignment. A hard, one-hot branch trains the AR with next-token prediction, while a differentiable soft branch carries a representation-alignment loss that flows back to guide only the tokenizer. The AR model thereby steers its tokenizer toward an index distribution it can predict more easily. This shifts the alignment burden from the tokenizer to the AR: the tokenizer's own features become less DINOv2-like while the AR's become more so, the opposite of diffusion-side recipes that make the latent itself semantic. GEAR speeds up ImageNet gFID convergence by up to 10x relative to the strong LlamaGen-REPA baseline, learns markedly better patch-level and spatially-coherent features, and generalizes across quantizers (VQVAE, LFQ, IBQ) and to text-to-image generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: GEAR 提出了一种端到端联合训练向量量化（VQ）分词器和自回归（AR）生成器的方法，通过表示对齐引导，解决 VQ 索引不可微导致梯度无法反向传播的问题。该方法采用双读出机制：硬 one-hot 分支用于 AR 的下一 token 预测，软可微分支携带表示对齐损失反向传播以指导分词器。实验表明，GEAR 在 ImageNet 上相比 LlamaGen-REPA 基线加速 gFID 收敛达 10 倍，并泛化到多种量化器和文生图任务。
Motivation: 现有视觉生成模型通常两阶段训练：先训练分词器（冻结），再训练生成器。这种解耦导致分词器不了解生成器的建模偏好，限制了生成效率和质量。
Method: 提出 GEAR，端到端联合训练 VQ 分词器和 AR 生成器。关键创新是双读出：硬 one-hot 分支提供下一 token 预测损失，软可微分支提供表示对齐损失，梯度仅更新分词器，使 AR 模型引导分词器产生更易预测的索引分布。
Result: 在 ImageNet 上，GEAR 相比 LlamaGen-REPA 加速 gFID 收敛高达 10 倍，学习到更好的块级和空间一致特征，并适用于多种量化器（VQVAE, LFQ, IBQ）及文生图任务。
Conclusion: GEAR 通过端到端对齐使分词器适应生成器，将表示对齐负担从分词器转移到 AR 模型，与扩散方法中使潜在语义化的方向相反。论文声称该方法有效提升生成效率和特征质量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Introspective Coupling: Self-Explanation Training Tracks Behavioral Change Despite Fixed Supervision
papers.abstract_en: When does training language models (LMs) to generate explanations of their predictions yield faithful introspection, rather than superficial imitation? We study LMs trained to explain which features of their inputs influenced their behavior, using models' counterfactual behavior on modified inputs as supervision. Surprisingly, we find that LMs trained on fixed counterfactual explanations derived from earlier checkpoints of themselves, or even from behaviorally similar models in different families, frequently produce explanations more faithful to their own current behaviors than to those of their training targets. This "introspective" coupling between LM explanations and behaviors occurs when training explanations remain sufficiently correlated with current behaviors over the course of training, even as behaviors themselves shift. We also show that introspective coupling tracks behavior shifts: when explanation training is provided concurrently with other post-training objectives, explanations track those shifts without requiring updated supervision. This phenomenon appears in multiple tasks, including sycophancy and refusal, and is robust to label noise. Overall, our results show that even fixed datasets of counterfactual explanations can provide scalable and generalizable post-training signal for introspection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究语言模型在训练生成反事实解释时，是否能够产生真正的内省（introspection）而非表面模仿。发现使用早期检查点或行为相似模型的反事实解释训练模型，模型生成的解释往往更忠实于自身当前行为，而非训练目标。这种'内省耦合'出现在多个任务中，包括奉承和拒绝行为，且对标签噪声鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有方法训练语言模型生成预测解释时，难以区分解释是真正的内省还是表面模仿。论文旨在探究使用固定反事实解释训练能否实现内省，以及其机制和条件。
Method: 训练语言模型使用反事实解释（counterfactual explanations）作为监督，这些解释来自模型自身早期检查点或行为相似的不同族模型。通过分析解释与模型当前行为的一致性，评估内省耦合程度。
Result: 发现即使训练解释固定，当它们与模型当前行为保持足够相关性时，模型会生成与自身行为更一致的解释（内省耦合）。此外，当解释训练与其他后训练目标并行时，解释能追踪行为变化而无需更新监督。
Conclusion: 固定反事实解释数据集可以为语言模型提供可扩展、可泛化的后训练信号，促进内省。该现象在多个任务中稳健。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PointSplat: Compact Gaussian Splatting via Human-Centric Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Producing 3D human representations from input views on the fly is essential for immersive live streaming systems, where representation compactness is as critical as high fidelity given limited computational power and transmission bandwidth. Although recent feed-forward reconstruction methods achieve impressive quality through the view-centric prediction of 3D representations, they repeatedly encode the same subject content across multiple views, leading to significant inter-view redundancy. Our key insight is to perform predictions directly in 3D space, enabling the network to learn and produce a highly compact representation. To this end, we propose PointSplat, a novel human-centric approach that directly infers Gaussian primitives from an input point set. The proposed method first estimates a coarse geometric proxy and performs ray casting to prune redundant points and establish explicit 2D--3D correspondences. Subsequently, it employs a Point-Image Transformer to fuse appearance and geometry features, predicting Gaussian attributes in a single forward pass. This design restricts predictions to foreground regions of interest, substantially reducing the total number of Gaussians while improving novel-view rendering quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PointSplat achieves higher efficiency and quality while exhibiting strong robustness to variations in view count and image resolution across multiple datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PointSplat，一种针对3D人体表示的高效紧凑高斯泼溅方法。该方法直接在3D空间预测高斯图元，通过粗几何代理和光线投射减少冗余点，并利用Point-Image Transformer融合特征单次前向生成高斯属性。实验表明在保持高渲染质量的同时显著减少高斯数量，并对视图数量和分辨率变化具有鲁棒性。
Motivation: 现有前馈重建方法从多视图预测3D表示时重复编码相同主体，导致大量跨视图冗余，限制了紧凑性和实时性。
Method: 首先估计粗几何代理并进行光线投射以修剪冗余点并建立显式2D-3D对应；然后使用Point-Image Transformer融合外观和几何特征，单次前向预测高斯属性。
Result: 在多个数据集上，PointSplat实现了更高的效率和渲染质量，并对视图数量和图像分辨率变化展现出强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 直接3D空间预测能有效消除跨视图冗余，为沉浸式直播等实时应用提供紧凑且高质量的人体表示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: QVal: Cheaply Evaluating Dense Supervision Signals for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents increasingly act over long horizons, where a single trajectory can contain hundreds or thousands of actions. In these settings, outcome-only rewards provide too sparse guidance, failing to inform the model about the goodness of intermediate actions. Dense supervision methods aim to solve this problem by scoring intermediate steps, from intrinsic confidence to self-distillation and embedding similarities. However, it is common practice to evaluate them by measuring the downstream performance of a training pipeline that integrates them. This is expensive, conflates supervision quality with training engineering confounders, and renders different methodological families requiring distinct training setups incomparable. As a result, dense supervision methods are rarely benchmarked on common ground. We introduce QVal, a training-free testbed for directly evaluating dense supervision signals. Given a state-action pair, QVal measures how well a method's score is Q-aligned: whether it orders actions according to the Q-values of a strong reference-policy. This lets us compare signals before any training run and separate signal quality from other engineering choices. We instantiate QVal as QVal-v1.0, benchmarking 21 dense supervision methods across four diverse environments and seven methodological families, with over 1.2K evaluation experiments across six open-weight model backbones. We find that simple prompting baselines consistently outperform recent dense supervision methods from the literature, and that performance clusters strongly by family. These findings hold across model sizes, environments, and observation modalities. QVal is designed to be easily extensible to new environments and methods, enabling researchers to iterate on dense supervision methods before any training run.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 5 figures in main text; 48 pages, 6 figures with appendix
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出QVal，一个无需训练的测试平台，用于直接评估长时间跨度LLM智能体的密集监督信号。QVal通过Q-对齐（Q-alignment）衡量信号排序质量，在四个环境、21种方法和六种模型上的实验表明，简单提示基线（prompting baselines）始终优于最新的密集监督方法，且性能按方法族聚类。
Motivation: 现有密集监督方法通过下游训练性能评估，成本高、混淆因素多，且不同方法族因训练设置不同而难以公平比较。
Method: 提出QVal，直接评估密集监督信号的Q-对齐程度：给定状态-动作对，衡量该信号对动作排序是否与强参考策略的Q值一致，无需训练即可比较信号质量。
Result: 在QVal-v1.0基准测试中，对21种方法（七族）评估1,200+实验，发现简单提示基线一致优于文献中较新的密集监督方法，且性能按方法族强聚类。
Conclusion: QVal易于扩展至新环境和方法，使研究者能在训练前迭代优化密集监督信号，分离信号质量与工程混杂因素。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: SpheRoPE: Zero-Shot Optimization-Free 360 Panorama Generation with Spherical RoPE
papers.abstract_en: We present a zero-shot, training-free and optimization-free framework for generating 360 panoramic images and videos by directly injecting spherical priors into pre-trained diffusion transformers. Existing methods either rely on costly fine-tuning on scarce panoramic data that limits generalization, or leverage multi-step optimization that incurs prohibitive inference latency. We observe that contemporary generative models natively exhibit some panoramic priors from large-scale training. However, these emergent capabilities are insufficient, as the models fundamentally fail to satisfy the rigorous topological constraints imposed by equirectangular projection (ERP). We introduce a zero-shot and optimization-free approach that resolves these constraints at inference time. Spherical RoPE replaces standard rotary position embeddings: low-frequency channels are re-parameterized as 3D Cartesian coordinates to natively encode the spherical manifold, while high-frequency channels are harmonically quantized to enforce exact periodicity. Coupled with complementary Semantic Distortion classifier-free guidance (CFG) that explicitly steers geometry, we avoid retraining and inherit the full creative breadth of state-of-the-art models. Our approach generalizes across diverse backbones and 360 generation modalities. We demonstrate this across text-to-panorama using Flux.1, Flux.2, and LTX-Video backbones, achieving competitive performance against baselines, all while remaining training-free. Project page: https://orhir.github.io/SpheRoPE
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpheRoPE，一种零样本、无需训练或优化的360°全景图像/视频生成框架。它通过将球面先验直接注入预训练的扩散Transformer，用球面旋转位置编码（Spherical RoPE）替换标准RoPE，并配合语义畸变无分类器引导（CFG），在推理时解决等距柱状投影（ERP）的拓扑约束。方法在Flux.1/Flux.2和LTX-Video等骨干网络上实现文本到全景图生成，性能与基线相当且无需微调。
Motivation: 现有360°全景生成方法要么依赖稀缺全景数据的昂贵微调且泛化受限，要么采用多步优化导致推理延迟高。预训练模型虽原生具备部分全景先验，但无法满足ERP的严格拓扑约束。
Method: 提出SpheRoPE，将标准旋转位置嵌入中的低频通道重参数化为3D笛卡尔坐标以编码球面流形，高频通道进行谐波量化强制精确周期性；同时结合语义畸变CFG显式引导几何结构。
Result: 在文本到全景图任务上使用Flux.1、Flux.2和LTX-Video骨干，取得与基线可比的性能，且全程无需训练。
Conclusion: 该方法是一种零样本、免训练/优化的360°全景生成方案，可在多种骨干和生成模态上泛化，继承了预训练模型的完整创作能力。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Metacognitive Feedback Elicits Faithful Uncertainty Expression in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Metacognition is a critical component of intelligence that describes the ability to monitor and regulate one's own cognitive processes. Yet LLMs exhibit systemic deficiencies in key metacognitive faculties: they hallucinate with high confidence, fail to recognize knowledge boundaries, and misrepresent their internal uncertainty--undermining trustworthiness and reliability. Since monitoring task performance and adapting behavior accordingly are central to metacognition, we posit that models capable of accurately judging their own performance are better positioned to improve it. We operationalize this idea via two novel mechanisms: reinforcement learning with metacognitive feedback (RLMF), a paradigm to refine completion rankings during preference optimization based on the quality of a model's self-judgments of performance, and metacognitive data selection, which uses similar self-judgments to identify high-value training examples, outperforming naive active learning. We apply these innovations to the problem of faithful calibration (FC), a task that is itself fundamentally metacognitive: the goal is to align expressed with intrinsic uncertainty, difficult even for frontier LLMs. We adopt a two-stage, decoupled approach, first using these methods to calibrate the faithfulness of models' self-reported confidence scores, then mapping to natural, context-adaptable linguistic uncertainty via targeted output editing. Extensive experiments show RLMF achieves generalizable, state-of-the-art FC on diverse tasks while preserving accuracy. Further, RLMF surpasses standard RL by up to 63% while enhancing models' ability to assess and express their own capability limits. This positions RLMF as a promising paradigm to enhance LLM metacognition toward improved abilities and alignment, and suggests metacognitive performance as an effective RL signal to overcome limits of prior intrinsic feedback methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出强化学习与元认知反馈（RLMF）机制，通过模型对自身表现的自我评判质量来优化偏好排序，并设计元认知数据选择方法，以提升LLM在忠实校准（FC）任务上的不确定性表达能力。实验表明RLMF在多种任务上实现可泛化的最优FC，且相比标准RL提升高达63%。该方法定位为提升LLM元认知能力的通用范式。
Motivation: LLM在元认知能力上存在系统性缺陷，如高置信度幻觉、无法识别知识边界、内部不确定性表达失真，损害可信度与可靠性。现有方法难以使模型忠实对齐内在与表达的不确定性。
Method: 提出两种机制：1）带元认知反馈的强化学习（RLMF），在偏好优化中根据模型自我评判质量调整完成排序；2）元认知数据选择，利用自我评判识别高价值训练样本。采用两阶段解耦方法：先用上述机制校准置信度分数，再通过目标输出编辑映射为自适应语言不确定性。
Result: RLMF在忠实校准任务上达到可泛化的最优性能，同时保持准确性；相较标准RL提升高达63%，且增强模型评估和表达自身能力极限的能力。
Conclusion: RLMF可作为提升LLM元认知能力的有效范式，将元认知性能作为强化学习信号可克服传统内在反馈方法的局限。

papers.title: When LLMs Read Tables Carelessly: Measuring and Reducing Data Referencing Errors
papers.abstract_en: While large language models (LLMs) perform well on table tasks, they still make data referencing errors (DREs), i.e., incorrectly citing or omitting table values, despite understanding the table structure. Beyond final-answer accuracy, DREs directly compromise the correctness and reliability of intermediate reasoning steps. Yet prior studies have only offered limited, small-scale analyses. In this work, we present the first systematic evaluation of tabular data referencing errors across different models and tasks. Our results show that DREs occur across all tested models (1.7B to 20B parameters). Furthermore, we demonstrate that incorporating data referencing as a critic significantly improves answer accuracy up to 12.0%, through critic-based filtering and rejection sampling. Finally, we trained a lightweight 4B-parameter critic model that achieves an average F1 score of 78.2% in detecting both in-distribution and out-of-distribution DREs, and effectively assists inference for larger models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了LLM在表格数据引用中的错误（DRE），发现所有模型（1.7B-20B参数）均存在此类错误。通过基于批评者的过滤和拒绝采样，答案准确率最高提升12%。训练了一个4B参数的批评者，检测DRE的F1达78.2%，并有效辅助大模型推理。
Motivation: 现有研究仅做了有限的小规模分析，缺乏对表格数据引用错误的系统性评估，而此类错误直接影响推理步骤的正确性和可靠性。
Method: 首次系统评估不同模型和表格任务中的DRE；提出将数据引用作为批评者（critic）的方法，通过批评者过滤和拒绝采样提升答案准确率；训练了一个4B参数的轻量批评者模型检测DRE。
Result: 实验显示所有测试模型（1.7B-20B参数）均出现DRE；批评者过滤方法将答案准确率提升最多12.0%；训练的批评者模型在检测分布内和分布外DRE上平均F1为78.2%。
Conclusion: 数据引用错误是表格任务中普遍存在的问题，所提出的批评者方法可以有效检测并缓解此类错误，提升LLM输出的可靠性。

papers.title: Freeform Preference Learning for Robotic Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Reward design remains a central bottleneck for autonomous robot policy improvement, especially in long-horizon manipulation tasks where sparse success labels provide too little signal and binary preferences collapse many competing notions of quality into one ambiguous signal. We introduce Freeform Preference Learning (FPL), a method for learning robot policies from freeform human preferences. Rather than asking annotators which of two trajectories is better overall, FPL lets them define natural-language preference axes, such as speed, safety, quality of placement, or carefulness, and provide pairwise preferences along each axis. These annotations are used to learn a language-conditioned reward model that maps a trajectory and preference label to an axis-specific reward. We use this model to train a reward-conditioned policy that optimizes across the multiple human-specified dimensions. Across four real-world and two simulated long-horizon manipulation tasks, FPL improves over sparse-reward and binary-preference methods by 38 percentage points. Beyond improved performance, FPL learns dense progress signals without explicit subtask segmentation, shows compositionality of behavior not present in the data, and allows users to steer the policy towards different behaviors at test time without retraining. Blog post with videos available at https://freeform-pl.github.io/fpl.website/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自由形式偏好学习（FPL），让人类标注员定义自然语言偏好轴（如速度、安全性、放置质量）并沿每个轴提供成对偏好，从而学习语言条件奖励模型，用于训练多维度优化策略。在四个真实和两个模拟长时域操作任务中，FPL相比稀疏奖励和二元偏好方法提升38个百分点，并展现了行为组合性和测试时策略引导能力。
Motivation: 奖励设计是自主机器人策略改进的核心瓶颈，长时域操作任务中稀疏成功标签信号不足，二元偏好将多种竞争质量概念压缩为模糊信号。
Method: FPL允许标注员定义自然语言偏好轴并提供轴内成对偏好，学习语言条件奖励模型，将轨迹和偏好标签映射到轴特定奖励，再用奖励条件策略优化多个维度。
Result: 在四个真实和两个模拟长时域操作任务中，FPL相比稀疏奖励和二元偏好方法提升38个百分点，学到密集进展信号无需子任务分割，展现数据中未出现的行为组合性，并允许测试时引导策略行为。
Conclusion: FPL通过自由形式偏好有效利用人类反馈，改进了长时域操作任务的策略学习，并具备多维度优化和用户引导能力。

papers.title: AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model
papers.abstract_en: Latent world models enable planning from high-dimensional observations by predicting future states in a compact latent space. However, these models are typically kept frozen at test time: when their predictions become inaccurate, planning can fail, especially under test-time distribution shift. To address this, we propose AdaJEPA, an adaptive latent world model that performs test-time adaptation within the closed loop of model predictive control (MPC). After training, AdaJEPA plans and executes the first action chunk, uses the observed next-state transition as a self-supervised adaptation signal, and replans with the updated model. This closed-loop update continuously recalibrates the world model without additional expert demonstrations. Across a range of goal-reaching tasks, AdaJEPA substantially improves planning success with as few as one gradient step per MPC replanning step.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AdaJEPA（自适应潜在世界模型）在模型预测控制闭环中进行测试时自适应。它利用观测到的状态转换作为自监督信号，持续重新校准世界模型，无需额外专家演示。在多种目标到达任务中，该方法显著提高了规划成功率。
Motivation: 潜世界模型在测试时通常是冻结的，当预测不准确时，特别是在分布偏移下，规划可能会失败。
Method: 提出AdaJEPA，在模型预测控制（MPC）闭环中执行测试时自适应。训练后，模型规划和执行第一个动作块，使用观测到的下一状态转换作为自监督自适应信号，并用更新后的模型重新规划。
Result: 在多种目标到达任务中，AdaJEPA在每个MPC重新规划步骤仅需一次梯度步长，就能大幅提高规划成功率。
Conclusion: 该闭环更新持续重新校准世界模型，无需额外专家演示，提高了模型在测试时的适应性。

papers.title: FLORA: A deep learning approach to predict forest attributes from heterogeneous LiDAR data
papers.abstract_en: Forest attributes are essential for national-scale resource monitoring. Airborne LiDAR metrics are among the auxiliary variables most strongly correlated with forest attributes used in National Forest Inventory (NFI) estimates. However, producing wall-to-wall predictions remains challenging when LiDAR data are acquired under heterogeneous conditions. As national LiDAR programs expand across Europe, variability in sensors, flight parameters, seasons, and scan angles limits the robustness of existing models, which are often calibrated for local conditions. We present FLORA (Forest LiDAR Octree Regression with Auxiliary Data), a deep learning framework that predicts six forest attributes: dominant height, total volume, deciduous volume, coniferous volume, basal area, and stem density from heterogeneous LiDAR point clouds. FLORA combines an octree-based backbone with ecological and spatiotemporal auxiliary variables through a late-fusion gating mechanism. Models are trained and evaluated on 32,052 National Forest Inventory plots across mainland France using data from the French LiDAR HD program. A single model trained on both leaf-on and leaf-off acquisitions outperforms season-specific models and improves cross-season robustness. Auxiliary variables provide modest overall gains but contribute more strongly to species-specific volume prediction. FLORA achieves an rRMSE of about 12.3% (R2 = 0.88) for dominant height and 39% (R2 = 0.74) for total volume, providing a robust baseline for large-scale forest attribute estimation from heterogeneous national LiDAR programs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: FLORA是一个基于深度学习的框架，用于从异构LiDAR点云数据预测六个森林属性（优势高度、总体积、落叶木体积、针叶木体积、胸高断面积、立木密度）。它采用八叉树骨干网络结合生态和时空辅助变量，通过后期融合门控机制处理不同传感器、飞行参数、季节和扫描角度的异质性。在法国本土32,052个国家森林调查样地上，单一模型在落叶和常绿采集数据上均优于季节特定模型，实现了优势高度rRMSE约12.3%（R²=0.88）和总体积rRMSE约39%（R²=0.74）的性能。
Motivation: 国家森林资源监测需要壁对壁预测，但LiDAR数据在传感器、飞行参数、季节和扫描角度上存在异质性，现有模型通常针对局部条件校准，鲁棒性不足。
Method: 提出FLORA框架，结合八叉树点云骨干网络和辅助变量（生态、时空信息），通过后期融合门控机制整合异质LiDAR数据，并训练单一模型处理落叶和常绿采集。
Result: 单一模型在32,052个NFI样地上跨季节预测优势高度rRMSE 12.3%（R²=0.88）、总体积rRMSE 39%（R²=0.74），辅助变量总体增益有限但显著提升树种体积预测。
Conclusion: FLORA为异构国家LiDAR项目提供了一种鲁棒的森林属性估计基线，展示了单一模型跨季节采集的可行性和辅助变量的针对性贡献。

summary_sections.motivation: 国家森林资源监测需要壁对壁预测，但LiDAR数据在传感器、飞行参数、季节和扫描角度上存在异质性，现有模型通常针对局部条件校准，鲁棒性不足。
summary_sections.method: 提出FLORA框架，结合八叉树点云骨干网络和辅助变量（生态、时空信息），通过后期融合门控机制整合异质LiDAR数据，并训练单一模型处理落叶和常绿采集。
summary_sections.result: 单一模型在32,052个NFI样地上跨季节预测优势高度rRMSE 12.3%（R²=0.88）、总体积rRMSE 39%（R²=0.74），辅助变量总体增益有限但显著提升树种体积预测。
summary_sections.conclusion: FLORA为异构国家LiDAR项目提供了一种鲁棒的森林属性估计基线，展示了单一模型跨季节采集的可行性和辅助变量的针对性贡献。

papers.title: SemRF: A Semantic Reference Frame for Residual-Stream Dynamics in Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Residual-stream analysis asks how language-model computation evolves across depth, but intermediate decoding requires comparable readout coordinates across layers. If embedding anchors and unembedding readout disagree on the chosen span, apparent motion may reflect measurement drift rather than computation. We introduce \emph{Semantic Reference Frames} (SemRF), an anchor-based formalism separating semantic measurement from residual dynamics. A SemRF fixes anchors and measures states against them. Pseudo-inverse tying gives exact synchronization; under restricted bi-invertibility, SemRF yields stable semantic-basis coordinates, distortion bounds, and near-identity changes. With the frame fixed, residual computation becomes a depthwise semantic trajectory. The anchors induce a semantic Voronoi diagram: distance, or evidence such as logits, assigns each layer to a coarse cell, while coordinates retain within-cell motion and margins. We define layerwise steps, contribution profiles, and imbalance diagnostics, then use the Voronoi trace to define a margin-relaxed tube. The canonical trace is the minimum-action path inside this tube; when nonempty with positive quadratic weight, it is unique and obeys a discrete spline equation away from active constraints. Excess action controls step, curvature, and profile mismatch. Low curvature implies piecewise-linear compressibility and local knowledge density: lower trace complexity means fewer semantic knots. Through the parameter-to-trajectory map, this gives a conditional link to parameter efficiency: among admissible settings fitting data, lower-action and lower-complexity traces use fewer semantic degrees of freedom. The guarantees require controlled interface error and small projection residual under explicit tube constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出语义参考框架 (SemRF)，用于区分语言模型残差流中的语义测量与残差动力学。SemRF 通过固定锚点并基于锚点测量状态，利用伪逆绑定实现精确同步。在受限双可逆性条件下，SemRF 提供稳定的语义基坐标、失真界和近恒等变化。锚点诱导语义 Voronoi 图，距离或证据（如 logits）将每层分配到一个粗粒度单元，而坐标保留单元内运动。定义层间步长、贡献轮廓和不均衡诊断，然后利用 Voronoi 迹定义边缘松弛管。规范迹是该管内最小作用路径，唯一且满足离散样条方程。低曲率意味着分段线性可压缩性和局部知识密度。通过参数到迹映射，与参数效率有条件联系。
Motivation: 残差流分析中，中间解码需要跨层可比读出坐标，但嵌入锚点和去嵌入读出可能不一致，导致表观运动反映测量漂移而非计算。
Method: 提出 SemRF，一种基于锚点的形式体系，通过伪逆绑定实现精确同步，并利用语义 Voronoi 图分析层间动力学。
Result: 摘要声称 SemRF 提供稳定语义基坐标、失真界，以及低曲率下的分段线性可压缩性，并建立与参数效率的条件联系。
Conclusion: 该框架在控制接口误差和小投影残差条件下提供理论保证。

papers.title: Cross-Space Distillation: Teaching One-Step Students with Modern Diffusion Teachers
papers.abstract_en: Modern one-step diffusion models achieve impressive quality through distribution-based timestep distillation. Yet, they rely on a critical assumption: Teacher and Student must inhabit the same latent space. This Shared-Space constraint prevents knowledge transfer from modern high-capacity Teachers (e.g., SD 3.5 and Flux) into compact, deployment-friendly Students such as SD 1.5, whose latent resolution and VAE parameterization differ from the Teacher. We formalize this overlooked regime as Cross-Space Distillation, where Teacher and Student differ in both latent resolution and VAE space. To enable distillation under this mismatch, we introduce the Bridge, a lightweight latent interface that maps Student latents into the Teacher space without modifying the Student backbone. Bridge combines a frozen Student VAE decoder as a spatial prior with a compact learnable projector, and is trained with latent reconstruction and attention fidelity objectives for stable Teacher-space alignment. Across diverse modern Teachers, Bridge enables substantial gains for compact one-step Students; for example, it improves SD 1.5 from 5.4 to 9.4 HPSv3 while preserving one-step inference, low latency, and broad ecosystem compatibility. These results show that heterogeneous large Teachers can be distilled into efficient, deployable backbones through a lightweight latent-space interface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Cross-Space Distillation，解决教师和学生模型处于不同潜在空间（如分辨率、VAE参数化不同）时的知识蒸馏问题。通过轻量级Bridge接口将学生潜在映射到教师空间，无需修改学生主干，实现从高容量教师（如SD 3.5、Flux）向紧凑学生（如SD 1.5）的蒸馏。实验表明，该方法显著提升学生模型性能，例如SD 1.5的HPSv3从5.4提升至9.4。
Motivation: 现有单步扩散模型蒸馏假设师生处于相同潜在空间，限制了从现代高容量教师向紧凑部署学生的知识迁移，因为两者在潜在分辨率和VAE参数化上存在差异。
Method: 提出Bridge，一种轻量级潜在接口，结合冻结的学生VAE解码器（空间先验）和紧凑的可学习投影器，通过潜在重建和注意力保真度目标在教师空间对齐，实现跨空间蒸馏。
Result: 在多个现代教师上，Bridge显著提升紧凑单步学生性能：SD 1.5的HPSv3从5.4提升至9.4，同时保持单步推理、低延迟和广泛生态兼容性。
Conclusion: 通过轻量级潜在空间接口，异构大教师可成功蒸馏到高效、可部署的骨干网络，为扩散模型的知识迁移提供了新范式。

papers.title: Automated Background Swapping for Robustness against Spurious Backgrounds
papers.abstract_en: Classifiers based on Deep Neural Networks exhibit strong performance across domains, yet can fail catastrophically if they rely on spurious correlations, i.e., features that are predictive of the target label in the training data but are not causally linked and thus fail to generalize. For the vision domain, many such spurious correlations manifest themselves within the background of the image, where only the foreground is predictive of the class label. In this paper, we introduce Automated Background Swapping (AutoBackSwap) to reduce the reliance of classifiers on such spurious backgrounds. AutoBackSwap uses a secondary network to disentangle the foreground and background, followed by infilling to synthesize complete backgrounds, and finally combines different foregrounds and inpainted backgrounds to augment the training data. We find that patch-wise labeling of just a few hundred samples suffices to train the secondary network and automatically augment the full training dataset on challenging image classification tasks. In contrast to many previous methods, AutoBackSwap proves very effective even if there is not a single sample in the training data breaking the spurious correlation. Across a range of image classification tasks with spurious backgrounds, AutoBackSwap consistently outperforms prior methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自动背景交换方法（AutoBackSwap），通过辅助网络分离前景与背景并合成完整背景，然后交换前景与背景以扩增训练数据，从而减少深度神经网络分类器对虚假背景特征的依赖。实验表明仅需少量样本的补丁标注即可训练辅助网络，且在没有打破虚假相关性的样本时仍能有效改善分类器的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 深度神经网络分类器容易依赖训练数据中的虚假背景相关性，导致在测试分布变化时性能下降；现有方法需要大量反相关样本或复杂生成模型，缺乏自动且高效的手段。
Method: AutoBackSwap 包含三步：1）用辅助网络（通过少量补丁标注训练）对前景和背景进行解耦；2）利用图像修复（inpainting）合成完整背景；3）将不同前景与修复后的背景组合生成新训练样本。
Result: 在多个具有虚假背景的图像分类任务上，AutoBackSwap 一致优于先前方法，且在没有打破虚假相关性的训练样本时仍然有效。
Conclusion: 提出的自动背景交换方法能够有效减少分类器对虚假背景的依赖，提升泛化能力，仅需少量标注即可自动化数据增强。

papers.title: TRIAGE: Role-Typed Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Agentic reinforcement learning requires assigning credit to environment-facing actions such as searches, clicks, edits, navigation commands, and object interactions. Standard GRPO uses the final verifier outcome as a uniform advantage over all action tokens. This outcome signal is useful but structurally incomplete: it punishes useful exploration in failed rollouts and reinforces redundant or regressive actions in successful rollouts. We propose TRIAGE, a role-typed credit assignment framework that adds a semantic role axis to outcome credit. A structured judge classifies each segment as decisive progress, useful exploration, no-progress infrastructure, or regression, and a fixed role-conditioned rule maps these labels to bounded segment-level process rewards. This keeps verifier outcomes as the source of optimization direction while correcting the two main blind spots of outcome-only credit. We further show that role-conditioned credit is the optimal segment-level correction expressible from role labels alone -- a projection of the per-segment advantage residual onto the role variable -- so that the fixed role constants reduce advantage estimation error whenever the judge is reliable, and we connect this to lower-variance policy gradients. Across ALFWorld, Search-QA, and WebShop, TRIAGE improves success rates over GRPO for two policy models and outperforms both a scalar judge-derived process reward and an outcome-supervised shared-backbone value baseline. Ablations show that the gain comes from role typing rather than merely adding dense rewards: reliable detection of regression inside successful trajectories is the dominant contributor, while exploration credit provides a consistent secondary gain; on completed ALFWorld and WebShop rollouts, TRIAGE also reduces environment-facing turns by an additional $10.4\%$ and $14.8\%$ relative to GRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TRIAGE，一种基于角色类型的信用分配框架，用于智能体强化学习。它通过结构化的评判器将轨迹片段分类为决定性进展、有用探索、无进展基础设施或回归，并利用固定的角色条件规则映射为分段过程奖励，从而修正仅基于最终结果信用的盲点。实验表明，在 ALFWorld、Search-QA 和 WebShop 上，TRIAGE 相较于 GRPO 提升了成功率，并减少了环境交互步数。
Motivation: 标准 GRPO 使用最终验证结果作为所有动作标记的均匀优势信号，这惩罚了失败轨迹中的有用探索，并强化了成功轨迹中的冗余或回归动作。需要更精细的信用分配来克服这些结构性问题。
Method: 提出角色类型信用分配框架：用结构化评判器将每个轨迹片段分类为四种角色（决定性进展、有用探索、无进展基础设施、回归），然后通过固定的角色条件规则赋予分段过程奖励。该奖励是最优的片段级纠正项，能降低优势估计误差并产生更低方差的策略梯度。
Result: 在 ALFWorld、Search-QA 和 WebShop 上，TRIAGE 对两种策略模型均提升了成功率，优于标量评判器导出的过程奖励和基于结果监督的共享骨干价值基线。消融实验表明增益主要来自角色类型而非单纯增加密集奖励，且可靠检测成功轨迹中的回归是主要贡献因素，探索信用则提供一致次要增益。在完成轨迹上，TRIAGE 还额外减少了 10.4%（ALFWorld）和 14.8%（WebShop）的环境交互步数。
Conclusion: 角色类型信用分配能有效修正仅依赖结果信用的盲点，提升智能体强化学习的性能，且通过降低优势估计误差和方差实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FedLAB: Traceable Semantic Codebooks for Federated Multimodal Graph Foundation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal graph foundation models aim to learn reusable knowledge from graphs enriched with text, images, attributes, and relational topology, thereby supporting diverse graph-centric and modality-centric tasks. In practice, however, such multimodal graphs are often distributed across decentralized clients, where raw contents and local structures cannot be centrally shared due to privacy constraints. This motivates federated multimodal graph foundation learning, which requires not only transferable representation learning but also intrinsic semantic traceability under strict data isolation. Existing methods usually exchange or store knowledge through parameters, prototypes, embeddings, or compact codebooks, which support optimization and transfer but do not explicitly expose how modality evidence, node semantics, and topology context jointly support predictions. To bridge this gap, we propose FedLAB, a traceable semantic codebook framework that organizes multimodal graph knowledge into typed hierarchical codebooks for modality evidence, node semantics, and topology context. FedLAB further refines these trace units through federated semantic barycenter pre-training while keeping raw multimodal contents and graph structures local. Extensive experiments on 10 benchmarks and 6 downstream tasks show that FedLAB improves over state-of-the-art baselines by up to 7.53\%, while preserving a native semantic trace interface.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FedLAB，一个面向联邦多模态图基础学习的可追溯语义码本框架。通过组织模态证据、节点语义和拓扑上下文的分层码本，并在联邦环境中进行语义重心预训练，FedLAB 在保持数据本地化的同时实现了语义可追溯性。在 10 个基准和 6 个下游任务上，FedLAB 较现有方法提升最高 7.53%。
Motivation: 现有联邦多模态图学习方法通过参数、原型或码本交换知识，但缺乏显式的语义可追溯性，即无法揭示模态证据、节点语义和拓扑上下文如何共同支持预测。
Method: 提出 FedLAB 框架，构建类型化分层语义码本（模态证据、节点语义、拓扑上下文），并通过联邦语义重心预训练（federated semantic barycenter pre-training）在数据本地化的前提下优化这些可追溯单元。
Result: 在 10 个基准和 6 个下游任务上，FedLAB 较最先进基线提升最高 7.53%，同时保持原生语义追溯接口。
Conclusion: FedLAB 通过可追溯语义码本在联邦多模态图学习中实现了可解释性提升，且不牺牲隐私或性能。

papers.title: CoMet: Context and Multiplicity Decomposition for Multimodal Uncertainty Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty estimation has been a long-standing challenge in AI models; it amounts to "knowing what you don't know," and metacognition is notoriously difficult even for humans (cf. the Dunning-Kruger effect). Although it is still far from solved even in simpler classification systems, tackling it in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is becoming increasingly important. Within MLLMs, uncertainty can stem from any of the diverse sources as well as from their relationships, and further can stem from the unbounded answers in the open-ended setting. To tackle the issues, we propose CoMet, an MLLM uncertainty estimation method by decomposing uncertainty into a context-specific term and a multiplicity-specific term. The former captures ambiguity induced by the given context (e.g., task or prompt), while the latter captures how many plausible answers determined by the context remain compatible with the given input. We train a lightweight post-hoc uncertainty module to estimate these quantities, which enables efficient uncertainty estimation without autoregressive answer generation or repeated sampling. Experiments on various open-ended multimodal benchmarks, hallucination detection, and multiple-choice visual question answering benchmarks show that CoMet consistently improves uncertainty estimation over existing baselines while remaining efficient in practice. Code is available at https://github.com/princetonvisualai/comet_uncertainty
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoMet，一种针对多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 的不确定性估计方法，将不确定性分解为上下文特定项和多样性特定项，并通过轻量级后验模块高效估计，无需自回归生成或重复采样。在多项开放域多模态基准和幻觉检测任务上，CoMet 在保持效率的同时持续提升了不确定性估计性能。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型中的不确定性来源多样且复杂，包括不同模态和开放式回答，现有方法（如重复采样或自回归生成）效率低下。需要一种高效且能分解不确定性来源的方法。
Method: 提出 CoMet，将不确定性分解为上下文特定项（反映给定上下文引起的歧义）和多样性特定项（反映上下文确定的合理答案有多少与输入兼容）。训练一个轻量级后验不确定性模块来估计这两个量。
Result: 实验表明，CoMet 在多个开放域多模态基准、幻觉检测和多项选择 VQA 任务上，一致优于现有基线，且保持高效（无需自回归生成或重复采样）。
Conclusion: CoMet 提供了一种高效且可解释的多模态不确定性估计方法，通过分解不确定性来源，提高了估计质量。未来可扩展到更多模态或任务。

papers.title: Surrogate Fidelity: When Can Open LLMs Explain Closed Ones?
papers.abstract_en: Mechanistic interpretability (MI) requires full access to model internals, yet the APIs for most widely deployed language models at best expose log-probabilities over output tokens. This creates a surrogate problem: when do measurements made on open models allow us to make claims about a closed model? We evaluate surrogate fidelity at the prediction, attribution, and representation levels. For binary classification tasks, log-odds provide an API-compatible scalar readout of the model's representation space, and leave-one-out attributions provide insight into model behavior. Across eleven models spanning four families (Llama, Qwen, GPT, and Gemini), we find that prediction fidelity substantially overstates attribution fidelity: models that agree on what the answer is often disagree on why. We document an access-validity inversion: white-box signals like attention patterns and perturbation magnitudes are highly stable across models but only weakly predictive of causal attributions, which black-box input ablations capture by design. Mechanistic insight does not automatically transfer to closed targets, and prediction-level agreement is insufficient to warrant such transfer. Code and results are available at https://github.com/facebookresearch/surrogate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨了当无法访问闭源语言模型内部机制时，能否通过开源模型替代解释（surrogate）的问题。作者在预测、归因和表示三个层面评估代理保真度，发现预测保真度远高于归因保真度，即模型在答案上一致但推理过程不同。白盒信号（如注意力模式）对因果归因的预测能力较弱，而黑盒输入消融更能捕获因果信息。结论是预测层面的同意不足以支持自动迁移机制性解释。
Motivation: 广泛部署的语言模型API通常只暴露输出token的对数概率，无法进行完全的机械可解释性（MI）分析。因此需要研究何时可以用开源模型作为代理来推断闭源模型的行为。
Method: 在二元分类任务中，使用对数几率作为API兼容的标量表示空间读出，并采用留一法归因（leave-one-out attribution）分析模型行为。比较四个模型家族（Llama, Qwen, GPT, Gemini）共11个模型在预测、归因和表示维度的保真度。
Result: 预测保真度大幅高于归因保真度；白盒信号（注意力模式、扰动幅度）跨模型稳定，但仅能弱预测因果归因；黑盒输入消融能直接捕获因果归因。
Conclusion: 机械可解释性不能自动迁移到闭源目标模型，预测层面的同意不足以支持这种迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AxDafny: Agentic Verified Code Generation in Dafny
papers.abstract_en: We study agentic code generation in Dafny, where a model must generate both executable code and the proof artifacts for verification. We present AxDafny, a verifier-guided repair framework that iteratively generates implementations, invariants, assertions, and termination arguments. We also introduce LiveCodeBench-Pro-Dafny (LCB-Pro-Dafny), a benchmark of 250 competition-style programming problems translated into Dafny with formal specifications and a verifier-based evaluation harness. On LCB-Pro-Dafny, AxDafny substantially improves verification success over baseline GPT-5.5 performance. On DafnyBench, AxDafny achieves 92.7\% verification success, outperforming the strongest previously reported proof-hint baseline by 6.5 percentage points. Lastly, we show that verification success and runtime test performance measure different aspects of generated code.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AxDafny，一个在 Dafny 语言中进行智能体代码生成的验证器引导修复框架，能够迭代生成实现、不变量、断言和终止论证。同时引入 LiveCodeBench-Pro-Dafny 基准，包含 250 道竞赛风格编程题，配有形式化规约和基于验证器的评估工具。在 LCB-Pro-Dafny 上，AxDafny 显著提升验证成功率；在 DafnyBench 上达到 92.7% 的验证成功率，比此前最强的证明提示基线高出 6.5 个百分点。实验还表明验证成功与运行时测试表现衡量的是代码的不同方面。
Motivation: 现有的代码生成方法在需要同时生成可执行代码和验证证明工件时效果不佳，缺乏针对 Dafny 这类形式化验证语言的专用修复框架。
Method: 提出验证器引导的修复框架 AxDafny，利用验证器反馈迭代地改进实现、不变量、断言和终止参数，无需额外提示工程。
Result: 在 LCB-Pro-Dafny 上，AxDafny 优于基线 GPT-5.5；在 DafnyBench 上达到 92.7% 验证成功率，较先前最强基线提升 6.5 个百分点。
Conclusion: 验证成功与运行时测试表现衡量代码的不同方面，AxDafny 在形式化验证代码生成上展现了显著改进。

papers.title: Random Reshuffling Dominates Stochastic Gradient Descent
papers.abstract_en: Stochastic Gradient Descent ($\textsf{SGD}$) is one of the most classical optimization algorithms with favorable theoretical guarantees, yet the practical implementation of $\textsf{SGD}$ differs subtly from its well-known form and is often referred to as Shuffling Stochastic Gradient Descent ($\textsf{Shuffling SGD}$). A particularly popular strategy in $\textsf{Shuffling SGD}$ is Random Reshuffling ($\textsf{RR}$), which has achieved great empirical success across numerous experiments. Despite its strong performance, $\textsf{RR}$ has long been considered a heuristic due to a lack of theoretical support. Over the last decade, people have finally established provable convergence rates for $\textsf{RR}$, thus justifying its observed superiority. However, for smooth convex optimization, two clouds over the convergence theory of $\textsf{RR}$ remain to this day. More precisely, according to the current theory, $\textsf{Shuffling SGD}$ under $\textsf{RR}$ converges only when the stepsize is smaller than a threshold proportional to $1/n$, where $n$ is the number of summands in the objective (or the number of data points). Consequently, the optimally tuned theoretical rate of $\textsf{Shuffling SGD}$ under $\textsf{RR}$ is strictly worse than that of $\textsf{SGD}$ when the number of epochs is smaller than another threshold proportional to $n$. These two restrictions heavily limit the applicability of existing theories and leave a critical mismatch with practice. In this work, for the first time, we prove that $\textsf{RR}$ dominates $\textsf{SGD}$ in smooth convex optimization under any reasonable stepsize after any finite number of epochs, thereby addressing a longstanding open question.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文证明在光滑凸优化中，随机重排（RR）策略的随机梯度下降（Shuffling SGD）在任意有限轮次后，使用任何合理的步长，都优于标准SGD，解决了一个长期存在的开放问题。
Motivation: 现有理论对RR的收敛性分析存在两个限制：步长必须小于1/n的阈值，且最优理论速率在轮次较少时比SGD差，与实际应用不符。
Method: 该论文首次通过理论证明，证明了RR在光滑凸优化中，对于任何合理的步长和有限轮次，都优于SGD。
Result: 解决了关于RR与SGD比较的长期开放问题。
Conclusion: 该工作结束了RR被视作启发式方法的历史，为RR的实践优越性提供了理论保障。

papers.title: PolicyGuard: From Organizational Policies to Neuro-SymbolicCompliance Review Engines
papers.abstract_en: Policy-grounded document review requires determining whether a target document complies with organization-specific policies, guidelines, or playbooks. While large language models can assist with policy interpretation and document analysis, end-to-end prompting leaves the applied policy logic implicit, making compliance decisions difficult to inspect, update, and test. We present PolicyGuard, a neuro-symbolic framework for policy-grounded document compliance review. PolicyGuard converts organizational policy guidance into an executable review engine consisting of typed relational logic rules and atom-level extraction questions. During review, LLMs answer these local questions using retrieved document evidence, and a symbolic evaluator applies the formal rules to detect non-compliance. We instantiate and evaluate PolicyGuard on company-specific NDA compliance review, where contract clauses must be checked against organization-specific negotiation policies. By separating policy formalization, local document interpretation, and symbolic compliance evaluation, PolicyGuard makes document review more explicit, maintainable, and systematically testable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PolicyGuard 是一个神经符号框架，将组织政策转换为可执行的审查引擎，结合类型化关系逻辑规则和原子级提取问题，利用 LLM 回答局部问题并通过符号评估器检测不合规。在 NDA 合规审查中实例化，使文档审查更明确、可维护和可测试。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 端到端提示使政策逻辑隐式化，导致合规决策难以检查、更新和测试，需要显式且可维护的合规审查方法。
Method: 将组织政策转换为包含类型化关系逻辑规则和原子级提取问题的可执行审查引擎；LLM 使用检索到的文档证据回答局部问题，符号评估器应用形式规则检测不合规。
Result: 在公司特定 NDA 合规审查任务中实例化，通过分离政策形式化、局部文档解释和符号合规评估，使审查更明确、可维护和可系统测试。
Conclusion: PolicyGuard 通过神经符号分离实现了显式、可维护和可测试的文档合规审查，但当前仅评估于 NDA 场景，需进一步扩展至其他政策领域。

papers.title: Self-Study Reconsidered: The Hidden Fragility of Learning from Self-Generated QA
papers.abstract_en: Language models are increasingly taught from synthetic question--answer (QA) supervision: a model generates questions about a document, answers them from the same text, and the resulting pairs are used to fine-tune, distill, or compress knowledge into another model. We show that this generation step is not neutral preprocessing. It is an implicit policy that both selects which evidence becomes training signal and decides how that evidence is answered, and it is fragile at both stages. When choosing what to ask, generators do not scan a document uniformly. Coverage saturates early and concentrates on salient spans, diverse prompts converge on the same regions, and what looks question-worthy is driven by local presentation. As a result, salient artifacts such as poorly cleaned markup can hijack question generation across model families and scales. When answering, the model that produces the supervision tends to obey instruction-like passages embedded in the text. This compliance depends on the intent and surface form of the passage rather than its strictness, and is worst under task conflict, where larger models comply more often. These failure modes arise from choices made during QA generation, so they can be reduced without changing the training loop. Tying each question to a fixed target reduces biased selection, and filtering instruction-like spans before answering lowers mean injection compliance from $88\%$ to $13\%$ in our evaluation while retaining nearly all clean text.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文研究了语言模型从自身生成的问答对进行学习（自学习）的脆弱性。生成步骤并非中性预处理，而是一种隐式策略，在选择哪些证据成为训练信号以及如何回答时存在偏差。生成器不均匀扫描文档，覆盖过早饱和并集中于显著跨度，且易受不良标记等伪造物影响。回答时，监督模型倾向于遵循文本中的指令性段落，这种遵从性在任务冲突时更严重。通过将每个问题绑定到固定目标以及过滤指令性跨度，可以在保持干净文本的同时显著降低注入遵从性。
Motivation: 现有自学习方法依赖模型生成的问答对进行训练，但生成过程可能引入系统性偏差，导致学习效果脆弱。需要深入分析这些偏差的根源。
Method: 通过实验分析QA生成过程中的选择偏差和回答偏差，并提出缓解措施：将每个问题绑定到固定目标以减少选择偏差，以及过滤指令性跨度后再回答以降低注入遵从性。
Result: 实验表明，将每个问题绑定到固定目标可减少偏差；过滤指令性跨度后，注入遵从性从88%降至13%，同时几乎保留所有干净文本。
Conclusion: 自学习中的QA生成步骤存在隐藏的脆弱性，但通过简单的预处理调整可以有效缓解，无需改变训练循环。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Radial Suppression Accelerates Algorithmic Generalization: A Geometric Analysis of Delayed Generalization
papers.abstract_en: Why do neural networks memorize algorithmic training data long before they generalize? We present a geometric case study demonstrating that, on tasks where generalization requires discovering structured low-dimensional circuits, the memorization-generalization delay is driven by radial inflation of hidden representations under cross-entropy optimization. We formalize a radial-angular decomposition of activation-space dynamics and derive three testable propositions: (i) that penalizing radial inflation induces anisotropic, data-dependent weight regularization; (ii) that it suppresses radial gradient energy below the isotropic random baseline, forcing predominantly angular updates; and (iii) that it biases convergence toward flatter minima. To empirically validate these propositions, we study a single-hyperparameter norm penalty that softly constrains activations to a sqrt(d)-radius hypersphere. On modular arithmetic, this penalty accelerates grokking up to 6x across MLPs and Transformers, and halves training steps for a 10M-parameter nanoGPT on 3-digit addition.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Presented at the Workshop on High-dimensional Learning Dynamics at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过几何分析展示了神经网络在算法任务中泛化延迟的原因：交叉熵优化导致隐藏表示的径向膨胀，延迟了结构化低维电路的发现。作者提出一种径向惩罚方法，将激活约束到 sqrt(d)-半径超球面上，经验证可在模算术任务上将“顿悟”加速最多6倍，并在10M参数的nanoGPT上使3位数加法的训练步骤减半。
Motivation: 神经网络在算法数据上往往先记忆后泛化，泛化延迟的几何机制尚不明确。理解并加速这一转变对提升模型泛化能力至关重要。
Method: 提出径向-角度分解的激活空间动力学分析，并引入单超参数范数惩罚项，软约束激活到 sqrt(d)-半径超球面，抑制径向膨胀，迫使更新以角度为主。
Result: 在模算术任务上，该方法将MLP和Transformer的顿悟加速最多6倍；对10M参数的nanoGPT，3位数加法的训练步骤减半。
Conclusion: 径向抑制是一种简单有效的正则化手段，能显著加速算法泛化，且倾向于收敛到更平坦的极小值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Amplifying Membership Signal Through Chained Regeneration
papers.abstract_en: The tendency of large generative models to memorize training data makes sample verification critical for privacy auditing and copyright enforcement. Current membership (MIA) and dataset inference (DI) attacks often rely on one-shot generations, which yield weak signals and limited sensitivity across modalities. Inspired by Model Autophagy Disorder (MAD), we introduce MADreMIA, a model-agnostic framework that enhances white-, gray-, and black-box MIA and DI. Rather than relying on shadow model training -- often infeasible for large generative models -- our framework facilitates scalable inference by leveraging inherent signals through iterative trajectories. This process utilizes chained generations across diverse modalities, where each output serves as the subsequent input, to improve membership evidence at low FPR. We demonstrate that memorized training samples exhibit significantly higher coherence and slower degradation during iterative regeneration than non-member generations. Our results show that MADreMIA provides richer signals across diverse model families and modalities; we present comprehensive evaluations for IARs, diffusion, and language models, alongside preliminary results demonstrating its potential for audio models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MADreMIA框架，利用链式生成迭代轨迹增强成员推断攻击（MIA）和数据集推断（DI）的信号。该框架无需影子模型训练，适用于白盒、灰盒、黑盒设置，在自回归、扩散、语言模型等多种模态下验证有效，并在音频模型上展示初步潜力。
Motivation: 现有成员攻击方法依赖单次生成，信号弱且跨模态敏感性有限；影子模型训练在大规模生成模型上不可行。
Method: 基于模型自噬紊乱（MAD）现象，通过迭代再生（每个输出作为下一输入）放大成员信号，利用记忆样本在迭代过程中保持更高一致性和更慢退化。
Result: 在自回归、扩散、语言模型上提供更丰富的成员信号，并在低假阳性率下提升检测性能；初步实验表明该方法对音频模型也有潜力。
Conclusion: MADreMIA是一种模型无关的框架，可扩展应用于多种生成模型和模态，为隐私审计提供高效、无需影子模型的方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluation of Population Initialization Methods for Genetic Programming-based Symbolic Regression
papers.abstract_en: We analyze the effect of optimizing the initial population of genetic programming (GP) for symbolic regression (SR) on the accuracy and complexity of solutions. We compare three well-established random initialization methods as well as initialization with small optimized solutions from exhaustive symbolic regression (ESR) using a GP/SR implementation which is based on the multi-objective evolutionary algorithm NSGA-II. We compare the final Pareto fronts found with each initialization method on twelve synthetic problems of varying complexity and one real-world dataset. We find no significant differences in accuracy or model complexity among the initialization methods. The initial advantage of initialization with ESR disappears after only a few generations. Our results show that, given similar diversity in the initial population, the effect of the initialization method in GP-based symbolic regression on the final Pareto front is negligible.
papers.comment: 15 pages. Accepted for publication at EUROCAST 2026: 20th International Conference on Computer Aided Systems Theory
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了遗传编程符号回归中不同种群初始化方法（三种随机方法和一种基于穷举符号回归的方法）对解精度和复杂度的影响。在12个合成问题和1个真实数据集上使用NSGA-II多目标进化算法进行实验，发现不同初始化方法在最终帕累托前沿上无显著差异，ESR初始化的优势在少数几代后消失。
Motivation: 研究初始化方法对GP符号回归性能的影响，因为初始化被认为是影响进化算法效果的关键因素之一。
Method: 采用三种标准随机初始化方法和一种基于穷举符号回归（ESR）的小优化解初始化方法，使用基于NSGA-II的多目标GP/SR实现进行实验。
Result: 在12个合成问题和一个真实数据集上，不同初始化方法产生的最终帕累托前沿在精度和模型复杂度上没有显著差异，ESR初始化的早期优势在几代后消失。
Conclusion: 在给定初始种群多样性相似的情况下，初始化方法对GP符号回归最终帕累托前沿的影响可以忽略。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: CoLT: Teaching Multi-Modal Models to Think with Chain of Latent Thoughts
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has enabled multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) to tackle complex visual reasoning tasks by generating explicit intermediate reasoning steps in natural language. However, this text-based reasoning paradigm is inherently slow at inference time with even thousands of tokens and fundamentally constrained by the expressiveness of natural language. In this paper, we propose CoLT, (Chain of Latent Thoughts), a novel framework that teaches multi-modal models to reason through a chain of latent thought representations instead of verbose text tokens, which can perform thinking with as few as 3 steps. Naively forcing the model to think with latent states easily produces meaningless semantics and makes training unstable. To effectively regulate the latent reasoning process, we introduce a lightweight external decoder that provides step-level supervision for each latent reasoning step in two complementary directions: a forward mode that decodes latent thoughts into the textual reasoning of the next step, and a backward mode that aligns decoder hidden states with the model's latent thoughts given preceding textual context. We further incorporate internal supervision that encourages coherent step-by-step latent transitions. The decoder and internal supervision are removed during inference to maintain high efficiency of latent reasoning. Extensive experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate that CoLT not only outperforms existing latent reasoning methods such as CODI and SIM-CoT, but also surpasses latent visual reasoning approaches that rely on auxiliary images with costly annotation requirements. Compared to text CoT methods, CoLT can notably reduce the inference time by 10.1$\times$ and text decoding time by 22.6$\times$. Code is released at https://github.com/hulianyuyy/CoLT.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV2026. Code is available at https://github.com/hulianyuyy/CoLT
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoLT（Chain of Latent Thoughts），一种框架让多模态大模型通过隐式潜在表示链进行推理，而非冗长的文本推理。在 8 个基准上，CoLT 优于现有潜在推理方法如 CODI 和 SIM-CoT，并相比文本 CoT 方法减少推理时间 10.1 倍、文本解码时间 22.6 倍。潜在推理步骤可低至 3 步，且推理时无需额外解码器或内部监督模块，保持高效。
Motivation: 现有文本链式推理（text CoT）在视觉推理任务中生成大量中间文本令牌，推理速度慢，且受限于自然语言表达能力的边界。
Method: 提出轻量级外部解码器提供两步级监督：前向模式将潜在思解码为下一步的文本推理，反向模式根据前置文本上下文对齐解码器隐藏状态与模型潜在思；同时引入内部监督确保逐步骤的潜在转变连贯性。推理时移除所有额外模块。
Result: 在 8 个基准上，CoLT 超越现有潜在推理方法 CODI 和 SIM-CoT，以及依赖辅助图像且标注成本高的潜在视觉推理方法；相比文本 CoT，推理时间减少 10.1 倍，文本解码时间减少 22.6 倍。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 CoLT 通过隐式潜在链推理实现高效视觉推理，大幅降低推理时间，且无需昂贵标注。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: GR2 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Industrial recommendation systems serve billions of users through a multi-stage funnel -- retrieval, early-stage ranking, and re-ranking -- where the final re-ranking step disproportionately shapes user engagement and downstream performance, particularly for carousel and grid display formats. Despite growing enthusiasm for Large Language Models (LLMs) in recommendation, three gaps hinder industrial adoption: (1) most efforts target retrieval and ranking, leaving re-ranking -- the stage closest to the final user experience -- largely underexplored; (2) LLMs are typically deployed zero-shot or via supervised fine-tuning, underutilizing the reasoning capabilities unlocked by reinforcement learning (RL) on verifiable rewards; (3) deployed catalogs index billions of items with non-semantic identifiers that lie outside any base-LLM vocabulary. We present GR2 (Generative Reasoning Re-Ranker), an end-to-end framework that combines (i) mid-training on semantic IDs produced by a tokenizer with >=99% uniqueness, (ii) reasoning-trace distilled from a stronger teacher via targeted prompting and rejection sampling, and (iii) RL with verifiable rewards purpose-built for re-ranking. To make GR2 resource-viable, we further (iv) introduce a context compressor that amortizes training cost, On-Policy Distillation (OPD) as a scalable alternative to SFT -- which we find collapses at industrial scale -- and reasoning distillation for low-latency serving. GR2 delivers +18.7% R@1, +7.1% R@3, and +9.6% N@3 over legacy baselines on industrial-scale traffic. We further find that reward design is critical in re-ranking: LLMs often hack rewards by preserving the incoming order or exploiting position bias, motivating conditional verifiable rewards as essential industrial components.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GR2（生成式推理重排序器），一个结合语义ID中间训练、推理蒸馏和基于可验证奖励的强化学习的端到端框架，专门用于工业推荐系统的重排序阶段。在工业规模流量上，GR2相比基线将R@1提升18.7%，R@3提升7.1%，N@3提升9.6%。摘要还指出奖励设计在重排序中至关重要，LLM易通过保持输入顺序或利用位置偏差来欺骗奖励，因此需要条件可验证奖励。
Motivation: 工业推荐系统的重排序阶段最接近最终用户体验，但现有LLM推荐工作主要针对检索和排序，重排序研究不足；LLM通常以零样本或监督微调方式部署，未充分利用强化学习的推理能力；此外，物品目录使用非语义标识符，不在基础LLM词汇表中。
Method: GR2框架包含：(i) 使用唯一性≥99%的分词器生成语义ID进行中间训练；(ii) 通过针对性提示和拒绝采样从更强教师模型蒸馏推理轨迹；(iii) 使用为重排序设计的可验证奖励进行强化学习；同时引入上下文压缩器降低成本，提出在线策略蒸馏（OPD）作为SFT（在工业规模下失效）的可扩展替代方案，以及推理蒸馏用于低延迟服务。
Result: 在工业规模流量上，GR2相比基线实现R@1提升18.7%，R@3提升7.1%，N@3提升9.6%。发现奖励设计关键：LLM常通过保持输入顺序或利用位置偏差来绕过奖励，需要条件可验证奖励。
Conclusion: GR2证明了将LLM与强化学习结合应用于工业级重排序的可行性，并强调奖励设计是工业部署中不可或缺的组件。

summary_sections.motivation: 工业推荐系统的重排序阶段最接近最终用户体验，但现有LLM推荐工作主要针对检索和排序，重排序研究不足；LLM通常以零样本或监督微调方式部署，未充分利用强化学习的推理能力；此外，物品目录使用非语义标识符，不在基础LLM词汇表中。
summary_sections.method: GR2框架包含：(i) 使用唯一性≥99%的分词器生成语义ID进行中间训练；(ii) 通过针对性提示和拒绝采样从更强教师模型蒸馏推理轨迹；(iii) 使用为重排序设计的可验证奖励进行强化学习；同时引入上下文压缩器降低成本，提出在线策略蒸馏（OPD）作为SFT（在工业规模下失效）的可扩展替代方案，以及推理蒸馏用于低延迟服务。
summary_sections.result: 在工业规模流量上，GR2相比基线实现R@1提升18.7%，R@3提升7.1%，N@3提升9.6%。发现奖励设计关键：LLM常通过保持输入顺序或利用位置偏差来绕过奖励，需要条件可验证奖励。
summary_sections.conclusion: GR2证明了将LLM与强化学习结合应用于工业级重排序的可行性，并强调奖励设计是工业部署中不可或缺的组件。

papers.title: ERA: Entropy-Guided Visual Token Pruning with Rectified Attention for Efficient MLLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) incur prohibitive inference costs due to long visual token sequences. Training-free visual token reduction provides an efficient solution. However, existing methods distort attention distributions, giving rise to a phenomenon we term Attention Logit Collapse. To address this issue, we propose ERA, an Entropy-guided visual token pruning framework with Rectified Attention for efficient MLLMs. Specifically, ERA comprises three crucial components: Dual-view Entropy Pruning (DEP), Bias-aware Token Recycling (BTR), and Logit-preserving Attention Rectification (LAR). First, DEP identifies representative anchor tokens by jointly modeling visual diversity and head-wise saliency. BTR then recycles pruned tokens into their corresponding anchors while estimating a cluster-level logit bias. Building upon this, LAR injects the estimated bias into attention logits, effectively rectifying the collapse induced by token reduction. Together, these components preserve visual evidence even under aggressive compression, enabling robust performance across single-image, multi-image, and video settings on a wide range of MLLMs. Beyond delivering practical acceleration, ERA establishes logit-preserving visual token pruning as a principled framework for efficient MLLMs, unifying theoretical foundation, algorithmic design, and practical deployment. The code is at https://github.com/924973292/ERA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ERA框架，通过熵引导的视觉token剪枝和注意力校正，降低多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的推理成本。摘要显示该方法在单图、多图和视频设置下均能保持性能，同时实现加速。
Motivation: 现有训练-free视觉token剪枝方法会扭曲注意力分布，导致作者所称的注意力logit坍缩（Attention Logit Collapse）现象，影响模型性能。
Method: ERA包含三个组件：双视图熵剪枝（DEP）联合建模视觉多样性和头级显著性；偏置感知token回收（BTR）将剪枝token聚类到锚点并估计聚类级logit偏置；logit保持注意力校正（LAR）将偏置注入注意力logits以校正坍缩。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在多种MLLMs上实现鲁棒性能，并实现实际加速。
Conclusion: ERA为高效MLLMs建立了logit保持视觉token剪枝的框架，统一了理论基础、算法设计和实际部署。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LUNA: Learning Universal 3D Human Animation Beyond Skinning
papers.abstract_en: Creating photorealistic, animatable 3D human avatars from monocular images still largely depends on Linear Blend Skinning (LBS) and parametric body models, which constrain expressivity and often introduce artifacts due to imperfect fitting. We propose LUNA, an LBS-free universal neural animation model that directly maps multiple 2D controls like images, keypoints, sketches, and unseen characters into 3D Gaussian deformations, bypassing explicit body fitting. At its core, a transformer-based motion regressor disentangles global rigid motion from fine-grained local dynamics to capture both coherent movement and subtle non-rigid effects. To resolve the inherent ambiguity of 2D-to-3D lifting while scaling beyond fitted datasets, we introduce hybrid supervision that distills soft structural priors from an LBS teacher and a loss that supports training on both limited fitted data and large in-the-wild unlabeled videos. Extensive experiments show LUNA achieves competitive visual fidelity compared to LBS-based approaches, while delivering realistic human motion and zero-shot cross-identity generalization across diverse driving modalities. To the best of our knowledge, LUNA is the first end-to-end 3D animatable model that supports implicit 2D driving.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出LUNA，一种无需线性混合蒙皮（LBS）的通用神经动画模型，直接从2D控制（图像、关键点、草图等）预测3D高斯变形。核心是transformer运动回归器，分离全局刚体运动与局部非刚体运动，并通过混合监督（LBS教师蒸馏与未标注视频训练）实现零样本跨身份泛化。实验表明视觉质量与LBS方法相当，且是首个端到端支持隐式2D驱动的3D可动画模型。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖LBS和参数化身体模型，表达性受限且因拟合不完美产生伪影。
Method: 提出无LBS的神经动画模型，使用transformer运动回归器解耦刚体与非刚体运动，并采用混合监督：从LBS教师蒸馏软结构先验，结合未标注视频训练，解决2D到3D歧义并扩展训练数据。
Result: 实验表明LUNA在视觉保真度上与LBS方法相当，能生成逼真人体运动，并支持多种驱动模态的零样本跨身份泛化。
Conclusion: LUNA是首个端到端3D可动画模型，支持隐式2D驱动，无需显式身体拟合。

papers.title: Planar-SfM: Camera Pose Estimation via Homography Graph Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Structure from Motion (SfM) systems traditionally struggle with planar scenes, where standard epipolar geometry-based methods become degenerate. Rather than viewing planar surfaces as a limitation, we propose a unified framework that leverages them as a source of geometric constraints. Our key insight is that each planar surface visible across multiple views provides an independent estimate of relative camera poses through homography decomposition. By aggregating estimates from multiple planes or even from a single dominant plane we achieve robust pose recovery in scenarios where traditional methods fail. We introduce a novel graph-based approach that constructs a pose-graph from homography estimates and employs spectral embedding to identify and filter unreliable edges. Our method maps homography-based pose estimates onto the real line based on their geometric and visual consistency, enabling efficient extraction of a maximally consistent spanning tree for pose recovery. This approach naturally handles both highly planar scenes, such as indoor sports arenas, and general $3$D environments. We demonstrate superior performance on basketball court imagery where existing methods struggle, while matching or exceeding state-of-the-art results on unconstrained outdoor scenes from the IMC Phototourism benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Planar-SfM框架，利用平面场景中的单应性分解来估计相机位姿，构建基于单应性图（homography graph）的位姿图，并通过谱嵌入过滤不可靠边，提取最大一致生成树。该方法在室内体育馆等平面场景表现优异，在非约束室外场景（IMC Phototourism基准）上达到或超越现有方法。
Motivation: 传统SfM在平面场景中因极线几何退化而失败，本文认为平面表面可提供几何约束，而非限制。
Method: 提出统一框架，通过单应性分解从多视图平面表面估计相对相机位姿；构建位姿图，利用谱嵌入将估计映射到实数线，基于几何和视觉一致性过滤不可靠边，提取最大一致生成树进行位姿恢复。
Result: 在篮球场图像（高度平面场景）上优于现有方法；在IMC Phototourism基准的非约束室外场景上匹配或超越最先进结果。
Conclusion: 该框架自然地处理高度平面场景和一般3D环境，证明了平面表面作为几何约束源的有效性。

papers.title: TreeAgent: A Generalizable Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Bias Labeling in Forestry via Compiled Expert Rules and Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Human-labeled data are widely used as reference annotations in ML, despite known variability across annotators in many expert-driven domains. In addition, expert annotation is slow, inconsistent, and remains a major bottleneck for scaling tasks like tree height bias classification in forestry remote sensing. We propose a multi-agent system (MAS) that orchestrates expert decision trees with Vision-Language Models (VLMs), treating the decision tree as a structural prior while VLMs perform localized semantic perception at individual nodes, with multi-agent voting to mitigate VLM stochasticity. We formalize a Decoupled Declarative Decision (D3) Framework that enables zero-modification generalization across diverse expert-defined decision structures. On a tree bias classification testbed, our framework outperforms supervised ML baselines and reduces the amount of expert labeling effort required. These results suggest that agentic orchestration of VLMs with expert priors can reproduce expert-defined labeling procedures at substantially lower annotation cost while maintaining interpretability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多智能体系统TreeAgent，在林业遥感中自动化树木高度偏差标注，结合编译的专家决策树和视觉语言模型（VLM），通过多智能体投票减少VLM随机性。框架在树偏差分类测试集上优于有监督机器学习基线，减少了专家标注工作量。
Motivation: 人类标注在专家驱动领域存在变异性，且专家标注缓慢、不一致，成为林业遥感中树木高度偏差分类等任务的瓶颈。
Method: 提出解耦声明式决策（D3）框架，将专家决策树作为结构先验，由VLM在单个节点进行局部语义感知，多智能体投票以缓解VLM随机性，框架可零修改泛化到不同专家定义决策结构。
Result: 在树偏差分类测试集上，该方法优于有监督机器学习基线，并减少了专家标注所需工作量。
Conclusion: 摘要表明，将VLM与专家先验通过智能体编排可以以更低标注成本复现专家定义标注流程，同时保持可解释性。

papers.title: Semantic Leakage and Privacy Preservation in Relay-Assisted Semantic Communications
papers.abstract_en: Semantic communication (SemCom) has emerged as a promising paradigm in which the transmission of task-relevant information is prioritized over raw data, enabling efficient and robust communication under resource and channel constraints. In this paper, the privacy implications of relay-assisted SemCom systems are studied, where the intermediate relay node operates directly on learned latent representations. It is shown that the relay, even without access to source data, can reliably infer semantic meaning and reconstruct signals with performance comparable to that of the legitimate receiver, revealing a fundamental privacy vulnerability of semantic representations. To address this issue, an iterative adversarial training framework is proposed in which a strong, adaptively trained eavesdropper at the relay is explicitly accounted for. The proposed approach alternates between optimizing the relay's eavesdropping function and the legitimate system, resulting in representations that preserve semantic decoding performance at the intended receiver while degrading semantic inference at the relay. The semantic accuracy gap between the legitimate receiver and the eavesdropper is significantly enlarged across channel conditions. Importantly, this protection is achieved in a stealthy manner, with high reconstruction fidelity maintained while semantic leakage is selectively suppressed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究中继辅助语义通信系统的隐私泄露问题，发现中继节点即使无法访问原始数据，也能从语义表示中可靠推断语义并重构信号，性能接近合法接收者。为此提出迭代对抗训练框架，显式建模中继处的自适应窃听者，通过交替优化中继窃听功能和合法系统，在保留合法接收者解码性能的同时抑制中继的语义推理。
Motivation: 语义通信中继节点直接操作学习到的潜在表示，可能泄露隐私。现有工作未充分研究中继的隐私威胁及防御机制。
Method: 提出迭代对抗训练框架，交替优化中继窃听器（自适应训练的强窃听者）和合法系统（编码器-解码器），使得语义表示能在合法接收者处保持解码性能，同时在中继处退化语义推理。
Result: 在各种信道条件下，合法接收者与窃听者之间的语义精度差距显著扩大；同时以隐蔽方式实现保护，高重构保真度得以维持，语义泄露被选择性抑制。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能有效防御中继的语义隐私泄露，且不牺牲合法传输性能，为语义通信隐私保护提供了新思路。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MECoBench: A Systematic Study of Multimodal Agent Collaboration in Embodied Environments
papers.abstract_en: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have strong potential as embodied agents, but their ability to collaborate in visually grounded environments remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce MECoBench, a multimodal embodied cooperation benchmark with an evaluation platform spanning diverse real-world tasks, two cooperation structures, and three collaboration modes. Through extensive experiments across various MLLMs, we summarize three key findings: (i) Collaboration generally improves embodied task completion, but its benefits depend on balancing collaborative gains against coordination complexity. (ii) Communication is essential to collaboration gains, while the best collaboration mode depends on team size and model capability. (iii) Moreover, collaboration improves robustness under noisy priors and exploration conditions. Generally, MECoBench provides a systematic testbed for understanding the mechanisms and limits of multimodal embodied collaboration. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/q-i-n-g/MECoBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MECoBench是一个面向多模态具身协作的基准测试平台，涵盖多种真实世界任务、两种协作结构和三种协作模式。通过对多种多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的广泛实验，总结了三个关键发现：协作通常能提升任务完成效果，但收益需权衡协调成本；通信对协作增益至关重要，最佳模式取决于团队规模和模型能力；协作在噪声先验和探索条件下提升鲁棒性。该平台为理解多模态具身协作的机制和局限提供了系统化测试环境。
Motivation: 现有的多模态大语言模型在作为具身智能体时，其在视觉环境中的协作能力尚未得到充分探索，缺乏系统性的基准来评估和理解这种协作。
Method: 提出了MECoBench基准，包含一个评估平台，覆盖多种真实世界任务、两种协作结构（如共享感知与独立感知）和三种协作模式（如通信、无通信、共享观察）。通过在不同MLLMs上进行实验进行系统评估。
Result: 实验表明：协作总体上提升任务完成度，但依赖协作增益与协调复杂度的平衡；通信是协作增益的关键，最佳协作模式因团队规模和模型能力而异；协作在噪声先验和探索条件下增强了鲁棒性。

papers.title: Signed-Permutation Coordinate Transport for RMSNorm Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Modern LLM workflows move coordinate-indexed objects across checkpoints: steering vectors, sparse autoencoders, top-$k$ neuron sets, attribution lists, and merge alignments. This is only well posed after fixing the model's residual-stream gauge, which we show is architecture-dependent: LayerNorm residual charts have permutation gauge $S_d$ (up to a global sign flip), while RMSNorm charts with generic per-channel gain have signed-permutation gauge $B_d = S_d \ltimes \{\pm 1\}^d$. Permutation-only alignment is therefore symmetry-incomplete for RMSNorm models. We introduce sign-marginalized Hungarian matching and prove a sharp failure mode: with decorrelated coordinates, raw signed-correlation matching has a structural permutation-accuracy ceiling at the positive-sign fraction of the true gauge, which sign-marginalization removes. We then make coordinate-preserving transport, not function-level merging, the primary object: composing saved-checkpoint local $B_d$ gauges along same-base fine-tuning trajectories recovers 91.1% of cross-run coordinates at 1500 steps versus 60.3% for endpoint matching, and the gain is not explained by merely routing through the base. The recovered gauge transfers tools that permutation-only alignment breaks: TinyLlama SAE reconstruction has NMSE 0.004 under $B_d$ versus 1.08 under $S_d$; Qwen sentiment steering preserves 95.8% of its effect versus 17.2%; refusal steering reverses sign under $S_d$; coordinate-preserving merges behave the same way. The same covariance governs stateful training: signed transport of AdamW state preserves the resumed trajectory, while permutation-only state follows a different one from a functionally identical checkpoint. Finally, gauge-sweep audits show index-level interpretability claims are reproducible only relative to an explicit gauge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现RMSNorm Transformer的残差流具有符号-置换规范（signed-permutation gauge）B_d，而LayerNorm仅为置换规范S_d。为此提出符号边缘化匈牙利匹配（sign-marginalized Hungarian matching）来实现坐标保持传输，在检查点间传输稀疏自编码器、情感向量等工具时显著优于纯置换对齐。在TinyLlama上，SAE重建NMSE从1.08降至0.004；Qwen情感转向效果保持率从17.2%提升至95.8%。
Motivation: 现代LLM工作流需要在不同检查点间传输坐标索引对象，但RMSNorm模型具有比LayerNorm更复杂的规范结构，纯置换对齐忽略符号自由度，导致传输失效。
Method: 引入符号-置换规范B_d，设计符号边缘化匈牙利匹配算法用于对齐，并倡导以坐标保持传输（而非函数级合并）作为首要操作，沿微调轨迹组合局部规范。
Result: 沿同基微调轨迹组合局部规范可恢复91.1%的跨运行坐标（端点匹配仅60.3%）；B_d对齐下SAE重建NMSE=0.004 vs S_d下的1.08；情感转向保持95.8%效果 vs 17.2%；拒绝转向在S_d下符号反转。
Conclusion: 索引级可解释性主张仅在显式规范下可复现；强调坐标保持传输比函数级合并更适合RMSNorm模型，且AdamW状态需经符号传输才能恢复轨迹。

papers.title: AnyBokeh: Physics-Guided Any-to-Any Bokeh Editing with Optical Fingerprint Transfer
papers.abstract_en: Depth-of-field control is a fundamental tool in photography, yet post-capture bokeh editing from a single image remains challenging. A practical editor should handle images captured under arbitrary focus and aperture settings. Existing methods typically assume an all-in-focus input, or first recover an all-in-focus image before rendering new bokeh. Such pipelines can discard useful blur cues from the source image and propagate reconstruction artifacts into the final edit. We introduce AnyBokeh, a physics-guided framework for any-to-any bokeh editing. Instead of treating source blur merely as a degradation to be removed, AnyBokeh estimates the source blur state with a signed circle-of-confusion map and a disparity map. By modeling the linear relation between signed circle of confusion and disparity difference, AnyBokeh estimates a source-specific optical fingerprint and transfers the source optical characteristics to the desired focus and aperture setting. A generative editor conditioned on both source and target circle-of-confusion maps then performs relative blur synthesis, enabling spatially adaptive deblurring, preservation, and defocus rendering. To support physically supervised learning, we further construct a high-fidelity synthetic dataset with accurate depth, focus distance, and full EXIF metadata. Experiments on real-world benchmarks show that AnyBokeh achieves faithful and controllable editing across any-to-any bokeh editing, all-in-focus-to-bokeh rendering, and defocus deblurring, while avoiding all-in-focus reconstruction and test-time bokeh-level calibration commonly required by existing approaches. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/itsmag11/AnyBokeh.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AnyBokeh 提出一种物理引导的任意到任意散景编辑框架，通过估计源图像的 signed circle-of-confusion 图和 disparity 图，提取源光学指纹并传递到目标焦点和光圈设置。该方法避免全对焦重建和测试时校准，在真实世界基准上实现可控的散景编辑、全对焦到散景渲染和散焦去模糊。
Motivation: 现有散景编辑器通常假设输入为全对焦图像或先恢复全对焦再渲染新散景，这会丢弃源图像的模糊线索并传播重建伪影。
Method: 估计源图像的 signed circle-of-confusion 图和 disparity 图，利用 signed CoC 与视差差值的线性关系提取源光学指纹，将其传递到目标设置；条件生成编辑器根据源和目标 CoC 图进行相对模糊合成，实现空间自适应去模糊、保留和散焦渲染。
Result: 在真实世界基准上实现忠实可控的任意到任意散景编辑、全对焦到散景渲染和散焦去模糊，无需全对焦重建和测试时校准。
Conclusion: AnyBokeh 通过物理引导的光学指纹传递避免了传统方法的缺陷，实现了高质量的散景编辑。

papers.title: Locally stationary Argo ocean heat content estimates: Modeling, validation and uncertainty quantification
papers.abstract_en: Argo profiling floats measure seawater temperature and salinity in the upper 2000 meters of the ocean. These floats are uniquely capable of measuring the global Ocean Heat Content (OHC), a quantity that is of central importance for understanding Earth Energy Imbalance. Yet, producing Argo-based OHC estimates with reliable uncertainties is statistically challenging due to the complex structure and large size of the Argo dataset. Here we present an end-to-end mapping and uncertainty quantification framework for Argo-based OHC estimation using state-of-the-art methods from spatio-temporal statistics. The framework is based on modeling vertically integrated Argo temperature profiles as a locally stationary Gaussian process defined over space and time. This enables us to produce computationally tractable OHC anomaly maps based on data-driven decorrelation scales estimated from the Argo observations. Our modeling choices are validated using statistical cross-validation, which demonstrates the importance of including a climatological time trend in the mean field and accounting for time in the covariance function. We quantify the uncertainty of these maps using local conditional simulation ensembles, a novel approach that leads to principled spatially and temporally correlated uncertainty quantification. A new paired cross-validation technique is presented to validate these uncertainties. The mapping framework is implemented in an open-source codebase that is designed to be modular, reproducible and extensible. To demonstrate the mapping and uncertainty quantification capabilities of this approach, we present new Argo OHC maps with uncertainties for 2004-2022 and report on various downstream climatological estimates and their uncertainties.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用局部平稳高斯过程对Argo浮标垂直积分温度剖面进行建模，生成2004-2022年全球海洋热含量异常图并量化其时空相关的不确定性。框架通过交叉验证选择气候趋势和时间相关函数，并采用局部条件模拟集合进行不确定性量化。
Motivation: Argo数据集庞大且结构复杂，现有海洋热含量估计缺乏可靠的空间-时间一致性不确定性量化，影响对地球能量不平衡的理解。
Method: 将垂直积分温度剖面建模为时空上的局部平稳高斯过程，基于数据驱动的去相关尺度；使用配对交叉验证验证不确定性，并通过局部条件模拟集合产生具有时空相关性的不确定度。
Result: 生成了2004-2022年全球海洋热含量异常图及其不确定性，并通过交叉验证确认了包含气候趋势和时间协方差函数的必要性。
Conclusion: 该框架提供了可复现、模块化的Argo海洋热含量估计方法，为气候学研究提供了具有可靠不确定性的下游估计。

papers.title: DEMUN: Fast and accurate discovery of music notation in very large collections
papers.abstract_en: Much of written musical heritage is preserved and digitised at memory institutions: libraries, museums, and archives. Owing to their collection structures, sheet music tends to be concentrated in large subsets that are defined as collections of music, with corresponding metadata that makes the music findable. However, when studying musical life as opposed to individual works, relevant documents often lie outside of these specialised collections: in textbooks, newspapers, other periodicals, pamphlets, and other documents with extensive circulation. But these documents are typically not catalogued as musical documents, and though there may be a lot of such documents overall, in large library collections, they are still extremely sparse. Manual discovery is thus unfeasible. Automated discovery requires an extremely low false positive rate in order to be useful, and must also operate quickly. We present DEMUN: a two-stage lightweight detector of music notation with a false positive rate of 0.015 %. In the test scenario, 4 million images of a national-scale library were processed, out of which 1,500 pages with music notation were discovered, suggesting the entire collection may contain up to 20-30,000 unmarked documents of musical life.

papers.title: World Narrative Model for Highly Controllable Video Generation: A Paradigm Shift from Pixel Sampling to Physical World Orchestration
papers.abstract_en: The fundamental obstacle to industrial grade video generation is the lack of controllability: existing models treat video as a pixel distribution sampling problem, bypassing the explicit, instance level $4D$ $(3D + T)$ physical world. Consequently, content creators cannot specify geometry, motion, camera parameters, or lighting in a deterministic, quantitative way, leading to the infamous ''gacha'' loop that makes professional content creation prohibitively inefficient and expensive. To address this, we introduce the World Narrative Model (WNM), a paradigm that decouples what to render -- the structured physical narrative -- from how to render -- the pixel generation process. WNM replaces end-to-end black-box sampling with orchestrated $4D$ pre-visualization for media generation. Collaborative agents translate sparse multimodal inputs, including text, reference videos, and sketches, into a fully editable world representation with scene geometry, object layouts, character/animal skeleton motion, trajectories, camera motion, and lighting at quantitative, physically meaningful granularity. This representation acts as a deterministic structural blueprint that drives existing video foundation models, either frozen or lightly adapted, to render final footage, turning the base model into a faithful neural shader. Built on this engine, our human-AI platform supports automatic world generation and pre-visualization aligned with professional filmmaking pipelines, while director consoles enable seamless human refinement. Experiments show that WNM greatly reduces probabilistic ``gacha'' calls and produces videos whose layout, motion, and cinematography closely follow creator intent. The framework is open and modular, allowing each component, such as world representation, control agents, and adapters, to be independently improved. Project website: https://glassroom.sjtu.edu.cn/WNM/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出世界叙事模型（WNM），将视频生成从像素采样范式转向物理世界编排范式，通过解耦渲染内容（结构化物理叙事）与渲染过程（像素生成），利用协作代理将稀疏多模态输入转化为可编辑的4D世界表征，作为确定性蓝图驱动现有视频基础模型生成最终视频。实验表明WNM大幅减少概率性“gacha”调用，使视频布局、运动和摄影更贴近创作者意图。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型缺乏可控性，将视频视为像素分布采样问题，导致创作者无法定量指定几何、运动、相机参数或光照，造成专业内容创作低效昂贵。
Method: 引入WNM范式，通过协作代理将文本、参考视频、草图等稀疏多模态输入转化为包含场景几何、物体布局、骨骼运动、轨迹、相机运动、光照的定量4D世界表征，该表征作为确定性蓝图驱动冻结或轻量适配的现有视频基础模型渲染最终视频。
Result: 摘要称WNM大幅减少概率性“gacha”调用，生成的视频在布局、运动和摄影上紧密遵循创作者意图。
Conclusion: WNM是一个开放模块化框架，各组件（世界表征、控制代理、适配器）可独立改进，适用于专业影视制作流程。
