papers.title: FARS: A Fully Automated Research System Deployed at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Recent automated research systems show that language-model agents can generate hypotheses, run experiments, and write complete manuscripts, but most evidence still comes from selected examples, human-framed topics, or a few pre-defined research tasks. We present FARS (Fully Automated Research System), a fully automated AI-for-AI research system designed to operate across research topics at scale. FARS autonomously generates and advances projects through ideation, planning, experimentation, and writing, using stage-specific agents coordinated through a shared workspace that records proposals, code, logs, results, and manuscripts. In its first public deployment, FARS produced 166 complete research papers spanning 67 fine-grained AI/ML topics while preserving intermediate artifacts as an auditable corpus rather than a curated set of successes. We evaluate this corpus with 282 structured reviews from volunteer reviewers covering 140 papers, including overall ratings, sub-scores, integrity checks, and LLM-use disclosure. The reviews indicate that FARS can produce review-worthy and occasionally strong AI/ML research artifacts in a large-scale public deployment, while also exposing recurring failure modes in narrow experimental scope, methodological limitations, and integrity issues.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍FARS，一个全自动的AI研究系统，能够在多种研究主题上自主生成和推进项目。首次大规模部署产生了166篇完整论文，覆盖67个细粒度AI/ML主题，并经过282份结构化评审。评审显示FARS能产生值得评审甚至偶尔高质量的研究成果，但也暴露出实验范围狭窄、方法局限性和诚信问题等常见失败模式。
Motivation: 现有自动化研究系统多依赖于选定例子、人类预设主题或少数预定义任务，缺乏在规模上跨主题运行的完全自动化系统。
Method: 设计FARS系统，采用阶段专用智能体，通过共享工作区协调创意、规划、实验和写作环节，自动生成研究项目并产出论文。
Result: 首次公开部署产生166篇完整论文，覆盖67个AI/ML主题；经过282份结构化评审（覆盖140篇论文），结果显示系统能产出值得评审的成果，但存在实验范围狭窄、方法局限性和诚信问题。
Conclusion: FARS展示了全自动AI研究系统在大规模公开部署中的潜力，同时揭示了需要改进的失败模式。

papers.title: ECHO: Prune to act, trace to learn with selective turn memory in agentic RL
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language agents must repeatedly interact with tools, accumulate evidence, and make decisions under bounded context windows. Existing context-management methods make such rollouts feasible by truncating distant history, folding past turns into summaries, or selecting compact memory states. However, these breakthroughs introduce two coupled limitations. First, as the number of turns grows, historical observations are progressively removed or collapsed into compressed states, making it harder for the policy to reuse fine-grained evidence. Second, once the original turns are no longer source-addressable, outcome-based RL loses an explicit path for aligning policy updates with the evidence that supported a successful final answer. To this end, we propose ECHO, a selective turn-memory framework that jointly addresses history collapse and traceable learning through source-indexed reconstruction. Specifically, ECHO compresses each completed environment turn into a compact memory record, reconstructs bounded policy contexts by selecting from these records, and reuses the selected source indices to route positive outcome credit to the evidence and selection actions that support successful answers. On BrowseComp-Plus, ECHO reaches 43.4% held-out accuracy, outperforming GRPO (28.9%) and the rolling-summary baseline SUPO (36.1%), while using fewer turns and lower trajectory volume than SUPO (Figure 1). Additionally, the trained policy improves zero-shot generalization across multi-objective QA, code generation, and deep information-seeking benchmarks on both dense and MoE backbones.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ECHO，一种选择性回合记忆框架，用于长程语言代理在强化学习中解决历史坍塌和可追溯学习问题。ECHO 通过压缩环境回合、基于源索引重建策略上下文，并将正向奖励路由到支持成功答案的证据和选择动作。在 BrowseComp-Plus 上达到 43.4% 的保留准确率，优于 GRPO (28.9%) 和 SUPO (36.1%)，并在多个下游任务上提升零样本泛化。
Motivation: 现有长程语言代理上下文管理方法随着回合数增加会逐渐移除或压缩历史观测，导致细粒度证据难以重用，且基于结果的强化学习无法将策略更新与支持成功答案的证据对齐。
Method: ECHO 框架压缩每个完成的环境回合为紧凑记忆记录，通过选择这些记录重建有界策略上下文，并利用所选源索引将正向奖励路由到支持成功答案的证据和选择动作。
Result: 在 BrowseComp-Plus 上 ECHO 达到 43.4% 保留准确率，优于 GRPO (28.9%) 和 SUPO (36.1%)，且使用更少的回合和轨迹量；训练后的策略在多种骨干网络上提升了零样本泛化能力。
Conclusion: ECHO 通过源索引重建实现了选择性记忆，有效解决了历史坍塌和可追溯学习问题，验证了在长程推理任务中的优势。

papers.title: Think in English, Answer in Korean: Efficient Adaptation of Multilingual Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract_en: We present LuckyStar 111B, a 111B-parameter hybrid reasoning model developed through a collaboration between Cohere and LG CNS for Korean-English enterprise agents under practical memory and serving constraints. The model trains from Cohere's fully post-trained Command A model rather than a new pretraining run, and uses preamble conditioning to switch between concise non-reasoning behavior and longer tool-oriented reasoning. We study four choices for scaling tool-using agents efficiently: multilingual supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards for multi-step tool-use tasks, language-consistency rewards for Korean user-facing responses, and 4-bit quantization for single-GPU serving. The adapted model improves mathematical reasoning, function calling, and agentic natural-language-to-SQL (NL2SQL) performance while preserving general Korean and English instruction-following quality. These results provide a practical recipe and failure-mode analysis for adapting post-trained multilingual models to verifiable agentic workflows under memory-constrained deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LuckyStar 111B，一个基于Cohere Command A模型后训练得到的111B参数混合推理模型，用于韩英企业代理。通过前导条件控制（preamble conditioning）在简洁非推理行为与长工具导向推理间切换，并研究了四种扩展技术：多语言监督微调、基于可验证奖励的多步工具使用强化学习、语言一致性奖励以及4比特量化。模型在数学推理、函数调用和自然语言到SQL（NL2SQL）任务上性能提升，同时保持通用指令跟随质量。
Motivation: 在内存和服务约束下，高效地将后训练的多语言模型适应到可验证的代理工作流（agentic workflows）中，是韩英企业代理面临的实际挑战。
Method: 采用Command A作为基础模型，通过前导条件控制实现行为切换；结合多语言监督微调、基于可验证奖励的多步工具使用强化学习、语言一致性奖励和4比特量化四种策略进行高效适应。
Result: 模型在数学推理、函数调用和代理式自然语言到SQL任务上取得改进，同时保持通用韩英指令跟随质量。
Conclusion: 提供了一套实用的自适应方法和失败模式分析，可用于在内存受限部署下将后训练多语言模型扩展到可验证的代理工作流。

papers.title: Technical Report of RoboSpatial Challenge at CVPR 2026: Selective Reasoning Activation and Reference-Frame Disambiguation for Embodied Spatial Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models achieve strong general perception but often struggle with the spatial reasoning required for embodied tasks. We present RoboSpatialBrain, our submission to the RoboSpatial Challenge at the Embodied Reasoning in Action Workshop, CVPR 2026, built on RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV. RoboSpatialBrain combines two training-free, inference-time mechanisms: a forced <think> prefix activation strategy paired with a task-specific post-prompt that elicits deliberate reasoning on context and compatibility tasks, and an explicit reference-frame redirection pipeline that resolves camera-centric and object-centric ambiguity for context tasks. We additionally explore fine-tuning RoboBrain2.5 on compatibility data and present a detailed analysis of its interaction with prompting. RoboSpatialBrain achieved first place in the RoboSpatial Challenge, with an overall success rate of 80.9\% on RoboSpatial-Home. Code is available at https://github.com/YuxiangXie2003/RoboSpatialBrain.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文报告了 RoboSpatialBrain，一种用于具身空间推理的无训练推理方法，在 CVPR 2026 RoboSpatial 挑战赛中取得第一名。该方法基于 RoboBrain2.5-8B-NV，结合强制 <think> 前缀激活与显式参考帧重定向，在 RoboSpatial-Home 上达到 80.9% 的成功率。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在通用感知上表现良好，但在具身任务所需的空间推理上存在不足，因此需要针对空间歧义和推理激活的改进。
Method: 提出两种推理时机制：一是强制 <think> 前缀激活与任务特定后提示，引导模型在上下文和兼容性任务上进行深思推理；二是显式参考帧重定向管道，解决相机中心和对象中心歧义。同时探索了微调与提示的交互。
Result: 在 RoboSpatial 挑战赛中排名第一，总体成功率为 80.9%（RoboSpatial-Home）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调训练时推理激活与参考帧消歧结合的简单方案能有效提升具身空间推理性能，代码已开源。

papers.title: A Lifecycle and Application-Stack Survey of Large Language Model Vulnerabilities: Attacks, Risks, Defenses, and Open Problems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are no longer only text generators. They are increasingly embedded in retrieval pipelines, enterprise assistants, coding environments, robotic systems, security-operation workflows, and autonomous agents that can read private data, call tools, write files, execute code, and act across organizational boundaries. This shift changes the security problem: risks do not arise from the model weights alone, but from the full lifecycle and application stack through which data, prompts, model outputs, tools, memories, and user authority interact. This paper systematizes the literature on vulnerabilities in large language model systems through a lifecycle and application-stack lens. We organize attacks across eight stages: data collection, pretraining, post-training alignment, model packaging and supply chain, retrieval and memory, prompting and inference, tool/agent execution, and deployment/maintenance. For each stage, we analyze attacker capabilities, affected security objectives, representative attacks, practical risks, evaluation practices, and defenses. We further map LLM-specific vulnerabilities to confidentiality, integrity, availability, safety, privacy, fairness, accountability, and agency-control objectives. Unlike taxonomies that list isolated attack names, the proposed systematization emphasizes where trust boundaries fail, how untrusted data becomes executable instruction, how delegated authority amplifies model errors, and why point defenses rarely compose. We close with a research agenda for secure LLM systems, including compositional security, provenance-aware retrieval, tool-call containment, long-horizon agent evaluation, privacy-preserving adaptation, realistic red teaming, and deployment-grade incident response.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从生命周期和应用栈视角系统化了大型语言模型（LLM）系统中的漏洞文献。将攻击分为数据收集、预训练、后训练对齐、模型打包与供应链、检索与记忆、提示与推理、工具/代理执行、部署与维护八个阶段，分析每个阶段的攻击能力、安全目标、典型攻击、实际风险、评估实践与防御措施，并映射到机密性、完整性、可用性、安全性、隐私、公平性、问责制和代理控制等安全目标。最后提出包括组合安全、溯源感知检索、工具调用隔离等在内的研究议程。
Motivation: LLM不再仅是文本生成器，而是嵌入检索管道、企业助手、机器人系统等复杂应用栈中，风险不仅来自模型权重，更来自全生命周期中数据、提示、输出、工具、记忆和用户权限的交互。现有分类学仅列出孤立攻击名称，缺乏系统化的信任边界分析。
Method: 采用生命周期和应用栈视角，将攻击分为八个阶段，对每个阶段分析攻击者能力、受影响的安全目标、代表性攻击、实际风险、评估实践和防御，并建立LLM特有漏洞到安全目标的映射。
Result: 系统化了八个阶段的攻击分类，揭示了信任边界失效、不可信数据变为可执行指令、委托权威放大模型错误等问题，并指出点防御难以组合形成有效防护。
Conclusion: 提出安全LLM系统的研究议程，包括组合安全、溯源感知检索、工具调用隔离、长周期代理评估、隐私保护适应、现实红队测试和部署级事件响应。

papers.title: Intrinsic decomposition and editing of 3D Gaussian splats
papers.abstract_en: Intrinsic decomposition which expresses image colors as the product of diffuse albedo and shading, possibly augmented with view-dependent residuals has a long history in image editing as it enables the modification of object colors and textures without altering lighting. We extend intrinsic decomposition to radiance fields represented with Gaussian splatting by proposing solutions to three key aspects of such decomposition. First, we describe how to model the intrinsic decomposition as independent sets of Gaussian primitives, which allows each set to adapt to the characteristics of the layer it represents. Second, we present an optimization procedure guided by data-driven predictions to disentangle multi-view photographs of a scene into the aforementioned intrinsic sets. Finally, we provide an editing workflow where users modify the texture of planar surfaces simply by modifying the albedo of that surface in one image. Capturing this edit within the intrinsic radiance field allows re-rendering of the edited scene with plausible lighting under arbitrary viewpoints.
papers.journal_ref: Proc. ACM Comput. Graph. Interact. Tech. 9, 1, Article 10 (May 2026), 18 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将内在分解扩展到3D高斯溅射表示的辐射场，通过独立高斯基元集建模、数据驱动优化分解以及用户编辑工作流，实现场景纹理编辑且保持光照合理。方法包括三个关键方面：将内在分解建模为独立的高斯基元集，基于数据驱动预测的优化分解多视图照片，以及允许用户通过修改单张图像中平面的反照率来编辑纹理，并在辐射场中捕获编辑以实现任意视角的合理光照渲染。
Motivation: 传统内在分解应用于图像编辑，但缺乏对辐射场的支持。本文目标是扩展内在分解到高斯溅射辐射场，以支持场景的纹理和颜色编辑而不改变光照。
Method: 提出三种关键方案：1) 将内在分解建模为独立的高斯基元集，使每组适应其表示层的特性；2) 通过数据驱动预测指导的优化过程分解多视图照片为反照率、阴影和视图相关残差；3) 提供编辑工作流，用户通过修改单张图像中平面的反照率，进而自动更新辐射场，实现任意视角下的重渲染。
Result: 摘要未提供量化实验结果，但声称能够实现场景纹理修改并保持光照合理。
Conclusion: 该工作将内在分解引入高斯溅射辐射场，支持用户通过单图像编辑修改纹理，并在辐射场中捕获编辑，从而实现任意视角下的光照一致重渲染。

papers.title: LiteMatch: Lightweight Zero-Shot Stereo Matching via Cost Volume Stabilization
papers.abstract_en: Despite rapid progress in learning-based stereo matching, high accuracy is often achieved at the cost of heavy backbones and computationally intensive 3D cost volume processing, resulting in substantial memory and runtime overhead. More critically, these methods frequently struggle to generalize across domains, limiting their practical deployment. We present \textit{LiteMatch}, a lightweight stereo matching framework that achieves strong zero-shot generalization through cost volume stabilization-without expensive 3D convolutions. LiteMatch employs two complementary encoders: a Cross-View Correspondence Encoder (CVCE) to capture global cross-view interactions, and a High-Frequency Encoder (HFE) that enhances fine structural details via FFT-based frequency cues. To stabilize the cost volume, we introduce the \textit{Cost Volume Consistency Loss (CVC-Loss)}, a voxel-wise binary cross-entropy objective applied to softmax-normalized cost distributions. By encouraging sharp and unimodal disparity probabilities, CVC-Loss promotes stable cost distributions and enables rapid convergence. A lightweight refinement module further produces sharp full-resolution disparities with low-iteration updates, avoiding heavy recurrent refinement. With a flexible design ranging from 3.36M to 9.58M parameters, LiteMatch achieves exceptional zero-shot generalization, delivering competitive EPE and D1 performance across Scene Flow, KITTI, Middlebury, ETH3D, and DrivingStereo. Our results establish that lightweight architectures can indeed generalize across domains without sacrificing accuracy. \href{https://mdraqibkhan.github.io/Litematch}{\textcolor{blue}{Code}}
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LiteMatch，一种轻量级零样本立体匹配框架，通过成本体积稳定性实现强泛化，无需昂贵的3D卷积。采用交叉视图对应编码器（CVCE）和高频编码器（HFE）提取特征，引入成本体积一致性损失（CVC-Loss）稳定成本分布，轻量级精化模块产生高分辨率视差。在Scene Flow、KITTI、Middlebury、ETH3D和DrivingStereo上取得有竞争力的EPE和D1性能，参数量3.36M-9.58M。
Motivation: 现有立体匹配方法依赖重型骨干网络和计算密集的3D成本体积处理，导致高内存和运行时开销，且跨域泛化能力差，限制实际部署。
Method: LiteMatch采用两个互补编码器：CVCE捕获全局跨视图交互，HFE通过FFT增强细粒度结构细节。引入CVC-Loss（对softmax归一化的成本分布应用体素级二元交叉熵损失）鼓励锐利单峰视差概率，稳定成本体积。最后用轻量级精化模块以低迭代次数生成全分辨率视差。
Result: 摘要报告LiteMatch在Scene Flow、KITTI、Middlebury、ETH3D和DrivingStereo上实现有竞争力的EPE和D1性能，参数量仅3.36M-9.58M，证明轻量架构可跨域泛化且不牺牲精度。
Conclusion: 本文表明轻量级架构通过成本体积稳定化可以在零样本跨域泛化中达到高精度，无需3D卷积或重型循环精化。

papers.title: A Tutorial on Autonomous Fault-Tolerant Control Using Knowledge-Grounded LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Fault recovery in process plants still relies heavily on plant operators, especially when faults fall outside predefined supervisory logic. Operators interpret alarms, procedures, P\&IDs, interlocks, and process trends, then decide how to move the plant to a safe operating mode without triggering a shutdown. This paper examines how Large Language Model (LLM) agents can support such recovery decisions. The proposed framework treats the LLM as a constrained supervisory planner. It uses plant-specific knowledge to propose recovery actions, and every proposal is checked by an external validator (symbolic or simulation-based) before actuation. The paper develops three design dimensions for applying the framework: the recovery patterns for which LLM agents are useful, the validation strategies that separate admissible from inadmissible proposals, and the deployment constraints imposed by latency, knowledge engineering, safety integration, and model lifecycle management. To make the framework directly usable, two openly available executable Python environments are provided. Both re-implement established case studies, a modular mixing module and a continuous stirred-tank reactor, extended with configurable faults and defined interfaces for custom recovery and validation methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个利用基于知识的LLM代理进行自主容错控制的教程框架。该框架将LLM作为受约束的监督规划器，使用工厂特定知识提出恢复动作，并通过外部验证器（符号或仿真）检查每个提议。论文开发了三个设计维度：恢复模式、验证策略和部署约束，并提供了两个开源的Python环境。
Motivation: 过程工厂中的故障恢复仍严重依赖操作员，尤其是当故障超出预定义监督逻辑时。现有方法缺乏灵活性和自主性，需要一种能够利用LLM代理支持恢复决策的框架。
Method: 提出一个框架，将LLM视为受约束的监督规划器，利用工厂特定知识生成恢复动作，并通过外部验证器（符号或仿真）确保动作安全性。论文定义了三个设计维度：恢复模式、验证策略和部署约束（延迟、知识工程、安全集成、模型生命周期管理）。提供了两个开源Python环境（模块化混合模块和连续搅拌釜反应器）用于实施。
Result: 论文提供了两个重新实现已有案例研究的可执行环境，支持可配置故障和自定义恢复/验证方法接口。
Conclusion: 该框架为利用LLM代理进行过程工厂容错控制提供了系统化的教程，强调了验证安全性和部署约束的重要性。

papers.title: Calibration, Not Compilation: Detecting and Repairing Misspecified Probabilistic Programs Written by Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Language models increasingly write probabilistic programs (in NumPyro, Stan, or Pyro), but a program that compiles, runs, and passes every unit test can still be \emph{statistically} wrong -- a Gaussian likelihood for heavy-tailed data, a Poisson for over-dispersed counts, an invalid prior support, or a pathological parameterization. The right verifier is therefore not a test suite but the Bayesian workflow itself: posterior predictive checks, simulation-based calibration, sampler diagnostics ($\hat R$, divergences, ESS), and held-out predictive density. We study this calibration oracle along three axes. \textbf{Detection:} on a benchmark of $14$ misspecification types across $10$ model families ($200$ instances), it flags the bug with AUC $0.97$ ($88\%$ at $2\%$ FPR \emph{when handed the correct reference program, an upper bound}) -- and a fully \emph{reference-free} version that uses no correct program reaches $62$--$78\%$ (the upper figure from a small automated model search), versus $0\%$ for a unit-test oracle. \textbf{Repair:} used as feedback in an LLM repair loop across fifteen models, calibration significantly outperforms unit-test feedback -- which is itself \emph{significantly worse than no feedback at all}, a passing test inducing false confidence that suppresses repair -- and improves over no feedback on strong-but-unsaturated models (GPT-5.1 $33{\to}92\%$, Claude $75{\to}100\%$; paired McNemar, $n{=}228$). \textbf{Reality:} on programs LLMs write from scratch for neutral briefs, $15$--$47\%$ of runnable ones are statistically misspecified (unit tests catch none), and calibration-guided repair significantly beats LLM-as-judge review, a Bayesian-workflow checklist, and data-summary self-debug. Across all three, the lesson is the same: for probabilistic programs, correctness is calibration, not compilation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究语言模型编写的概率程序（如NumPyro、Stan程序）的统计正确性问题。即使程序能编译运行并通过单元测试，仍可能存在统计错误。作者提出使用贝叶斯工作流（后验预测检查、基于模拟的校准、采样器诊断等）作为校准验证器。实验检测14种错误类型，AUC达0.97；在修复环节，校准反馈显著优于单元测试反馈；并发现15-47%的LLM编写程序存在统计错误。
Motivation: 语言模型生成的概率程序可能编译通过但统计上错误，而传统单元测试无法检测此类错误，因此需要一种统计正确性的验证方法。
Method: 使用贝叶斯工作流中的后验预测检查、模拟校准、采样器诊断（R-hat、分歧、ESS）以及留出预测密度等作为校准验证器；并设计检测和修复流程。
Result: 在14种错误类型、10个模型家族（200个实例）的基准上，校准验证器检测AUC达0.97；修复环节中，校准反馈显著优于单元测试（单元测试甚至比无反馈更差），在强模型上修复率提升（GPT-5.1从33%到92%，Claude从75%到100%）。
Conclusion: 对于概率程序，正确性在于校准而非编译——单元测试无法捕捉统计错误，而基于贝叶斯工作流的校准是有效的检测和修复工具。
Relevance: 10

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究语言模型编写的概率程序（如NumPyro、Stan程序）的统计正确性问题。即使程序能编译运行并通过单元测试，仍可能存在统计错误。作者提出使用贝叶斯工作流（后验预测检查、基于模拟的校准、采样器诊断等）作为校准验证器。实验检测14种错误类型，AUC达0.97；在修复环节，校准反馈显著优于单元测试反馈；并发现15-47%的LLM编写程序存在统计错误。

summary_sections.method: 使用贝叶斯工作流中的后验预测检查、模拟校准、采样器诊断（R-hat、分歧、ESS）以及留出预测密度等作为校准验证器；并设计检测和修复流程。

papers.title: PrISM-IQA: Image Quality Assessment Made Practical for Smartphone Photography
papers.abstract_en: Existing smartphone image quality assessment (IQA) methods commonly reduce perceptual quality to a single score. However, this scalar formulation is poorly aligned with practical image signal processor (ISP) tuning, where engineers must identify specific quality issues, estimate their severities, and determine whether they are acceptable or require intervention. In this work, we introduce a Practical ISP-aware Structured Model for IQA (PrISM-IQA), which reformulates smartphone IQA as a multi-issue ordinal diagnosis problem. Rather than regressing a single quality score, PrISM-IQA predicts an \textit{ordered} severity level -- absent, minor, severe, or critical -- for each ISP-relevant issue, covering both global image-level artifacts and local content-dependent defects. To produce logically consistent predictions, PrISM-IQA combines cumulative ordinal encoding with structured inference that captures within-issue monotonicity as well as cross-issue subsumption and exclusion relations. We evaluate PrISM-IQA on a reconstructed SPAQ benchmark annotated with $53$ ISP-relevant quality issues and on a small-scale expert-annotated real-world dataset. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of PrISM-IQA for practical issue-level diagnosis, reveal transferable perceptual quality representations through linear probing, and further show how its predictions can support actionable and meaningful ISP tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: PrISM-IQA 将智能手机图像质量评估（IQA）重新表述为多问题有序诊断任务，预测每个 ISP 相关问题的严重程度（无、轻微、严重、关键），而非单一分数。该方法结合累积有序编码和结构化推理，在重构的 SPAQ 基准和专家注释数据集上验证了有效性，并展示了可迁移的感知质量表示。
Motivation: 现有 IQA 方法将感知质量简化为单一分数，与实际的 ISP 调优需求不匹配——工程师需要识别具体质量问题、估计严重程度并决定是否干预。
Method: 提出 PrISM-IQA 模型，采用累积有序编码预测每个 ISP 问题（全局伪影和局部缺陷）的有序严重级别，并通过结构化推理捕获问题内的单调性以及问题间的包含与排斥关系。
Result: 在包含 53 个 ISP 质量问题的重构 SPAQ 基准和小规模专家注释真实数据集上，PrISM-IQA 实现了有效的问题级诊断，线性探测表明感知质量表示可迁移，预测结果可用于可操作的 ISP 调优。
Conclusion: 多问题有序诊断范式比单一分数回归更符合实际 ISP 调优需求，模型预测能提供具象的质量反馈以指导调优。

papers.title: Scientific Explanations in Health Sciences: Causality, Trust, and Epistemic Adequacy
papers.abstract_en: Medical Artificial Intelligence (AI) is widely expected to transform clinical practice, yet the decision-making processes of many Machine Learning (ML) models remain opaque. Explainability has been advanced as a partial remedy to clarify why AI generates predictions, particularly in high-stakes contexts. Despite ongoing efforts, debates on what constitutes an adequate medical explanation remain unsettled. Yet, explanation has long been a central topic of inquiry in the philosophy of science and medicine. The insights developed in these fields, however, have been largely overlooked in contemporary explainable AI (XAI) research, leaving its foundational assumptions insufficiently examined. To address this gap, this paper develops a critical review at the intersection of philosophy of science and XAI. It examines prevailing accounts of what counts as an explanation in the health sciences and assesses their adequacy for informing XAI in medicine, arguing that they provide necessary conditions for a philosophically grounded approach to explainability in this domain. Building on this foundational philosophical literature, the discussion identifies three central axes of analysis: the role of causality in medical reasoning, the epistemic and relational dimensions of medical trust, and the criteria of explanatory adequacy as shaped by the pragmatic needs of diverse stakeholders. By integrating philosophical analysis with current developments in medical AI, the paper outlines principles for designing XAI systems that offer explanations that are not only epistemically robust but also aligned with the epistemic and practical requirements of clinical decision-making, shaping ongoing debates in medical XAI toward underexplored conceptual foundations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从科学哲学和医学哲学的视角，批判性地审视了可解释人工智能（XAI）在医学中的应用。作者认为当前XAI研究忽视了哲学领域对解释的长期探讨，并基于哲学文献提出因果性、信任和解释充分性三个核心分析轴，旨在为设计认知稳健且符合临床决策需求的XAI系统提供原则。
Motivation: 现有医学XAI研究对“什么是充分的医学解释”缺乏共识，且忽视了科学哲学和医学哲学中关于解释的丰富理论，导致其基础假设未经充分检验。
Method: 本文采用跨学科的批判性综述方法，整合科学哲学、医学哲学与XAI当前发展，识别出三个核心分析轴：因果推理中的因果性角色、医学信任的认知与关系维度、解释充分性标准如何受不同利益相关者的实用需求塑造。
Result: 论文提出了设计认知稳健且符合临床决策需求的XAI系统的原则，并指出当前医学XAI辩论中未充分探索的概念基础。
Conclusion: 作者主张医疗XAI系统应提供不仅认知健壮而且符合临床决策认知与实践要求的解释，以推动该领域向更坚实的哲学基础发展。

papers.title: Automating Cause-Effect Specification with Knowledge Graphs and Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Engineering specifications such as interlocks, alarm rationalization tables, and cause-and-effect (C&E) matrices remain central to process control and safety, yet their creation is still predominantly manual, document-driven, and prone to inconsistency. This paper presents a semantic-AI framework that automates the generation of C&E logic by combining a knowledge graph (KG) with a constrained large language model (LLM) layer. The KG builds on an established modular alignment ontology to represent process structure, operating modes, faults, symptoms, causes, and mitigation actions in a machine-interpretable form. The LLM then transforms this information into operator-ready safety narratives and Semantic Web Rule Language (SWRL) rules under strict ontology and vocabulary constraints, grounding the generated artifacts in the underlying semantic model. The workflow is demonstrated on a modular process plant, showing how engineering semantics, diagnostic relations, and machine-verifiable specifications can be generated from a unified knowledge representation with reduced manual effort.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对过程控制中因果（C&E）规范手动创建且易不一致的问题，提出一个结合知识图谱（KG）和受限大语言模型（LLM）的语义AI框架。该框架利用模块化对齐本体表示过程结构、故障、症状等，并由LLM生成操作员可读的安全描述和SWRL规则。在模块化工厂上验证了减少人工工作量的效果。
Motivation: 当前工程规范（如联锁、报警管理表、因果矩阵）的创建仍主要依赖手工文档，效率低且易出现不一致，亟需自动化方法。
Method: 构建基于模块化对齐本体的知识图谱，表示过程结构、操作模式、故障、症状、原因和缓解措施；然后通过受严格本体和词汇约束的LLM层，将图谱信息转化为安全叙述和SWRL规则。
Result: 在模块化工厂场景中演示了该框架能自动生成工程语义、诊断关系和机器可验证规范，减少了人工工作量。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了通过统一知识表示和约束LLM可实现C&E规范的自动化生成，但摘要未提及其他场景或量化性能。

papers.title: Robust Autonomous UAV Landing on Maritime Platforms via Multimodal Agentic AI and Active Wave Compensation
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous aerial inspection of marine infrastructure is frequently compromised by stochastic sea states, introducing risks of high-kinetic impacts, post-landing toppling, and sensory occlusion. This paper proposes a decoupled, multi-vehicle landing framework synchronizing an Unmanned Surface Vehicle (USV) equipped with a 3-RPU stabilized platform with a robust Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV). The architecture utilizes two independent Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) agents: a Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) agent providing high-frequency wave-motion compensation for the landing deck, and a multimodal RL agent for the UAVs final approach. Evaluated in high-fidelity maritime simulations, the system achieved a 100% landing success rate across 15 trials in wave states varying from calm to rough. Results show a mean stabilization efficacy of 87.8%, maintaining the landing surface within 1 degree of the horizontal plane for 96% of the mission duration in rough conditions, effectively contributing to safer landings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种解耦的多飞行器自主着陆框架，用于无人机在海洋平台上安全着陆。框架利用两个深度强化学习智能体：一个SAC智能体高频补偿波浪运动，另一个多模态RL智能体控制无人机最终进近。在15次高保真仿真试验中，系统在平静到汹涌的海况下均实现100%着陆成功率，并在汹涌条件下将着陆面维持在水平面1度以内达96%时间。
Motivation: 海上基础设施的自主航空检查常受随机海况影响，存在高动能冲击、着陆后倾覆和传感器遮挡风险，现有方法缺乏鲁棒性。
Method: 提出解耦的多飞行器着陆框架：USV配备3-RPU稳定平台，UAV使用独立DRL智能体——SAC进行高频波浪补偿，多模态RL智能体控制最终进近。
Result: 15次高保真仿真中，从平静到汹涌海况下着陆成功率达100%；稳定效能均值87.8%，汹涌条件下96%时间着陆面在水平面1度内。
Conclusion: 该框架通过主动波浪补偿和分层RL显著提升了无人机在海洋平台上的着陆安全性，但仅基于仿真验证，未涉及真实海试。

papers.title: What Memory Do GUI Agents Really Need? From Passive Records to Active Task-Driving States
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents increasingly face long-horizon tasks that require reading, updating, and reusing task-relevant data across pages and applications. Existing memory methods treat memory largely as passive storage, where past observations are accumulated and retrieved when needed. Yet retrieving a value does not reveal its current role in the workflow. The agent must still infer from accumulated records whether the value should be used now, has already been used, or must wait for a later dependency. This implicit reconstruction becomes unreliable in long trajectories with similar fields, repeated values, distractors, and outdated states, causing repeated or missed operations. We propose Active Task Driving Memory (ATMem), which shifts GUI-agent memory from passive storage to an actively maintained execution state. ATMem maintains task-relevant information as a continually updated execution state that links each value to its role and current status, enabling action selection based on the current workflow state. We therefore introduce \textbf{STR-GRPO}, an online reinforcement learning method that learns to use ATMem selectively according to its contribution to task completion. STR-GRPO contrasts memory-on and memory-off rollouts to estimate when memory use improves execution, while memory-cost-aware reward discourages costly memory usage that does not improve execution. To evaluate whether agents can complete all in-scope work while avoiding out-of-scope actions over long-horizon execution, we build a challenging mobile benchmark. From a list of near identical entries, agents must act on every entry that satisfies the instruction and reject entries that violate its constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对移动GUI代理在长时任务中记忆不可靠的问题，提出主动任务驱动记忆（ATMem），将代理记忆从被动存储转为持续更新的执行状态，并引入STR-GRPO在线强化学习方法，通过对比记忆开关的轨迹来学习选择性使用记忆。在自主构建的移动基准上，该方法旨在使代理完成所有在范围内操作同时避免越界行为。
Motivation: 现有GUI代理记忆多作为被动存储，仅积累和检索历史观测，但在长轨迹中难以推断值的当前作用、是否已使用或需等待依赖，导致重复或遗漏操作。
Method: 提出ATMem，将任务相关信息维护为持续更新的执行状态，每个值关联其角色和当前状态；同时提出STR-GRPO，一种在线强化学习算法，通过对比记忆启用和禁用的轨迹来估计何时使用记忆有益，并加入记忆成本感知奖励以抑制无效记忆使用。
Result: 自主构建的移动基准要求代理从相似条目列表中仅对满足指令的条目操作并拒绝违规条目，用于评估长时执行中完成范围内任务且避免越界行为的能力。
Conclusion: ATMem和STR-GRPO通过主动维护执行状态和选择性使用记忆，有望提升GUI代理在长时任务中的可靠性。

papers.title: Learning Structurally Consistent Representations for Multi-View Radar Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Radar sensors provide reliable perception under adverse weather and lighting conditions, but their sparse, noisy, and weakly semantic measurements make dense semantic segmentation challenging. Most existing radar segmentation methods rely on grid-based encodings and pairwise interactions, which struggle to capture the higher-order relational structure formed by multiple radar returns from the same physical object. We introduce a unified higher-order structural alignment framework for multi-view radar segmentation. The proposed method refines radar feature representations using learnable hypergraphs to capture higher-order dependencies among spatially related responses. To ensure consistency across heterogeneous radar projections, we further align view-specific features using Unbalanced Optimal Transport (UOT), enabling correspondence-free alignment under varying measurement densities and partial observations. An adaptive attention mechanism then fuses complementary radar views while emphasising structurally informative responses under sparsity and noise. The resulting architecture learns structurally consistent representations across Range Angle (RA), Range Doppler (RD), and Angle Doppler (AD) views and is trained using supervised segmentation together with cross-view consistency regularisation. Experiments on the CARRADA and RADIal benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong radar-specific baselines, achieving 63.8% mIoU on CARRADA and 83.4% mIoU on RADIal, improving the previous best methods by +1.7 and +2.3 mIoU, respectively. These results highlight the importance of higher-order relational modelling for robust radar perception.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于高阶结构对齐的多视图雷达语义分割框架，利用可学习超图捕获雷达回波间的高阶依赖关系，并通过非平衡最优传输（UOT）对齐不同视图的异构特征，最后用自适应注意力融合互补视图。在CARRADA和RADIal基准上分别达到63.8%和83.4% mIoU，相比先前最佳方法提升1.7和2.3个百分点。
Motivation: 现有雷达分割方法依赖网格编码和成对交互，难以捕捉同一物理目标的多个雷达回波形成的高阶关系结构，且多视图一致性不足。
Method: 引入可学习超图建模高阶依赖；用非平衡最优传输实现无对应关系的视图特征对齐；设计自适应注意力机制在稀疏噪声下强调结构信息丰富的响应。
Result: 在CARRADA数据集上mIoU达63.8%，在RADIal数据集上mIoU达83.4%，分别比先前最佳方法提升1.7和2.3个百分点。
Conclusion: 高阶关系建模对鲁棒雷达感知至关重要，所提结构一致性表示能有效提升多视图雷达语义分割性能。

papers.title: Preserve the Hard, Regenerate the Rest: Uncertainty-Guided Synthetic Training Data Augmentation with Diffusion Models
papers.abstract_en: Semantic segmentation models struggle with data sparsity and rare or visually diverse regions, e.g., dense regions or small objects in aerial or autonomous mobility data. While synthetic augmentation is an appealing solution, directly generating new labeled data risks misalignment of labels and generated pixels. Existing solutions to this problem often rely on external models, or employ coarse heuristics such as indiscriminately augmenting all foreground objects or entire backgrounds, which wastes capacity on uninformative pixels. To address this, we propose an uncertainty-guided synthetic context augmentation strategy that strictly preserves label validity and efficiently maximizes pixel informativeness per synthetic sample - no external guardrails required. Using a baseline segmenter's predictive entropy, we identify uncertain semantic regions and inpaint only the complementary visual context. When fine-tuning the segmenter on this synthetic data, we compute the loss only over the original pixels, excluding inpainted regions. This focuses learning on the unmodified, uncertain regions while presenting them in novel contexts. We demonstrate substantial mIoU gains on Cityscapes, UAVID, and BDD100K with the largest gains on rare and difficult classes such as buses, trains, or (from the aerial perspective) cars. Our results demonstrate that uncertainty-guided context augmentation is a highly effective lever to improve segmentation performance on complex datasets, with code provided at https://github.com/XITASO/Preserve-the-Hard-Regenerate-the-Rest.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种不确定性引导的合成上下文增强策略，用于语义分割任务。通过基线分割器的预测熵识别不确定区域，并用扩散模型仅重绘这些区域的视觉上下文，同时保留原始标签和像素。微调时仅对未修改的原始像素计算损失，迫使模型在不确定区域上学习新上下文。在Cityscapes、UAVID和BDD100K数据集上，该方法在稀有类别（如公交车、火车）上取得了显著的mIoU提升。
Motivation: 现有语义分割模型在数据稀疏或视觉多样区域（如密集区域、小物体）表现不佳，直接生成合成数据容易导致标签与生成像素不对齐，而现有增强方法（如无差别增强所有前景或背景）浪费计算在无信息像素上。
Method: 利用预训练语义分割模型的预测熵作为不确定性度量，选择熵高于阈值的区域；使用预训练的扩散模型（如Stable Diffusion）对这些区域进行上下文修复（inpainting），仅替换视觉上下文而不改变标签；在微调分割模型时，仅对原始像素区域计算损失，忽略修复区域。
Result: 在Cityscapes、UAVID和BDD100K数据集上，该方法在平均交并比（mIoU）上取得显著提升，特别是在稀有和困难类别（如公交车、火车、汽车）上提升最大。
Conclusion: 不确定性引导的上下文增强是一种高效且无需外部模型或复杂启发式的策略，能够有效提升语义分割模型在复杂数据集上的表现，尤其针对稀有类别。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: On Optimal Data Splitting for Split Conformal Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Conformal prediction and its variants, including the split conformal prediction, provide a distribution-free framework for uncertainty quantification by constructing prediction intervals or sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees. The statistical efficiency of these intervals depends critically on how the data are split into training and calibration samples. Despite its practical importance, a principled characterization of the training-calibration split that minimizes prediction interval length while maintaining coverage has remained largely unresolved. In this paper, we develop a theoretical framework for optimal data splitting in split conformal prediction. We first analyze the problem in a general setting and derive analytical characterizations of the length-optimal split ratio under both symmetric and asymmetric regimes. We then show how the general results specialize to several commonly used regression settings, including linear regression, nonparametric regression, and neural networks, thereby demonstrating the scope of the framework. We also describe a data-based method for selecting the optimal proportion. Our analysis clarifies how model-related features govern the optimal allocation of samples between training and calibration and provides principled guidance for constructing shorter prediction intervals. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the applicability of the proposed methodology across a variety of practical scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文为分裂共形预测中的训练-校准数据分割比例提供了理论最优性框架，在对称和非对称损失下解析推导了长度最优的分割比率，并推广到线性回归、非参数回归和神经网络等常见场景。还提出了数据驱动的比例选择方法，实验验证了其有效性。
Motivation: 分裂共形预测中训练与校准样本的分割比例对预测区间长度影响显著，但缺乏理论指导。
Method: 建立理论框架，在一般设定下推导最优分割比的解析表达式，并针对线性回归、非参数回归和神经网络等具体模型特化；同时给出数据自适应的最优比例估计方法。
Result: 导出了长度最优的分割比；合成与真实数据集上的实验证明了方法的实用性和普适性。
Conclusion: 模型特征决定了训练与校准的最优样本分配，所提框架可为构造更短的预测区间提供理论依据。

papers.title: Token-Sparse Medical Multimodal Reasoning via Dual-Stream Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) combining reinforcement learning (RL) ignite remarkable progress in multimodal reasoning, yet still struggle with medical images, which typically exhibit extremely sparse visual evidence to inform clinical decision-making. We recognize that pruning visual tokens outside the grounding region greatly enhances medical reasoning. However, a united RL framework for active visual token pruning (VTP) and medical multimodal reasoning remains unestablished. Here, we propose a dual-stream RL framework, ViToS, to fulfill token pruning and question answering. ViToS trains one policy model with two task branches, where one focuses on grounding while the other conducts token-sparse reasoning after VTP. Furthermore, we solve the coupled policy learning problem by introducing the cross-feedback sequential optimization, avoiding gradient conflict and facilitating convergence of the shared policy model. Evaluated on seven medical benchmarks, our method reduces visual tokens to 77% of the original sequence length while achieving a 108.27% relative performance on Lingshu-7B and 104.16% relative performance on HuatuoGPT-Vision-7B. Overall, ViToS delivers superior performance and inference speedup, establishing an efficient paradigm for medical multimodal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双流强化学习框架 ViToS，用于医疗多模态推理中的视觉令牌剪枝（VTP）和问答。ViToS 训练一个策略模型，包含两个任务分支：一个专注于定位，另一个在 VTP 后进行令牌稀疏推理。通过跨反馈顺序优化解决耦合策略学习问题。在七个医疗基准上，ViToS 将视觉令牌减少至原序列长度的 77%，并在 Lingshu-7B 和 HuatuoGPT-Vision-7B 上分别取得 108.27% 和 104.16% 的相对性能提升，同时实现推理加速。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在医疗图像上表现不佳，因为医疗图像中用于临床决策的视觉证据极为稀疏，而现有强化学习框架未能统一视觉令牌剪枝与医疗多模态推理。
Method: 提出双流强化学习框架 ViToS，包含一个共享策略模型和两个任务分支：一个负责定位，另一个在令牌剪枝后进行稀疏推理。利用跨反馈顺序优化来训练共享策略，避免梯度冲突并促进收敛。
Result: 在七个医疗基准上，视觉令牌数量减少至原来的 77%，在 Lingshu-7B 上相对性能达到 108.27%，在 HuatuoGPT-Vision-7B 上达到 104.16%。
Conclusion: ViToS 在性能提升的同时实现推理加速，为医疗多模态推理建立了一种高效的范式。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning based Intrusion Detection in Realistic IoT Networks
papers.abstract_en: The Internet of Things (IoT) is rapidly growing and expanding into various sectors, such as healthcare, transportation, smart homes, and more. Despite the benefits of using IoT devices, they present several challenges. Given the significant role these devices play in our lives, it is crucial to address issues related to their security and privacy. These devices are limited in resources, which complicates their security and the protection of the data that they manage. The paper aims to examine intrusion detection systems using the Gotham2025 dataset, generated through the Gotham testbed, which consists of 78 emulated IoT devices utilising various protocols, including MQTT, CoAP, and RTSP, to assist in safeguarding IoT networks from attacks. We conduct a comparative analysis between five machine learning algorithms, including Random Forest, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Deep Neural Network. We demonstrate that the Random Forest Classifier was the top-performing model, achieving an F1-score of 0.99 in classifying attacks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用Gotham2025数据集（包含78个仿真IoT设备，使用MQTT、CoAP、RTSP等协议）比较了五种机器学习算法（随机森林、XGBoost、逻辑回归、朴素贝叶斯、深度神经网络）在IoT网络入侵检测中的性能。结果显示随机森林分类器表现最佳，F1分数达到0.99。
Motivation: IoT设备资源受限，安全与隐私保护面临挑战，需要有效的入侵检测系统来保护网络。
Method: 使用Gotham测试平台生成的Gotham2025数据集，包含78个仿真IoT设备，应用随机森林、XGBoost、逻辑回归、朴素贝叶斯和深度神经网络进行对比分析。
Result: 随机森林分类器在攻击分类中取得最佳性能，F1分数为0.99。
Conclusion: 随机森林在IoT网络入侵检测中表现优异，但研究局限于特定数据集和仿真环境。

papers.title: Evil Spectra: How Optimisers can Amplify or Suppress Emergent Misalignment
papers.abstract_en: Emergent misalignment (EM) is a recently discovered phenomenon in LLMs where fine-tuning on a narrow misaligned task, such as writing insecure code, leads to broadly misaligned behaviour on unrelated prompts. Previous work has noted that the severity of EM is highly sensitive to training choices; however, we still lack a systematic characterisation of this sensitivity. We perform a sweep over several Qwen3 models, optimisers, datasets, and batch sizes, and find that the choice of optimiser has the largest effect, producing a 7x spread in misalignment rate. Surprisingly, model size has a negligible effect within the Qwen3 family. An additional sweep over 12 models from three families using Adam confirms that model scale (1B-235B) and family have negligible effects for that optimiser. Analysing the loss-alignment relationship on Qwen3-8B, we find that final log training loss is a strong predictor of alignment, and that stratifying by optimiser captures nearly all the residual variance. Training dynamics reveal that each optimiser follows a different trajectory through loss-alignment space, and that after significant training, the optimiser becomes more important than training loss as a predictor of alignment. Muon, the adaptive optimiser that preserves alignment the best, implicitly regularises for a more uniform distribution of singular values of the LoRA adapter. We evaluate this insight by training with an additional loss term that incentivises a flatter singular value spectrum, and find that this substantially recovers alignment for the more EM-prone adaptive optimisers (Adam and Lion), with negligible cost to training loss. These results identify optimiser choice as a key factor in EM severity, but show that spectral regularisation can substantially mitigate the effects of EM-prone optimisers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文系统探究了优化器选择对大型语言模型（LLM）中新兴错位（emerging misalignment）现象的影响，发现优化器是导致错位率变化的最关键因素（差异可达7倍），而模型规模影响甚微。通过分析Qwen3-8B的损失与对齐关系，发现最终对数训练损失可强预测对齐，且优化器能解释几乎所有残差方差。Muon优化器通过隐式正则化使LoRA适配器的奇异值分布更均匀，从而保持对齐；而显式添加谱正则化项可显著恢复Adam和Lion等易错位优化器的对齐效果。
Motivation: 新兴错位现象中，微调窄范围错位任务会引发广泛错位行为，但其对训练超参数的敏感性尚未被系统刻画。
Method: 在多个Qwen3模型、优化器、数据集和批次大小上进行扫描，分析优化器选择对错位率的影响；并通过损失-对齐关系、训练动力学以及奇异值谱正则化进行深入分析。
Result: 优化器选择产生7倍错位率差异；模型规模在Qwen3系列及跨家族（1B-235B）中影响可忽略；最终对数训练损失是强预测因子；Muon优化器表现最佳，其隐式正则化使奇异值分布更均匀；显式谱正则化可恢复Adam和Lion的对齐。
Conclusion: 优化器选择是影响新兴错位严重性的关键因素，但谱正则化可有效缓解易错位优化器的副作用。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 该论文系统探究了优化器选择对大型语言模型（LLM）中新兴错位（emerging misalignment）现象的影响，发现优化器是导致错位率变化的最关键因素（差异可达7倍），而模型规模影响甚微。通过分析Qwen3-8B的损失与对齐关系，发现最终对数训练损失可强预测对齐，且优化器能解释几乎所有残差方差。Muon优化器通过隐式正则化使LoRA适配器的奇异值分布更均匀，从而保持对齐；而显式添加谱正则化项可显著恢复Adam和Lion等易错位优化器的对齐效果。
summary_sections.motivation: 新兴错位现象中，微调窄范围错位任务会引发广泛错位行为，但其对训练超参数的敏感性尚未被系统刻画。
summary_sections.method: 在多个Qwen3模型、优化器、数据集和批次大小上进行扫描，分析优化器选择对错位率的影响；并通过损失-对齐关系、训练动力学以及奇异值谱正则化进行深入分析。
summary_sections.result: 优化器选择产生7倍错位率差异；模型规模在Qwen3系列及跨家族（1B-235B）中影响可忽略；最终对数训练损失是强预测因子；Muon优化器表现最佳，其隐式正则化使奇异值分布更均匀；显式谱正则化可恢复Adam和Lion的对齐。
summary_sections.conclusion: 优化器选择是影响新兴错位严重性的关键因素，但谱正则化可有效缓解易错位优化器的副作用。

papers.title: From Failure to Alignment: A Requirements Engineering Framework for Machine Learning Systems
papers.abstract_en: Organisations designing, developing, and deploying machine learning systems (MLS) need to be able to check that these systems are trustworthy, and communicate this clearly to their stakeholders, be they different categories of users, engineers, or wider society. By focusing on stakeholders, Requirements Engineering is well positioned to drive the design and engineering of MLS that align with the needs of their stakeholders. Yet, we still need a systematic process for modelling and reasoning about requirements for MLS that is driven both by stakeholders' needs and constraints for MLS development. This paper proposes a framework entitled REAL (Requirements Engineering for mAchines that Learn - and Fail) to help develop MLS that align with stakeholders' needs by adopting a requirements engineering approach. This model-based framework is based on three principles. First, weaving together requirements for data, models, and the system as a whole. Second, using failure to drive the exploration of alternative requirements. Third, iterative and traceable refinement of MLS requirements. We demonstrate the proposed framework using an example from autonomous driving and show that REAL supports the development of MLS that better align with stakeholders' requirements. A replication package is available online.
papers.journal_ref: RE 2026 - the 34th IEEE International Requirements Engineering Conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出REAL框架，一种基于模型的需求工程方法，用于开发与利益相关者需求对齐的机器学习系统。框架融合数据、模型和系统需求，利用失败驱动探索替代需求，并支持迭代可追溯的精化。通过自动驾驶案例展示了其有效性。
Motivation: 机器学习系统需要确保可信赖并与利益相关者对齐，但缺乏系统化的需求建模和推理过程。

Result: 通过自动驾驶案例表明，REAL支持开发更符合利益相关者需求的机器学习系统。
Conclusion: REAL提供了系统的需求工程方法，有助于机器学习系统与利益相关者需求对齐。

papers.title: ZEBRA: Zero-Shot Entropy-Regularized Prompt Learning for Base-to-Novel Generalization in Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Audio-Language Models (ALMs) achieve strong zero-shot performance by aligning audio with textual class descriptions. Although prompt learning improves accuracy on base classes through few-shot supervised adaptation, we observe a critical trade-off: it often degrades performance on novel classes, sometimes falling below zero-shot accuracy. This exposes a base-to-novel generalization gap in prompt learning for ALMs. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{ZEBRA} (Zero-shot Entropy-Regularized Prompt Learning for Base-to-Novel Generalization), a plug-and-play framework that fuses zero-shot logits with prompt-learning logits, and employs self-entropy regularization to reduce overfitting to base classes. Experiments across multiple audio classification datasets show that ZEBRA consistently improves novel-class performance while maintaining strong base accuracy, significantly reducing the base-to-novel gap compared to standard prompt learning. The code is available at: https://github.com/asif-hanif/zebra.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ZEBRA框架，用于解决音频-语言模型（ALM）中提示学习（prompt learning）在基类（base classes）上表现好但在新类（novel classes）上性能下降的泛化差距问题。该方法融合零样本logits与提示学习logits，并采用自熵正则化（self-entropy regularization）减少过拟合。实验表明，ZEBRA在多个音频分类数据集上一致提升新类性能，同时保持基类准确率，显著缩小基类到新类的差距。
Motivation: 现有的提示学习通过少量监督适应提升基类准确率，但往往导致新类性能下降，甚至低于零样本基线，暴露了基类到新类的泛化差距。
Method: 提出即插即用框架ZEBRA，将零样本logits与提示学习logits融合，并引入自熵正则化以降低对基类的过拟合。
Result: 在多个音频分类数据集上，ZEBRA一致提升新类性能，同时保持强基类准确率，显著缩小基类到新类的泛化差距。
Conclusion: ZEBRA有效缓解了音频-语言模型提示学习中的基类到新类泛化差距，且不牺牲基类性能。

papers.title: DPPE: Rethinking Camera-Based Positional Encoding for Scaling Multi-View Transformers
papers.abstract_en: The remarkable scalability of Transformers has expanded their application to 3D computer vision, where camera-aware positional encoding is crucial for providing spatial cues in multi-view geometry. Recent advancements have established the practice of using camera parameters -- such as extrinsics or projection matrices -- as relative positional encoding into the query, key, and value vectors of the attention mechanism. However, when scaling up the training recipe of novel view synthesis (NVS) models with the camera-based positional encoding, we observe a significant issue: model performance stagnates in the late stages of training. In this paper, we investigate the cause of the performance bottleneck when scaling up and demonstrate that storing rotation and translation given by the positional encoding in the same dimensions of the value vector causes indeterminacy in their independent identification, hindering training scalability. To address this, we propose Decoupled Pose Positional Encoding (DPPE), a novel camera-based positional encoding that explicitly decouples rotation and translation. Extensive evaluations on NVS tasks demonstrate that DPPE enables stable long-term training even in scaled-up training setup. Furthermore, it exhibits superior generalization performance in extrapolation settings, such as handling an increased number of viewpoints and zoom-in scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了基于相机的位置编码（camera-aware positional encoding）在多视图Transformer中的可扩展性问题，发现将旋转和平移编码到同一维度会导致训练后期性能停滞的瓶颈。作者提出解耦位姿位置编码（DPPE），将旋转和翻译显式分离，并在新视角合成（NVS）任务上验证了其稳定长程训练和更好的外推泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有相机位置编码将旋转和平移编码到同一维度，导致在大规模训练中模型性能在后期停滞，限制了可扩展性。
Method: 提出解耦位姿位置编码（DPPE），将旋转和平移分别编码到不同的维度，避免信息混淆。
Result: 在NVS任务上，DPPE实现了稳定长程训练，并在外推设置（如增加视角数和放大场景）中展现了更好的泛化性能。
Conclusion: 分离旋转和平移的位置编码能有效提升多视图Transformer的训练可扩展性和泛化能力。

papers.title: Robustness of neural networks to random noise perturbations of their inputs
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the problem of the robustness of a trained neural network to the perturbation of its input values. More specifically, we examine the interplay between the accuracy of the network, as measured by the mean squared error, and robustness. Accordingly, we present a robustness measure, which, with high probability, suggests an upper bound on the mean squared error of the network, with respect to an input data set, for a given perturbation of the input values of the network. The measure we propose is both simple and efficient to compute, treating the neural network as a black box. We provide experimental results on several real-world data sets showing the efficacy of the proposed method. We also introduce the concept of robustness curves, which allows us to further analyse robustness within and between data sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究训练后的神经网络对输入值随机扰动的鲁棒性，重点考察网络精度（均方误差）与鲁棒性之间的权衡。作者提出了一个高效且简单的鲁棒性度量，该度量以高概率给出在给定输入扰动下网络均方误差的上界。实验在多个真实数据集上验证了方法的有效性，并引入鲁棒性曲线（robustness curves）概念以进一步分析数据集内和数据集间的鲁棒性。
Motivation: 神经网络在面对输入噪声时可能表现不稳定，现有鲁棒性度量往往复杂或需要访问模型内部。本文旨在提出一种计算简单、无需模型内部知识即可评估鲁棒性的度量。
Method: 将神经网络视为黑箱，提出一种鲁棒性度量，该度量基于输入扰动下的均方误差上界，且具有高概率保证。方法计算简单，依赖输入数据集和扰动设置。
Result: 实验在多个真实数据集上验证了所提度量的有效性，展示了精度与鲁棒性的关系，并通过鲁棒性曲线提供了更深入的分析。
Conclusion: 本文提出的鲁棒性度量能够有效地评估神经网络对输入扰动的鲁棒性，且计算简便。鲁棒性曲线为分析鲁棒性提供了新视角。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: Localized Conformal Prediction for Image Classification with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Conformal predictions have attracted significant attention in the field of uncertainty quantification, mainly because of their strong marginal coverage guarantees. Full conditional guarantee is not an attainable goal, a well known fact in conformal predictions literature. As a result, several approaches have tried to approximate this behavior by adapting the conformal sets of test-time samples according to their similarity to calibration examples. Although the latter has gained traction and shown impressive performances for regression problems, its application to image classification remains under-explored. We conduct an extensive benchmarking on natural image classification tasks with vision-language models (VLMs), using our open source implementation of a recent localized conformal prediction algorithm. We show that straightforward usage of the cosine similarity between test-time and calibration visual features, an intuitive choice for VLMs, is not sufficient to improve over the non-local baselines. In response, we propose a simple non-linear transformation of the cosine similarities, which conserves marginal coverage guarantees and achieves statistically significant mean set sizes reduction. Code is available at https://github.com/cfuchs2023/lcp-vlm/.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探索了局部化保形预测（localized conformal prediction）在视觉-语言模型（VLM）图像分类中的应用。通过广泛的基准测试，发现直接使用视觉特征的余弦相似度不能优于非局部基线。作者提出一种简单的非线性变换，在保持边际覆盖保证的同时，显著降低了平均集合大小。代码已开源。
Motivation: 保形预测虽然有边际覆盖保证，但完全条件保证不可实现。局部化方法通过考虑测试样本与校准样本的相似性来近似条件保证，但在图像分类中的应用尚不充分。
Method: 基于一个最近提出的局部化保形预测算法，使用VLM的视觉特征计算测试样本与校准样本的余弦相似度，并提出一种非线性变换来改进相似度度量，从而调整保形集合。
Result: 实验表明，直接使用余弦相似度不能改善非局部基线；提出的非线性变换在保持边际覆盖保证的同时，实现了统计显著的集合大小减少。
Conclusion: 局部化保形预测在VLM图像分类中有潜力，但简单的余弦相似度不够，需要更合适的相似度变换。作者建议未来探索更复杂的相似度学习。

papers.title: Introduction to Stochastic Differential Equations for Generative Machine Learning: A Variational Perspective
papers.abstract_en: The use of ordinary and stochastic differential equations has led to substantial progress in generative machine learning with applications to, for example, image, video and biomolecule generation. This paper provides a self-contained and informal introduction to the differential equations, the probabilistic framework for using them in generative modeling and the Fokker--Planck equation that governs the temporal evolution of the marginal distribution of the stochastic variables of the differential equations. The variational lower bound on the log-likelihood (the evidence lower bound, ELBO) is derived and used as a general starting point for a discussion of diffusion models, score matching, and flow matching. All of these approaches may be viewed as specific parameterizations of the most general variational approach. A one-dimensional density modeling problem is used as a simple example to compare different parameterizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提供了一篇自包含的非正式导论，介绍常微分方程和随机微分方程在生成式机器学习中的应用。从变分角度出发，推导了证据下界（ELBO），并用于统一讨论扩散模型、分数匹配和流匹配。通过一维密度建模问题比较了不同参数化方法。
Motivation: 生成式机器学习中微分方程（ODE/SDE）方法取得了显著进展，但缺乏从变分角度的统一介绍。本文旨在填补这一空白，为读者提供自包含的入门材料。
Method: 从变分下界（ELBO）出发，将扩散模型、分数匹配和流匹配视为该变分框架的不同参数化方式。推导了Fokker-Planck方程，并通过一维密度建模问题对参数化进行比较。
Result: 使用一维密度建模问题作为简单示例，比较了不同参数化方法的表现。未报告定量结果，重点在于概念说明。
Conclusion: 本文强调所有生成式微分方程方法均可统一在变分框架下，为理解和比较不同方法提供了通用起点。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.conclusion: 本文强调所有生成式微分方程方法均可统一在变分框架下，为理解和比较不同方法提供了通用起点。

papers.title: Which Tokens Matter? Adaptive Token Selection for RLVR with the Relative Surprisal Index
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful tool for propelling Large Language Models (LLMs) beyond imitation-based training towards more robust reasoning capabilities. Among existing approaches, RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a pivotal paradigm for advancing LLM reasoning. Despite its empirical success, recent studies have offered different insights. One line of inquiry advocates prioritizing high-entropy token positions during training, while another perspective cautions against allowing low-probability tokens to dominate gradient updates. Notably, although high-entropy tokens are usually correlated with low probability, both paradigms empirically yield substantial performance gains. In this work, we argue that evaluating sampled-token probability or entropy in isolation is insufficient to capture the policy optimization dynamics. To resolve this tension, we introduce the Relative Surprisal Index (RSI), a principled, information-theoretic metric that naturally couples the token's entropy with the probability of the selected token. We show that, under mild conditions, RSI is related to the local ratio between the first-order variations of the logit-gradient norm and predictive entropy under a selected-logit perturbation. Building on RSI, we propose RSI Selection (RSI-S), an entropy-adaptive token filtering method that retains tokens within a stable RSI interval. RSI-S successfully reconciles previous contradictory paradigms and filters out both redundant low-surprisal tokens and unstable high-surprisal tail tokens. Empirical evaluations show that RSI-S achieves higher avg@32 accuracy across different model scales (Qwen2.5-1.5B, 3B, and 7B) on AIME and AMC benchmarks: RSI-S improves avg@32 accuracy by 2--3 percentage points over GRPO. Overall, RSI offers a promising perspective for RLVR improvement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）中token选择策略的矛盾观点，提出相对惊奇指数（RSI）作为信息论度量，自然耦合token熵与选中token概率。基于RSI提出的RSI-S过滤方法保留稳定RSI区间内的token，在AIME和AMC基准上相比GRPO提升avg@32准确率2–3个百分点。
Motivation: 现有RLVR研究存在矛盾：一方主张优先高熵token，另一方警告避免低概率token主导梯度更新。单独评估采样token概率或熵不足以捕捉策略优化动态，需要统一度量。
Method: 提出相对惊奇指数（RSI），耦合token熵与选中token概率，与logit梯度范数和预测熵在选中logit扰动下的一阶变化局部比相关。基于RSI提出RSI-S，一种熵自适应token过滤方法，保留稳定RSI区间内的token，滤除冗余低surprisal和不稳定高surprisal尾部token。
Result: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B、3B、7B模型上，RSI-S在AIME和AMC基准上avg@32准确率相比GRPO提升2–3个百分点。
Conclusion: RSI为RLVR改进提供了有前景的视角，通过调和矛盾观点实现了稳定的token过滤策略。

papers.title: Temperature Field Reconstruction of Tungsten Monoblock Divertor on EAST using Physics-aware Neural Operator Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Accurate modeling of the divertor temperature field is essential for preventing material melting and damage and for extending the service life of fusion devices. However, conventional numerical methods, such as the Finite Element Method (FEM), are computationally expensive and therefore unsuitable for real-time applications. Therefore, a fast and generalizable method is required for real-time reconstruction of the divertor temperature field and subsequent real-time control. To address the above issue, we propose a Physics-aware Neural Operator Transformer (PNOT) to characterize the spatiotemporal evolution of the divertor temperature field. It models boundary heat-flux relations as a structured graph and employs graph attention to explicitly capture spatial physical dependencies. Inspired by physics-aware attention, we further develop a physics-aware neural operator module to aggregate query points with similar physical conditions via slicing and model heat diffusion, while a gradient-constrained Sobolev regularization loss enforces consistency between function values and their derivatives. Experimental results show that these physical constraints improve prediction accuracy while preserving physical consistency. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenFusion
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对EAST托卡马克偏滤器温度场实时重建问题，提出物理感知神经算子Transformer (PNOT)。该方法将边界热流关系建模为图结构，利用图注意力显式捕获空间物理依赖，并设计物理感知神经算子模块通过切片聚合相似物理条件来建模热扩散。实验表明，物理约束和梯度约束的Sobolev正则化损失在提高预测精度的同时保持了物理一致性。
Motivation: 传统有限元方法计算成本高，无法满足偏滤器温度场实时重建与控制需求，亟需快速且泛化性强的方法。
Method: 提出PNOT，包含图注意力模块捕获空间依赖、物理感知神经算子模块聚合相似物理条件并建模热扩散，以及梯度约束的Sobolev正则化损失保证函数值与导数一致性。
Result: 摘要报告物理约束提高了预测精度并保持了物理一致性。
Conclusion: 所提方法为聚变装置偏滤器温度场的实时重建与控制提供了一种高效的深度学习方案。

papers.title: Mitigating Positional Leakage in 3D Masked Autoencoders for Robust Representation Learning
papers.abstract_en: Masked autoencoding has emerged as a prominent paradigm for self-supervised learning on 3D point clouds, achieving competitive performance across downstream tasks. Unlike its 2D counterpart, 3D masked autoencoding directly reconstructs spatial coordinates, making it inherently susceptible to positional leakage. In this work, we identify that the decoder in existing 3D MAE frameworks tends to over-rely on positional information, which weakens semantic representation learning and leads to suboptimal feature quality. To address this issue, we propose MPL-MAE, a masked point learning framework that mitigates positional over-reliance while enhancing the utilization of encoder features. Specifically, we introduce a recalibrated positional embedding module that suppresses metric-dominant coordinate signals while preserving geometric topology, together with a gated positional interface module that dynamically regulates positional injection during reconstruction. These designs promote a more balanced interaction between spatial priors and semantic features, yielding robust and informative representations. Extensive experiments across downstream tasks demonstrate that MPL-MAE consistently achieves competitive performance, validating its effectiveness. Code is available at https://github.com/yanx57/MPL-MAE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对3D掩码自编码器（MAE）中位置信息泄露导致语义表示学习弱化的问题，提出MPL-MAE框架。该方法通过重新校准位置嵌入模块来抑制度量主导的坐标信号并保留几何拓扑，同时引入门控位置接口模块动态调节重建过程中的位置注入。实验表明，MPL-MAE在下游任务上取得竞争性性能。代码已开源。
Motivation: 现有3D MAE解码器过度依赖位置信息，削弱了语义表示学习，导致特征质量次优。
Method: 提出MPL-MAE，包含重新校准位置嵌入模块（抑制度量主导坐标信号并保留几何拓扑）和门控位置接口模块（动态调节位置信息注入）。
Result: 在下游任务上持续取得竞争性性能，验证了有效性。
Conclusion: 所提方法可在3D点云自监督学习中促进空间先验与语义特征的平衡交互，获得鲁棒且信息丰富的表示。

papers.title: FLARE-AI: Flaw Reporting for AI
papers.abstract_en: Flaw reporting for deployed AI systems is fundamental to identifying system failures and improving AI safety. Yet the AI reporting ecosystem is fragmented: researchers who identify flaws often do not know what or where to report, and groups who receive reports rarely share them with other relevant stakeholders. As a result, good-faith reporters duplicate effort by submitting many different forms, and recipients lack standardized, triage-ready information. We audit 12 reporting systems published by AI developers, cybersecurity groups, and AI flaw aggregators, identifying five recurring design challenges spanning discoverability, scope, information collection, coordination, and guidance for strict-liability cases. Building on this analysis and feedback from 49 experts across 32 organizations representing developers, security researchers, and ecosystem coordinators, we introduce FLARE-AI, an open-source AI flaw reporting system designed for interoperability with existing systems. FLARE-AI streamlines flaw report creation by collecting triage-relevant information through conditional logic and early classification, then enables optional dissemination of standardized, machine-readable reports to multiple developers, coordinators, and incident registries from a single submission. By lowering barriers to reporting AI flaws and improving interoperability across stakeholders, FLARE-AI helps break down silos and accelerate remediation across the AI ecosystem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI系统缺陷报告生态碎片化的问题，审计了12个现有报告系统，识别出可发现性、范围、信息收集、协调和严格责任指导五个设计挑战。基于此分析和来自32个组织的49位专家反馈，提出了FLARE-AI，一个开源、可互操作的AI缺陷报告系统，通过条件逻辑和早期分类收集分流相关信息，并支持向多个开发者和协调机构选择性分发标准化机器可读报告。
Motivation: 现有AI缺陷报告生态碎片化：研究人员不知向何处报告，接收方之间缺乏信息共享，导致重复报告和缺乏标准化信息。需要统一的报告系统来打破隔阂、加速修复。
Method: 审计12个现有报告系统，识别五个设计挑战；结合49位专家反馈；设计FLARE-AI系统，采用条件逻辑和早期分类收集分流信息，并支持标准化机器可读报告的可选分发。
Result: FLARE-AI通过单一提交实现向多个利益相关方分发标准化报告，降低报告门槛并提高互操作性，有助于打破信息孤岛并加速修复。
Conclusion: FLARE-AI作为开源框架，旨在促进AI缺陷报告的标准化和跨组织协调，但其有效性依赖于实际部署和生态采纳。

papers.title: ACE: Pluggable Adaptive Context Elasticizer across Agents
papers.abstract_en: The increasing complexity of agentic tasks has led to rapidly growing trajectory lengths, which poses significant challenges for large language model (LLM) based agents with fixed context windows. Existing context management techniques, such as truncation and summarization, suffer from inherent inflexibility and irreversibility: once information is discarded or compressed, it cannot be recovered even when it becomes critically relevant in later decision steps. To address these limitations, we propose the Adaptive Context Elasticizer (ACE), a plug-and-play module that elastically orchestrates historical step information into the agent's context at each decision step. ACE maintains a lossless message maintenance layer that stores both raw messages and compressed abstractions for each historical step, while a context orchestration layer adaptively assigns each step an elastic type as raw, abstract, or drop, at every decision step based on the current task state. This reversible design ensures that the main LLM always receives a compact yet information-rich context. We adapt ACE to four diverse agent frameworks, including ReAct, DeepAgent, WebThinker, and MiroFlow, without training or architectural modifications. Experiments show that ACE consistently outperforms truncation and summarization baselines, and brings consistent performance gains across all four agent frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ACE（自适应上下文弹性化模块），一种即插即用的模块，用于管理基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在长轨迹任务中的上下文。ACE维护一个无损的消息维护层，存储原始消息和压缩抽象，并通过上下文编排层根据当前任务状态动态为每个历史步骤分配弹性类型（原始、抽象或丢弃），确保主LLM始终接收紧凑且信息丰富的上下文。ACE无需训练或架构修改即可适配ReAct、DeepAgent、WebThinker和MiroFlow四种智能体框架，实验表明其一致优于截断和摘要基线。
Motivation: 现有智能体任务中轨迹长度快速增长，固定上下文窗口的LLM面临挑战；截断和摘要等上下文管理技术缺乏灵活性和可逆性，丢弃或压缩的信息在后续决策中无法恢复，导致性能下降。
Method: 提出ACE模块，包含无损消息维护层（存储每个历史步骤的原始消息和压缩抽象）和上下文编排层（根据当前任务状态自适应为每个步骤分配弹性类型：原始、抽象或丢弃）。ACE作为即插即用模块，可适配多种智能体框架，无需训练或架构修改。
Result: 在ReAct、DeepAgent、WebThinker和MiroFlow四种智能体框架上，ACE一致优于截断和摘要基线，并带来稳定的性能提升。
Conclusion: ACE通过可逆的弹性上下文管理解决了长轨迹智能体任务中信息不可恢复的问题，是一种通用且有效的模块化方案。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CVE-TTP KG: Knowledge Graph Linking Software Vulnerabilities to Attack Behaviors
papers.abstract_en: In the evolving threat landscape, adversaries exploit software vulnerabilities to launch sophisticated attacks, challenging traditional defenses. Although databases like CVE and NVD provide detailed technical information, they often lack links to attacker behaviors such as tactics and techniques, limiting effective threat interpretation and response. This work bridges this gap by connecting vulnerabilities with behavioral patterns from the MITRE ATT&CK framework. We construct a CVE-TTP Knowledge Graph that links CVEs to tactics and techniques using classification and relation extraction. Transformer-based models are developed for behavior identification, with CySecBERT achieving macro F1-scores of 87.71% (techniques) and 96.16% (tactics). Also, we created an annotated dataset with 24,820 entities and 43,608 relations for entity and relation extraction. The pipeline-based approach achieves macro F1-scores of 0.86 (entity extraction) and 0.99 (relation extraction), while a span-based joint model achieves 0.78. These outputs are integrated into a Neo4j-based Cyber Threat Knowledge Graph, enabling structured visualization of vulnerabilities.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建CVE-TTP知识图谱，将软件漏洞（CVE）与MITRE ATT&CK攻击行为（战术和技术）关联。使用Transformer模型（CySecBERT）进行行为识别，在技术分类上达到87.71%的宏F1，战术分类上达到96.16%。还创建了包含24,820个实体和43,608个关系的标注数据集，用于实体和关系抽取。最终输出整合到基于Neo4j的网络威胁知识图谱中。
Motivation: 现有CVE/NVD漏洞数据库缺乏与攻击者行为（如战术、技术）的关联，限制了威胁的解读和响应。
Method: 采用分类和关系抽取方法连接CVE与MITRE ATT&CK框架；开发基于Transformer的模型（CySecBERT）进行行为识别；构建标注数据集用于实体和关系抽取，并采用流水线方法和跨度联合模型。

papers.title: AugSplat: Radiance Field-Informed Gaussian Splatting for Sparse-View Settings
papers.abstract_en: Generating high-quality novel views at real-time frame rates remains a central challenge in 3D vision, particularly in sparse-view scenarios. Neural radiance fields have demonstrated robust reconstruction from limited observations, but their reliance on volumetric rendering leads to high computational cost and slow inference. In contrast, Gaussian Splatting methods achieve real-time rendering through rasterization, but their optimization is highly sensitive to the quality of the initial geometry. This sensitivity becomes especially problematic in sparse-view settings, where limited observations often lead to incomplete or noisy point-cloud reconstructions. In this work, we present AugSplat, a simple framework for improving Gaussian Splatting in sparse-view regimes using radiance-field-based view augmentation. We first train a radiance field on the sparse input views and use it to synthesize additional images from nearby novel viewpoints, increasing the effective view-space coverage available for supervision. These synthetic views are then used as auxiliary supervision during Gaussian Splatting optimization. We study two variants: Staged AugSplat, which uses synthetic views for an initial optimization phase before switching to real images, and Dual AugSplat, which jointly trains on real and synthetic views with a decaying synthetic loss weight. Experiments on sparse-view mip-NeRF 360 scenes show that AugSplat improves reconstruction quality over standard Gaussian Splatting. Staged AugSplat achieves the strongest average performance, while Dual AugSplat provides a closely performing formulation that keeps real-image supervision active throughout training, and both variants preserve real-time rendering at inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AugSplat 框架，利用辐射场（radiance field）为稀疏视图下的高斯泼溅（Gaussian Splatting）生成合成视图作为额外监督，从而提升重建质量。两种变体：Staged AugSplat 先使用合成视图优化再切换真实图像，Dual AugSplat 全程联合训练并衰减合成损失权重。实验表明该方法在稀疏视图 mip-NeRF 360 场景上优于标准高斯泼溅，同时保持实时渲染。

Conclusion: 简单有效的框架，通过辐射场视图增强改善稀疏视图高斯泼溅，同时不牺牲实时渲染速度。

papers.title: Improving multichannel speech enhancement through accurate room-acoustic simulations
papers.abstract_en: Room-acoustic simulations are widely used to augment training data for deep-learning-based speech enhancement. While most pipelines rely on simplified geometrical acoustics, wave-based approaches offer greater physical accuracy. In this work, we examine how simulation fidelity affects multichannel speech enhancement performance. To this end, we train SpatialNet on datasets augmented with different room-acoustic simulation methods and evaluate the resulting models on measured data. We compare lower-fidelity datasets based on geometrical acoustics with a high-fidelity dataset using advanced acoustic modelling and a hybrid combination of wave-based and geometrical acoustics simulations. Training on the high-fidelity dataset results in an up to 38 % relative reduction in median word error rate compared to the lower-fidelity alternatives. These results show that augmentation with high-fidelity room-acoustic simulations directly translates into improved multichannel speech enhancement performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了房间声学模拟的逼真度对多通道语音增强性能的影响。作者使用不同逼真度的模拟方法（几何声学、波声学及其混合）生成数据集，训练SpatialNet并在实测数据上评估。高逼真度模拟相比低逼真度方案，中位词错误率相对降低高达38%。
Motivation: 现有基于深度学习的语音增强通常使用几何声学模拟来扩增训练数据，但几何声学简化可能损失物理准确性。需要研究更高逼真度的波声学模拟能否带来性能提升。
Method: 使用不同房间声学模拟方法（低逼真度几何声学、高逼真度波声学及混合方法）生成扩增数据集，训练多通道语音增强模型SpatialNet，并在真实测量数据上评估。
Result: 高逼真度数据集训练出的模型，中位词错误率相对降低高达38%。
Conclusion: 高逼真度房间声学模拟直接转化为多通道语音增强性能的提升，表明仿真质量对实际应用效果至关重要。

papers.title: Modality-Driven Search with Holistic Trace Judging for ARC-AGI-2
papers.abstract_en: Large language models can produce fluent, internally coherent reasoning traces for abstract reasoning tasks while still being confidently wrong - making selection among candidates, not just generation, the central challenge. I present a solver for ARC-AGI-2, a few-shot visual reasoning benchmark, built around two principles: (i) treating reasoning modalities as search operators, generating diverse candidates independently across text, image, and code channels, and (ii) context-preserving holistic judging, in which a judge model jointly compares all candidate reasoning traces within a single long-context prompt. Unlike self-consistency or majority voting, this approach reliably recovers correct minority hypotheses on tasks where the modal answer is wrong. On the ARC Prize semi-private evaluation set, the solver achieves 72.9 percent at USD 38.99 per task - the highest score on the verified leaderboard at the time of writing, exceeding the best standalone frontier models, GPT-5.2 Pro at 54.2 percent and Gemini 3 Pro at 54.0 percent, by +18.7 percentage points. On the public evaluation set, it achieves 76.1 percent at USD 19.69 per task. I release the full source code and document extensive negative results, including the finding that prescriptive prompting templates and iterative refinement systematically reduce hypothesis diversity and degrade performance.
papers.comment: 37 pages, 4 figures; source code available at https://github.com/beetree/ARC-AGI
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对ARC-AGI-2视觉推理基准，提出了一种基于模态驱动的搜索和整体轨迹评判的求解器。该方法将推理模态视为搜索算子，独立在文本、图像和代码通道生成多样候选，并使用上下文保持的整体评判模型在单个长上下文提示中比较所有候选推理轨迹，不同于自洽性或多数投票，能可靠恢复错误模态下的正确少数假设。在ARC Prize半私有评估集上达到72.9%准确率，成本每任务$38.99，超过GPT-5.2 Pro和Gemini 3 Pro约18.7个百分点。公开评估集达到76.1%，成本每任务$19.69。作者开源代码并记录了负面结果。
Motivation: 大型语言模型能生成流畅但错误的自一致性推理轨迹，因此选择候选比生成更关键。现有方法如自洽性或多数投票在多数答案错误时失败。
Method: 提出两个原则：(i) 将推理模态视为搜索算子，在文本、图像、代码通道独立生成多样候选；(ii) 上下文保持的整体评判，使用评判模型在单个长上下文提示中联合比较所有候选推理轨迹。
Result: 在半私有评估集上达到72.9%准确率，成本$38.99/任务，超过GPT-5.2 Pro (54.2%)和Gemini 3 Pro (54.0%) 18.7个百分点。公开评估集76.1%准确率，成本$19.69/任务。
Conclusion: 该方法在ARC-AGI-2上取得了最高分，开源代码并显示了负面结果，如预设提示模板和迭代细化会减少假设多样性并降低性能。

papers.title: DataEvolver: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Data Construction for Text-Rich Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Text-rich image generation is one of the most challenging settings in image generation, since models must simultaneously produce visually realistic images and render legible, semantically aligned, and layout-consistent text. Existing data pipelines usually follow a static crawl-filter-freeze paradigm. They collect candidate samples, filter them once, and freeze the accepted data for training. However, rejected samples are usually discarded, although they often contain useful failure signals such as OCR errors and semantic mismatches. As a result, later construction rounds may repeat the same failure modes. To address these limitations, we propose DataEvolver, a self-evolving multi-agent framework for text-rich image data construction. DataEvolver treats data construction as feedback-driven construction policy evolution. A Retriever collects candidate samples, a Verifier assigns quality scores and rejection causes, a Critic summarizes round-level feedback into semantic feedback, and a Generator completes under-covered regions through targeted synthesis. The updated feedback memory then guides the next construction round. Experiments on text-rich image generation benchmarks show that DataEvolver produces more useful training data than fixed-dataset baselines under matched data budgets. At the 0.75M scale on PixArt-alpha, DataEvolver improves OCR-F1 over the strongest baseline by 85.3 percent on TextScenesHQ and 35.3 percent on LongTextBench. The improvements are consistent across both evaluated benchmarks and also transfer to Show-o2, indicating that the benefit of DataEvolver is not tied to a single downstream generator. These results suggest that rejected samples can provide actionable feedback for improving text-rich image data construction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DataEvolver，一个自进化的多智能体框架，用于文本丰富图像生成的数据构建。该框架通过检索器、验证器、批评者和生成器的协作，将拒绝样本的失败信号转化为反馈，指导下一轮数据构建。实验表明，在PixArt-alpha和Show-o2上，DataEvolver显著提升了OCR-F1等指标。
Motivation: 现有文本丰富图像生成的数据管道采用静态的采集-过滤-冻结范式，丢弃了含有有用失败信号（如OCR错误、语义不匹配）的拒绝样本，导致后续构造重复相同错误。
Method: DataEvolver包含四个智能体：Retriever收集候选样本，Verifier分配质量分数和拒绝原因，Critic总结轮次反馈为语义反馈，Generator通过目标合成补充覆盖不足的区域，更新后的反馈记忆指导下一轮构造。
Result: 在0.75M规模下，DataEvolver在PixArt-alpha上相比最强基线在TextScenesHQ上提升OCR-F1 85.3%，在LongTextBench上提升35.3%，且优势可迁移至Show-o2。
Conclusion: 拒绝样本可提供可操作的反馈，用于改进文本丰富图像数据构建，且DataEvolver的收益不局限于特定下游生成器。

papers.title: Beyond the Expressivity-Trainability Paradox: A Dynamical Lie Algebra Perspective on Navigating Barren Plateaus in Quantum Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: As Quantum Machine Learning (QML) transitions toward practical implementation, the field faces a critical architectural bottleneck that challenges the fundamental assumptions of classical statistical learning theory. In classical deep learning, increasing model capacity typically risks overfitting. However, this study advances a counter-intuitive paradigm: unstructured contemporary QML architectures suffer from a profound state of quantum underfitting, driven by the "expressivity-trainability paradox." We demonstrate that the vast Hilbert space capacity of Parameterized Quantum Circuits (PQCs)-traditionally chased as the source of quantum advantage is the direct mathematical cause of Barren Plateaus (BPs), where gradient landscapes become exponentially flat. By synthesizing recent breakthroughs in Dynamical Lie Algebras (DLAs) and Geometric QML, we establish a comprehensive framework linking the algebraic dimension of circuit generators to their optimization dynamics. Furthermore, we empirically validate this framework on a non-linear binary classification task, illuminating a uniquely quantum manifestation of the bias-variance tradeoff: while unstructured architectures achieve near-perfect training accuracy via unscalable parameterization (quantum overfitting), embedding group-theoretic geometric priors acts as a structural regularizer. By restricting the DLA growth to a polynomial regime, our symmetry-preserving approach sacrifices raw memorization capacity to guarantee scalable, gradient-rich training landscapes, offering a robust roadmap for "Trainability-by-Design" in scalable quantum neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对量子机器学习中表达性-可训练性悖论（expressivity-trainability paradox）导致的贫瘠高原（Barren Plateaus）问题，提出通过动力李代数（DLA）框架理解并缓解该现象。作者证明无结构参数化量子电路的巨大希尔伯特空间容量是贫瘠高原的直接数学原因，并通过限制DLA增长的多项式尺度，将群论几何先验作为结构正则化器，实现可训练性设计。经验验证在非线性二分类任务上展示了该方法在保证梯度丰富训练景观的同时牺牲部分记忆容量。
Motivation: 经典深度学习中增加模型容量通常导致过拟合，而现代无结构量子机器学习架构却因表达性-可训练性悖论陷入量子欠拟合状态。贫瘠高原（BP）使得梯度指数级平坦，阻碍了可扩展训练，亟需从代数几何角度提供系统性解决方案。
Method: 综合动力李代数（DLA）与几何QML的最新成果，建立电路生成元的代数维度与优化动力学之间的统一框架。通过嵌入群论几何先验作为结构正则化器，将DLA增长限制在多项式范围内，从而牺牲原始记忆容量以换取梯度丰富的训练景观。
Result: 在非线性二分类任务上，无结构架构通过不可扩展的参数化达到接近完美的训练精度（量子过拟合），而对称性保持方法通过结构化正则化实现了可扩展、梯度丰富的训练行为。
Conclusion: 该框架揭示了量子偏差-方差权衡的独特体现，并提供了“可训练性设计”（Trainability-by-Design）的可扩展量子神经网络路线图。

summary_sections.method: 综合动力李代数（DLA）与几何QML的最新成果，建立电路生成元的代数维度与优化动力学之间的统一框架。通过嵌入群论几何先验作为结构正则化器，将DLA增长限制在多项式范围内，从而牺牲原始记忆容量以换取梯度丰富的训练景观。
summary_sections.result: 在非线性二分类任务上，无结构架构通过不可扩展的参数化达到接近完美的训练精度（量子过拟合），而对称性保持方法通过结构化正则化实现了可扩展、梯度丰富的训练行为。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架揭示了量子偏差-方差权衡的独特体现，并提供了“可训练性设计”（Trainability-by-Design）的可扩展量子神经网络路线图。

papers.title: MV-GEL: Language-Driven Multi-View Geometric Entity Localization on Meshes
papers.abstract_en: Identifying and grounding precise geometric entities, such as edges, planar regions, and curved surfaces within 3D objects, is foundational to computer-aided design (CAD), robotic manipulation, and scientific simulation. Although modern Vision Language Models (VLMs) have advanced referring segmentation (RIS) in the image domain, extending such language-driven localization to structured 3D geometry is substantially harder. The 3D object appearance is highly sensitive to viewpoints; a single perspective may render a target entity clearly observable, while another may suffer from severe occlusion or foreshortening. In this work, we attempt to solve these challenges with MV-GEL (Multi-View Geometric Entity Localization), a framework for localizing fine-grained geometric entities on polygon meshes from natural language queries. Our key insight is that reliable CAD entity (i.e., faces, edges or solids) localization depends on selecting views that make the queried entity maximally interpretable. We introduce GELviews, a prompt-conditioned ranking module that prioritizes viewpoints based on language prompted observability of geometric CAD entities. Selected views are processed by a VLM-based reasoning segmentation backbone, and predicted masks are lifted to the corresponding meshes via geometry-aware ray casting. Our framework is completely CAD agnostic and relies only on 3D meshes. Experiments show up to a 1.7X improvement in face-level IoU and over 4.5X gains in edge-level F1 compared to vanilla baselines, substantially outperforming CLIP-based and random view sampling, particularly for thin and view-sensitive structures.The dataset, code and trained checkpoints are available at https://github.com/kbali1297/MV-GEL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MV-GEL框架，用于从自然语言描述在多边形网格上定位细粒度几何实体（面、边、固体）。通过GELviews模块根据语言提示选择最佳视角，利用VLM分割和光线投射将掩码提升到网格。实验显示与基线相比，面级IoU提高1.7倍，边级F1提高4.5倍，尤其在细薄和视图敏感结构上。
Motivation: 现有VLM在图像域有参照分割，但在3D几何上困难，因为3D物体外观对视角敏感。需要选择能让目标实体最可观测的视角。
Method: 提出GELviews排名模块，根据语言提示选择视角，再用VLM分割，最后通过几何光线投射将掩码映射到网格。
Result: 实验显示面级IoU提升1.7倍，边级F1提升4.5倍，远优于CLIP和随机视角采样。
Conclusion: 框架完全与CAD无关，仅依赖3D网格。强调视图选择的重要性。
Relevance: 0
