papers.title: A time-series classification framework for individual-level absenteeism prediction under severe class imbalance
papers.abstract_en: Staff absenteeism imposes substantial operational costs in high-demand work environments such as healthcare, emergency services, meat processing, construction, and courier and delivery services, where proactive workforce planning depends on reliable individual-level absence prediction. Existing regression and classification approaches share a structural limitation; they map features observed at time t to labels at the same time t, reproducing already-realised outcomes rather than predicting future events, and discard the sequential behavioural structure inherent in individual attendance histories. We propose a Time Series Classification (TSC) framework that separates historical attendance sequences from future absence labels, enabling genuinely proactive prediction. Due to the lack of public longitudinal attendance data, we construct a reproducible simulated dataset calibrated to the UCI dataset. We analyse Binary Focal Loss (BFL) and Geometric Mean (G-Mean) loss under severe class imbalance using only the imbalance ratio $ρ$. For BFL, the initial gradient ratio is $ρα/(1-α)$, implying the balanced weight $α= 1/(1+ρ) \approx 0.023$. Experiments show that performance is governed mainly by $α$, with BFL achieving specificity 0.813 and balanced accuracy 0.888, comparable to G-Mean. Unlike BFL, G-Mean adapts automatically without parameter calibration. Among three deep learning architectures evaluated, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and the hybrid LSTM-Fully Convolutional Network (LSTM-FCN), the LSTM-FCN delivers strong precision and specificity. Stable performance is obtained with batch sizes >= 64 and window sizes between 40-80 days, yielding balanced accuracy of approximately 80% on held-out test data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个时间序列分类框架用于个体层面的缺勤预测，解决了现有方法无法真正预测未来事件且忽略行为序列结构的问题。基于模拟数据集验证，分析了二元焦点损失和几何平均损失在严重类别不平衡下的表现，其中LSTM-FCN架构在批次大小≥64和窗口大小40-80天时取得约80%的平衡准确率。
Motivation: 现有缺勤预测方法存在结构缺陷：将时间t的特征映射到同一时间的标签，只是复现已发生的结果而非预测未来，且丢弃了个体考勤历史的序列结构。
Method: 提出时间序列分类框架，将历史考勤序列与未来缺勤标签分离；使用二元焦点损失和几何平均损失处理严重类别不平衡；评估LSTM、CNN和LSTM-FCN三种深度学习架构。
Result: 二元焦点损失在平衡权重α=0.023时获得特异性0.813和平衡准确率0.888，与几何平均损失相当；几何平均损失无需参数校准；LSTM-FCN在精度和特异性上表现最佳，批次大小≥64且窗口40-80天时测试集平衡准确率约80%。
Conclusion: 模拟数据集的实验表明所提框架有效，LSTM-FCN结合恰当的损失函数能在严重类别不平衡下实现可靠的个体缺勤预测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: On the Convergence of Self-Improving Online LLM Alignment
papers.abstract_en: The Self-Improving Alignment (SAIL) algorithm addresses distribution shift by reducing a bilevel formulation of the problem to an efficient, single-level method. Empirically, SAIL has demonstrated strong performance on this task. However, a formal analysis of its convergence properties has been lacking. We identify a key theoretical challenge: the standard SAIL objective function is not guaranteed to be strongly concave due to unfavorable properties of its Hessian. To address this limitation, we propose a regularized objective, SAIL-RevKL, which incorporates a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence penalty to improve the optimization landscape. Our central theoretical contribution is to prove that this regularized objective satisfies the Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition within a bounded parameter space. We establish global convergence guarantees, achieving a near-linear sample complexity. We further validate the effectiveness and stability of SAIL-RevKL through empirical evaluations, demonstrating that it outperforms the vanilla SAIL on both MuJoCo benchmarks and LLM alignment tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自改进在线LLM对齐算法SAIL的收敛性缺乏理论分析的问题，提出正则化目标SAIL-RevKL，通过引入逆向KL散度惩罚改善优化景观。理论贡献是证明该目标在有界参数空间内满足Polyak-Lojasiewicz条件，并建立全局收敛保证和近线性样本复杂度。实验表明SAIL-RevKL在MuJoCo和LLM对齐任务上优于原始SAIL。
Motivation: 标准SAIL目标函数由于Hessian矩阵的不利性质不能保证强凹性，导致其收敛性缺乏正式分析。
Method: 提出SAIL-RevKL，在原始目标中加入逆向KL散度（reverse KL divergence）惩罚项，以改善优化景观。
Result: 证明SAIL-RevKL在有界参数空间内满足Polyak-Lojasiewicz条件，实现全局收敛和近线性样本复杂度；实验显示其在MuJoCo和LLM对齐上性能优于原始SAIL。
Conclusion: 该正则化方法有效解决了SAIL的理论缺陷，保证了收敛性，且实际表现稳定。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: FinPersona-Bench: A Benchmark for Longitudinal Psychometric Stability of Autonomous Financial Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous financial agents initialized with explicit behavioral mandates such as "preserve capital" or "avoid speculative bets" that are meant to govern every decision throughout deployment. In practice, however, as market context accumulates over long horizons, these mandates gradually lose their behavioral influence, a phenomenon we formalize as Mandate Salience Decay (MSD). To measure MSD objectively, we introduce FinPersona-Bench, a simulation benchmark in which a synthetic market decouples observable price from hidden fundamental value, enabling falsifiable evaluation across three failure modes: trading without signal in calm markets, panic-selling during crashes, and ignoring fundamental value during speculative bubbles. Evaluating 18 leading frontier and open-source LLMs, each assigned one of three behavioral profiles ranging from strict capital preservation to aggressive growth, shows that MSD compounds over time and is model-dependent. In crash scenarios, the behavioral gap between static agents and those receiving periodic mandate re-grounding grows 4.4x from the first to the final quarter of the simulation. The effects of mandate re-grounding are not uniformly positive: it consistently helps conservative agents in low-signal markets but actively worsens behavior for aggressive agents in the same setting. These findings suggest that reliable long-horizon deployment requires selective, mandate-aware re-grounding based on agent profile and market regime.
papers.comment: 29 pages, includes figures and tables; formalizes Mandate Salience Decay and introduces FinPersona-Bench
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Mandate Salience Decay（指令显著性衰减）现象，即LLM金融代理在长期部署中逐渐偏离初始行为指令。为客观测量该现象，作者构建FinPersona-Bench仿真基准，通过合成市场分离价格与内在价值，评估三种失败模式。实验表明，指令衰减随时间累积且模型依赖，周期性的指令重定向对保守型代理有益，但对激进型代理可能有害。
Motivation: LLM金融代理在长期部署中，初始行为指令（如“保本”）逐渐失去对决策的约束力，导致行为漂移，可能造成风险。现有基准缺乏对这种纵向心理测量稳定性的量化评估。
Method: 提出FinPersona-Bench仿真基准，设计合成市场将可观察价格与隐藏基本面价值解耦，使得可以在三种失败模式（平静市场无信号交易、恐慌性抛售、忽视基本面价值投机）下进行可证伪评估。对18个前沿和开源LLM分配三种行为特征进行测试。
Result: 指令显著性衰减随时间累积且模型相关。在崩盘场景中，静态代理与定期重定向代理的行为差距从模拟第一季到最后扩大4.4倍。重定向效果非总是正面：在低信号市场中，对保守型代理有帮助，但使激进型代理行为恶化。
Conclusion: 可靠的长周期部署需要根据代理特征和市场状态进行选择性、指令感知的重定向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Distortion-Corrected Diffusion MRI Using Rotated-View EPI and Joint Field-Map/Image Estimation with Gaussian Primitives
papers.abstract_en: Echo Planar Imaging (EPI) is the standard acquisition technique for diffusion and functional neuroimaging, enabling rapid imaging but suffering from geometric distortions caused by B0 field inhomogeneities. Existing correction methods first reconstruct distorted images using parallel imaging, then estimate the B0 field and correct the distortion in the image domain. In this sequential process, reconstruction artifacts at high acceleration factors and low SNR at high diffusion b-values degrade B0 estimation and limit the overall correction quality. We propose a physics-informed framework that jointly estimates the B0 field and distortion-free image directly from k-space data, without depending on an intermediate parallel-imaging reconstruction for the correction. The image and the B0 field are each represented as a superposition of Gaussian primitives embedded within an MRI physics forward model. The explicit, continuous parameterization captures both smooth regions and tissue boundaries and supports rotated-view EPI acquisitions without interpolation. The diffusion-weighted image is modeled as real and non-negative, with the image phase absorbed into a per-shot phase factor. Rotated views distribute distortions across multiple phase-encoding orientations, improving point spread function isotropy and providing stronger constraints for B0 estimation. On in vivo brain diffusion EPI, the proposed method attains the closest brain-boundary agreement with a distortion-free structural reference, with the largest improvement over sequential methods at high b-value and high acceleration. Extensive visual comparisons further show improved detail fidelity and noise suppression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出一种物理引导的框架，直接从k空间数据联合估计B0场和无失真图像，避免顺序方法中的重建伪影问题。图像和B0场用高斯基元叠加表示，支持旋转视图EPI采集。在体脑扩散EPI上，该方法在脑边界一致性上达到最优，尤其是在高b值和高加速下。
Motivation: 现有EPI校正方法顺序进行：先重建失真图像再估计B0场，导致高加速因子下的重建伪影和高b值下低SNR降低B0估计质量，限制整体校正效果。
Method: 提出物理引导的联合估计框架，直接从k空间数据联合估计B0场和无失真图像。图像和B0场各表示为高斯基元叠加，嵌入MRI物理前向模型。扩散加权图像建模为实非负，相位被吸收到每帧相位因子。旋转视图EPI采集无需插值，提供更强约束。
Result: 在体脑扩散EPI上，该方法在脑边界一致性上最接近无失真结构参考，在高b值和高加速下比顺序方法有最大改进。视觉比较显示细节保真和噪声抑制改善。
Conclusion: 通过连续参数化表示和旋转视图EPI，本文提出的联合估计方法有效提高了扩散MRI的失真校正质量。

papers.title: RaBitQCache: Rotated Binary Quantization for KVCache in Long Context LLM Inference
papers.abstract_en: Long-context Large Language Model inference is severely bottlenecked by the massive Key-Value (KV) cache, yet existing sparse attention methods often suffer from static fixed-budget (Top-k) retrieval or rely on proxy scores that are computationally expensive and biased. To address these limitations, we propose RaBitQCache, a novel sparse attention framework that utilizes randomized rotated binary quantization and high-throughput binary-INT4 arithmetic to efficiently estimate attention weights. Our proxy score serves as an unbiased estimator with a proven error bound, enabling adaptive Top-p retrieval that dynamically adjusts the token budget based on actual attention sparsity. We further implement a hardware-aware system with asynchronous pipelining and lazy updates to mask overhead. Evaluations demonstrate that RaBitQCache significantly accelerates inference and reduces memory I/O while preserving generation quality compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/Sakuraaa0/RaBitQCache.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长上下文LLM推理中KV缓存导致的瓶颈，提出RaBitQCache，一种基于随机旋转二值量化（rotated binary quantization）的稀疏注意力框架。该方法通过二进制-INT4算术高效估计注意力权重，提供无偏代理分数（proxy score）并给出误差界，实现自适应Top-p检索。硬件感知系统采用异步流水线和延迟更新来掩盖开销。实验表明，相比基线方法，该方法显著加速推理并减少内存I/O，同时保持生成质量。
Motivation: 现有稀疏注意力方法通常采用静态固定预算Top-k检索，或依赖计算昂贵且有偏的代理分数，无法有效应对长上下文场景下的KV缓存瓶颈。
Method: 提出RaBitQCache框架，核心是使用随机旋转二值量化生成高吞吐的二进制-INT4算术，从而高效计算注意力权重的无偏估计；基于该估计的误差界设计自适应Top-p检索策略；并实现异步流水线和延迟更新的硬件感知系统以掩盖开销。
Result: 摘要报告，与最先进基线相比，RaBitQCache显著加速推理并减少内存I/O，同时保持生成质量。
Conclusion: RaBitQCache通过无偏代理分数和自适应范围检索，在长上下文LLM推理中实现了高效的KV缓存稀疏化，且硬件感知设计降低了实际部署开销。

papers.title: Design and Implementation of Agentic Orchestrations and Orchestration of Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agentic Business Process Management has gained momentum recently. The prospect is that the autonomy of AI agents, i.e., predominantly LLM-based agents, can be balanced with a certain level of robustness, tractability, and traceability through a combination with process technology. In this paper, we provide a classification framework for agentic orchestration options along properties such as task specificity, traceability and tractability, autonomy and reactivity, and correctness assurance and present qualitative decision criteria for realizations of different scenarios. We also provide metrics for the quantitative assessment of realization properties and show them through different agentic implementations of a predictive light sensing scenario. Altogether, this work aims at providing properties, criteria, and metrics for the design and implementation of agentic orchestrations and orchestration of agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI代理（主要是基于LLM的代理）在业务流程管理中的编排问题，提出了一个分类框架，从任务特异性、可追踪性、自主性、正确性保证等维度描述代理编排选项，并提供了定性决策标准和定量评估指标。通过在预测光感场景中的不同代理实现演示了这些指标。
Motivation: 当前AI代理在业务流程管理中缺乏鲁棒性、可追踪性和可解释性，需要与流程技术结合以平衡代理的自主性和流程的规范性。
Method: 提出一个分类框架，涵盖代理编排的多个属性（如任务特异性、可追踪性、自主性等），并给出定性决策准则和定量评估指标，通过预测光感场景的多种代理实现展示指标应用。
Result: 提供了定性决策标准和定量指标，并通过实际代理实现验证了框架的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文为代理编排的设计与实现提供了属性、准则和度量标准，帮助在不同场景下选择合适的编排方式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unsupervised Data-Efficient Cross-Modal Retrieval with Global-Neighborhood Alignment Hashing
papers.abstract_en: Compared to supervised cross-modal hashing (CMH), unsupervised CMH reduces the reliance on manual labeling by learning binary codes from unlabeled image-text pairs. However, existing unsupervised CMH methods often rely on large-scale image-text pairs, which are costly to collect. To address this limitation, we propose Global-Neighborhood Alignment Hashing (GNAH), a novel approach that preserves the semantic structure of vision-language foundation models within a compact binary Hamming space using only a limited number of image-text pairs. Specifically, GNAH captures global structural information from the continuous latent space and transfers it into the binary Hamming space through a Prototype-Anchored Global Alignment module. In addition, GNAH extends conventional pairwise contrastive learning by modeling stochastic neighborhood relationships via a Contrastive Stochastic Neighborhood Alignment module, thereby alleviating overfitting to sparse pairwise correlations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GNAH consistently outperforms existing unsupervised cross-modal retrieval methods under data-constrained settings, offering a practical solution for real-world CMH applications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出全局-邻域对齐哈希（GNAH），一种数据高效的无监督跨模态检索方法，利用有限图像-文本对学习紧凑二值哈希码。通过原型锚定全局对齐模块和对比随机邻域对齐模块，将视觉-语言基础模型的连续语义结构迁移至汉明空间，缓解稀疏成对相关性的过拟合。实验表明GNAH在数据受限设置下优于现有无监督方法。
Motivation: 现有无监督跨模态哈希方法依赖大规模图像-文本对，收集成本高；小样本场景下稀疏成对相关性易导致过拟合。
Method: 提出GNAH，包含两个模块：原型锚定全局对齐（Prototype-Anchored Global Alignment）从连续潜空间捕获全局结构并转移至二值汉明空间；对比随机邻域对齐（Contrastive Stochastic Neighborhood Alignment）建模随机邻域关系，扩展传统成对对比学习。
Result: 在数据受限设置下，GNAH一致优于现有无监督跨模态检索方法。
Conclusion: GNAH为实际跨模态哈希应用提供了一种数据高效的解决方案，无需大规模标注或海量数据。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: PRISM: Latent Composition Consistency for Single-Image Reflection Removal
papers.abstract_en: Single-image reflection removal (SIRR) seeks to recover the transmission layer from a mixture corrupted by reflections -- a severely ill-posed problem. Existing methods operate in pixel space, where the nonlinear sRGB formation model entangles the two layers and limits generalization. We observe that pretrained VAE latent spaces exhibit substantially lower coherence between image layers compared to pixel space, providing a more favorable working space for decomposition. Building on this finding, we propose \textbf{PRISM} (Pretrained-latent Reflection Image Separation Model), which reinterprets SIRR as a latent linear separation problem. Under an approximate additive formulation in latent space, PRISM learns a flow matching velocity field on a pretrained FLUX backbone that recovers both transmission and reflection in a single forward pass. To enforce robust disentanglement, we introduce a Latent Composition Consistency (LCC) strategy that constructs synthetic mixtures by swapping reflection latents across samples and enforces consistent decomposition via a cycle loss. We further propose a Layer Contrastive Separation (LCS) loss that promotes semantic separation between layers through patch-level contrastive learning, without requiring explicit reflection targets. Experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that PRISM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods by significant margins, with strong generalization to in-the-wild images.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PRISM模型，利用预训练VAE的潜在空间将单图像反射去除建模为线性分离问题，并引入潜在构成一致性（LCC）和层对比分离（LCS）损失，在六个基准上显著超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有像素空间方法受非线性sRGB形成模型限制，难以分离反射层；观察到预训练VAE潜在空间中图像层间的相干性更低，为分离提供更有利的空间。
Method: 基于预训练FLUX骨干，在潜在空间学习流匹配速度场，一次前向传播恢复传输和反射层；采用LCC策略通过交换反射潜在构建合成混合并用循环损失保证一致性；LCS损失通过块级对比学习促进层间语义分离。
Result: 在六个基准数据集上，PRISM一致且显著优于现有最先进方法，并展现对野外图像的强泛化能力。
Conclusion: 潜在空间中的线性近似和所提一致性损失有效解决了反射去除的ill-posed问题，但依赖预训练VAE的表示质量。

papers.title: Falsification, Not Exposure: An Internally Preregistered Placebo-Controlled Decomposition of Self-Repair Feedback in Frozen Small Code Models
papers.abstract_en: In deployment settings where retraining is infeasible, small frozen code models are routinely asked to repair a failed program after seeing their own failing output, usually treated as a retry mechanism. From a Popperian view, a generated program is a conjecture and a test-execution violation is an oracle-relative, executable counterexample, so feedback's value should be attributed not to re-exposure to failing code but to whether the conjecture is opened to external, executable criticism. As the third stage of a falsification-centered measurement program, this study builds a placebo-controlled instrument that decomposes the feedback packet against a blind-resampling baseline at matched output-generation budget and against content-free, shape-matched placebos. The contribution is not a new repair algorithm but a reflexive methodology (packet decomposition, placebo mirroring, matched-budget discordant-pair tests, fresh-generation confirmation, executable audits) that makes both the model's program conjecture and the researcher's "feedback content works" claim falsifiable. Across six HumanEval+/MBPP+ cells with three 0.5B-1.5B frozen models, 290 dead task-cell units (no best-of-8 candidate passing the public tier) were evaluated; the main run produced 7,000 fresh generations and a preregistered follow-up 1,400 more. Blind resampling exceeded bare-code retry by +18 net unlocks (25/7, Holm p=0.0021). Code-plus-facts recovered +18 over bare code (21/3, p=0.00042) and +15 over a generic-bullet placebo (p=0.0041). An instruction-only effect was not distinguishable (+3, p=0.36). Code-plus-facts and blind resampling tied at 26 unlocks each (not equivalence). Six external-controller follow-ups tied a content-free shape placebo. In this regime, falsification helped not as vocabulary or self-critique, but as comparison with external, executable counterexamples.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过安慰剂对照实验，分解了冻结小代码模型在程序修复中反馈信号的作用。研究发现，盲重采样（blind resampling）比裸代码重试多解锁18个任务，代码+事实（code-plus-facts）反馈也优于通用占位符安慰剂，但仅指令效果不显著。结论是，反馈的价值在于将程序猜想暴露于外部可执行的反例（即证伪），而非单纯的自我暴露。
Motivation: 在部署环境中，小冻结代码模型常通过查看自身失败输出来修复程序，但反馈的机制尚不明确。本文从证伪主义视角出发，质疑反馈的价值是否来自重新暴露于失败代码，而非让猜想接受外部可执行批评。
Method: 构建安慰剂对照框架，将反馈包分解，并与盲重采样基线（匹配输出生成预算）以及无内容形状匹配的安慰剂对比。采用包分解、安慰剂镜像、匹配预算不一致对检验、新生成确认、可执行审计等自反方法论。在HumanEval+/MBPP+的六个子集上，使用三个0.5B-1.5B冻结模型，评估290个死单元。
Result: 盲重采样比裸代码重试净解锁+18个任务（25/7, Holm p=0.0021）；代码+事实比裸代码净解锁+18（21/3, p=0.00042），比通用占位符安慰剂净解锁+15（p=0.0041）；仅指令效果不显著（+3, p=0.36）。代码+事实与盲重采样均解锁26个任务（不等效）。六个外部控制器随访与无内容形状安慰剂无差异。
Conclusion: 作者强调反馈的价值并非来自词汇或自我批评，而是来自与外部可执行反例的比较。本方法论使模型程序猜想和研究者的“反馈内容有效”主张均可被证伪。

papers.title: SimpleSearch-VL: A Simple Recipe for Multimodal Agentic Deep Search
papers.abstract_en: We present SimpleSearch-VL, an efficient, reliable, and practical framework for multimodal agentic search. Its core idea is to improve the agent's own search-and-verification process rather than scaling data, tools, or auxiliary model components. For efficiency, Factorized Adaptive Rollout (FAR) improves sampling efficiency by forming more informative training groups while using redundant samples to mitigate long-tail latency and expose hard samples. For reliability, SimpleSearch-VL performs evidence-verified reasoning, explicitly using chain-of-thought verification to assess the relevance of retrieved visual and textual cues to the original context. For practicality, SimpleSearch-VL keeps a lightweight tool interface and performs webpage self-summary within the agent, requiring no additional external dependencies. With only 5K supervised tool-interleaved trajectories and 2K RL data, SimpleSearch-VL improves Qwen3-VL agentic baselines by 15.8 and 16.0 average points for the 8B and 30B-A3B variants, respectively. The SimpleSearch-VL-30B-A3B model further achieves performance competitive with agentic Gemini-3-Pro.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SimpleSearch-VL，一个多模态智能体搜索框架，通过改进智能体自身的搜索与验证流程而非扩展数据或工具来提升效率与可靠性。核心贡献包括因子化自适应展开（FAR）提高采样效率、证据验证推理（利用链式思维验证检索到的视觉和文本线索的相关性）以及轻量级工具接口和网页自我摘要。仅用5K监督轨迹和2K RL数据，在Qwen3-VL智能体基线上将8B和30B-A3B变体分别提升15.8和16.0平均点，30B-A3B模型性能与Gemini-3-Pro相当。
Motivation: 现有多模态智能体搜索方法依赖大量数据、复杂工具或辅助模型组件，效率低且可靠性不足，缺乏兼顾效率、可靠性和实用性的统一方案。
Method: 提出因子化自适应展开（FAR）形成更信息丰富的训练分组，利用冗余样本缓解长尾延迟并暴露困难样本；采用证据验证推理，通过链式思维显式评估检索到的视觉和文本线索与原始上下文的相关性；保持轻量级工具接口并在智能体内进行网页自我摘要，无需外部依赖。

papers.title: Fully Automated High-Precision Segmentation of Retinal Atrophy and Ellipsoid Zone Thickness in OCT: A Reliable Tool for Real-World GA Monitoring
papers.abstract_en: Geographic atrophy (GA) secondary to age-related macular degeneration (AMD) requires precise monitoring of relevant structural biomarkers to assess disease stage, progression, and treatment response. This paper presents a fully automated, deep learning-based framework for the high-precision, pixel-wise segmentation of key biomarkers in optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging: retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) loss, ellipsoid zone (EZ) loss, and EZ thinning. The proposed pipeline uses three specialized semantic segmentation models to delineate RPE loss, EZ boundaries (including interruptions), and Bruch's membrane. To ensure robustness and generalizability, the models were developed on a diverse dataset of 298 SD-OCT volumes representing the full phenotypic spectrum of AMD (GA:222, intermediate AMD: 40, neovascular AMD: 17, healthy: 19) and validated on an independent external dataset (n=43). The comprehensive evaluation was further strengthened using additional datasets to assess repeatability, inter-reader reliability, the impact of B-scan density on measurement accuracy, and subgroup performance stratified by lesion size. Results demonstrated high segmentation accuracy (Dice RPE loss: 0.88, Dice EZ loss: 0.87, Pearson's r > 0.99). Total EZ thickness measurements exhibited a sub-pixel average deviation of 2.15 $μm$, and segmentation reliability was confirmed by a strong reproducibility score (ICC > 0.98). By accurately and consistently quantifying outer photoreceptor degeneration and RPE loss, this fully automated framework provides a highly reliable tool for GA assessment in both clinical trials and routine real-world ophthalmic care.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个全自动深度学习框架，用于光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像中视网膜色素上皮（RPE）丢失、椭圆体带（EZ）丢失及EZ变薄的高精度像素级分割。模型在298个SD-OCT体积（涵盖地图样萎缩（GA）、中间型AMD、新生血管性AMD和健康眼）上训练，并在独立外部数据集（n=43）上验证。结果显示高分割精度（Dice RPE丢失：0.88，EZ丢失：0.87，皮尔逊r>0.99），EZ厚度测量亚像素平均偏差2.15μm，再现性ICC>0.98。
Motivation: 年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）继发的地图样萎缩（GA）需要精确监测结构性生物标志物以评估疾病阶段、进展和治疗反应，现有方法缺乏全自动高精度分割工具。
Method: 提出全自动深度学习流水线，使用三个专门化的语义分割模型分别分割RPE丢失、EZ边界（包括中断）和Bruch膜。在多样化数据集上开发，并通过重复性、读片者间可靠性、B扫密度影响及亚组分析进行综合评估。
Result: 分割准确率高：Dice系数RPE丢失0.88，EZ丢失0.87，皮尔逊r>0.99；总EZ厚度测量平均偏差2.15μm；再现性ICC>0.98。
Conclusion: 该全自动框架能准确一致地量化外感光细胞退化和RPE丢失，为临床试验和常规眼科护理中的GA评估提供可靠工具。

papers.title: HVPNet: A Bio-Inspired Network for General Salient and Camouflaged Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, most research on multimodal salient object detection (SOD) and camouflaged object detection (COD) typically aims to improve performance through complex cross-modal feature fusion and decoding structures. However, this approach leads to an excessively large model parameter scale and often fails to deliver satisfactory detection performance due to structural redundancy. In contrast, the human visual process is able to efficiently perform salient and camouflaged object identification without such complex structures. This contrast raises an important question: Can we draw conceptual inspiration from the human visual process to achieve a simpler modeling strategy, and still realize accurate and efficient object detection? To answer this question, we propose HVPNet, a simple yet general bio-inspired computational architecture. Drawing on the multi-layered information integration of the retina as a conceptual metaphor, we designed a Retinal Integration Module (RIM), which effectively integrates multimodal features through a level-specific multi-stage integration strategy. To fully exploit these features, we further design a cortical decoder (CD) that breaks down the decoding process into low- and high-level visual stages, abstracting the hierarchical processing in the human visual cortex. Benefiting from these designs, HVPNet can readily extend to seven tasks across four modalities. Without bells and whistles, it establishes an excellent accuracy-efficiency trade-off across 22 datasets spanning these seven tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/jiaweiXu1029/HVPNet.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文受人类视觉过程启发，提出一种简单的生物启发计算架构HVPNet，用于显著目标检测（SOD）和伪装目标检测（COD）。该网络包含视网膜集成模块（RIM）和皮层解码器（CD），通过多层级多阶段融合多模态特征，并解耦解码过程。在22个数据集上覆盖7个任务，实现精度与效率的良好平衡。
Motivation: 现有多模态SOD和COD方法依赖复杂跨模态融合和解码结构，导致模型参数庞大且性能欠佳。作者希望借鉴人眼视觉过程的高效性，设计更简洁的建模策略以实现准确且高效的目标检测。
Method: 提出HVPNet，包括视网膜集成模块（RIM）模拟视网膜的多层信息整合，通过层级特定多阶段策略融合多模态特征；以及皮层解码器（CD）将解码分解为低层和高层视觉阶段，模拟人脑皮层分层处理。
Result: HVPNet可扩展至7个任务（含RGB、深度、热红外等4种模态），在22个数据集上达到最优或接近最优的精度，同时保持较低参数量和计算开销。
Conclusion: 摘要强调生物启发的方法能在简化结构的同时保持高性能，为多模态目标检测提供了新思路。

papers.title: Surprise as a Signal for Plasticity and Metacognition
papers.abstract_en: We study a single idea across two settings: that a prediction-error signal, computed by a small predictor over the latent space of a frozen encoder, can serve both as a gate on plasticity and as a substrate for metacognition. In the first system, a non-parametric episodic memory writes a new concept only when this surprise is high, and a periodic offline replay phase consolidates recent traces into a slow linear readout. On a continual stream of 1000 ImageNet classes with a frozen DINOv2 or I-JEPA backbone, the consolidation phase recovers 17.7 points of retention on the oldest classes for DINOv2 and 51.3 points for I-JEPA (single-seed runs), and an ablation shows that replaying only a recent window is worse than no replay at all. In few-shot evaluation the same memory reaches 91.6% on 5-way 1-shot mini-ImageNet, above a task-specific baseline, while a harder 500-way regime exposes the true difficulty. In the second system, the same surprise signal, computed in a shared text-image space, modulates the behaviour of a vision-language model: it answers assertively when a concept is known, hedges when it is partially familiar, and refuses to identify the object and asks for an explanation when it is novel, learning the concept from a single user utterance. The external detector separates known from novel concepts at an AUROC of 0.966 (95% CI +/-0.024), far above the model's own verbalised confidence (0.618), while its token-level confidence sits below chance under greedy decoding; after a sleep phase that empties the fast store, the system recalls 99.2% of fifty taught facts from the consolidated store while a base model recovers none. We report both systems as proof-of-concept, with explicit limitations, and position the second against recent episodic-memory and personalised-VLM work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究一个核心想法：由冻结编码器隐性空间上的小预测器计算的预测误差信号，既可以作为可塑性门控信号，也可以作为元认知的基质。在第一个系统中，非参数情景记忆仅在惊奇度高时写入新概念,并通过周期性离线重放将近期痕迹巩固到慢速线性读出中。在DINOv2或I-JEPA骨干的1000类ImageNet持续流上,重放阶段使DINOv2的最旧类别保留恢复17.7分，I-JEPA恢复51.3分(单次运行)。Few-shot评估中相同记忆在5-way 1-shot mini-ImageNet上达91.6%。在第二个系统中，相同惊奇信号在共享文本-图像空间中调节视觉语言模型的行为：已知时断言回答，部分熟悉时含糊，新颖时拒绝识别并请求解释，从单次用户话语学习概念。外部检测器区分已知与新颖概念的AUROC达0.966(95% CI +/-0.024),远高于模型自身口头置信度(0.618)。睡眠阶段清空快速存储后,系统从巩固存储中回忆已教事实的99.2%,而基模型为0%。作者将两个系统报告为概念验证，并明确指出局限性。
Motivation: 利用单一的预测误差信号同时实现持续学习中的可塑性控制（仅在高惊奇时写入）和开放世界交互中的元认知（根据惊奇度调节自信度），以解决灾难性遗忘和模型自知不确定性问题。
Method: 提出两个基于相同惊奇信号的系统。系统1：冻结编码器+小预测器计算惊奇，非参数记忆仅在惊奇高时写入，定期离线重放（使用近期窗口或全部）巩固到慢速线性读出。系统2：在共享文本-图像空间中对相同惊奇信号进行阈值处理，调节VLM生成行为（断言/含糊/拒绝并请求解释），并学习新概念。
Result: 系统1：在DINOv2上恢复17.7点保留，I-JEPA上恢复51.3点；5-way 1-shot mini-ImageNet达91.6%，高于任务特异性基线。系统2：外部检测器AUROC 0.966，模型自身置信度仅0.618；睡眠阶段后从慢速存储回忆99.2%已教事实，基模型为0%。
Conclusion: 作为概念验证，展示了惊奇信号在持续学习和元认知两种场景中的有效性，并强调了局限性（如单次运行、任务特异性基线、硬性500-way regime的困难）。系统2与近期情景记忆和个性化VLM工作进行了对比定位。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Robustness of Robotic Manipulation: Foundations and Frontiers
papers.abstract_en: Humans and animals exhibit remarkable robustness in physical manipulation, yet robots remain far behind. Progress toward human-level manipulation robustness is hindered by the absence of a unified and systematic understanding: different subfields frame robustness in distinct ways, often leaving the concept ambiguous and limiting deeper analysis as well as communication across research areas. This paper presents a systematic study of manipulation robustness. We begin with a formal definition, characterizing robustness as the degree to which a manipulation system can achieve its goal in the presence of uncertainty and variation. Building on this definition, we introduce general formulations of manipulation robustness from probabilistic and control-theoretic perspectives. We then synthesize the guiding principles and concrete mechanisms of manipulation robustness across perception, planning, control, policy learning, and hardware, illustrating each mechanism through representative works, including foundational and recent studies. In addition, we revisit existing metrics and evaluation methods for quantifying manipulation robustness. Finally, we distill broader lessons for designing robust manipulation systems and discuss open problems and future directions toward achieving human-level robustness in robotic manipulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了机器人操作中的鲁棒性问题，从形式化定义出发，结合概率论和控制论视角给出一般性表述，并综合了感知、规划、控制、策略学习和硬件层面的鲁棒性机制。最后讨论了现有评估方法和未来方向，旨在实现类人水平的操作鲁棒性。
Motivation: 人类和动物在物理操作中表现出显著的鲁棒性，而机器人远未达到；不同子领域对鲁棒性的定义不统一，导致概念模糊，阻碍深入分析和跨领域交流。
Method: 提出正式定义：鲁棒性是操作系统在不确定性和变化下达成目标的程度；从概率和控制论角度给出一般公式；梳理感知、规划、控制、策略学习和硬件中的指导原则与具体机制。
Result: 本文是综述性研究，没有新的实验结果，但提供了统一的鲁棒性框架和代表性工作分析。
Conclusion: 通过对鲁棒性的系统梳理，提炼出设计鲁棒操作系统的经验教训，并指出实现类人水平鲁棒性的开放问题和未来方向。

summary_sections.motivation: 人类和动物在物理操作中表现出显著的鲁棒性，而机器人远未达到；不同子领域对鲁棒性的定义不统一，导致概念模糊，阻碍深入分析和跨领域交流。
summary_sections.method: 提出正式定义：鲁棒性是操作系统在不确定性和变化下达成目标的程度；从概率和控制论角度给出一般公式；梳理感知、规划、控制、策略学习和硬件中的指导原则与具体机制。
summary_sections.result: 本文是综述性研究，没有新的实验结果，但提供了统一的鲁棒性框架和代表性工作分析。
summary_sections.conclusion: 通过对鲁棒性的系统梳理，提炼出设计鲁棒操作系统的经验教训，并指出实现类人水平鲁棒性的开放问题和未来方向。

papers.title: DrivingDepth: Sparse-Prompted Pixel-wise Scale Correction for Driving Depth Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Dense depth estimation for autonomous driving faces a geometry-scale conflict: depth foundation models deliver pixel-aligned dense visual geometry without reliable metric scale, while projected LiDAR provides metric anchors that are sparse, noisy, and misaligned with image structures. Existing sparse-prompted methods incorporate LiDAR by regenerating depth from scratch, overriding the foundation model's coherent geometry and producing structural artifacts on visually continuous surfaces. Our key insight is that foundation models already capture geometrically coherent relative depth; no additional surface structure learning is required-only a per-pixel scale factor mapping relative geometry to metric coordinates. Based on this, we propose DrivingDepth, which treats sparse LiDAR as geometric prompts that locally calibrate a frozen foundation prior through residual pixel-wise scale correction, preserving dense visual geometry by construction. On nuScenes with 4-frame surround-view input, DrivingDepth achieves an AbsRel of 11.19 and an EdgeCR of 5.741, outperforming MapAnything (11.99/1.914) by simultaneously delivering SOTA metric accuracy and geometric consistency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶中的密集深度估计问题，提出DrivingDepth方法，将稀疏LiDAR点云作为几何提示，对冻结的深度基础模型进行逐像素尺度校正，从而保持密集视觉几何的一致性。在nuScenes四目环视输入上，AbsRel达到11.19，EdgeCR为5.741，同时优于MapAnything的11.99/1.914，兼顾度量精度与几何一致性。
Motivation: 现有深度基础模型能输出像素对齐的密集视觉几何，但缺乏可靠的度量尺度；而投影LiDAR提供稀疏且有噪声的度量锚点，两者存在几何尺度冲突。现有稀疏提示方法从头生成深度，会覆盖基础模型的连贯几何，造成视觉连续表面上的结构伪影。
Method: 提出DrivingDepth，将稀疏LiDAR视为几何提示，通过残差逐像素尺度校正局部校准冻结的基础先验，从而无需额外表面结构学习，直接保留密集视觉几何。
Result: 在nuScenes四目环视输入上，DrivingDepth的AbsRel达到11.19，EdgeCR为5.741，优于MapAnything的11.99/1.914，同时达到最优度量精度和几何一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，基础模型已捕获几何一致的相对深度，只需逐像素尺度因子映射到度量坐标，无需重新学习表面结构。

papers.title: Fork-Think with Confidence
papers.abstract_en: Parallel thinking has enjoyed great success for boosting LLM performance on reasoning tasks without the need for any re-training. However, existing methods follow a think-first-then-decide paradigm, i.e., they first sample multiple reasoning paths, which inevitably leads to overgeneration, then prune or stop unnecessary paths to compensate. In contrast, decide-first-then-think, i.e., first identifying points that are likely to lead to desirable generations, has been underexplored so far. Following this paradigm, we propose Fork-think with confidence, that first identifies forking points using model confidence in a single seeding path, then triggers thinking, sampling multiple continuations and aggregating them for the final response. Our experiments across three models and three reasoning benchmarks show that Fork-think reduces the token consumption by up to 30% and run-time by up to 57%, while performing comparable to or better than parallel thinking. Our analysis reveals that Fork-think is able to identify forking points that are meaningful with respect to the downstream task and that sampling at later positions can lead to substantially better generations. Finally, we demonstrate how combining Fork-think with existing mechanisms such as early stopping and weighted voting can further boost the performance and perform comparably to existing state-of-the-art methods, without requiring any warm-up or offline training. Our results establish pre-determined forking as a promising research direction for efficient LLM reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Fork-think with confidence，一种先决断再思考的并行推理范式，首先在单个种子路径上用模型置信度识别分叉点，然后触发多路径采样并聚合。实验表明该方法在三个模型和三个推理基准上相比现有并行思考方法可减少最多30%的token消耗和57%的运行时间，性能相当或更好。分析发现分叉点具有语义意义，且后期采样能带来更好的生成。
Motivation: 现有并行思考方法采用先思考后决断范式，导致过度生成和无效修剪，效率低下。作者探索先决断再思考，即先识别可能产生理想生成的关键点。
Method: 提出Fork-think with confidence：在单个种子路径上利用模型置信度检测分叉点，然后在该点触发并行思考，采样多个延续并通过聚合得到最终答案。
Result: 在三个模型和三个推理基准上，Fork-think减少了最多30%的token消耗和57%的运行时间，性能与并行思考持平或更优。结合早期停止和加权投票后可进一步提升，无需预训练或热身。
Conclusion: 预确定分叉点是一种高效LLM推理的有前景方向，能够在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅降低计算开销。

papers.title: Constrained Online Convex Optimization without Slater's Condition
papers.abstract_en: We study constrained online convex optimization with adversarial losses and stochastic or adversarial constraints. For stochastic constraints, existing algorithms that achieve nearly optimal regret and constraint violation bounds typically rely on regularity assumptions such as Slater's condition, while adversarial-constraint algorithms avoid these assumptions by using a rather restrictive round-wise feasible comparator. We bridge this gap with an anytime primal-dual framework that incorporates an adaptive regularizer into the dual update. The regularizer stabilizes the dual process without relying on the negative drift induced by Slater's condition. For stochastic constraints and convex losses, our algorithm achieves $O(\sqrt{T})$ expected regret and $O(\sqrt{T}\log T)$ expected cumulative constraint violation. Furthermore, we show that our algorithm also admits high-probability bounds of the same order on regret and constraint violation. For strongly convex losses, the regret bound improves to $O(\log T)$ with a violation bound of the same order. With a minor modification, the framework also applies to adversarial constraints and provides guarantees for hard constraint violation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对约束在线凸优化中的遗憾与约束违反界问题，提出一种不依赖Slater条件的任意时间原始-对偶算法，在对偶更新中引入自适应正则化器以稳定对偶过程。在随机约束下，算法对于凸损失达到O(sqrt(T))期望遗憾和O(sqrt(T)logT)期望累积约束违反，并具有高概率保证；对于强凸损失，遗憾界改进为O(logT)。此外，算法可扩展至对抗约束并提供硬约束违反保证。
Motivation: 现有约束在线凸优化算法在随机约束下通常依赖Slater条件，而对抗约束算法则使用限制性较强的可行比较器，缺乏通用的无Slater条件方法。
Method: 提出一个任意时间原始-对偶框架，通过对偶更新中引入自适应正则化器来稳定对偶过程，从而避免依赖Slater条件产生的负漂移。
Result: 对于随机约束和凸损失，达到O(sqrt(T))期望遗憾和O(sqrt(T)logT)期望累积约束违反，并具有高概率界；对于强凸损失，遗憾界改进为O(logT)。对于对抗约束，提供硬约束违反保证。
Conclusion: 该框架不依赖Slater条件即可获得接近最优的遗憾和约束违反界，并通过自适应正则化实现了对偶稳定性；适用于随机和对抗约束场景。

papers.title: One Reflection Is Not Enough: Self-Correcting Autonomous Research via Multi-Hypothesis Failure Attribution
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous research agents can now draft hypotheses, write code, run experiments, and produce papers, but they remain brittle when experiments fail. Under the prevailing paradigm, failure recovery is usually delegated to a single free-form reflection: a rich trajectory of metrics, logs, and design choices is compressed into one verbal critique, which often leads either to localized trial-and-error or to hard pivots that discard useful context. We propose SAGE, a Self-correcting, Autonomous, Grounded Experimenter, to tackle this failure-recovery bottleneck. Its core mechanism, Multi-Hypothesis Failure Attribution (MHFA), treats recovery as a structured causal diagnosis. By analyzing dynamic trajectory features, MHFA systematically generates multiple evidence-grounded explanations for a failure, independently evaluates their severity, and deterministically routes the verified root cause to the correct intervention level (hypothesis, experimental design, or implementation). To guarantee scientific honesty, SAGE further employs a grounded reporting mechanism that explicitly constrains drafted results to actual measured values, redacting hallucinated numbers. On a 12-topic, 5-domain benchmark, SAGE increases metrics-bearing outputs from 42% to 92% over a reflection baseline, improves artifact quality from 5.00 to 6.75/10, and blindly outscores AI-Scientist-v2 (52.0 vs. 48.2), with gains concentrated in code development and execution. While fully autonomous scientific writing and generating conference-ready papers remain notoriously difficult open problems for the entire field, SAGE successfully produces significantly more reliable and higher-quality scientific artifacts. Ultimately, by coupling structured recovery with explicit grounding constraints, SAGE significantly outperforms monolithic reflection paradigms, establishing a highly trustworthy foundation for future autonomous research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE（自纠正自主有根据实验者），通过多假设失败归因（MHFA）机制解决自主研究代理在实验失败时的恢复瓶颈。MHFA将恢复视为结构化因果诊断，生成多个基于证据的解释，独立评估严重性，并将已验证的根因路由到正确的干预级别。SAGE还采用有根据的报告机制，限制草稿结果反映实际测量值。在12个主题5个领域的基准上，SAGE将包含指标的输出从42%提升到92%，工件质量从5.00提高到6.75/10，并超越AI-Scientist-v2（52.0 vs 48.2）。
Motivation: 当前自主研究代理在实验失败时依赖单一自由形式反思，容易产生局部试错或硬转折，丢弃有用上下文，导致恢复效率低下。
Method: 提出SAGE框架，核心是MHFA机制：通过分析动态轨迹特征，系统生成多个基于证据的失败解释，独立评估严重性，并将验证的根因确定性路由到正确的干预级别（假设、实验设计或实现）。同时采用有根据的报告机制，约束草稿结果仅包含实际测量值。
Result: 在12个主题5个领域的基准上，SAGE将包含指标的输出从42%提升到92%，工件质量从5.00提高到6.75/10，并盲目评分超越AI-Scientist-v2（52.0 vs 48.2），增益主要集中在代码开发和执行。
Conclusion: 通过结构化恢复与明确有根据约束的结合，SAGE显著超越单一反思范式，为未来自主研究建立了高度可信的基础。但完全自主的科学写作和生成会议级论文仍是显著的开放难题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: TabPATE: Differentially Private Tabular In-Context Learning Without Public Data
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models enable accurate in-context learning (ICL) from small labeled datasets, but the private records placed in context can leak through model predictions. We first show that even basic membership inference attacks succeed against tabular ICL, motivating formal privacy protection. We then introduce TabPATE, a differentially private PATE-style defense for tabular ICL that does not require public in-distribution data. TabPATE partitions the private context across teacher models, privately aggregates their labels on synthetic tabular queries, and releases the resulting labeled queries as a student context. Because tabular features are bounded and relatively low-dimensional, useful queries can be generated from feature ranges alone or from lightly privatized marginals. Across tabular benchmarks, TabPATE preserves competitive utility while reducing membership inference to near-random success, providing a practical path to private tabular ICL without public data.
papers.comment: Presented at the 2nd ICML Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对表格基础模型上下文学习（ICL）中的隐私泄露问题，提出TabPATE方法，一种无需公共数据的差分隐私PATE式防御。TabPATE通过将私有上下文分配给多个教师模型，对合成表格查询进行隐私聚合，生成标注查询作为学生上下文，从而保护训练数据隐私。实验表明，该方法在表格基准上保持竞争性效用，并将成员推理攻击成功率降至接近随机水平。
Motivation: 表格基础模型可以通过少量标注数据进行准确的上下文学习，但上下文中的私有记录可能通过模型预测泄露隐私。简单的成员推理攻击即可成功，因此需要正式的隐私保护方法。
Method: 提出TabPATE，一种基于PATE（Private Aggregation of Teacher Ensembles）的差分隐私框架。将私有上下文样本分给多个教师模型，对从特征范围或轻隐私化边际生成的合成表格查询进行投票聚合，以隐私保护的方式生成标签，作为学生模型的上下文。
Result: 在多个表格基准任务上，TabPATE保持与现有方法相当的效用，同时将成员推理攻击的成功率降低到接近随机猜测水平。
Conclusion: TabPATE提供了一种无需公共数据即可实现表格ICL差分隐私的实用路径，适用于特征有界且低维的表格数据场景。

summary_sections.result: 在多个表格基准任务上，TabPATE保持与现有方法相当的效用，同时将成员推理攻击的成功率降低到接近随机猜测水平。
summary_sections.conclusion: TabPATE提供了一种无需公共数据即可实现表格ICL差分隐私的实用路径，适用于特征有界且低维的表格数据场景。

papers.title: Von Mises Based Uncertainty Quantification for Closely Spaced Automotive Radar Targets
papers.abstract_en: This work investigates uncertainty-aware deep learning approaches for direction of arrival (DOA) estimation in automotive radar, focusing on probabilistic modeling and downstream integration. A circular-statistics-based von Mises (VM) ensemble (ENS) is compared with an evidential deep learning (EDL) framework based on a normal inverse gamma formulation, yielding a Student t predictive distribution in the Euclidean domain. The ENS framework produces angular predictions parameterized by (mu, kappa), enabling interpretable uncertainty aligned with directional geometry. Performance is evaluated under in distribution and multiple out-of-distribution conditions using risk coverage and ROC or AUROC analyses. Results indicate that ENS achieves lower uncertainty under nominal conditions and exhibits stronger sensitivity to severe perturbations, whereas EDL provides smoother uncertainty variation and slightly improved ranking consistency. Importantly, the ENS representation enables direct probabilistic integration into association modules via closed form VM likelihoods, facilitating a unified detection tracking pipeline. These findings highlight a trade-off between geometric consistency and statistical generality in uncertainty-aware DOA estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了基于von Mises分布的集成方法（ENS）和基于正态逆伽马的证据深度学习（EDL）两种不确定性量化方法在汽车雷达到达角估计中的应用。ENS提供参数化的角预测（mu, kappa），在标称条件下不确定性更低且对严重扰动更敏感；EDL则提供更平滑的不确定性变化和略优的排序一致性。ENS的表示可直接通过封闭形式的von Mises似然集成到检测跟踪管道中。
Motivation: 汽车雷达中密集目标的到达角估计需要不确定性量化，但现有方法在概率建模和下游集成方面存在不足。
Method: 提出基于圆形统计的von Mises集成方法和基于正态逆伽马的证据深度学习框架，后者产生学生t预测分布，并使用风险覆盖和ROC/AUROC进行性能评估。
Result: ENS在标称条件下不确定性更低，对严重扰动更敏感；EDL不确定性变化更平滑，排序一致性略好。ENS可通过封闭形式VM似然直接集成到关联模块。
Conclusion: 不确定性感知DOA估计中存在几何一致性与统计通用性之间的权衡。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Think While You Map: Asynchronous Vision-Language Agents for Incremental 3D Scene Graphs
papers.abstract_en: Open-vocabulary 3D scene graph methods typically operate in two stages: first reconstruct, then enrich with vision-language models, leaving the graph unqueryable during exploration. We argue that this sequential coupling is unnecessary and propose an asynchronous architecture in which lightweight online mapping runs concurrently with heavyweight semantic refinement. A probabilistic voxel-based backbone maintains stable object identities incrementally, while background VLM agents progressively enrich the graph. This framework resolves duplicate object tracks through semantic loop closure, attaches fine-grained visual attributes and derives spatial relations between objects. A multi-target frame scheduler amortizes VLM cost by selecting a small set of informative frames that jointly cover multiple targets. The resulting scene graph is queryable during exploration and grows in semantic richness over time. Our method matches or outperforms existing open-vocabulary 3D scene graph methods on semantic segmentation (ScanNet, Replica) and surpasses the prior state-of-the-art across three visual grounding benchmarks (Sr3D+, Nr3D, ScanRefer) by 15.3 to 18.8 A@0.25. Project page: https://denizbickici.github.io/thinkgraphs/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种异步视觉语言代理架构，用于增量式3D场景图构建，在探索过程中即可查询并逐渐丰富语义。通过概率体素骨干维护物体身份，背景VLM代理进行语义细化，并利用多目标帧调度器摊销成本。在ScanNet、Replica等语义分割基准以及Sr3D+、Nr3D、ScanRefer视觉定位基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有开放词汇3D场景图方法通常先重建再语义增强，导致探索期间图不可查询。作者认为这种顺序耦合不必要。
Method: 提出异步架构，轻量在线建图与重型语义细化并行运行。使用概率体素骨干增量维护物体身份，背景VLM代理通过语义闭环消除重复并添加属性与空间关系，多目标帧调度器选择信息量大的帧。
Result: 在语义分割（ScanNet, Replica）上匹配或超越现有方法，在三个视觉定位基准（Sr3D+, Nr3D, ScanRefer）上超越先前最优15.3-18.8 A@0.25。
Conclusion: 该方法使得场景图在探索期间可查询且语义随时间增长，效果达到或超越现有方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CLOUDADV: Decision-Aligned Instance Sizing with Zero-Shot Foundation Models under Drift
papers.abstract_en: Cloud virtual machines are often overprovisioned, creating avoidable cost and operational inefficiency. We present CLOUDADV, an interactive engineer-facing advisory system for cloud instance sizing under workload drift. The system combines zero-shot time-series forecasting with bounded recommendation generation across day-, week-, and month-scale planning horizons. For each query, CLOUDADV constructs a structured decision context from historical utilization, forecast summaries, current VM metadata, candidate instance options, pricing, and explicit sizing heuristics. A higher-capacity LLM is used offline to generate reference recommendations, while a smaller production model is evaluated on the same prompts to assess deployment-time alignment under latency and cost constraints. Evaluation prioritizes downstream recommendation quality using simulated Azure cost savings and ex-post exceedance, with rolling-origin forecast accuracy reported as a secondary diagnostic against classical and supervised baselines. In a case study of seven production VMs, the reference recommendations reduce simulated monthly cost from about \$1,503 to \$708, yielding \$795/month in savings (52.9%) under conservative heuristic constraints, while the highest observed exceedance rate among downgraded cases is 1.5%. Although Chronos-2 does not minimize every forecasting metric, it often induces recommendation patterns similar to those of a supervised per-VM baseline. These results suggest that zero-shot foundation models can support decision-aligned provisioning in non-stationary cloud environments while reducing the operational burden of repeated per-tenant retraining, revalidation, and redeployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CLOUDADV，一个面向工程师的云实例大小建议系统，利用零样本时间序列预测和结构化决策上下文，在工作负载漂移下生成推荐。参考建议在7个生产VM案例中将模拟月成本从约1503美元降至708美元（节省52.9%），降级实例的超出率最高为1.5%。结果表明零样本基础模型可支持决策对齐的云资源供应，减少重复训练负担。
Motivation: 云虚拟机经常过度配置，造成成本和效率浪费，现有方法难以应对工作负载漂移且需要频繁重新训练。
Method: CLOUDADV组合零样本时间序列预测与有界推荐生成，利用历史利用率、预测摘要、VM元数据、定价和启发式规则构建决策上下文；大容量LLM离线生成参考推荐，小模型在线评估。
Result: 在7个生产VM案例中，参考建议将模拟月成本从约1503美元降至708美元（节省52.9%），降级实例超出率最高1.5%；Chronos-2在预测指标上不总是最优，但推荐模式与监督基线相似。
Conclusion: 零样本基础模型可在非平稳云环境中支持决策对齐的供应，降低每租户重复训练、验证和部署的运营负担。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AeroVerse-SatAgent: UAV-Satellite Collaborative Spatial Reasoning Inspired by the Dual Visual Pathway Theory of Cognitive Neuroscience
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of aerospace embodied intelligence, enabling Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) to autonomously understand and reason about complex environments has become increasingly important. However, existing UAV-based spatial reasoning approaches face critical limitations: single-view perception renders them vulnerable to occlusions and perspective distortions, while most VLMs lack explicit geometric modeling, relying on semantic cues and yielding inconsistent reasoning under viewpoint and scale variations. To address these challenges, we propose SatAgent, a UAV-Satellite collaborative spatial reasoning model inspired by the dual-pathway mechanism of the human visual system. By jointly leveraging satellite and UAV perspectives, SatAgent enables robust, accurate reasoning in complex urban environments. We first introduce a Geometric-Aware 3D Reconstruction Encoder that elevates 2D UAV features into explicit 3D spatial representations. Next, we design a multi-view topology-semantic alignment module integrating cross-view features within a unified BEV coordinate system. We further introduce a multi-view consistency loss encouraging viewpoint-invariant representations. Finally, we construct SatAgent-SR130K, the first large-scale UAV-Satellite collaborative multi-view spatial reasoning dataset. Experiments show SatAgent outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose foundation models and specialized spatial reasoning models by 25.91\% and 11.69\%, respectively, across diverse tasks, achieving particularly high accuracy in complex geometric relationship reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SatAgent，一种受人类视觉双通路机制启发的无人机-卫星协同空间推理模型。通过几何感知3D重建编码器将2D无人机特征提升为3D空间表示，设计多视角拓扑-语义对齐模块在统一BEV坐标系中融合跨视角特征，并引入多视角一致性损失。构建了首个大规模无人机-卫星协同多视角空间推理数据集SatAgent-SR130K。实验表明，SatAgent在多种任务上比通用基础模型和专用空间推理模型分别高出25.91%和11.69%，尤其在复杂几何关系推理中精度高。
Motivation: 现有无人机空间推理方法受限于单视角感知，易受遮挡和视角畸变影响；大多数视觉语言模型缺乏显式几何建模，依赖语义线索，在视角和尺度变化下推理不一致。
Method: 提出基于双视觉通路理论的SatAgent模型：包括几何感知3D重建编码器将2D特征提升为3D表示；多视角拓扑-语义对齐模块在BEV坐标系融合特征；多视角一致性损失促进视角不变表示。
Result: 在SatAgent-SR130K数据集上，SatAgent比通用基础模型和专用空间推理模型分别提升25.91%和11.69%，在复杂几何关系推理中达到高精度。
Conclusion: 本文通过无人机-卫星协同和显式几何建模，显著提升了空间推理的鲁棒性和准确性，但摘要未提及其在极端天气或无卫星场景下的适用性。

papers.title: Team MKC at CLPsych 2026: Capturing and Characterizing Mental Health Changes through Social Media Timeline Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have motivated their adoption across a wide range of domains, including Artificial Intelligence (AI) for mental health. Given the growing prevalence of mental health disorders worldwide and the limited accessibility of professional care, there is an increasing demand for scalable computational approaches that can assist in early detection and continuous monitoring of psychological well-being. In this area, ongoing efforts have focused on curating domain-specific datasets and leveraging them to develop LLMs capable of supporting holistic mental health analysis. In line with this direction, we propose an LLM-based pipeline for comprehensive mental health analysis over sequentially ordered user posts, as part of the CLPsych shared task. Our pipeline offers a unified framework that jointly enables post-level assessment and user-level temporal modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对心理健康分析的CLPsych共享任务，提出一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的流水线，利用用户社交媒体时间线数据同时进行帖子级评估和用户级时间建模，以捕捉和表征心理健康变化。
Motivation: 心理健康障碍日益普遍，专业护理资源有限，亟需可扩展的计算方法辅助早期检测和持续监测，现有LLM为此提供了新可能。
Method: 提出一个基于LLM的统一流水线，对按时间排序的用户帖子进行心理健康分析，集成了帖子级别（单条内容）和用户级别（时间动态）的建模。

papers.title: CSTrader: A Testbed for Language-Grounded Trading in a Community-Driven Virtual Asset Market
papers.abstract_en: Niche asset markets, such as Counter-Strike 2 (CS2) weapon skins, are small, volatile, and heavily driven by community discussions and platform rules. These properties make them hard for traditional quantitative models, but provide an ideal testbed for studying how large language models (LLMs) turn unstructured text into trading actions. We present CSTrader, a multi-agent framework for language-grounded trading in the CS2 skin market. The system first integrates heterogeneous signals from various sources, then uses specialized agents for technical analysis, liquidity, events, and (reversed) sentiment, and finally applies risk control, transaction friction, and portfolio management agents to produce buy, sell, or hold decisions under realistic trading frictions. We build a live-like evaluation environment with real CS2 data from a highly volatile period and evaluate several recent LLM backbones. Across models, CSTrader consistently outperforms both a falling market index (-15.62%) and simple single-prompt LLM baselines, achieving up to a 7.58% cumulative return with controlled risk. Ablation studies show that liquidity, reversed sentiment, and transaction friction agents are crucial for turning noisy language signals into stable profits, suggesting that niche, language-driven markets are a useful benchmark for future language-to-action research. Code is available at: https://github.com/IatomicreactorI/CSGOTrading?tab=readme-ov-file#quick-start
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CSTrader，一个用于社区驱动虚拟资产市场（CS2 皮肤市场）中基于语言交易的多智能体框架。该框架整合多种异构信号，包括技术分析、流动性、事件和反转情绪，并应用风险控制、交易摩擦和投资组合管理，生成买卖持有决策。在真实波动时期的数据上，CSTrader 优于市场指数（-15.62%）和简单单提示 LLM 基线，最高实现 7.58% 的累计收益，且风险可控。消融实验表明，流动性、反转情绪和交易摩擦智能体对稳定盈利至关重要。
Motivation: 利基资产市场（如 CS2 皮肤市场）波动大、受社区讨论和平台规则驱动，传统量化模型难以处理，但为研究 LLM 如何将非结构化文本转化为交易动作提供了理想测试环境。
Method: 提出 CSTrader 多智能体框架：首先集成来自多种来源的异构信号，然后分别使用技术分析、流动性、事件和反转情绪专家智能体进行分析，最后通过风险控制、交易摩擦和投资组合管理智能体输出买入、卖出或持有决策，并模拟真实交易摩擦。
Result: 在 CS2 皮肤市场高波动时期的真实数据上，CSTrader 持续优于市场指数（-15.62%）和单提示 LLM 基线，最高实现 7.58% 累计收益，且风险可控。消融实验显示流动性、反转情绪和交易摩擦智能体是稳定盈利的关键。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Quantization for Object Detectors using Off-the-Shelf Generative Models
papers.abstract_en: With an increasing number of Object Detection (OD) models being deployed on edge devices, Zero-Shot Quantization for OD (ZSQ-OD) aims to quantize these models when access to the original training data is prohibited. Existing research on Zero-Shot Quantization-Aware Training (QAT) for OD synthesizes training sets through noise optimization. However, this approach struggles to maintain performance in low-bit regions. In this paper, we introduce GoodQ (Generative off-the-shelf models for object detector Quantization), a QAT pipeline that utilizes off-the-shelf generative models to construct a training set. We first identify three challenges that arise when introducing a generative model to the ZSQ-OD task: 1) each image contains dense information with multiple instances, 2) the class-wise distribution in the original dataset is imbalanced, and 3) the pseudo-labels assigned to the generated images can potentially act as noisy signals during QAT. GoodQ addresses these challenges by 1) introducing an Information-Dense Prompting strategy to generate multi-instance images, 2) applying Intrinsic Distribution-Aware Selection to match the pretrained class distribution, and 3) employing Teacher-guided Adaptive Noise Reduction to mitigate noise arising from the QAT process. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art performance in low-bit ZSQ (W4A4) and extends quantization to extreme bit-widths (W3A3). Furthermore, we conduct an extensive analysis to uncover the underlying factors contributing to the efficacy of GoodQ.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文提出GoodQ，一种针对目标检测的零样本量化感知训练(QAT)流水线，利用现成的生成模型来构建训练集。通过信息密集提示、本征分布感知选择和教师引导自适应降噪等策略，在低比特量化（W4A4, W3A3）上取得了SOTA性能。
Motivation: 现有零样本量化方法在生成训练集时依赖噪声优化，难以保持低比特区域的性能。作者旨在利用生成模型解决该问题。
Method: 引入GoodQ框架，包括：1) 信息密集提示（IDP）生成多实例图像；2) 本征分布感知选择（IDAS）匹配预训练类别分布；3) 教师引导自适应降噪（TANR）减轻QAT中的噪声。
Result: 在低比特ZSQ（W4A4）上达到SOTA，并扩展至极宽比特（W3A3）。
Conclusion: 摘要强调GoodQ通过有效利用生成模型，克服了零样本目标检测量化的三大挑战，并通过大量分析揭示了有效性的背后因素。

papers.title: Towards a foundational model for recognising diastematic Gregorian notation
papers.abstract_en: Optical recognition of Gregorian notation has recently been attempted with end-to-end methods, with four datasets introduced. However, each of these datasets is in a different encoding. We design a common encoding based on the S-GABC proposal, convert all four datasets to this common encoding, and train a shared end-to-end foundational model for diastematic Gregorian notation that establishes a new state of the art across all four datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对格里高利记谱法（diastematic Gregorian notation）的光学识别，提出将四个现有数据集统一转换为基于S-GABC提议的公共编码，并训练一个共享的端到端基础模型（foundational model），在该任务的所有四个数据集上取得了新的最优结果。
Motivation: 目前格里高利记谱法的光学识别已存在四个数据集，但每个数据集采用不同的编码格式，限制了跨数据集的模型泛化和性能提升。
Method: 设计一种基于S-GABC提议的公共编码，将四个现有数据集全部转换为此统一编码，然后训练一个共享的端到端基础模型。
Result: 该基础模型在所有四个数据集上均达到新的最优性能（state of the art）。
Conclusion: 统一的编码和共享的端到端模型能够有效提升格里高利记谱法光学识别的性能，为后续研究提供基础。

papers.title: UniTac: A Unified Multimodal Model for Cross-Sensor Tactile Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) have shown great promise in integrating understanding and generation across diverse modalities. However, existing research rarely extends this paradigm to the tactile domain, where both object-level semantics and sensor-level configurations jointly determine the meaning of touch. To address this gap, we propose UniTac, the first UMM designed for tactile understanding and generation. UniTac models the tactile process as a transition from non-contact to contact, capturing the physical interaction between sensors and objects through a dual-level representation that encodes both sensor and object attributes. For tactile understanding, UniTac introduces two tasks, object property description and sensor identification, to enhance reasoning over physical and cross-sensor information. For tactile generation, we design a two-stage training paradigm consisting of reconstruction and alignment, together with a sensor-prior-based sampling strategy that simulates realistic tactile contact. Trained on large-scale multi-sensor datasets, UniTac achieves state-of-the-art performance in tactile understanding and generates realistic tactile signals across sensors.
papers.comment: This paper has been accepted by ECCV 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UniTac，首个用于跨传感器触觉理解与生成的统一多模态模型。UniTac将触觉过程建模为非接触向接触的转变，通过双级表示（传感器与物体属性）统一编码。在触觉理解上，引入物体属性描述与传感器识别任务；在触觉生成上，设计两阶段训练（重建与对齐）及基于传感器先验的采样策略。在大型多传感器数据集上，UniTac在触觉理解与生成任务上均达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型极少涵盖触觉模态，且触觉信号同时依赖物体语义与传感器配置，缺乏能同时理解和生成跨传感器触觉信号的方法。
Method: 提出双级表示编码传感器与物体属性；理解任务包括物体属性描述与传感器识别；生成任务采用两阶段训练（重建+对齐）以及传感器先验采样策略模拟触觉接触。
Result: 在大型多传感器数据集上，UniTac在触觉理解任务（物体属性描述、传感器识别）和触觉生成任务上均达到state-of-the-art性能。
Conclusion: UniTac首次将统一多模态模型范式扩展到触觉领域，验证了双级表示和两阶段训练对跨传感器触觉建模的有效性。

papers.title: Contextual Slate GLM Bandits with Limited Adaptivity
papers.abstract_en: We investigate the contextual slate bandit problem with generalized linear rewards under limited adaptivity. At each round, the learner is presented with $N$ sets of items, where each item is represented by a $d$-dimensional feature vector. The learner then constructs a slate by selecting one item per set; the resulting slate yields a scalar reward sampled from a Generalized Linear Model (GLM). We propose algorithms under two limited-adaptivity settings: (a) Batched and (b) Rarely-Switching. For the batched setting, we introduce B-SlateGLinCB, which partitions the time horizon into $\mathcal{O}(\log\log T)$ batches such that each batch's policy relies only on data from previous batches. For the rarely-switching setting, we propose RS-SlateGLinCB, which adaptively performs only $\mathcal{O}(Nd\log T)$ parameter updates. Under a diversity assumption on the item sequences, we prove that B-SlateGLinCB and RS-SlateGLinCB achieve regret bounds of $\mathcal{O}(Nd^{3/2}\sqrt{T})$ and $\mathcal{O}(Nd\sqrt{T})$, respectively. Notably, both bounds are independent of the non-linearity parameter $κ$ that is typically found to scale the regret of GLM bandit algorithms. Our algorithms are computationally efficient, requiring only $\text{poly}(N)$ time per round despite $2^{Ω(N)}$ possible slates. Simulations show our algorithms outperform existing baselines with limited adaptivity and remain competitive with Slate-GLM-OFU, a fully adaptive state-of-the-art algorithm. Notably, a slightly modified B-SlateGLinCB empirically matches this baseline. Finally, we demonstrate strong performance in a practical in-context example selection task for language models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在有限自适应性下具有广义线性奖励的上下文带状老虎机(slate bandit)问题。提出两种算法B-SlateGLinCB（批处理设置）和RS-SlateGLinCB（罕见切换设置），分别实现O(Nd^(3/2)√T)和O(Nd√T)的遗憾界，且与GLM非线参数κ无关。实验表明算法在有限自适应性下优于现有基线，并在语言模型的上下文示例选择任务中表现良好。
Motivation: 现有带状老虎机算法通常假设完全自适应性（每轮更新策略），但实际场景中通信或计算成本限制了策略更新频率。本文旨在解决有限自适应性下的上下文带状老虎机问题，特别是具有广义线性奖励的场景。
Method: 提出两种算法：B-SlateGLinCB将时间划分为O(log log T)个批次，每批策略仅依赖之前批次数据；RS-SlateGLinCB仅进行O(Nd log T)次参数更新。两者均基于广义线性模型，并利用多样性假设证明遗憾界。
Result: 证明遗憾界分别为O(Nd^(3/2)√T)和O(Nd√T)，独立于非线参数κ。仿真显示算法在有限自适应下优于现有基线，且与完全自适应的Slate-GLM-OFU竞争力相当。
Conclusion: 本文在有限自适应性下实现了与完全自适应算法相媲美的遗憾界，且计算高效（每轮poly(N)时间）。未来工作可扩展到更一般的奖励模型或更宽松的假设。

papers.title: Revising RVL-CDIP: Quantifying Errors and Test-Train Overlap
papers.abstract_en: RVL-CDIP is a popular dataset for benchmarking document classifiers. However, the dataset contains ample amounts of label errors as well as non-trivial amounts of test-train overlap, both of which may impact model performance metrics. In this paper, we address these two problems by (1) finding and fixing label errors, and (2) detecting and addressing test-train overlap. We produce several variations of RVL-CDIP with label error and test-train overlap fixes, and benchmark document classification performance on these new RVL-CDIP variations. Our rigorous analysis of RVL-CDIP finds that the corpus contains 12\% label error and approximately 35% test-train duplication. Remediation sees improvements in classification accuracy when errors are removed, but sees decreases in accuracy when duplicates are removed. We additionally evaluate models on RVL-CDIP-N, an out-of-distribution benchmark, finding that training on error-corrected data substantially improves OOD generalization, with supervised models gaining an average of 8.1 percentage points in accuracy and improvements as large as 14 percentage points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统性地纠正了文档分类基准数据集RVL-CDIP中的标签错误（约12%）和测试-训练重叠（约35%）问题，并生成了多个修正版本。实验表明，移除错误能提升分类准确率，但移除重复样本会降低准确率；在分布外基准RVL-CDIP-N上，训练于纠错数据可显著提升监督模型的泛化性能（平均提升8.1个百分点，最高达14个百分点）。
Motivation: RVL-CDIP作为广泛使用的文档分类数据集，存在大量标签错误和测试-训练重叠，可能导致模型性能指标失真。
Method: 通过人工检查和自动方法定位并修正标签错误，检测并处理测试-训练重叠，生成多个修正版本，并在这些版本上对文档分类模型进行基准测试。
Result: 发现原始数据集中12%的标签错误和约35%的测试-训练重复；移除错误后分类准确率提升，移除重复后准确率下降；纠错数据训练在RVL-CDIP-N上使监督模型平均提升8.1个百分点准确率。
Conclusion: 数据集纠错对于可靠评估和分布外泛化至关重要，建议社区使用修正后的版本。

papers.title: Temporal Training Strategies for Left Atrium and Left Atrial Appendage Segmentation in Dynamic Contrast 4DCT
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic contrast-enhanced cardiac CT enables time-resolved analysis of contrast filling and washout in the left atrium (LA) and left atrial appendage (LAA), with potential applications for assessing blood stasis in atrial fibrillation (AF). Accurate segmentation across all frames is required for such analysis but is challenging due to large temporal contrast variations and the use of a single annotation per registered sequence. This creates a trade-off between training for robustness and limiting label noise. In this study, we investigate how temporal training-set design affects nnUNet-based segmentation of the LA and LAA in dynamic 4DCT. We compare training using a minimal two-frame dataset reflecting standard clinical practice, a physiologically selected subset of frames, and the full 27-frame sequence. We further evaluate the impact of foreground-based normalization. Training with all frames yielded the best performance in early low-contrast phases. However, the physiologically selected subset achieved comparable performance from the filling phase onward. Applying normalization parameters derived from the full dataset improved performance of reduced datasets in low-contrast frames, but did not fully close the gap. These findings highlight the importance of temporal diversity in training data for robust segmentation in dynamic CT, while indicating that carefully selected frame subsets may provide an effective trade-off between performance and efficiency for downstream applications.

TL;DR: 本文研究了在动态对比4DCT中用于左心房和左心耳分割的时间训练集设计。通过比较最小两帧数据集（标准临床实践）、生理选择的帧子集和全27帧序列，发现全帧训练在早期低对比度阶段表现最佳，但生理选择子集在填充阶段后表现相当。使用全数据集归一化参数改善了减少数据集在低对比度帧的表现，但未能完全弥补差距。

Method: 使用nnUNet进行分割，比较三种训练集设计：最小两帧（标准临床实践）、生理选择的帧子集、全27帧序列，并评估前景归一化的影响。
Result: 全帧训练在早期低对比度帧表现最好；生理选择子集在填充阶段后表现相当；使用全数据集归一化参数改善了减少数据集在低对比度帧的表现，但未能完全弥补差距。
Conclusion: 训练数据的时间多样性对动态CT鲁棒分割至关重要，但精心选择的帧子集可以在性能和效率之间提供有效的折衷。

papers.title: Who Determines the Meaning of an Emotion? Affective Sovereignty as an Epistemic Consequence of Measurement Limits
papers.abstract_en: Emotion-sensing AI is rapidly becoming embedded in vehicles, home appliances, dialogue agents, and social infrastructure, giving rise to a sphere in which emotion is no longer confined to individual experience but is instead observed and computed at a societal scale, a domain we term the Affectosphere. Yet a central normative question in this domain has remained underexplored: who has the final authority to determine the meaning of one's own emotion? This study addresses the question from the epistemological side of measurement's structural limits. We define a meaning distribution as the distribution of labels assigned by annotators drawn from a population under a fixed annotation protocol, and decompose its uncertainty into reducible and irreducible components. We then demonstrate that, while emotion AI can assign high-confidence point labels and discriminate real differences at an aggregate level, the irreducible component of the meaning distribution for individual instances cannot be estimated with adequate coverage under realistic annotator counts, a systematic divergence we term the epistemic gap. The key finding is that high device confidence does not constitute evidence that irrecoverable meaning has been recovered. From this epistemic gap, together with an explicitly stated normative premise, namely that the output of a system which cannot recover a quantity in principle must not be treated as its authoritative determination, we derive the norm that the final interpretive authority over the meaning of one's emotion is procedurally reserved for the experiencing subject, the norm of affective sovereignty. These results suggest that the design, evaluation, and regulation of emotion AI should place explicit allocation of interpretive authority, rather than accuracy maximisation, at their core.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“情感圈”（Affectosphere）概念，探讨情感感知AI中情感意义解释权的问题。通过定义“意义分布”并分解其不确定性，作者展示了不可约组分在个体案例上无法被充分估计，导致“认知鸿沟”（epistemic gap）。基于此，作者论证了情感意义的最终解释权应程序性地保留给体验主体，即“情感主权”（affective sovereignty）规范。
Motivation: 情感AI在多个领域广泛应用，但谁有权决定个人情感的意义这一核心规范问题尚未得到充分探讨。
Method: 从测量结构性局限的认识论角度切入，定义“意义分布”为在固定标注协议下标注者赋予的标签分布，将其不确定性分为可约与不可约组分；通过理论分析表明个体案例的不可约组分在现实标注者数量下无法被适当覆盖，形成“认知鸿沟”。
Result: 高置信度的设备输出并不代表已恢复不可恢复的意义；由此推导出“情感主权”规范。
Conclusion: 情感AI的设计、评估和监管应更注重解释权的明确分配，而非仅仅追求准确率。

papers.title: CDR-Bench: Evaluating Faithful Execution of Compositional, Order-Sensitive Data Refinement Recipes
papers.abstract_en: Data refinement involves executing multi-step recipes over evolving text states, where both composition and execution order of processing operators determine the outcome. While existing benchmarks either isolate text editing or entangle it with code and tool execution, it remains unclear whether LLMs can directly and faithfully execute these compositional, order-sensitive data refinement recipes. To fill this gap, we introduce CDR-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark featuring 3,462 high-quality tasks spanning four real-world data refinement domains and 29 distinct operators. Our benchmark evaluates models across atomic, order-agnostic, and order-sensitive settings, leveraging deterministic reference outputs to enable exact evaluation. Experiments on 10+ state-of-the-art LLMs reveal consistent failure patterns: performance degrades sharply in compositional settings, and order-sensitive recipe success collapses. These findings underline that current LLMs lack the procedural faithfulness required for reliable compositional data refinement.
papers.comment: 29 pages, 20 figures. Corresponding authors: Daoyuan Chen and Yi R. Fung
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CDR-Bench基准，用于评估LLM在组合、顺序敏感的数据精炼配方上的忠实执行能力。基准包含3462个高质量任务，覆盖4个真实数据精炼领域和29个操作符，支持原子、顺序无关和顺序敏感三种设置。实验表明，当前LLM在组合设置下性能急剧下降，顺序敏感配方成功率近乎崩溃。
Motivation: 现有基准要么孤立地评估文本编辑，要么与代码和工具执行混杂，不清楚LLM能否直接并忠实地执行组合、顺序敏感的数据精炼配方。
Method: 构建CDR-Bench基准，包含3462个任务，涵盖4个真实数据精炼领域和29个不同操作符，在原子、顺序无关和顺序敏感设置下评估，使用确定性参考输出进行精确评估。
Result: 在10多个最先进LLM上的实验显示一致失败模式：在组合设置下性能急剧下降，顺序敏感配方成功率近乎崩溃。
Conclusion: 当前LLM缺乏用于可靠组合数据精炼所需的过程忠实性。

papers.title: No Prompt, No Leaks: A Robust Generative Steganography Framework via Prompt-Free Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: Generative image steganography synthesizes stego images directly from secret information to achieve inherent security advantages. Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) have recently emerged as a fundamental image steganography framework that modulates secret latent representations with text prompts. Limited by the inflexibility of text prompts, these methods still struggle to generate high-quality stego images and accurately recover secret images. In this work, we propose a prompt-free diffusion image steganography framework that integrates style semantic priors to control more robust and reliable stego image generation. Specifically, a Cascaded Affine Coupling Module (CACM) establishes a bijective, deterministic mapping between a secret image and its latent representation. Then, style semantics are integrated into the diffusion process to control latent representation and ensure visual imperceptibility in the generated stego images. To mitigate trajectory deviations stemming from the unconditioned reverse process, a predictor-corrector mechanism is introduced to iteratively refine the generation trajectory via feedback from the current and predicted next states. Extensive experimental results show that the proposed method achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art methods in terms of security, secret image reconstruction accuracy and controllability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无提示扩散图像隐写框架，通过级联仿射耦合模块（CACM）建立秘密图像与潜表示的双射映射，并整合风格语义先验控制生成过程，同时引入预测-校正机制修正无条件反向过程中的轨迹偏差。实验表明该方法在安全性、秘密图像重建精度和可控性方面达到先进水平。
Motivation: 现有基于文本提示的隐写方法受限于提示的灵活性，难以生成高质量隐写图像并精确恢复秘密图像。
Method: 提出无提示扩散隐写框架：1) CACM模块建立秘密图像与潜表示的确定性双射；2) 将风格语义集成到扩散过程以控制潜表示并确保视觉不可察觉性；3) 使用预测-校正机制迭代细化生成轨迹。
Result: 实验在安全性、秘密图像重建精度和可控性上与最先进方法相比具有竞争力。
Conclusion: 该方法通过无提示设计和风格语义先验提升了隐写图像的生成质量和秘密恢复的准确性。

papers.title: DA-Studio: An Agentic System for End-to-End Data Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Real-world data analysis is a multi-step process over heterogeneous inputs rather than merely producing a final answer. A practical system should autonomously organize multi-step workflows, execute generated code in a sandboxed and controllable environment, and remain inspectable through visible action traces and intermediate artifacts. Existing LLM-based analysis tools, however, often emphasize isolated subtasks, leaving limited support for complete execution-grounded workflows. We present DA-Studio (Data Analysis Studio), an interactive web-based demo system for end-to-end data analysis that is autonomous, sandboxed, and inspectable. DA-Studio integrates an action-structured analysis backend, a sandboxed execution workspace, and a browser interface for task setup, streamed action traces, artifact preview, code editing and rerunning, and report export. Through iterative action generation, code execution, and feedback incorporation, it incrementally constructs executable analysis steps from raw files and natural-language requests while exposing intermediate results and artifacts throughout the process.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DA-Studio是一个用于端到端数据分析的交互式演示系统，具备自主、沙盒化和可检查特性。该系统通过迭代动作生成、代码执行和反馈整合，从原始文件和自然语言请求逐步构建可执行的分析步骤，并暴露中间结果和工件。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的分析工具通常强调孤立子任务，缺乏对完整执行导向工作流的支持，难以处理多步骤、异构输入的真实数据分析流程。
Method: DA-Studio集成了一个动作结构化的分析后端、沙盒化执行工作空间和浏览器界面，支持任务设置、流式动作追踪、工件预览、代码编辑重运行和报告导出。
Conclusion: 该系统通过迭代动作生成和反馈整合，实现从原始数据到最终结果的端到端数据分析流程，并保持过程的可检查性。

papers.title: Ask the World Before Acting: Budgeted Environment Probing for World-Model Calibration
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon language agents do not only choose actions; they carry a private model of the world from one decision to the next. When that model drifts, a later failure can be decided before the failing action is ever taken. We study a direct repair mechanism: before committing to the next task action, an agent may ask the environment about one belief field and write the answer back into its world model. This makes environment interaction a scarce calibration resource, not merely a way to advance the task. We introduce \method, a budgeted probing operator for structured belief tables. The useful probes are not the same everywhere. Procedural beliefs, such as tool dependencies, can often be repaired by targeted checks, but those checks spend steps that the task may need. Spatial beliefs, such as object locations and graph edges, rely more on structural cues; the agent's own confidence can be a poor guide when the world changes off-screen. A type-stratified analysis formalizes this probe-action frontier, and controlled experiments show that mid-planning environment evidence reduces terminal world-model error when the probe policy follows the structure of the task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种预算环境探测机制，允许长周期语言智能体在执行决策前主动询问环境并校正其世界模型中的信念场。通过结构化的信念表，智能体可以针对程序性信念和空间性信念进行有预算的探测，从而减少终端世界模型误差。实验表明，遵循任务结构的探测策略能有效降低错误。
Motivation: 长周期语言智能体的世界模型可能在决策过程中发生漂移，导致失败早已被决定。直接修复机制缺失，环境交互被视为任务推进手段而非校准资源。
Method: 提出Budgeted Probing Operator，在结构化信念表上选择性地探测环境中的信念场，并将答案写回世界模型，同时控制探测预算，支持类型分层分析（程序性信念如工具依赖，空间性信念如物体位置）。
Result: 受控实验表明，遵循任务结构的中期计划环境探测能显著降低终端世界模型误差，并且不同类型信念的最优探测策略不同。
Conclusion: 环境探测应被视为预算校准资源，探测策略需根据信念类型和任务结构设计，以平衡校准收益与任务步数成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Temporal Preservation over Processing: Diagnosing and Designing Spatiotemporal Single-Stage Video Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Single-stage video object detectors are increasingly deployed in time-critical applications, yet it remains unclear whether these models genuinely reason over temporal context or merely exploit a single informative frame-a gap hidden by standard metrics, which reward correct predictions regardless of how they are reached. We address this from two complementary directions: first, we propose TemporalLens, a model-agnostic diagnostic framework probing temporal dependence through controlled perturbations, structured occlusions, temporal shuffling, redundancy injection, and resolution degradation, revealing whether a detector actually uses information across time. Applied to stacked-frame 2D detectors and our YOLO-3D architecture, it exposes behavioural differences invisible to mAP: stacked 2D models collapse when the target frame is removed, while spatiotemporal models recover predictions from earlier frames, a signature of real temporal reliance. Second, we detail YOLO-3D, a modular real-time spatiotemporal detector built on YOLOv8, and show that simply preserving temporal depth through the backbone is the dominant performance driver (+3.7 pp mAP@50 at 32 frames averaged across scales). Together, the diagnostics and architecture turn "does this detector reason over time?" into a measurable, actionable question.

papers.title: BP-TTA: Balanced and Prototype-Guided Test-Time Adaptation in Dynamic Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) enables models trained on a source domain to adapt online to unlabeled test data under distribution shifts. While recent TTA methods have moved beyond static settings and begun to consider continual domain shifts, they primarily address distribution drift and fail to account for class imbalance in dynamic scenarios. In real-world test-time streams, class imbalance and continual domain shifts often occur at the same time and interact with each other. In this paper, we propose a novel Balanced and Prototype-Guided Test-Time Adaptation (BP-TTA) method, which combines batch-balanced sampling with prototype-guided adaptation to handle the class imbalance and continual domain shift problems. BP-TTA constructs balanced adaptation batches by integrating current samples with high-confidence historical instances, effectively mitigating bias toward dominant classes and stabilizing online updates. Meanwhile, BP-TTA maintains evolving class prototypes during inference and leverages prototype similarity as a constraint for model adaptation, thereby improving the reliability of pseudo-labels and enhancing the stability of online updates under persistent domain shifts. Extensive experiments demonstrate that BP-TTA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art TTA methods in dynamic test-time streaming settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BP-TTA 方法，用于处理动态测试场景中类别不平衡与持续领域漂移的交互问题。通过批次平衡采样和原型引导适应，在在线测试流中稳定模型更新。实验表明在动态测试流中持续优于现有 TTA 方法。
Motivation: 现有测试时适应方法主要关注领域漂移，未考虑动态场景中类别不平衡与领域漂移的共同作用，导致模型偏向主导类别且更新不稳定。
Method: BP-TTA 结合批次平衡采样（集成当前样本与高置信历史样本）和原型引导适应（维护演化类原型，用原型相似度约束模型适应），以缓解类别不平衡并提高伪标签可靠性。
Result: 在动态测试流设置中，BP-TTA 持续优于最先进的 TTA 方法（摘要未提供具体数值）。
Conclusion: 同时处理类别不平衡和持续领域漂移对测试时适应的稳定性至关重要，原型引导和平衡采样是有效策略。

papers.title: Learning to Select, Not Relearn: Hard-Routed Mixtures of Reasoning LoRAs
papers.abstract_en: Composing independently trained LoRA adapters into a single large language model is useful for multi-domain adaptation, especially when the original training data cannot be shared. A common approach is to use MoE-style routing over LoRA experts, but for frozen pretrained adapters, soft weighted combinations can change the unit-scale additive update under which each LoRA module was originally trained. We propose \textbf{Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA}, a two-stage framework for composing frozen reasoning LoRA experts through unit-scale hard selection. First, domain-specific LoRA adapters are trained independently using reinforcement learning from verifiable feedback to obtain reasoning experts. Then, all experts are frozen, reasoning traces are distilled from them, and only a lightweight shared router together with a small attention LoRA is trained for integration. The router selects exactly one expert per token using hard top-1 routing, while a straight-through estimator enables gradient-based training. Experiments across five benchmarks, multiple model scales, and additional model families show that Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA preserves expert behavior while requiring substantially fewer trainable parameters than soft-routing mixture baselines. Our analysis further shows that normalized soft mixtures often concentrate most routing mass on a single expert, suggesting that hard unit-scale routing provides a simple and efficient abstraction for frozen LoRA expert composition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA，一种两阶段框架，用于组合冻结的推理LoRA适配器。通过硬top-1路由每token选择一个专家，并利用直通估计器进行梯度训练，在多个基准和模型规模上表明该方法在保留专家行为的同时，训练参数远少于软路由混合基线。分析还显示归一化的软混合通常将大部分路由质量集中在一个专家上，暗示硬单位尺度路由是冻结LoRA专家组合的简单高效抽象。
Motivation: 独立训练的LoRA适配器组合时，软加权组合可能改变每个LoRA模块原始训练的加性更新尺度，导致行为变化。本文旨在解决组合冻结预训练适配器时的这一挑战。
Method: 采用两阶段框架：首先通过可验证反馈的强化学习独立训练领域特定LoRA推理专家；然后冻结所有专家，从中蒸馏推理轨迹，仅训练轻量共享路由器和一个小注意力LoRA。路由器使用硬top-1路由每token选择恰好一个专家，配合直通估计器实现梯度训练。
Result: 在五个基准、多种模型规模和额外模型家族上的实验表明，Hard-Routed MoR-LoRA在保有专家性能的前提下，所需可训练参数显著少于软路由混合基线。
Conclusion: 硬单位尺度路由为冻结LoRA专家组合提供了简单高效的抽象，且归一化软混合的集中路由质量现象进一步支持了该方法的合理性。
