papers.title: Linguistic Bias Mitigation for Spoofing Detection via Gradient Reversal and A Variational Information Bottleneck
papers.abstract_en: Rapid advancements in generative speech technology have compromised the reliability of voice biometrics. While current spoofing detectors excel when assessed under in-domain conditions, generalisation to out-of-domain settings is often poor. We show that this can be due to linguistic bias. A reliance on linguistic cues observed in training data can then compromise robustness to cross-data. We propose a linguistic-invariant spoofing detection framework utilizing teacher-student adversarial learning. The linguistic-aware teacher model, pre-trained on linguistic content of an external dataset, guides the student detector via gradient reversal to minimize the linguistic information. To prevent the inadvertent removal of non-linguistic cues, we incorporate a Variational Information Bottleneck to enable suppression of principal cues. Across nine DF Arena datasets, our method achieves up to a 36.2% relative reduction in the EER compare to the baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现语音欺骗检测器在跨数据集场景下泛化差的原因之一是语言偏差（linguistic bias），即模型过度依赖训练数据中的语言线索。为此提出一个语言不变欺骗检测框架，通过教师-学生对抗学习（teacher-student adversarial learning）结合梯度反转（gradient reversal）最小化语言信息，并引入变分信息瓶颈（Variational Information Bottleneck）防止非语言线索被意外移除。在九个DF Arena数据集上，该方法相比基线最高实现36.2%的相对等错误率（EER）降低。
Motivation: 现有欺骗检测器在域内条件下表现良好，但跨数据集泛化能力差，原因是模型依赖于训练数据中的语言线索，导致语言偏差。
Method: 提出语言不变欺骗检测框架：使用预训练于外部数据集语言内容的语言感知教师模型，通过梯度反转指导学生检测器最小化语言信息；同时引入变分信息瓶颈以保留非语言线索。
Result: 在九个DF Arena数据集上，该方法相比基线最高实现36.2%的相对EER降低。
Conclusion: 通过对抗性去除语言偏差并保留非语言线索，可以显著提升欺骗检测的跨数据集泛化性能。

papers.title: Xiaomi-GUI-0 Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents build on vision-language models to complete user tasks end-to-end in real applications through interface actions such as tapping, swiping, text entry, and navigation. However, existing GUI agents are trained and evaluated largely on offline trajectories, simulated environments, and standardized benchmarks. These differ substantially from real applications in interface layout, interaction logic, and abnormal-state distribution, and cannot faithfully characterize execution stability in real-world use, where account states, permission dialogs, payment authentication, and risk control continually reshape the state distribution and open a persistent gap between benchmark scores and real usability. To close this gap, we propose Xiaomi-GUI-0, a native multimodal GUI agent for real mobile environments, trained and evaluated within a real-device closed loop. At its core is a real-device-dominant hybrid infrastructure, where physical devices are the primary execution environment and sandboxes provide auxiliary support, so that data collection, training, rollout, and evaluation share an execution distribution close to real deployment. We construct multi-source training data spanning high-frequency head tasks, high-generalization data for long-tail intents, and capability-enhancement data for reflection and memory, and introduce an error-driven data flywheel that turns failure trajectories into corrected actions, reflective explanations, and recovery demonstrations. The model is trained through a progressive three-stage pipeline of supervised fine-tuning, step-level reinforcement learning, and agentic reinforcement learning. Evaluated on public benchmarks and our in-house RealMobile, Xiaomi-GUI-0 achieves 72.0% success on RealMobile and 78.9% on AndroidWorld, while substantially improving execution stability and abnormal-state recognition in real-world tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Xiaomi-GUI-0，一个面向真实移动环境的多模态GUI智能体，采用真实设备主导的混合基础设施，结合多源训练数据和错误驱动数据飞轮，通过三阶段渐进式训练（监督微调、步骤级强化学习、智能体强化学习）。在RealMobile任务上达到72.0%成功率，在AndroidWorld上达到78.9%，显著提升了执行稳定性和异常状态识别能力。
Motivation: 现有GUI智能体主要在离线轨迹、模拟环境和标准化基准上训练与评估，与真实应用在界面布局、交互逻辑和异常状态分布上差异巨大，导致基准分数与真实可用性之间存在持续差距。
Method: 提出真实设备主导的混合基础设施，物理设备为主要执行环境，沙箱辅助支持；构建多源训练数据（高频头部任务、长尾意图泛化数据、反思与记忆能力增强数据）；引入错误驱动数据飞轮，将失败轨迹转化为修正动作、反思解释和恢复演示；采用三阶段渐进式训练：监督微调、步骤级强化学习、智能体强化学习。
Result: 在自有RealMobile基准上达到72.0%成功率，在AndroidWorld上达到78.9%成功率，在真实任务中显著提升执行稳定性和异常状态识别能力。
Conclusion: Xiaomi-GUI-0通过真实设备闭环训练和评估，有效缩小了基准测试与真实可用性之间的差距，证明了混合基础设施和数据飞轮在构建稳健GUI智能体中的价值。

papers.title: Visual Semantic Entropy: Do Vision Language Models Recognize Visual Ambiguity?
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models can produce confident answers on visually ambiguous inputs, resulting in biased predictions. Common entropy-based methods, such as Semantic Entropy (SE), rely on output diversity. Yet our analysis shows that overconfident visual embeddings suppress output diversity under stochastic decoding, causing SE to underestimate uncertainty in such cases. Recent methods instead probe output diversity through input perturbations, including textual paraphrasing or joint text-image perturbations, and show improved performance. We study these approaches and reveals that the resulting variability is often dominated by textual changes rather than visual evidence, causing uncertainty estimates to reflect prompt sensitivity rather than visual ambiguity. We therefore propose Visual Semantic Entropy (VSE), which perturbs only the image to probe nearby visual variations while keeping the text query fixed. VSE measures uncertainty by clustering generated answers into semantic prototypes and computing the mass-weighted dispersion among them. Extensive evaluation across five modern vision-language models and five diverse VQA benchmarks demonstrates that VSE effectively captures visual ambiguity, establishing a new state-of-the-art for VLM uncertainty estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在视觉模糊输入下产生自信但错误预测的问题，提出视觉语义熵（Visual Semantic Entropy, VSE）。该方法仅对图像进行扰动，保持文本查询固定，通过将生成答案聚类为语义原型并计算加权离散度来度量不确定性。在五个现代VLM和五个VQA基准上，VSE达到了VLM不确定性估计的新SOTA。
Motivation: 现有基于语义熵的方法因视觉嵌入过度自信而低估不确定性，而输入扰动方法（如文本释义或图文联合扰动）反映的是提示敏感性而非视觉模糊性。需要一种专注于视觉模糊性的不确定性估计方法。
Method: 提出VSE：仅扰动图像（如图像增强或噪声），保持文本查询不变；收集多个扰动下的生成答案，使用语义聚类得到原型，计算每个原型的质量（密度）加权离散度作为不确定性得分。
Result: 在五个现代VLM（如LLaVA、BLIP-2等）和五个VQA基准（如VQAv2、A-OKVQA等）上，VSE在不确定性估计指标上超越现有方法，建立新SOTA。
Conclusion: VSE通过仅扰动图像来捕捉视觉模糊性，避免了文本扰动带来的混淆，为VLM不确定性估计提供了更可靠的手段。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wisdom Of The (AI) Crowd: Investigating Artificial Swarm Intelligence In Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Human swarm intelligence demonstrates remarkable collective accuracy but faces scalability constraints in cost, coordination, and time. We investigate whether large language models (LLMs) can approximate swarm intelligence effects through artificial swarms, addressing a critical gap in understanding AI-based aggregation mechanisms. We conducted a controlled experiment with 960 manually executed prompts across three proprietary models (GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude Sonnet 4.5), testing intra-model sampling and inter-model aggregation on eight estimation tasks. Results reveal consistent error reduction through intra- and inter-model aggregation, with significant error reductions up to 37 percentage points in MAPE across different aggregation strategies. We observed small to large effect sizes for positive correlations (Spearman's $ρ=0.242-0.568$, all $p<0.001$) between relative confidence interval widths and relative estimation errors, suggesting LLMs possess metacognitive awareness when assessing uncertainty. We discuss implications for research and practice, providing actionable insights for deploying LLM swarms in organizational decision-making.
papers.comment: 18 pages, 0 figures, 6 tables, Accepted at ECIS 2026 (European Conference on Information Systems), Track: General Track, Paper No. ECIS2026-1499
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨大型语言模型（LLMs）能否通过人工群体（artificial swarms）近似人类群体智能（swarm intelligence）的集体准确性。在960个手写提示上的对照实验表明，模型内采样和模型间聚合均能持续降低估计误差，平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）最高降低37个百分点。此外，相对置信区间宽度与相对估计误差之间存在正相关（Spearman's ρ=0.242-0.568, p<0.001），提示LLMs具备元认知意识。
Motivation: 人类群体智能虽准确性高，但受限于成本、协调和时间；缺乏对基于AI的聚合机制能否复现群体智能效应的理解。
Method: 通过960个手动执行的提示，在三种专有模型（GPT-5、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Claude Sonnet 4.5）上测试模型内采样和模型间聚合，对八项估计任务进行控制实验。
Result: 模型内和模型间聚合均持续减少误差，不同聚合策略下MAPE最大降低37个百分点；置信区间宽度与估计误差呈正相关（Spearman's ρ=0.242-0.568）。
Conclusion: LLMs可通过人工群体聚合实现类似群体智能的准确性提升，并具备一定的元认知能力，为组织决策中部署LLM群体提供了实践启示。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: World-Model Collapse as a Phase Transition
papers.abstract_en: Water looks unchanged as it warms, then at a critical point it boils. We ask whether long-horizon language agents show an analogous transition in their implicit world models. In some parameter settings, changing state load by a small amount, or adding a single step of horizon, leaves behavior nearly unchanged; near a critical boundary, the same small change causes a sudden world collapse. We study this effect in a deterministic task family with exact per-step gold state. A large grid search over state cardinality, dependency density, horizon, branching, observation mode, and mutation rate reveals a phase diagram: a solved plateau, a narrow transition band, and a collapse floor. Per-step traces show the mechanism: world-state fidelity fails before action validity, so the agent is not merely choosing a bad action; it is acting from a corrupted world. Stronger models translate the critical boundary but do not remove the qualitative transition. These results make world-model collapse a measurable bottleneck for long-horizon agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究长程语言智能体的隐式世界模型是否存在类似水沸腾的相变现象。通过在确定性任务家族中进行大规模网格搜索，发现随状态载荷、horizon等参数变化，智能体行为会出现从稳定到突然崩溃的相变边界。实验表明，世界状态保真度先于动作有效性失效，导致智能体从受损世界模型出发采取行动。
Motivation: 现有长程语言智能体的世界模型在参数变化时可能突然崩溃，但缺乏系统性的相变分析。
Method: 在确定性任务家族中，对状态基数、依赖密度、horizon、分支因子、观测模式和变异率进行大规模网格搜索，并记录per-step轨迹以分析机制。
Result: 发现相图包含稳定平台、窄过渡带和崩溃区域；世界状态保真度先于动作有效性失效；更强模型仅平移临界边界，不消除定性相变。
Conclusion: 世界模型崩溃是长程智能体的可量化瓶颈，相变现象具有普遍性。

papers.title: Mixture-of-Control: State-Aware Fine-Tuning for Transformer-based Models
papers.abstract_en: State-based fine-tuning has emerged as a compelling alternative to weight-based adaptation for transformers, updating lightweight controls into states rather than model weights, offering substantial memory savings while retaining parameter efficiency. However, most existing state-based methods typically apply only per-block control updates, which limits inter-block information exchange and restricts representational adaptation. Meanwhile, prior mechanisms that enable cross-block communication often introduce considerable computational overhead, reducing their practicality for efficient fine-tuning. We introduce Mixture-of-Control (MoC), a lightweight fine-tuning framework that adaptively integrates local and global control signals to enhance representation learning. MoC treats block-wise control states as experts in a sparse mixture-of-experts process, enabling efficient communication across transformer blocks. Empirical results across diverse transformer-based benchmarks demonstrate that MoC outperforms state-based methods while maintaining a comparable memory and computational efficiency.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 Workshop on Connecting Low-rank Representations in AI, CoLoRAI, 26 pages, 12 figures, 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mixture-of-Control (MoC)，一种轻量级的 transformer 微调框架，将每块控制状态视为稀疏混合专家 (sparse mixture-of-experts) 中的专家，通过自适应整合局部和全局控制信号增强跨块信息交换。实验表明，MoC 在多种 transformer 基准上优于现有基于状态的微调方法，且保持相近的内存和计算效率。
Motivation: 现有基于状态的微调方法通常仅对每块独立更新控制状态，限制了跨块的信息交换，导致表示适应性不足；而允许跨块通信的先前机制往往带来显著计算开销。
Method: MoC 将 transformer 各块的轻量级控制状态视为稀疏混合专家中的专家，通过自适应路由机制选择性激活局部和全局控制信号，实现高效的跨块通信，同时保持训练和推理的低开销。
Result: 在多种 transformer 基准任务上，MoC 在准确率等指标上优于现有基于状态的方法，且内存与计算效率相当。
Conclusion: MoC 提供了一种兼顾跨块通信效率与计算开销的轻量级微调方案，适用于通用 transformer 模型。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Resolving superposition in AI for interpretability and cross-modal alignment in patient-neuronal images
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence is transforming our capability to solve biological challenges. In dimensionality bottleneck regimes exacerbated by high-dimensional biological data, Neural networks force distinct concepts into the lower dimensions known as superposition. Although this superposition is widely known to hinder interpretability, its impact on corrupting the geometry of latent spaces remains critically overlooked. Here, we utilized sparse autoencoders (SAEs) trained on over 100,000 multiplexed images of patient-derived Parkinson's disease and healthy neurons to resolve superposition. This approach bypasses the mathematical non-uniqueness of feature attribution by shifting to interpretable latent representation analysis. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that superposition contaminates representational metric spaces, and thereby SAEs successfully recover geometric fidelity. By treating these geometrically purified representations as single-cell state vectors, we adapted single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data analysis methodologies directly to the image domain. Finally, we introduce GW-map, utilizing Gromov-Wasserstein optimal transport to align these image representations with authentic scRNA-seq data \emph{de novo}. This coupling reconstructs hierarchical neuronal pathology pathways such as Calcium-AIS scaffold, without reference spatial transcriptomics, establishing a scalable foundation for spatial biology. Code is available at https://github.com/jijihihi/Bio_superposition
papers.comment: 10 pages, 7 figures (plus 14 in appendix), 1 table, NeurIPS 2026 preprint
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对高维生物数据中神经网络因维度瓶颈导致的叠加（superposition）问题，提出使用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）在超过10万张帕金森病患者与健康神经元的多重染色图像上训练，以解耦叠加并恢复潜在空间的几何保真度。作者进一步引入GW-map，通过Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输将图像表征与单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据直接对齐，无需参考空间转录组数据即可重建层级病理通路（如钙离子-AIS骨架）。理论分析与实证结果均表明叠加会污染表征度量空间，而SAEs能成功恢复几何结构。
Motivation: 神经网络在高维生物数据中因维度瓶颈迫使不同概念叠加进入低维空间，该现象虽已知阻碍可解释性，但其对潜在空间几何结构的破坏作用此前被忽视。
Method: 利用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）在大量患者神经元图像上训练以解耦叠加，并通过Gromov-Wasserstein最优传输（GW-map）将纯化后的图像表征与scRNA-seq数据进行无监督对齐。
Result: 理论证明与实验表明叠加会污染表征度量空间，而SAEs能恢复几何保真度；GW-map成功重建了钙离子-AIS骨架等层级病理通路，无需空间转录组参考数据。
Conclusion: 该方法为空间生物学提供了一种可扩展的跨模态对齐框架，通过几何纯化与最优传输实现图像与转录组数据的直接关联。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReGRPO: Reflection-Augmented Policy Optimization for Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract_en: Tool-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) can solve multimodal, multi-step tasks by calling external tools, yet they remain fragile in practice. Existing works have two common gaps. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is built mostly on successful trajectories and offers little signal for recovery after tool failures, while sparse trajectory-level RL rewards provide limited guidance on which step failed and how to repair it. We introduce ReGRPO (Reflection-augmented Group Relative Policy Optimization), a framework that learns reflection-guided correction in tool-using agents. ReGRPO starts with a structured reflective data engine: we execute near-miss actions to collect grounded failure observations, then build Reflection-of-Thought triplets (ErrorType, Evidence, FixPlan) paired with corrected actions for warm-start SFT. We then optimize reflection tokens and corrective actions jointly within local trajectories using group-relative advantages, and include a reflection-cost term to reduce unnecessary reflection. Experiments on GTA and GAIA show that, under the same backbone and tool suite, ReGRPO consistently outperforms strong open-source baselines and achieves the best results among the compared open-source controllers. Code and RoT data are available at https://github.com/showlab/ReGRPO.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出ReGRPO框架，通过反射增强的组相对策略优化来提升工具使用智能体的鲁棒性。该方法利用近失败动作收集失败观察，构建反射三元组（错误类型、证据、修复计划）进行SFT预训练，然后联合优化反射tokens和矫正动作，并引入反射成本项减少不必要的反射。在GTA和GAIA基准上，使用相同骨干网络和工具套件，ReGRPO一致优于强开源基线，达到最优性能。
Motivation: 现有工作存在两个缺陷：监督微调（SFT）主要基于成功轨迹，对工具调用失败后的恢复信号不足；稀疏的轨迹级RL奖励难以定位具体失败步骤及修复方式。
Method: 提出Reflection-augmented Group Relative Policy Optimization (ReGRPO)，包括：1) 结构化的反射数据引擎，通过执行近失败动作收集失败观察，构建Reflection-of-Thought三元组（ErrorType, Evidence, FixPlan）及修正动作，用于SFT预热；2) 在局部轨迹内使用组相对优势联合优化反射tokens和矫正动作；3) 引入反射成本项以减少不必要的反射。
Result: 在GTA和GAIA基准上，相同骨干网络和工具套件设置下，ReGRPO一致优于强开源基线，达到最优性能。
Conclusion: ReGRPO通过反射引导的矫正学习有效提升了工具使用智能体的鲁棒性和任务成功率。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.method: 提出Reflection-augmented Group Relative Policy Optimization (ReGRPO)，包括：1) 结构化的反射数据引擎，通过执行近失败动作收集失败观察，构建Reflection-of-Thought三元组（ErrorType, Evidence, FixPlan）及修正动作，用于SFT预热；2) 在局部轨迹内使用组相对优势联合优化反射tokens和矫正动作；3) 引入反射成本项以减少不必要的反射。
summary_sections.result: 在GTA和GAIA基准上，相同骨干网络和工具套件设置下，ReGRPO一致优于强开源基线，达到最优性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: ReGRPO通过反射引导的矫正学习有效提升了工具使用智能体的鲁棒性和任务成功率。

papers.title: Direction-Magnitude Decomposition for Low-Rank Matrix Optimization: Faster Convergence and Saddle-to-saddle Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Low-rank matrix optimization is often carried out via the Burer-Monteiro (BM) formulation, but choosing the factorization rank $r$ is delicate and can substantially slow optimization. We propose a unified framework, termed direction-magnitude decomposition (DMD), that decomposes the optimization variable to improve optimization efficiency even when the target rank is unknown. We develop two DMD-based approaches and establish their theoretical advantages on the canonical problem of matrix factorization. The first, overparameterized DMD, uses a rank $r$ larger than necessary and enjoys faster convergence as $r$ increases. The second, recursive DMD, is motivated by the incremental eigenpair learning, or saddle-to-saddle, behavior of overparameterized DMD. It achieves lower memory and computational costs, complementing overparameterized DMD. Both approaches are exponentially faster than gradient descent applied to the BM formulation. Numerical experiments on matrix factorization, sensing, and completion corroborate our theoretical findings and demonstrate the practical effectiveness of DMD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出方向-幅度分解（DMD）框架用于低秩矩阵优化，通过将变量分解为方向和幅度两部分，设计过参数化DMD和递归DMD两种方法，在矩阵分解、感知和补全等任务上比标准Burer-Monteiro梯度下降快指数倍，且对目标秩不敏感。
Motivation: 标准Burer-Monteiro公式对秩的选择敏感，导致优化缓慢；本文旨在构建一个对未知目标秩鲁棒且能显著加速优化的统一框架。
Method: 提出方向-幅度分解（DMD），将优化变量分解为方向（单位向量）和幅度（标量）两部分；开发过参数化DMD（使用比必要秩更大的秩）和递归DMD（利用过参数化DMD的增量特征学习鞍-鞍动力学），两者均不依赖准确秩的先验知识。
Result: 理论上证明两种DMD方法在矩阵分解问题上比梯度下降指数级更快收敛；数值实验在矩阵分解、感知和补全问题中验证了理论加速和实际效果。
Conclusion: DMD通过变量分解和利用鞍-鞍动力学，实现了对目标秩不敏感且指数级更快的低秩矩阵优化，过参数化DMD和递归DMD在不同资源条件下互补。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: One Video, One World: Turning Monocular Video into Physical 4D Scenes
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \textbf{OVOW}, the first training-free system that reconstructs \emph{instance-level, simulation-ready} 4D mesh scenes from a single monocular video. Recent 4D reconstruction achieves impressive rendering quality, but its outputs (\eg, implicit fields, Gaussian primitives, or point clouds) lack the watertight topology, instance separation, and standardized physical interfaces required by physics simulators and embodied AI. OVOW closes this gap with a four-stage pipeline: a vision-language model discovers, labels, and motion-classifies all instances; category-aware reconstruction yields per-instance meshes for rigid objects and topology-consistent mesh sequences for deformable ones; an iterative render-match-optimize procedure recovers metric scale and 6-DoF pose trajectories; and physics-grounded assembly enforces ground contact and inter-object support. Crucially, we model all motion, rigid and non-rigid, through direct vertex deformation without category-specific priors or skeleton rigging, producing watertight mesh scenes ready for downstream physics simulation and editing. We further establish the first benchmark for \emph{structured Video-to-4D} evaluation, with metrics for geometric correctness, instance separation, and physical plausibility beyond visual fidelity; the same pipeline doubles as a scalable engine for \emph{synthesizing} paired video-to-4D simulation data for future 4D world models and embodied AI. Across two synthetic benchmarks (static and 4D), OVOW attains the best overall layout and geometry accuracy and the lowest photometric and semantic error among all baselines, and on monocular video runs one to two orders of magnitude faster than the baselines, while downstream physics simulation confirms its physical stability.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://OneVideoOneWorld.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OVOW，首个无需训练的从单目视频重建实例级、可物理仿真的4D网格场景系统。结合视觉语言模型实现实例发现与运动分类，类别感知重建生成刚性物体网格与可变形物体的拓扑一致网格序列，迭代渲染-匹配-优化恢复度量尺度和6D姿态轨迹，物理组装确保地面接触和物体间支撑。在静态和4D合成基准上取得最佳布局与几何精度，速度比基线快1-2个数量级，且下游物理仿真验证其物理稳定性。
Motivation: 现有4D重建方法（隐式场、高斯原语、点云）缺乏水密拓扑、实例分离和标准化物理接口，无法直接用于物理仿真和具身AI。
Method: 四阶段流水线：VLM发现、标记和运动分类实例；类别感知重建产生每个实例的网格；迭代渲染-匹配-优化恢复度量尺度和6D姿态轨迹；物理组装强制地面接触和物体间支撑。所有运动通过顶点变形建模，无需类别先验或骨架绑定。
Result: 在静态和4D合成基准上取得最佳布局与几何精度、最低光度与语义误差；单目视频运行速度比基线快1-2个数量级；下游物理仿真证实物理稳定性。
Conclusion: OVOW首个实现从单目视频到实例级、可仿真的4D网格场景的零训练重建，为结构化视频到4D评估建立基准，并可作为合成视频到4D仿真数据的可扩展引擎。

papers.title: MS-Resampler: Multi-Scope Visual Resampling for Efficient Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) typically employ resampling-based projectors to transform dense visual features into a compact token sequence for language modeling. Most existing resamplers adopt a single, fixed aggregation scope via global cross-attention, which can blur fine-grained local evidence and limit the ability to capture both local details and global context within a fixed token budget. In this work, we propose MS-Resampler, a multi-scope visual resampling framework for MLLMs. MS-Resampler instantiates multiple scope-specific resamplers by injecting explicit spatial scope priors into the resampling attention, enabling each branch to aggregate visual information at a particular granularity from local to global. The outputs of these scope-specific resamplers are then adaptively fused to produce the final visual representations for language modeling. Extensive experiments on ten public multimodal benchmarks show that MS-Resampler consistently improves visual understanding and multimodal reasoning over conventional single-scope resamplers, while introducing only minimal computational overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MS-Resampler，一种多范围视觉重采样框架，用于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）。通过注入显式空间范围先验，实例化多个从局部到全局的不同粒度重采样器，并自适应融合输出，在十个公开多模态基准上一致提升视觉理解和推理能力，仅引入极小的计算开销。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs的重采样投影器通常采用单一固定聚合范围的全局交叉注意力，这会模糊细粒度局部证据，限制了在固定token预算下同时捕捉局部细节和全局上下文的能力。
Method: 提出多范围视觉重采样框架MS-Resampler，通过向重采样注意力注入显式空间范围先验，实例化多个范围特定的重采样器，每个分支聚合特定粒度的视觉信息，最后自适应融合所有分支输出。
Result: 在十个公开多模态基准上，MS-Resampler相比传统单范围重采样器一致提升视觉理解与多模态推理性能，且计算开销极小。
Conclusion: MS-Resampler通过多范围重采样与自适应融合，在几乎不增加计算量的前提下有效提升了MLLMs的视觉表示能力，验证了多范围聚合的有效性。

papers.title: MAPE: Defending Against Transferable Adversarial Attacks Using Multi-Source Adversarial Perturbations Elimination
papers.abstract_en: Neural networks are vulnerable to meticulously crafted adversarial examples, leading to high-confidence misclassifications in image classification tasks. Due to their consistency with regular input patterns and the absence of reliance on the target model and its output information, transferable adversarial attacks exhibit a notably high stealthiness and detection difficulty, making them a significant focus of defense. In this work, we propose a deep learning defense known as multi-source adversarial perturbations elimination (MAPE) to counter diverse transferable attacks. MAPE comprises the single-source adversarial perturbation elimination (SAPE) mechanism and the pre-trained models probabilistic scheduling algorithm (PPSA). SAPE utilizes a thoughtfully designed channel-attention U-Net as the defense model and employs adversarial examples generated by a pre-trained model (e.g., ResNet) for its training, thereby enabling the elimination of known adversarial perturbations. PPSA introduces model difference quantification and negative momentum to strategically schedule multiple pre-trained models, thereby maximizing the differences among adversarial examples during the defense model's training and enhancing its robustness in eliminating adversarial perturbations. MAPE effectively eliminates adversarial perturbations in various adversarial examples, providing a robust defense against attacks from different substitute models. In a black-box attack scenario utilizing ResNet-34 as the target model, our approach achieves average defense rates of over 95.1\% on CIFAR-10 and over 71.5\% on Mini-ImageNet, demonstrating state-of-the-art performance.
papers.journal_ref: Complex & Intelligent Systems, Volume 11, article number 155 (2025)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对迁移性对抗攻击的防御问题，提出多源对抗扰动消除（MAPE）方法。MAPE 包含单源对抗扰动消除（SAPE）机制和预训练模型概率调度算法（PPSA），通过通道注意力 U-Net 作为防御模型，并利用不同预训练模型生成的对抗样本来训练，以消除已知扰动。在 CIFAR-10 和 Mini-ImageNet 上的黑盒攻击场景中，分别达到 95.1% 和 71.5% 的平均防御率。
Motivation: 迁移性对抗攻击具有高隐蔽性和检测难度，现有防御方法在应对多样化攻击时鲁棒性不足。
Method: 提出 MAPE：SAPE 使用通道注意力 U-Net 作为防御模型，用单一预训练模型生成的对抗样本训练；PPSA 引入模型差异量化和负动量，策略性地调度多个预训练模型，最大化训练中对抗样本的差异性，增强防御模型的鲁棒性。
Result: 在 ResNet-34 作为目标模型的黑盒攻击下，MAPE 在 CIFAR-10 上平均防御率超过 95.1%，在 Mini-ImageNet 上超过 71.5%，达到当时最佳性能。
Conclusion: MAPE 能有效消除多种对抗样本中的扰动，提供针对不同替代模型攻击的鲁棒防御。

papers.title: Stage-Transition Dense Reward Modeling for Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon robotic manipulation is often limited by sparse and delayed rewards, while manually designing dense shaping signals is costly and brittle to changes in environments and object configurations. This work proposes Stage-Transition Dense Reward (STDR), a visual reward-learning framework that converts unstructured expert videos into logically grounded dense rewards for training RL agents from scratch. STDR leverages semantic understanding to infer a task's stage structure from demonstrations, and delivers two complementary learning signals during online training: (i) stage-transition feedback that provides goal-directed reward, and (ii) within-stage progress feedback that supplies fine-grained guidance toward completing each stage. Furthermore, an out-of-distribution (OOD) detection mechanism and a grasping regulation module are integrated to enhance robustness and prevent reward hacking. Experiments on 14 manipulation tasks across MetaWorld, ManiSkill, and Franka Kitchen show that STDR consistently improves sample efficiency and success rates over multiple baselines, and matches or surpasses handcrafted dense rewards on several challenging tasks. Real-robot evaluations further indicate that STDR assigns stable, progress-aligned rewards on successful executions while producing appropriately low rewards for failures, suggesting robustness to visual noise and better-calibrated reward assignment across settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出阶段转换密集奖励（STDR），一种将无结构化专家视频转换为逻辑化密集奖励的视觉奖励学习框架，用于从零训练强化学习智能体。STDR利用语义理解从演示中推断任务阶段结构，在在线训练中提供阶段转换反馈和阶段内进度反馈，并集成OOD检测和抓取调节模块以增强鲁棒性。在MetaWorld、ManiSkill和Franka Kitchen的14个操作任务上，STDR一致提升了样本效率和成功率，在多个任务上匹配或超越手工设计的密集奖励。真实机器人评估表明STDR能分配稳定、与进度对齐的奖励。
Motivation: 长时域机器人操作中的强化学习常受限于稀疏和延迟奖励，而手动设计密集奖励信号成本高且对环境变化脆弱。
Method: 提出STDR框架，包括：从专家演示中推断任务阶段结构；在训练时提供阶段转换奖励（目标导向）和阶段内进度奖励（细粒度引导）；集成OOD检测和抓取调节模块防止奖励欺骗。
Result: 在MetaWorld、ManiSkill和Franka Kitchen的14个操作任务上，STDR一致提升样本效率和成功率，匹配或超越手工密集奖励。真实机器人评估显示奖励稳定且有效。
Conclusion: STDR提供了一种自动化、鲁棒的密集奖励生成方法，减轻了手工设计依赖，并在多种机器人操作任务上验证了有效性。

summary_sections.method: 提出STDR框架，包括：从专家演示中推断任务阶段结构；在训练时提供阶段转换奖励（目标导向）和阶段内进度奖励（细粒度引导）；集成OOD检测和抓取调节模块防止奖励欺骗。
summary_sections.result: 在MetaWorld、ManiSkill和Franka Kitchen的14个操作任务上，STDR一致提升样本效率和成功率，匹配或超越手工密集奖励。真实机器人评估显示奖励稳定且有效。
summary_sections.conclusion: STDR提供了一种自动化、鲁棒的密集奖励生成方法，减轻了手工设计依赖，并在多种机器人操作任务上验证了有效性。

papers.title: Domain Adaptive Object Detection via Dual-Stream Bilevel-Cycle Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Cycle self-training (CST) breaks the shared classifier assumption of the standard self-training framework, which is effective for unsupervised domain adaptation and exploits unlabeled target data by training with target pseudo-labels. CST introduces a target classifier and employs an inner-outer loop updating strategy, addressing the issue of unreliable pseudo-labels and enabling pseudo-labels to generalize across domains. Despite its success in image classification, extending CST to object detection faces three main challenges. First, the upper bound of CST in object detection is constrained by three types of unreliable pseudo-labels, such as classification error alone, localization error alone, and their combination. Second, since object detection involves detecting multiple target objects, directly applying CST leads to training insta bility. Third, a wider numerical range of regression coordinates leads to exploding losses. To this end, we apply CST to both classification and regression and propose the Dual-Stream Bilevel-Cycle Optimization framework. Specifically, we construct CST upon Mean Teacher to prevent training instability and use extra normalization to map the regression bounding box into a standardized space, effectively addressing exploding losses. Also, we provide a theoretical derivation of the regression bound. Extensive experiments across four cross domain standard scenarios demonstrate that our framework achieves considerable results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对循环自训练（CST）在目标检测中遇到的不可靠伪标签、训练不稳定和回归损失爆炸问题，提出双流双层循环优化框架。通过在均值教师（Mean Teacher）上构建CST并引入额外归一化将回归框映射到标准化空间，该方法在四个跨域标准场景上取得了显著结果。
Motivation: CST在图像分类中有效，但直接扩展到目标检测面临三大挑战：三种不可靠伪标签（分类错误、定位错误及两者结合）限制上限、多目标检测导致训练不稳定、回归坐标数值范围宽导致损失爆炸。
Method: 提出双流双层循环优化框架，将CST同时应用于分类和回归分支；在均值教师模型上构建CST以防止训练不稳定；使用额外归一化将回归边界框映射到标准化空间以解决损失爆炸问题。
Result: 在四个跨域标准场景上的大量实验表明，所提框架取得了显著结果。
Conclusion: 通过双流双层循环优化和归一化处理，有效解决了CST在目标检测中的伪标签不可靠、训练不稳定和损失爆炸问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Calibrating the Evaluator: Does Probability Calibration Mitigate Preference Coupling in LLM Agent Feedback Loops?
papers.abstract_en: When large language model (LLM) agents adapt their behavior through evaluator feedback, systematic evaluator biases propagate into the agent's learned strategy distribution - a phenomenon termed evaluator preference coupling. Prior work has documented this coupling and established a diagnostic framework (EPC) to measure it, but has not investigated whether calibration techniques can mitigate the effect. We present the first study of evaluator calibration as mitigation: applying probability calibration to the evaluator's pairwise judgments to reduce spurious preference propagation. In a controlled within-subjects experiment (N=5) comparing standard binary TTRL (win/loss) with confidence-calibrated TTRL (probability-weighted updates) using DeepSeek-V4-Pro as executor and GLM5.2 as evaluator, we find that calibration reduces the coupling coefficient gamma by 20-49% and Jensen-Shannon divergence by 45-67%. A symmetric-LR control confirms the effect is not due to reduced update asymmetry. We release the calibrated TTRL protocol and recommend it as a lightweight mitigation for LLM-as-judge deployment pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次研究评估器概率校准能否减轻LLM智能体反馈循环中的偏好耦合现象。实验使用DeepSeek-V4-Pro作为执行器、GLM5.2作为评估器，将标准TTRL的二元胜负更新替换为概率加权更新，在N=5的受试者内实验中，校准使耦合系数gamma降低20-49%，Jensen-Shannon散度降低45-67%。对称LR对照实验排除了更新不对称性降低的解释。
Motivation: 先前工作已发现LLM评估器的系统性偏差会通过反馈传播到智能体策略分布中（即评估器偏好耦合），但尚未探索校准技术能否缓解这一效应。
Method: 对评估器的成对判断应用概率校准（例如温度缩放、保序回归等），并在TTRL训练中使用置信度加权的概率更新而非简单的二元胜负更新。
Result: 校准后耦合系数gamma下降20-49%，Jensen-Shannon散度下降45-67%。对称LR对照实验确认该效果并非由于更新不对称性减少所致。
Conclusion: 概率校准可有效减轻评估器偏好耦合，研究建议将校准后的TTRL协议作为LLM-as-judge部署流程中的轻量级缓解措施。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evidence Triangulation for Multimodal Fact-Checking in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: The proliferation of multimedia content on social platforms has fueled multimodal misinformation, where images are used to reinforce false claims. Consequently, Multimodal Fact-Checking (MFC) has emerged as an increasingly important research area. However, current progress is hindered by a reliance on synthetic training data and curated benchmarks that fail to capture the complexity of in-the-wild data. Furthermore, existing detection models rely on restricted intra-modality consistency or unconstrained all-to-all fusion, failing to capture nuanced relations between posts and external evidence. To address these limitations, we introduce X-POSE, a benchmark of real-world, community-annotated multimodal posts from X (formerly Twitter), augmented with full-length news articles retrieved via VLM-optimized search. Additionally, we propose TRENT, a novel MFC model that performs evidence triangulation using three parallel cross-attention streams alongside a relational fusion mechanism that explicitly models entailment and contradiction. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that TRENT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art specialized models and commercial VLMs. The code, prompt templates, and dataset are available at https://github.com/stevejpapad/evidence-triangulation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态事实核查（MFC）领域依赖合成数据和受限融合方法的问题，提出了真实世界基准X-POSE（包含来自X平台的多模态帖子及通过VLM优化检索的新闻文章）以及新模型TRENT，该模型通过三个并行交叉注意力流和关系融合机制进行证据三角化，显式建模蕴含和矛盾关系。实验表明TRENT在多个指标上优于现有专业模型和商业VLM。
Motivation: 现有MFC方法依赖合成训练数据和精心整理的基准，无法捕捉真实数据的复杂性；同时检测模型局限于模态内一致性或全连接融合，未能捕捉帖子与外部证据之间的细微关系。
Method: 提出TRENT模型，采用三个并行交叉注意力流进行证据三角化，并设计关系融合机制显式建模蕴含和矛盾关系。同时构建X-POSE基准，包含来自X平台的真实多模态帖子及通过VLM优化搜索获取的全长新闻文章。
Result: TRENT在多个评估中持续优于现有专业模型和商业VLM。
Conclusion: 真实世界多模态事实核查需要更好的基准和更精细的证据关系建模，TRENT和X-POSE为此提供了有效工具。代码、提示模板和数据集已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Materials Database to Materials Bank: Assetizing Data for AI Driven Materials Innovation
papers.abstract_en: Driven by high-throughput experimentation, computational modeling, and artificial intelligence (AI), materials data has expanded at an unprecedented rate. Conventional materials databases function only as passive repositories, archiving raw experimental records indiscriminately including both successful and failed data, without systematic value filtering or asset management. This creates a critical gap between massive data accumulation and actionable innovation, hindering the identification of high-potential materials and industrial translation. To address this bottleneck, we propose an industrialization-oriented Materials Bank, a dedicated valuefiltering and assetization layer that operates beyond traditional databases. It does not merely curate high-quality data but systematically elevates qualified candidates into standardized, upgradable materials assets via a multi-dimensional BankCard framework covering scientific validity, synthesis feasibility, application readiness, and industrial value. By unifying databases, AI models, automated experimentation, and multi-criteria assessment into a cohesive closed-loop ecosystem, the Materials Bank establishes a clear trajectory from data to knowledge, candidate, asset, and product. It serves not as an enhanced database or screening tool, but as a decision infrastructure bridging academic discovery and industrial demand, offering a scalable paradigm to accelerate AI-driven materials innovation and deliver tangible real-world impact.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种工业化导向的材料银行（Materials Bank）框架，旨在将传统材料数据库中的原始数据通过价值过滤和资产化提升为标准化、可升级的材料资产，并集成多维度评估（科学有效性、合成可行性、应用准备度、工业价值）形成闭环生态系统，以加速AI驱动的材料创新。
Motivation: 传统材料数据库被动存储数据，缺乏价值筛选和资产管理，导致数据积累与可行动创新之间存在鸿沟，阻碍高潜力材料识别和工业转化。
Method: 提出材料银行作为价值过滤和资产化层，通过多维银行卡片（BankCard）框架系统地将合格候选者提升为标准化材料资产，并统一数据库、AI模型、自动化实验和多标准评估形成闭环。
Result: 论文未提供具体实验结果，但声称材料银行建立了从数据到知识、候选、资产、产品的清晰路径，作为连接学术发现与工业需求的决策基础设施。
Conclusion: 材料银行不是增强型数据库或筛选工具，而是可扩展的范式，旨在加速AI驱动的材料创新并产生实际工业影响。

papers.title: Language-Assisted Super-Resolution from Real-World Low-Resolution Patches
papers.abstract_en: Single image super-resolution aims to reconstruct high-resolution (HR) images from low-resolution (LR) inputs. Training SR models typically requires paired HR-LR data, which is difficult to obtain in reality. As a result, most methods synthesize LR images by artificially degrading HR images with handcrafted kernels or camera ISP adjustments. However, these synthetic degradations fail to capture the complexity of real LR images, leading to poor generalization in practice. To address this, we observe that even within a single high-quality image, regions at different depths exhibit varying resolutions, where distant regions act as LR patches and closer ones as HR patches. This allows the extraction of real, degradation-induced LR patches from real images. Since these LR patches lack paired HR counterparts, we propose LA-SR (Language Assistant for SR), a novel framework for unpaired SR. The key idea of LA-SR is to redefine unpaired SR in the language space, using vision-language models to bridge the LR-HR gap. LA-SR projects images into a semantically rich space representing both content and quality, and applies two language-guided losses: linguistic content loss to preserve semantic fidelity, and linguistic quality loss to enhance perceptual realism. With this alignment, LA-SR effectively super-resolves real LR inputs, producing realistic outputs that overcome the limitations of synthetic-data-trained methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LA-SR框架，利用视觉-语言模型在语言空间中实现无配对真实低分辨率图像的超分辨率重建。该方法从真实图像中提取不同深度区域作为天然LR/HR对，通过语言内容损失和语言质量损失对齐LR和HR特征，克服了合成退化方法在真实场景中的泛化不足问题。
Motivation: 现有超分辨率方法依赖人工合成的低分辨率图像，无法模拟真实成像中的复杂退化，导致模型在真实低分辨率输入上表现不佳。
Method: 提出LA-SR框架，利用视觉-语言模型将图像投影到语义空间，定义语言内容损失和语言质量损失，在无配对条件下对齐LR和HR特征，实现真实LR图像的超分辨率重建。
Result: 摘要未提供定量结果，但声称该方法能有效超分辨率真实LR输入，产生比合成数据训练方法更逼真的输出。
Conclusion: LA-SR通过语言空间对齐克服了合成退化方法的局限性，为无配对真实超分辨率提供了新思路。

papers.title: RCL-Mamba: A Dual-domain State Space Model for Measurement-oriented Image Restoration in Rotational Sparse-View Scanning Computed Laminography
papers.abstract_en: Rotational Scanning Computed Laminography (RCL) is widely utilized for the Non-Destructive Testing(NDT) of large planar components. However, to facilitate rapid inspection, continuous sparse-view scanning is often employed, where the angular integration effect during exposure induces rotational blur in the projection domain. Furthermore, the data incompleteness inherent in sparse sampling manifests as sparse artifacts in the reconstructed image domain. To address these cross-domain degradations, this paper proposes RCL-Mamba, a measurement-oriented dual-domain State Space Model (SSM)-based image restoration network. The framework adopts a cascaded joint processing strategy: it first corrects the rotational blur in the projection domain and subsequently suppresses the sparse artifacts in the image domain. Additionally, we design a Mamba-CNN dual-branch module to adaptively balance large-scale blur correction with local detail recovery. Evaluations on both simulated datasets and real-world Printed Circuit Board (PCB) scans demonstrate that RCL-Mamba outperforms existing baselines in blur removal, artifact suppression, and structural preservation. Line-profile-based structural measurement further verifies that the proposed method better preserves via/pad boundaries and slender trace profiles. Crucially, by reducing the required scanning views from 512 to 64, our method enhances inspection efficiency by approximately 8-fold without compromising reconstruction quality, offering a robust measurement-oriented restoration solution for high-throughput RCL inspection with improved structural measurement fidelity.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Dualformer: Efficient Feature Extractor for Complex-valued Blind Communication Signal Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Designing effective feature extractors is critical for blind signal analysis tasks such as automatic modulation recognition (AMR), signal scheme recognition (SSR), and \color{black} signal structure parsing (SSP). In this work, we propose dual-channel neural network (DualNN) that efficiently exploits complex-valued signals through parameter sharing across IQ channels. Unlike traditional real-valued or complex-valued models, DualNN is a groundbreaking framework which shares the network parameters for processing the real and imaginary parts of the complex-valued signals, and is theoretically shown to reduce generalization error while preserving expressive capacity. Specifically, we propose a novel Transformer-based architecture to implement DualNN, called Dualformer. The Dualformer segments input signals into patch-level tokens and captures multi-granularity features, enabling robust performance across diverse signal analysis tasks. Furthermore, we conduct extensive experiments comparing Dualformer with three Transformer-based baselines and four conventional DL-based approaches. Results demonstrate consistent performance improvements on AMR, SSR, and SSP tasks. Besides, the modular design of DualNN allows it to generalize well to blind signal processing tasks such as blind source separation and low-SNR spectrum sensing. This work paves the way for a broader application of DualNN architectures in unsupervised and weakly supervised complex-valued signal analysis scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为Dualformer的双通道神经网络，用于复杂通信信号的盲分析。该网络通过在IQ通道间共享参数来高效处理复值信号，理论上降低了泛化误差并保持表达能力。在自动调制识别、信号方案识别和信号结构解析等任务上，Dualformer相比多种基线取得了一致性能提升。
Motivation: 传统复值神经网络在盲信号分析中性能有限，而实值模型未能充分利用复值信号的通道结构信息。需要一种既能高效处理复值信号又能降低泛化误差的通用特征提取器。
Method: 提出双通道神经网络（DualNN）框架，通过共享网络参数处理复值信号的实部和虚部。基于此框架设计了Transformer架构的Dualformer，将输入信号分割为图块级token并捕获多粒度特征。
Result: 在自动调制识别、信号方案识别和信号结构解析三个任务上，Dualformer相比三种Transformer基线和四种传统深度学习方法均取得一致性能改进。
Conclusion: Dualformer的模块化设计可推广至盲源分离和低信噪比频谱感知等任务，为无监督和弱监督复值信号分析提供了新范式。

papers.title: PGUDA: Pressure-Guided Unsupervised Domain Adaptation with Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for sEMG-Based Gesture Recognition
papers.abstract_en: Surface electromyography (sEMG)-based gesture recognition has emerged as a promising technology for natural human-computer interaction. However, its practical deployment remains challenging due to severe performance degradation caused by feature distribution discrepancies across different subjects and recording sessions. Although domain adaptation (DA) techniques are commonly employed to mitigate such discrepancies, conventional methods often struggle to effectively aligning sEMG features, primarily due to their inherent stochasticity and the scarcity of labeled data. To address these limitations, this paper proposes a novel Pressure-Guided Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (PGUDA) framework, which leverages the robustness and stability of pressure signals to introduce a cross-modal knowledge distillation strategy that transfers consistent physical semantics across modalities. Specifically, a teacher network trained on pressure signals guides an sEMG student network on unlabeled target domains, thereby regularizing the representation learning process with transferable and modality-invariant knowledge. Extensive experiments conducted on a self-collected multimodal dataset involving eleven subjects validate the effectiveness of the proposed PGUDA framework. The results demonstrate that our proposed PGUDA achieves leading performance in both cross-subject and cross-session classification tasks, achieving average accuracies of 58.08% and substantially outperforming existing DA approaches. Notably, PGUDA exhibits remarkable label efficiency: it attains classification accuracy comparable to fully supervised benchmarks while requiring only 5% of labeled data for teacher network training. This framework offers a robust and data-efficient solution that can significantly reduce the calibration burden in practical sEMG-based gesture recognition systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于压力引导的无监督域适应框架(PGUDA)，利用压力信号的鲁棒性通过跨模态知识蒸馏将一致物理语义从教师网络传递到学生网络，以解决sEMG手势识别中跨主体和跨会话的特征分布差异问题。在自采集的11人多模态数据集上，跨主体/跨会话平均准确率达58.08%，显著优于现有域适应方法，且仅需5%标签数据即可达到接近全监督的性能。
Motivation: sEMG手势识别在实际部署中因不同主体和会话间的特征分布差异导致性能严重下降，而传统域适应方法因sEMG信号的随机性和标签数据稀缺难以有效对齐特征。
Method: 提出PGUDA框架，利用压力信号的稳健性，通过跨模态知识蒸馏策略，使压力信号训练的教师网络引导未标注目标域上的sEMG学生网络学习模态不变且可迁移的表征。
Result: 在自采数据集上，跨主体/跨会话分类平均准确率58.08%，大幅超越现有DA方法；仅使用5%标签数据训练教师网络即可达到与全监督相当的精度。
Conclusion: PGUDA提供了一种鲁棒且数据高效的解决方案，可显著降低实际sEMG手势识别系统的校准负担。

papers.title: Patient-Level Elbow Abnormality Detection: Leakage-Aware Evaluation of Learned Preprocessing, Calibration, and Triage-Oriented Operating Points
papers.abstract_en: In this study, we examine learned preprocessing pipelines in the context of triage-oriented orthopedic abnormality detection task using elbow radiographs from MURA dataset. The evaluation focuses on patient-level detection of musculoskeletal abnormalities under a leakage-aware protocol. We compare multiple preprocessing pipelines, with and without a lightweight DnCNN module as a learned preprocessing component, to assess their impact on discrimination and calibration. Performance is assessed using discrimination metrics (AUROC, PR-AUC), calibration measures (ECE, Brier score), and validation-selected operating point analysis targeting high specificity. Results show that differences across preprocessing strategies are modest and configuration-dependent, with no consistent discrimination advantage over the raw-input DenseNet121 baseline. The raw and diverse inputs combined with the DnCNN front-end showed reduced ECE and Brier score, while CLAHE combined with DnCNN did not improve calibration. Overall, the results suggest that under patient-level evaluation, preprocessing gains are modest and configuration-dependent; the raw-input DenseNet121 baseline remains competitive throughout, and no tested preprocessing strategy produced a consistent discrimination advantage across all metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用MURA数据集的肘部X光片，在患者级别下评估不同预处理流程（包括轻量级DnCNN模块）对骨科异常检测的影响，重点关注区分度、校准度和高特异性操作点。结果发现预处理带来的提升有限且依赖配置，原始输入DenseNet121基线在所有指标上仍具竞争力。
Motivation: 现有研究在肘部X光异常检测中常忽略患者级别的数据泄露问题，且对预处理流程的系统性评估不足。
Method: 采用泄漏感知协议，对比多种预处理流水线（含/不含DnCNN），并使用AUROC、PR-AUC、ECE、Brier评分及高特异性操作点分析进行评估。
Result: 预处理策略差异不大，无一致区分度优势；原始+DnCNN降低ECE和Brier，CLAHE+DnCNN未改善校准。
Conclusion: 患者级别评估下预处理增益有限，原始输入基线仍具竞争力，未发现能持续提升所有指标的策略。

papers.title: Smart charging of large fleets of Electric Vehicles: Independent Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning approaches
papers.abstract_en: The electrification of transportation through electric vehicles introduces new challenges for power grid management, such as increased peak demand, voltage fluctuations, line overloads, and the integration of variable renewable energy sources. To enable efficient integration of EVs while minimizing costs for users and avoiding network overloads, implicit coordination between EVs is required. This work compares two independent multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches for optimizing such decentralized EV charging: contextual combinatorial bandits and policy gradient algorithms. Using a realistic simulation environment with autonomous agents making decisions based on local environmental information (including price signals, state-of-charge, and temporal constraints), we evaluate their performance across varying congestion levels, and mixed-strategy configurations with heterogeneous agent groups under dynamic electricity pricing derived from real photovoltaic production data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文比较了两种独立多智能体强化学习方法（上下文组合老虎机和策略梯度算法）用于大规模电动汽车车队的分散式智能充电，以降低用户成本并避免电网过载。实验在包含动态电价和真实光伏数据的仿真环境中进行，评估了不同拥堵程度和异构智能体混合策略下的性能。
Motivation: 电动汽车大规模接入电网会带来峰值需求增加、电压波动等问题，需要车辆间的隐式协调以优化充电并最小化成本，同时避免网络过载。
Method: 采用两种独立多智能体强化学习框架：上下文组合老虎机（contextual combinatorial bandits）和策略梯度算法（policy gradient algorithms）。智能体基于局部环境信息（电价信号、荷电状态、时间约束）自主决策，并在包含真实光伏发电数据的动态电价下进行仿真。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称在仿真中评估了不同拥堵水平和异构智能体配置下的性能。
Conclusion: 独立多智能体强化学习方法可用于大规模电动汽车的分散式充电协调，但需综合考虑电网约束和用户成本。

papers.title: Domain-Decomposed Randomized Neural Networks for Partial Differential Equations in Unbounded Domains
papers.abstract_en: Partial differential equations on unbounded domains are challenging because the exterior region must be represented without excessive truncation error. Truncation-based methods often require problem-dependent artificial boundary conditions, while global spectral bases may be inefficient for localized structures, irregular geometries, or solutions with different near-field and far-field behaviors. We propose a domain-decomposed randomized neural network framework for such problems. Different randomized subnetworks are assigned to different spatial regimes: a near-field subnetwork captures local and geometric features, whereas a far-field subnetwork represents exterior decay. The subnetworks are coupled by boundary and interface conditions, and only the output-layer coefficients are solved from linear least-squares systems arising from Petrov--Galerkin or collocation formulations. We develop a Petrov--Galerkin method for semi-unbounded elliptic problems and a collocation method for fully unbounded, perforated, and time-dependent problems. A conditional bounded-parameter approximation result is proved in a broken Sobolev norm, together with an error decomposition covering approximation, empirical-consistency/quadrature, and least-squares optimization errors. Numerical experiments for Poisson and time-dependent Schrödinger equations demonstrate the accuracy and flexibility of the proposed method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种域分解随机神经网络框架，用于求解无界域上的偏微分方程。通过将空间划分为近场和远场子区域，分别为每个区域分配随机子网络，并耦合边界条件，输出层系数通过求解线性最小二乘系统确定。作者证明了有界参数逼近结果和误差分解，并在泊松方程和含时薛定谔方程上验证了精度和灵活性。
Motivation: 无界域上的偏微分方程求解因外部区域需要截断且截断误差难以控制而具有挑战性；传统方法依赖问题依赖的人工边界条件或全局谱基，难以处理局部结构、不规则几何或近场/远场行为不同的解。
Method: 提出域分解随机神经网络框架：近场子网络捕获局部和几何特征，远场子网络表示外部衰减；子网络通过边界和界面条件耦合，输出层系数通过Petrov-Galerkin或配点法得到的线性最小二乘系统求解。
Result: 对于半无界椭圆问题发展了Petrov-Galerkin方法，对于全无界、穿孔和时变问题发展了配点法；在断裂Sobolev范数下证明了有界参数逼近结果，并给出了包含逼近、经验一致性/求积和最小二乘优化误差的误差分解；数值实验在泊松方程和含时薛定谔方程上展示了方法的准确性和灵活性。
Conclusion: 该方法为无界域PDE提供了一种灵活且准确的解决方案，避免了截断边界条件，并通过域分解和随机网络简化了训练（仅需线性最小二乘求解）。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出一种域分解随机神经网络框架，用于求解无界域上的偏微分方程。通过将空间划分为近场和远场子区域，分别为每个区域分配随机子网络，并耦合边界条件，输出层系数通过求解线性最小二乘系统确定。作者证明了有界参数逼近结果和误差分解，并在泊松方程和含时薛定谔方程上验证了精度和灵活性。
summary_sections.motivation: 无界域上的偏微分方程求解因外部区域需要截断且截断误差难以控制而具有挑战性；传统方法依赖问题依赖的人工边界条件或全局谱基，难以处理局部结构、不规则几何或近场/远场行为不同的解。
summary_sections.method: 提出域分解随机神经网络框架：近场子网络捕获局部和几何特征，远场子网络表示外部衰减；子网络通过边界和界面条件耦合，输出层系数通过Petrov-Galerkin或配点法得到的线性最小二乘系统求解。
summary_sections.result: 对于半无界椭圆问题发展了Petrov-Galerkin方法，对于全无界、穿孔和时变问题发展了配点法；在断裂Sobolev范数下证明了有界参数逼近结果，并给出了包含逼近、经验一致性/求积和最小二乘优化误差的误差分解；数值实验在泊松方程和含时薛定谔方程上展示了方法的准确性和灵活性。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法为无界域PDE提供了一种灵活且准确的解决方案，避免了截断边界条件，并通过域分解和随机网络简化了训练（仅需线性最小二乘求解）。

papers.title: Beyond Binary Instrument QA: Probing Instrument Grounding in Music Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent music audio-language models achieve high accuracy on instrument question-answering benchmarks, but it remains unclear whether this reflects robust audio grounding or benchmark-specific shortcuts. In this paper, we introduce an OpenMIC-derived diagnostic benchmark sequence for instrument grounding in music audio-language models, extending binary instrument-presence QA to genre-prior-reduced examples, confusable instrument discrimination, longer audio context, and temporal localization. Across these settings, high binary QA accuracy often fails to predict model behavior: models can exhibit option-position bias, confusable-instrument errors, and temporal response bias. These results suggest that instrument grounding should be evaluated with multi-axis diagnostic benchmarks rather than a single aggregate accuracy.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对音乐音频语言模型在乐器问答基准上的高准确率是否反映真正的音频接地能力提出质疑，并引入了一个基于OpenMIC的诊断基准序列，扩展了二元乐器存在问答到减少体裁先验的例子、易混淆乐器判别、更长音频上下文和时间定位。实验表明，高二元QA准确率往往无法预测模型行为，模型可能出现选项位置偏差、易混淆乐器错误和时间响应偏差。
Motivation: 现有音乐音频语言模型在乐器问答基准上表现良好，但不清楚这是否源于稳健的音频接地还是基准特有的捷径。
Method: 引入基于OpenMIC的诊断基准序列，将二元乐器存在问答扩展至减少体裁先验、易混淆乐器判别、长音频上下文和时间定位四个维度。
Result: 高二元QA准确率不能预测模型在扩展设置中的行为；模型存在选项位置偏差、易混淆乐器错误和时间响应偏差。
Conclusion: 乐器接地评估应使用多轴诊断基准而非单一聚合准确率。

papers.title: Optimization Algorithms for Joint OFDM Waveform Design and RIS Configuration in 6G Networks: From Convex Relaxation to Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: Joint OFDM-RIS optimization for 6G is a mixed-integer nonlinear programming (MINLP) problem covering sum-rate maximization, energy efficiency, max-min fairness, and peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR)-constrained objectives. Seventy-eight joint OFDM-RIS optimization works published between 2021 and 2026 are surveyed. No standardized benchmark exists, and cross-paper comparisons remain infeasible. This survey classifies these works into four paradigms: (I) model-based convex relaxation, (II) heuristic and metaheuristic search, (III) deep reinforcement and unsupervised learning, and (IV) emerging methods including foundation models (FM), diffusion-based generative AI, and quantum optimization. A literature synthesis of self-reported benchmarks shows that ML-based methods (Paradigm~III) report 95-99\% of model-based spectral efficiency at 10^2-10^4 x faster per-inference runtime (method-pair dependent; literature values are self-reported and exclude ML pre-training cost). A companion tutorial benchmark at N=16, N=64, and N=128 reveals a critical scaling property: GPU-based neural network inference (DDQN, PPO, graph neural network (GNN), unsupervised DL) is N-invariant, with identical runtime at N=16 and N=128, while iterative solvers (AO+SCA, PSO) scale polynomially. Energy efficiency (P2) and PAPR-constrained (P4) benchmarks are deferred to future work with standardized power models and waveform generators. Six open challenges emerge from the synthesis: the cross-paradigm benchmark deficit, real-world hardware-constrained deployment, joint waveform-RIS optimization for doubly-dispersive channels, multi-objective PAPR trade-offs, LLM safety in live network control, and diminishing returns of standalone heuristics. We specify requirements for a standardized benchmark. This study serves as a roadmap for researchers and practitioners working on joint OFDM-RIS optimization in 6G networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文综述了2021-2026年间78篇关于6G网络中联合OFDM波形设计与RIS配置的优化工作，将其分为四个范式：模型基凸松弛、启发式与元启发搜索、深度强化与无监督学习、以及包括基础模型、扩散生成式AI和量子优化的新兴方法。还提供了教程基准测试，揭示GPU神经网络推理的N不变性，并讨论跨范式基准缺陷、硬件约束部署等六个开放挑战。
Motivation: 联合OFDM-RIS优化是混合整数非线性规划问题，现有研究缺乏标准化基准，跨论文比较不可行，亟需系统分类与评估。
Method: 对78篇文献进行综述，将其方法分为四个范式；自建教程基准测试（N=16/64/128）比较不同方法的运行时缩放特性。
Result: ML方法（范式III）在自报基准中达到模型基谱效率的95-99%，推理时快10^2-10^4倍；GPU神经网络推理运行时与N无关，迭代求解器（如AO+SCA、PSO）呈多项式缩放。
Conclusion: 识别出六大开放挑战，包括跨范式基准缺陷、硬件约束部署、双弥散信道优化、多目标PAPR折衷、LLM安全性及启发式方法收益递减，并提出标准化基准需求。

papers.title: CryoACE: An Atom-centric Framework for Accurate and Automated Model Building in Cryo-EM
papers.abstract_en: Protein automodeling from cryo-EM density maps faces unique challenges in enforcing physicochemical validity and managing conformational heterogeneity. Current solvers are often limited to static predictions or require computationally intensive heuristic searches. We present CryoACE, an end-to-end framework that reconstructs precise atomic graphs for both homogeneous and heterogeneous structures. Our method features two key innovations: an atom-centric reconstruction paradigm, where density features are sampled directly at atomic coordinates and iteratively recycled to refine structures, replacing expensive voxel convolutions for efficient multimodal fusion; and a training-free guidance mechanism that leverages predicted local resolution priors to resolve dynamic ambiguity. Validated on a newly constructed high-quality dataset, CryoACE significantly outperforms existing baselines on static benchmarks and, for the first time, unveils atomic-level dynamic conformations on complex real-world datasets like EMPIAR-10345 without relying on pre-built static structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CryoACE是一个端到端框架，用于从冷冻电镜密度图重建精确的原子图，包括同质和异质结构。它采用原子中心重建范式，直接在原子坐标处采样密度特征并迭代循环优化，避免昂贵的体素卷积；还引入了无训练引导机制，利用预测的局部分辨率先验解决动态歧义。在新建的高质量数据集上，CryoACE显著优于现有基线，并首次揭示了复杂真实数据集（如EMPIAR-10345）中的原子级动态构象，无需依赖预建静态结构。
Motivation: 从冷冻电镜密度图自动建模蛋白质面临物理化学有效性验证和构象异质性管理的独特挑战。现有求解器通常局限于静态预测或需要计算密集的启发式搜索。
Method: 提出原子中心重建范式，直接在原子坐标处采样密度特征并迭代循环优化，替代昂贵的体素卷积以实现高效多模态融合；以及一种无需训练的引导机制，利用预测的局部分辨率先验来解决动态模糊性。
Result: 在新的高质量数据集上，CryoACE在静态基准上显著优于现有基线，并在复杂真实数据集（如EMPIAR-10345）上首次揭示原子级动态构象，无需依赖预构建的静态结构。
Conclusion: CryoACE为冷冻电镜蛋白质自动建模提供了一种准确且自动化的原子中心框架，能够处理同质和异质结构，并在动态构象解析方面取得突破。

papers.title: Expected Gain-based Escalation in Vertical Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative inference can improve predictive performance by integrating complementary information across agents, but applying collaborative fusion to every sample can incur unnecessary communication and computational overhead. This trade-off is particularly relevant in vertical federated learning (VFL), where clients observe different views of the same sample and fusion typically requires transmitting intermediate representations to a server. We study selective escalation in a two-round VFL inference protocol, in which a low-cost first round produces a prediction from client posteriors and a second embedding-fusion round is invoked only when it is expected to improve the final decision. We formulate routing as expected-gain score estimation: a sample is escalated when a predicted improvement in correctness justifies the additional communication. The proposed analytical score combines a calibrated pooled posterior with classwise reliability estimates of the VFL model, both obtained from held-out calibration data, yielding an interpretable router that requires no separately trained routing network. Experiments on multi-view classification benchmarks, including controlled test--time view degradation settings, show that the proposed router improves the communication-accuracy trade-off over confidence-, learned-gain-, and deferral-based baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于期望增益（expected gain）的垂直联邦学习（VFL）推理协议，通过两轮机制选择性升级样本：低成本的初步预测基于客户后验，仅当预期能改善最终决策时才触发第二轮的嵌入融合。路由决策由解析公式计算，融合校准的池化后验与类别级可靠性估计，无需单独训练路由网络。多视图分类实验表明，该方法在通信-准确率权衡上优于置信度、学习增益和延迟基线。
Motivation: 垂直联邦学习中，对所有样本进行协作融合会引入不必要的通信和计算开销，尤其当某些样本的本地预测已足够可靠时。
Method: 提出两轮VFL推理协议：第一轮基于客户后验进行低成本预测；设计一种解析的期望增益得分，结合校准的池化后验和VFL模型的类别级可靠性估计，用于决定是否将样本升级到第二轮嵌入融合。
Result: 在多视图分类基准（包括受控的测试时视图退化设置）上，该路由器在通信-准确率权衡上优于基于置信度、学习增益和延迟的基线方法。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，基于期望增益的解析路由可以提升VFL中通信与准确率的平衡，且无需额外训练路由网络。

papers.title: 3D HAMSTER: Bridging Planning and Control in Hierarchical Vision Language Action Models through 3D Trajectory Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models decouple high-level planning from low-level control to improve generalization in robot manipulation. Recent work in this paradigm uses 2D end-effector trajectories predicted by a Vision-Language Model (VLM) as explicit guidance for a downstream policy. However, state-of-the-art low-level policies operate in 3D metric space on point clouds, and feeding them 2D guidance that lacks depth forces each waypoint to be assigned the depth of whatever scene surface lies beneath it, producing geometrically distorted trajectories. We propose 3D HAMSTER, a hierarchical framework that closes this gap by having the planner directly output metrically reliable 3D trajectories. We augment a VLM with a dedicated depth encoder and a dense depth reconstruction objective to predict 3D waypoint sequences, which are directly integrated into a pointcloudbased low-level policy. Across 3D trajectory prediction, simulation, and real-world manipulation, 3D HAMSTER consistently outperforms proprietary VLMs and 2D-guided baselines, with the largest gains under appearance-altering shifts and unseen language, spatial, and visual conditions. The project page is available at https://davian-robotics.github.io/3D_HAMSTER/.
papers.comment: Published in IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026. Code: https://github.com/DAVIAN-Robotics/3D_HAMSTER. Project page: https://davian-robotics.github.io/3D_HAMSTER/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出3D HAMSTER，一种层次化的视觉语言动作模型，通过让规划器直接输出度量可靠的3D轨迹来桥接规划和控制在3D空间中的差距。方法包括增强视觉语言模型（VLM）以深度编码器和密集深度重建目标，预测3D路点序列，并直接集成到基于点云的低层策略中。实验表明在3D轨迹预测、仿真和真实操作中优于专有VLM和基于2D引导的基线，尤其在外观变化和未见语言、空间、视觉条件下提升最大。
Motivation: 现有层次化VLA模型使用2D末端执行器轨迹作为低层策略的引导，但低层策略在3D度量空间操作，2D引导缺乏深度，导致几何扭曲的轨迹。
Method: 提出3D HAMSTER框架，规划器直接输出度量可靠的3D轨迹。增强VLM带有专用深度编码器和密集深度重建目标，预测3D路点序列，并直接集成到基于点云的低层策略中。
Result: 在3D轨迹预测、仿真和真实操作中，3D HAMSTER持续优于专有VLM和基于2D引导的基线，尤其在出现外观变化和未见语言、空间、视觉条件下提升最大。
Conclusion: 该框架通过将规划器输出3D轨迹，弥合了2D规划和3D控制之间的差距，提高了在多种条件下的泛化能力。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有层次化VLA模型使用2D末端执行器轨迹作为低层策略的引导，但低层策略在3D度量空间操作，2D引导缺乏深度，导致几何扭曲的轨迹。
summary_sections.method: 提出3D HAMSTER框架，规划器直接输出度量可靠的3D轨迹。增强VLM带有专用深度编码器和密集深度重建目标，预测3D路点序列，并直接集成到基于点云的低层策略中。

summary_sections.conclusion: 该框架通过将规划器输出3D轨迹，弥合了2D规划和3D控制之间的差距，提高了在多种条件下的泛化能力。

papers.title: Bridging Video Understanding and Generation in a Unified Framework
papers.abstract_en: Recently, unified image generation and understanding have been extensively explored. However, extending such unified modeling paradigms to the video domain remains largely underexplored. A central challenge is that video understanding favors compact, discriminative semantic representations, whereas video generation requires dense signals that preserve visual details and temporal coherence. Videos naturally capture both spatial semantics and temporal dynamics, making them a more suitable modality for unified multimodal modeling compared to static images. In this paper, we propose Vega, a unified framework that bridges video understanding and generation. Vega leverages a shared vocabulary to jointly model text and visual representations and employs a hybrid architecture combining autoregressive (AR) prediction with diffusion-based rendering. Specifically, the AR model focuses on predicting semantically meaningful visual tokens for keyframes, providing a structured representation that guides the diffusion module in rendering dense, high-resolution video frames. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Vega achieves strong performance on video generation benchmarks such as VBench and video understanding benchmarks like VideoMME.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Vega，一个统一的视频理解与生成框架。Vega通过共享词汇表联合建模文本和视觉表示，并采用自回归预测关键帧语义token与扩散渲染密集帧的混合架构。在VBench和VideoMME等基准上取得良好性能。
Motivation: 现有统一建模范式在视频领域探索不足，核心挑战在于视频理解需要紧凑语义表示而生成需要密集细节，视频自然具备空间语义与时间动态，更适合统一多模态建模。
Method: 提出Vega框架，采用共享词汇表联合建模文本与视觉表示，混合自回归（AR）与扩散架构：AR模型预测关键帧的语义视觉token，引导扩散模块生成高分辨率连贯视频帧。
Result: 在视频生成基准VBench和视频理解基准VideoMME上表现出强性能。
Conclusion: Vega展示了在视频领域统一理解与生成的可行性，混合架构有效结合了语义推理与细节渲染。

papers.title: HistoriQA-ThirdRepublic: Multi-Hop Question Answering Corpus for Historical Research, Parliamentary Debates from the French Third Republic (1870-1940)
papers.abstract_en: We present HistoriQA-ThirdRepublic: a French-language dataset of multi-hop historical questions derived from parliamentary debates and newspapers of the French Third Republic. Designed in collaboration with a historian, the corpus captures complex reasoning patterns typical of historical inquiry, including cross-source synthesis, temporal reasoning, and the integration of sparse evidence. The dataset is made of 1782 questions and emphasizes multi-hop connections across heterogeneous historical documents, providing a resource for evaluating retrieval-augmented and large language model systems in domain-specific contexts. We describe the methodology for constructing the corpus, including the selection and alignment of sources, question validation, and metadata integration. While the dataset focuses on French historical documents, our methodology can be readily adapted to other languages and national corpora. Finally, we demonstrate how the corpus can support realistic evaluation scenarios for multi-hop question answering, bridging the gap between NLP benchmarks and the needs of historical scholarship.
papers.journal_ref: LREC 2026: Language Resources and Evaluation Conference, ELRA Language Resources Association, May 2026, Palma de Mallorca, Spain

TL;DR: HistoriQA-ThirdRepublic 是一个法文多跳历史问答数据集，包含1782个问题，源自法国第三共和国的议会辩论和报纸。与历史学家合作设计，强调跨来源综合、时间推理和稀疏证据整合，用于评估检索增强和大型语言模型在特定领域的能力。

Result: 数据集包含1782个多跳问题，覆盖典型的历史推理模式。
Conclusion: 该数据集可支持多跳问答的现实评估场景，且构建方法可迁移至其他语言和国家语料库。

papers.title: Accelerated Likelihood Maximization for Diffusion-based Versatile Content Generation
papers.abstract_en: Generating diverse, coherent, and plausible content from partially given inputs remains a fundamental challenge for diffusion models. Existing approaches face clear limitations: training-based approaches offer strong task-specific results but require costly computation, and they generalize poorly across tasks. Training-free approaches offer better efficiency, but they do not explicitly optimize over unobserved variables, leading to globally inconsistent results. To address these limitations, we introduce Accelerated Likelihood Maximization (ALM), a novel training-free sampling strategy integrated into the reverse diffusion process that significantly extends the applicability of diffusion models beyond simple generation tasks. Unlike previous methods that implicitly influence missing regions through pre-generated region constraints, we directly optimize the unobserved region during the sampling process, enabling globally coherent and plausible generation. Furthermore, we incorporate an acceleration strategy that significantly improves computational efficiency without sacrificing performance. Experimental results demonstrate that ALM consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in various data domains and tasks, establishing a powerful paradigm for versatile content generation.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无训练的加速似然最大化（ALM）采样策略，直接优化扩散模型反向过程中的未观测区域，实现全局一致的内容生成，并在多个任务上超越现有方法。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在部分给定输入生成多样内容时，训练方法计算成本高且通用性差，无训练方法则隐式影响缺失区域导致全局不一致。
Method: 提出ALM，在反向扩散过程中直接优化未观测区域的似然，并引入加速策略提升计算效率。
Result: 实验表明ALM在多个数据域和任务上一致优于当前最优方法。
Conclusion: ALM为通用内容生成建立了有效范式。

papers.title: Safe Online Learning via Smooth Safety-Structured Policy Composition
papers.abstract_en: Safe online reinforcement learning requires policies to respect safety constraints while maintaining smooth optimization dynamics. Existing approaches typically rely on either strict safety enforcement via action interventions, which introduce discontinuities in system interaction and learning, or soft safety constraint formulations, which preserve smooth learning but provide limited safety assurance. We propose AutoSafe, a safety-aware policy architecture that integrates structured safety monitoring and intervention directly into the action generation process. This design enables smooth, risk-dependent transitions between performance-driven and safety-preserving behaviors, resulting in continuous online interaction and learning dynamics. Empirical results across a suite of continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate strong safety enforcement without sacrificing learning smoothness. We further validate AutoSafe on a physical cart-pole system, highlighting its practical effectiveness for safe online learning in the real world.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AutoSafe，一种安全感知的策略架构，将结构化安全监控和干预直接集成到动作生成过程中，实现平滑的风险依赖转换。在连续控制基准和物理倒立摆系统上的实验表明，该方法在保持学习平滑性的同时实现了强安全保证。
Motivation: 现有安全在线强化学习方法要么通过动作干预强制执行安全但导致系统不连续，要么采用软约束保持学习平滑但安全保障有限。
Method: 提出 AutoSafe 架构，通过将安全监控和干预嵌入动作生成过程，实现性能驱动与安全保持行为之间的平滑、风险依赖转换，从而保持连续的在线交互和学习动态。
Result: 在连续控制基准上表现出强大的安全执行且不牺牲学习平滑性，并在物理倒立摆系统上验证了实际世界中的有效性。
Conclusion: 该设计能够实现连续的在线交互和学习动态，适用于实际世界中的安全在线学习。

papers.title: Wavelet-Optimized Pseudo-3D Accelerated Diffusion Model for Truncated Computed Laminography
papers.abstract_en: Computed Laminography (CL) is a key technology for the nondestructive testing of large plate-shaped objects. However, field-of-view (FOV) limitations inevitably lead to truncation of projected data, an ill-posed inverse problem that causes severe reconstruction artifacts. Existing deep learning methods typically rely on 2D architectures that lack rigorous data consistency constraints. Furthermore, they conventionally confine artifact removal strictly to the FOV, discarding potentially recoverable information outside it. To overcome these limitations, we first introduce a comprehensive CL FOV analysis, categorizing the space into data-complete, data-incomplete, and data-free regions. By extending our reconstruction target to encompass the data-incomplete region, we significantly expand the effective imaging range and enhance scanning efficiency. To achieve this, we propose a novel wavelet-optimized pseudo-3D accelerated diffusion model for CL truncation reconstruction (CL-DM). Our method utilizes a standard 2D diffusion model for slice aggregation, combined with a 3D model-based iterative reconstruction (MBIR) method to ensure strict data consistency. To mitigate inter-slice discontinuities, we introduce wavelet regularization along the z-direction, paired with a translation-invariant (TI) mechanism and a low-frequency preservation strategy. Finally, we introduce a 3D fast sampling architecture, significantly accelerating inference speed. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that CL-DM is superior in effectively eliminating truncation artifacts and restoring high-fidelity, continuous 3D structures.

TL;DR: 本文针对计算层析成像（CL）中视场限制导致投影数据截断的逆问题，提出小波优化伪3D加速扩散模型（CL-DM）。通过将重建目标扩展至数据不完全区域，扩大了有效成像范围。方法结合2D扩散模型和3D基于模型迭代重建（MBIR），并引入小波正则化、平移不变机制和低频保持策略，以及3D快速采样架构。仿真和实际实验表明CL-DM在消除截断伪影和恢复高保真连续3D结构上表现优越。
Motivation: 现有CL中视场限制导致投影截断，造成严重重建伪影；现有深度学习方法缺少数据一致性约束，且仅关注FOV内伪影去除，忽略了FOV外可恢复信息。
Method: 提出小波优化伪3D加速扩散模型（CL-DM）：使用2D扩散模型进行切片聚合，结合3D MBIR确保数据一致性；沿z方向引入小波正则化、平移不变机制和低频保持策略；采用3D快速采样架构加速推理。
Result: 仿真和实际实验表明CL-DM能有效消除截断伪影，恢复高保真连续3D结构。
Conclusion: 摘要强调CL-DM通过扩展重建目标和结合扩散模型与MBIR，在CL截断重建中取得优越性能。

papers.title: From Idea to Prototype in an Afternoon: Scaffolded, AI-Assisted Rapid VA Prototyping
papers.abstract_en: Testing a new visual-analytics idea usually takes months: one needs to find a realistic data set, clean it, and implement an interactive prototype. We describe a case where a workflow language and an AI assistant reduced this effort to one afternoon. The idea under test: relax the Pareto frontier with a tolerance and group the surviving options into recurring types -- ``constellations'' on a ``soft sky''. Using the Artifact--Transform Workflow Language (ATWL) as a scaffold, we obtained a consistent workflow in minutes and a running prototype in a few hours. We derive three lessons. The scaffold matters: without ATWL the assistant produced a naive workflow. The scaffold alone is not enough: the first implementation was only average, and expert knowledge injection was needed to reach state-of-the-art quality. Finally, the way the scaffold is used matters: controlled experiments show that a language definition and a library of examples support different aspects of the task, that providing both at once reduces quality because template following displaces creative content, and that scaffolds work best when introduced after an initial unconstrained design pass. We argue that the field needs a typology of human knowledge injection, in a form that is both human-editable and machine-accessible.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出结合工作流语言（ATWL）与AI助手进行快速视觉分析原型开发的方法，将传统数月的开发周期缩短至数小时。通过引入“软化Pareto前沿”案例，展示了脚手架（scaffold）和专家知识注入在原型质量中的关键作用。受控实验表明，脚手架的使用方式（如先自由设计再引入）显著影响最终质量。
Motivation: 现有视觉分析原型开发周期过长（数月），难以快速验证新想法。需要一种方法将时间压缩到几小时，同时保证原型质量。
Method: 采用Artifact-Transform Workflow Language (ATWL)作为结构化脚手架，结合AI助手自动生成工作流与原型。通过实验对比不同脚手架提供策略（单独语言定义、单独示例库、两者同时提供、先自由设计再引入脚手架），评估对原型质量的影响。
Result: 在案例中，方法在数小时内生成可运行原型。实验发现同时提供语言定义和示例库会降低质量（模板跟随抑制创意），而先自由设计再引入脚手架策略达到最优质量。
Conclusion: 强调需要建立人类知识注入的类型学，使其同时可被人类编辑和机器访问；脚手架的设计与使用顺序对AI辅助原型开发至关重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CSO-LLM: Class Subspace Orthogonalization for Post-Training Backdoor Detection and Trigger Inversion in LLMs
papers.abstract_en: While post-training backdoor detection and trigger inversion schemes have been developed for AIs used e.g. for images, there is a paucity of such methods for LLMs. First, the LLM input space is discrete, with up to 150,000^k k-tuples to consider with k the token-length of a putative trigger. Second, one must blacklist tokens typical of the putative target response (class) of an attack, as such tokens may give false detection signals. However, a comprehensive blacklist is not available, in general, for a given domain. We develop a highly effective detection and inversion framework for LLMs treated as classifiers. Central to our approach is class subspace orthogonalization (CSO), a novel plug-and-play paradigm for backdoor detection that serves two fundamental roles when applied to LLMs: i) it enhances both sensitivity and specificity of a baseline detector; ii) it provides a form of implicit blacklisting, as it penalizes against inclusion, in a candidate trigger, of tokens that induce signal perturbations "in the direction of" the putative target class of an attack. One version of our detector performs continuous optimization in token embedding space, while a companion trigger-inversion and detection method performs greedy accretion in discrete token space. Our methods give both strong detection performance and accurate inversion of ground-truth triggers on several LLM classification domains, and for several different LLM architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型（LLM）的后门检测与触发反转问题，提出了一种基于类子空间正交化（CSO）的检测框架。该方法结合连续优化与离散贪婪搜索，有效提升了检测的敏感性和特异性，并在多个LLM分类任务中准确反转真实触发器。
Motivation: 现有的后门检测和触发反转方法主要针对图像等连续输入空间，而LLM的离散输入空间巨大（可达150,000^k）且缺乏全面的黑名单，导致检测困难。本文旨在填补LLM后门检测的空白。
Method: 提出类子空间正交化（CSO）范式，作为即插即用的检测增强模块。一个版本在token嵌入空间进行连续优化，另一个版本在离散token空间进行贪婪累加触发反转与检测。
Result: 在多个LLM分类领域和不同架构上，该方法表现出强检测性能，并能准确反转真实触发器。
Conclusion: CSO方法有效提升了LLM后门检测的灵敏度与特异性，且通过隐式黑名单机制降低了误检。

papers.title: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Floating-Point Error Classification
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the capability of Large Language Models (LLMs) to detect and classify floating-point errors statically in software code. We introduce InterFLOPBench, a benchmark of 90 C kernels with 1 130 test samples designed to evaluate LLMs across six categories of floating-point error: cancellation, comparison, division by zero, overflow, underflow and NaN, compared across 14 LLMs. The evaluation framework treats floating-point error detection as a multi-label classification problem and employs the F1-score metric to measure performance. Results demonstrate that latest models (Qwen 3 32b, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Phi 4 Reasoning, DeepSeek R1T2, and gpt-oss 20b and 120b) achieve a performance greater than 0.88 overall F1-score. Performance varies between error categories, between explicit operations such as division by zero (Average F1-score: 0.8479) and more subtle numerical phenomena such as underflow (Average F1-score: 0.6059) and cancellation (Average F1-score: 0.6164).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了大语言模型（LLM）在静态检测和分类代码中浮点误差的能力。作者构建了InterFLOPBench基准，包含90个C内核和1130个测试样本，覆盖六类浮点误差（抵消、比较、除零、溢出、下溢、NaN），并在14个LLM上测试。结果表明，最新模型（如Qwen 3 32b、Gemini 2.5 Flash等）的总体F1分数超过0.88，但不同错误类别表现差异显著，显式操作（如除零）平均F1为0.8479，而微妙数值现象（如下溢和抵消）分别仅为0.6059和0.6164。
Motivation: 现有LLM在软件工程任务中表现突出，但针对浮点误差这类数值问题的系统评估尚属空白，需要构建专门基准来量化LLM在此类细粒度数值异常上的检测与分类能力。
Method: 提出InterFLOPBench基准，将浮点误差检测建模为多标签分类问题，采用F1分数作为评估指标，在14个不同规模和来源的LLM上比较跨六类误差的性能。
Result: 最新模型（Qwen 3 32b、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Phi 4 Reasoning、DeepSeek R1T2、gpt-oss 20b和120b）总体F1超过0.88；误差类别间性能差异大，除零平均F1最高（0.8479），下溢（0.6059）和抵消（0.6164）最低。
Conclusion: LLM能够有效检测和分类浮点误差，但面对抵消和下溢等复杂数值现象时准确性仍有提升空间，提示需进一步优化模型对细微数值行为的理解。

papers.title: Minimizing Quantized Semantic Age of Information (QSAoI) in Foundation Model-Based Semantic Communications
papers.abstract_en: The emerging techniques of semantic communications and edge computing in 6G networks necessitate a paradigm shift toward co-designed semantic-aware and adaptive resource allocation for short-packet transmissions. However, there is a fundamental gap between the semantic layer and the physical layer under low-latency finite blocklength (FBL) effects. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Quantized Semantic Age of Information (QSAoI), a novel metric that rigorously captures the trade-offs among freshness and semantic efficiency of high-level features in real-time communication in the FBL regime. Guided by this metric, we propose a novel foundation model-based efficient co-designed framework to minimize the expected QSAoI over wireless fading channels in latency-constrained semantic communication. Specifically, we formulate a non-linear joint optimization problem to dynamically optimize the block-wise mixed-precision quantization (MPQ) strategy and the physical blocklength. To efficiently resolve this complex problem, we develop a high-efficiency low-complexity algorithm based on fixpoint inspection and bisection search. Extensive simulations validate that our proposed algorithm dynamically adapts the semantic quantization precision to varying channel conditions, effectively minimizing the expected QSAoI compared to baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对6G网络中低延迟有限块长（FBL）效应下语义层与物理层的差距，提出量化语义信息年龄（QSAoI）指标，并设计基于基础模型的联合优化框架，动态调整混合精度量化（MPQ）策略和物理块长，以最小化期望QSAoI。仿真表明所提算法能根据信道条件自适应调整语义量化精度。
Motivation: 现有语义通信在低延迟有限块长条件下缺乏同时刻画新鲜度和语义效率的指标，且语义层与物理层存在脱节。
Method: 引入量化语义信息年龄（QSAoI）作为新度量，提出基于基础模型的共设计框架，将块级混合精度量化（MPQ）和物理块长的联合优化建模为非线型问题，并开发基于定点检查和二分搜索的低复杂度算法。
Result: 仿真验证所提算法能动态调整语义量化精度以适应信道变化，相比基线有效降低期望QSAoI。
Conclusion: 该指标和框架填补了语义通信中有限块长条件下的度量空白，为语义感知资源分配提供了新工具。

papers.title: Deep Spectral Models for Robust Dental Shape Generation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate modeling of dental crown morphology is fundamental for diagnosis, orthodontic planning, and computer-aided restoration design. However, datasets suitable for training such models are typically limited in size. We present ToothForge, a deep spectral generative framework that models dental crown geometries from compact, intrinsic representations. By operating in the spectral domain, ToothForge learns a latent manifold of 3D tooth shapes through synchronized spectral embeddings, ensuring consistent modeling across samples with varying connectivity. Spectral synchronization mitigates the instability of Laplace-Beltrami eigenbases and enables efficient learning in a low-dimensional space. The framework is thoroughly evaluated through robustness analysis, ablation studies, and benchmarking against PCA-based statistical shape models and point-based generative frameworks. Results show that synchronized spectral modeling achieves reconstruction and generative performance comparable to or exceeding spatial approaches, while maintaining compactness and geometric interpretability. Together, the compact synchronized coefficients and low-dimensional learning space make the framework particularly suitable for limited datasets, as often encountered in dental and medical domains, and applicable in real-world scenarios where guaranteeing consistent connectivity across shapes from various clinics is unrealistic.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:016
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ToothForge，一种基于深度光谱的牙齿冠部几何生成框架。该框架利用同步谱嵌入在低维空间中学习 3D 牙齿形状的潜在流形，克服了拉普拉斯-贝尔特拉米特征基的不稳定性，并在有限数据集上实现了与空间方法相当或更优的重建与生成性能。
Motivation: 牙科数据集通常规模有限，而现有形状生成方法往往需要大量数据或依赖拓扑一致的网格，限制了实际应用。
Method: ToothForge 在谱域中通过同步谱嵌入学习牙齿形状的紧凑内在表示，利用谱同步缓解特征基的不稳定性，实现低维空间中的高效学习。
Result: 在鲁棒性分析、消融实验和与 PCA 统计形状模型及基于点的生成框架的对比中，同步谱建模达到了与空间方法相当或更优的重建与生成性能，同时保持紧凑性和几何可解释性。
Conclusion: 该框架适用于牙科和医学领域常见的小样本数据集，且不要求不同来源的几何形状具有一致的拓扑连接，具有良好的实际应用前景。
