papers.title: Distilling Temporal Coherence into 2D Networks for Transrectal Ultrasound Prostate Video Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Real-time video segmentation of the prostate in Transrectal Ultrasound (TRUS) is essential for image-guided interventions. While conventional 2D methods suffer from inter-frame inconsistencies by disregarding temporal context, 3D architectures incur prohibitive latency. To resolve this dilemma, we present a Temporally Consistent Learning Framework that distills temporal coherence into a 2D network during training, preserving single-frame inference efficiency. Our design is driven by a key clinical observation: the prostate exhibits geometric stability, whereas the surrounding acoustic environment fluctuates due to physiological motion and transducer pressure. Because conventional temporal constraints propagate erroneous gradients from these unstable regions, we introduce a Confidence-Weighted Temporal Consistency objective derived from optical flow warping residuals, selectively attenuating contributions from unreliable regions. Complementing this pixel-wise constraint, a Dual-scale Prototype Alignment Module enforces semantic coherence through contrastive optimization of local boundary and global semantic features. Furthermore, to eliminate the need for dense per-frame video annotations, we employ geometric equivariance-based pseudo-labeling with knowledge distillation from a pretrained teacher. Extensive experiments on SUN-SEG and our newly introduced TRUS-V benchmark (2,679 frames) demonstrate state-of-the-art accuracy and temporal consistency at real-time speed. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/DYDevelop/DTC-TRUS.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the 29th International Conference on Medical Image Computing and Computer-Assisted Intervention (MICCAI 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种时域一致性学习框架，通过知识蒸馏将时间连贯性注入2D网络，用于经直肠超声前列腺视频分割，在保持单帧推理实时性的同时提升分割的时间一致性。核心创新包括置信度加权的时间一致性损失（基于光流残差）和双尺度原型对齐模块（对比学习局部边界与全局语义特征），并使用几何等变伪标签避免密集标注。在SUN-SEG和新提出的TRUS-V基准上达到实时最先进精度和时间一致性。
Motivation: 经直肠超声前列腺视频分割需要实时性，但2D方法忽略时序导致帧间不一致，3D方法延迟过高。现有时间约束在超声图像中因前列腺周围声学环境不稳定而传播错误梯度。
Method: 提出时间一致性学习框架：1) 基于光流残差的置信度加权时间一致性损失，选择性抑制不可靠区域贡献；2) 双尺度原型对齐模块，通过对比学习对齐局部边界和全局语义特征；3) 利用几何等变伪标签和知识蒸馏从教师网络生成伪标签，避免逐帧标注。
Result: 在SUN-SEG和包含2679帧的TRUS-V基准上，该方法在实时速度下达到最先进的准确性和时间一致性。
Conclusion: 通过蒸馏时域一致性到2D网络，有效平衡了实时推理与分割时间稳定性，临床可行。

papers.title: ISM:Self-Improving Strategy Memory for Continual Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: We propose Intelligent Schema Memory (ISM), a self-evolving memory-augmented system that improves mathematical reasoning for a frozen LLM under continual learning with hard episodic resets. ISM maintains a compact, self-refined bank of strategy schemas learned from both successful and failed episodes, with symbolic tools that check intermediate steps and certify answers.Without updating model parameters, ISM outperforms passive, retrieval, and reflection baselines on MATH-Hard and OlympiadBench, using 64% and 86% fewer schemas respectively than the strongest passive baseline. These results show that small, actively maintained, and verified strategy memories can support reliable continual mathematical reasoning under strict episodic isolation.
papers.comment: 3rd AI for Math Workshop at ICML 2026 Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出智能模式记忆（ISM），一种自演进的记忆增强系统，使冻结的LLM在严格情节重置的持续学习下改进数学推理。ISM维护一个紧凑且自我精炼的策略模式库，从成功和失败的情节中学习，并利用符号工具检查中间步骤和验证答案。在不更新模型参数的情况下，ISM在MATH-Hard和OlympiadBench上优于被动、检索和反思基线，分别比最强被动基线少用64%和86%的模式。这些结果表明，在严格情节隔离下，小型、主动维护且经过验证的策略记忆可以支持可靠的持续数学推理。
Motivation: 现有持续学习方法在处理数学推理时，难以在严格的情节重置下保持性能，且被动记忆或检索方法效率低下。
Method: ISM维护一个自改进的策略模式库，从成功和失败情节中学习，结合符号工具进行中间步骤检查和答案验证，不更新模型参数。
Result: ISM在MATH-Hard和OlympiadBench上优于基线，且使用的模式数量分别比最强被动基线少64%和86%。
Conclusion: 小型、主动维护且经过验证的策略记忆能够在严格情节隔离下实现可靠的持续数学推理。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出智能模式记忆（ISM），一种自演进的记忆增强系统，使冻结的LLM在严格情节重置的持续学习下改进数学推理。ISM维护一个紧凑且自我精炼的策略模式库，从成功和失败的情节中学习，并利用符号工具检查中间步骤和验证答案。在不更新模型参数的情况下，ISM在MATH-Hard和OlympiadBench上优于被动、检索和反思基线，分别比最强被动基线少用64%和86%的模式。这些结果表明，在严格情节隔离下，小型、主动维护且经过验证的策略记忆可以支持可靠的持续数学推理。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有持续学习方法在处理数学推理时，难以在严格的情节重置下保持性能，且被动记忆或检索方法效率低下。
summary_sections.method: ISM维护一个自改进的策略模式库，从成功和失败情节中学习，结合符号工具进行中间步骤检查和答案验证，不更新模型参数。
summary_sections.result: ISM在MATH-Hard和OlympiadBench上优于基线，且使用的模式数量分别比最强被动基线少64%和86%。
summary_sections.conclusion: 小型、主动维护且经过验证的策略记忆能够在严格情节隔离下实现可靠的持续数学推理。

papers.title: Learning to Deny: Action Denial in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have rapidly advanced video understanding, achieving strong zero-shot and few-shot recognition across standard benchmarks. Yet their ability to deny an action by recognizing when an activity is not happening despite strong contextual cues remains largely unexplored. We introduce UCF101-AD, a large-scale benchmark consisting of paired Action-Presence and Action-Denial clips, designed to evaluate this capacity for denial. Each negative video in UCF101-AD preserves the same contextual and motion cues, including persons, objects, and locations, as its positive counterpart, but the defining action itself is explicitly absent. Evaluating 20 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveals a consistent failure: models that exceed 85% accuracy on the positive action classes collapse below 50% on their action-denial counterparts, indicating a strong inclination to affirm plausible actions rather than verify that they truly occur. This exposes a critical blind spot in modern video understanding: the inability to reason causally about whether a motion actually happens. To probe this issue, we explore a causal graph formulation, CausalAct, which expresses scene structure through natural-language prompts linking context, interaction, and motion. Incorporating such causal cues substantially reduces false positives, demonstrating that denial is a learnable reasoning skill. UCF101-AD provides a new lens for diagnosing and improving causal reasoning in multimodal models. Dataset and relevant code: https://github.com/raiyaan-abdullah/Learn-to-Deny.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视频理解中缺乏“动作否认”能力的问题，构建了UCF101-AD基准数据集，其中负样本保留与正样本相同的场景和运动线索但缺失关键动作。评估20个SOTA MLLMs发现，它们在动作否认任务上准确率低于50%，而正样本准确率超过85%。作者提出CausalAct因果图框架，通过自然语言提示引入因果推理，显著减少误报，表明否认是可学习的推理技能。
Motivation: 现有MLLMs在视频理解中只能识别动作存在，但缺乏判断动作是否实际发生的能力，即使有强烈上下文线索也会误认为动作发生，存在因果推理盲点。
Method: 构建UCF101-AD基准，包含成对的动作存在/否认视频片段；提出CausalAct因果图，用自然语言提示将场景结构表示为上下文、交互和运动之间的因果关系，用于引导模型推理。
Result: 评估20个SOTA MLLMs，在动作否认任务上准确率低于50%（正样本>85%）；引入CausalAct后，误报大幅减少。
Conclusion: 动作否认是可学习的推理技能，因果推理是改善MLLMs视频理解的关键；UCF101-AD为诊断和提升因果推理提供新视角。

papers.title: Gated Multi-Graph Fusion via Graph Attention Networks for Alzheimer's Disease Detection
papers.abstract_en: Spontaneous speech is a vital non-invasive biomarker for Alzheimer's Disease (AD), yet many systems overlook non-linear structural disruptions and clinical heterogeneity in pathological language. We propose a Multi-View Gated Graph Attention Network that transcribes audio via Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) to construct semantic, dependency, and co-occurrence graphs, characterizing speech through a "content-structure-flow" framework. Notably, the co-occurrence graph leverages Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) from a normative corpus to quantify narrative logic and linguistic deviation. To address symptomatic diversity, an adaptive gated fusion mechanism dynamically integrates these views. Evaluated on the ADReSSo dataset, our model achieves 90.00% accuracy. Ablation results confirm that the PMI-based graph and heterogeneity-aware gating are essential for robust classification across diverse clinical populations. Our source code is publicly available at https://github.com/opeacc/AD.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, and accepted in interspeech 2026 conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多视图门控图注意力网络用于阿尔茨海默病检测。通过ASR转录自发语音，构建语义图、依存图和共现图，形成“内容-结构-流程”框架。共现图利用规范语料库的点互信息（PMI）量化叙事逻辑和语言偏差，自适应门控融合机制整合多视图。在ADReSSo数据集上达到90.00%准确率，消融实验证明PMI图和异质性门控对鲁棒分类至关重要。
Motivation: 现有AD检测系统多忽略病理语言中的非线性结构破坏和临床异质性，需要更全面的语音特征提取方法。
Method: 提出多视图门控图注意力网络：使用ASR转录语音，构建语义、依存和共现三种图，其中共现图基于规范语料库的PMI；通过自适应门控融合机制动态整合多视图特征。
Result: 在ADReSSo数据集上达到90.00%准确率，消融实验证实PMI图和异质性感知门控是关键组件。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法能有效利用自发语音中的结构性和异质性信息进行AD检测，且代码开源。

papers.title: Transformers as Bayesian In-Context Experimenters: Smoothness-Adaptive Efficient ATE Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive experiments for average treatment effects (ATE) require randomized allocations balancing valid inference with statistical efficiency. The oracle design is a covariate-dependent Neyman rule governed by unknown arm-conditional outcome variances. We investigate whether this sequential variance-estimation and allocation process can be amortized via in-context learning. We introduce Bayesian in-context experimenters: transformer policies trained to imitate a Bayesian posterior Neyman teacher. The teacher updates nonparametric beliefs over potential outcomes using experimental history to assign posterior Neyman treatment probabilities. This design converges to the oracle rule, supporting efficient ATE inference. Transformers constructively implement this mapping through attention-based sufficient statistics and projected gradient descent, imitating Bayesian updating for Gaussian-series priors. To address unknown outcome smoothness, we combine smoothness-indexed experimenters using a mixture-of-experts transformer. The gate acts as a hierarchical posterior over smoothness classes, concentrating on near-oracle experts. By bounding the complexity of the transformer class, we prove this amortized policy can be learned via empirical risk minimization using supervised pretraining. Experiments confirm accurate teacher imitation, adaptive allocation, and improved ATE precision over baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何通过Transformer实现贝叶斯上下文学习，以自适应地进行平均处理效应（ATE）估计。作者将实验设计视为一个序贯决策过程，用Transformer模仿贝叶斯后验Neyman教师策略，实现了平滑自适应的高效ATE估计。理论上证明了可以通过经验风险最小化学习该策略，实验验证了其准确性。
Motivation: 自适应ATE实验需要在有效推断和统计效率之间平衡，现有方法（如Neyman分配）依赖未知的方差函数，且需要逐个实验重新计算。本文尝试将这一序贯方差估计和分配过程通过上下文学习来摊销，实现可泛化的实验策略。
Method: 提出贝叶斯上下文实验者：训练一个Transformer策略来模仿贝叶斯后验Neyman教师，该教师利用实验历史更新非参数先验，并分配后验Neyman处理概率。Transformer通过注意力机制和投影梯度下降实现该映射。对未知结果平滑度，使用混合专家Transformer（MoE），门控机构作为平滑度类的分层后验，集中选择近最优专家。
Result: 实验表明Transformer能准确模仿教师策略，实现自适应分配，并在ATE估计精度上优于基线方法。理论证明了该摊销策略可通过监督预训练的经验风险最小化学习得到。
Conclusion: 本文展示了Transformer可以作为贝叶斯上下文实验者，在无需逐个实验重新拟合的情况下高效进行ATE估计，并自然适应未知结果平滑度。局限性可能在于需要预训练数据和任务分布假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AI-Assisted Discovery of Convex Relaxations via Dual Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent work shows that LLM agents can improve sharp-constant inequalities by searching for extremal constructions, which yield upper bounds. We address the complementary side: a lower bound holds for every admissible function and follows from a convex relaxation of the nonconvex problem, with tighter relaxations giving stronger bounds. We instantiate the autoresearch paradigm to discover such relaxations: a coding agent proposes valid tightening constraints, a theory agent verifies each one and searches for counterexamples, and every reported bound is certified by an explicit dual-feasible point checked in rigorous interval arithmetic. On two optimization constants studied by \citet{tao2025alphaevolve} - the first autocorrelation inequality ($C_{6.2}$) and the Erdős minimum-overlap constant ($C_{6.5}$) - we improve the certified lower bounds from $1.28$ to $1.2937$ and from $0.379005$ to $0.37912$, respectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用LLM智能体自动发现非凸优化问题的凸松弛，从而改进下界。编码智能体提出有效收紧约束，理论智能体验证并搜索反例，每个下界均由显式对偶可行点经严格区间算术验证。在自相关不等式（C_{6.2}）和Erdős最小重叠常数（C_{6.5}）上，将认证下界分别从1.28提升至1.2937、从0.379005提升至0.37912。
Motivation: 现有自动搜索方法主要针对上界，而下界由非凸问题的凸松弛得到，但自动发现更紧的凸松弛仍具挑战。
Method: 提出双智能体自动研究范式：编码智能体生成候选收紧约束，理论智能体验证约束有效性并搜索反例，最终下界由显式对偶可行点在区间算术下严格验证。
Result: 在两个优化常数上取得下界改进：自相关不等式下界从1.28提升至1.2937，Erdős最小重叠常数下界从0.379005提升至0.37912。
Conclusion: 该方法展示了LLM智能体可自动发现并认证非凸问题的凸松弛，显著改进已知优化常数的下界。

papers.title: HealthAgentBench: A Unified Benchmark Suite of Realistic Agentic Healthcare Environments for Challenging Frontier AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: As AI agents become increasingly capable of complex, long-horizon reasoning, rigorous and holistic evaluation is essential for measuring progress toward real-world healthcare applications. We introduce HealthAgentBench, a suite of 54 agentic healthcare tasks across 7 categories each with its unique environment. The benchmark suite spans diverse workflows throughout the patient journey and a broad range of modalities. Each task is designed to replicate an end-to-end clinical workflow: given minimal instructions, an agent must explore raw healthcare data, operate within a complex environment, and execute multi-step solutions that go beyond naive prompting. A final task success rate is reported to provide a single, interpretable metric for HealthAgentBench overall performance for each agent. Evaluating frontier agents on HealthAgentBench, we find that overall task success rate remains low, underscoring the difficulty of the suite. The strongest and the most cost effective agent, Codex GPT-5.5, achieves only approximately 42% success rate. Beyond aggregate performance, HealthAgentBench reveals nuanced strengths and weaknesses across task categories. Frontier agents show promise in automatically developing research modeling pipelines over EHR data, but medical imaging remains especially challenging, particularly for Claude Code models, while Codex GPT-5.5 shows emerging capability. Tasks that combine large search spaces with compositional reasoning requirements remain difficult for all current agents. Together, these results suggest that HealthAgentBench provides a challenging and realistic benchmark with substantial room for future progress. We release our benchmark at https://github.com/microsoft/HealthAgentBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HealthAgentBench 是一个包含54个医疗代理任务、覆盖7个类别的统一基准套件，每个任务模拟端到端临床工作流，要求代理在最小指令下探索原始医疗数据并执行多步解决方案。评估多个前沿AI代理后，整体任务成功率仍低，最强且最具成本效益的代理 Codex GPT-5.5 仅达到约42%的成功率，表明该基准具有挑战性且未来提升空间大。
Motivation: 随着AI代理在复杂长程推理方面能力增强，需要严格且整体的评估来衡量向实际医疗应用的进展。现有基准缺乏真实医疗环境的复杂性和多模态性，因此需要构建一个涵盖多样化临床工作流的统一基准套件。
Method: 构建了54个任务，涵盖7个类别，每个任务具有独立环境，模拟真实临床工作流。代理在给定最小化指令后，需探索原始医疗数据、操作复杂环境、执行多步解决方案，最终以任务成功率为单一可解释指标报告性能。
Result: 评估多个前沿代理，整体成功率低。最强代理 Codex GPT-5.5 仅约42%。代理在EHR数据建模流水线开发方面有潜力，但医学成像对Claude Code模型尤其困难，Codex GPT-5.5 展现出初步能力。涉及大搜索空间与组合推理的任务对所有当前代理仍具挑战。
Conclusion: HealthAgentBench 提供了具有挑战性和真实性的医疗代理基准，揭示了不同任务类别中前沿代理的优势与不足，并指出未来提升空间。基准已开源。

summary_sections.result: 评估多个前沿代理，整体成功率低。最强代理 Codex GPT-5.5 仅约42%。代理在EHR数据建模流水线开发方面有潜力，但医学成像对Claude Code模型尤其困难，Codex GPT-5.5 展现出初步能力。涉及大搜索空间与组合推理的任务对所有当前代理仍具挑战。
summary_sections.conclusion: HealthAgentBench 提供了具有挑战性和真实性的医疗代理基准，揭示了不同任务类别中前沿代理的优势与不足，并指出未来提升空间。基准已开源。

papers.title: AETDICE: Unified Framework and Offline Optimization for Nonlinear Multi-Objective RL
papers.abstract_en: Optimizing nonlinear preferences in multi-objective reinforcement learning (MORL) is essential for capturing complex trade-offs like risk aversion or fairness. However, such non-linearity has historically bifurcated nonlinear MORL objectives into two distinct paradigms: Scalarized Expected Return (SER) and Expected Scalarized Return (ESR). While SER requires global-level optimization and ESR requires non-Markovian policies, leading to fragmented optimization strategies, we bridge this divide through the Aggregation-Expectation-Transformation (AET) framework. By unifying both criteria through a tripartite decomposition of scalarization, AET provides a principled foundation for general nonlinear MORL. Building on this framework, we propose AETDICE, a tractable offline RL algorithm for AET objectives. By utilizing DICE-style density-ratio estimation in an augmented state space, AETDICE enables sample-based optimization from static datasets. Our framework resolves long-standing barriers and captures respective trade-offs induced by AET framework, which existing methods fail to address.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出聚合-期望-变换（AET）框架，统一了非线性多目标强化学习（MORL）中两种长期分裂的范式：标量化期望收益（SER）和期望标量化收益（ESR）。基于此框架，进一步提出AETDICE算法，利用DICE密度比估计在增广状态空间中实现离线优化，能够从静态数据集中学习非线性偏好策略。
Motivation: 非线性MORL中SER和ESR两种范式导致优化策略碎片化，缺乏统一的理论基础，且现有方法无法处理由AET框架产生的权衡。
Method: 提出AET框架，通过三部分分解统一两种非线性MORL目标；在此基础上开发AETDICE算法，采用DICE风格密度比估计在增广状态空间中进行离线优化。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称框架解决了长期存在的障碍，并能够捕获现有方法无法处理的由AET框架产生的权衡。
Conclusion: AET框架为一般非线性MORL提供了原则性基础，AETDICE算法实现了从静态数据集进行样本优化，弥合了两种范式之间的鸿沟。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GaussianMap: Learning Gaussian Representation for Multi-Sensor Online HD Map Construction
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous driving systems benefit from high-definition (HD) maps that provide critical information about road infrastructure. The online construction of HD maps offers a scalable approach to generate local vectorized maps from onboard sensor observations. Existing methods commonly adopt bird's-eye-view (BEV) features as the intermediate scene representation, encoding the surrounding space with fixed-resolution dense grids. However, map elements are spatially sparse yet require fine-grained geometric localization, making uniformly allocated BEV representations redundant and less effective for vectorized map prediction. In this work, we propose GaussianMap, an online HD map construction framework that learns an adaptive Gaussian representation of the surrounding scene. This representation consists of a set of Gaussian primitives on the BEV plane, each encoding a flexible local region with geometric properties and a feature vector, allowing the model to allocate representational capacity to map-relevant regions. To generate such a representation from sensor observations, we introduce a feed-forward Gaussian encoder that progressively refines these primitives through Gaussian interaction modeling and multi-sensor feature aggregation. The refined Gaussian representation is then splatted into a BEV feature map and decoded into vectorized map predictions. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and Argoverse 2 datasets demonstrate that GaussianMap achieves state-of-the-art performance in both camera-only and camera-LiDAR fusion settings. Our code will be made publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GaussianMap，一种在线高精地图（HD map）构建框架，学习自适应的高斯表示（Gaussian representation），替代传统固定分辨率的鸟瞰图（BEV）网格。该表示由一组高斯图元（Gaussian primitives）组成，每个图元编码几何属性与特征向量，并通过前馈高斯编码器逐步细化及多传感器特征聚合来生成。最终通过 splatting 生成 BEV 特征图并解码为向量化地图。在 nuScenes 和 Argoverse 2 数据集上，相机仅和相机-激光雷达融合设置下均达到 state-of-the-art 性能。
Motivation: 传统 BEV 特征使用固定分辨率密集网格编码周围空间，但地图元素稀疏且需要精细几何定位，均匀分配表示容量导致冗余且对向量化地图预测效果不佳。
Method: 提出高斯图元表示，每个图元在 BEV 平面上编码灵活局部区域的几何属性与特征向量；引入前馈高斯编码器，通过高斯交互建模和多传感器特征聚合逐步细化图元；细化后的高斯表示通过 splatting 生成 BEV 特征图并解码为向量化地图预测。
Result: 在 nuScenes 和 Argoverse 2 数据集上，GaussianMap 在相机仅和相机-激光雷达融合设置下均取得 state-of-the-art 性能。
Conclusion: 自适应高斯表示能有效分配表示能力到地图相关区域，提升在线 HD 地图构建性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ClawArena-Team: Benchmarking Subagent Orchestration and Dynamic Workflows in Language-Model Agents
papers.abstract_en: Production large language-model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed not as lone problem-solvers but as managers: a main model creates specialized subagents, delegates work, and orchestrates their parallel, asynchronous returns through dynamic workflows. Whether one model can actually run such a team is largely unmeasured: existing benchmarks score a policy's own task-solving or a fixed multi-agent system's emergent behavior, but none isolate the management ability of the single LLM acting as leader. We introduce ClawArena-Team, a benchmark of 41 multi-turn, multimodal, multi-directory scenarios spanning 258 evaluation rounds and 72 staged updates that measures this management ability. The main agent is deliberately constrained: it natively perceives only text and directly accesses only part of the workspace. It commands a fixed, locally served subagent pool, so score differences reflect management skill, not raw capability. All scoring is execution-based with no LLM judge: an overall score -- the Subagent-Management Score (SMS) -- multiplies task correctness by a least-privilege and modality-routing factor. Across twelve proprietary, community-hosted, and self-hosted models, experiments show that the management bottleneck is privilege granting rather than perception (no model exceeds 50% workspace-permission precision); that cost and management quality are decoupled (API cost spans over 100 times while the overall score spans under 4 times, with the cheapest open models on the Pareto frontier); and that most leaderboard scores cluster within a 9.9-point band while orchestration behaviors diverge by more than an order of magnitude. Code and data will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ClawArena-Team 是一个用于衡量大语言模型作为管理者的子代理编排与动态工作流能力的基准，包含41个多轮、多模态、多目录场景，共258轮评估和72个阶段性更新。实验表明管理瓶颈在于权限授予而非感知，成本与质量解耦，大多数模型得分集中于9.9分区间。
Motivation: 现有基准仅衡量模型自身任务解决能力或固定多智能体系统的涌现行为，未能独立评估单个LLM作为领导者的管理能力。
Method: 设计主模型仅能感知文本并直接访问部分工作空间，通过固定子代理池执行任务，以子代理管理得分（SMS）综合任务正确性与最小权限及模态路由因子。
Result: 12个模型实验显示：权限授予精度均低于50%；API成本差异超100倍而得分差异不足4倍，最便宜开源模型位于帕累托前沿；多数模型得分聚集在9.9分区间，但编排行为差异超一个数量级。
Conclusion: 该基准揭示了当前模型作为管理者的核心瓶颈在于权限授予，并指出成本与质量解耦，为未来多智能体系统设计提供参考。

papers.title: HSDF-Lane: Height-Aligned Signed Distance Field with Semantic Lane Prior for 3D Lane Detection
papers.abstract_en: Monocular 3D lane detection plays a critical role in autonomous driving, yet recovering reliable 3D geometry from a single image remains challenging due to inherent depth ambiguity. Prior methods project image features into Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) space under a flat-ground assumption, causing geometric distortion on real-world roads. Recent methods instead predict explicit height maps to capture non-planar surfaces, but still rely on sparse anchor-based regression and exploit the recovered geometry merely for spatial transformation rather than semantic understanding. To overcome these limitations, we propose HSDF-Lane, which implicitly models the road surface as a Height-aligned Signed Distance Field (HSDF) over a densely sampled 3D feature volume. Through differentiable rendering, the HSDF jointly produces an accurate height map and surface-aligned features. We further introduce Lane-aware Semantic Positional Encoding (LSPE), which injects a lane-existence prior derived from the surface-aligned features into the transformer queries, coupling geometric structure with semantic guidance. Extensive experiments on the OpenLane benchmark show that HSDF-Lane achieves state-of-the-art performance in both 3D lane detection and height map estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 HSDF-Lane，通过隐式建模道路表面为高度对齐的有符号距离场（HSDF），结合可微渲染生成精确的高度图和表面对齐特征，并引入车道感知语义位置编码（LSPE）将车道存在先验注入Transformer查询，实现几何与语义的联合优化。在OpenLane基准上，该方法在3D车道检测和高度图估计均达最优。
Motivation: 现有单目3D车道检测方法依赖平面假设或锚点回归，导致几何失真且未充分利用几何信息进行语义理解。
Method: 提出HSDF（高度对齐的有符号距离场）隐式建模道路表面，通过可微渲染联合生成高度图和表面对齐特征；同时引入LSPE（车道感知语义位置编码），利用表面特征中的车道存在先验增强Transformer查询。
Result: 在OpenLane基准上，3D车道检测和高度图估计均达到最先进水平。
Conclusion: 该工作表明结合隐式几何表示与语义先验可有效提升单目3D车道检测性能。

papers.title: Cross-Domain Feature Expansion for Tabular Medical Data via Knowledge Graphs Injection
papers.abstract_en: Acquiring comprehensive cross-domain biomedical profiles is often costly and time-consuming, resulting in severe data scarcity in medical research. To address this challenge, we propose MedKGTab, a knowledge-injected framework specifically engineered for cross-domain feature expansion in tabular medical data. MedKGTab seeks to infer uncollected biomedical features from available ones by exploiting their inherent statistical dependencies and established medical correlations. By employing a row-column dual-attention mechanism, MedKGTab operates directly on raw structured tabular data, inherently capturing exact numerical distributions without the structural loss caused by tokenization. Crucially, MedKGTab integrates data-driven statistical priors with the SPOKE biomedical knowledge graph, achieving an optimal synergy between the data and knowledge channels. Within this synergy, the representations derived from the data channel are modulated by the injected biomedical knowledge, ensuring the final generated data are grounded in empirical medical research. Experimental results demonstrate that MedKGTab achieves high data fidelity and realistic data representation in cross-domain feature expansion. It outperforms both SOTA medical large models (e.g., Baichuan M3-plus) and specialized tabular models designed for medical data generation. Furthermore, MedKGTab consistently delivers superior performance across various data generation scenarios, whether inferring missing features within the same dataset or generalizing across different medical cohorts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedKGTab，一种通过知识图谱注入实现表格医疗数据跨域特征扩展的框架。该框架采用行-列双注意机制直接处理原始结构化表格数据，并结合 SPOKE 生物医学知识图谱与数据驱动的统计先验，生成基于经验医学研究的特征。实验表明，MedKGTab 在数据保真度和现实性上优于现有医疗大模型和专用表格生成模型。
Motivation: 获取全面的跨域生物医学数据成本高且耗时，导致医疗研究中的数据稀缺问题。
Method: 提出 MedKGTab 框架，使用行-列双注意机制 (row-column dual-attention) 处理原始表格数据，并融合数据驱动的统计先验与 SPOKE 生物医学知识图谱，通过知识注入调控数据通道的表示。
Result: 在跨域特征扩展任务中，MedKGTab 实现了高数据保真度，优于 SOTA 医疗大模型（如 Baichuan M3-plus）和专用表格医疗数据生成模型，并在同一数据集内缺失特征推断及不同医疗队列泛化场景中均表现优越。
Conclusion: MedKGTab 通过数据与知识通道的协同，能够从已有特征推断未采集的生物医学特征，生成结果基于经验医学研究，且在不同生成场景下保持优越性能。

papers.title: Beyond Single Character: Evaluating MLLMs for Sentence-Level Oracle Bone Inscription Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Existing AI-assisted oracle bone inscription (OBI) visual recognition and understanding studies mainly focus on character-level, ignoring the long-form textual coherence and contextual dependencies embedded in complete divination charges. Recently, the powerful visual perception capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have opened new possibilities for OBI information processing. In this work, we introduce S-OBI, a novel benchmark for evaluating MLLMs in Sentence-level OBI understanding. Instead of using noisy and incomplete rubbings as the visual input, S-OBI synthesizes clear and standardized sentence-level OBI instances through glyph substitution and composition. According to 95 original rubbings with translations that have been identified, corrected, and verified by experts, we replace characters in the original rubbings with corresponding clean glyph samples sourced from existing OBI datasets while preserving the overall inscriptional structure and semantic organization. This mitigates the influence of low-level distortions and enables a more focused evaluation of sentence-level OBI understanding. Based on this, we design semantic matching, semantic slot extraction, and contextual reasoning tasks and obtain 695 question-answer pairs. Experiments reveal the inferiority of contemporary MLLMs on sentence-level OBI understanding. In particular, visual perception errors in unmasked regions propagate through the reasoning chain, leading to erroneous predictions for masked characters, which indicates that sentence-level OBI understanding in current models remains strongly dependent on character-level recognition. Overall, S-OBI provides a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating whether MLLMs can move beyond isolated character recognition toward structured inscription-level understanding.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 现有AI辅助甲骨文识别研究集中在单字符级，缺乏对完整占卜辞中长程文本连贯性和上下文依赖的评估，而多模态大语言模型为高级理解提供了可能。
Method: 构建S-OBI基准：依据95片经专家校验的拓片及其译文，通过字形替换与组合将原始拓片中的字符替换为对应干净字形样本，保持整体铭文结构和语义组织，获得695个问答对，覆盖语义匹配、语义槽抽取和上下文推理任务。
Result: 实验发现当代MLLMs在句子级OBI理解上表现劣于单字符任务；未遮挡区域的视觉感知错误会沿着推理链蔓延，导致对遮挡字符的预测错误，表明句子级理解仍强烈依赖于字符级识别。

papers.title: Probe Choice Changes Canary-Memorization Verdicts: Three Post-Hoc Disagreement Case Studies in a Text-Dominant LoRA-Tuned Autoregressive Testbed
papers.abstract_en: We audit a fixed prefix-window mean-NLL memorization probe (K=20) on a Qwen2.5-VL-7B canary testbed and report three post-hoc cases where it disagrees with full-span secret NLL or greedy exact-recall. C3 (false negative, window truncation): damage lands on hex tokens outside K=20; the probe stays flat while hit@1 drops. C4 (false positive, non-secret drift): the probe moves, but approximately 99% sits on non-secret preamble; the secret span and hit@1 are unchanged. C5 (ambiguous in-window drop): the probe falls on an undertrained baseline while full-span hex is positive and hit@1=0. Recommendation: report (i) full-span secret NLL, (ii) a span-localised decomposition, (iii) behavioural exact-recall at k>=4, and (iv) decoy probes before asserting secret-specificity. Evidence is on controlled canaries in one backbone; magnitudes are testbed-specific.
papers.comment: ICML 2026 FoGen Workshop camera-ready. 17 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 金丝雀文本测试平台上，对固定前缀窗口平均负对数似然（mean-NLL）记忆探针（K=20）进行审计，报告了三种事后不一致案例：C3（假阴性，窗口截断），C4（假阳性，非秘密漂移），C5（模糊窗口内下降）。作者建议在断言秘密特异性前，报告全跨度秘密 NLL、跨度局部分解、行为精确召回（k>=4）和诱饵探针。
Method: 使用固定前缀窗口平均 NLL 探针（K=20）对 LoRA 微调的自回归模型进行记忆审计，通过三个案例揭示探针选择对金丝雀记忆判定结果的影响。
Result: 发现三种不一致：C3 中窗口截断导致假阴性，hit@1 下降；C4 中非秘密前缀漂移导致假阳性；C5 中窗口内下降但全跨度 hex 为正且 hit@1=0。
Conclusion: 建议报告全跨度秘密 NLL、跨度局部分解、k>=4 的行为精确召回和诱饵探针，以增强记忆评估的可靠性。证据限于受控金丝雀和单一骨干模型。

papers.title: MIRTH: Mutual-Information Reasoning with Temporal Hubs for Vision-Language-Action Agents
papers.abstract_en: VLA models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for transferring semantic knowledge from web-scale data to physical robotic control. However, current single-frame architectures suffer from intrinsic limitations: temporal myopia that discards historical dynamics, reasoning gaps between high-level instructions and low-level motor commands, and inference inefficiency due to autoregressive scalar decoding. In this work, we propose MIRTH, a unified framework designed to address these challenges. MIRTH augments a pretrained VLA backbone with three key innovations: (1) dual-scale temporal memory hubs that compress long-term scene evolution and short-term motion trends into compact embeddings; (2) latent reasoning tokens optimized via a mutual-information objective carving out a semantic plan space to align multimodal context with action trajectories; and (3) a parallel action decoding scheme that replaces autoregressive generation with vector-wise prediction to maximize control throughput. Extensive evaluations on the LIBERO simulation benchmark and a real-world LeRobot platform demonstrate that MIRTH achieves state-of-the-art performance and exhibiting emergent error recovery capabilities. The codes and collected datasets are released at http://github.com/kiva12138/mirth.
papers.comment: Accepted as main conference paper at ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: MIRTH 是一个针对视觉-语言-动作 (VLA) 模型的多模态推理框架，通过双尺度时间记忆集线器、互信息优化的潜在推理 token 和平行动作解码机制，解决时间短视、推理鸿沟和推理效率低下的问题。在 LIBERO 仿真和真实 LeRobot 平台上达到最优性能，并展现涌现的错误恢复能力。
Motivation: 现有单帧 VLA 模型存在时间短视（忽略历史动态）、高层语义指令与低层电机指令之间的推理鸿沟，以及自回归标量解码导致的推理效率低下问题。
Method: 提出 MIRTH 框架，包含 (1) 双尺度时间记忆集线器，压缩长期场景演化和短期运动趋势为紧凑嵌入；(2) 通过互信息目标优化的潜在推理 token，构建语义规划空间以对齐多模态上下文与动作轨迹；(3) 平行动作解码，用向量级预测替代自回归生成，提升控制吞吐量。
Result: 在 LIBERO 仿真基准和真实 LeRobot 平台上达到当前最优性能，并展现涌现的错误恢复能力。
Conclusion: MIRTH 通过统一框架同时解决时间短视、推理鸿沟和推理效率问题，并具备错误恢复能力。

papers.title: TAG-DLM: Diffusion Language Models for Text-Attributed Graph Learning
papers.abstract_en: Text-attributed graphs (TAGs), where each node carries a natural language description, require models to jointly reason over text and graph topology. Existing approaches often handle the two modalities separately: graph neural networks operate on shallow text features, while hybrids of LLMs and graphs use the language model mainly as a text encoder and delegate structure learning to a separate graph module. We propose method that unifies textual reasoning and graph message passing within a masked diffusion language model, a language model with bidirectional attention and generative decoding. For each graph instance, method linearises a sampled local neighbourhood into a token sequence and injects graph structure through a topology attention mask, which realises message passing over the graph. Because the diffusion language model can both interpret and generate text, the method adapts to different tasks simply by changing the prompt, supporting node classification, link prediction, and cross-dataset transfer with no target-specific fine-tuning. Experiments show that method outperforms graph neural networks, graph transformers, and LLM-based baselines on all three TAG benchmarks across two tasks, improving over the strongest baseline by up to 3.9 points.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TAG-DLM，一种将文本推理与图消息传递统一在掩码扩散语言模型中的方法。该方法通过线性化局部邻域为令牌序列并注入拓扑注意力掩码，实现图上的消息传递，并支持通过提示适配不同任务。实验表明，在三个TAG基准的两个任务上，该方法优于图神经网络、图Transformer和基于LLM的基线，最高提升3.9个百分点。
Motivation: 现有文本属性图方法通常分开处理文本和拓扑：图神经网络使用浅层文本特征，LLM与图的混合方法将语言模型仅用作文本编码器。缺乏真正的统一模型。
Method: 在掩码扩散语言模型（双向注意力+生成解码）中，将采样的局部邻域线性化为令牌序列，并通过拓扑注意力掩码注入图结构，从而在图实例上实现消息传递。
Result: 在三个TAG基准上，针对节点分类和链接预测两个任务，该方法均优于图神经网络、图Transformer和基于LLM的基线，最高提升3.9个百分点。
Conclusion: 统一的扩散语言模型能够同时处理文本和图拓扑，并通过提示适应多种任务，无需目标特定微调。

papers.title: Seeing Through the Weights: Privacy Leakage in Scene Coordinate Regression
papers.abstract_en: Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) methods are increasingly adopted for visual localization. In these approaches, the scene is implicitly encoded within a neural network that regresses a 3D world coordinate for each image pixel. Because the scene is represented only through the network parameters and not stored explicitly as images or maps, such methods are often assumed to be privacy-preserving. In this work, we show that this assumption is incorrect in practice. Specifically, we introduce a query-based attack that reconstructs the 3D geometry of the training environment from an SCR model under different levels of model access. To do so, we repeatedly query the model with batches of proxy images unrelated to the target scene to obtain dense pixel-wise 3D coordinates. Reliable points are identified through their stability under small input perturbations and can be further refined in a white-box setting. These stable points are accumulated across independent query batches to recover the scene geometry. From the recovered 3D representation, we also invert the network features to synthesize images from arbitrary viewpoints, revealing additional appearance information. Experiments on indoor and outdoor datasets demonstrate that substantial portions of training environments can be reconstructed with high geometric fidelity. Beyond geometry, we also recover an approximate color appearance, which exposes recognizable layout and potentially sensitive scene elements. This directly contradicts claims in the literature that SCR representations are privacy-preserving by design, and reveals a real risk when such systems are deployed in private or security-critical spaces. The project page is available at https://jaeminch0.github.io/seeing-through-the-weights-privacy-leakage-in-scene-coordinate-regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示场景坐标回归（SCR）方法并非隐私保护，提出一种基于查询的攻击，能从SCR模型中重建训练环境的3D几何，甚至合成任意视角的图像，暴露外观信息。
Motivation: SCR被广泛用于视觉定位，因其场景仅编码在网络参数中而不存储图像或地图，常被认为隐私保护。本文指出这一假设错误。
Method: 提出查询攻击，使用与目标场景无关的代理图像批量查询SCR模型，获得密集像素3D坐标；通过小扰动下稳定性识别可靠点，在白盒设置下进一步优化；累加稳定点恢复场景几何；并反演网络特征合成图像。
Result: 实验表明，在室内外数据集上可以高保真重建训练环境的大部分几何信息，还能恢复近似颜色外观，暴露可识别的布局和潜在敏感元素。
Conclusion: 本文结果直接反驳了SCR表示天然隐私保护的文献说法，揭示了在私密或安全关键场景中部署此类系统的实际风险。

papers.title: ComplianceGate: Classifier-Gated Multi-Tier LLM Routing for Inference in Regulated Industries
papers.abstract_en: Large language models deployed in regulated industries operate under two constraints: compliance enforcement and cost efficiency. Personally identifiable information (PII) in user queries can reach model endpoints before the system determines whether that data should leave its jurisdictional boundary. Serving all queries through a single large model consumes full GPU capacity regardless of query complexity while offering no mechanism for geographic routing. Mixture-of-Experts architectures do not address this routing occurs between expert layers within the model after data has already arrived at the endpoint, with all experts loaded in memory regardless of query complexity. We propose a classifier-gated routing architecture that enforces compliance by design. A trained encoder classifier sits before any decoder inference, evaluating each query for complexity and data sensitivity, then routing it to an appropriately sized dense model in the appropriate geographic location. PII-containing queries route to local endpoints before any LLM computation begins, making data residency violations structurally impossible. Simple queries reach small, fast models at a fraction of the cost. Our evaluation on 600 queries demonstrates 39% median latency reduction, 33-52% cost savings depending on query distribution, and generation throughput of 122-200 tokens/second versus 50-64 for the baseline. The encoder classifier achieves 99.2% accuracy with near-perfect PII recall at 7ms inference overhead, establishing pre-inference classification as a practical path to compliance-by-design LLM deployment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对监管行业LLM部署中合规与成本效率的双重约束，提出ComplianceGate架构：在LLM推理前使用编码器分类器评估查询的复杂度和数据敏感性，根据结果将查询路由至适当规模且位于适当地理位置的密集模型，确保含PII的查询在本地处理，避免数据出境。在600个查询上的实验显示，中位延迟降低39%，成本节省33-52%，生成吞吐量122-200 tokens/s（基线50-64），分类器准确率99.2%，PII召回率近乎完美，推理开销7ms。
Motivation: 监管行业部署LLM时，单一大模型消耗全部GPU资源且无法实现地理路由，Mixture-of-Experts架构在数据到达端点后才在专家层间路由，无法从根源上防止PII泄露。需要一种架构在推理前即执行合规决策并优化成本。
Method: 提出分类器门控路由架构：在解码器推理前插入一个训练好的编码器分类器，评估每个查询的复杂度（简单/复杂）和数据敏感性（是否含PII），然后路由至相应规模的密集模型（小/大）并在合规的地理端点执行。含PII查询在LLM计算前即被路由到本地端点，实现结构性的数据驻留合规。
Result: 在600个查询上的评估结果：中位延迟降低39%，成本节省33-52%（取决于查询分布），生成吞吐量122-200 tokens/s相比于基线的50-64 tokens/s。分类器准确率99.2%，PII召回率近乎完美，附加推理开销仅7ms。

papers.title: Reasoning-aware Speculative Decoding for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models in Autonomous Driving
papers.abstract_en: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) planners for autonomous driving emit a chain-of-causation (CoC) reasoning step \emph{before} producing a trajectory. The reasoning is autoregressive and dominates inference latency, while the trajectory head is parallel and cheap. Latency is an operational constraint in autonomous driving, so accelerating the reasoning step is the central problem we address. We observe that CoC reasoning has two qualitatively different needs: most tokens continue routine setup that follows naturally from the ego-trajectory history, and a small fraction encode commitments that require fresh visual evidence about an unexpected situation. We split this reasoning into two specialized paths: a \emph{routine reasoner} that handles the predictable continuation by attending to trajectory history, and a \emph{deliberative reasoner} (the unmodified VLA target) that handles novel cases by attending to current visual evidence, using the speculative decoding framework as the architectural template for how the two paths cooperate. Unlike standard speculative decoding, our routine reasoner is not a smaller replica of the target; the two reasoners are deliberately specialized to read different parts of the prompt. We propose two techniques to realize this. First, we introduce \textbf{FlatRoPE}, a 1D rotary positional embedding in the draft that breaks the rotational symmetry of the target's 3D M-RoPE, redirecting attention away from visual tokens and onto trajectory-history tokens. Second, we introduce \textbf{Action-aware RL (AARL)}, a post-training stage that uses an action-quality reward together with a static-reference KL anchor. Together, our two-reasoner system reduces the reasoning-step running time by approximately $4\times$ relative to the original Alpamayo planner.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶视觉-语言-动作（VLA）规划器中因果链（CoC）推理步骤延迟过高的问题，提出一种基于推测解码（speculative decoding）的两路径推理系统：常规推理器（routine reasoner）利用轨迹历史处理可预测的推理，而审慎推理器（deliberative reasoner）关注当前视觉证据处理意外情况。作者引入FlatRoPE旋转位置编码和行动感知强化学习（AARL）训练策略，在Alpamayo规划器上将推理步耗时降低约4倍。
Motivation: 现代VLA规划器在生成轨迹前需要自回归的因果链推理，该推理延占了主要延迟，而轨迹头推理是并行的、计算代价低。降低推理延迟是自动驾驶的实际操作约束。
Method: 将因果链推理拆分为两条专有路径：常规推理器依据轨迹历史进行常规预测，审慎推理器（原VLA目标）依据当前视觉证据处理新奇情况并作为目标模型。采用推测解码框架使两路径协作，并提出FlatRoPE（打破目标3D M-RoPE的旋转对称性，将注意力从视觉标记转移到轨迹历史标记）和AARL（使用动作质量奖励和静态参考KL散度锚点的后训练阶段）。
Result: 在Alpamayo规划器上，两推理器系统将推理步运行时间减少约4倍。
Conclusion: 通过将因果链推理路由到专有路径并利用推测解码框架，可以在保持生成质量的同时大幅加速自动驾驶VLA规划器的推理速度。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Security Calibration in Large Language Models for Code
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are rapidly transforming software development, yet their use in security-critical contexts raises a key question: do models know when their generated code is insecure? This property, known as calibration, measures whether a model's confidence aligns with the true correctness of its outputs. We present the first large-scale empirical study of security calibration in LLM-generated code. We evaluate GPT-4o-mini, Gemini-2.0-Flash, and Qwen3-Coder-Next across multiple temperature settings on two complementary benchmarks: self-contained security tasks and multi-language repository-level contexts. Our results suggest that overconfidence is prevalent across the evaluated LLMs. Functional calibration is consistently worse than security calibration, suggesting that models estimate security outcomes more reliably than functional correctness, potentially because functional correctness depends on complex execution behavior. We also examine whether calibration-guided automated repair can help remediate vulnerabilities in LLM-generated code, finding only limited improvements while frequently introducing functional regressions. Moreover, we study different mitigation strategies for reducing False Trust, where models assign high confidence to vulnerable code. The results show that although architectural gating improves calibration on controlled benchmarks, calibration deteriorates in realistic repository-level settings, increasing the risk of high-confidence vulnerable outputs.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 42nd International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME 2026) Research Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次大规模实证研究大语言模型（LLM）生成代码的安全性校准（security calibration），评估GPT-4o-mini、Gemini-2.0-Flash和Qwen3-Coder-Next，发现模型普遍过度自信，安全性校准优于功能性校准，但校准指导的自动修复效果有限，且在实际仓库级设置中校准变差。
Motivation: LLM在安全关键代码生成中是否知道自己的输出不安全？现有研究缺乏对代码安全校准的系统评估。
Method: 在自包含安全任务和多语言仓库级上下文两个基准上，对不同温度设置下的多个LLM进行校准评估，并探索基于校准的自动修复和缓解策略。
Result: 模型普遍过度自信；安全性校准优于功能性校准；校准指导的自动修复改善有限且常引入功能回归；架构门控在受控基准上改善校准，但在仓库级设置中校准恶化。
Conclusion: 当前LLM在代码安全校准上存在过度自信问题，实际部署中可能对不安全代码产生高置信度，需进一步研究缓解策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LLM-Powered Interactive Robotic Action Synthesis from Multimodal Speech, Gestures, and Music
papers.abstract_en: The quest for intuitive and natural human-robot interaction (HRI) remains a significant challenge in robotics. Traditional methods often rely on rigid, pre-programmed commands that limit the robot's expressiveness and adaptability. This paper introduces a novel framework that leverages the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to synthesize complex robotic actions from a rich tapestry of multimodal human inputs: natural speech, hand gestures, and music/sound beats. Our system architecture integrates a speech transcription model, a gesture recognition module, and a signal processing pipeline for beat detection. These processed inputs are contextualized using prompt templates and fed into a LLM. The LLM, informed by a predefined robot action space, reasons over the combined inputs to generate a coherent sequence of actions. This sequence is dispatched to an action queue for execution on a quadruped robot over ROS. The framework has ability to interpret and fuse semantic commands from speech, deictic information from gestures, and rhythmic cues from music. This work represents a step towards creating robots that can interact with humans in a more fluid, creative, and context-aware manner.
papers.comment: IROS 2025 Workshop on Action and Interaction: Humans and Robots in Collaboration
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于大语言模型（LLM）的框架，融合语音、手势和音乐节拍等多模态人类输入，为四足机器人合成动作。系统通过语音转录、手势识别和节拍检测模块处理输入，利用提示模板注入LLM，生成动作序列并通过ROS执行，旨在实现更自然流畅的人机交互。
Motivation: 传统机器人交互依赖固定预编程指令，缺乏表达力和适应性，难以实现直观自然的交互。
Method: 构建包含语音转录、手势识别和节拍检测的管道，将多模态输入经提示模板送入LLM，LLM基于预定义动作空间推理生成动作序列，通过行动队列在ROS上执行。
Result: 框架能解释并融合语音的语义指令、手势的指示信息和音乐的节奏线索，生成连贯的机器人动作序列。
Conclusion: 该工作向创造更流畅、有创造力和上下文感知的机器人交互迈进一步，但摘要未提具体定量评估。

papers.title: Rethinking Foundation Model Collaboration: Enhancing Specialized Models through Proxy Task Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are increasingly integrated into embodied intelligence systems, but directly assigning them structured prediction tasks requires precise geometric and numerical estimation, where specialized models often remain stronger. This capability mismatch raises a key question: should foundation models replace task-specific predictors, or should they collaborate through tasks better aligned with their strengths? We propose FAT, a foundation-model-augmented task-specific reasoning framework that treats collaboration as task decomposition rather than model replacement. FAT decomposes structured prediction into specialist prediction, information-space reconstruction, and foundation-model proxy reasoning. The specialist generates geometrically and physically valid hypotheses in the native output space, while the foundation model performs a bounded proxy task, such as selection or verification, over reconstructed multimodal candidates. We instantiate this principle as ProxySelect with a vision--language model. Across 2D object detection, 3D object detection, trajectory prediction, and semantic segmentation, ProxySelect consistently improves specialized baselines and substantially outperforms direct foundation-model regression at lower computational cost. These results suggest a general collaboration principle: specialized models preserve task-specific structure, while foundation models refine their hypotheses through contextual proxy reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FAT（基础模型增强的任务特定推理）框架，通过将结构预测分解为专门预测、信息空间重建和基础模型代理推理来解决基础模型与专门模型的能力不匹配问题。具体实例化 ProxySelect 使用视觉语言模型执行选择或验证等有限代理任务，在 2D/3D 目标检测、轨迹预测和语义分割任务上一致提升专门基线的性能，且计算成本低于直接使用基础模型进行回归。
Motivation: 基础模型在需要精确几何和数值估计的结构化预测任务中不如专门模型，但直接替换为专门模型并未充分利用基础模型的优势，因此需要一种更好的协作方式而非模型替代。
Method: 提出 FAT 框架，将结构化预测分解为三个阶段：专门模型在原生输出空间生成假设、信息空间重建、以及基础模型通过有界代理任务（如选择或验证）对重建后的多模态候选进行推理。具体实现为 ProxySelect，基于视觉语言模型。
Result: 在 2D/3D 目标检测、轨迹预测和语义分割多个任务上，ProxySelect 一致提升了专门基线的性能，并显著优于直接使用基础模型进行回归的方法，同时计算成本更低。
Conclusion: 提出通用协作原则：专门模型保留任务特定结构，基础模型通过上下文代理推理优化假设，从而在嵌入式智能系统中实现高效协作。

papers.title: One Retrieval to Cover Them All: Co-occurrence-Aware Knowledge Base Reorganization for Session-Level RAG
papers.abstract_en: RAG systems retrieve documents optimized for answering one query at a time. Yet enterprise users arrive with sessions, that is, coherent episodes of related questions that span semantically distant parts of the knowledge base. We show that a single retrieval call over a standard knowledge base covers only 41% of a user's session-level information need. To close this gap, we reorganize the KB offline using co-occurrence-aware clustering and expand retrieval candidates through cluster neighborhoods at query time. On WixQA (6,221 enterprise support articles), our method raises single-query session coverage to 58% (+17% absolute; 95% CI: [14.1, 20.4]), reduces retrieval calls to 70% coverage by 34%, and compresses the KB to 20% of its original size, all consistently across four embedding models and six functional domains. We argue that session-level coverage, not single-query recall, should be the primary metric for enterprise RAG evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted to the Towards Knowledgeable Foundation Models (KnowFM) Workshop at ACL 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对企业级对话RAG中单次检索只能覆盖会话信息需求41%的问题，提出基于共现聚类的知识库离线重组方法，并在查询时通过集群邻域扩展检索候选。在WixQA数据集上，该方法将单次查询的会话覆盖率提升至58%，检索调用减少34%，知识库压缩至原始大小的20%。
Motivation: 现有RAG系统为单次查询优化，但企业用户常以会话形式提出一系列相关但分散的问题，单次检索的会话覆盖率仅41%，需要改进。
Method: 通过离线共现感知聚类重组知识库，并在查询时利用聚类邻域扩展检索候选，以覆盖整个会话的信息需求。
Result: 在WixQA数据集上，单次查询的会话覆盖率从41%提升到58%（绝对提升17%），检索调用次数减少34%，知识库压缩至原始大小的20%，且在四种嵌入模型和六个功能领域上表现一致。
Conclusion: 作者主张会话级覆盖率而非单次查询召回率应作为企业RAG评估的主要指标。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有RAG系统为单次查询优化，但企业用户常以会话形式提出一系列相关但分散的问题，单次检索的会话覆盖率仅41%，需要改进。
summary_sections.method: 通过离线共现感知聚类重组知识库，并在查询时利用聚类邻域扩展检索候选，以覆盖整个会话的信息需求。
summary_sections.result: 在WixQA数据集上，单次查询的会话覆盖率从41%提升到58%（绝对提升17%），检索调用次数减少34%，知识库压缩至原始大小的20%，且在四种嵌入模型和六个功能领域上表现一致。

papers.title: PPT-Eval: A Benchmark for Computer-Use Agents on PowerPoint Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Creating and editing slides is a rich, multimodal activity that is ubiquitous in professional and educational settings, making it an ideal testbed for real-world computer-use agents. Microsoft PowerPoint is among the most widely adopted and feature-rich environments for presentation creation. We introduce PPT-Eval, a benchmark of 120 PowerPoint tasks across 12 files that cover both content creation and presentation editing scenarios, organized by difficulty. A central challenge in this domain is evaluation: tasks are complex, multimodal, and often admit many valid solutions. Moreover, today's agents frequently make only partial progress, which binary success metrics fail to capture. To address this, we design a robust evaluation framework to help create task-specific rubrics for PowerPoint tasks, taking inspiration from and building on past works for rubric-based evaluation. These rubrics award partial credit for intermediate steps, penalize unnecessary changes and poor aesthetics, and provide natural language feedback. This nuanced approach proves highly effective, achieving a Kendall's τ-b correlation of 0.77 with human judgments. We find that existing frontier agents still struggle with solving PowerPoint tasks, with strong models like Claude-4.5-Opus achieving only a 45% success rate and an average partial score of 57%. The benchmark is located at: https://microsoft.github.io/ppteval.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PPT-Eval，一个包含120个PowerPoint任务的基准测试，用于评估计算机使用代理在幻灯片创建和编辑上的能力。为解决任务多解性和部分进展难以评估的问题，作者设计了一个基于评分准则的部分分数评估框架，该框架与人类判断的Kendall's τ-b相关系数达0.77。实验表明，当前最强模型Claude-4.5-Opus仅取得45%的成功率和57%的平均部分分数，说明该任务仍有较大挑战。
Motivation: 现有基准缺乏对PowerPoint这类多模态复杂任务的系统评估，且代理常只能部分完成目标，二进制成功指标无法反映实际进展，亟需更精细的评估方法。
Method: 构建包含12个文件、120个任务的PPT-Eval基准，并设计评估框架：为每个任务制定具体评分准则，对中间步骤给予部分分数，同时惩罚不必要的更改和较差的美观性，并生成自然语言反馈。
Result: 该评估框架与人类判断的Kendall's τ-b相关性达到0.77；Claude-4.5-Opus等前沿代理的最终成功率仅为45%，平均部分分数为57%。
Conclusion: PPT-Eval揭示了现有计算机使用代理在复杂多模态任务上的不足，所提供的细粒度评估方法有助于引导未来研究。

papers.title: PruneGround: Plug-and-play Spatial Pruning for 3D Visual Grounding
papers.abstract_en: 3D Visual Grounding (3DVG) aims to localize target objects in 3D scenes given natural language descriptions. Existing approaches typically perform reasoning over the entire scene, leading to ambiguous predictions and high computational cost, especially in cluttered environments. We observe that many referential expressions rely on local spatial context and often correspond to restricted spatial regions rather than the full scene. Motivated by this insight, we propose PruneGround, an effective plug-and-play framework for 3DVG built upon three key components. First, we introduce Language-Guided Spatial Pruning (LGSP), which leverages a frozen Vision Language Model (VLM) to identify language-relevant regions, thereby reducing spatial computation and grounding candidates in the narrower search space. Second, we propose MultiView-Conditioned Description Reformulation (MCDR), which decomposes complex expressions into simplified target-anchor relations and augments missing spatial cues through multi-view reasoning. Finally, we propose LLM-Grounder, which repurposes a detection-pretrained spatial LLM into a language-conditioned grounding model by aligning point cloud and linguistic representations within the pruned region. Extensive experiments on the three most popular point cloud benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art results on all three ScanRefer settings and on 9 out of 10 Nr3D/Sr3D settings. Code and models are publicly available: https://github.com/leduckhai/PruneGround
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PruneGround，一种即插即用的空间剪枝框架用于 3D 视觉定位（3DVG）。该方法包含三个核心组件：语言引导空间剪枝（LGSP）利用冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）识别语言相关区域以减少计算；多视角条件描述重构（MCDR）将复杂表达式分解为简化的目标-锚点关系并增强空间线索；LLM-Grounder 将检测预训练的空间大语言模型（LLM）重用于语言条件定位。在三个点云基准上，该方法在 ScanRefer 的所有三个设置和 Nr3D/Sr3D 的 9/10 设置上达到最先进结果。
Motivation: 现有 3DVG 方法对整个场景进行推理，导致模糊预测和高计算成本，尤其在杂乱环境中。观察到许多指代表达依赖于局部空间上下文，仅对应受限空间区域。
Method: 提出即插即用框架 PruneGround，包括语言引导空间剪枝（LGSP）、多视角条件描述重构（MCDR）和 LLM-Grounder。LGSP 使用冻结的 VLM 定位语言相关区域；MCDR 通过多视角推理分解复杂表达式；LLM-Grounder 将空间 LLM 调整为语言条件定位模型。
Result: 在 ScanRefer 所有三个设置和 Nr3D/Sr3D 的 9/10 设置上达到最先进结果。
Conclusion: 该方法通过空间剪枝降低计算成本并提高定位精度，适用于 3D 场景理解。

papers.title: WaterGen: Decoupling Scene and Medium in Underwater Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Underwater computer vision tasks, such as detection, restoration, and segmentation, are limited by the scarcity of large-scale and diverse training data. We introduce WaterGen, a method for generating large-scale, realistic, and diverse underwater images that provides independent control of the scene and water medium conditions. Our approach treats underwater image generation as the decoupled control of two factors: realistic and diverse scene content (what is in the image), and accurate and controllable water medium effects (what the water does to the image). Existing methods generally achieve only part of this objective: they either provide controllability with limited realism or diversity, or generate realistic scenes without accurately and independently modeling water-medium effects. Our key insight, that allows us to avoid this compromise, is that scene generation and medium modeling can be decoupled within a latent diffusion framework, enabling diverse scene generation together with accurate and controllable underwater appearance. To do this, we decompose underwater image synthesis into two stages. First, we fine-tune the latent diffusion U-Net using degradation-free underwater images so that it learns to generate diverse and realistic latent embeddings of underwater scene content without medium-induced degradation. Second, we formulate the physically accurate medium degradation synthesis as a conditional decoding process applied to these latent embeddings. This decoupled design allows our model to generate diverse scenes with full control of underwater appearance. We leverage WaterGen to build large-scale synthetic underwater datasets that are diverse in scene structures and accurate in water effects and pseudo-labels. We demonstrate that our synthetic data consistently improve downstream performance in underwater restoration and semantic segmentation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WaterGen 是一种水下图像生成方法，将场景内容与水介质效应解耦，通过两阶段流程：先微调潜扩散U-Net生成无退化的水下场景潜编码，再以物理精确的介质退化合成作为条件解码过程。该方法能独立控制场景多样性和水下外观，生成大规模合成数据集，并在水下恢复和语义分割任务上提升下游性能。
Motivation: 水下计算机视觉任务受限于大规模、多样化训练数据的稀缺，现有方法无法同时实现场景多样性与水介质效应的精确可控建模。
Method: 将水下图像生成分解为两个阶段：1) 使用无退化水下图像微调潜扩散U-Net，学习生成多样且真实的场景潜编码；2) 基于物理准确的介质退化模型，将条件解码过程应用于这些潜编码，实现水下外观的精确控制。
Result: 利用WaterGen构建的合成数据集在场景结构上多样，在水效应和伪标签上精确；下游实验表明，该数据能一致提升水下恢复和语义分割的性能。
Conclusion: 通过解耦场景生成与介质建模，WaterGen避免了现有方法在真实感、多样性和可控性之间的权衡，为水下视觉任务提供了有效数据增强手段。

papers.title: A Modular Vision-Language-Action Robotics Framework for Indoor Environments
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents an integrated system for the CMU Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Challenge, designed to enable an autonomous agent to perform complex tasks based on natural language instructions. Our framework employs a modular architecture that orchestrates environment mapping, question processing, and navigation. The system operates in two parallel streams: a perception pipeline that constructs a semantic voxel map from real-time camera feeds using OwlViT embeddings, and a language pipeline that classifies user commands with a Vision-Language Model. The mapping is time-constrained; the system proceeds with a partial map if a 500-second exploration limit is reached. The classified query is then grounded in the geometric and semantic context of the map to generate a detailed prompt for the VLM. This yields an actionable output, demonstrating a capable solution for bridging the gap between human language and robotic action.
papers.comment: IEEE IROS 2025 Workshop on Generative AI for Robotics and Smart Manufacturing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个模块化的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）机器人框架，用于室内环境中的自主导航和任务执行。系统并行运行感知流水线（使用OwlViT嵌入构建语义体素地图）和语言流水线（使用视觉语言模型分类用户指令），并在500秒探索时限后基于部分地图生成可执行的导航动作。
Motivation: 现有机器人系统在理解自然语言指令并根据实时环境进行复杂任务方面存在不足，需要一种能有效融合视觉、语言和动作的模块化框架。
Method: 采用双流水线模块化架构：感知流水线通过OwlViT嵌入从实时摄像头流构建语义体素地图，语言流水线使用视觉语言模型（VLM）对用户命令进行分类。两者并行运行，在时间约束（500秒）内生成部分地图，然后将分类后的查询与地图的几何和语义上下文结合，生成详细提示输入VLM，最终输出可执行动作。
Result: 摘要未提供具体的量化实验结果，仅称该方法展示了将人类语言与机器人动作连接的有效解决方案，参加了CMU VLA挑战。
Conclusion: 该框架作为CMU VLA挑战的参赛系统，证明了模块化设计在结合视觉、语言和动作方面的可行性，但依赖于时间约束下的部分地图构建。

papers.title: A Bayesian Filtering Approach for Learning Lagrangian Dynamics from Noisy Measurements
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a Bayesian filtering-based approach for learning the dynamics of a physical system from partial, noisy measurements. We model the system dynamics using a Lagrangian mechanics formulation. As in Lagrangian neural networks (LNNs), we parameterize the kinetic and potential energies with neural networks. The unknown external forces in the Lagrangian formulation are modeled as white Gaussian noise. The corresponding Euler--Lagrange equations then yield a continuous-time stochastic state-space model (SSM) that describes the system dynamics. The neural network parameters and system states are then jointly learned via a maximum-likelihood method using Gaussian-approximation-based Bayesian filters. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated on pendulum and Duffing oscillator examples, and its performance is compared with conventional LNNs and with approximate Bayesian filters using known system models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于贝叶斯滤波的方法，用于从含噪声的部分测量中学习物理系统的拉格朗日动力学。通过神经网络参数化动能和势能，将未知外力建模为白噪声，导出的欧拉-拉格朗日方程形成连续时间随机状态空间模型，并利用基于高斯近似的贝叶斯滤波器以最大似然方式联合估计神经网络参数和系统状态。在摆和Duffing振子示例上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有拉格朗日神经网络（LNN）在处理含噪声测量时能力有限，本文旨在解决从部分、噪声测量中学习物理系统动力学的问题。
Method: 将系统动力学建模为拉格朗日形式，用神经网络参数化动能和势能，未知外力视为高斯白噪声，得到连续时间随机状态空间模型，采用基于高斯近似的贝叶斯滤波进行最大似然估计，联合学习网络参数和系统状态。
Result: 在摆和Duffing振子示例上展示了方法的有效性，并与传统LNN以及使用已知系统模型的近似贝叶斯滤波器进行了性能比较。
Conclusion: 该方法能够结合物理先验和噪声测量数据，有效学习系统动力学。

papers.title: FROST: Training-Free Few-Shot Segmentation with Frozen Features and Nonparametric Statistics
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot segmentation asks a model to delineate a target class in a query image from only a handful of annotated examples, a setting most acute in remote sensing, where labels are scarce and the imagery departs sharply from the natural images on which vision backbones are pretrained. Prevailing approaches either train a segmenter on labelled episodes, which raises accuracy within the training distribution but binds the model to it, or reduce each class to a lossy summary of frozen features, a single prototype, a few cluster prototypes, or a discrete clustering, none of which preserves the internal structure of a multimodal class. We argue that a class is better described by a distribution than by a point, and that frozen self-supervised features already carry enough structure to estimate that distribution directly. We introduce FROST, a training-free few-shot segmenter that treats the reference foreground and background as two point clouds on the unit sphere of frozen DINOv3 features and labels each query token by a nonparametric density ratio, with a threshold the Bayes rule fixes at zero under equal priors. Because the variance of a density estimate shrinks as its sample grows, the decision sharpens as references accumulate, and every remaining quantity from the kernel bandwidth to the spatial gate is read from the support set rather than tuned. We develop FROST for overhead imagery, where a class is typically a scatter of many small and dissimilar instances that a density tracks but a lossy summary blurs. Across seventeen remote-sensing benchmarks FROST surpasses both training-free and learning-based methods, leading by 5.6 mIoU from a single annotated example and widening its lead as the support set grows, all while remaining among the smallest models compared. Code is available at https://github.com/jhpark-ai/FROST.

Conclusion: 摘要强调密度估计随参考样本增多而方差减小，决策更精确，且所有参数均从支持集确定，无需训练。该方法在遥感图像中有效，但仅针对该领域进行了评估。

papers.title: MSNN-LINet: Cross-Modal Learning via Continuous Linear Integration
papers.abstract_en: We present LINet (Linear Integration Network), a Multi-Stream Neural Network (MSNN) for RGB-D scene classification. Current multi-modal architectures treat feature fusion as a discrete, ad-hoc event: early fusion entangles representations prematurely, late fusion isolates them until the final layer, and hybrid or attention-based methods require architectural guesswork to place intermediate fusion blocks. LINet addresses this structural compromise by maintaining three dedicated parallel streams (RGB, depth, and integration) where a novel Linear Integration Convolution (LIConv2d) operator enables continuous cross-modal learning at every layer. The integration stream receives raw filtered signals from both modality streams and combines them before the nonlinear activation threshold, conceptually inspired by somatic integration preceding the neuronal firing decision. Implementing continuous integration exposes a critical initialization pathology: Kaiming initialization of the bridging weights scrambles gradients before they reach the stream backbones, producing a failure mode that resembles overfitting but is corrupted gradient flow. A 1/N constant initialization mitigates this. We employ progressive modality dropout, a curriculum adapted to continuous fusion in which blanking probability increases from zero, preventing pathway collapse, a form of negative co-learning, by forcing robust independent stream representations. Trained from scratch on SUN RGB-D 19-class scene classification, LINet reaches 45.2% mean class accuracy at ResNet18 scale, outperforming prior from-scratch results, and rises to 49.6% with in-domain RGB-D (ScanNet) pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多流神经网络LINet用于RGB-D场景分类，通过连续线性集成卷积（LIConv2d）在每一层进行跨模态学习，并解决初始化路径问题和渐进式模态dropout。在SUN RGB-D 19类场景分类上从零训练达到45.2%平均类别准确率，使用ScanNet预训练达到49.6%。
Motivation: 当前多模态架构将特征融合视为离散事件，过早或过晚融合都有弊端，需要一种更连续的方法来平衡表示学习和融合时机。
Method: 提出LINet，包含三个并行流（RGB、深度和集成流），使用LIConv2d操作在每层进行连续跨模态学习；采用1/N常数初始化解决梯度问题；使用渐进式模态dropout防止通路坍塌。
Result: 从零训练在SUN RGB-D 19类场景分类上达到45.2%平均类别准确率，超过之前从零训练结果；使用ScanNet预训练提升至49.6%。
Conclusion: 连续线性集成方法能够有效改善RGB-D场景分类中的跨模态学习，且渐进式模态dropout有助于防止负协同学习。

papers.title: Beyond the Library: An Agentic Framework for Autoformalizing Research Mathematics
papers.abstract_en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in mathematical reasoning, they frequently produce subtle errors that evade human detection. Formal mathematical languages like Lean 4 offer mechanical proof checking, strongly motivating the need for autoformalization: the automatic translation of natural language mathematics into verifiable code. Recent trends indicate that general-purpose LLMs, heavily optimized for standard programming, now outperform smaller models explicitly fine-tuned for Lean. Leveraging this shift, we introduce an agentic autoformalization framework powered by general coding LLMs. At the core of our system is an orchestrator that manages a multi-agent pipeline tailored for research-level mathematics. Because cutting-edge research frequently relies on concepts outside the scope of existing libraries like Mathlib, our system dynamically extends necessary type definitions and validates them via a novel Auxiliary Lemma technique before formalizing the primary theorems. We applied our approach to PutnamBench, producing machine-checked Lean proofs for a random sample of 32 problems. Furthermore, we evaluate our system on five papers from the ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC) spanning combinatorics, communication complexity, mechanism design, and learning theory, successfully formalizing their main theorems and validating the generated formalizations with human experts; for all five we also formalize the proofs alongside the statements, and notably two of them are proved with no axioms beyond Lean's kernel. All of our formalizations are available at https://beyondthelibrary.github.io/formal_arxiv .
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于通用编程LLM的智能体框架用于自动形式化研究级数学。核心是编排器管理多智能体流水线，能动态扩展类型定义，并通过新辅助引文技术验证。在PutnamBench和STOC论文上验证，成功形式化主要定理和证明，其中两个证明无需额外公理。
Motivation: 大型语言模型在数学推理中常产生难以检测的细微错误，而形式化语言Lean 4提供机械证明检查，因此需要自动形式化——将自然语言数学转化为可验证代码。现有方法依赖小型微调模型，而通用编程LLM性能更优。
Method: 引入基于通用编程LLM的智能体自动形式化框架。编排器管理多智能体流水线，针对研究级数学，能动态扩展类型定义，并通过辅助引文技术验证，之后形式化主要定理。应用在PutnamBench和STOC论文。
Result: 在PutnamBench随机32个问题上生成机器检查的Lean证明；在5篇STOC论文上成功形式化主要定理及其证明，两个证明无需Lean内核外的公理。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该框架能有效自动形式化研究级数学，并开源所有形式化内容。

papers.title: Scenario Generation for Testing of Autonomous Driving Systems Using Real-World Failure Records
papers.abstract_en: To ensure safe on-road behavior, pre-deployment testing and failure discovery of Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS) is crucial. Present day simulation based testing methods focus largely on mathematical models for efficient search of optimal scenarios, assuming a fixed scenario representation. On the other hand, real-world testing involves substantial manual effort to design scenario templates for testing. These templates represent distinct failure scenarios consisting of pre-deployment vehicle movements, map types, etc. Historical failure records for ADS are a reliable source of real-world failure conditions, which can be used for scenario generation. In this work, we propose a scenario generation pipeline using categorical and contextual information available from historical records in natural language format. Our approach consists of modular LLM based synthetic scenario generation, compatible with the testing constraints of a given system. We successfully apply our method to generate a diverse set of scenarios for testing autonomous navigation on Metadrive simulator using the NHTSA ADS crash records. Our approach results in accurate and diverse scenario generation with a combination of 4 road types, 3 non ego vehicle movement types, including on road anomalies in the form of working zones. Generated scenarios align with the provided testing conditions, and reveals interesting failures of the system within a limited testing budget of 20 scenarios. Code is available at https://github.com/anjaliParashar/crash2scenario.
papers.comment: 9 pages, Appendix included. Paper accepted and presented at NeuS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用历史故障记录（NHTSA ADS碰撞记录）生成自动驾驶系统测试场景的流水线，通过模块化LLM从自然语言描述中提取类别和上下文信息，生成多样化的场景，并在Metadrive模拟器上验证，在20个场景的测试预算内成功发现了系统有趣失效。
Motivation: 现有基于模拟的测试方法主要依赖固定场景表示的数学模型，而真实世界测试需要大量手动设计场景模板，历史故障记录未被充分利用。
Method: 提出基于LLM的模块化场景生成流水线，从历史记录的自然语言中提取道路类型、非自车运动类型等类别和上下文信息，生成符合给定测试约束的场景。
Result: 在Metadrive模拟器上使用NHTSA碰撞记录生成场景，组合了4种道路类型、3种非自车运动类型和施工区异常，在20个场景的测试预算内发现了系统有趣失效。
Conclusion: 该方法能准确、多样化地生成与给定测试条件一致的场景，在有限预算下有效发现系统失效。

papers.title: UniSAE: Unified Speech Attribute Editing on Speaker, Emotion and Low-Level Content via Discrete Phonetic Posteriorgram Modelling
papers.abstract_en: Speech editing aims to modify specific portions of an utterance while preserving the remaining speech. Existing approaches primarily focus on word-level content modification and typically treat content, speaker, and emotion editing as separate tasks, limiting both editing granularity and flexibility. We propose UniSAE, a unified speech attribute editing framework which supports composable speaker, emotion and content editing from sub-phoneme to word level within a single architecture. UniSAE introduces a Discrete Phonetic PosteriorGram (DPPG) representation that factorizes speech content into discrete tokens encoding phoneme identity, pronunciation variants, and duration, enabling direct phoneme- and sub-phoneme-level editing. For higher-level modifications, an autoregressive content transformer predicts edited DPPG sequences for word-level content editing. The edited sequences are rendered into speech by a diffusion-based acoustic decoder, conditioned on disentangled speaker and emotion representations. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed unified framework supports precise speaker and emotion control, content editing at multiple granularities, and joint modification of all three attributes within a single framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 UniSAE，一个统一的语音属性编辑框架，支持说话人、情感和内容编辑，编辑粒度从亚音素到词级别。其核心是离散音素后验图 (DPPG) 表示，将语音内容分解为音素、发音变体和时长的离散标记；使用自回归内容变换器预测编辑后的 DPPG 序列，并通过扩散声学解码器生成语音。实验证明该框架能精确控制说话人和情感，实现多粒度内容编辑及三种属性的联合修改。
Motivation: 现有语音编辑方法主要关注词级内容修改，且通常将内容、说话人和情感编辑视为独立任务，限制了编辑的粒度和灵活性。
Method: 提出 UniSAE 框架，包含：(1) 离散音素后验图 (DPPG) 表示，用于编码音素身份、发音变体和时长；(2) 自回归内容变换器，用于词级内容编辑并预测编辑后的 DPPG 序列；(3) 扩散声学解码器，以解耦的说话人和情感表示为条件，从编辑后的序列生成语音。
Result: 实验结果表明，UniSAE 支持精确的说话人和情感控制、多粒度内容编辑（从亚音素到词级），并能在单一框架内联合修改所有三种属性。
Conclusion: 该统一框架实现了灵活的语音属性编辑，支持多种粒度和属性组合，超越现有分离式方法。

papers.title: SkillSpotter: Pose-Aware Multi-View Skilled Action Detection and Grading in Ego-Exo Videos
papers.abstract_en: To enable personalized, real-time coaching using Augmented Reality glasses or fixed camera setups in domains such as sports, cooking, or music, a system must understand not just what a person does, but how well they execute an activity. In an ego-exo video setting, this requires simultaneously detecting individual skilled actions and classifying each as correct or needing improvement, which Ego-Exo4D's proficiency demonstration benchmark formalized. We first adapt seven state-of-the-art temporal action detection architectures to this task, extend the evaluation protocol to disentangle detection from grading, and show that existing methods grade near-randomly. We then introduce SkillSpotter, a pose-aware multi-view architecture that jointly detects and grades skilled actions through three task-specific modules: (1) adaptive temporal suppression to handle the varying density of skilled actions across diverse activities, (2) gated 3D body pose fusion to leverage body kinematics as a complementary signal to visual features, and (3) bidirectional cross-view attention to combine ego and exo views effectively. SkillSpotter improves class-specific mAP from 12.40 to 21.82 (+76%) and balanced accuracy from 55.99% to 60.40% over the best baseline. SkillSpotter's modules transfer to other temporal action detection models with consistent gains, and our method generalizes beyond Ego-Exo4D to HoloAssist. Code: https://github.com/eth-siplab/SkillSpotter
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SkillSpotter，一种姿态感知的多视角架构，用于自我-外部视频中的技能动作检测和分级。在Ego-Exo4D基准上，将类别特定mAP从12.40提升至21.82（+76%），平衡准确率从55.99%提升至60.40%。
Motivation: 现有方法在自我-外部视频中检测技能动作并分级时表现接近随机，需要更好的联合检测与分级方法。
Method: SkillSpotter包含三个模块：(1)自适应时间抑制处理技能动作密度变化；(2)门控3D身体姿态融合利用身体运动学作为视觉特征的补充信号；(3)双向跨视角注意力结合自我和外部视角。
Result: 类别特定mAP从12.40提升至21.82（+76%），平衡准确率从55.99%提升至60.40%，且模块可迁移到其他模型，泛化到HoloAssist。

papers.title: Can Tabular In-Context Learners Generalize to Biomolecular Property Prediction?
papers.abstract_en: Predicting biomolecular properties from limited labeled data is a central bottleneck in protein engineering and small-molecule design. As strong pretrained encoders now supply rich fixed-length representations, the difficulty has shifted from representation learning to building a data-efficient predictor for the few-shot regime. Tabular foundation models such as TabPFN3 and TabICL are unlikely candidates for this role: they are in-context learners pretrained on synthetic tables drawn from random causal graphs, a generative prior with no obvious correspondence to the processes that produce protein sequences or molecular graphs. That this tabular, causal inductive bias should transfer to biomolecular data at all is unintuitive, yet we find it does. Treating each method as a predictor-representation pair, we evaluate across two domains. Over a fixed ESMC representation, tabular in-context learning is consistently competitive for protein fitness regression on ProteinGym and a diverse esterase dataset. For small-molecule classification with ECFP/RDKit descriptors, no single pairing dominates across TDC ADMET, MoleculeNet, FS-Mol, and DrugOOD; representation choice becomes a primary determinant, as expected when the predictor's own prior is indifferent to molecular structure. We conclude that tabular foundation models are strong performers on biomolecular prediction tasks, but that their performance depends strongly on the sequence or molecular representation used.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究表格上下文学习模型（如TabPFN3和TabICL）是否能泛化到生物分子性质预测任务。这些模型在随机因果图生成的合成表格上预训练，与生物分子过程无关。实验发现，在固定ESMC表示下，对于蛋白质适应度回归，表格上下文学习表现有竞争力；对于小分子分类，表示选择成为主要因素。结论是表格基础模型在生物分子预测上表现强，但依赖表示选择。
Motivation: 从有限标注数据预测生物分子性质是蛋白质工程和小分子设计的瓶颈。现有编码器提供固定表示后，难点转向数据高效的预测器。表格基础模型看似不可能胜任，因其生成先验与生物分子过程无关。
Method: 将每种方法视为预测器-表示对，在蛋白质适应度回归和小分子分类两个领域评估。蛋白质适应度使用固定ESMC表示，小分子使用ECFP/RDKit描述符，在多个基准上测试。
Result: 对于蛋白质适应度回归，表格上下文学习在ProteinGym和酯酶数据集上表现一致有竞争力。对于小分子分类，没有单一方法主导，表示选择成为主要决定因素。
Conclusion: 表格基础模型在生物分子预测任务上表现强，但性能强烈依赖于所使用的序列或分子表示。

papers.title: WildProp: Visual Estimation of Wildlife Body Proportions at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Population-level morphometric measurements underpin ecological and evolutionary studies but traditionally require controlled imaging or physical specimen handling, limiting scalability. We present WildProp, a training-free framework that estimates wildlife body proportion distributions directly from large-scale, unconstrained image repositories. We cast morphometric estimation as a retrieval-driven correspondence problem: given a single user-annotated canonical image, WildProp performs pose-aware retrieval using foundation model features, transfers part endpoints via dense patch-level matching, filters predictions using geometric consistency, and aggregates measurements across retrieved images to estimate population-level ratio distributions. Unlike supervised keypoint pipelines, our approach adapts to arbitrary species and user-defined parts without per-species training. Evaluations on three large morphometric datasets spanning birds and amphibians show median relative errors of 10-20%. We further highlight the broad applicability of our approach through a number of case studies measuring various proportions across diverse taxa, including birds, frogs, insects, and flowers. Ablations demonstrate that pose-aware retrieval is critical for stable estimation, while robust aggregation mitigates keypoint and pose noise. Our results indicate that carefully curated 2D correspondences over web-scale imagery can provide scalable morphometric proxies for comparative and subgroup analyses across taxa, geography, and seasonality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: WildProp 是一种无需训练的框架，通过检索和密集匹配从大规模无约束图像中估计野生动物身体比例分布。该方法利用基础模型特征进行姿态感知检索，并利用几何一致性过滤预测，最终在鸟类和两栖动物数据集上实现了10-20%的中位相对误差。
Motivation: 传统形态测量需要受控成像或物理标本处理，难以规模化。论文旨在从网络图像中直接估计种群层面的身体比例分布，无需针对物种进行训练。
Method: 提出基于检索的对应问题：给定一张带标注的规范图像，通过姿态感知检索找到类似图像，利用密集块级匹配传递部位端点，通过几何一致性过滤预测，并聚合测量结果得到比例分布。
Result: 在三个大型形态测量数据集（鸟类和两栖动物）上，中位相对误差为10-20%。消融实验表明姿态感知检索和鲁棒聚合对稳定估计至关重要。
Conclusion: 精心策划的2D对应关系可以从网络规模图像中提供可扩展的形态测量代理，适用于跨分类群、地理和季节性的比较和亚组分析。

papers.title: The Past Is Prologue: A Plug-in Controller for Selective Updates in Sequentially Evolving LLM Memory
papers.abstract_en: Sequentially evolving LLM memory enables agents to reuse past experience, but existing systems usually deploy each locally generated memory update without checking whether it improves future behavior. As a result, updates that help the current task may overwrite useful knowledge, introduce over-specific rules, or bias the final memory toward recent examples. We propose Janus, a plug-in memory controller that decides whether to accept a candidate memory update or retain the previous memory. To make this decision efficient, Janus uses a Memory Momentum Trigger to identify suspicious deviations in the memory-update trajectory, and compares old and new memories on a compact hybrid evaluation set of coverage, boundary, and fresh tasks instead of replaying the full history. Janus is method-agnostic and wraps existing updaters without changing their update rules. Across six datasets, two backbone LLMs, and two memory updaters, Janus improves average accuracy by +2.7 to +4.6 points over the corresponding base updaters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Janus，一种即插即用的记忆控制器，用于决定是否接受大语言模型（LLM）在顺序演进中的记忆更新，以解决现有系统盲目更新导致知识覆盖、过拟合或偏向近期样本的问题。Janus 利用“记忆动量触发器”检测更新轨迹中的可疑偏差，并通过紧凑的混合评估集（覆盖、边界、新鲜任务）比较新旧记忆，无需回放完整历史。在六个数据集、两个骨干LLM和两个记忆更新器上，Janus 将平均准确率提升 +2.7 到 +4.6 个百分点。
Motivation: 现有顺序演进LLM记忆系统通常不加检查地接受每次本地生成的记忆更新，导致有用的知识被覆盖、引入过具体规则或使最终记忆偏向近期样本。
Method: Janus 是一个即插即用的记忆控制器，使用 Memory Momentum Trigger 检测记忆更新轨迹中的可疑偏差，并在紧凑的混合评估集（覆盖、边界、新鲜任务）上比较新旧记忆，而非回放完整历史，以决定是否接受更新。
Result: 在六个数据集、两个骨干LLM和两个记忆更新器上，Janus 相对于基础更新器将平均准确率提升 +2.7 到 +4.6 个百分点。
Conclusion: Janus 是一种与具体更新方法无关的插件式控制器，能有效选择有益的记忆更新，提升任务性能。

papers.title: Visualizing High-Dimensional Graph Embeddings via Informed Multi-View Projections
authors: Yifan Hu (1) ((1) Khoury College of Computer Sciences
papers.abstract_en: Graphs are commonly visualized in 2D, where humans readily interpret spatial relationships, yet such layouts often distort higher-dimensional structure. We propose to embed graphs in high-dimensional space and search for informative 2D viewpoints that optimize aesthetic and readability metrics (e.g., edge crossings and angular resolution), enabled by a novel differentiable surrogate for edge crossings. Numerical experiments show that these viewpoints consistently outperform standard 2D layouts, and can even surpass methods explicitly designed to optimize these metrics. We further introduce DataFly, an interactive system for exploring multiple candidate viewpoints through seamless navigation. A usability study demonstrates that our approach reveals structural patterns that remain hidden in conventional 2D visualizations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在高维空间中嵌入图，并搜索信息丰富的2D视角，以优化美学和可读性指标（如边交叉和角分辨率），通过一种新的可微边交叉代理实现。实验表明这些视角优于标准2D布局，甚至能超过专门优化这些指标的方法。同时介绍了交互式系统DataFly，通过无缝导航探索多个候选视角。可用性研究表明该方法能揭示传统2D可视化中隐藏的结构模式。
Motivation: 传统2D图布局常扭曲高维结构，缺乏从高维嵌入中自动选择最佳视图的方法。
Method: 提出在高维空间中嵌入图，并利用可微边交叉代理优化视觉指标（边交叉、角分辨率等），搜索信息丰富的2D投影。
Result: 实验表明优化后的2D投影在边交叉和角分辨率等指标上一致优于标准2D布局，甚至超过专门优化这些指标的方法。
Conclusion: 该方法能揭示传统2D可视化中隐藏的结构模式，DataFly系统支持交互式探索。
