papers.title: Dual Sparse Aggregation Transformer for Multispectral Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based approaches have obtained excellent performance in multispectral object detection tasks due to their ability to model long-range dependencies and capture complementary information. However, previous transformer-based multispectral detection methods tend to use all available tokens for similarity calculation, which results in redundant information interaction from irrelevant areas, leading to degraded detection performance. To overcome this challenge, we propose a novel Dual Sparse Aggregation Transformer (DSAFormer) for multispectral object detection, which consists of a Dual Sparse Transformer (DSFormer) and a Learnable Addition Fusion Block (LAFB). Specifically, the DSFormer is designed to exploit and boost cross-modal complementary information, thereby improving detection performance. It incorporates three key components: A Spatial Sparse Multi-Head Cross-Attention (SSMHCA) mechanism selectively captures cross-modal relationships at the spatial level by reserving only the high query-key similarity scores, eliminating irrelevant interactions. A Channel Sparse Multi-Head Cross-Attention (CSMHCA) mechanism performs similar sparse calculations at the channel level to enhance feature representation and filter out low matching query-key. A Multi-Scale Feature Refinement Layer (MSFRL) is developed to aggregate hierarchical features and suppress redundant information. To effectively fuse multimodal features, the LAFB is introduced to aggregate intramodal and intermodal feature information by feature reweighting. Extensive experimental results have demonstrated that our proposed DSAFormer achieves better detection performance against state-of-the-art methods on four public datasets, including the MFAD, FLIR, M$^3$FD, and LLVIP. The source code of our DSAFormer will be released at https://github.com/WenCongWu/DSAFormer.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Dual Sparse Aggregation Transformer (DSAFormer) 用于多光谱目标检测，包含 Dual Sparse Transformer (DSFormer) 和 Learnable Addition Fusion Block (LAFB)。DSFormer 通过空间稀疏多头交叉注意力和通道稀疏多头交叉注意力减少无关 token 的信息交互，并利用多尺度特征细化层聚合层级特征。LAFB 通过特征重加权融合模态内和模态间信息。在四个公共数据集上达到 SOTA。
Motivation: 现有多光谱检测 Transformer 使用所有 token 计算相似度，导致无关区域的信息冗余，降低检测性能。
Method: 提出 DSAFormer，包含 DSFormer 和 LAFB。DSFormer 有空间稀疏多头交叉注意力（SSMHCA）、通道稀疏多头交叉注意力（CSMHCA）和多尺度特征细化层（MSFRL）。LAFB 通过特征重加权融合模态内和模态间特征。
Result: 在 MFAD、FLIR、M$^3$FD、LLVIP 四个数据集上超越现有方法。
Conclusion: DSAFormer 通过稀疏注意力减少冗余交互，提升多光谱检测性能，为多模态融合提供新思路。

papers.title: Dense Structural Priors for Sparse Functional Landmark Localization in Surgical Videos
papers.abstract_en: Vision foundation models such as SAM 3 can provide transferable object-level structure across diverse surgical video conditions, but segmentation outputs do not explicitly encode the action-conditioned semantics that define functional surgical landmarks. Estimating instrument extent and geometry differs from localizing the tip or anchor relevant to clipping, grasping, or dissecting. We investigate vision foundation model-enabled sparse action-aware landmark localization, using zero-shot, point-prompted structural masks to provide dense instrument-level context without manual pixel-level mask annotations. We propose a lightweight refinement framework that uses SAM 3 as a structural prior. A coarse multi-frame network predicts tip and anchor prompts, generating non-oracle masks that are fused with visual and heatmap features to refine functional landmark predictions. We compare direct mask-augmented supervision, prediction-derived mask-prior refinement, and auxiliary mask supervision to examine how vision foundation model-derived structure should enter a precision-oriented localization system. Experiments on 7,867 clips from 60 surgical videos spanning YouTube, Cholec80, HeiChole, SurgVU, and CRCD evaluate the approach under heterogeneous conditions. Without manual pixel-level mask annotations for training, the proposed model achieves overall F1 scores of 72.4% for tip and 58.0% for anchor localization. Directly imposing masks on heatmap targets biases learning toward broad tool regions, whereas prediction-derived priors and auxiliary supervision provide effective intermediate structural guidance for action-dependent landmark prediction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用视觉基础模型（如 SAM 3）作为结构先验，在手术视频中实现稀疏的动作感知功能地标定位。方法通过轻量级细化框架，结合多帧网络预测的提示点和 SAM 生成的掩码，融合视觉与热图特征来细化地标预测。在 7,867 个手术视频片段上的实验表明，无需人工像素级掩码标注，模型在尖端和锚点定位上分别达到 72.4% 和 58.0% 的 F1 分数。
Motivation: 现有分割输出不编码动作条件语义，难以直接定位与手术动作（如夹持、切割）相关的功能地标，且手动标注像素级掩码成本高昂。
Method: 提出基于 SAM 3 结构先验的轻量级细化框架：粗多帧网络预测尖端和锚点提示，生成非 oracle 掩码，与视觉和热图特征融合以细化功能地标预测。比较了直接掩码增强监督、预测派生掩码先验细化和辅助掩码监督三种方式。
Result: 在 YouTube、Cholec80、HeiChole、SurgVU、CRCD 等数据集上的 7,867 个视频片段中，无需人工像素级掩码，模型在尖端和锚点定位的 F1 分数分别为 72.4% 和 58.0%。直接施加掩码会偏向宽泛工具区域，而预测派生先验和辅助监督提供有效中间结构指导。
Conclusion: 视觉基础模型提供的结构先验可有效辅助手术功能地标定位，无需密集标注，但需注意掩码的引入方式以避免学习偏差。

papers.title: Auditing Generalization in AI-Generated Video Detection: A Six-Control Protocol and the VidAudit Toolkit
papers.abstract_en: AI-generated video detection benchmarks such as GenVidBench and AIGVDBench are the de facto leaderboards, yet most evaluation protocols leave uncontrolled confounds that can inflate reported generalization. As an existence proof, a three-feature clip-length classifier reaches a leave-one-generator-out (LOGO) AUC of 0.998 on GenVidBench under unaudited evaluation, while measuring nothing about motion. A 20-paper survey finds none applying all six standard controls that would catch this, so we combine them into an audited protocol and apply it to six representative feature sources (three published detectors and three repurposed signal sources), re-running it cross-dataset on AIGVDBench. The audit both debunks and certifies: the trivial classifier collapses to near chance (0.529), a CLIP baseline is caught carrying dataset identity, and the 2025 forensic detector WaveRep clears the floor at out-of-distribution LOGO AUC 0.996 with chance-level real-vs-real coherence. At a deployable FPR of 0.1%, multiple high-AUC methods fall to single-digit recall and the leaderboard order changes, so we recommend an audited tuple (AUC, above-floor margin, operating-point recall, and calibration) over a single number. As a white-box positive control, we add TemporalSpec (codec motion vectors); via cross-substrate feature fusion (XSFF), a second substrate adds genuine complementarity that survives the audit. We release VidAudit, to our knowledge the largest unified and audited detector collection for this task, providing 14 detectors behind one plugin API, a leaderboard, and Croissant metadata, available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/vidaudit. Together, the protocol and toolkit move evaluation from leaderboard rank toward whether a result measures what it claims.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI生成视频检测基准中存在的泛化评估漏洞，提出六控制审计协议和VidAudit工具包。通过实验揭示简单分类器在未审计评估下可虚高超高AUC，而审计后性能骤降；同时验证了WaveRep等检测器的鲁棒性。推荐使用多元指标（AUC、margin、召回率、校准）替代单一分数。
Motivation: 现有AI生成视频检测基准如GenVidBench和AIGVDBench的评估协议存在未控制的混淆变量，可能夸大泛化性能，导致排名不可靠。
Method: 提出六控制审计协议，包含一系列标准化控制措施；收集14个检测器构建VidAudit工具包，并引入TemporalSpec（基于编码运动向量）和跨底物特征融合（XSFF）作为正控制。
Result: 未经审计时，一个简单分类器在GenVidBench上达到LOGO AUC 0.998；审计后降至0.529。CLIP基线被发现携带数据集身份偏差。WaveRep在审计后仍保持0.996 AUC，且真实-真实相干性为随机水平。在0.1% FPR下，多个高AUC方法召回率降至个位数，排行榜顺序改变。
Conclusion: 六控制审计协议能揭露评估中的虚假泛化，推荐使用多元指标评估检测器。VidAudit提供了统一的审计平台和排行榜。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Compilation: Evaluating Faithful Natural-Language-to-Lean Statement Formalization
papers.abstract_en: Theorem-proving benchmarks evaluate proof search against fixed formal statements, but natural-language-to-Lean formalization must generate the formal statement itself. In this setting, compilation is only a validity check: a Lean declaration may type-check while omitting hypotheses, changing domains, or expressing a vacuous claim. We study faithful statement formalization as both an evaluation problem and a bottleneck-attribution problem. On a 400-entry graduate-level benchmark spanning real analysis, complex analysis, topology, and algebra, our protocol combines Lean compilation, cross-model semantic judging, and human expert calibration. The resulting picture is different from compile-rate evaluation: a full tool-augmented agent reaches 89.5% compilation but only 60.5% consensus faithfulness, exposing a 29.0-point compile-pass but consensus-unfaithful gap. Targeted human audits support the metric as a conservative decision boundary: across available case-level audits, 96.0% of consensus-positive outputs are human-confirmed faithful, while 82.4% of compile-pass consensus-negative outputs are human-confirmed semantic failures. Under this metric, existing one-shot formalizer models and prover-oriented Lean models remain low, suggesting that formal validity, proof-oriented Lean competence, and faithful statement generation should be reported separately. We then use a full $2^3$ factorial design to decompose three recurring interventions in formalization pipelines: parametric expert drafting, Mathlib/context search, and Lean elaboration feedback. Elaboration feedback is the largest validity intervention, but it also exposes a larger compile-pass semantic-failure bucket; search mainly improves grounding and selectivity; and fine-tuned drafting is largely substitutable in this tool stack once feedback and grounding are available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究自然语言到Lean的形式化语句的忠实性评估问题。现有定理证明基准聚焦于固定形式语句上的证明搜索，而自然语言到Lean的形式化需要生成语句本身，编译通过不保证语义忠实性。作者提出了结合Lean编译、跨模型语义判断和人类专家校准的评估协议，并在400条研究生级基准（涵盖实分析、复分析、拓扑和代数）上评估。结果显示，工具增强代理的编译率达89.5%，但共识忠实性仅60.5%，存在29.0个百分点的差距。人类审计表明，96.0%的共识阳性输出被人类确认忠实，而82.4%的编译通过但共识阴性输出被确认为语义失败。全因子实验设计分解了参数化专家起草、Mathlib/语境搜索和Lean细化反馈三种干预，发现细化反馈是最大的有效性干预，但也暴露了更大的编译通过但语义失败的桶。
Motivation: 定理证明基准评估的是给定形式语句上的证明搜索，而自然语言到Lean的形式化需要生成语句本身。编译（类型检查）通过并不保证语句的语义忠实性，例如可能漏掉假设、改变定义域或表达空泛断言。因此需要研究忠实性评估问题及瓶颈归因。
Method: 提出评估协议，结合Lean编译、跨模型语义判断（基于多种语言模型的语义一致性）和人类专家校准。在400条基准上，对工具增强代理的编译通过输出进行两阶段判断：先由多个模型投票得出共识忠实性，再由人类专家审计争议样本。进一步采用全2^3因子实验设计，分解参数化专家起草、Mathlib/语境搜索和Lean细化反馈三种干预对有效性和忠实性的贡献。
Result: 工具增强代理编译率89.5%但共识忠实性仅60.5%，存在29.0个百分点的差距。人类审计显示，96.0%的共识阳性输出被确认忠实，82.4%的编译通过但共识阴性输出被确认为语义失败。现有单次形式化模型和面向证明的Lean模型在这一指标上表现低。全因子实验表明，细化反馈是最大的有效性干预，但也增加了编译通过但语义失败的比率；搜索主要改善接地性和选择性；微调起草在该工具栈中可被替代。
Conclusion: 形式有效性（编译通过）与语句忠实性应分别报告。细化反馈虽然最有效，但会暴露更多语义失败；未来的形式化系统应平衡正确性与忠实性。现有的证明导向模型在语句生成上能力不足。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Estimating Supply Incrementality in Two-sided Marketplaces: A Causal Machine Learning Approach
papers.abstract_en: In two-sided marketplaces with heterogeneous products, it is important to understand the causal relationship between additional supply and marketplace outcomes, such as the total quantity transacted or transaction value in the marketplace. This paper studies a causal machine learning approach to estimating this relationship across product segments. We use the Airbnb marketplace as an example, focusing on the impact of additional listing supply on total bookings, but the methodology applies to other two-sided marketplaces. Our approach combines double/debiased machine learning with a hierarchical Bayesian framework that leverages pre-existing knowledge as priors. We construct tractable and informative features for the model by leveraging measures of product segment similarity from the geospatial literature. We find that such a model provides plausible estimates of the marketplace returns to additional supply and strong out of sample performance.
papers.comment: 5 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the KDD 2025 Workshop on Causal Inference and Machine Learning in Practice (not presented)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究双边市场中额外供给对交易量的因果效应，提出结合双重/去偏机器学习与层次贝叶斯框架的方法，利用地理空间相似性构造特征，以Airbnb为例估计供给增量对预订量的影响。摘要显示该方法能提供合理的估计和良好的样本外表现。
Motivation: 在双边市场中，理解额外供给（如Airbnb的房源）对交易总量的因果影响至关重要，但现有方法难以处理产品细分异质性。
Method: 采用双重/去偏机器学习（double/debiased machine learning）与层次贝叶斯框架，结合先验知识，并利用地理空间文献中的产品细分相似性度量构造特征。
Result: 摘要报告该方法能提供合理的供给增量回报估计，并具有强样本外表现。
Conclusion: 该方法适用于其他双边市场，但摘要未讨论局限性。

summary_sections.result: 摘要报告该方法能提供合理的供给增量回报估计，并具有强样本外表现。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法适用于其他双边市场，但摘要未讨论局限性。

papers.title: A Three-Phase Foundation Model for Tax-Aware Personalized Portfolio Management
papers.abstract_en: We present a three-phase deep reinforcement learning system for personalized portfolio management that addresses three limitations shared by all prior financial RL work: 1) ticker lock-in, 2) monolithic objectives , and 3) static user models. Phase 1 pretrains a ticker-identity-free cross asset encoder via self-supervised learning on a multi-asset corpus, augmented by a frozen parallel branch using Chronos, a T5-based time series foundation model, fused via a learned gating mechanism. To our knowledge, this is the first application of a time series foundation model to portfolio management RL. The encoder generalizes to any publicly traded asset via a 50-dimensional observable metadata vector that requires no retraining for new tickers. Phase 2 fine-tunes a MoE (Mixture of Experts) portfolio actor critic with PPO under an objective-conditioned reward that simultaneously serves six distinct investment goals sampled per episode: short-term alpha, short-term gain, long-term gain, capital preservation, tax-loss harvesting, and long-term-gains-only. A MoE architecture assigns each objective to a specialized expert head (momentum, growth, defensive, tax-aware), and a learned intent router blends experts based on the active objective and current market regime, which eliminates cross-objective gradient conflict. Phase 3 adds a lightweight personalization layer further adapted at inference time to each individual via a 76-parameter LoRA module fine-tuned on real brokerage transaction history, inferring investment objectives from revealed trading behavior rather than questionnaires. A natural language intent parser converts free-form goals directly into structured investment objective parameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个三阶段深度强化学习系统用于个性化投资组合管理，解决了现有金融强化学习方法中的三个局限性：股票代码锁定、单一目标、静态用户模型。第一阶段通过自监督学习预训练一个与股票代码无关的跨资产编码器，并融合基于T5的时间序列基础模型Chronos；第二阶段使用PPO和MoE架构同时优化六个投资目标；第三阶段通过LoRA模块实现个性化适应。
Motivation: 现有金融强化学习方法受限于固定股票代码集合、单一优化目标和静态用户模型，无法灵活处理新资产、多目标冲突和个性化需求。
Method: 提出三阶段系统：1) 自监督预训练跨资产编码器（融合Chronos时间序列基础模型）；2) MoE架构的PPO强化学习，每个投资目标对应一个专家头，通过意图路由器根据当前目标和市场状态混合专家输出；3) 基于LoRA的个性化层，利用真实交易历史推断用户目标。
Result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果，仅描述了系统设计。
Conclusion: 该系统首次将时间序列基础模型应用于投资组合管理强化学习，并实现了无需重新训练即可推广到新资产、多目标协同优化和动态个性化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Multistage Defer Trees for Hybrid Interpretability: If at First You Can't Succeed, Tree Again
papers.abstract_en: Recent work has shown that well-optimized individual decision trees can match complex black box models in some settings, primarily in noisy domains. For the remaining settings, however, complex ensembled compositions of trees often achieve higher accuracy at the cost of interpretability, leaving practitioners with difficult modeling decisions along an accuracy-interpretability tradeoff. Ideally, we would like to classify as much of the data as possible with one or a small number of trees, achieving interpretability for most samples while maintaining state-of-the-art accuracy. We introduce Multistage Defer Trees: a sequence of sparse decision trees that each make predictions for most samples, while deferring a small proportion to the next tree in the sequence or, ultimately, to a black box. We demonstrate that we can train this model class to match the performance of complex tree-based ensembles while routing most samples through only one or a small number of sparse decision trees. We discuss a range of techniques for training these models while maintaining simplicity. Our method expands the accuracy--interpretability frontier in settings where single-tree methods remain insufficient, demonstrating that even when complex models are necessary, they need not be fully opaque.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出多阶段推迟树（Multistage Defer Trees），通过序列化的稀疏决策树逐步将难以分类的样本推迟到更复杂的模型（包括黑箱），在保持高精度的同时为大多数样本提供可解释性。实验表明该方法在复杂树集成模型精度相当的条件下，将大多数样本路由至少量稀疏决策树。
Motivation: 现有决策树在噪声领域可匹配黑箱模型，但在高精度需求场景中，集成树虽精度更高却牺牲了可解释性，导致用户面临精度-可解释性权衡。
Method: 提出多阶段推迟树：训练一系列稀疏决策树，每棵树对大部分样本做出预测，仅将小部分样本推迟到下一棵树或最终的黑箱模型。讨论了保持简单性的多种训练技术。
Result: 该方法在复杂树集成模型精度匹配的情况下，使大部分样本仅需通过一或少量稀疏决策树即可完成分类，扩展了精度-可解释性前沿。
Conclusion: 即使在需要复杂模型的场景中，模型也无需完全不可解释；该方法为单棵树不足的领域提供了新的可解释性方案。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Hierarchical Clustering As a Novel Solution to the Notorious Multicollinearity Problem in Observational Causal Inference
papers.abstract_en: Multicollinearity is a long lasting challenge in observational causal inference, especially in regressions -- highly correlated independent variables make it hard to isolate their individual impacts on outcomes of interest. While common solutions such as shrinkage estimators and principal component regressions are helpful in prediction problems, a crucial limitation hinders their applicability to causal inference problems -- they cannot provide the original causal relationships. To fill the gap, we present an innovative and intuitive solution, by employing hierarchical clustering to aggregate data in a way that effectively alleviates collinearity. This method is generally applicable to causal problems featuring multicollinearity. We use a marketing application to demonstrate how and why it works. Expenditures on different advertising channels often exhibit correlations, making it exceedingly difficult to separately measure their impact. Many previous studies proposed to leverage granular cross-sectional data for better identification but, to our knowledge, none explicitly addressed multicollinearity, which undermines causal identification even with granular data. We propose to hierarchically cluster geographic units based on marketing spend correlation to reduce collinearity, and to implement a Bayesian Marketing Mix Model with cluster-level data. Such clustering happens in two steps -- we first normalize and demean geo-level data to establish a common scale and to eliminate the common trends; we then calculate pairwise distance to summarize marketing spend correlation between geos and cluster the ones with moderate to strong correlation. Both descriptive evidence and regression analysis affirm that such hierarchical clustering effectively mitigates collinearity and facilitates the separate identification of the impact of different marketing channels.
papers.comment: Presented at the KDD 2023 Workshop on Causal Inference and Machine Learning in Practice, Long Beach, CA; also presented at the 2023 Joint Statistical Meetings
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用层次聚类（hierarchical clustering）来解决观察性因果推断中常见的多重共线性问题，特别是在回归分析中高度相关的自变量使得难以分离各自的影响。该方法通过基于相关性对地理单元进行聚类，减少共线性，并在贝叶斯营销组合模型中应用。描述性证据和回归分析表明，层次聚类能有效缓解共线性并帮助区分不同营销渠道的影响。
Motivation: 多重共线性是观察性因果推断中长期存在的挑战，现有方法如收缩估计和主成分回归虽能用于预测，但无法保持原始因果关系。本文旨在填补这一空白，提出一种能保留因果解释的解决方案。
Method: 提出两步骤层次聚类方法：首先对地理级别数据进行归一化和去趋势化以建立共同尺度并消除共同趋势；然后基于营销支出相关性计算地理单元间的成对距离，将具有中等至强相关性的单元聚类。基于聚类后的数据实现贝叶斯营销组合模型（Bayesian Marketing Mix Model）。
Result: 描述性证据和回归分析均表明，该层次聚类方法有效减轻了共线性，并有助于单独识别不同营销渠道的影响。
Conclusion: 该方法适用于存在多重共线性的因果问题，尤其适用于广告渠道支出相关场景，能够通过聚类减少共线性而不损失因果解释。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wait, am I Being Fair? Characterizing Deductive Stereotyping and Mitigating It with Fair-GCG
papers.abstract_en: Warning: This paper contains several toxic and offensive statements. While reasoning generally improves fairness in recent large language models (LLMs), failures persist. In this work, we identify a failure mode, deductive stereotyping, in which models apply population-level statistical regularities to individual cases, producing logically coherent yet socially biased inferences. We provide a statistical interpretation of this phenomenon. To steer models toward fairness-aware reasoning, we propose a reasoning-time injection framework. We further introduce Fair-GCG to systematically discover effective injection phrases. Injection phrases discovered by Fair-GCG improve performance across multiple fairness benchmarks, generalize from smaller to larger LLMs, improves reasoning-level fairness, reduces bias in open-ended generation, and transfer to real-world fairness-sensitive tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文识别了大型语言模型（LLM）推理中的一种失败模式——演绎刻板印象（deductive stereotyping），即模型将群体统计规律应用于个体案例，导致逻辑一致但带有社会偏见的推断。作者提供了统计解释，并提出推理时注入框架及Fair-GCG方法来自动发现有效的注入短语，以引导模型进行公平感知推理。实验表明，Fair-GCG发现的短语在多个公平基准上提升性能，能泛化到更大模型，减少开放生成中的偏见，并迁移到真实敏感任务。
Motivation: 尽管推理通常能提升LLM的公平性，但演绎刻板印象作为一种失败模式仍然存在，使得模型在个体层面产生有偏推断。需要识别并缓解这一问题，以实现更公平的AI推理。
Method: 提出推理时注入框架，并引入Fair-GCG方法系统性地搜索能有效缓解演绎刻板印象的注入短语。
Result: Fair-GCG发现的注入短语在多个公平基准上提升性能，从较小LLM泛化到较大LLM，改善推理级公平性，减少开放生成偏见，并能迁移到现实公平敏感任务。
Conclusion: 论文强调推理时注入框架和Fair-GCG可以有效缓解演绎刻板印象，提升LLM的公平性，且方法具有泛化性和迁移性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PerceptionRubrics: Calibrating Multimodal Evaluation to Human Perception
papers.abstract_en: We introduce PerceptionRubrics, a rubric-based evaluation framework that addresses the gap between saturated benchmark scores and real-world brittleness. Shifting evaluation from holistic semantic matching to rigorous atomic auditing, PerceptionRubrics pairs 1,038 information-dense images with over 10,000 instance-specific rubrics. These criteria are derived from golden captions constructed via a novel Circular Peer-Review consensus pipeline and then distilled into a dual-stream system of Must-Right (essential facts) and Easy-Wrong (fine-grained details) rubrics. Crucially, PerceptionRubrics implements a Gated Scoring mechanism: unlike linear averages, failure on mandatory visual facts triggers sharp binary penalties. Extensive evaluation yields critical insights: (1) The Reliability Gap: models often verify fragmented elements correctly yet fail strict conjunctive constraints, exposing brittleness in dense domains; (2) Open-Closed Stratification: contrary to reasoning trends, we reveal a persistent 8% perception deficit between open-source and proprietary frontiers; and (3) Human-Aligned Rigor: our gated metrics substantially out-align conventional benchmarks, validating that strict perceptual fidelity is the prerequisite for reliable generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于评分规则（rubric）的多模态评估框架 PerceptionRubrics，通过 1,038 张信息密集的图像和超过 10,000 条实例级评分准则，从整体语义匹配转向严格的原子级审核。引入双流系统（Must-Right 和 Easy-Wrong）及门控评分机制，对强制性视觉事实的失败施加二元惩罚。实验揭示三个关键发现：可靠性差距、开源与闭源模型之间 8% 的感知差距，以及门控指标与人类感知的高度对齐。
Motivation: 现有基准分数饱和但实际应用脆弱，需要更严格的评估方法来衡量多模态模型的感知能力。
Method: 构建金色描述（golden captions）的循环同行评审共识管道，从中提取 Must-Right（基本事实）和 Easy-Wrong（细粒度细节）评分准则，并采用门控评分机制，对强制性事实的失败进行二元惩罚。
Result: 模型在碎片化元素上表现正确，但在严格合取约束下失败，暴露密集领域的脆弱性；开源与专有前沿模型之间存在 8% 的感知差距；门控指标与人类对齐程度显著优于传统基准。
Conclusion: 严格的感知保真度是可靠生成的前提，所提评估框架为多模态评测提供了更鲁棒的标准。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: The Remittance Blueprint: Data-driven Intelligence for Sri Lanka
papers.abstract_en: This study analyzes Sri Lankan migration and remittances over 32 years (1994-2025). Using a 384-month harmonized dataset, we apply exploratory data analysis, stationarity corrected time-series modeling (ADF, Johansen, VAR/VECM), and supervised learning. Results reveal remittance inflows are primarily driven by external macroeconomic variables, specifically exchange rate dynamics and global oil prices, rather than domestic indicators. Impulse response analysis confirms the asymmetric impact of currency depreciation and oil price shocks. Predictively, multivariate machine learning models outperform traditional univariate approaches; Ridge Regression achieves a 73.8% accuracy improvement over SARIMA (Annualized RMSE: USD 494.8 Mn). The optimized framework projects 2026 remittances at USD 9,001 million under stable conditions. These findings highlight the structural dependence of remittances on global economies, emphasizing the need for robust exchange rate policies, skilled migration, and formal financial channels to enhance long-term economic resilience.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析斯里兰卡1994-2025年的移民和汇款数据，使用平稳性校正的时间序列模型（ADF、Johansen、VAR/VECM）和监督学习，发现汇款流入主要由外部宏观经济变量（汇率、全球油价）驱动，而非国内指标。多变量机器学习模型优于传统单变量方法，Ridge回归较SARIMA提升73.8%精度（年化RMSE: 4.948亿美元），并预测2026年汇款为90.01亿美元。
Motivation: 斯里兰卡汇款依赖全球经济的结构性特征尚不清晰，现有研究缺乏对长期时间序列和多变量建模的系统分析。
Method: 构建384个月统一数据集，进行探索性数据分析、平稳性检验（ADF）、协整检验（Johansen）、向量自回归/误差修正模型（VAR/VECM），以及Ridge回归等机器学习模型。
Result: Ridge回归实现年化RMSE 4.948亿美元，较SARIMA改进73.8%。预测2026年汇款稳定条件下为90.01亿美元。
Conclusion: 汇款高度依赖外部经济变量，需强化汇率政策、技能型移民管理和正规汇款渠道以增强经济韧性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MixTTA: Low-Rank Cross-Channel Mixing for Reliable Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) methods commonly update the affine parameters of normalization layers to adapt deployed models under distribution shifts. However, per-channel affine parameters perform axis-aligned scaling and shifting, making them geometrically incapable of correcting cross-channel structural changes induced by distribution shift. To address this limitation, we propose MixTTA, a lightweight plug-in module that equips normalization layers with a low-rank cross-channel transformation, enabling inter-channel mixing at each layer. To ensure that the low-rank branch captures only cross-channel interactions, we also propose Decoupling Projection that enforces strict separation from the diagonal affine path, along with Spectral Projection that prevents rank-1 collapse under non-stationary test streams. MixTTA can be seamlessly integrated into any existing normalization-based TTA method. Experiments in both standard and wild TTA settings show consistent improvements over strong baselines while mitigating adaptation failure under challenging conditions. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/delta6189/MixTTA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出测试时自适应（TTA）方法通常只更新归一化层的仿射参数，但这种逐通道的仿射变换无法纠正分布偏移引起的跨通道结构性变化。为此，作者提出MixTTA，一个轻量级即插即用模块，为归一化层添加低秩跨通道变换，并引入解耦投影（Decoupling Projection）和谱投影（Spectral Projection）来防止秩塌陷。实验表明，在标准和wild TTA设置下，MixTTA均能一致提升强基线性能，并在挑战性条件下缓解适应失败。
Motivation: 现有TTA方法仅调整归一化层的逐通道仿射参数，几何上无法纠正分布偏移导致的跨通道结构变化。
Method: 提出MixTTA模块，为归一化层增加低秩跨通道变换分支；同时设计解耦投影确保低秩分支与对角仿射路径严格分离，以及谱投影防止非平稳测试流下的秩1塌陷。
Result: 在标准TTA和wild TTA设置下，MixTTA一致优于强基线，并在困难条件下有效缓解适应失败。
Conclusion: MixTTA可无缝集成到任何基于归一化的TTA方法中，源代码已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SHARD: cell-keyed residual splitting for alignment-resistant private dense retrieval
papers.abstract_en: Dense embeddings underpin semantic search and retrieval-augmented generation, yet a leaked vector store hands much of the underlying text back. Modern inversion and alignment attacks share one weakness: the protected store is a single global geometry, and any single geometry can be aligned to a known one - a secret global rotation included, since orthogonal Procrustes recovers it from about subspace-dimension known-plaintext pairs. We introduce SHARD, a retrieval-preserving embedding transform that removes that weak axis. The centred embedding is rotated and split into a short public prefix (driving stage-1 retrieval) and a private residual sharded into C cells, each rotated under a separate secret key; the residual is reranked under CKKS, where the keys cancel and the inner product stays exact. One parameter C spans the global-linear baseline (C=1) to per-document micro-keys (C=N), making the keyed residual a cancellable template - revocable, renewable, unlinkable - for text embeddings, the first such scheme for dense retrieval. On five encoders: full-dimensional reranking returns the raw-space nDCG@10 that half-SVD truncation gives up; recovering the cell-keyed residual under a diffuse known-plaintext leak costs about C times more anchors (median 200 to 102,400 at C=256) for a few encrypted residual queries and the short public prefix leaks far less neighbour structure, with a micro-key limit driving residual leakage to zero. The barrier holds against learned-linear, non-linear and unsupervised aligners, and where a matched-utility noise defence de-anonymises almost every probe, SHARD de-anonymises none. Limits: within a cell similarities survive, a targeted attacker on one victim's cell needs only about d_priv anchors, and an overlapping reference corpus still leaks through the public prefix. SHARD is an attack-aware geometric defence, not a cryptographic guarantee.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SHARD是一种针对密集检索的嵌入变换方法，通过将中心化嵌入旋转并分割为公共前缀和私有残差，再将残差划分为多个细胞，每个细胞使用独立密钥旋转，从而抵御对齐攻击。该方法在五个编码器上实现全维重排序，恢复半SVD截断的nDCG@10，并在已知明文泄露下需要约C倍锚点才能恢复残差。SHARD是一种攻击感知的几何防御，而非密码学保证。
Motivation: 现有密集嵌入的向量存储面临泄露风险，现代反转和对齐攻击利用单一全局几何结构的弱点，可通过正交Procrustes等方法恢复秘密全局旋转，从而还原原始文本。
Method: 将中心化嵌入进行旋转和分割，形成短公共前缀（用于第一阶段检索）和私有残差，残差被分割为C个细胞，每个细胞在独立密钥下旋转，并通过CKKS同态加密进行精确内积重排序，实现密钥抵消。
Result: 在五个编码器上，全维重排序恢复半SVD截断的nDCG@10；在弥漫已知明文泄露下，恢复细胞密钥残差需要约C倍锚点（C=256时中位数从200到102,400）；微密钥极限使残差泄露趋近于零。SHARD对学习线性、非线性和无监督对齐器均有效，且在匹配效用噪声防御几乎去匿名化所有探针时，SHARD未去匿名化任何探针。
Conclusion: SHARD是一种攻击感知的几何防御，而非密码学保证，其局限包括细胞内相似性残留、针对单个受害者细胞的攻击仅需约d_priv个锚点，以及重叠参考语料库通过公共前缀泄露信息。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Controllable Histopathology Image Synthesis with Training-free Structural Initialization and Textural Modulation
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning has demonstrated remarkable success in high-throughput histopathology image analysis. However, the performance of learning-based models critically depends on the quality and size of annotations by expert pathologists, which is a resource-intensive and time-consuming process. To address the limitations of data scarcity and annotation burden, several methods have been proposed to synthesize paired histopathology data. Nevertheless, these frameworks typically still require annotation data, albeit in reduced quantities, to impose structural constraints during training. In this work, we present CHIS, a plug-in framework that guides the sampling trajectory of a pretrained diffusion model through two key stages: structural initialization at the start and textural modulation during generation. The initial noise state is refined by fusing the phase information from a prior mask with the amplitude of Gaussian noise in the frequency domain, yielding a structurally informed starting point. During the reverse diffusion process, we adaptively modulate both coarse-grained and fine-grained textures at different wavelet decomposition levels. This enables a diffusion model pretrained solely on unlabeled images to generate outputs that align with prior structural masks while preserving the reference tissue style. We conducted extensive experiments demonstrating the superiority of CHIS in generation fidelity and its substantial benefits for downstream segmentation tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/IBIL-Code/CHIS.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CHIS，一种无需训练的插件框架，通过结构初始化（频域相位信息融合）和纹理调制（小波分解自适应调整）引导预训练扩散模型生成与先验掩码对齐的组织病理学图像，仅需无标签图像即可完成训练，显著提升了生成保真度和下游分割任务性能。
Motivation: 现有组织病理学图像合成方法仍需少量标注数据提供结构约束，且依赖训练过程；数据稀缺和标注负担仍是主要瓶颈。
Method: CHIS框架包含两阶段：首先在频域将先验掩码的相位信息与高斯噪声的振幅融合，得到结构化的初始噪声；在反向扩散过程中，在不同小波分解层上自适应调制粗粒度和细粒度纹理，使预训练扩散模型生成符合掩码结构且保持参考组织风格的图像。
Result: 实验表明CHIS在生成保真度上优于现有方法，并显著提升了下游分割任务的性能。
Conclusion: CHIS作为一种无训练插件，可灵活嵌入任意预训练扩散模型，有效缓解组织病理学图像合成中的数据标注压力，且对下游任务有实质增益。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Reflect-R1: Evidence-Driven Reflection for Self-Correction in Long Video Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Current multimodal reflection mechanisms for long video understanding predominantly rely on closed-loop self-reflection within internal parameters. Lacking objective external evidence, models are frequently trapped in blind confidence and often fail to correct errors. Furthermore, applying reinforcement learning to multi-stage reflection pipelines introduces severe policy coupling, which is exacerbated by a critical scarcity of dedicated training data. To address these limitations, this work proposes Reflect-R1, the first Evidence-Driven self-correction framework for long video understanding. The framework constructs a three-stage pipeline consisting of intuition, verification, and arbitration. By dynamically retrieving objective visual evidence to verify initial intuitions and autonomously executing multiple temporal searches to resolve conflicts, it completely breaks the hallucination loop. To overcome policy coupling, we design a stage-decoupled reinforcement learning algorithm named SD-GRPO that independently computes advantage functions across different reasoning stages. Concurrently, we construct a dataset of 120K samples to bridge the training data gap. Extensive experiments on benchmarks such as VideoMME and LongVideoBench demonstrate that Reflect-R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our method significantly improves the genuine rectification rate and enables authentic self-correction strictly grounded in objective evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Reflect-R1，首个面向长视频理解的证据驱动自我修正框架。通过直觉-验证-仲裁三级流水线，动态检索客观视觉证据来打破幻觉循环，并设计阶段解耦强化学习算法 SD-GRPO 解决策略耦合问题。在 VideoMME 等基准上达到最先进性能，显著提升真实修正率。
Motivation: 现有长视频理解的多模态反思机制依赖内部参数闭环自省，缺乏客观外部证据，模型常陷入盲目自信且难以纠正错误；强化学习在多阶段反思流水线中引发严重的策略耦合，且缺乏专用训练数据。
Method: 构建三级流水线：直觉阶段生成初始答案，验证阶段动态检索客观视觉证据进行校验，仲裁阶段自主执行多次时间搜索解决冲突。提出阶段解耦强化学习算法 SD-GRPO，独立计算不同推理阶段的优势函数。同时构造 120K 样本数据集弥补训练数据缺口。
Result: 在 VideoMME 和 LongVideoBench 等基准上取得最先进性能，显著提升真实修正率，实现严格基于客观证据的自我修正。
Conclusion: 证据驱动框架可有效打破长视频理解中的幻觉循环，阶段解耦 RL 训练方式能缓解多阶段策略耦合问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SpatialUAV: Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence for Low-Altitude UAV Perception, Collaboration, and Motion
papers.abstract_en: Spatial intelligence is essential for low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) perception, collaboration, and navigation. However, existing UAV benchmarks often emphasize image-level recognition, single-view understanding, or narrow answer formats, leaving 3D spatial inference, multi-view collaboration, scene dynamics, and diverse task formulations insufficiently evaluated. To address these gaps, we introduce SpatialUAV, a real low-altitude UAV benchmark comprising 4,331 curated instances across 14 fine-grained task types, covering semantic discrimination, spatial relation, aerial--aerial collaboration, aerial--ground collaboration, and motion understanding. SpatialUAV organizes all samples into a unified visual-input--question--answer schema, while supporting seven input configurations and nine answer formats, including option labels, region identifiers, geometric values, cross-view correspondences, and free-form motion descriptions. To ensure reliable and grounded evaluation, our data construction pipeline integrates detector-assisted regions, depth supervision, metadata-derived rules, extensive manual annotation, blind filtering, and multi-turn human validation, together with task-specific metrics for heterogeneous outputs. Evaluating representative vision-language models across three categories, we show that current models remain far from human-level performance, with pronounced bottlenecks in cross-view association, structured grounding, geometric reasoning, and temporal viewpoint understanding. These results offer empirical guidance for advancing low-altitude UAV spatial intelligence. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Hyu-Zhang/SpatialUAV.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 SpatialUAV，一个面向低空无人机空间智能的真实基准，包含4331个实例和14种任务类型，覆盖语义、空间关系、协作和运动理解。通过统一的问题-答案格式和多输入多答案配置，评估了现有视觉语言模型，发现它们在跨视角关联和几何推理等关键能力上远低于人类水平。
Motivation: 现有无人机基准多侧重于图像识别或单视角理解，缺乏对3D空间推理、多视角协作、场景动态及多样化任务形式的充分评估。
Method: 构建了包含4331个实例的基准，统一视觉输入-问题-答案模式，支持7种输入配置和9种答案格式。数据通过检测器辅助、深度监督、元数据规则、人工标注、盲过滤和多轮验证等流程生成，并针对异构输出设计了特定指标。
Result: 评估多种视觉语言模型后，发现它们在跨视角关联、结构化定位、几何推理和时间视角理解等方面存在显著瓶颈，远未达到人类水平。
Conclusion: 该基准为推进低空无人机空间智能提供了实证指导，当前模型在关键能力上仍有很大提升空间。

papers.title: Beyond Points: Spherical Distributional Part Prototypes for Interpretable Classification
papers.abstract_en: Prototype-based neural networks aim to provide intrinsic interpretability by grounding predictions in a small set of part prototypes. However, modern vision backbones typically operate in normalized, directional embedding spaces where each semantic part exhibits substantial intra-class variability. As a result, point prototypes often become redundant or unstable, hurting both explanation quality and robustness. We propose vMFProto, a distributional part-prototype framework that models each class as a mixture of von Mises-Fisher components on the hypersphere. Each prototype learns its own concentration, capturing part-specific variability, and we use entropic optimal transport (OT) to obtain structured patch-to-prototype assignments. A two-stage training schedule performs OT-driven prototype discovery followed by end-to-end refinement with patch-level distillation and distribution-aware diversity regularization. Experiments on CUB-200-2011, Stanford Dogs, and Stanford Cars with frozen DINO backbones show that vMFProto achieves state-of-the-art explanation quality (consistency, stability, and distinctiveness) with competitive accuracy. Qualitative results confirm that vMFProto yields localized, non-redundant part evidence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 vMFProto，一种基于 von Mises-Fisher 分布的原型网络，在超球面上对每个类建模为混合分布，通过熵正则化最优传输获取结构化 patch-to-prototype 分配，并采用两阶段训练。在 CUB-200-2011、Stanford Dogs 和 Stanford Cars 上，使用冻结 DINO 骨干网络，取得了最先进的解释质量（一致性、稳定性、区分性）和竞争性准确率。
Motivation: 现有基于点的原型网络在归一化、有方向性的嵌入空间中，由于语义部分的类内变异性大，导致点原型冗余或不稳定，损害解释质量和鲁棒性。
Method: 提出分布原型框架 vMFProto，每个原型学习自身的浓度参数以捕获部分特异性变异性；利用熵正则化最优传输进行结构化 patch-to-prototype 分配；两阶段训练：先进行 OT 驱动的原型发现，再通过 patch 级蒸馏和分布感知多样性正则化进行端到端优化。
Result: 在 CUB-200-2011、Stanford Dogs 和 Stanford Cars 上，使用冻结 DINO 骨干，实现了最先进的解释一致性、稳定性和区分性，同时保持竞争性分类准确率。
Conclusion: vMFProto 生成局部化、非冗余的部分证据，在可解释分类中优于基于点的原型方法。

papers.title: MemoBench: Benchmarking World Modeling in Dynamically Changing Environments
papers.abstract_en: Video generation models aspire to simulate dynamic environments, and several benchmarks now evaluate memory consistency across frames. However, most assess consistency only while the target remains in view, and the few that force objects out of view evaluate static scenes where nothing changes during occlusion. To bridge this gap, we introduce MemoBench, a diagnostic benchmark built around the disappear-and-reappear paradigm in dynamically changing environments: a target object undergoes a physical process, disappears from view, and must be correctly recovered in its updated state upon reappearance. We curate 360 ground-truth clips spanning synthetic and real-world scenes, and design an evaluation suite combining automated metrics with VQA-based assessment across four diagnostic pillars. Evaluation of eight state-of-the-art models reveals key insights and open challenges regarding memory consistency under the disappear-and-reappear paradigm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Memobench是一个围绕动态环境中物体消失-重现范式的诊断基准，用于评估视频生成模型的记忆一致性。摘要指出，现有基准多评估目标可见时的帧间一致性，而物体出镜时只考虑静态场景。作者收集360个合成与真实视频片段，设计了包含自动度量与VQA的评估套件，并对8个模型进行了评测，揭示了物体消失-重现下的记忆一致性的关键挑战。
Motivation: 现有视频生成模型基准在评估记忆一致性时，大多只考虑目标始终可见的情况；少数迫使物体出镜的基准只评估静态场景，忽略了物体在遮挡期间可能发生的动态变化。
Method: 提出Memobench基准，围绕物体消失-重现范式构建，覆盖动态环境变化（物体经历物理过程后消失，重现时必须恢复更新状态）。包含360个真实与合成片段，评估套件结合自动度量与VQA，从四个诊断层面评测。
Result: 评估8个当前最优模型，揭示了物体消失-重现范式下记忆一致性的关键问题与开放挑战。
Conclusion: 摘要强调，现有的视频生成模型在处理物体消失并发生动态变化后再现时仍存在显著不足，Memobench为这一挑战提供了系统化的评估平台。

papers.title: Understanding Domain-Aware Distribution Alignment in Budgeted Entity Matching
papers.abstract_en: Entity Matching (EM) is a core operation in the data integration pipeline, where records from different sources are compared to determine whether they refer to the same real-world entity. Recent work has incorporated domain information and low-resource learning techniques to better adapt EM systems to realistic settings. While these approaches have demonstrated strong performance, it remains unclear how they behave under varying data constraints and levels of supervision in practice. In this paper, we investigate a state-of-the-art method for low-resource, domain-aware EM--BEACON--and study how its performance is affected by different algorithmic choices and data availability conditions. We conduct a series of targeted experiments to evaluate these variations, providing deeper insight into the role of distribution alignment and the behavior of the BEACON framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究低资源领域感知实体匹配方法BEACON，通过系列实验分析不同算法选择和可用数据条件对其性能的影响，重点关注分布对齐的作用。
Motivation: 现有领域感知实体匹配方法在低资源条件下表现良好，但其在不同数据约束和监督水平下的行为尚不清楚，需要深入理解。
Method: 以BEACON框架为研究对象，设计系列对比实验，变化算法组件和数据可用性条件，分析性能差异。
Result: 实验揭示了分布对齐在BEACON框架中的关键作用，以及不同配置下的性能变化规律。
Conclusion: 研究为低资源实体匹配中领域感知分布对齐的行为提供了深入见解，有助于指导未来方法设计。

papers.title: ViQ: Text-Aligned Visual Quantized Representations at Any Resolution
papers.abstract_en: A unified representation for text and vision is a natural pursuit, as it enables simpler multimodal modeling and more efficient training. However, representing images as discrete signals in the same way as text inevitably introduces severe information loss. Existing work struggles to balance low-level details and high-level semantics in discrete representations: reconstruction-oriented representations often lack semantic information, whereas semantically stronger features typically suffer from severe loss of detail. We present ViQ, a Visual Quantized Representations framework, which is designed to balance semantics and details in discrete representations while supporting inputs at native resolutions, thereby enabling it to serve as a unified and general discrete representation for arbitrary visual inputs. Our approach structures quantization learning into two stages: text-aligned pre-training and feature discretization. With text-aligned pre-training, we enhance the visual encoder semantic-rich supervision from the pretrained language model and enable it to process native-resolution visual inputs. During discretization, we propose a proximal representation learning strategy to progressively compact the feature space, along with a position-aware head-wise quantization mechanism that enables flexible processing of arbitrary resolutions. Extensive experiments on multimodal tasks demonstrate that ViQ achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art multimodal vision encoders with continuous and high-dimensional visual features, while maintaining high precision in low-level reconstruction. We also show that multimodal training with visual quantized representations largely improves efficiency, yielding up to 20\%-70\% acceleration with different base LLMs and training recipes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ViQ框架，通过两阶段量化学习（文本对齐预训练和特征离散化）生成平衡语义与细节的离散视觉表示，支持任意分辨率输入。实验表明，ViQ在多模态任务上达到与连续高维视觉特征编码器相当的性能，同时保持低层重建精度，并实现20%-70%的训练加速。
Motivation: 现有离散视觉表示难以兼顾低层细节与高层语义：重建导向表示缺乏语义信息，而语义特征又往往损失细节。需要一种统一的离散表示方法，在两者间取得平衡并支持任意分辨率输入。
Method: 提出两阶段量化学习框架：1）文本对齐预训练，利用预训练语言模型为视觉编码器提供语义监督，并使其处理原生分辨率输入；2）特征离散化阶段，采用近端表示学习逐步压缩特征空间，结合位置感知头量化机制灵活处理任意分辨率。
Result: 在多模态任务上，ViQ与使用连续高维特征的最先进视觉编码器性能相当，同时保持低层重建的高精度。多模态训练效率提升20%-70%，适用于不同基座语言模型和训练配置。
Conclusion: ViQ实现了可同时捕捉语义与细节的离散视觉表示，并支持原生分辨率输入，为多模态训练提供了高效统一的基础表示。

papers.title: OpenRCA 2.0: From Outcome Labels to Causal Process Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Root cause analysis (RCA) poses a holistic test of LLM agentic capabilities, such as long-context understanding, multi-step reasoning, and tool use. However, existing datasets suffer from a fundamental gap: they label only the root cause, not the propagation path connecting it to the observed symptom, which largely simplifies the task to naive pattern matching. To support rigorous evaluation, we introduce PAVE, a step-wise labeling protocol that leverages known interventions from fault injection to reconstruct causal propagation paths. The mechanism is forward verification: reasoning from cause to effect rather than inferring backward from symptoms. Applying PAVE yields OpenRCA 2.0 (500 instances), the first cross-system RCA benchmark with step-wise causal annotations for LLM agents. Across 11 frontier LLMs, recovering the exact root-cause set succeeds in only 20.7% of cases on average. To locate where this difficulty lies, we relax the criterion and find what we call the ungrounded diagnosis: agents identify at least one correct root-cause service in 76.0% of cases, but ground that service in a verified causal propagation path to the observed symptom in only 61.5%. Outcome-only evaluation hides this failure mode; step-wise causal ground truth is the missing piece for trustworthy LLM-based RCA agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PAVE 协议进行逐步因果标注，构建 OpenRCA 2.0 基准，用于评估 LLM 在根因分析上的因果传播路径推理能力。实验发现，LLM 在确定根因服务时准确率尚可（76.0%），但能将其与症状通过验证的因果路径连接起来的只有 61.5%，表明结果标签掩盖了故障模式。
Motivation: 现有 RCA 数据集仅标记根因，缺少因果传播路径，简化了任务。需要严格的逐步因果标注来评估 LLM 的因果推理能力。
Method: 引入 PAVE 协议，通过已知故障注入干预，从原因到效果正向验证，重构因果传播路径，并构建包含 500 个实例的跨系统 RCA 基准 OpenRCA 2.0。
Result: 11 个前沿 LLM 平均只有 20.7% 能完全恢复精确根因集合。放宽标准后，76.0% 能识别至少一个正确根因服务，但仅 61.5% 能将其与症状通过验证的因果路径连接。
Conclusion: 结果标签评估隐藏了 LLM 在因果路径推理上的失败，逐步因果真值是对 LLM 进行可信 RCA 评估的关键。

papers.title: Event-based Gaze Control System for Accurate Real-time Spin Estimation in Professional Ball Games
papers.abstract_en: Spin plays a crucial role in many ball sports due to its effect on the trajectory of the ball. Vision-based estimation of the ball's spin during a game with conventional cameras is challenging due to the ball's small size, high speed, and fast rotation. To address these challenges, we propose an event-based active vision system that can track unmodified balls and measure their spin in real time. The system consists of an event camera for its high temporal resolution and minimal motion blur, high-speed pan/tilt galvanometer mirrors to keep the ball in the field of view, and a low-latency focus-tunable telephoto lens to increase the spatial resolution on the ball and keep it in focus. To track the ball, we use a hybrid approach that combines 2D event-based detection for centering and 3D positions from a ball localization system for re-initialization. For high-accuracy spin estimation, we propose an offline method that performs contrast maximization on the sphere (s-CMax). This method achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on static balls across multiple sports (table tennis, baseball, tennis, and golf), with mean magnitude and axis errors of 1.2% and 1.5 degrees, respectively. We then develop a low-latency online method for table tennis as a case study in real-time applications. This method uses an uncertainty-aware convolutional neural network trained on pseudo-ground-truth spin labels from the offline approach, combined with a GPU-accelerated batch implementation of contrast maximization for refinement. We demonstrate reliable tracking and spin estimation with a three-view setup during professional table tennis matches, with high accuracy (8.8% magnitude and 6.4 degrees axis mismatch w.r.t. the offline method), 3 ms latency, and 750 Hz throughput.
papers.summary_zh:

papers.title: Mask to Concept: Auto-Promptable SAM3 via Efficient Test-Time Concept Embedding Search for Few-Shot Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Transforming foundation segmentation models from human-prompted tools into auto-promptable annotators is critical for scalable medical data annotation. Current methods commonly depend on external feature matchers or auxiliary networks to automate geometric prompting, but introducing architectural overhead and limiting performance scalability. Although SAM3 natively supports concept segmentation via reusable text prompts, its direct use in medical imaging is hindered by a lack of fine-grained clinical knowledge and the ambiguity of human-written descriptions. In this work, we propose Mask to Concept (M2C), an efficient framework that adapts SAM3 for medical few-shot annotation without external modules, parameter retraining, or manual text engineering. Using only a few labeled images, M2C enables SAM3 to automatically search for transferable visual concepts entirely within its frozen architecture: it initializes a learnable concept embedding, uses it to prompt segmentation, and updates the embedding by gradients of minimizing the concept segmentation error. We further introduce a Hybrid Uncertainty Estimation (HUE) module that calculates the prediction entropy and maps concept predictions back to the box prompts, measuring concept-geometry prompting inconsistency. Highly uncertain samples are flagged actively for human correction, and the corrected masks are then fed back to M2C to continuously search for more precise concept embeddings, forming a self-enhancing annotation loop with minimal expert effort. Experiments on medical segmentation benchmarks show that our method achieves SOTA few-shot segmentation performance and outstanding annotation efficiency, offering a practical and efficient pathway toward scalable medical image labeling. Codes are at https://github.com/Huster-Hq/M2C.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Mask to Concept (M2C)框架，无需外部模块或重训练，通过可学习概念嵌入和梯度搜索，使SAM3在冻结架构内自动找到可转移的视觉概念，用于医学少样本标注。同时引入混合不确定性估计（HUE）模块，通过预测熵和框提示的一致性来标记高不确定样本，形成主动学习循环。实验表明在医学分割基准上达到少样本SOTA。
Motivation: 现有的基础分割模型依赖于外部特征匹配器或辅助网络来自动化几何提示，引入架构开销且限制可扩展性；而SAM3直接用于医学图像缺乏细粒度临床知识且文本描述模糊。
Method: 提出M2C框架：初始化可学习概念嵌入，用其提示分割，通过最小化概念分割误差的梯度更新嵌入；并设计HUE模块计算预测熵并将概念预测映射回框提示，度量不一致性，高不确定样本主动标记由人工校正后反馈继续搜索更精确嵌入。
Result: 在医学分割基准上取得少样本分割SOTA性能，并展示了出色的标注效率。
Conclusion: 该方法为可扩展的医学图像标注提供了实用的高效途径，无需外部模块、参数重训练或手动文本工程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Clinical Harness for Governable Medical AI Skill Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: Medical AI remains organized around isolated models, whereas care requires accountable capabilities that persist across time. We define clinical AI skills and propose the Clinical Harness, a runtime governance architecture that registers, orchestrates, constrains and monitors them. Using osteoporosis as an exemplar, we show how knowledge-driven, data-driven and physics-enhanced skills can support lifecycle care and provide a governed substrate for future medical agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文定义了临床AI技能的概念，并提出Clinical Harness运行时治理架构，用于注册、编排、约束和监控这些技能。以骨质疏松为例，展示了知识驱动、数据驱动和物理增强技能如何支持全生命周期护理，为未来医疗代理提供可治理的基础。
Motivation: 当前医疗AI围绕孤立模型组织，而护理需要跨时间的可靠能力，现有架构缺乏对持久技能的治理。
Method: 提出Clinical Harness架构，通过注册、编排、约束和监控机制管理临床AI技能，并集成多种技能类型。
Result: 以骨质疏松为例，展示了知识驱动、数据驱动和物理增强技能在生命周期护理中的可行性。
Conclusion: 该架构为未来医疗代理提供了可治理的底层支持，强调了技能持续性和问责性。

papers.title: DinoLink: A Token-Centric Representation Compression Framework for Bandwidth-Constrained Collaborative V2X Perception
papers.abstract_en: High-precision remote perception is often hindered by the severe bandwidth constraints of Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) networks. We propose \textit{DinoLink}, a token-centric compression framework that replaces raw pixel streaming with discrete semantic communication for vehicle-cloud collaborative inference. DinoLink employs a dual-sparsity architecture: a saliency-aware selector prunes redundant background tokens, while a Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ) module collapses features into compact codebook indices. By transmitting only lightweight indices and positional priors, DinoLink achieves a $139\times$ bitrate reduction compared to uncompressed transmission while maintaining a competitive 32.8\% mAP on the nuScenes dataset. Deployment simulations further demonstrate a $34.5\times$ acceleration in narrow-band environments, such as LoRa. Our results substantiate DinoLink as a robust, bandwidth-efficient frontend for high-fidelity remote perception in constrained V2X scenarios. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/UGA-MOBILITY-LAB/dino_link.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DinoLink，一种基于令牌的压缩框架，用于带宽受限的车联网(V2X)协同感知。它通过双稀疏架构（显著性感知选择器和残差向量量化）将原始像素流替换为离散语义通信，在nuScenes数据集上实现139倍比特率降低和32.8% mAP，并在LoRa等窄带环境中加速34.5倍。
Motivation: 现有V2X远程感知受限于严重带宽约束，原始像素流传输效率低，需要有效的压缩方法。
Method: 提出DinoLink框架，包含显著性感知令牌选择器（修剪冗余背景令牌）和残差向量量化（RVQ）模块（将特征压缩为紧凑码本索引），仅传输轻量级索引和位置先验。
Result: 在nuScenes上，相比未压缩传输实现139倍比特率降低，mAP为32.8%；窄带环境仿真（如LoRa）中加速34.5倍。
Conclusion: DinoLink可作为高保真远程感知在受限V2X场景中的稳健、高效前端，代码已公开。

papers.title: Training for the Model You Return: Improving Optimization for Iterate-Averaged Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Many modern Language Model (LM) pipelines return an averaged model, such as an exponential moving average of the training iterates, rather than the final iterate itself. This raises a fundamental question: given that we will return an iterate average, how should we change training to improve the performance of this average? We study this question by formulating optimizer design for the iterate-average estimator as an optimal-control problem. In a continuous-time stochastic quadratic model, we solve for the control strategy that minimizes the error of the returned average subject to a penalty on the size of the intervention. A practical approximation to this controller yields PACE, a lightweight wrapper around AdamW that pulls the live weights toward their exponential moving average with a clipped, per-coordinate control strength. We prove that a stylized version of PACE converges at the standard stochastic convex optimization rate, up to a factor depending on the averaging rule, while in the quadratic setting it can strictly improve the limiting squared error of the iterate-average estimator and can do so by an arbitrarily large factor on some instances. Empirically, our results suggest that PACE improves over AdamW and EMA-evaluated AdamW in supervised fine-tuning of 1-2B parameter LMs and in GPT-2 pretraining on FineWeb for a wide range of learning rates, decay schedules, and other hyperparameters.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在语言模型训练中返回迭代平均模型（如指数移动平均）时，如何改进优化器以提高平均模型的性能。作者将优化器设计建模为最优控制问题，提出PACE——一种轻量级包装器，通过裁剪的逐坐标控制强度将实时权重拉向指数移动平均。在二次模型上证明可任意倍数改善均方误差，在1-2B参数语言模型微调和GPT-2预训练上优于AdamW。
Motivation: 现代语言模型流水线通常返回迭代平均模型而非最后迭代，但训练过程未针对此进行优化，导致平均模型性能未达最优。
Method: 将优化器设计建模为连续时间随机二次模型的最优控制问题，求解得到控制策略，并近似得到PACE算法，该算法为AdamW包装器，通过裁剪的逐坐标控制强度将实时权重拉向指数移动平均。
Result: 在二次设置中严格改善迭代平均估计器的极限均方误差（可任意倍数）；在1-2B参数语言模型监督微调和GPT-2预训练上，PACE在多种学习率、衰减调度下优于AdamW和EMA评估的AdamW。
Conclusion: 作者提出应针对返回的迭代平均模型调整训练过程，PACE提供了一种简单有效的方式，并证明了理论收敛性。

papers.title: PatternGSL: A Structured Specification Language for Template-Free and Simulation-Ready 3D Garments
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing realistic, physically plausible garments from a single image remains a fundamental challenge. Template-free methods capture surface geometry but lack explicit sewing structure for simulation; while programmatic systems are simulation-ready but constrained by predefined templates. This reveals a fundamental representation gap between geometric reconstruction and structured garment construction. We present PatternGSL, a structured garment representation in the form of a template-free and learnable specification language that encodes complete sewing patterns, including panel boundaries, parameterized seams, and explicit stitch topology, in a compact and standardized form. PatternGSL preserves the physical rigor of pattern-based models while removing template dependence, elevating sewing structure as a first-class target for generative modeling. We further propose a vision-language framework that predicts PatternGSL specifications directly from a single image and decodes them into garments using lightweight deterministic validity handling, without optimization-based refinement or manual cleanup. In addition, we introduce PatternGSLData, the first large-scale image-to-GSL paired dataset comprising 300K samples with complete sewing pattern annotations, enabling supervised VLM training for structured garment reconstruction. Experiments demonstrate improved pattern accuracy over prior baselines, explicit sewing-structure recovery, reliable cloth simulation, and pattern-level editing through the same deterministic decoding pipeline. Code and data-processing scripts will be released at https://lagrangeli.github.io/PatternGSL/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PatternGSL，一种无模板且可学习的结构化服装表示语言，编码完整的缝纫图案，包括面板边界、参数化缝线和显式缝合拓扑。同时提出视觉-语言框架，从单张图像预测PatternGSL规格，并解码为服装，无需优化或手动清理。引入大规模图像-GSL配对数据集PatternGSLData。实验表明在图案准确性、缝纫结构恢复、布料仿真和编辑方面优于先前方法。
Motivation: 现有无模板方法捕捉表面几何但缺乏缝纫结构，难以仿真；程序化系统仿真就绪但受限于预定义模板。存在几何重建与结构化服装构建之间的表示鸿沟。
Method: PatternGSL是一种无模板可学习规格语言，编码完整缝纫图案，包括面板边界、参数化缝线和缝合拓扑；视觉语言框架直接从单张图像预测PatternGSL规格，并通过轻量确定性有效性处理解码为服装。
Result: 实验证明图案准确性优于先前基线，恢复显式缝纫结构，实现可靠的布料仿真和图案级编辑。
Conclusion: PatternGSL弥合了几何重建与结构化服装构建之间的表示鸿沟，提供了仿真就绪且可编辑的服装表示，无需优化或手动清理。

summary_sections.method: PatternGSL是一种无模板可学习规格语言，编码完整缝纫图案，包括面板边界、参数化缝线和缝合拓扑；视觉语言框架直接从单张图像预测PatternGSL规格，并通过轻量确定性有效性处理解码为服装。
summary_sections.result: 实验证明图案准确性优于先前基线，恢复显式缝纫结构，实现可靠的布料仿真和图案级编辑。
summary_sections.conclusion: PatternGSL弥合了几何重建与结构化服装构建之间的表示鸿沟，提供了仿真就绪且可编辑的服装表示，无需优化或手动清理。

papers.title: ATRIA: Adaptive Traceable ECG Reporting with Iterative Agents
papers.abstract_en: Existing ECG report generation is tightly coupled -- interpretation and reporting fused end-to-end, so errors propagate without stage-level recourse -- while agent-based systems decouple tasks but remain single-pass, never revisiting earlier outputs. Clinical ECG reporting instead unfolds iteratively, requiring progressive context integration and bidirectional editing. We present \textsc{ATRIA}, a multi-agent ECG reporting system that mirrors the clinician's iterative workflow: it binds every report claim to its supporting evidence, flags statements unsupported by that evidence, incorporates additional context mid-session, and lets clinicians verify and revise individual findings rather than accept one opaque output. Because its agents use ECG analysis models already in clinical use, the underlying findings are clinically trustworthy; and as a cloud-based web service, \textsc{ATRIA} is ready for immediate deployment. We demonstrate \textsc{ATRIA} through four interaction cases, with a live demo and video available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对心电图（ECG）报告生成中错误传播且无法迭代修正的问题，提出ATRIA多智能体系统。该系统将每个报告声明与支持证据绑定，标记无证据支持的语句，允许临床医生在过程中补充上下文并逐条验证修改。通过四个交互案例展示其功能，并提供在线演示。
Motivation: 现有ECG报告生成系统要么端到端耦合导致错误无法分阶段纠正，要么单次生成后无法回溯编辑，不符合临床医生迭代的工作流程。
Method: 提出ATRIA多智能体框架，将报告声明与ECG分析证据关联，实时标记无支持声明，支持中途纳入额外临床上下文，并允许医生针对单个发现进行验证和修订。
Result: 通过四个交互案例验证了系统的可用性，提供在线演示和视频，但未报告定量性能指标。
Conclusion: ATRIA通过镜像临床迭代工作流提高了ECG报告的可解释性和可修正性，但缺乏大规模临床验证。

papers.title: TIGER: Taming Identity, Geometry, and Generative Priors for High-Quality Face Video Restoration
papers.abstract_en: Face Video Restoration (FVR) aims to recover high-fidelity facial videos from degraded input while preserving identity and semantic consistency across frames. Existing methods often struggle to simultaneously address three key challenges: identity shift, viewpoint-entangled guidance, and perceptual realism. To tackle these issues, we propose TIGER, a structured tri-prior fusion framework that Tames Identity, Geometry, and gEnerative pRiors for high-quality FVR. Specifically, an Identity Prior is first established by injecting subject-discriminative embeddings into the latent space, effectively anchoring the subject's identity against severe degradations. Then, to provide temporally consistent structural guidance for dynamic videos, TIGER constructs a Geometry Prior by lifting 2D reference cues into a disentangled 3D parameter space, creating a geometric anchor through cross-source parameter fusion. Moreover, to achieve maximum efficiency without compromising realism, we harness the video generation model's Generative Prior through a one-step rectified flow. We further design a progressive three-stage training optimization strategy that refines structural fidelity, textural reconstruction, and distribution-level realism to ensure robust optimization. We also construct a large-scale FVR dataset to facilitate robust training and standardized evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TIGER achieves state-of-the-art performance in both identity fidelity and temporal stability, delivering a high-quality, efficient and identity-consistent FVR. Project page: https://yzhoulv.github.io/Tiger/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TIGER框架，通过融合身份先验、几何先验和生成先验来实现高质量人脸视频恢复。身份先验注入主体判别嵌入以对抗退化，几何先验将2D参考线索提升至解耦的3D参数空间以提供时序一致的结构引导，生成先验利用一步整流流实现高效逼真重建。采用三阶段渐进训练策略优化结构、纹理和分布级真实感。
Motivation: 现有人脸视频恢复方法难以同时解决身份偏移、视点纠缠引导和感知真实感三个关键挑战。
Method: 提出结构化的三先验融合框架：1) 身份先验：将主体判别嵌入注入潜在空间；2) 几何先验：通过交叉源参数融合从2D参考构建解耦3D几何锚点；3) 生成先验：采用一步整流流利用视频生成模型。设计三阶段渐进训练优化策略。
Result: 在多个基准上实现身份保真度和时间稳定性方面的最先进性能，生成高质量、高效且身份一致的人脸视频。
Conclusion: TIGER通过身份、几何和生成先验的结构化融合，有效解决了人脸视频恢复中的身份偏移、视点纠缠和感知真实感问题。

papers.title: REDI-Match: Rotation-Equivariant Distillation for Efficient and Robust Dense Matching
papers.abstract_en: Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) have significantly advanced dense feature matching, yet severe in-plane rotation remains a critical challenge. Existing solutions face a fundamental dilemma: data-driven methods require inefficient parameter scaling to implicitly learn rotations, whereas strictly equivariant networks lack the semantic capacity of modern VFMs. Consequently, current frameworks typically freeze VFMs and shift the entire burden of rotation generalization to the downstream decoder. To break this architectural bottleneck, we propose REDI-Match, an efficient framework driven by a novel Rotation-Equivariant Distillation (REDI) paradigm. Instead of relying on rotation data augmentation to establish rotational correspondences, REDI distills the non-equivariant semantic representations of a VFM into a lightweight, strictly rotation-equivariant encoder, leveraging an equivariant geometric architecture to constrain robust high-dimensional semantics. To fully exploit these features, we equip the decoder with an entropy-driven spatial alignment module. By evaluating discrete rotation hypotheses, this mechanism explicitly locks onto the canonical coordinate system, eliminating global ambiguity before continuous refinement. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REDI-Match establishes a new state-of-the-art (SOTA) across multiple benchmarks. Notably, it achieves a 13.89% absolute pose accuracy improvement on the highly challenging SatAst dataset while operating 1.9x faster than the current SOTA (RoMa v2), enabling real-time inference (~41 FPS) on a single RTX 4090 GPU. Code: https://github.com/YinjiGe/REDI-Match.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对稠密匹配中严重的面内旋转挑战，提出REDI-Match框架，核心是一种旋转等变蒸馏（REDI）范式。该方法将视觉基础模型（VFM）的非等变语义表示蒸馏到一个轻量级、严格旋转等变的编码器中，并引入熵驱动空间对齐模块，通过离散旋转假设锁定规范坐标系。实验结果显示，REDI-Match在多个基准上达到新SOTA，尤其在SatAst数据集上姿态精度提升13.89%，推理速度比当前SOTA（RoMa v2）快1.9倍，在单张RTX 4090上实现实时推理（~41 FPS）。
Motivation: 现有VFM在稠密匹配中难以应对严重旋转：数据驱动方法需大量参数隐式学习旋转，而严格等变网络缺乏VFM的语义表达能力；当前框架通常冻结VFM，将旋转泛化负担完全留给下游解码器，成为架构瓶颈。
Method: 提出REDI-Match框架，包含旋转等变蒸馏（REDI）：将预训练VFM的非等变语义蒸馏到轻量级旋转等变编码器中，利用等变几何架构约束鲁棒的高维语义；解码器配备熵驱动空间对齐模块，通过评估离散旋转假设显式锁定规范坐标系，消除全局歧义后再进行连续优化。
Result: 在多个基准上取得新SOTA，其中在挑战性SatAst数据集上姿态精度提升13.89%，推理速度比RoMa v2快1.9倍，在RTX 4090上达到~41 FPS的实时推理速度。
Conclusion: REDI-Match通过旋转等变蒸馏和熵驱动空间对齐有效解决了旋转泛化瓶颈，实现了高效且鲁棒的稠密匹配。

papers.title: Teaching LLMs String Matching, Backtracking, and Error Recovery to Deduce Bases and Truth Tables for the Combinatorially Exploding Bit Manipulation Puzzles
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents our algorithmic innovations for the NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge, focusing on Bit Manipulation Puzzles. In this task, the objective is to discover a hidden logical rule transforming input binary strings to outputs, then apply it to unseen inputs. Large Language Models (LLMs) notoriously struggle here; traditional methods force them to simulate complex boolean logic and arithmetic, leading to hallucinations. Furthermore, the search space of bitwise operations (combinations of shifts, rotations, and logic gates) suffers from a severe combinatorial explosion. To overcome this computational intractability, we present a novel approach that abandons arithmetic logic entirely in favor of string similarity, structured search, and autonomous error recovery. Our core contributions are: 1. Bases and Truth Table Formulation: We reframe logic-gate deduction into a base-selection task, leveraging string similarity (minimal bit flips) to isolate primitive transformations ("bases") and deduce truth tables without complex arithmetic. 2. Backtracking DFS and Error Recovery: We formalize a search process that tests candidate bases, detects logical collisions across examples, and backtracks upon failure to perform robust error recovery. 3. Bit Tokenization and Interactive Reasoning SFT: We force the tokenizer to encode binary strings as individual single-bit tokens. We use dynamic masking to simulate external oracle feedback, training the model to hypothesize, self-evaluate, and backtrack natively. Evaluated on bit manipulation puzzles, our approach achieved over 96% validation accuracy. This represents the highest performance in this category, driving our 7th Place overall finish in the contest.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. 7th Place Solution for the NVIDIA Nemotron Model Reasoning Challenge (Kaggle)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对位操作谜题（Bit Manipulation Puzzles）提出一种避免使用算术逻辑、转而利用字符串相似度、结构化搜索与自主错误恢复的方法。核心创新包括：将逻辑门推理重新表述为基选择（base-selection）任务，通过最小比特翻转分解原始变换并推导真值表；引入回溯深度优先搜索（DFS）与错误恢复机制，测试候选基、检测碰撞并回溯；采用比特分词与交互式推理监督微调（SFT），训练模型原生地假设、自我评估与回溯。在NVIDIA Nemotron模型推理挑战赛中，该方法在验证集上达到超过96%的准确率，获得总排名第7。
Motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）在模拟复杂布尔逻辑和算术时容易产生幻觉，且位运算组合搜索空间存在严重的组合爆炸，传统方法难以有效解决。
Method: 提出基于字符串相似度的基与真值表（Bases and Truth Table Formulation），通过最小比特翻转分解原始变换；形式化回溯DFS与错误恢复过程，测试候选基、检测逻辑碰撞并回溯；引入比特分词（Bit Tokenization）和动态掩码模拟外部oracle反馈，训练模型进行假设、自评估与回溯。
Result: 在位操作谜题上，验证准确率超过96%，在该类别中达到最高性能，最终在竞赛中获得总排名第7。
Conclusion: 本文展示了一种避免算术逻辑、依赖字符串相似度和结构化搜索的LLM推理方法，可有效处理组合爆炸的位操作任务。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Measuring & Mitigating Over-Alignment for LLMs in Multilingual Criminal Law Courts
papers.abstract_en: While the wider applicability of LLMs in the legal field is currently debated due to their reliability and the gravity of any errors, narrow uses with well-understood and mitigated risks have emerged. Notably the Swiss Federal Supreme Court uses small on-premises models for tentative translations and short-passage summarization across the four official languages. However, such usage is challenging in the context of Criminal Law. Since rulings and cases employees work on routinely can contain detailed descriptions of violent and sexual offenses, their legitimate work is compromised by refusals and disclaimers due to the activation of model guardrails (over-alignment). To measure this phenomenon, we introduce TF-RefusalBench, a multilingual benchmark for criminal-law translation and summarization derived from public Swiss Supreme Court rulings. TF-RefusalBench contains 5,200 total prompts across French, German, Italian, and English, corresponding to common task prompts and passages likely to trigger refusal. We then use TF-RefusalBench to show that over-alignment is a multifaceted phenomenon, influenced by the model and the prompt and text languages being processed, and that its impact cannot be evaluated solely from an over-refusal perspective, given the disclaimer's impact on task faithfulness. Finally, we evaluate approaches to enable on-premises LLMs for Criminal Law Tasks, demonstrating that while prompting can be effective, abliteration (refusal directions ablation) eliminates refusal with minimal impact on task performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM在刑事法律领域因过度对齐（over-alignment）导致拒答和免责声明影响任务忠实度的问题，构建了多语言基准TF-RefusalBench，包含5,200条来自瑞士联邦最高法院的刑事裁决提示（法语、德语、意大利语、英语）。实验表明过度对齐受模型和文本语言影响，且仅从过度拒绝角度评估不够。研究显示提示工程可缓解该问题，而abliteration（拒绝方向消融）能彻底消除拒绝且对任务性能影响极小。
Motivation: LLM在刑事法律场景中的合法工作常因模型安全护栏（如拒答和免责声明）而受阻，这种现象称为过度对齐，但目前缺乏针对性评估和缓解方法。
Method: 基于瑞士联邦最高法院公开裁决构建多语言基准TF-RefusalBench，包含5,200条可能触发拒答的提示；评估不同模型和语言下的拒答率；比较提示工程与abliteration（拒绝方向消融）两种缓解策略。
Result: 过度对齐是多面现象，其影响不能仅从拒答率衡量，还需考虑免责声明对任务忠实度的破坏；abliteration几乎完全消除拒绝，且对翻译和摘要任务性能影响极小。
Conclusion: 对于刑事法律场景中的LLM部署，abliteration是消除过度对齐的有效手段，而提示工程效果有限。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对LLM在刑事法律领域因过度对齐（over-alignment）导致拒答和免责声明影响任务忠实度的问题，构建了多语言基准TF-RefusalBench，包含5,200条来自瑞士联邦最高法院的刑事裁决提示（法语、德语、意大利语、英语）。实验表明过度对齐受模型和文本语言影响，且仅从过度拒绝角度评估不够。研究显示提示工程可缓解该问题，而abliteration（拒绝方向消融）能彻底消除拒绝且对任务性能影响极小。
summary_sections.motivation: LLM在刑事法律场景中的合法工作常因模型安全护栏（如拒答和免责声明）而受阻，这种现象称为过度对齐，但目前缺乏针对性评估和缓解方法。
summary_sections.method: 基于瑞士联邦最高法院公开裁决构建多语言基准TF-RefusalBench，包含5,200条可能触发拒答的提示；评估不同模型和语言下的拒答率；比较提示工程与abliteration（拒绝方向消融）两种缓解策略。
summary_sections.result: 过度对齐是多面现象，其影响不能仅从拒答率衡量，还需考虑免责声明对任务忠实度的破坏；abliteration几乎完全消除拒绝，且对翻译和摘要任务性能影响极小。
summary_sections.conclusion: 对于刑事法律场景中的LLM部署，abliteration是消除过度对齐的有效手段，而提示工程效果有限。

papers.title: IPO Finance Agent: Benchmark of LLM Financial Analysts Beyond Finance Agent v2, with Automated Rubric Generation, on the SpaceX (SPCX) IPO
papers.abstract_en: Finance Agent v2 (by Vals AI) has emerged as the reference benchmark for evaluating both Anthropic Claude and OpenAI ChatGPT frontier language models on financial tasks. However, it narrowly deals with periodic reporting from publicly traded companies (SEC 10-K and 10-Q filings), and its agentic harness relies on naive, unenriched chunk retrieval. Neither the task design nor the retrieval approach addresses the distinct challenges of IPO due diligence. SEC S-1 filings combine historical financial statements, governance structures, pro forma and common-control accounting treatments, capital-formation narratives, and underwriting-sensitive risk disclosures within substantially longer documents than typical periodic filings. That is why we introduce IPO Finance Agent, which extends the Finance Agent v2 framework along two directions: task domain and retrieval architecture. During our experiments, the original Finance Agent v2 harness basically failed to deliver any output related to the SpaceX S-1 filing, due to document length. We therefore had to improve the agentic harness with contextual retrieval, a more realistic and industry-standard approach for long documents. We also built a dataset of 1,000 IPO-diligence questions, and publicly release 70 questions on the SpaceX (SPCX) S-1 filing to support reproducibility, while the remainder are held private to guard against benchmark contamination. In addition, we introduce an evaluator-optimizer pipeline to automatically generate evaluation rubrics for the benchmark: candidate facts are extracted from model answers, consolidated into draft criteria, then automatically audited for omissions, hallucinations, mistiered items, and redundancy, with LLM feedback driving iterative repair, targeted enrichment, and deduplication. Human experts only review final rubrics before deployment. Results show that the best-performing evaluated model, Zhipu GLM-5.2, reaches 79.8% accuracy, and the most cost-efficient model on the resulting Pareto frontier, Xiaomi MiMo-2.5 Pro, reaches slightly lower accuracy (77.2%) at 0.05 USD per query, while exceeding the current Finance Agent v2 leaderboard ceiling, Google Gemini 3.5 Flash at 57.9% for 2.51 USD per query, and undercutting even FABv2's cheapest entry (MiniMax M3: 48.3% at 0.32 USD) on cost-efficiency. Code and data are released on GitHub https://github.com/benstaf/ipoagent

Conclusion: IPO金融代理是首个针对IPO尽职调查的LLM评估基准，并展示了自动生成评分标准的可行性。

papers.title: InteractiveAvatar: Real-Time Streaming Video Generation for Consistent and Intent-Aware Avatars
papers.abstract_en: Recent diffusion-based models have enabled realistic audio-driven avatar generation in real-time streaming. However, existing approaches struggle to maintain visual temporal consistency and fail to explicitly perceive user intent in complex interactive streaming scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose InteractiveAvatar, a real-time infinite-streaming video generation framework that supports visually consistent avatar video generation and intent-aware interactions. With autoregressive distillation, InteractiveAvatar achieves real-time str-eaming generation of human avatars over arbitrarily long durations. For visual consistency, we introduce a Long-Short Visual Memory (LSVM) mechanism that flexibly compresses historical visual information into compact tokens, preserving both short-range coherence and long-term consistency. To generate avatars with speeches and actions aligned with user intent, we propose a Reasoning-Reaction Module (RRM), which incorporates a State-Cycling strategy and a Cache-Switching mechanism. Extensive experimental results over diverse scenarios demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art visual consistency in long-duration generation, while enabling complex user-avatar interaction in real time.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出InteractiveAvatar，一个实时无限流视频生成框架，通过自回归蒸馏实现任意长时长的流式生成。引入长-短视觉记忆（LSVM）机制压缩历史视觉信息为紧凑令牌，保持短程连贯性和长程一致性。提出推理-反应模块（RRM），包含状态循环策略和缓存切换机制，实现与用户意图对齐的语音和动作生成。实验表明在长时长生成中达到最优视觉一致性，并支持实时复杂人机交互。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型在实时音频驱动虚拟形象生成中难以维持时间视觉一致性，且无法在复杂交互流场景中显式感知用户意图。
Method: 提出InteractiveAvatar框架，包含自回归蒸馏实现实时无限流生成；长-短视觉记忆（LSVM）压缩历史视觉信息；推理-反应模块（RRM）通过状态循环和缓存切换实现意图感知。
Result: 实验在多样场景下表明，方法在长时长生成中达到最先进的视觉一致性，并支持实时用户-虚拟形象交互。
Conclusion: 该方法有效解决了实时流式虚拟形象生成中的视觉一致性和意图感知问题。

papers.title: The Geometry of Refusal: Linear Instability in Safety-Aligned LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) rely on extensive safety alignment, yet the mechanistic basis of refusal remains opaque. In this work, we investigate whether safety compliance is a deep semantic decision or a manipulable linear feature. We introduce Contrastive Logit Steering (CLS), a zero-optimization framework that isolates the "refusal direction" by contrasting hidden states derived from safe and unrestricted system prompts. Unlike representation engineering methods that intervene on internal activations, CLS operates directly on the output distribution, serving as a diagnostic probe for alignment fragility. When coupled with prefix injection to bypass initial refusal reflexes, this method induces a phase transition where guardrails collapse. Our experiments on 7 model families reveal that safety implementation is architecturally deterministic. While models like Llama-3.1 exhibit a "Late Decision" topology that is easily bypassed by CLS (reaching 95% ASR in approximately one second), others like Qwen-2.5 demonstrate "Early Divergence" by integrating safety mid-computation. Direct comparison with established activation-level steering methods shows that CLS achieves substantially higher attack success rates on Llama 2 (73% vs. 22.6%) and Qwen 7B (91% vs. 79.2%), demonstrating that logit-level intervention exposes alignment vulnerabilities that hidden-state methods underestimate. Beyond attacks, we show that this linearity enables bidirectional control: inverting the steering vector "hardens" models against jailbreaks without retraining. Our findings suggest that current alignment techniques create a steerable "safety axis" that serves as both a critical vulnerability and a precise primitive for defense.
papers.comment: Accepted at TrustNLP 2026 (Sixth Workshop on Trustworthy Natural Language Processing, ACL 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过对比logit steering (CLS) 框架揭示LLM安全对齐的线性脆弱性，发现拒绝行为是一种可操控的线性特征。实验表明，不同模型架构（如Llama-3.1的“晚决策”拓扑和Qwen-2.5的“早发散”）对攻击的鲁棒性不同，CLS在攻击成功率上显著优于激活层干预方法，且反向控制可增强防御。
Motivation: 现有安全对齐的机制尚不透明，作者希望探究拒绝行为是深层语义决策还是可操控的线性特征。
Method: 提出对比logit steering (CLS) 框架，通过对比安全与无限制系统提示的隐藏状态隔离“拒绝方向”，直接作用于输出分布，并结合前缀注入绕过初始拒绝反射。
Result: 在7个模型族上，CLS对Llama-3.1达到95%的攻击成功率（ASR），时间约1秒；相比于激活层方法，CLS在Llama 2上ASR从22.6%提升到73%，在Qwen 7B上从79.2%提升到91%。反向控制可增强模型防御。
Conclusion: 当前对齐技术创造了一个可操控的“安全轴”，既是关键脆弱性也是精确防御原语。

papers.title: A Neurosymbolic Framework for Interpretable Skeleton-Based Seizure Detection via Concept-Driven Logical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Video-based seizure detection is essential for the management of epilepsy patients, offering a non-invasive complement to electroencephalography. While several deep learning approaches have been developed for video-based seizure detection, none are inherently interpretable, limiting their adoption and translation into clinical practice. We present, to our knowledge, the first exploration of a neurosymbolic framework for video-based seizure detection that directly addresses this gap. Our approach (1) extracts patient-centric skeleton sequences from epilepsy monitoring units via a prompt-guided foundation model, (2) predicts binary spatio-temporal concept activations grounded in clinical motor semiology guidelines, and (3) composes them via differentiable logic into interpretable Boolean rules with auditable contributions. Furthermore, to mitigate false positives arising from the traditional binary formulation (seizure vs.\ non-seizure), we sub-classify non-seizure segments into clinically relevant normal activities, providing the model with fine-grained discriminative supervision. Evaluated on two public seizure video benchmarks, our framework achieves 89.78% sensitivity with 0.06 false detections per hour on SAHZU and 85.27%,0.09 on IEEE, while producing complete three-level interpretability: every prediction decomposes into which motor primitives were detected, how they were logically composed, and how much each rule contributed to the clinical decision. We publicly release all annotations, extracted pose sequences, our data pipeline and code, https://github.com/Mr-TalhaIlyas/CDSD/.

TL;DR: 本文提出首个用于视频癫痫检测的神经符号框架，通过提示引导的基础模型提取患者中心骨骼序列，预测基于临床运动半规的二元时空概念激活，并利用可微逻辑将其组合为可解释的布尔规则。该方法还通过将非癫痫段细分为正常活动来减少误报。在SAHZU和IEEE两个公共基准上分别达到89.78%和85.27%的灵敏度，每小时误检次数分别为0.06和0.09，同时提供三级可解释性。
Motivation: 现有基于视频的癫痫检测深度学习方法缺乏内在可解释性，限制了其临床转化。
Method: 使用提示引导的基础模型提取患者中心骨骼序列，预测基于临床运动半规的二元时空概念激活，并通过可微逻辑组合为可解释的布尔规则；同时将非癫痫段细分为正常活动以提供细粒度监督。
Result: 在SAHZU数据集上达到89.78%灵敏度、0.06次/小时误检；在IEEE数据集上达到85.27%灵敏度、0.09次/小时误检。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了三级可解释性：每个预测可分解为检测到的运动基元、逻辑组合方式及每项规则对临床决策的贡献。代码和数据集已公开。

papers.title: PIAvatar: Physically Interactive Avatars via Deformation Gradient Decoupling
papers.abstract_en: 3D human avatars have shown impressive visual fidelity driven by pose-conditioned models, yet they still lack the physical ability required for interactions with each other and environments. Although recent studies have made various attempts to incorporate physical characteristics into 3D avatars, they only exhibit limited physical deformations, often leading to constrained interaction behaviors. To resolve this issue, we present PIAvatar, a framework to simultaneously enable physically aware interactions between avatar-avatar and avatar-environment, and a non-rigid deformable human body simulation. In this work, our key insight is to decouple kinematic velocity from deformation gradient. When external forces act on avatars, the kinematic velocity induces stress which hinders the avatar's ability to achieve a desired pose. In addition, we integrate a skeletal framework within the avatar. It allows estimating its poses and real-time tracking in a closed form, even during non-rigid physical interactions. Our approach is implemented within a conventional Material Point Method framework to ensure physically consistent dynamics. We lastly evaluate the method on both human-object and human-human interaction scenarios to assess its behavior under diverse interaction settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PIAvatar 框架，通过解耦运动速度与变形梯度，实现化身-化身和化身-环境之间的物理感知交互，并支持非刚性可变形人体模拟。该方法在传统物质点法框架内集成骨骼结构，实现实时姿态估计与跟踪。在人物交互和人-人交互场景下评估，展示了多样化的物理交互行为。
Motivation: 现有3D人体化身缺乏物理交互能力，已有的尝试仅能表现有限的物理变形，导致交互行为受限。
Method: 提出 PIAvatar，核心思想是解耦运动速度与变形梯度，避免外力引起的应力干扰姿态；并在化身内集成骨骼框架，实现非刚性物理交互下的实时姿态估计与跟踪，整体在物质点法（Material Point Method）框架中实现。
Result: 在人物交互和人-人交互场景中评估，方法能展现丰富的物理变形和交互行为。
Conclusion: 通过解耦运动速度与变形梯度，并集成骨骼框架，PIAvatar 能够实现更自然的化身-化身和化身-环境物理交互。
