papers.title: Distill Once, Adapt Life-Long: Exploring Dataset Distillation for Continual Test-Time Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) aims to maintain model performance under evolving target domains by adapting online without labeled data. However, practical deployments often cannot retain the source dataset due to privacy or licensing constraints, and purely source-free CTTA methods tend to become unstable under long-term distribution shift, suffering from compounding self-training errors and catastrophic forgetting. We introduce DO-ALL (Distill Once, Adapt Life-Long), a plug-and-play framework that revisits source information in a compact and privacy-conscious form via Dataset Distillation (DD). Before deployment, DO-ALL performs DD to produce a small set of synthetic distilled anchors that summarize the source distribution. During adaptation, each target sample is matched with its most semantically aligned anchor, which provides a stable reference for various CTTA via source replay, representation alignment, and manifold-smoothing regularization. DO-ALL can be seamlessly integrated into existing CTTA algorithms, consistently improving long-term robustness across CIFAR100-C, ImageNet-C, and the CCC benchmark. This demonstrates the potential of leveraging DD to enable stable and continuous adaptation without retaining raw source data. The code is available at https://github.com/blue-531/DOALL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DO-ALL 框架，用于持续测试时适应（CTTA），通过数据集蒸馏（DD）生成少量合成锚点，总结源分布，在适应过程中为目标样本提供稳定参考，无需保留原始源数据。在 CIFAR100-C、ImageNet-C 和 CCC 基准上，DO-ALL 能够提升现有 CTTA 方法的长期鲁棒性。
Motivation: 实际部署中，源数据集常因隐私或许可限制无法保留，而纯无源 CTTA 方法在长期分布偏移下会因自训练错误累积和灾难性遗忘变得不稳定。
Method: 部署前对源数据进行数据集蒸馏，生成紧凑的合成锚点；适应时，将每个目标样本与最语义对齐的锚点匹配，并通过源回放、表示对齐和流形平滑正则化来实现稳定适应。
Result: 在 CIFAR100-C、ImageNet-C 和 CCC 基准上，DO-ALL 能一致提升现有 CTTA 算法的长期鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 数据集蒸馏为无源持续适应提供了一种隐私友好且稳定的可行方案，可无缝集成到现有 CTTA 算法中。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: PSCT-Net: Geometry-Aware Pediatric Skull CT Reconstruction via Differentiable Back-Projection and Attention-Guided Refinement
papers.abstract_en: Computed Tomography (CT) is essential for diagnosing pediatric craniofacial abnormalities, yet poses radiation risks to developing anatomies. Reconstructing 3D CT from sparse bi-planar X-rays offers a low-dose alternative but is severely ill-posed. Existing methods employ geometry-agnostic feature lifting, naively projecting 2D features into 3D without explicit spatial modeling, causing depth ambiguity and degraded osseous boundaries. We present PSCT-Net, a geometry-aware framework with differentiable back-projection. Differentiable back-projection establishes a spatially faithful volumetric prior, alleviating depth ambiguity. An Attention-Guided Projection (AGP-3D) module then learns non-linear voxel-wise correspondences between 2D regions and 3D locations. A Bidirectional Mamba (BiM-3D) module captures long-range volumetric dependencies with linear complexity. We further curate a private institutional pediatric skull CT cohort, PedSkull-CT, comprising normal and pathological cases for internal evaluation, addressing the gap in adult-centric, trunk-focused datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PSCT-Net，一种基于几何感知的儿科颅骨CT重建框架，通过可微反投影（differentiable back-projection）从稀疏双平面X光重建3D CT。方法包括注意力引导投影（AGP-3D）模块学习2D-3D体素对应，以及双向Mamba（BiM-3D）模块以线性复杂度捕获长距离体素依赖。作者还收集了私有儿科颅骨CT数据集PedSkull-CT用于内部评估。
Motivation: 儿科CT有辐射风险，从稀疏双平面X光重建3D CT是低剂量替代方案，但现有方法缺乏几何建模，导致深度模糊和骨边界退化。
Method: 提出可微反投影建立空间忠实体素先验，缓解深度模糊；AGP-3D模块学习2D区域与3D位置的非线性体素对应；BiM-3D模块以线性复杂度捕获长距离体素依赖。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，仅说明方法在内部数据集上评估。
Conclusion: PSCT-Net通过几何感知框架和可微反投影改善了儿科颅骨CT重建质量，但泛化性需进一步验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AMALIA-VL: A Native European Portuguese Open-Source Vision and Language Model
papers.abstract_en: Large Vision and Language Models (LVLMs) have advanced rapidly, yet European Portuguese (pt-PT) remains systematically underserved by existing open-source multimodal models, which either conflate it with Brazilian Portuguese or severely under-represent it in their training data mixes. We introduce AMALIA-VL, the first open-source instruction-tuned LVLM built natively for pt-PT, pairing a high-resolution vision encoder with dynamic image tiling and a fully open pt-PT-optimized language model via a learned connector. We contribute with a purposefully designed three-stage training process - vision-language alignment, general visual instruction tuning, and preference optimization - together with a pt-PT-centric multimodal data mix combining curated and translated public datasets with novel datasets that address the near-total absence of European Portuguese multimodal resources. Our evaluation shows that AMALIA-VL establishes a strong baseline for open-source pt-PT LVLMs.We will release model weights, training data, and construction pipelines along with machine-translated pt-PT evaluation benchmarks to help democratize pt-PT LVLM development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍 AMALIA-VL，首个专为欧洲葡萄牙语 (pt-PT) 构建的开源指令微调大视觉语言模型 (LVLM)，采用高分辨率视觉编码器、动态图像平铺及基于学习连接器的 pt-PT 优化语言模型，并设计三阶段训练流程——视觉-语言对齐、通用视觉指令微调和偏好优化，结合人工筛选与翻译的 pt-PT 多模态数据混合。评估表明该模型为开源 pt-PT LVLM 建立了强基线。
Motivation: 现有开源多模态模型严重缺乏对欧洲葡萄牙语 (pt-PT) 的支持，常将其与巴西葡萄牙语混为一谈或在训练数据中占比极低。
Method: 构建 AMALIA-VL，包含高分辨率视觉编码器、动态图像平贴模块及通过学习连接器连接的 pt-PT 优化语言模型；采用三阶段训练：视觉-语言对齐、通用视觉指令微调、偏好优化；并设计包含 curated 和翻译公开数据集以及新增 pt-PT 多模态资源的数据混合。
Result: 评估显示 AMALIA-VL 为开源 pt-PT LVLM 建立了强基线，并将发布模型权重、训练数据、构建管道及机器翻译的 pt-PT 评估基准。
Conclusion: 该工作旨在通过提供首个原生 pt-PT 开源 LVLM 及其相关资源，推动欧洲葡萄牙语多模态模型开发的民主化。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Structural Preservation and the Logical Expressiveness of Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Bridges between graph neural networks (GNNs) and logical formalisms have been established by fixing architectural choices, such as the types of aggregation, combination, and activation functions. These choices define restricted classes of GNNs for which tight correspondences with logical formalisms can be obtained, by showing that logical formulae can be translated into equivalent GNNs and, conversely, that GNNs can be translated into equivalent formulae. In this paper we take a semantic perspective by establishing the logical expressiveness of classes of GNN classifiers that are preserved under structural properties: embeddings (extensions), injective homomorphisms, and homomorphisms. We show that, for each such property, there exists a fragment of graded modal logic characterising the class of GNNs. In particular, preservation under embeddings, injective homomorphisms, and homomorphisms corresponds to existential graded modal logic, its existential-positive fragment, and existential-positive modal logic, respectively. These results characterise the expressiveness of broad classes of GNNs independently of specific architectural choices, but we also show that each of these classes admits a GNN architecture of the same expressiveness. Technically, our approach uses a new well-quasi-order result for trees of bounded height, yielding finite representations of unravelling-invariant classes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从语义角度研究图神经网络（GNN）分类器在结构保持性质（嵌入、内射同态、同态）下的逻辑表达能力。证明对于每种保持性质，存在对应的分级模态逻辑片段刻画GNN类：嵌入保持对应存在性分级模态逻辑，内射同态保持对应其存在性正片段，同态保持对应存在性正模态逻辑。技术贡献包括利用有界高度树的良拟序结果获得有限表示。
Motivation: 现有工作通过固定架构选择（如聚合、组合函数）建立GNN与逻辑的对应，但缺乏跨架构的通用语义表征。本文旨在不依赖具体架构的情况下，从语义保持性质出发刻画GNN分类器的逻辑表达能力。
Method: 采用语义视角，定义三类结构保持性（嵌入、内射同态、同态）并研究GNN分类器在这些性质下的逻辑刻画。使用良拟序理论处理有界高度树，得到展开不变类的有限表示，进而映射到分级模态逻辑片段。
Result: 证明保持嵌入、内射同态、同态的GNN分类器分别对应于存在性分级模态逻辑、其存在性正片段以及存在性正模态逻辑。这些结果独立于具体架构，且每类均可构造出对应表达能力的GNN架构。
Conclusion: 本文建立了广泛GNN类与分级模态逻辑片段间的精确语义对应，为理解GNN表达能力提供理论基础。方法可推广至其他结构保持性质，但当前限于图分类任务且未涉及连续特征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Post-Training Shapes Biological Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Scientific reasoning models for biology combine language models with foundation models trained on multimodal biological data, including DNA, RNA, and proteins. These models are built through post-training, yet how each stage shapes reasoning and generalization remains poorly understood. We study when post-training improves performance and when it induces over-specialization. Across genomics, transcriptomics, and proteins, we train and evaluate more than 100 biological reasoning models under controlled variation in backbone, continued pre-training (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), measuring both in-domain (ID) and out-of-domain (OOD) performance. We find that each post-training stage reshapes generalization in a distinct way rather than contributing uniform gains. CPT improves downstream performance by aligning models with biological language. SFT consistently increases ID performance but causes OOD performance to peak early and decline as models fit the training distribution. RL, when applied to strong SFT checkpoints with aligned rewards, improves OOD performance and partially recovers generalization. These results show that biological reasoning does not improve monotonically with additional supervision or compute. Instead, performance depends on how training stages are composed. Under fixed post-training budgets, the strongest ID-OOD trade-off comes from brief SFT, larger RL allocations, and asymmetric adaptation capacity across stages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究后训练（continued pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning）如何影响生物学推理模型（biology reasoning models）在基因组学、转录组学和蛋白质组学上的泛化能力。通过对100多个模型的控制实验，发现不同训练阶段对域内和域外性能有不同的影响，而不是单调提升。最佳性价比是短SFT、更多RL和不对称的适应容量。
Motivation: 生物学推理模型通常通过后训练构建，但各阶段（CPT, SFT, RL）如何塑造模型的推理和泛化能力尚未被充分理解，尤其是何时提升性能、何时导致过专门化。
Method: 在基因组学、转录组学和蛋白质组学数据集上，控制骨干网络、持续预训练、监督微调和强化学习的变化，训练并评估超过100个生物学推理模型，测量域内和域外性能。
Result: 持续预训练通过对齐生物语言提升下游性能；监督微调一致提升域内性能但域外性能先升后降；强化学习应用到强SFT检查点并配以对齐奖励时，可提升域外性能并部分恢复泛化。在固定后训练预算下，最佳域内-域外权衡来自短暂SFT、更多RL分配和不对称的阶段间适应容量。
Conclusion: 生物学推理并不随额外监督或计算而单调提升，性能取决于训练阶段的组成方式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning a Sampling-Free Variational DNN Plugin from Tiny Training Sets to Refine OOD Segmentation With Uncertainty Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks (DNNs) frequently fail to generalize to out-of-distribution (OOD) medical images because of variations in scanners and acquisition protocols. Retraining DNN models to address these distribution shifts is often impractical due to the high cost of acquiring and annotating new medical datasets. To address this, we introduce VarDeepPCA, a novel lightweight variational DNN framework designed to restore/refine degraded segmentation maps by leveraging intrinsic geometric priors. Unlike existing approaches that require target-domain data or extensive pre-training, our VarDeepPCA explicitly learns a distribution of valid anatomical geometries using only small in-distribution (ID) datasets. Theoretically, our novel variational learning framework leverages a reinterpretation of the softmax mapping to implicitly perform exact distribution modeling, thereby enabling computationally efficient, sampling-free learning and inference. This also enables VarDeepPCA to provide uncertainty estimates associated with its restored segmentation maps. We empirically validate our framework across 4 distinct clinical applications, using 14 publicly available datasets, involving segmentation of the myocardium, neuroretinal rim, prostate, and fetal head. Comparisons against 15 existing methods demonstrate that VarDeepPCA consistently restores segmentation maps produced by the existing methods on OOD data to (i) significantly improve anatomical plausibility of geometries and clinical utility of the segmentations, and (ii) significantly reduce errors, without needing any more training data than that used by existing methods.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:017
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 VarDeepPCA，一种轻量级变分深度神经网络框架，用于修复医学图像中因分布偏移导致的退化分割图。该框架无需目标域数据或大量预训练，仅利用少量同分布数据集学习解剖几何先验，通过重新解释 softmax 映射实现精确分布建模，支持免采样学习与推理，并能提供不确定性估计。在心肌、视神经、前列腺和胎儿头部等4种临床应用的14个公开数据集上，与15种现有方法对比，VarDeepPCA 持续提升了分割图的解剖合理性和临床实用性，并显著降低了误差。
Motivation: 深度神经网络在医学图像中常因扫描仪和采集协议变化导致的分布偏移而泛化失败，重新训练模型成本高昂，需要一种无需目标域数据或大量预训练的方法来修复退化分割图。
Method: 提出 VarDeepPCA 轻量级变分 DNN 框架，利用内在几何先验，通过重新解释 softmax 映射进行精确分布建模，实现计算高效的免采样学习和推理，并能够提供不确定性估计。
Result: 在4种临床应用的14个公开数据集上，与15种现有方法对比，VarDeepPCA 持续改善了分割图的解剖合理性和临床实用性，显著减少了分割误差。
Conclusion: 摘要强调 VarDeepPCA 能够仅利用小规模同分布数据集学习有效解剖几何分布，无需额外训练数据，提供不确定性估计，且免采样的特性使其计算高效。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: CoMNet: A MedNeXt-CorrDiff Framework for Multi-Site Brain Tumor Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from multiparametric magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is critical for treatment planning, response assessment, and neuro-oncology research. However, automated segmentation remains a difficult task in computer vision because of variation in tumor appearance and MRI protocols across patient scans. Moreover, clinically important regions such as enhancing tumor and tumor core are often small relative to the full brain volume, further increasing the difficulty of achieving high voxel-level precision. These challenges are amplified in multi-site datasets, where differences in scanner hardware and acquisition parameters can introduce non-biological variation. To address this, networks must learn tumor-specific features while remaining robust to site-dependent noise. In this paper, we show that an ensemble of multi-fold predictions from a modern 3D convolutional segmentation network with corrective diffusion (CorrDiff) post-processing improves brain tumor segmentation across datasets. We propose CoMNet, an ensembled MedNeXt-CorrDiff framework for accurate multi-site brain tumor segmentation. In this framework, we use MedNeXt as the primary segmentation model for feature learning, while a corrective diffusion block learns to refine the residual errors in the individual prediction maps before probabilistic thresholding. This process reduces the variance across fold predictions by correcting fold-specific residual errors and aggregating them into a consensus mask that is less sensitive to site-dependent imaging variability. Our proposed framework achieved the highest Dice score compared to two baseline models on the UTSW-Glioma and BraTS-SSA datasets. Experimental results support the use of corrective diffusion and fold-level probability ensembling as meaningful additions to existing state-of-the-art models for accurate glioma segmentation on multi-site datasets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CoMNet，一种集成MedNeXt分割网络与纠正扩散（CorrDiff）后处理的框架，用于多站点脑肿瘤分割。该方法通过MedNeXt学习特征，利用CorrDiff模块修正个体预测残差，再通过折叠集成生成对站点依赖性噪声鲁棒的共识掩膜。实验在UTSW-Glioma和BraTS-SSA数据集上取得最高Dice分数。
Motivation: 多参数MRI脑肿瘤分割面临肿瘤外观变化、MRI协议差异、增强肿瘤和肿瘤核心区域小等挑战，多站点数据集的硬件差异进一步加剧难度。现有方法难以同时学习肿瘤特异性特征并保持对站点噪声的鲁棒性。
Method: 使用MedNeXt作为主分割网络进行特征学习，引入纠正扩散（CorrDiff）块学习修正个体预测图的残差，然后通过概率阈值和折叠级概率集成得到共识掩膜，减少折叠预测方差。
Result: 在UTSW-Glioma和BraTS-SSA数据集上，CoMNet相比于两个基线模型获得了最高的Dice分数。
Conclusion: 纠正扩散和折叠级概率集成可作为现有先进模型的有意义补充，提升多站点胶质瘤分割的准确性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Pano3D: Unified 3D Reconstruction and Panoptic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D feedforward reconstruction neural networks have achieved remarkable success in dense reconstruction from images without any camera parameters. Yet, equipping these models with robust semantic understanding remains an open problem. Here we introduce an approach that performs 3D reconstruction and 3D panoptic segmentation in a unified framework. We build on existing 3D reconstruction models and augment them with a set-based mask decoder. The approach is jointly trained with a geometric and semantic loss, which are shown to be mutually beneficial. More precisely, the features are initialized from the geometric information and then finetuned to capture jointly geometry and semantics. We demonstrate the generality of our approach by successfully applying our framework both to online and all-to-all attention reconstruction backbones. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in 3D panoptic segmentation across ScanNet, ScanNet200, and ScanNet++ datasets. Ablation studies show that such joint training of a unified model equips 3D feedforward reconstruction neural networks with panoptic segmentation and yields mutually beneficial improvements.
papers.comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project page: https://victorbbt.github.io/Pano3D/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Pano3D，一个统一3D重建与全景分割（panoptic segmentation）的框架。它基于现有的3D前馈重建模型，添加集掩码解码器（set-based mask decoder），并通过几何和语义损失的联合训练实现两者的相互促进。在ScanNet、ScanNet200和ScanNet++数据集上，该方法在3D全景分割任务中达到了当前最优性能。
Motivation: 当前的3D前馈重建网络在无需相机参数的情况下实现了高质量的密集重建，但缺乏鲁棒的语义理解能力。
Method: 在现有3D重建模型基础上，引入集掩码解码器（set-based mask decoder），并通过几何损失和语义损失的联合训练，使特征先由几何信息初始化再微调以共同捕捉几何与语义。
Result: 在ScanNet、ScanNet200和ScanNet++数据集上，该方法在3D全景分割任务中取得了最优性能。
Conclusion: 联合训练使几何和语义相互受益，为3D前馈重建网络赋予了全景分割能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Same-Origin Policy for Agentic Browsers
papers.abstract_en: Agentic browsers integrate autonomous AI agents into web browsers, enabling users to accomplish web tasks through natural-language instructions. The same-origin policy (SOP) is a fundamental browser security mechanism that prevents unauthorized automated cross-origin data flows induced by scripts. However, whether SOP remains effective in agentic browsers is an open question that has not been systematically studied. In this work, we bridge this gap. We first observe that an agentic browser can itself serve as an automated channel for cross-origin data flows, potentially leading to SOP violations. To investigate this phenomenon, we construct SOPBench, a benchmark for evaluating SOP violations in agentic browsers. Our evaluation shows that existing agentic browsers frequently violate SOP, both in benign settings and under attacks. To address this problem, we propose SOPGuard, an SOP enforcement mechanism tailored to agentic browsers. We implement SOPGuard in BrowserOS, an open-source agentic browser. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SOPGuard effectively enforces SOP while preserving utility and incurring only a small runtime overhead. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/wxl-lxw/BrowserOS-SOPGuard.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了自主浏览器（agentic browsers）中同源策略（SOP）的有效性问题。作者发现自主浏览器本身可能成为跨源数据流的自动化通道，导致SOP违规。为此，他们构建了SOPBench基准测试，评估现有自主浏览器的SOP违规情况，并提出SOPGuard机制，在开源自主浏览器BrowserOS中实现，有效执行SOP且开销较小。
Motivation: 自主浏览器将AI代理集成到浏览器中，但同源策略（SOP）是否仍有效尚未被系统研究，存在安全漏洞风险。
Method: 构建SOPBench基准测试评估SOP违规；提出SOPGuard机制，在BrowserOS中实现以强制执行SOP。
Result: 评估显示现有自主浏览器在良性场景和攻击下频繁违反SOP；SOPGuard能有效执行SOP，保持实用性，运行时开销小。
Conclusion: SOPGuard可有效保护自主浏览器的跨源数据安全，代码和数据已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: IterCAD: An Iterative Multimodal Agent for Visually-Grounded CAD Generation and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Computer-Aided Design is pivotal in modern manufacturing, yet existing automated methods predominantly rely on open-loop, one-shot generation, creating a mismatch with iterative real-world practices. In this paper, we present IterCAD, a unified multimodal agent framework for closed-loop, interactive CAD generation and editing. We formulate the task as a multi-turn interaction between a multimodal agent and an executable CAD sandbox, covering three tasks: Drawing-to-Code, Text-to-Code, and Interactive Editing. To support this, we develop a data synthesis pipeline incorporating advanced industrial manufacturing features to generate standard-compliant multi-view engineering drawings, complex code-editing tasks, and high-fidelity interaction trajectories. We optimize the agent via progressive SFT followed by geometry-aware reinforcement learning with viable-prefix masking to enhance code executability and geometric fidelity. Finally, we introduce the IterCAD-Bench evaluation suite and propose the Chamfer Distance Tolerance-Recall (CD-TR) curve alongside its AUC-TR metric, establishing a survivor-bias-free standard that unifies code validity and geometric precision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that IterCAD achieves highly competitive performance across multiple benchmarks, significantly outperforming existing approaches in both code executability and geometric precision, while exhibiting superior capabilities in closed-loop iterative refinement.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 IterCAD，一个统一的多模态智能体框架，用于闭环、交互式的 CAD 生成与编辑。任务被建模为多模态智能体与可执行 CAD 沙箱之间的多轮交互，涵盖绘图到代码、文本到代码和交互式编辑三类子任务。通过数据合成流水线生成符合工业标准的多视图工程图纸和复杂编辑任务，并采用渐进式监督微调（SFT）结合几何感知强化学习与可行前缀掩码来优化智能体。同时提出 IterCAD-Bench 评估套件和 CD-TR 曲线及 AUC-TR 指标，消除存活者偏差。实验表明，IterCAD 在代码可执行性和几何精度上显著优于现有方法，并展现闭环迭代优化的优越能力。
Motivation: 现有计算机辅助设计（CAD）自动化方法主要依赖开环、一次生成的方式，与现实中迭代式设计实践不匹配，缺乏闭环交互能力。
Method: 提出统一的多模态智能体框架，将 CAD 生成与编辑建模为多轮交互；构建包含高级工业制造特征的数据合成流水线；采用渐进式 SFT 和几何感知强化学习（含可行前缀掩码）优化智能体；提出新的评估指标 CD-TR 和 AUC-TR。
Result: 在多个基准上取得竞争性性能，代码可执行性和几何精度显著优于现有方法，并在闭环迭代精炼中表现优越。
Conclusion: IterCAD 验证了闭环多模态交互框架在 CAD 生成与编辑中的有效性，为下一代交互式设计工具提供了基础。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ComAct: Reframing Professional Software Manipulation via COM-as-Action Paradigm
papers.abstract_en: Existing computer-use agents remain fundamentally limited in professional software manipulation: GUI-based agents suffer from fragile visual grounding and long-horizon error accumulation, while API-basedapproaches struggle with heterogeneous protocols and inaccessible commercial interfaces. In this work,we identify the Component Object Model (COM) as a unified executable abstraction, proposing COM-as-Action: a new paradigm that reframes professional software interaction as deterministic program synthesisrather than sequential visual control. To validate this paradigm in the most demanding environments, weintroduce ComCADBench, the first benchmark for agents operating real industrial CAD software. Ourexperiments reveal a substantial paradigm gap: frontier proprietary models achieve near-zero successunder GUI-based interaction, whereas COM-based execution yields substantial immediate gains. Tobridge the remaining gap between syntactic correctness and geometric accuracy, we develop ComActor, aself-correcting agent trained through a progressive three-stage framework, alongside ComForge, a scalableplatform for large-scale training in Windows containers. Extensive experiments show that ComActorachieves state-of-the-art performance on ComCADBench, with strong resilience in long-horizon taskswhere baselines collapse, and generalizes to external CAD benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出COM-as-Action范式，将专业软件操作重新定义为确定性程序合成，而非传统的视觉控制。引入ComCADBench基准，用于评估工业CAD软件中的代理。实验表明，基于COM的执行比GUI交互有显著提升，并开发了自修正代理ComActor和训练平台ComForge，在ComCADBench上取得SOTA性能。
Motivation: 现有GUI代理在专业软件操作中存在视觉定位脆弱和长程错误累积问题，而API方法受限于协议异构和商业接口不可访问。论文识别Component Object Model (COM)作为统一的可执行抽象，旨在解决这些局限。
Method: 提出COM-as-Action范式，将软件交互转化为确定性程序合成。构建ComCADBench基准，开发ComActor代理，通过渐进三阶段框架训练，并建立ComForge平台用于Windows容器中的大规模训练。
Result: 前沿专有模型在GUI交互下接近零成功率，而COM执行带来显著提升。ComActor在ComCADBench上达到SOTA，在长程任务中表现强韧性，并泛化到外部CAD基准。
Conclusion: COM-as-Action范式能有效桥接专业软件操作中语法正确性与几何精度之间的差距，为工业软件自动化提供新方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 前沿专有模型在GUI交互下接近零成功率，而COM执行带来显著提升。ComActor在ComCADBench上达到SOTA，在长程任务中表现强韧性，并泛化到外部CAD基准。
summary_sections.conclusion: COM-as-Action范式能有效桥接专业软件操作中语法正确性与几何精度之间的差距，为工业软件自动化提供新方向。

papers.title: INFUSER: Influence-Guided Self-Evolution Improves Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolution offers a scalable path to stronger reasoning: a pretrained language model improves itself with only minimal external supervision. Yet existing methods either depend on extensively curated or teacher-generated training data, or, when the generator runs unsupervised, reward it by a difficulty heuristic that need not improve the solver. We introduce INFUSER, an iterative co-training framework with two co-evolving roles: a Generator that drafts questions and reference golden answers from a pool of unstructured, automatically collected documents, and a Solver that improves by training on them. The solver is trained with standard correctness rewards against the generator-provided answers, while the generator is rewarded by an optimizer-aware influence score that measures whether each proposed question would actually improve the solver on the target distribution. Because this continuous, noisy influence score is poorly served by standard GRPO, we propose DuGRPO, a dual-normalized variant of GRPO, for generator training. Together, these turn the document pool into an adaptive curriculum that favors questions useful to the current solver, not just hard ones. On Qwen3-8B-Base, INFUSER outperforms strong self-evolution baselines with over 20% relative improvement on Olympiad and SuperGPQA benchmarks, and an 8B INFUSER co-evolving generator outperforms a frozen 32B thinking generator on math and coding. Ablations confirm each design choice is necessary, and two extensions, applying INFUSER to an instruction-finetuned anchor and augmenting it with rule-verifiable RLVR data, further demonstrate the flexibility and generalizability of the framework. Code is available at https://github.com/FFishy-git/INFUSER.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: INFUSER是一个迭代共训练框架，包含生成器和求解器两个角色。生成器从非结构化文档池中生成问题及答案，求解器通过训练改进。生成器的奖励由优化器感知的影响分数决定，该分数衡量问题对求解器在目标分布上的改进。使用DuGRPO（双重归一化GRPO）训练生成器。在Qwen3-8B-Base上，INFUSER在Olympiad和SuperGPQA基准上相对提升超过20%，且8B共进化生成器优于冻结的32B思考型生成器。
Motivation: 现有自进化方法依赖精心策划的数据或难度启发式，不一定提升求解器能力。本文提出基于影响的自进化，使生成器生成对求解器真正有用的问题。
Method: 提出INFUSER框架，两个角色迭代共训练：生成器从非结构化文档池中草拟问题及参考答案，求解器基于这些数据训练。求解器使用标准正确性奖励，生成器使用优化器感知的影响评分（衡量问题对求解器在目标分布上的改进）。由于影响评分连续且噪声，提出DuGRPO（双重归一化GRPO）用于生成器训练，将文档池转化为自适应课程。
Result: 在Qwen3-8B-Base上，INFUSER优于强自进化基线，在Olympiad和SuperGPQA上相对提升超过20%。8B共进化生成器在数学和编码上优于冻结的32B思考型生成器。消融实验证实每个设计选择必要。扩展到指令微调锚点和结合RLVR数据进一步展示灵活性和泛化性。
Conclusion: INFUSER将文档池转化为自适应课程，偏向对当前求解器有用的问题，而非仅难的问题。框架展示了泛化性和灵活性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RhinoVLA Technical Report
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation, but real-time deployment on edge hardware remains challenging. In this work, we identify VLM visual and context tokens as a major source of deployment latency: for GEMM-dominated projection operators, computation grows linearly with the number of input tokens when model dimensions are fixed. Motivated by this observation, we propose RhinoVLA, a deployment-oriented VLA model co-designed with the Huixi R1 edge SoC. RhinoVLA adopts a token-efficient Qwen3-VL backbone and a continuous Action Expert, reducing the VLM-side token and computation burden while preserving pretrained multimodal capability. To support cross-robot learning, RhinoVLA further introduces a unified interface that combines View Registry, 72D physical state-action slot space, and robotinstance LoRA, allowing heterogeneous robot observations and action schemas to be aligned under a shared policy. On the deployment side, RhinoVLA is optimized through hardware-aware compilation, mixed-precision execution, and parallel visual encoding. Experiments show that RhinoVLA achieves downstream performance comparable to π0.5 at a similar parameter scale, while reaching 11.69 Hz end-to-end inference on Huixi R1, meeting the 10 Hz real-time closedloop control target. The project will be open-sourced at https://github.com/HuixiAI/RhinoVLA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了RhinoVLA，一种面向边缘部署的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，与Huixi R1边缘SoC协同设计。RhinoVLA采用token高效的Qwen3-VL主干和连续动作专家，减少VLM侧的token和计算负担；引入统一接口支持异构机器人的跨机器人学习。通过硬件感知编译、混合精度执行和并行视觉编码优化部署，在Huixi R1上实现了11.69 Hz的端到端推理，满足10 Hz实时闭环控制目标。
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型在边缘硬件上实时部署存在延迟问题，主要瓶颈来自VLM的视觉和上下文token，导致GEMM主导的投影操作计算量随token数线性增长。
Method: 提出RhinoVLA：采用token高效的Qwen3-VL骨干和连续动作专家以减少VLM侧token和计算；引入统一接口（视图注册表、72维物理状态-动作槽空间、机器人实例LoRA）实现异构机器人观测和动作模式的统一策略学习；通过硬件感知编译、混合精度执行和并行视觉编码优化部署。
Result: RhinoVLA在相似参数规模下达到与π0.5相当的下游性能，在Huixi R1上实现11.69 Hz的端到端推理，满足10 Hz实时闭环控制目标。
Conclusion: 摘要强调VLA模型通过token优化和硬件协同设计可在边缘设备上实现实时闭环控制，并计划开源。

papers.title: LARA: Latent Action Representation Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Visual-language action (VLA) models enable robots to predict actions directly from observations and language instructions, but their performance depends on large-scale, high-quality data and is limited by the scarcity of real-world robot action datasets. To facilitate VLA model learning with abundant unlabeled human videos, Latent Action Models (LAM) learn latent action representations from visual dynamics to provide additional supervision for VLA learning. However, LAM and VLA are typically trained separately, leaving LAM ungrounded during VLA training and VLA models constrained by frozen LAM representations. To address these issues, we propose Latent Action Representation Alignment (LARA), a plug-and-play framework that jointly optimizes LAM and VLA via representation alignment. This enables reciprocal benefits where LAMs learn with action trajectories to avoid spurious visual changes, while VLAs are regularized by forward dynamics learned within LAMs to reduce hallucinations of functionally ineffective trajectories. We demonstrate LARA versatility and effectiveness for pre-training, post-training enhancement of pre-trained VLA models, and LAM refinement, achieving an average of ~10%, ~5%, and ~15% improvement over 3 simulation and 1 meticulously designed real-world robotic manipulation benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LARA框架，通过对齐潜在动作表示来联合优化潜在动作模型（LAM）和视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），解决LAM与VLA分离训练导致的问题。实验表明，在3个仿真和1个真实机器人操作基准上，预训练、后训练增强和LAM精炼分别提升约10%、5%和15%。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型依赖大规模高质量数据，但真实机器人动作数据集稀缺。LAM虽然能从人类视频学习潜在动作表示，但LAM和VLA分开训练，导致LAM在VLA训练中未接地，VLA受限于冻结的LAM表示。
Method: 提出LARA框架，是一种即插即用的对齐方法，通过表示对齐联合优化LAM和VLA。LAM利用动作轨迹避免虚假视觉变化，VLA通过LAM的前向动力学正则化减少无效轨迹的幻觉。
Result: 在3个仿真和1个真实机器人操作基准上，预训练、后训练增强和LAM精炼分别带来约10%、5%和15%的平均改进。
Conclusion: LARA框架展示了在VLA模型不同阶段（预训练、后训练增强、LAM精炼）的有效性和通用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Representing Research Attention as Contextually Structured Flows
papers.abstract_en: Research metrics increasingly use attention as evidence of societal impact. Yet attention serves as evidence only once interpreted, and its meaning depends on the contexts in which it occurs, not on volume alone. Altmetrics records signals in isolation, retaining a count of the attention an output received, or a sequence of when. We address this gap with attention flows, representations that situate a research output's attention in the social settings in which it occurs, the language expressing it, and the time over which it arrives. To evaluate the flow, we construct a benchmark of analogy queries, each testing whether the relationship between two outputs transfers to a third. The count and sequence baselines fail to recover these relationships, whereas flows learned with dynamic contextualised embeddings recover them. The recovered structure survives partial observation and is intrinsic to the attention itself. These findings support representing attention as contextually structured for research evaluation.
papers.comment: Accepted at STi 2026 - International Conference on Science and Technology Indicators
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将研究注意力表示为上下文结构流（attention flows），不仅关注计数和时序，还捕捉注意力发生的社会语境、表达语言和时间维度。通过类比查询基准测试，发现使用动态上下文嵌入学习的流能恢复关系结构，而计数和时序基线失败。
Motivation: 现有altmetrics只记录孤立信号（计数或时序），忽略了注意力发生的上下文，无法作为有意义的证据评估社会影响。
Method: 构建注意力流表示，利用动态上下文嵌入（dynamic contextualised embeddings）编码社会语境、语言和时间信息。设计类比查询基准来评估表示的质量。
Result: 动态上下文嵌入学习的注意力流能够恢复研究产出之间的关系结构，并且这种结构在部分观测下仍保持，而传统的计数和时序基线无法恢复。
Conclusion: 研究注意力应被表示为上下文结构化流，以更有效地用于研究评估。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Finding Needles in the Haystack: Transductive Active Labeling in Ecology
papers.abstract_en: Active learning is now standard practice in labeling ecological data, enabling ecologists to quickly process large volumes of field data to understand and monitor natural environments. Current practices evaluate active learning inductively, estimating predictive performance on a held-out test set. We argue that this evaluation is misaligned with most ecological tasks, where the goal is to transductively label an entire pool of data as efficiently as possible. We demonstrate that ignoring the human-in-the-loop underestimates the importance of continuing to label, particularly for classes in the long tail which may be of disproportionate ecological importance (rare species, uncommon behaviors, etc.). Our analysis shows that, for this long tail, the transductive objective shifts importance from prediction to discovery: the true challenge becomes finding "needles in the haystack," examples of rare classes that are embedded within dense regions of abundant classes in the latent geometry, which we quantify with a novel metric of sampling difficulty. Finally, to translate these insights to practical ecological workflows, we propose a conservative hybrid stopping criterion inspired by ecological rarefaction curves, and show that combining predictive performance with discovery criteria reduces premature stopping on long-tailed pools, improving rare-class recovery when discovery, not classification, is the limiting factor.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对生态学数据标注中主动学习（active learning）的评估方式提出质疑，认为当前归纳式评估（inductive evaluation）与大多数生态任务的目标（转导式标注全部池数据）不一致。作者证明忽略人类在环中会低估持续标注的重要性，尤其是在长尾类别（稀有物种、罕见行为）上，转导目标从预测转向发现，即从密集的常见类别中挖掘罕见类别。提出一种结合生态学稀化曲线（rarefaction curves）的保守混合停止准则，结合预测性能与发现标准，可减少在长尾池上的过早停止，提升稀有类别的恢复。
Motivation: 生态学数据标注中，现有主动学习采用归纳式评估（在保留测试集上预测性能），但这与大多数生态任务的目标（转导式地高效标注整个数据池）不一致，导致低估持续标注的重要性，特别是对生态意义重大的稀有类别。
Method: 提出一种保守混合停止准则，灵感来自生态学稀化曲线，结合预测性能与发现标准，以避免在长尾数据池上过早停止标注。
Result: 分析表明，转导目标使得长尾类别的重要性从预测转向发现，挑战在于从常见类别的稠密区域中找到稀有类别的“大海捞针”，并用新颖的采样难度度量量化这一点。混合停止准则改善了稀有类别的恢复。
Conclusion: 生态学标注任务应使用转导式评估，并结合发现标准来设定停止规则，以更好地恢复稀有类别。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When to Re-Plan: Subgoal Persistence in Hierarchical Latent Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon reasoning requires a system to commit to medium-horizon intent without becoming rigid: re-plan too often and computation never coheres into multi-step structure; commit too long and the plan goes stale. We study this stability-adaptivity tradeoff in the latent reasoning setting, where multi-step computation occurs inside hidden state rather than externalized token traces. We extend the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM) with a feudal-style manager-worker interface: a slow high-level module periodically emits a normalized directional subgoal that persists for P low-level steps, biasing the worker's hidden-state updates and supplying an intrinsic cosine alignment loss. On ARC and ConceptARC, we find that subgoal persistence -- not subgoal injection alone -- is the central knob: moderate periods P in [3, 6] consistently outperform both very frequent (P=1) and very long horizons, with a clear minimum LM loss at P=3 (1.544 vs. 1.674 at P=1, 1.640 baseline; replicated over 5 seeds at mean 1.595, std 0.045). The intrinsic alignment weight lambda shows a complementary narrow optimum (lambda approximately 0.05). A controlled ablation at past-sweet-spot lambda isolates learned directional structure -- not architectural capacity or auxiliary loss alone -- as the source of interference when the alignment signal exceeds its optimum. Together these findings implicate a design principle for compositional planning in latent reasoning systems: medium-horizon intent must be coherent across enough computational steps for compositional structure to form.

TL;DR: 本文研究层次潜在推理中的子目标持久性（subgoal persistence），即中等时间尺度的意图需要持续多少个计算步骤才能形成组合结构。在ARC和ConceptARC上实验表明，中等持久期P∈[3,6]优于频繁重规划（P=1）和过长持久期；内在对齐权重λ存在窄最优值（λ≈0.05）。消融实验表明最优λ之上的干扰来自学习的定向结构而非架构容量或辅助损失。结论指向设计原则：潜在推理系统中中等时间尺度的意图必须在足够多的计算步骤上保持连贯以形成组合结构。
Motivation: 长程推理需要在稳定性与适应性之间权衡：重规划过频繁则计算无法形成多步结构，承诺过长则计划过时。该问题在潜在推理设置下未被充分研究。

Result: 在ARC和ConceptARC上，子目标持久性（而非仅子目标注入）是关键；中等持久期P∈[3,6]一致优于非常频繁（P=1）和非常长的持久期，P=3时LM损失最低（1.544 vs. P=1的1.674，基线1.640），5种子重复均值为1.595，标准差0.045。内在对齐权重λ在约0.05处有窄最优。

papers.title: Quantitative Movement Testing: Measuring Chronic Pain Patient Movements from a Single Smartphone Video
papers.abstract_en: Chronic pain diminishes quality of life by decreasing functional ability, yet objectively measuring this functional impact remains challenging in real-world settings. While optical motion capture provides high precision for assessing altered movement quality, it is costly and restricted to laboratory environments. We aimed to develop and validate Quantitative Movement Testing (QMT), a computer vision pipeline extracting 3D kinematic biomarkers from standard monocular smartphone video, balancing clinical accessibility with biomechanical accuracy. We validated the QMT pipeline, utilising deep learning-based 3D pose-estimation, against gold-standard optical motion capture in healthy controls (N=13). Following leave-one-subject-out calibration to correct systematic bias, we deployed QMT in two prospective clinical cohorts to assess real-world utility: a pre- and post-intervention trial for fibromyalgia patients, and a 30-day longitudinal at-home monitoring study of chronic sciatica patients and healthy controls. In laboratory validation, QMT extracted clinical kinematic metrics with high agreement to optical motion capture, yielding strong correlations (r > 0.85) and low mean absolute errors. QMT demonstrated high test-retest reliability (r > 0.86) in fibromyalgia patients and successfully tracked day-to-day movement fluctuations in chronic sciatica. While real-world home settings introduced higher measurement variance than lab settings, QMT found group-level differences between healthy controls and sciatica patients based entirely on remote recordings. Monocular 3D pose estimation offers a scalable alternative to traditional assessments. QMT provides an objective, accessible biomarker for tracking disease progression and treatment response in clinical trials, though further research is needed to optimise reliability in home environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出并验证了定量运动测试（QMT），利用深度学习3D姿态估计从单目智能手机视频中提取临床运动学生物标志物。在实验室环境中，QMT与金标准光学运动捕捉高度一致（r>0.85），并在纤维肌痛患者和慢性坐骨神经痛患者的临床试验中展示了良好的重测信度和区分能力。尽管家庭环境引入更高测量方差，QMT仍能基于远程记录发现组间差异。
Motivation: 慢性疼痛患者的功能能力下降难以在真实世界环境中客观测量，而现有的光学运动捕捉虽精确但成本高且局限于实验室。
Method: QMT采用基于深度学习的3D姿态估计，从标准智能手机视频中提取运动学指标，并通过留一受试者校准纠正系统偏差。
Result: 实验室验证显示QMT与光学捕捉的相关系数r>0.85，平均绝对误差低；重测信度r>0.86；在慢性坐骨神经痛患者中成功跟踪日常运动波动，并基于远程记录区分患者与健康对照组。
Conclusion: QMT为临床试验提供了一种客观、可扩展的运动功能评估工具，但家庭环境下的可靠性仍需进一步优化。

papers.title: Low-Rank Adaptation of Frozen Vision-Language Models for Blind Image Quality Assessment
papers.abstract_en: Blind image quality assessment (BIQA) predicts perceived image quality without access to a pristine reference and is fundamental to applications such as image compression, transmission, and restoration. Recent BIQA methods increasingly rely on large vision-language models (VLMs). Although frozen VLMs provide an efficient alternative to computationally expensive full fine-tuning, it remains unclear how much performance is sacrificed by not adapting the backbone and, more importantly, under what conditions such adaptation is truly beneficial. Answering this question, however, is complicated by the widespread use of image-level splitting on synthetic-distortion benchmarks, where distorted versions of the same reference image can appear in both training and test partitions. This content overlap artificially inflates the apparent performance of frozen representations, masking their true generalization ability and potentially leading to incorrect conclusions about the value of backbone adaptation. We therefore address these two issues jointly. We develop an efficient BIQA framework that fuses a natural-scene-statistics descriptor with frozen SigLIP and CLIP-H embeddings through a lightweight regression head, and then apply parameter-efficient Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to the SigLIP backbone, training only $0.23\%$ of its parameters. Evaluating both frozen and adapted models across six datasets under image-level and reference-level protocols, we find that image-level splitting inflates frozen-feature SROCC by up to $0.44$ and masks wide variation in true difficulty, which reference-level evaluation reveals. Under this content-independent protocol, LoRA adaptation recovers performance in proportion to the exposed difficulty, with the largest gains where frozen features generalize poorly (up to $+0.357$ SROCC on TID2013) and little benefit where they are already strong.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究盲图像质量评估（BIQA）中冻结视觉语言模型与参数高效微调（LoRA）的性能差异，发现图像级分割会高估冻结特征性能，而参考级评估下LoRA在困难样本上有显著提升。
Motivation: 现有BIQA方法依赖大型VLM，但冻结模型与微调的性能差距不明，且评估协议中内容重叠导致虚假性能提升。
Method: 提出结合自然场景统计描述符与冻结SigLIP/CLIP-H嵌入的轻量回归头，并对SigLIP骨干应用LoRA（仅训练0.23%参数）。
Result: 在六个数据集上，图像级分割使冻结特征SROCC高估0.44；参考级评估下，LoRA在TID2013上提升0.357 SROCC。
Conclusion: 内容无关的参考级评估揭示了冻结模型的真实泛化能力，LoRA能按需恢复性能，但应在困难场景下使用。

papers.title: Reasoning4Sciences: Bridging Reasoning Language Models to All Scientific Branches
papers.abstract_en: While Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) are rapidly emerging as powerful tools for scientific research, their impact is primarily concentrated in "hard science" fields. The slow -- or lack of -- adoption of RLMs in other branches of science is causing a widening gap in research productivity. In this survey, we provide the first comprehensive analysis of RLM adoption across 28 scientific disciplines following the classification used by the European Research Council (ERC), spanning the Social Sciences and Humanities, Physical Sciences and Engineering, and Life Sciences. We examine how RLMs are developed, evaluated, and applied across disciplines. Furthermore, we introduce a maturity-oriented assessment framework based on available domain-specific development and evaluation resources, revealing substantial disparities in RLM maturity that become even more pronounced when only publicly available resources are considered. Finally, we highlight current implementation paradigms that are gaining popularity across disciplines, current challenges, and future directions in enabling RLM adoption across science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是第一篇全面分析推理语言模型（RLMs）在28个科学学科中采用情况的综述，涵盖社会科学与人文、物理科学与工程、生命科学三大领域。作者提出了基于领域特定开发和评估资源的成熟度评估框架，揭示了不同学科间RLM成熟度的显著差异，尤其是在仅考虑公开资源时差异更为明显。最后讨论了当前流行的实现范式、挑战和未来方向。
Motivation: RLMs在“硬科学”领域快速发展，但在其他科学分支的采用缓慢，导致研究生产力差距扩大。
Method: 按欧洲研究理事会（ERC）分类对28个科学学科进行综合分析，引入基于领域特定开发和评估资源的成熟度评估框架。
Result: 揭示RLM成熟度在不同学科间存在巨大差异，且仅考虑公开资源时差异更显著。
Conclusion: 强调需关注RLMs在科学中广泛采用的挑战和未来方向。

papers.title: Prospect-Theory Behavior from Bellman Optimality in MDPs with Catastrophic States
papers.abstract_en: We study risk-neutral control in Markov decision processes with an absorbing catastrophic state. Even though rewards are linear and the agent has no utility curvature, probability weighting, or framing dependence, standard Bellman optimality produces three prospect-theory-like signatures: an S-shaped value-function profile (convex near catastrophe, concave in the far field), an endogenous loss-sensitivity coefficient $λ^*(S) > 1$, and a reflection-effect policy reversal. Across 495 configurations, the optimal policy plays safe near catastrophe in positive-drift (growth) regimes despite the risky action's higher immediate expected value, and plays risky near catastrophe in negative-drift (decline) regimes despite the safe action's lower immediate expected loss. We derive a closed-form expression for the asymptotic loss-aversion plateau $\barλ$ that depends only on win probability $p$, payoff asymmetry $r = |Δ_\ell/Δ_w|$, and discount factor $β$, and matches numerical solutions to $R^2 = 0.999$. The mechanism does not require asymmetric payoffs. Across a sweep of $(p,β)$ at three asymmetry levels, the asymmetry share of $\barλ$ above unity has median 4.6% at $r = 1.25$ and rises to 13.9% at $r = 2$, with the boundary contribution exceeding the asymmetry contribution in every cell tested. The phenomena persist under tabular Q-learning (a model-free agent reproduces $V^*$ at correlation 0.98 in growth and 1.00 in decline) and under stochastic transitions with Gaussian, heavy-tailed Student-$t_3$, and asymmetric skew-normal noise up to 50% of the step size, where the asymptotic plateau tracks the closed-form prediction within 0.41% for safe-channel noise and within 9.6% for risky-channel or both-channel noise. These results identify absorbing failure states as a sufficient structural mechanism for prospect-theory-like behavior under optimal control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究带有吸收灾难性状态的马尔可夫决策过程中的风险中性控制，发现标准Bellman最优性会产生类似于前景理论的行为：S形值函数、内生损失敏感系数大于1以及反射效应策略反转。在495个配置中，最优策略在灾难附近表现出与前景理论一致的风险偏好变化。
Motivation: 探索在无显式效用曲率、概率加权或框架依赖的情况下，风险中性控制是否以及如何产生前景理论式的行为模式。
Method: 理论分析贝尔曼最优性在吸收灾难状态下的性质，给出渐近损失厌恶平台的闭式表达式，并通过数值模拟和Q学习验证。
Result: 推导出渐近损失厌恶平台依赖于获胜概率、支付不对称性和折扣因子，与数值解拟合R²=0.999；在随机转换下闭式预测误差在0.41%到9.6%之间。
Conclusion: 吸收失败状态是前景理论行为在最优控制中的充分结构机制，无需引入传统行为经济学假设。

papers.title: Meta-Programming for Linear-time Temporal Answer Set Programming
papers.abstract_en: The development of temporal extensions of Answer Set Programming (ASP) has led to the emergence of non-monotonic linear-time (TEL), dynamic (DEL), and metric (MEL) temporal equilibrium logics. However, the inherent rigidity of highly optimized ASP systems often hinders the rapid exploration and implementation of alternative logical designs. In this work, we propose a flexible meta-programming framework that operationalizes the semantics of varied temporal logics through a unified, declarative framework. Our approach extends standard ASP meta-programming by augmenting clingo's theory grammar with formal type specifications and nesting capabilities. To ensure semantic correctness, we introduce a transformation pipeline that protects nested modalities from stable-model-based simplifications during grounding. We demonstrate the extensibility of our framework by implementing meta-encodings for TEL, MEL, and DEL. We provide a comprehensive account of TEL and highlight the key features for managing the interval constraints of MEL and the Fischer-Ladner closure in DEL. Finally, we introduce the metasp system, a versatile tool that encapsulates this workflow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个灵活的元编程框架，用于实现多种线性时态回答集编程（ASP）的语义，包括TEL、MEL和DEL。通过扩展clingo的理论语法（theory grammar）引入形式类型规范和嵌套能力，并设计转换流水线保护嵌套模态在grounding过程中不被简化。文中详细描述了TEL的编码，并展示了如何处理MEL的区间约束和DEL的Fischer-Ladner闭包。最后介绍了实现该工作流的metasp系统。
Motivation: 高度优化的ASP系统往往难以快速探索和实现不同的时态逻辑设计方案，缺乏灵活的元编程支持。
Method: 扩展ASP元编程，在clingo的理论语法中加入形式类型规范和嵌套能力；设计转换流水线，在grounding阶段保护嵌套模态免受基于稳定模型的简化；为TEL、MEL和DEL实现元编码。
Result: 成功实现了对TEL、MEL和DEL三种时态逻辑的元编码，并开发了metasp系统。文中给出了TEL的全面描述，并突出了处理MEL区间约束和DEL Fischer-Ladner闭包的关键特性。

papers.title: BenGER: Benchmarking LLM Systems on Subsumption-Based Legal Reasoning in German Law
papers.abstract_en: We introduce BenGER (Benchmark for German Law), a benchmark and dataset for evaluating LLM systems on subsumption-based legal reasoning in German law. The dataset combines 596 exam-style free-text legal case tasks across multiple levels of legal education and 531 short doctrinal reasoning tasks. It includes a controlled validation subset of timed human-written solutions under both unaided and human-AI co-creation conditions. We evaluate 12 contemporary LLM systems - closed flagship, efficiency-oriented, and open-weight - with a rubric-aligned LLM-as-a-Judge cross-validated against a multi-rater human-grading layer (three blind reviews per solution, six judge families benchmarked against the human pool). Closed-flagship systems lead the leaderboard across all three corpora, human-AI co-creation measurably improves on unaided human work, and the LLM judge tracks human grading at Pearson r=0.76 and Cohen's \k{appa}=0.60. System rankings are stable across judge families and two judges from independent providers clear the Calderon single-reviewer replacement bar on human-authored solutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BenGER（德国法律基准），一个用于评估LLM系统在德国法中的涵摄法律推理能力的基准和数据集。数据集包含596个考试风格的自由文本法律案例任务和531个简短的教义推理任务，并包含受控验证子集。评估了12个当代LLM系统，使用与人工评分交叉验证的LLM-as-a-Judge方法，结果显示闭源旗舰模型领先，人-AI共创显著提升表现，LLM评分与人工评分相关性较高。
Motivation: 法律推理中涵摄（subsumption）是核心环节，但现有基准缺乏针对德国法律的专门评估，无法系统衡量LLM在此特定任务上的能力。
Method: 构建包含考试案例和教义推理任务的综合数据集，采用多轮人工评分和LLM-as-a-Judge自动评估，并与多个人工评分者进行交叉验证。
Result: 闭源旗舰模型在所有三个语料库上领先；人-AI共创相比无辅助人工工作有可测量提升；LLM评分与人工评分的皮尔森相关系数为0.76，Cohen's κ为0.60。
Conclusion: BenGER为德国法律涵摄推理提供了标准化评估基准，LLM-as-a-Judge方法在特定条件下可接近人工评分可靠性，但需注意领域特殊性。

papers.title: Sparse POD Mode Selection and Manifold Dimensionality Reduction with Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Linear dimensionality reduction methods such as proper orthogonal decomposition (POD) make high-dimensional data amenable to analysis by identifying the principal components, or modes, that capture the most variance, or energy, in the data and constructing a low-dimensional representation in the subspace they span. Such linear methods struggle, however, for data with slowly decaying Kolmogorov $n$-widths, such as advection-dominated and turbulent flows, which require many modes for accurate reconstruction; moreover, energy-based truncation can discard low-energy modes needed to capture small-scale features. Recent nonlinear manifold methods using polynomial mappings with alternating or greedy mode selection achieve better reconstruction with fewer modes, but fix the form of the nonlinear mapping a priori, limiting expressivity. In contrast, neural network (NN) manifolds offer greater expressivity yet employ energy-based selection. We present SparseModesNet, a dimensionality reduction framework that employs linear encoding and nonlinear NN decoding. The decoder leverages LassoNet, a method enforcing hierarchical sparsity through a residual connection with a linear skip layer, to simultaneously select informative modes and learn a nonlinear mapping that minimizes reconstruction error. On benchmark advection-dominated and chaotic flows, SparseModesNet matches or exceeds state-of-the-art performance. For turbulent channel flow at friction Reynolds number $Re_τ= 5200$, our method reduces reconstruction error by 51-78% compared to existing polynomial manifold methods while maintaining interpretability through physically meaningful mode selection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SparseModesNet，一种结合线性编码和非线性神经网络解码的降维框架，通过LassoNet实现层次稀疏性，同时选择有信息量的POD模态并学习非线性映射。在平流主导湍流、混沌流以及摩擦雷诺数5200的湍流通道流上，重建误差比现有多项式流形方法降低51-78%，并保持可解释性。
Motivation: 线性降维方法（如POD）在Kolmogorov n-宽度缓慢衰减的数据（如平流主导流和湍流）上需要大量模态，且基于能量的截断可能丢弃低能但关键的小尺度模态。现有非线性流形方法（如多项式映射）表达力受限，而神经网络流形虽更具表达力但采用能量选择，因此需要同时兼顾模态选择和表达力的方法。
Method: SparseModesNet使用线性编码进行模态选择，非线性神经网络解码进行重建。解码器基于LassoNet，通过带线性跳跃层的残差连接强制层次稀疏性，从而同时选择信息模态并学习最小化重建误差的非线性映射。
Result: 在平流主导和混沌流基准上达到或超越现有最优性能。在摩擦雷诺数5200的湍流通道流上，与现有多项式流形方法相比，重建误差降低51-78%。
Conclusion: 该方法在保持可解释性（通过物理有意义的模态选择）的同时，显著提升了复杂流动数据上的降维重建精度，但摘要未提及在降水或天气预报领域的直接应用或实验。

papers.title: Measuring Reasoning Quality in LLMs: A Multi-Dimensional Behavioral Framework
papers.abstract_en: LLMs have achieved remarkable success in complex reasoning tasks, yet current evaluation approaches predominantly rely on final-answer correctness, offering limited insight into the underlying reasoning processes that produce those answers. To address this gap, this study proposes a unified multi-dimensional framework for measuring reasoning quality in LLMs from a behavioral perspective, operationalizing six theoretically grounded dimensions: Correctness (CQ), Consistency (CS), Robustness (RS), Logical Coherence (LS), Efficiency (ES), and Stability (SS). Extensive experiments on seven LLMs across 975 items from four benchmarks demonstrate that the framework reveals behaviors invisible to accuracy-only metrics. Notably, logical coherence is orthogonal to correctness (r = -0.172, ns), confirming that correct answers can arise from incoherent reasoning, while Claude-Haiku-4.5 achieves the highest multi-dimensional score (Q_bal = 0.778). Furthermore, the framework exposes critical ranking inversions: DeepSeek-V3 ranks second under accuracy-priority but fifth under legal/compliance weighting, a reversal that single-metric evaluation cannot detect. Discriminant validity confirms 11/15 dimension pairs are independent (|r| < 0.50), providing psychometric support for treating each dimension as a distinct signal. The dimensional profiles produced by the framework directly support three classes of deployment decision: identifying models whose reasoning traces would fail accountability audits despite correct final answers (LS--CQ orthogonality); preventing ranking errors caused by accuracy-only benchmarking; and ensuring that no single metric silently substitutes for the six independent signals the framework captures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究提出一个多维度行为框架来评估LLM的推理质量，包含正确性、一致性、鲁棒性、逻辑连贯性、效率和稳定性六个维度。实验表明逻辑连贯性与正确性正交（r=-0.172, ns），且框架能揭示排名反转等单一正确率指标无法捕捉的现象。Claude-Haiku-4.5在多维评分中最高（Q_bal=0.778）。
Motivation: 当前LLM评估主要依赖最终答案正确性，缺乏对推理过程质量的深入理解，无法区分正确答案是否源自合理推理。
Method: 提出一个统一的多维度框架，从行为视角定义并操作化六个推理质量维度，对七个LLM在975个项目上进行实验，验证判别效度。
Result: 框架揭示逻辑连贯性与正确性正交（r=-0.172, ns），且DeepSeek-V3在准确率优先和第二但法律/合规加权下排名第五，出现排名反转。Claude-Haiku-4.5多维评分最高。
Conclusion: 该框架能识别出虽答案正确但推理过程不可靠的模型，防止单一指标导致的排名错误，可支持三类部署决策：问责审计、排名校准、多信号监控。

papers.title: Time-varying rPPG signal separation via block-sparse signal model
papers.abstract_en: Remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) enables non-contact measurement of cardiac pulse signals by analyzing subtle color changes in facial videos. Nevertheless, extracting rPPG signals remains challenging because of their extremely weak signal strength and susceptibility to illumination noise. In this paper, we propose an rPPG signal extraction method that exploits the quasi-periodic characteristics of rPPG signals. Our approach models quasi-periodicity of the rPPG signal, which arises from the stable cardiac cycle, as a block-sparse structure in the time-frequency domain. To incorporate a block-sparse model and enable adaptive signal separation under illumination fluctuations, we construct a time-varying signal separation framework. Experiments using a public dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用rPPG信号准周期特性的时间-频率域块稀疏建模方法，在光照波动下实现时变信号分离，并在公开数据集上验证有效性。
Motivation: 现有rPPG方法由于信号微弱且易受光照噪声干扰，提取困难；本文旨在利用rPPG信号的准周期特性提高提取鲁棒性。

papers.title: StreamEdit: Training-Free Video Editing via Few-Step Streaming Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Although existing video editing methods are generally feasible, they often require many costly iterations and still struggle to deliver high-quality yet satisfying editing results. We attribute this limitation to the prevalent data-to-data paradigm, which is less compatible with modern generative models than noise-to-data generation. To address this gap, we revisit video editing from a noise-to-data perspective and propose Streaming-Generation-based Video Editing (StreamEdit), which preserves few-step sampling while seamlessly injecting source-video conditions. Built on pre-trained streaming generation models, StreamEdit introduces dual-branch fast sampling with a self-attention bridge and cross-attention grounding/boosting to satisfy both sampling and conditioning requirements. We further propose source-oriented guidance to improve target-generation quality, and a visual prompting strategy to enhance editing flexibility and practicality. The method is effective, robust, and generalizable across different models. Extensive experiments on diverse video editing tasks show that StreamEdit consistently outperforms existing approaches, even in few-step settings with minimal time cost. Code and results are available at: https://dsl-lab.github.io/StreamEdit/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从噪声到数据（noise-to-data）视角重新审视视频编辑，提出基于流式生成（streaming generation）的免训练视频编辑方法StreamEdit。通过在预训练流式生成模型上引入双分支快速采样、自注意力桥接（self-attention bridge）、交叉注意力接地/增强（cross-attention grounding/boosting）以及源导向引导（source-oriented guidance）等机制，实现高质量视频编辑。实验表明，在极少步骤下该方法优于现有方法，且无需额外训练。
Motivation: 现有视频编辑方法普遍采用数据到数据（data-to-data）范式，与生成模型不兼容，导致迭代成本高且编辑质量受限。本文尝试从噪声到数据角度解决此问题。
Method: 基于预训练流式生成模型，StreamEdit提出双分支快速采样架构，包含自注意力桥接和交叉注意力接地/增强，同时满足采样和条件注入需求。此外，引入源导向引导以提升目标生成质量，以及视觉提示策略（visual prompting）增强编辑灵活性与实用性。
Result: 在多种视频编辑任务上，StreamEdit在极少步数（few-step）设置下持续优于现有方法，且时间成本显著降低。
Conclusion: StreamEdit是一种高效、鲁棒、可泛化的免训练视频编辑方法，有望为视频编辑领域提供新的噪声到数据范式。

papers.title: Automated Byzantine-Resilient Clustered Decentralized Federated Learning for Battery Intelligence in Connected EVs
papers.abstract_en: Federated learning (FL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for managing electric vehicle (EV) battery data in intelligent transportation systems (ITS), enabling privacy-preserving tasks such as anomaly detection and capacity estimation. However, most existing frameworks rely on centralized aggregation schemes, which pose critical limitations in terms of security and trust. To address these challenges, we propose ABC-DFL, an automated Byzantine-resilient clustered decentralized federated learning (C-DFL) framework for connected EVs. The proposed incentive-driven C-DFL system replaces the central server with an open-permissioned blockchain, featuring a new dynamic Quorum Byzantine Fault Tolerance (QBFT) protocol and an oracle-based aggregation layer, to enhance trust, security, and automation. At the core of ABC-DFL lies FLECA (Filtered Layered Enhanced Clustering Aggregation), a robust hierarchical aggregation protocol that mitigates Byzantine attacks by having each EV filter malicious updates using an adaptive threshold based on deviations from its reference model update. Oracle nodes, responsible for inter-group aggregation, employ robust clustering to isolate and aggregate model updates from trustworthy EV groups. Comprehensive experimental evaluations demonstrate that FLECA matches FedProx convergence under benign conditions and significantly outperforms existing defenses with attack impact scores below 0.10 in adaptive adversarial scenarios. Furthermore, several learning experiments with multitask models confirm the effectiveness and fairness of the incentive mechanism. Finally, on-chain and off-chain benchmarks validate the practicality of ABC-DFL.

papers.title: OlmoEarth v1.2: A more efficient family of OlmoEarth models
papers.abstract_en: We present a set of improvements to the OlmoEarth family. These improvements allow us to cut compute costs during training ($3.0 \times$ reduction in GPU hours required to train our Base models) and inference ($2.9\times$ reductions in MACs on Sentinel-2 tasks), while maintaining the models' overall performance. All training code is available at github.com/allenai/olmoearth_pretrain.
papers.summary_zh:

Motivation: 降低OlmoEarth模型的训练和推理计算成本，使模型更高效，同时不牺牲性能。

papers.title: Task-Aligned Self-Supervised Learning for Medical Image Analysis: A Task-Oriented Review with Practical Design Guidelines
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is increasingly used in medical image analysis to reduce dependence on costly expert annotations by learning transferable representations from unlabeled data. However, SSL performance depends not only on model architecture, but also on whether the pretext task preserves information required by the downstream clinical objective. This review presents a task-oriented synthesis of SSL methods for medical imaging, focusing on how pretext-task design interacts with imaging modality, label availability, and downstream performance. We analyze 75 studies published from 2017 to 2025 and organize them into four paradigms: contrastive learning, non-contrastive and predictive learning, generative and reconstruction-based learning, and hybrid learning. Rather than cataloging methods chronologically, we examine how these paradigms support classification, segmentation, detection, reconstruction, and regression. The evidence suggests that no SSL strategy is universally optimal. Contrastive objectives generally encourage global discriminative representations and are well aligned with classification, but may underrepresent subtle or localized pathology. Spatial prediction, masked modeling, and reconstruction-based objectives better preserve anatomical structure and are often more suitable for segmentation and dense prediction. Hybrid methods can provide balanced representations, although they increase training complexity. Across modalities, SSL is most beneficial in low-label and few-shot regimes, but its effectiveness depends on modality-aware augmentation, pathology-preserving corruption, and clinically meaningful evaluation. We conclude with practical design guidelines and identify open challenges, including pathology-aware pretext tasks, resource-efficient training for high-dimensional data, and standardized evaluation protocols.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对医学图像分析中的自监督学习（SSL）方法进行了任务导向的综述，分析了2017至2025年间75项研究，将其分为对比学习、非对比预测学习、生成重建学习和混合学习四类。摘要指出，没有一种SSL策略普遍最优：对比目标更适合分类，而空间预测和掩码建模更利于分割和密集预测。混合方法可提供平衡表示但增加训练复杂度。文章最后给出了实用设计指南并指出了开放挑战。
Motivation: 自监督学习在医学图像分析中日益重要，但其性能不仅取决于模型架构，还取决于预文本任务是否保留下游临床目标所需的信息。现有综述多为方法罗列，缺乏任务导向的分析。
Method: 对75项研究进行系统分类，按四种范式（对比学习、非对比预测学习、生成重建学习、混合学习）组织，并分析各范式在不同任务（分类、分割、检测、重建、回归）上的适用性。
Result: 对比目标鼓励全局判别表示，适合分类但可能忽略局部病理；空间预测和掩码建模保留解剖结构，适合分割和密集预测；混合方法提供平衡表示但训练复杂。SSL在低标签和少样本场景下最有效，但依赖于模态感知的数据增强、病理保持的损坏和临床有意义的评估。
Conclusion: 没有单一SSL策略普遍最优，选择需匹配任务与模态。未来挑战包括病理感知预文本任务、高维数据的高效训练和标准化评估协议。

papers.title: Calibeating for general proper losses: A Bregman divergence approach
papers.abstract_en: This work introduces a general framework for calibeating based on regret minimization. As compared to Foster and Hart's seminal calibeating work which had specialized treatments of Brier score (squared loss) and log loss, we consider a large family of proper losses that includes $α$-Tsallis losses (for $α\in [1, 2]$) and Lipschitz losses. Our results for Tsallis losses also hold for an unscaled version of Tsallis loss that recovers log loss. Our analysis is oriented around the Bregman divergence view of a proper loss. Technically, our results for the family of Tsallis losses that we consider are U-calibration results, simultaneously obtaining logarithmic regret for all losses in this family while having a weaker dependence on the dimension compared to previous results. Of potential independent interest, we also show a new regret equality for the regret of Be The Regularized Leader. This regret equality holds for general proper losses and itself is based on two results related to online updating formulas for the generalized variance, the latter being a previously introduced generalization of variance based on Bregman divergences.
papers.comment: 33 pages; added discussion of concurrent works of Chen et al. (2026) and Foster and Hart (2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于遗憾最小化 (regret minimization) 提出了一种通用的calibeating框架，将Foster和Hart的calibeating工作从Brier score和log loss推广到包含α-Tsallis损失 (α∈[1,2]) 和Lipschitz损失的一大类proper损失。分析围绕Bregman散度视角，对Tsallis损失族得到U-calibration结果，同时实现了对数遗憾并在维度依赖性上优于先前结果。此外，还展示了Be The Regularized Leader的遗憾等式，基于广义方差 (generalized variance) 的在线更新公式。
Motivation: Foster和Hart的calibeating工作仅针对Brier score和log loss，缺乏对一般proper损失族的统一处理。本文旨在填补这一空白，提供基于Bregman散度的统一框架。
Method: 采用Bregman散度视角分析proper损失，利用对Be The Regularized Leader的新遗憾等式，该等式基于广义方差的在线更新公式，从而推导出针对Tsallis损失族和Lipschitz损失族的U-calibration结果。
Result: 对α-Tsallis损失 (α∈[1,2]) 和Lipschitz损失族获得U-calibration结果，同时实现对数遗憾，且维度依赖性弱于先前工作。
Conclusion: 本文提出的通用calibeating框架为更广泛的proper损失提供了理论保证，Bregman散度视角下的分析有助于进一步理解校准与遗憾最小化的关系。

papers.title: Separating Shortcut Transition from Cross-Family OOD Failure in a Minimal Model
papers.abstract_en: Shortcut features are often invoked to explain out-of-distribution (OOD) failure, but training correlation, learned shortcut use, and test-time failure need not coincide. We study a minimal binary model with one invariant coordinate and one family-dependent shortcut coordinate. In the deterministic regime, positive average shortcut correlation pulls logistic ERM toward positive shortcut weight, but ridge regularization keeps the classifier invariant-dominated and prevents deterministic OOD failure. When the invariant coordinate is noisy, ridge-logistic ERM switches to the shortcut rule once the training shortcut signal exceeds the invariant signal. Whether that transition causes failure depends on the held-out family: weaker shortcut correlation yields positive excess risk, and sign-flipped families yield above-chance error. Synthetic checks match these analytic regimes and show that the same training-side transition can have different held-out consequences. The model separates shortcut attraction, shortcut-rule transition, and cross-family OOD failure.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过一个最小二分类模型研究捷径特征（shortcut features）与跨领域（cross-family）分布外（OOD）失败之间的关系。模型包含一个不变坐标和一个依赖于领域的捷径坐标。在确定性条件下，正平均捷径相关促使逻辑回归向正捷径权重偏移，但岭回归可保持不变特征主导，避免OOD失败。当不变坐标含噪声时，岭回归逻辑回归会在训练捷径信号超过不变信号时切换到捷径规则，但该切换是否导致失败取决于保留领域：弱捷径相关导致正超额风险，符号翻转领域导致高于随机水平的错误。合成实验验证了这些分析区域，并表明相同的训练侧切换可能产生不同的保留领域后果。
Motivation: 捷径特征常被用来解释OOD失败，但训练相关性、习得的捷径使用和测试时失败并不必然一致。现有研究未清晰区分这些环节，本文旨在通过一个最小模型分离捷径吸引、捷径规则切换和跨领域OOD失败三个概念。
Method: 构建一个二分类最小模型，包含一个不变坐标和一个依赖于领域的捷径坐标。在确定性阶段分析正平均捷径相关下的逻辑回归行为；在噪声阶段加入岭正则化，分析训练捷径信号与不变信号强度对比如何导致捷径规则切换。通过合成数据验证理论分析。
Result: 在确定性条件下，岭正则化可保持分类器不变特征主导，防止OOD失败。在噪声条件下，一旦训练捷径信号超过不变信号，模型切换为捷径规则，但该切换对OOD失败的影响依赖于保留领域：弱捷径相关导致正超额风险，符号翻转领域导致高于随机水平的错误。
Conclusion: 该模型成功分离了捷径吸引、捷径规则切换和跨领域OOD失败三个不同过程，并表明训练侧的捷径切换并不必然导致测试侧的OOD失败，具体取决于领域相关性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Stable and Near-Reversible Diffusion ODE Solvers for Image Editing
papers.abstract_en: The inversion of diffusion models plays a central role in image editing. Algebraically reversible ODE solvers provide an appealing approach to diffusion inversion for text-guided image editing, by eliminating the inversion error inherent in DDIM-based editing pipelines. However, empirical results indicate that reversibility alone is insufficient. As edits require larger semantic or visual changes, reversible diffusion solvers often exhibit instabilities and suffer sharp drops in output quality. In this paper, we show that the trade-off between exact reversibility and numerical stability manifests empirically as a trade-off between background preservation and prompt alignment in image editing. We then investigate the use of near-reversible Runge-Kutta methods as a more stable alternative to exactly reversible diffusion schemes. When combined with a vector-field smoothing strategy, the resulting approach improves edit fidelity, remains stable under large edits, and largely retains the background-preservation benefits of reversible solvers.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究扩散模型求逆在图像编辑中的应用，发现代数可逆ODE求解器虽然消除DDIM的逆误差，但在大编辑时不稳定，导致背景保持与提示对齐之间权衡。作者提出使用近可逆Runge-Kutta方法结合向量场平滑策略，实现稳定且高效的编辑，同时保留可逆求解器的背景保持优势。
Motivation: 现有可逆扩散ODE求解器在大语义或视觉编辑时出现不稳定性和质量下降，需要一种既保持可逆性又增强数值稳定性的方法。
Method: 采用近可逆Runge-Kutta方法替代严格可逆扩散方案，并引入向量场平滑策略以提高稳定性。
Result: 该方法在保持背景的同时提升编辑保真度，在大编辑幅度下仍能稳定工作，且保留可逆求解器的背景保持优势。
Conclusion: 摘要强调可逆性与数值稳定性之间的权衡可以通过近可逆求解器和平滑策略来缓解，但未讨论局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Targeted Tests for LLM Reasoning: An Audit-Constrained Protocol
papers.abstract_en: Fixed reasoning benchmarks evaluate canonical prompts, but semantically valid changes in presentation can still change model behavior. Studies of prompt variation can reveal such failures, but without audit they can mix genuine model errors with invalid perturbations, extraction artifacts, and unmatched search procedures. We propose an audit-constrained protocol for targeted reasoning evaluation. Prompt variants are generated from a finite component grammar, rendered deterministically, evaluated under a fixed query budget, and counted as model errors only after semantic and extraction audit. Within this protocol we instantiate Component-Adaptive Prompt Sampling (CAPS), a score-based sampler over prompt components, and compare it with equal-budget uniform component sampling under the same task bank, renderer, model interface, decoding settings, and audit procedure. Across three audited slices, the protocol identifies confirmed model-error prompt keys while excluding formatting and extraction artifacts, but matched comparisons do not show that CAPS improves audited yield or unique prompt-key discovery over uniform sampling. The contribution is methodological: targeted prompt variation can be studied under a reconstructable, reviewable, budget-matched protocol, and proxy-guided policies should be judged by audited yield rather than raw mismatch counts or selected examples alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个审计约束的协议（audit-constrained protocol）用于针对性的LLM推理测试，通过组件语法生成提示变体，经语义和提取审计后才认定为模型错误。在该协议下实例化了组件自适应提示采样（CAPS），并与均匀采样在相同任务库、渲染器、模型接口、解码设置和审计流程下进行比较。实验表明协议能够识别确认的模型错误提示键，但未见CAPS在审计产出或独特提示键发现上优于均匀采样。贡献是方法论性的：在可重构、可审查、预算匹配的协议下研究目标提示变体。
Motivation: 固定推理基准测试规范提示，但语义上有效的呈现变化仍可改变模型行为。提示变异研究可揭示此类失败，但缺乏审计会混淆真实模型错误与无效扰动、提取伪影及不匹配的搜索过程。
Method: 提出一个审计约束的测试协议：从有限组件语法生成提示变体，确定性渲染，在固定查询预算下评估，并仅通过语义和提取审计后才计为模型错误。在该协议下实例化了CAPS（基于分数的提示组件采样器），并与等预算均匀组件采样进行比较。
Result: 在三个审计切片上，协议能够识别经确认的模型错误提示键，同时排除格式和提取伪影。但匹配比较未显示CAPS在审计产出或独特提示键发现上优于均匀采样。
Conclusion: 该研究的方法论贡献在于：可在可重构、可审查、预算匹配的协议下研究目标提示变体，且代理引导策略应基于审计产出而非原始不匹配计数或精选示例来评判。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Controlled Counterexample to Strong Proxy-Based Explanations of OOD Performance: in a Fixed Pretraining-and-Probing Setup
papers.abstract_en: Task-agnostic structure proxies are often used to interpret why one pretraining corpus transfers better than another, but such explanations require the proxy to track the structure that matters for the downstream task. We test this requirement in a fixed pretraining-and-probing setup motivated by computationally bounded notions of learned structure, including epiplexity. The core question is whether a proxy ranking of two pretraining datasets must agree with their ranking by OOD probe accuracy. We show that it need not. First, we give a controlled construction in which a formal structure quantity, its operational proxy, and the task-relevant structure for a target family separate. We then instantiate the same mechanism in a synthetic sequence-model experiment: under the primary all-sample evaluation, the OOD accuracy ranking reverses the proxy ranking in two of three seeds, with auxiliary diagnostics and ablations supporting the same interpretation. The counterexample does not reject structure-based explanations in general; it identifies a boundary on strong proxy-based explanations. A proxy for total learned structure can fail to track the task-relevant structure that drives OOD performance, even in a controlled setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在固定预训练-探测设置下，通过构造一个可控反例表明：任务无关的结构代理（proxy）对预训练语料库的排序可能与基于OOD探测准确率的排序相反。作者通过形式化构造和合成序列模型实验验证了该现象，指出代理对总学习结构的度量可能无法跟踪驱动OOD性能的任务相关结构。
Motivation: 现有研究常使用任务无关的结构代理来解释预训练语料迁移性能，但需要代理能跟踪下游任务相关的结构。本文检验了这一要求在固定预训练-探测设置下是否总是成立。
Method: 通过一个可控构造，使形式结构量、其操作代理和目标族的任务相关结构分离；然后在合成序列模型实验中实例化相同机制，使用主要全样本评估、辅助诊断和消融实验进行分析。
Result: 在主要全样本评估下，三个种子中的两个种子的OOD准确率排名与代理排名相反；辅助诊断和消融支持相同解释。
Conclusion: 该反例并不否定基于结构的解释，而是标识了强代理解释的边界：总学习结构的代理可能无法跟踪驱动OOD性能的任务相关结构。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: An Executable Benchmarking Suite for Tool-Using Agents
papers.abstract_en: Closed-loop tool-using agents are increasingly evaluated in executable web, code, and micro-task environments, but benchmark reports often conflate workloads, action-generating drivers, and the evidence admitted for systems-facing claims. We present an executable benchmarking suite that makes these objects explicit under a shared evidence-admission contract. The suite connects WebArena Verified, a SWE-Gym slice with SWE-bench-compatible verification, and MiniWoB++ through common workload adapters, task manifests, event schemas, replay/freeze policy, declared drivers, and reporting pipelines. In the canonical release, the gate separates paper-facing evidence from preflight, fixture, smoke, and diagnostic rows while preserving non-admitted artifacts for audit and onboarding. The admitted evidence records latency, invalid-action behavior, patch-generation cost, verifier metadata, replay bindings, and provenance under one auditable contract. The gate is decision-relevant rather than merely clerical: in a separate WebArena Verified controller study, clean-baseline and medium live-stressed evaluation select different fixed controller variants under the same workload and admission contract. The release is scoped as a benchmarking suite and admitted evidence, not a new agent policy, model leaderboard, backend comparison, or autonomous SWE-bench solver.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the authors. The authors identified substantive errors that affect the interpretation of the results and the support for the main conclusions. The current version should not be relied upon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一个可执行的基准测试套件，用于评估闭环工具使用代理，该套件通过共享的证据接纳契约分离工作负载、动作生成驱动程序和系统级声明所依据的证据。套件整合了 WebArena Verified、SWE-Gym 切片和 MiniWoB++ 等环境，并包含延迟、无效动作、补丁生成成本等指标。但该论文已被作者撤回，称存在实质性错误影响结果解释和主要结论。
Motivation: 现有闭环工具使用代理的基准测试常混淆工作负载、动作生成驱动程序和系统级声明的证据，需要一个明确的证据接纳契约来分离这些对象。
Method: 提出一个可执行的基准测试套件，通过共同的工作负载适配器、任务清单、事件模式、重放/冻结策略、声明驱动程序和报告流水线连接多个环境，并设置证据接纳门（gate）分离论文证据与预检、装置、冒烟和诊断行。
Result: 在一个 WebArena Verified 控制器研究中，干净基线和中等实时负载评估在相同工作负载和契约下选择了不同的固定控制器变体，表明门是决策相关的。
Conclusion: 该发布范围限定为基准测试套件和已接纳证据，而非新的代理策略、模型排行榜或后端比较。论文已被作者撤回。

papers.title: KV-RM: Regularizing KV-Cache Movement for Static-Graph LLM Serving
papers.abstract_en: Static-graph LLM decoders provide predictable launches, fixed tensor shapes, and low submission overhead, but online decoding exposes highly irregular KV-cache behavior: request lengths differ, EOS events arrive asynchronously, and logical histories fragment over time. Dynamic runtimes recover flexibility through paged KV management and step-level scheduling, while static-graph executors often over-reserve memory and suffer burst-time latency outliers. This paper studies whether much of this variability can be absorbed below a fixed decode interface. We present KV-RM, a runtime design that regularizes KV-cache movement beneath a static-graph LLM decoder. KV-RM decouples logical KV histories from physical storage, tracks active KV state through a block pager, and materializes each decode step through a single committed descriptor. A merge-staged transport path coalesces non-contiguous KV mappings into a small number of large transfer groups before a fixed-shape attention kernel consumes them. Optional bounded far-history summaries can be enabled under the same interface, but the core design does not depend on them. On a 2-GPU NVIDIA A100 node, KV-RM improves mixed-length decoding throughput and tail latency relative to a static-graph baseline, reduces reserved KV memory across workload families, and removes severe burst-time latency spikes under production-trace replay. These results suggest that KV-cache movement, rather than kernel shape, can be an effective boundary for recovering runtime flexibility in static-graph LLM serving.
papers.comment: Withdrawn by the authors. The authors identified substantive errors that affect the interpretation of the results and the support for the main conclusions. The current version should not be relied upon
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究静态图LLM解码器中KV缓存的移动规则化问题，提出KV-RM运行时设计。KV-RM将逻辑KV历史与物理存储解耦，通过块分页器和合并传输路径在固定形状注意力核下吸收可变性。在2-GPU A100节点上，它提升了混合长度解码吞吐和尾延迟，减少了KV内存预留，并消除了生产负载下的突发延迟尖峰。
Motivation: 静态图LLM解码器在在线解码中因请求长度变化、EOS异步到达和历史碎片化，导致KV缓存行为高度不规则，造成内存过度预留和突发延迟尖峰。
Method: KV-RM解耦逻辑KV历史与物理存储，使用块分页器跟踪活跃KV状态，并通过一个提交描述符实现解码步骤的物质化；采用合并阶段传输路径将非连续KV映射合并为少数大传输组，供固定形状注意力核消费。
Result: 在2-GPU NVIDIA A100节点上，KV-RM相比静态图基线改善了混合长度解码的吞吐和尾延迟，减少了各工作负载族的预留KV内存，并在生产跟踪回放下消除了严重的突发延迟尖峰。
Conclusion: 结果表明KV缓存移动而非核形状可以成为恢复静态图LLM服务运行时灵活性的有效边界。

papers.title: On Variance Reduction in Learning Mean Flows
papers.abstract_en: One-step generative modeling has emerged as a leading approach for amortizing the inference cost of diffusion and flow-matching models. Among distillation-free methods, MeanFlow training is notoriously unstable, with non-decreasing loss and unbounded gradient variance. In this work, we establish a theory that attributes this pathology to a misuse of the conditional velocity field. We show that the conditional velocity plays two distinct statistical roles in the loss: both as an unbiased regression target and as a Monte Carlo control variate in a Jacobi-vector product, with the original MeanFlow loss assigning the wrong coefficient to the latter. We derive the optimal coefficient in closed form and show that a family of fixes in concurrent works corresponds to different practical realizations of the same optimum. A controlled sweep of this coefficient on two-dimensional benchmarks and on a latent Diffusion Transformer recovers the predicted bias-variance ordering. Our DiT experiment also reveals a quantitative FID-MSE landscape mismatch. Specifically, although the gradient-MSE is minimized at an interior coefficient value near $β\!=\!0.94$, the coefficient that minimizes FID prefers to use conditional velocity directly at the unbiased corner. Our analysis therefore explains why MeanFlow is unstable and unifies its concurrent remedies, and shows that the variance-optimal coefficient need not coincide with the quality-optimal one.
papers.comment: 27 pages, 8 figures, 8 tables. Added supplementary experiment: independent validation of the small-bias regime, to break the circularity in bias estimation
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析MeanFlow训练不稳定的根源，指出条件速度场在损失中扮演双重角色（无偏回归目标和Monte Carlo控制变量）时系数错误，推导出最优系数的闭式解，并通过实验验证了偏差-方差排序，同时发现方差最优系数（β≈0.94）与生成质量最优系数（β=1）不一致。
Motivation: MeanFlow训练损失不降、梯度方差发散，现有方法缺乏理论解释，需要揭示其不稳定的根本原因。
Method: 通过将条件速度视为无偏回归目标和Monte Carlo控制变量，理论推导出损失中控制变量的最优系数，并证明一系列并发修复对应同一最优解的不同实际实现。
Result: 在二维基准和潜在Diffusion Transformer上验证了理论预测的偏差-方差排序，发现梯度MSE在β≈0.94处最小，而FID最优系数在β=1（无偏角点）。
Conclusion: 方差最优系数不等同于生成质量最优系数，这一发现解释了MeanFlow的不稳定性并统一了现有补救方法。

papers.title: A Complete Characterization of Learnability for Adversarial Noisy Bandits
papers.abstract_en: We study adversarial noisy bandits given a known function class $\mathcal{F}$. In each round, the adversary selects a function $f \in \mathcal{F}$, the learner chooses an arm, and then observes a noisy reward determined by the chosen arm and the function $f$. The goal is to minimize the cumulative regret $R(T)$, defined as the difference between the learner's performance and that of the best fixed arm in hindsight over $T$ rounds. We say that a function class $\mathcal{F}$ is learnable if there exists an algorithm achieving sublinear regret. Our main result is a complete characterization of learnability for adversarial noisy bandits. The characterization is given in terms of a convexified variant of the generalized maximin volume introduced by Hanneke and Wang (2025): namely, the generalized maximin volume evaluated on the convex hull $\operatorname{co}(\mathcal F)$. We prove that $\mathcal F$ is learnable if and only if this convexified generalized maximin volume is positive at every scale. This condition characterizes learnability against both oblivious and adaptive adversaries, showing in particular that these two notions of learnability are equivalent in the noisy bandit setting. Our analysis reveals that the key complexity measure is closely connected to two new combinatorial notions, hitting set and distribution covering number, which may be of independent interest. These results establish the first complete characterization of learnability for adversarial noisy bandits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了对抗噪声赌博机（adversarial noisy bandits）的可学习性，给出了基于凸化广义最大最小体积（convexified generalized maximin volume）的完整刻画。该刻画适用于所有已知函数类，并证明针对 oblivious 和 adaptive 两种对手的可学习性等价。论文还引入了命中集（hitting set）和分布覆盖数（distribution covering number）两个新组合概念。
Motivation: 对抗噪声赌博机中，哪些函数类是可学习的（即存在次线性遗憾算法）此前缺乏完整刻画，该问题对在线学习理论具有重要意义。
Method: 将广义最大最小体积（Hanneke & Wang, 2025）扩展到函数类的凸包上，提出凸化广义最大最小体积作为复杂度度量，并证明可学习性等价于该体积在每个尺度上为正。分析中引入命中集和分布覆盖数两个组合概念辅助刻画。
Result: 证明了函数类 F 可学习当且仅当其凸包上的广义最大最小体积在所有尺度上为正；这一条件同时刻画了 oblivious 和 adaptive 对手下的可学习性，且二者等价。
Conclusion: 这是对抗噪声赌博机可学习性的首个完整刻画，新定义的组合概念可能在其他学习问题中也有独立价值。
