papers.title: Sparse Layers are Critical to Scaling Looped Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Looped language models repeat a set of transformer layers through depth, reducing memory costs and providing natural early-exit points at loop boundaries. However, looped models do not scale as favorably as standard transformers with unique layers. We compare standard and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) transformers, with and without looping, and find two main results. First, we find Looped-MoE models scale better than the standard baseline while dense looped models do not. We trace this to routing divergence between loops: in Looped-MoE models, different experts are activated on each pass through the same shared layers, recovering expressivity without additional parameters. Our second finding is that looped models have better compute-quality trade-offs with early exits than standard models. Because each loop ends with the same layers that produce the final output, loop boundaries are superior exit points, as confirmed by earlier output convergence at these points. In sum, we provide a clear direction for scaling looped models: a Looped-MoE model with early exits can not only beat standard transformers at scale, but also enable significant memory and inference savings with minimal degradation in quality.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究循环语言模型（Looped Language Models）中稀疏层（MoE）对可扩展性的关键作用。与标准Transformer相比，Looped-MoE模型在参数共享下仍能通过路由发散激活不同专家，从而恢复表达力，使得扩展性优于标准基线；而密集循环模型则表现不佳。此外，循环模型的循环边界天然适合早停（early exit），在计算-质量权衡上优于标准模型。结果表明Looped-MoE结合早停可在大规模下超越标准Transformer，同时显著节省内存和推理成本。
Motivation: 循环语言模型通过重复共享层减少内存，但扩展性不如标准Transformer；需要找出提升其扩展性的关键因素。
Method: 对比标准Transformer、密集循环模型、MoE模型以及Looped-MoE模型，分析其扩展曲线和早停特性，并归因于Looped-MoE中不同循环间路由发散（routing divergence）带来的表达力恢复。
Result: Looped-MoE模型在扩展性上优于标准Transformer基线，而密集循环模型则不行；循环模型在早停时具有更好的计算-质量折衷。
Conclusion: 稀疏层（MoE）是使循环语言模型高效扩展的关键；Looped-MoE结合早停可在保持质量的同时实现存储和推理加速。

papers.title: Hybrid Iterative Neural Low-Regularity Integrator for Nonlinear Dispersive Equations
papers.abstract_en: We propose HIN-LRI, a hybrid framework that augments a classical numerical solver with a neural operator trained to correct the solver's structured truncation error. A base low-regularity integrator provides a consistent first-order approximation to nonlinear dispersive PDEs, while a lightweight neural network, operating on a low-dimensional latent manifold, learns the residual defect that analytical methods cannot close. An explicit time-step scaling on the neural correction ensures that its Lipschitz contribution remains $\mathcal{O}(τ)$, yielding a Gronwall stability factor bounded uniformly in the step size and independent of the spatial resolution. The network is trained end-to-end through a solver-in-the-loop objective that unrolls the full iteration and penalises trajectory error in a Bourgain-type norm, aligning learning with multi-step solver dynamics rather than isolated one-step targets. Under stated assumptions, the global error satisfies $C(\varepsilon_{net}+δ)\,τ^γ\ln(1/τ)$, where $\varepsilon_{net}$ measures the network approximation quality and $δ$ the training shortfall. Experiments on three dispersive benchmarks with rough data show that HIN-LRI improves accuracy over analytical integrators, splitting methods, and neural PDE surrogates, with stable spatial refinement, effective out-of-distribution transfer, and modest online overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HIN-LRI混合框架，将经典低正则性积分器与轻量级神经网络结合，用于求解非线性色散方程。神经网络在低维潜在流形上学习积分器的截断误差，并通过显式时间步缩放保证稳定性。理论给出全局误差界，实验在粗糙数据上比传统方法和神经PDE替代方案精度更高。
Motivation: 经典数值格式在低正则性场景下误差控制困难，纯神经方法缺乏理论保证；需要融合两者的优势，既保持数值稳定性又利用神经网络的逼近能力。
Method: 采用低正则性积分器作为基础一阶近似，用一个在低维流形上运行的轻量级神经网络学习残差；对神经校正施加时间步缩放使Lipschitz贡献为O(τ)，并通过求解器在环路中训练，用Bourgain型范数惩罚多步轨迹误差。
Result: 在三个粗糙数据的色散基准上，HIN-LRI相比分析积分器、分裂方法和神经PDE替代方法提高了精度，且具有稳定的空间细化、有效的分布外迁移和适度的在线开销。
Conclusion: 全局误差满足C(ε_net+δ)τ^γ ln(1/τ)，其中ε_net和δ分别衡量网络逼近质量和训练不足；该方法适用于低正则性非线性色散方程，但未直接验证于天气/降水预测问题。

papers.title: When Embedding-Based Defenses Fail: Rethinking Safety in LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM)-powered multi-agent systems (MAS) enable agents to communicate and share information, achieving strong performance on complex tasks. However, this communication also creates an attack surface where malicious agents can propagate misinformation and manipulate group decisions, undermining MAS safety. Existing embedding-based defenses aim to detect and prune suspicious agents, but their effectiveness depends on a clear separation between the text embeddings of malicious and benign messages. Attackers can circumvent such defenses by crafting messages whose embeddings lie close to benign ones. We analyze this failure mode theoretically and validate it empirically with three attacks, Slow Drift, Benign Wrapper, and Chaos Seeding. Our analysis further reveals a fundamental limitation of embedding-based defenses: because they rely solely on the text embeddings, they ignore token-level confidence signals such as logits, which can remain informative when embeddings are not distinguishable under attack. We propose using confidence scores to prune or down-weight messages during MAS communication. Experiments show improved robustness across models, datasets, and communication topologies. Moreover, we find that the effectiveness of confidence signals decays over communication rounds, highlighting the importance of early intervention. This insights can inform and inspire future work on MAS attacks and defenses.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文分析基于嵌入的防御在LLM多智能体系统（MAS）中的失败原因，攻击者可以通过生成与良性消息嵌入相近的恶意消息来绕过检测。作者提出利用置信度分数（logits）作为信号来修剪或降低恶意消息权重，实验表明该方法在多种模型和通信拓扑下提升了鲁棒性，但置信度信号效果随通信轮次衰减。
Motivation: 现有基于嵌入的防御在恶意消息嵌入与良性消息嵌入不可区分时失效，需要更鲁棒的防御机制来保护MAS免受信息操纵。
Method: 从理论上分析嵌入防御的局限性，提出在MAS通信中使用置信度分数（logits）修剪或降低消息权重，不依赖文本嵌入。
Result: 实验表明该方法在多个模型、数据集和通信拓扑下提升了鲁棒性，但置信度信号的有效性随通信轮次衰减，早期干预更为关键。
Conclusion: 该研究揭示了嵌入防御的局限性和置信度信号的潜力，强调早期干预的重要性，为未来MAS攻击与防御研究提供启示。

papers.title: Stable-GFlowNet: Toward Diverse and Robust LLM Red-Teaming via Contrastive Trajectory Balance
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Model (LLM) Red-Teaming, which proactively identifies vulnerabilities of LLMs, is an essential process for ensuring safety. Finding effective and diverse attacks in red-teaming is important, but achieving both is challenging. Generative Flow Networks (GFNs) that perform distribution matching are promising methods, but they are notorious for training instability and mode collapse. In particular, unstable rewards in red-teaming accelerate mode collapse. We propose Stable-GFN (S-GFN), which eliminates partition function $Z$ estimation in GFN and reduces training instability. S-GFN avoids $Z$ estimation through pairwise comparisons and employs a robust masking methodology against noisy rewards. Additionally, we propose a fluency stabilizer to prevent the model from getting stuck in local optima that produce gibberish. S-GFN provides more stable training while maintaining the optimal policy of GFN. We demonstrate the overwhelming attack performance and diversity of S-GFN across various settings. Our code can be found in https://github.com/kmc0207/Stable-GFN.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stable-GFlowNet (S-GFN)，一种用于 LLM 红队攻击的生成流网络变体。S-GFN 通过对比轨迹平衡 (contrastive trajectory balance) 消除配分函数估计，结合鲁棒掩码和流畅性稳定器，显著提升训练稳定性并避免模式崩溃。实验表明，S-GFN 在多种攻击设定下兼具高攻击成功率与输出多样性。
Motivation: 现有生成流网络在 LLM 红队攻击中训练不稳定，奖励信号的噪声会加速模式崩溃，导致攻击效果和多样性难以兼得。
Method: S-GFN 通过成对比较 (pairwise comparisons) 避免配分函数 $Z$ 的显式估计，并采用鲁棒掩码机制处理噪声奖励；引入流畅性稳定器 (fluency stabilizer) 防止模型陷入生成乱码的局部最优。
Result: 摘要报告 S-GFN 在多种实验设定下相比基线方法取得更高的攻击成功率和更大的输出多样性。
Conclusion: S-GFN 在保持生成流网络最优策略的同时实现更稳定的训练，为 LLM 红队攻击提供了一种有效且鲁棒的解决方案。

papers.title: Rendering-Aware Sparse Sampling for BRDF Acquisition
papers.abstract_en: Accurate BRDF acquisition is essential for realistic rendering, but dense gonioreflectometer measurements are slow and expensive. We study how to select a small set of BRDF measurements that is most informative for reconstructing material appearance under a learned BRDF prior. Existing sparse-acquisition methods often optimize samples for BRDF-space reconstruction for all materials, while the perceptual importance of a adaptive measurement ultimately depends on its effect on each rendered appearance. We therefore formulate sparse adaptive acquisition as a rendering-aware optimization problem. Our method combines a set encoder for sparse coordinate--value observations, a pretrained hypernetwork-based/PCA-based BRDF reconstructor, and a differentiable renderer. During sampler training, the reconstructor remains fixed, and gradients from a rendered-image loss optimize the measurement locations. This separates acquisition design from prior fitting and encourages the sampler to choose directions that are informative under the learned material distribution. To make the comparison controlled, we evaluate the uniform baseline, meta-learning method, HyperBRDF method, and our learned sampler under matched sample numbers, train/test split, rendering scene, object mask, image mapping, and metrics. Our central claim: rendering-aware sampling improves extremely sparse BRDF acquisition when final rendered appearance is the target. BRDF-space and combined losses are reported only as ablations, together with joint refinement and image-only latent fitting for unseen materials.

papers.title: AirZoo: A Unified Large-Scale Dataset for Grounding Aerial Geometric 3D Vision
papers.abstract_en: Despite the rapid progress in data-driven 3D vision, aerial geometric 3D vision remains a formidable challenge due to the severe scarcity of large-scale, high-fidelity training data. Existing benchmarks, predominantly biased toward ground-level or object-centric views, do not account for complex viewpoint transformations and diverse environmental conditions in UAV-based sensing. To bridge this critical gap, we propose AirZoo, a unified large-scale dataset and benchmark for grounding aerial geometric 3D vision. AirZoo possesses three appealing properties: 1) Scalable Generation Pipeline: Leveraging freely available, world-scale photogrammetric 3D meshes, it renders vast outdoor environments with customizable UAV flight trajectories and configurable weather/illumination. 2) Comprehensive Scene Diversity: It provides the most extensive coverage of region types to date (spanning 378 regions across 22 countries), systematically encompassing both highly structured urban landscapes and complex unstructured natural environments. 3) Rich Geometric Annotations: Each frame provides synchronized, pixel-level metric depth and precise 6-DoF geo-referenced poses, essential for geometry-aware learning. Through three rigorous evaluation tracks -- aerial image retrieval, cross-view matching, and multi-view 3D reconstruction -- we demonstrate that AirZoo serves as a powerful pre-training engine. Extensive experiments on both public and newly collected real-world benchmarks reveal that fine-tuning on AirZoo yields substantial performance gains for SoTA models (e.g., MegaLoc, RoMa, VGGT, and Depth Anything 3), establishing a new performance upper bound for aerial spatial intelligence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AirZoo，一个用于航空几何三维视觉的大规模统一数据集和基准。它利用可扩展生成流水线从世界级摄影测量 3D 网格渲染户外环境，覆盖 22 个国家 378 个区域，提供像素级深度和 6-DoF 位姿标注。在航空图像检索、跨视角匹配和多视图三维重建任务上，微调 AirZoo 显著提升 SoTA 模型（如 MegaLoc、RoMa、VGGT、Depth Anything 3）的性能，建立新的空中空间智能性能上限。
Motivation: 现有航空几何三维视觉数据集规模小且偏地面或物体中心视角，无法处理无人机感知中的复杂视角变换和环境多样性，制约了数据驱动方法的发展。
Method: 利用免费的世界级摄影测量 3D 网格，通过可控无人机轨迹和可配置天气/光照条件渲染大规模户外图像，并同步生成像素级度量深度和精确 6-DoF 地理参考位姿。
Result: 在公开和自建真实数据集上，AirZoo 预训练后微调使 SoTA 模型在三个评测任务中取得显著性能增益，建立新的性能上限。
Conclusion: AirZoo 弥补了航空几何三维视觉的数据鸿沟，为空中空间智能提供统一基准，但未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: Learning to Decipher from Pixels: A Case Study of Copiale
papers.abstract_en: Historical encrypted manuscripts require both paleographic interpretation of cipher symbols and cryptanalytic recovery of plaintext. Most existing computational workflows rely on a transcription-first paradigm, in which handwritten symbols are transcribed prior to decipherment. This intermediate step is labor-intensive, error-prone, and not always aligned with the goal of direct plaintext recovery. We propose an end-to-end, transcription-free approach that directly maps handwritten cipher images to plaintext. Using the Copiale cipher as a case study, we introduce the first text-line-level dataset pairing cipher images with German plaintext. We show that pretraining on generic handwriting data followed by cipher-specific fine-tuning substantially improves decipherment accuracy. Our results demonstrate that transcription-free image-to-plaintext decipherment is both feasible and effective for historical substitution ciphers, offering a simplified and scalable alternative to traditional pipelines. https://github.com/leitro/Decipher-from-Pixels-Copiale

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种无转录（transcription-free）的端到端方法，直接将手写加密图像映射为明文，以Copiale密码为案例。作者构建了首个文本行级别的Copiale密码图像与德文明文配对数据集，并证明在通用手写数据上预训练后通过密码特定微调能显著提升破解准确率。
Motivation: 传统历史密码破译流程依赖先转录手写符号再解密，转录步骤耗时易错且与直接恢复明文的目标不直接对齐。
Method: 提出无转录的图像到明文方法：使用通用手写数据预训练，再在Copiale密码图像-明文对上进行微调，实现端到端的直接解密。
Result: 在Copiale密码数据集上，该方法实现了有效的直接明文恢复，证明了无转录方式的可行性。
Conclusion: 无转录图像到明文破解对于历史替换密码是可行且有效的，为传统流水线提供了简化且可扩展的替代方案。

papers.title: Generalizing Numerical Reasoning in Table Data through Operation Sketches and Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Numerical reasoning over expert-domain tables often exhibits high in-domain accuracy but limited robustness to domain shift. Models trained with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on specific datasets tend to rely on header-operation shortcuts rather than structural reasoning. We introduce TaNOS, a continual pre-training framework comprising three components: (i) header anonymization to reduce lexical memorization, (ii) operation sketches that provide minimal structural cues, and (iii) self-supervised pretraining that constructs correctness-guaranteed program-question pairs from given tables in a program-first manner. By decoupling domain semantics and numerical operation structure, TaNOS improves the transferability of numerical reasoning. Applied to an 8B instruction-tuned model, TaNOS achieves 80.13% execution accuracy on FinQA with only 10% train data, outperforming SFT baseline (73.97%) with full train data and proprietary models such as GPT-5, Gemini-2.5-Pro. Furthermore, in the domain-shift experiments, TaNOS displays nearly-negligible cross-domain gap (<2pp) when standard SFT shows over 10pp gap. These results suggest that structural guidance with operation sketches, header-agnostic representations, and correctness-guaranteed self-supervision can improve the robustness of numerical reasoning across diverse expert-domain tables.
papers.comment: Accepted to TACL. This is a pre-MIT Press publication version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TaNOS 框架，通过表头匿名化、操作草图（operation sketches）和自监督预训练三个组件，提升表格数据数值推理的跨领域泛化能力。在 FinQA 等数据集上，TaNOS 仅用 10% 训练数据即超过全数据监督微调基线及 GPT-5 等闭源模型，并在域迁移实验中表现出极小的跨域性能差距（<2pp）。
Motivation: 现有数值推理模型在特定领域表格上精度高但对域迁移鲁棒性差，监督微调模型常依赖表头-操作捷径而非结构化推理。
Method: TaNOS 包含三部分：表头匿名化减少词汇记忆；操作草图提供最小结构线索；自监督预训练以程序优先方式从表格构造正确性有保证的程序-问题对，解耦领域语义和数值操作结构。
Result: 在 8B 指令调优模型上，TaNOS 在 FinQA 上以 10% 训练数据达到 80.13% 执行准确率，超过全数据 SFT 基线（73.97%）和 GPT-5、Gemini-2.5-Pro 等专有模型；在域迁移实验中，TaNOS 跨域差距<2pp，而标准 SFT 超过 10pp。
Conclusion: 操作草图的结构引导、表头无关表示和正确性有保证的自监督学习可以提高数值推理在多样专业领域表格上的鲁棒性。

papers.title: Lyapunov-Certified Direct Switching Theory for Q-Learning
papers.abstract_en: Q-learning is a fundamental algorithmic primitive in reinforcement learning. This paper develops a new framework for analyzing Q-learning from a switching linear system (SLS) viewpoint. In particular, we derive a stochastic SLS representation of the Q-learning error, and a finite-time error analysis through the joint spectral radius (JSR) of the corresponding SLS model, where the JSR is the exact worst-case exponential rate of the associated SLS. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first convergence rate analysis of standard Q-learning whose leading exponential rate is expressed through the JSR. The resulting rate is tied to the intrinsic worst-case exponential rate of the direct SLS representation and can be sharper than row-sum upper bounds when those bounds are conservative.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从切换线性系统（SLS）的角度提出了Q-learning误差分析的新框架。推导了Q-learning误差的随机SLS表示，并通过联合谱半径（JSR）给出了有限时间误差分析，其中JSR是相应SLS的精确最坏情况指数速率。据作者所知，这是首次通过JSR表达标准Q-learning收敛速率的前导指数速率，该速率与直接SLS表示的内在最坏情况指数速率相关，且在行和上界保守时可更紧。
Motivation: 现有的Q-learning收敛分析中，指数速率的界限往往基于行和上界，可能过于保守。需要一种能够直接捕捉系统内在最坏情况指数速率的方法。
Method: 将Q-learning误差建模为随机切换线性系统，利用联合谱半径（JSR）理论推导其有限时间收敛速率，得到由JSR主导的指数速率表达式。
Result: 摘要声称这是第一个通过JSR表达标准Q-learning收敛速率前导指数速率的工作，并指出该速率在行和上界保守时能够更紧。
Conclusion: 论文建立的SLS分析框架为Q-learning的收敛性提供了新的视角，JSR给出的指数速率可能比传统上界更准确，但分析限于标准Q-learning，未涉及函数逼近或策略优化。

papers.title: RARE: Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation Framework for High-Similarity Corpora
papers.abstract_en: Existing QA benchmarks typically assume distinct documents with minimal overlap, yet real-world retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems operate on corpora such as financial reports, legal codes, and patents, where information is highly redundant and documents exhibit strong inter-document similarity. This mismatch undermines evaluation validity: retrievers can be unfairly undervalued even when they retrieve documents that provide sufficient evidence, because redundancy across documents is not accounted for in evaluation. On the other hand, retrievers that perform well on standard benchmarks often generalize poorly to real-world corpora with highly similar and redundant documents. We present RARE (Redundancy-Aware Retrieval Evaluation), a framework for constructing realistic benchmarks by (i) decomposing documents into atomic facts to enable precise redundancy tracking and (ii) enhancing LLM-based data generation with CRRF. RAG benchmark data usually requires multiple quality criteria, but LLMs often yield trivial outputs. CRRF scores criteria separately and fuses decisions by rank, improving the reliability of generated data. Applying RARE to Finance, Legal, and Patent corpora, we introduce RedQA, where a strong retriever baseline drops from 66.4% PerfRecall@10 on 4-hop General-Wiki to 5.0-27.9% PerfRecall@10 at 4-hop depth, revealing robustness gaps that current benchmarks fail to capture. RARE enables practitioners to build domain-specific RAG evaluations that faithfully reflect real-world deployment conditions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RARE 框架，用于构建高相似度语料（如金融、法律、专利）上的检索评估基准。通过将文档分解为原子事实以追踪冗余，并利用 CRRF 方法改进 LLM 数据生成，创建了 RedQA 基准。实验显示强检索基线的 PerfRecall@10 在4跳深度下从66.4%降至5.0-27.9%，揭示了现有基准未能捕捉的鲁棒性差距。
Motivation: 现有 QA 基准假设文档间重叠少，而真实 RAG 系统处理高度冗余、相似度高的语料（如金融报告、法律条文、专利），导致评估失效：检索器因未考虑冗余而被低估，且标准基准表现好的检索器在真实语料上泛化差。
Method: 提出 RARE 框架，包含两步： (i) 将文档分解为原子事实以精确追踪冗余； (ii) 使用 CRRF 方法增强 LLM 数据生成，分别评分各标准并按排名融合决策，提高生成数据可靠性。
Result: 在金融、法律、专利语料上构建 RedQA 基准，强检索基线的 PerfRecall@10 从4跳 General-Wiki 的66.4%降至5.0-27.9%，暴露了现有基准未能捕捉的鲁棒性差距。
Conclusion: RARE 使从业者能构建反映真实部署条件的领域特定 RAG 评估，适用于高相似度语料场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: URoPE: Universal Relative Position Embedding across Geometric Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Relative position embedding has become a standard mechanism for encoding positional information in Transformers. However, existing formulations are typically limited to a fixed geometric space, namely 1D sequences or regular 2D/3D grids, which restricts their applicability to many computer vision tasks that require geometric reasoning across camera views or between 2D and 3D spaces. To address this limitation, we propose URoPE, a universal extension of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) to cross-view or cross-dimensional geometric spaces. For each key/value image patch, URoPE samples 3D points along the corresponding camera ray at predefined depth anchors and projects them into the query image plane. Standard 2D RoPE can then be applied using the projected pixel coordinates. URoPE is a parameter-free and intrinsics-aware relative position embedding that is invariant to the choice of global coordinate systems, while remaining fully compatible with existing RoPE-optimized attention kernels. We evaluate URoPE as a plug-in positional encoding for transformer architectures across a diverse set of tasks, including novel view synthesis, 3D object detection, object tracking, and depth estimation, covering 2D-2D, 2D-3D, and temporal scenarios. Experiments show that URoPE consistently improves the performance of transformer-based models across all tasks, demonstrating its effectiveness and generality for geometric reasoning. Our code is available on our project website: https://urope-pe.github.io/.
papers.comment: Accepted by ECCV 2026. Code is available: https://urope-pe.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出URoPE，一种将旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）扩展到跨视图或跨维度几何空间的通用相对位置嵌入方法。通过沿相机射线采样3D点并投影到查询图像平面，实现了参数自由且与内参相关的位置编码，兼容现有RoPE优化注意力核。在新型视图合成、3D目标检测、目标跟踪和深度估计等任务上，URoPE一致提升了Transformer模型的性能。
Motivation: 现有相对位置嵌入通常局限于固定的几何空间（如1D序列或2D/3D网格），限制了其在需要跨视图或2D-3D几何推理的计算机视觉任务中的应用。
Method: URoPE为每个键/值图像块沿对应相机射线在预定义深度锚点处采样3D点，并将其投影到查询图像平面，然后应用标准2D RoPE。该方法无参数、依赖相机内参，且对全局坐标系选择具有不变性。
Result: 在新型视图合成、3D目标检测、目标跟踪和深度估计等任务上，URoPE作为即插即用的位置编码一致提升了Transformer模型的性能。
Conclusion: URoPE是一种通用且有效的相对位置嵌入，适用于跨视图和跨几何空间场景，且与现有RoPE优化内核完全兼容。

papers.title: Match-Any-Events: Zero-Shot Motion-Robust Feature Matching Across Wide Baselines for Event Cameras
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras have recently shown promising capabilities in instantaneous motion estimation due to their robustness to low light and fast motions. However, computing wide-baseline correspondence between two arbitrary views remains a significant challenge, since event appearance changes substantially with motion, and learning-based approaches are constrained by both scalability and limited wide-baseline supervision. We therefore introduce the first event matching model that achieves cross-dataset wide-baseline correspondence in a zero-shot manner: a single model trained once is deployed on unseen datasets without any target-domain fine-tuning or adaptation. To enable this capability, we introduce a motion-robust and computationally efficient attention backbone that learns multi-timescale features from event streams, augmented with sparsity-aware event token selection, making large-scale training on diverse wide-baseline supervision computationally feasible. To provide the supervision needed for wide-baseline generalization, we develop a robust event motion synthesis framework to generate large-scale event-matching datasets with augmented viewpoints, modalities, and motions. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks show that our framework achieves a 37.7% improvement over the previous best event feature matching methods. Code and data are available at: https://github.com/spikelab-jhu/Match-Any-Events.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出首个零样本事件相机宽基线特征匹配模型，通过运动鲁棒的注意力骨干网络和事件令牌稀疏选择，结合事件运动合成框架生成大规模训练数据，在多个基准上比先前最好方法提升37.7%。
Motivation: 事件相机在宽基线视角下对应匹配困难，由于运动导致的事件表观剧烈变化，且现有学习方法受限于可扩展性和宽基线监督不足。
Method: 提出运动鲁棒且计算高效的注意力骨干网络，学习事件流的多时间尺度特征，并引入稀疏感知的事件令牌选择；同时开发事件运动合成框架生成大规模宽基线事件匹配数据集。
Result: 在多个基准上实现零样本跨数据集宽基线对应，比之前最佳事件特征匹配方法提升37.7%。
Conclusion: 该工作首次实现事件相机零样本跨数据集宽基线匹配，代码和数据集已开源，未来可应用于更多事件视觉任务。

papers.title: LiteResearcher: A Scalable Agentic RL Training Framework for Deep Research Agent
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a powerful training paradigm for LLM-based agents. However, scaling agentic RL for deep research remains constrained by two coupled challenges: hand-crafted synthetic data fails to elicit genuine real-world search capabilities, and real-world search dependency during RL training introduces instability and prohibitive cost, which limits the scalability of Agentic RL. LiteResearcher is a training framework that makes Agentic RL scalable: by constructing a lite virtual world that mirrors real-world search dynamics, we enable a continuously improving training recipe that empowers a tiny search agent to outperform large-scale open-source and commercial models (e.g., Tongyi DeepResearch and Claude-4.5 Sonnet). Specifically, on common benchmarks such as GAIA and Xbench, our LiteResearcher-4B achieves open-source state-of-the-art results of 71.3% and 78.0% respectively, demonstrating that scalable RL training is a key enabler for Deep Research Agents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiteResearcher 框架，通过构建模拟真实搜索动态的轻量虚拟世界，使得基于强化学习的深度研究代理训练可扩展。该框架让一个 4B 参数的搜索代理在 GAIA 和 Xbench 上分别达到 71.3% 和 78.0% 的开源 SOTA，超越 Tongyi DeepResearch 和 Claude-4.5 Sonnet 等大模型。
Motivation: 现有强化学习训练深度研究代理面临两个挑战：手工合成数据无法激发真实搜索能力，而依赖真实搜索环境则带来训练不稳定和高昂成本，限制了可扩展性。
Method: LiteResearcher 构建一个轻量虚拟世界，镜像真实搜索动力学，使代理在持续改进的训练方案中学习，从而让小规模搜索代理也能取得优异性能。
Result: 在 GAIA 和 Xbench 基准上，LiteResearcher-4B 分别取得 71.3% 和 78.0% 的开源 SOTA，超越多个大型商业模型。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，可扩展的强化学习训练是驱动深度研究代理的关键因素。

papers.title: Making Image Editing Easier via Adaptive Task Reformulation with Agentic Executions
papers.abstract_en: Instruction guided image editing has advanced substantially with recent generative models, yet it still fails to produce reliable results across many seemingly simple cases. We observe that a large portion of these failures stem not from insufficient model capacity, but from poorly formulated editing tasks, such as those involving small targets, implicit spatial relations, or under-specified instructions. In this work, we frame image editing failures as a task formulation problem and propose an adaptive task reformulation framework that improves editing performance without modifying the underlying model. Our key idea is to transform the original image-instruction pair into a sequence of operations that are dynamically determined and executed by a MLLM agent through analysis, routing, reformulation, and feedback-driven refinement. Experiments on multiple benchmarks, including ImgEdit, PICA, and RePlan, across diverse editing backbones such as Qwen Image Edit and Nano Banana, show consistent improvements, with especially large gains on challenging cases. These results suggest that task reformulation is a critical but underexplored factor, and that substantial gains can be achieved by better matching editing tasks to the effective operating regime of existing models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出自适应任务重述框架，通过多模态大语言模型代理将原始图像-指令对转化为动态确定的操作序列，在不修改底层模型的情况下提升图像编辑性能。实验在ImgEdit、PICA、RePlan等基准上使用Qwen Image Edit、Nano Banana等编辑骨干网络，显示一致改进，尤其在困难案例上效果显著。
Motivation: 指令引导图像编辑中大量失败源于任务表述不佳（如小目标、隐含空间关系、指令不明确），而非模型能力不足。
Method: 提出自适应任务重述框架，由MLLM代理通过分析、路由、重述和反馈驱动的优化，将原始任务转化为一系列更易执行的操作。
Result: 在多个基准和编辑骨干网络上取得一致改进，在困难案例上提升尤为显著。
Conclusion: 任务重述是图像编辑中关键但未充分研究的因素，通过更好匹配模型有效工作范围可获得显著性能增益。

papers.title: Diffusion Crossover: Defining Evolutionary Recombination in Diffusion Models via Noise Sequence Interpolation
papers.abstract_en: Interactive Evolutionary Computation (IEC) provides a powerful framework for optimizing subjective criteria such as human preferences and aesthetics, yet it suffers from a fundamental limitation: in high-dimensional generative representations, defining crossover in a semantically consistent manner is difficult, often leading to a mutation-dominated search. In this work, we explicitly define crossover in diffusion models. We propose Diffusion crossover, which formulates evolutionary recombination as step-wise interpolation of noise sequences in the reverse process of Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs). By applying spherical linear interpolation (Slerp) to the noise sequences associated with selected parent images, the proposed method generates offspring that inherit characteristics from both parents while preserving the geometric structure of the diffusion process. Furthermore, controlling the time-step range of interpolation enables a principled trade-off between diversity (exploration) and convergence (exploitation). Experimental results using PCA analysis and perceptual similarity metrics (LPIPS) demonstrate that Diffusion crossover produces perceptually smooth and semantically consistent transitions between parent images. Qualitative interactive evolution experiments further confirm that the proposed method effectively supports human-in-the-loop image exploration. These findings suggest a new perspective: diffusion models are not only powerful generators, but also structured evolutionary search spaces in which recombination can be explicitly defined and controlled.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出扩散交叉（Diffusion crossover）方法，将进化计算中的重组操作定义为扩散模型逆向过程中噪声序列的逐帧插值。通过对父图像对应的噪声序列应用球面线性插值（Slerp），生成的子图像继承双亲特征且保持扩散过程几何结构，并可通过控制插值时间步范围平衡探索与利用。实验表明该方法产生感知平滑且语义一致的过渡，并支持人在环图像探索。
Motivation: 交互式进化计算在高维生成表示中难以定义语义一致的交叉操作，导致搜索偏向突变主导；本文旨在为扩散模型显式定义可控制的交叉算子。
Method: 在DDPM逆向过程中，对选定的父图像噪声序列进行球面线性插值（Slerp），生成子图像；通过选择插值的时间步范围调节子代多样性与收敛性。
Result: PCA分析和LPIPS指标显示扩散交叉产生感知平滑、语义一致的父图像过渡；定性交互进化实验证实该有效支持人在环图像探索。
Conclusion: 扩散模型不仅是强大的生成器，也是可显式定义并控制重组操作的结构化进化搜索空间。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Structured Progressive Knowledge Activation for LLM-Driven Neural Architecture Search
papers.abstract_en: This paper focuses on a key challenge in Neural Architecture Search (NAS): integrating established architectural knowledge while exploring new designs under expensive evaluations. Large language models (LLMs) are a promising assistant for NAS because they can translate rich architectural and coding priors into executable code edits. However, in practice, seemingly local revisions often propagate into non-local behavioral and performance shifts because a single edit can inadvertently couple multiple interacting functional factors, a phenomenon we refer to as functional entanglement. To make LLM knowledge usable under such entanglement, we propose Structured Progressive Knowledge Activation (SPARK), which activates relevant priors by explicitly selecting the functional factor to modify and conditioning the edit on that factor. This factor-conditioned editing reduces entangled side effects and yields more targeted, reliable architecture modifications. On CLRS-DFS, SPARK achieves a 28.1x sample-efficient architecture evolution speedup and yields a 22.9\% relative improvement in OOD accuracy. Our code is available at https://github.com/AIM-ResearchLab/SPARK.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LLM驱动的神经架构搜索（NAS）中，局部编辑因功能纠缠导致全局性能偏移的问题，提出结构化渐进知识激活（SPARK）方法。SPARK通过显式选择待修改的功能因子并基于该因子条件化编辑，减少纠缠副作用，实现更精准的架构修改。在CLRS-DFS任务上，SPARK取得28.1倍样本效率提升和22.9%的OOD准确率相对改进。
Motivation: 现有LLM辅助NAS中，单个编辑可能无意耦合多个功能因子（功能纠缠），导致修改行为与预期不一致，影响搜索效率。
Method: 提出SPARK框架：在每次编辑时，先明确选择一个功能因子（functional factor），然后基于该因子生成条件化编辑，从而解耦不同功能的影响，激活相关的LLM先验知识。
Result: 在CLRS-DFS基准上，SPARK实现28.1倍的样本效率加速，并带来22.9%的OOD准确率相对提升。
Conclusion: SPARK通过因子条件化编辑有效缓解功能纠缠，使LLM先验知识更可靠地服务于NAS，未来可扩展至更多架构搜索场景。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对LLM驱动的神经架构搜索（NAS）中，局部编辑因功能纠缠导致全局性能偏移的问题，提出结构化渐进知识激活（SPARK）方法。SPARK通过显式选择待修改的功能因子并基于该因子条件化编辑，减少纠缠副作用，实现更精准的架构修改。在CLRS-DFS任务上，SPARK取得28.1倍样本效率提升和22.9%的OOD准确率相对改进。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有LLM辅助NAS中，单个编辑可能无意耦合多个功能因子（功能纠缠），导致修改行为与预期不一致，影响搜索效率。
summary_sections.method: 提出SPARK框架：在每次编辑时，先明确选择一个功能因子（functional factor），然后基于该因子生成条件化编辑，从而解耦不同功能的影响，激活相关的LLM先验知识。
summary_sections.result: 在CLRS-DFS基准上，SPARK实现28.1倍的样本效率加速，并带来22.9%的OOD准确率相对提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: SPARK通过因子条件化编辑有效缓解功能纠缠，使LLM先验知识更可靠地服务于NAS，未来可扩展至更多架构搜索场景。

papers.title: Physically Grounded 3D Generative Reconstruction under Hand Occlusion using Proprioception and Multi-Contact Touch
papers.abstract_en: We propose a multimodal, physically grounded approach for metric-scale amodal object reconstruction and pose estimation under severe hand occlusion. Unlike prior occlusion-aware 3D generation methods that rely only on vision, we leverage physical interaction signals: proprioception provides the posed hand geometry, and multi-contact touch constrains where the object surface must lie, reducing ambiguity in occluded regions. We represent object structure as a pose-aware, camera-aligned signed distance field (SDF) and learn a compact latent space with a Structure-VAE. In this latent space, we train a conditional flow-matching diffusion model, pretraining on vision-only images and finetuning on occluded manipulation scenes while conditioning on visible RGB evidence, occluder/visibility masks, the hand latent representation, and tactile information. Crucially, we incorporate physics-based objectives and differentiable decoder-guidance during finetuning and inference to reduce hand--object interpenetration and to align the reconstructed surface with contact observations. Because our method produces a metric, physically consistent structure estimate, it integrates naturally into existing two-stage reconstruction pipelines, where a downstream module refines geometry and predicts appearance. Experiments in simulation show that adding proprioception and touch substantially improves completion under occlusion and yields physically plausible reconstructions at correct real-world scale compared to vision-only baselines; we further validate transfer by deploying the model on a real humanoid robot with an end-effector different from those used during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于本体感觉和多触点触摸的多模态方法，用于手部严重遮挡下的度量级非模态物体重建与姿态估计。方法将物体结构表示为姿态感知的相机对齐有符号距离场（SDF），通过Structure-VAE学习紧凑潜空间，并训练条件流匹配扩散模型，结合视觉、遮挡物/可见性掩码、手部潜表征和触觉信息。推理时引入物理目标与可微分解码器引导以减少手-物穿透并与接触观测对齐。在仿真实验中，相比于纯视觉基线，添加本体感觉和触觉显著改善了遮挡下的物体补全，并生成真实尺度下的物理合理重建；并在真实机器人上验证了迁移能力。
Motivation: 现有遮挡感知的三维生成方法仅依赖视觉，在手部严重遮挡下歧义大，且无法保证物理一致性（如真实尺度和手-物穿透）。
Method: 提出多模态框架：使用Structure-VAE学习物体SDF的潜空间，训练条件流匹配扩散模型，条件包括RGB、遮挡/可见性掩码、手部潜表征和触觉信号；并通过物理目标（减少手-物穿透）和可微分解码器引导在微调和推理阶段优化重建。
Result: 仿真实验中，相比纯视觉基线，注入本体感觉和触觉显著提升遮挡下的物体补全质量，并生成真实尺度的物理合理重建；在真实机器人上成功迁移（末端执行器与训练时不同）。
Conclusion: 利用物理交互信号（本体感觉和触觉）可有效解决视觉遮挡下的物体重建与姿态估计的歧义，且所得度量级、物理一致的重建可直接集成到现有两阶段重建流水线。

papers.title: SMART: When is it Actually Worth Expanding a Speculative Tree?
papers.abstract_en: Tree-based speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by verifying a branching tree of draft tokens in a single target-model forward pass. However, existing methods prioritize maximizing token-level likelihood or the number of accepted tokens while ignoring a critical ``efficiency paradox'': the computational overhead of drafting and verifying big trees can grow super-linearly, particularly at scale. This often leads to negative wall-clock speedup when batch sizes increase or hardware saturation limits are reached. To address this, we propose SMART, a system-aware marginal analysis framework for runtime tree construction. SMART reformulates tree expansion as a hardware-aware optimization problem that directly maximizes end-to-end speedup. By applying a principled marginal benefit--cost rule at inference time, SMART expands a node only when its marginal benefit--cost ratio exceeds the tree-level speedup. SMART is training-free and serves as a plug-and-play controller for existing frameworks like MSD and EAGLE. Extensive evaluations across three MLLMs (e.g., LLaVA, Qwen2-VL) and four LLMs (e.g., Llama-3.1, DeepSeek-R1) demonstrate that SMART consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. It delivers an average additional speedup of 20.0\% for MLLMs and 15.4\% for LLMs across compute-bound batching regimes and diverse GPU architectures without performance loss.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SMART，一个系统感知的边际分析框架，用于在推测解码中动态构建树结构，避免树扩展过大导致的计算开销超过收益。SMART通过边际效益-成本规则决定是否扩展节点，无需训练，可直接集成到现有框架如MSD和EAGLE中。在多个多模态大模型和纯语言模型上的实验表明，SMART在计算受限的批处理场景下平均额外加速20.0%（MLLMs）和15.4%（LLMs），且不损失性能。
Motivation: 现有基于树的推测解码方法在构建树时忽略了一个关键效率悖论：随着树规模增大，草稿和验证的计算开销可能超线性增长，导致实际加速比随批大小或硬件饱和而下降甚至为负。
Method: 将树扩展形式化为一个硬件感知的优化问题，直接最大化端到端加速比。在推理时应用边际效益-成本规则：仅当某节点的边际效益-成本比大于当前树级别加速比时才扩展该节点。SMART是训练无关的即插即用控制器。
Result: 在LLaVA、Qwen2-VL等三种MLLM和Llama-3.1、DeepSeek-R1等四种LLM上，SMART在计算受限的批处理场景下相对基线平均额外加速20.0%（MLLM）和15.4%（LLM），且无性能损失。
Conclusion: SMART提供了一种系统感知的边际分析方案，能有效避免推测解码中树过度扩展导致的效率损失，在多种GPU架构和批处理设置下带来一致加速。

papers.title: The Impact of Dimensionality on the Stability of Node Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: Previous work has shown that node embedding methods can produce different representations and downstream predictions across repeated training runs, even when trained on the same data with identical hyperparameters. However, the role of embedding dimensionality in this instability remains poorly understood. In this work, we systematically analyze how embedding dimensionality affects the stability of embeddings from five widely used node embedding methods: ASNE, DGI, GraphSAGE, node2vec, and VERSE. We evaluate stability from both representational and functional perspectives across a broad range of dimensions, datasets, and repeated training runs, and relate the resulting stability patterns to predictive performance. Our results show that dimensionality can substantially affect embedding stability, although the observed effects depend strongly on the embedding method and stability notion considered. While node2vec and ASNE generally became more stable at higher dimensions, GraphSAGE and VERSE often exhibited non-monotonic behavior or decreasing stability. We further find that dimensions associated with high stability do not necessarily coincide with those yielding the strongest downstream performance. Overall, our findings demonstrate that embedding dimensionality can have a substantial impact on the stability of node embeddings and downstream predictions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了嵌入维度对五种节点嵌入方法（ASNE、DGI、GraphSAGE、node2vec、VERSE）稳定性的影响，发现维度对稳定性有显著但依赖于方法和稳定性度量。高维不一定同步提高下游性能。
Motivation: 已有工作表明节点嵌入方法在不同训练运行中会产生不同表示和下游预测，但嵌入维度在其中的作用尚不明确。
Method: 从表示和功能两个角度，在多维度、多数据集和多次训练上系统评估五种节点嵌入方法的稳定性，并关联稳定性模式与预测性能。
Result: node2vec和ASNE在高维时更稳定，GraphSAGE和VERSE常呈现非单调或稳定性下降；高稳定性的维度与最优下游性能的维度不吻合。
Conclusion: 嵌入维度对节点嵌入及下游预测的稳定性有显著影响，但效果取决于具体方法和稳定性定义。

papers.title: RASR: Retrieval-Augmented Semantic Reasoning for Fake News Video Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal fake news video detection is a crucial research direction for maintaining the credibility of online information. Existing studies primarily verify content authenticity by constructing multimodal feature fusion representations or utilizing pre-trained language models to analyze video-text consistency. However, these methods still face the following limitations: (1) lacking cross-instance global semantic correlations, making it difficult to effectively utilize historical associative evidence to verify the current video; (2) semantic discrepancies across domains hinder the transfer of general knowledge, lacking the guidance of domain-specific expert knowledge. To this end, we propose a novel Retrieval-Augmented Semantic Reasoning (RASR) framework. First, a Cross-instance Semantic Parser and Retriever (CSPR) deconstructs the video into high-level semantic primitives and retrieves relevant associative evidence from a dynamic memory bank. Subsequently, a Domain-Guided Multimodal Reasoning (DGMP) module incorporates domain priors to drive an expert multimodal large language model in generating domain-aware, in-depth analysis reports. Finally, a Multi-View Feature Decoupling and Fusion (MVDFF) module integrates multi-dimensional features through an adaptive gating mechanism to achieve robust authenticity determination. Extensive experiments on the FakeSV and FakeTT datasets demonstrate that RASR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieves superior cross-domain generalization, and improves the overall detection accuracy by up to 0.93%.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出检索增强语义推理（RASR）框架用于多模态假新闻视频检测，通过跨实例语义解析与检索、领域引导多模态推理和多视图特征解耦融合来提升检测准确率，在FakeSV和FakeTT数据集上优于现有方法，总体检测准确率提升0.93%。
Motivation: 现有方法缺乏跨实例全局语义关联，难以利用历史证据；跨领域语义差异阻碍通用知识迁移，缺乏特定领域专家知识。
Method: 提出RASR框架：跨实例语义解析与检索器（CSPR）将视频解构为高级语义原语并从动态记忆库检索相关证据；领域引导多模态推理（DGMP）模块引入领域先验驱动专家多模态大语言模型生成领域感知深度分析报告；多视图特征解耦与融合（MVDFF）模块通过自适应门控机制整合多维度特征进行真实性判断。
Result: 在FakeSV和FakeTT数据集上，RASR显著超越最先进基线，实现优越的跨领域泛化，总体检测准确率提升0.93%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调RASR通过检索增强和领域知识引导有效提升了假新闻视频检测性能，特别是跨域泛化能力。

papers.title: E-VLA: Event-Augmented Vision-Language-Action Model for Dark and Blurred Scenes
papers.abstract_en: Robotic Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generalize well for open-ended manipulation, but their perception is fragile under sensing-stage degradations such as extreme low light, motion blur, and black clipping. We present E-VLA, an event-augmented VLA framework that improves manipulation robustness when conventional frame-based vision becomes unreliable. Instead of reconstructing images from events, E-VLA directly leverages motion and structural cues in event streams to preserve semantic perception and perception-action consistency under adverse conditions. We build an open-source teleoperation platform with a DAVIS346 event camera and collect a real-world synchronized RGB-event-action manipulation dataset across diverse tasks and illuminations. We also propose lightweight, pretrained-compatible event integration strategies and study event windowing for stable deployment. Experiments show that even a simple parameter-free fusion, i.e., overlaying accumulated event maps onto RGB images, could substantially improve robustness in dark and heavy-blur scenes: on Pick-Place at 20 lux, success increases from 0% (image-only) to 60% with overlay fusion and to 90% with our event adapter; under severe motion blur (1000 ms-exposure proxy), Pick-Place improves from 0% to 20-25%, and Sorting from 5% to 32.5%. Overall, E-VLA provides systematic evidence that event-driven perception can be effectively integrated into VLA models, pointing toward robust embodied intelligence beyond conventional frame-based imaging. Code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/JJayzee/E-VLA.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/JJayzee/E-VLA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 E-VLA，一种事件增强的视觉-语言-动作模型，旨在提升机器人在极端低光、运动模糊等退化场景下的操作鲁棒性。通过直接利用事件流中的运动和结构线索，E-VLA 避免了从事件重建图像，并设计了轻量级事件融合策略。实验表明，在 20 lux 暗光场景下，简单的事件叠加融合即可将 Pick-Place 任务成功率从 0% 提升至 60%，事件适配器更达到 90%。
Motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在开放操作任务中泛化良好，但在极端低光、运动模糊等感知退化下性能脆弱，传统帧基视觉变得不可靠。
Method: 构建基于 DAVIS346 事件相机的遥操作平台，收集同步 RGB-事件-动作数据集；提出无需重建图像的轻量级事件集成策略，包括参数无关的事件叠加融合和可学习的适配器，并研究事件时间窗口以稳定部署。
Result: 在 20 lux 暗光下，Pick-Place 成功率从 0%（纯图像）提升至 60%（叠加融合）和 90%（适配器）；在严重运动模糊下，Pick-Place 从 0% 提升至 20-25%，Sorting 从 5% 提升至 32.5%。
Conclusion: E-VLA 系统性地证明了事件驱动感知可有效集成到 VLA 模型中，为超越传统帧基成像的鲁棒具身智能提供了证据。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文提出 E-VLA，一种事件增强的视觉-语言-动作模型，旨在提升机器人在极端低光、运动模糊等退化场景下的操作鲁棒性。通过直接利用事件流中的运动和结构线索，E-VLA 避免了从事件重建图像，并设计了轻量级事件融合策略。实验表明，在 20 lux 暗光场景下，简单的事件叠加融合即可将 Pick-Place 任务成功率从 0% 提升至 60%，事件适配器更达到 90%。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在开放操作任务中泛化良好，但在极端低光、运动模糊等感知退化下性能脆弱，传统帧基视觉变得不可靠。
summary_sections.method: 构建基于 DAVIS346 事件相机的遥操作平台，收集同步 RGB-事件-动作数据集；提出无需重建图像的轻量级事件集成策略，包括参数无关的事件叠加融合和可学习的适配器，并研究事件时间窗口以稳定部署。
summary_sections.result: 在 20 lux 暗光下，Pick-Place 成功率从 0%（纯图像）提升至 60%（叠加融合）和 90%（适配器）；在严重运动模糊下，Pick-Place 从 0% 提升至 20-25%，Sorting 从 5% 提升至 32.5%。
summary_sections.conclusion: E-VLA 系统性地证明了事件驱动感知可有效集成到 VLA 模型中，为超越传统帧基成像的鲁棒具身智能提供了证据。

papers.title: Learning Dexterous Grasping from Sparse Taxonomy Guidance
papers.abstract_en: Dexterous manipulation requires planning a grasp configuration suited to the object and task, which is then executed through coordinated multi-finger control. However, specifying grasp plans with dense pose or contact targets for every object and task is impractical. Meanwhile, end-to-end reinforcement learning from task rewards alone lacks controllability, making it difficult for users to intervene when failures occur. To this end, we present GRIT, a two-stage framework that learns dexterous control from sparse taxonomy guidance. GRIT first predicts a taxonomy-based grasp specification from the scene and task context. Conditioned on this sparse command, a policy generates continuous finger motions that accomplish the task while preserving the intended grasp structure. Our result shows that certain grasp taxonomies are more effective for specific object geometries. By leveraging this relationship, GRIT improves generalization to novel objects over baselines and achieves an overall success rate of 87.9%. Moreover, real-world experiments demonstrate controllability, enabling grasp strategies to be adjusted through high-level taxonomy selection based on object geometry and task intent.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRIT，一个两阶段框架，从稀疏分类法指导学习灵巧抓取。首先预测基于分类法的抓取规范，然后条件于稀疏指令生成连续手指运动。实验表明某些抓取分类法对特定物体几何更有效，GRIT在新物体上泛化优于基线，总体成功率87.9%。真实世界实验展示了可控制性。
Motivation: 指定密集姿态或接触目标的抓取规划不实用，而端到端强化学习缺乏可控性，难以在失败时干预。本文目标是从稀疏分类法指导学习可控的灵巧抓取。
Method: 两阶段框架GRIT：第一阶段从场景和任务上下文预测基于分类法的抓取规范；第二阶段基于该稀疏指令，策略生成连续手指运动，同时保持预期抓取结构。
Result: 摘要报告某些抓取分类法对特定物体几何更有效，GRIT在新物体上泛化优于基线，总体成功率为87.9%。真实世界实验展示了可控性，可通过高级分类法选择调整抓取策略。
Conclusion: 摘要强调通过利用抓取分类法与物体几何的关系，GRIT改进了泛化能力，并提供了可控性。

papers.title: TORA: Topological Representation Alignment for 3D Shape Assembly
papers.abstract_en: Flow-matching methods for 3D shape assembly learn point-wise velocity fields that transport parts toward assembled configurations, yet they receive no explicit guidance about which cross-part interactions should drive the motion. We introduce TORA, a topology-first representation alignment framework that distills relational structure from a frozen pretrained 3D encoder into the flow-matching backbone during training. We first realize this via simple instantiation, token-wise cosine matching, which injects the learned geometric descriptors from the teacher representation. We then extend to employ a Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) loss to match the similarity structure between student and teacher representations for enhanced topological alignment. Through systematic probing of diverse 3D encoders, we show that geometry- and contact-centric teacher properties, not semantic classification ability, govern alignment effectiveness, and that alignment is most beneficial at later transformer layers where spatial structure naturally emerges. TORA introduces zero inference overhead while yielding two consistent benefits: faster convergence (up to 6.9$\times$) and improved accuracy in-distribution, along with greater robustness under domain shift. Experiments on five benchmarks spanning geometric, semantic, and inter-object assembly demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, with particularly pronounced gains in zero-shot transfer to unseen real-world and synthetic datasets. Project page: https://nahyuklee.github.io/tora.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TORA，一种拓扑优先的表示对齐框架，用于 3D 形状组装。它从冻结的预训练 3D 编码器中蒸馏关系结构到流匹配主干，通过标记级余弦匹配和 Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) 损失增强拓扑对齐。该方法在五个基准上取得最先进性能，收敛速度提升高达 6.9 倍，并在分布偏移下鲁棒性更强。
Motivation: 现有流匹配方法学习逐点速度场以将部件运输到组装配置，但缺乏显式指导哪些跨部件交互驱动运动，导致组装效果不佳。
Method: 利用冻结的预训练 3D 编码器作为教师，通过简单的标记级余弦匹配注入几何描述符，然后使用 CKA 损失匹配学生与教师表示的相似性结构，实现拓扑对齐。
Result: 在五个基准（涵盖几何、语义和物体间组装）上取得最先进性能，收敛速度提升 6.9 倍，在分布偏移下鲁棒性更强，零样本迁移到未见过的真实和合成数据集上尤为突出。
Conclusion: 拓扑对齐在零推理开销下带来一致收益，对齐效果由几何和接触中心属性主导，而非语义分类能力，且在后层 Transformer 中收益最大。

papers.title: When Sinks Help or Hurt: Unified Framework for Attention Sink in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Attention sinks are defined as tokens that attract disproportionate attention. While these have been studied in single modality transformers, their cross-modal impact in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLM) remains largely unexplored: are they redundant artifacts or essential global priors? This paper first categorizes visual sinks into two distinct categories: ViT-emerged sinks (V-sinks), which propagate from the vision encoder, and LLM-emerged sinks (L-sinks), which arise within deep LLM layers. Based on the new definition, our analysis reveals a fundamental performance trade-off: while sinks effectively encode global scene-level priors, their dominance can suppress the fine-grained visual evidence required for local perception. Furthermore, we identify specific functional layers where modulating these sinks most significantly impacts downstream performance. To leverage these insights, we propose Layer-wise Sink Gating (LSG), a lightweight, plug-and-play module that dynamically scales the attention contributions of V-sink and the rest visual tokens. LSG is trained via standard next-token prediction, requiring no task-specific supervision while keeping the LVLM backbone frozen. In most layers, LSG yields improvements on representative multimodal benchmarks, effectively balancing global reasoning and precise local evidence.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Additional experimental results added
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中的注意力汇聚（attention sink）现象，将其分为源自视觉编码器的V-sink和源自LLM层的L-sink，并发现它们虽能编码全局场景先验，但过度主导会抑制局部感知所需的细粒度视觉证据。为此提出层式汇聚门控（LSG），一个轻量级即插即用模块，通过动态缩放V-sink与其余视觉令牌的注意力贡献，在不冻结LVLM主干的情况下，仅用标准下一词预测训练，在多个多模态基准上取得改进。
Motivation: 现有研究主要在单模态Transformer中探讨注意力汇聚，但其在LVLM中的跨模态影响尚未明确：它们究竟是冗余伪影还是必要的全局先验？
Method: 首先将视觉汇聚分为V-sink（源自视觉编码器）和L-sink（源自深层LLM层），并揭示其性能权衡。然后提出Layer-wise Sink Gating (LSG)，一个轻量级即插即用模块，通过动态缩放V-sink与其余视觉令牌的注意力贡献来调节汇聚影响，训练仅需标准下一词预测，保持LVLM主干冻结。
Result: 在大多数层级上，LSG在代表性多模态基准上带来改进，有效平衡了全局推理与精确局部证据。
Conclusion: 本文揭示了LVLM中注意力汇聚的双重作用及性能权衡，并提出LSG模块在无需任务特定监督下改善多模态理解，强调了在适当层调控汇聚的重要性。

papers.title: Policy Improvement Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning has become a central post-training paradigm for improving LLM and agent capabilities. Yet existing RL post-training methods share a common blind spot: they construct local learning signals from sampled trajectories, rewards, or feedback-conditioned targets, then update the policy without explicitly verifying whether the resulting policy outperforms its predecessor. Optimizing these local signals does not necessarily produce a better policy, while finite sampling, generation stochasticity and feedback noise can further widen this gap. We argue that the missing ingredient is policy improvement feedback: the ability to measure progress across policy iterations. We introduce Policy Improvement Reinforcement Learning (PIRL), which formulates inter-iteration performance gain as an explicit objective structurally aligned with final task performance. Building on PIRL, we propose Policy Improvement Policy Optimization (PIPO), a plug-in closed-loop framework that verifies the previous update against a sliding-window historical performance anchor. PIPO uses this improvement feedback to modulate the local learning signal of the base policy optimization algorithm, reinforcing updates associated with measured progress and suppressing those associated with performance drops. We provide theoretical evidence that PIPO locally aligns policy updates with the PIRL improvement objective. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, code, tool-use, and self-distillation settings show that PIPO yields consistent gains across PPO, group-relative, and self-distillation policy optimization families.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出策略改进强化学习（PIRL），将跨迭代性能增益显式建模为目标，并进一步提出策略改进策略优化（PIPO），即插即用闭环框架，通过滑动窗口历史性能锚点验证更新有效性，并利用改进反馈调节局部学习信号。实验在数学推理、代码、工具使用和自蒸馏设置上显示，PIPO在PPO、组相对和自蒸馏策略优化族上均取得一致提升。
Motivation: 现有RL后训练方法构建局部学习信号后直接更新策略，但不验证新策略是否优于前身，导致局部优化未必产生更好策略，且有限采样和噪声加剧差距。
Method: 提出PIRL，将跨迭代性能增益形式化为显式目标；在此基础上提出PIPO，一个即插即用闭环框架，使用滑动窗口历史性能锚点验证更新，并用改进反馈调节基策略优化算法的局部学习信号。
Result: 在数学推理、代码、工具使用和自蒸馏设置上，PIPO在PPO、组相对和自蒸馏策略优化族上带来一致性能提升。
Conclusion: PIRL/PIPO通过引入策略改进反馈弥补现有RL后训练盲点，理论证明局部对齐PIRL改进目标，实验验证其有效性。

papers.title: TSHA: A Benchmark for Visual Language Models in Trustworthy Safety Hazard Assessment Scenarios
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in vision-language models (VLMs) have accelerated their application to indoor safety hazards assessment. However, existing benchmarks suffer from three fundamental limitations: (1) heavy reliance on synthetic datasets constructed via simulation software, creating a significant domain gap with real-world environments; (2) oversimplified safety tasks with artificial constraints on hazard and scene types, thereby limiting model generalization; and (3) absence of rigorous evaluation protocols to thoroughly assess model capabilities in complex home safety scenarios. To address these challenges, we introduce TSHA (\textbf{T}rustworthy \textbf{S}afety \textbf{H}azards \textbf{A}ssessment), a comprehensive benchmark comprising 66,668 validated question-answer pairs, including 64,961 carefully curated training QA pairs drawn from existing indoor datasets, internet frames/images, AIGC images, newly captured images, and Hunyuan panoramic images. This benchmark also includes a highly challenging test set with 1,707 QA pairs, comprising not only a carefully selected subset from the training distribution but also newly added Sora-generated videos and Hunyuan panoramic images containing multiple safety hazards, used to evaluate the model's robustness in complex safety scenarios. Extensive experiments on 22 popular VLMs demonstrate that current VLMs lack robust capabilities for safety hazard assessment. Importantly, models trained on the TSHA training set achieve a significant performance improvement of up to +18.3 points on the TSHA test set and also exhibit enhanced generalizability across other benchmarks, underscoring the substantial contribution and importance of the TSHA benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在室内安全危害评估中的应用，指出现有基准存在三大缺陷：依赖合成数据集导致领域差距、任务过于简单、缺乏严格评估协议。为此提出TSHA基准，包含66,668个验证问答对（64,961训练对+1,707测试对），数据来源涵盖室内数据集、互联网图像、AIGC图像、新拍摄图像及混元全景图像，测试集还包含Sora生成视频和含多安全危害的全景图像。在22个VLM上的实验表明，当前VLM缺乏稳健的安全危害评估能力，但TSHA训练集可提升模型性能最多18.3个百分点，并增强跨基准泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有室内安全危害评估基准存在三大局限：过度依赖模拟软件合成的数据集造成领域差距；安全任务过于简化，人为限制危害和场景类型；缺乏严格的评估协议来全面评估模型在复杂家庭安全场景中的能力。
Method: 构建TSHA基准，包含66,668个QA对，训练数据来自六种来源（室内数据集、网络帧/图像、AIGC图像、新拍摄图像、混元全景图像），测试集含1,707个QA对，包括训练分布子集、Sora生成视频和多危害混元全景图像，用于评估模型鲁棒性。
Result: 在22个流行VLM上的实验表明，当前VLM缺乏稳健的安全危害评估能力；基于TSHA训练集训练的模型在测试集上性能提升最高达18.3个百分点，并在其他基准上展现增强的泛化能力。
Conclusion: TSHA基准对提升VLM在复杂安全场景中的危害评估能力有显著贡献，强调高质量真实世界数据的重要性。
Relevance: 5

summary_sections.tldr: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）在室内安全危害评估中的应用，指出现有基准存在三大缺陷：依赖合成数据集导致领域差距、任务过于简单、缺乏严格评估协议。为此提出TSHA基准，包含66,668个验证问答对（64,961训练对+1,707测试对），数据来源涵盖室内数据集、互联网图像、AIGC图像、新拍摄图像及混元全景图像，测试集还包含Sora生成视频和含多安全危害的全景图像。在22个VLM上的实验表明，当前VLM缺乏稳健的安全危害评估能力，但TSHA训练集可提升模型性能最多18.3个百分点，并增强跨基准泛化能力。
summary_sections.motivation: 现有室内安全危害评估基准存在三大局限：过度依赖模拟软件合成的数据集造成领域差距；安全任务过于简化，人为限制危害和场景类型；缺乏严格的评估协议来全面评估模型在复杂家庭安全场景中的能力。

papers.title: Quality-Controlled Active Learning via Gaussian Processes for Robust Structure-Property Learning in Autonomous Microscopy
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous experimental systems are increasingly used in materials research to accelerate scientific discovery, but their performance is often limited by low-quality, noisy data. This issue is especially problematic in data-intensive structure-property learning tasks such as Image-to-Spectrum (Im2Spec) and Spectrum-to-Image (Spec2Im) translations, where standard active learning strategies can mistakenly prioritize poor-quality measurements. We introduce a gated active learning framework that combines curiosity-driven sampling with a physics-informed quality control filter based on the Simple Harmonic Oscillator model fits, allowing the system to automatically exclude low-fidelity data during acquisition. Evaluations on a pre-acquired dataset of band-excitation piezoresponse spectroscopy (BEPS) data from PbTiO3 thin films with spatially localized noise show that the proposed method outperforms random sampling, standard active learning, and multitask learning strategies. The gated approach enhances both Im2Spec and Spec2Im by handling noise during training and acquisition, leading to more reliable forward and inverse predictions. In contrast, standard active learners often misinterpret noise as uncertainty and end up acquiring bad samples that hurt performance. Given its promising applicability, we further deployed the framework in real-time experiments on BiFeO3 thin films, demonstrating its effectiveness in real autonomous microscopy experiments. Overall, this work supports a shift toward hybrid autonomy in self-driving labs, where physics-informed quality assessment and active decision-making work hand-in-hand for more reliable discovery.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于高斯过程的门控主动学习框架，结合物理信息质量控制器，用于自主显微镜中的结构-属性学习（如图像到光谱与光谱到图像转换）。在PbTiO3薄膜的预采集数据集上，该方法优于随机采样、标准主动学习和多任务学习，并在BiFeO3薄膜的实时实验中验证了有效性。
Motivation: 自主实验系统常受低质量噪声数据限制，标准主动学习可能误选噪声样本，导致性能下降。需要一种能在数据采集时自动排除低质量数据的方法。
Method: 提出门控主动学习框架，融合好奇心驱动的采样与基于简谐振子模型拟合的物理信息质量控制器，在采集阶段自动过滤低质量数据。
Result: 在预采集的压电响应光谱数据集上，该方法在图像到光谱和光谱到图像任务中均优于随机采样、标准主动学习和多任务学习；实时实验进一步验证了其在自主显微镜中的有效性。
Conclusion: 该工作支持自驱动实验室向混合自主方向发展，即物理质量评估与主动决策相结合，以实现更可靠的发现。

papers.title: Ranked Activation Shift for Post-Hoc Out-of-Distribution Detection
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art post-hoc out-of-distribution detection methods rely on intermediate layer activation editing. However, they exhibit inconsistent performance across datasets and models. We show that this instability is driven by differences in the activation distributions, and identify a failure mode of scaling-based methods that arises when penultimate layer activations are not rectified. Motivated by this analysis, we propose RAS, a hyperparameter-free post-hoc method that replaces sorted activation magnitudes with a fixed in-distribution reference profile. Our simple plug-and-play method shows strong and consistent performance across datasets and architectures without assumptions on the penultimate layer activation function, and without requiring any hyperparameter tuning, while empirically preserving in-distribution classification accuracy. We further analyze what drives the improvement, showing that both inhibiting and exciting activation shifts independently contribute to better out-of-distribution discrimination.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对现有基于中间层激活编辑的后处理分布外检测方法在不同数据集和模型上表现不一致的问题，提出了一种无需超参数的后处理方法RAS。RAS通过将排序后的激活量替换为固定的分布内参考分布，实现了跨数据集和架构的强一致性性能，同时保持分布内分类准确率。分析表明，抑制和激励激活移位的独立贡献改善了分布外判别。
Motivation: 现有后处理分布外检测方法依赖中间层激活编辑，但在不同数据集和模型上表现不稳定，且缩放方法在倒数第二层激活未矫正时存在失败模式，需要分析激活分布差异以提升鲁棒性。
Method: 提出RAS（Ranked Activation Shift），一种无需超参数的后处理方法。该方法将排序后的激活值替换为从分布内数据中预先计算的固定参考分布，替换过程不依赖于激活函数的假设，且无需调参。
Result: 在多个数据集和架构上，RAS展现了强一致性的分布外检测性能，无需超参数调优，并经验上保持了分布内分类准确率。
Conclusion: 论文强调抑制和激励激活移位的独立贡献均能提升分布外判别能力，且RAS作为即插即用模块具有实用价值。

papers.title: GUIDE: Resolving Domain Bias in GUI Agents through Real-Time Web Video Retrieval and Plug-and-Play Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Large vision-language models have endowed GUI agents with strong general capabilities for interface understanding and interaction. However, due to insufficient exposure to domain-specific software operation data during training, these agents exhibit significant domain bias - they lack familiarity with the specific operation workflows (planning) and UI element layouts (grounding) of particular applications, limiting their real-world task performance. In this paper, we present GUIDE (GUI Unbiasing via Instructional-Video Driven Expertise), a training-free, plug-and-play framework that resolves GUI agent domain bias by autonomously acquiring domain-specific expertise from web tutorial videos through a retrieval-augmented automated annotation pipeline. GUIDE introduces two key innovations. First, a subtitle-driven Video-RAG pipeline unlocks video semantics through subtitle analysis, performing progressive three-stage retrieval - domain classification, topic extraction, and relevance matching - to identify task-relevant tutorial videos. Second, a fully automated annotation pipeline built on an inverse dynamics paradigm feeds consecutive keyframes enhanced with UI element detection into VLMs, inferring the required planning and grounding knowledge that are injected into the agent's corresponding modules to address both manifestations of domain bias. Extensive experiments on OSWorld demonstrate GUIDE's generality as a plug-and-play component for both multi-agent systems and single-model agents. It consistently yields over 5% improvements and reduces execution steps - without modifying any model parameters or architecture - validating GUIDE as an architecture-agnostic enhancement to bridge GUI agent domain bias.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 30 pages: 15-page main paper followed by supplementary material as an appendix (Sections A-F). Project page: https://sharryXR.github.io/GUIDE/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GUIDE框架，通过从网络教程视频中自主获取领域专业知识，解决GUI代理在特定软件操作中的领域偏差问题。GUIDE包含字幕驱动的Video-RAG管道和基于逆动力学的自动标注管道，无需训练即可作为即插即用组件提升多智能体系统和单模型代理的性能。在OSWorld基准上，GUIDE实现了超过5%的性能提升并减少了执行步骤。
Motivation: 当前GUI代理因训练数据缺乏特定软件操作知识，存在领域偏差，影响其在真实任务中的规划和UI元素定位能力。
Method: 提出训练无关的即插即用框架GUIDE，包含两个关键创新：1）基于字幕分析的Video-RAG管道，通过领域分类、主题提取和相关性匹配渐进式检索教程视频；2）基于逆动力学的自动标注管道，利用连续关键帧和UI元素检测，从视频中推断并注入规划与定位知识。
Result: 在OSWorld基准上，GUIDE作为即插即用组件使多智能体系统和单模型代理均取得超过5%的性能提升，并减少执行步骤，且无需修改模型参数或架构。
Conclusion: GUIDE是一种架构无关的增强方法，能有效弥合GUI代理的领域偏差，验证了从视频中获取领域知识的可行性。

papers.title: The Geometry of Efficient Nonconvex Sampling
papers.abstract_en: We present an efficient algorithm for uniformly sampling from an arbitrary compact body $\mathcal{X} \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ from a warm start under isoperimetry and a natural volume growth condition. Our result provides a substantial common generalization of known results for convex bodies and star-shaped bodies. The complexity of the algorithm is polynomial in the dimension, the Poincaré constant of the uniform distribution on $\mathcal{X}$ and the volume growth constant of the set $\mathcal{X}$.

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种从任意紧致集上均匀采样的高效算法，在等周条件和体积增长条件下，算法复杂度在维度、Poincaré常数和体积增长常数上多项式。结果统一了凸体和星形体的已知采样结果。
Motivation: 非凸采样问题中，现有方法通常局限于凸体或星形体，缺乏统一高效算法。
Method: 提出一种基于等周条件和体积增长条件的采样算法，从热启动开始，复杂度多项式于相关参数。
Result: 算法适用于任意紧致集，统一了凸体和星形体的采样，复杂度在维度、Poincaré常数和体积增长常数上多项式。
Conclusion: 论文表明在适当几何条件下，非凸采样可以高效进行，并给出了复杂度界。

papers.title: LaMP: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policy with 3D Scene Flow as Latent Motion Prior
papers.abstract_en: We introduce \textbf{LaMP}, a dual-expert Vision-Language-Action framework that embeds dense 3D scene flow as a latent motion prior for robotic manipulation.Existing VLA models regress actions directly from 2D semantic visual features, forcing them to learn complex 3D physical interactions implicitly.This implicit learning strategy degrades under unfamiliar spatial dynamics.LaMP addresses this limitation by aligning a flow-matching \emph{Motion Expert} with a policy-predicting \emph{Action Expert} through gated cross-attention.Specifically, the Motion Expert generates a one-step partially denoised 3D scene flow, and its hidden states condition the Action Expert without full multi-step reconstruction.We evaluate LaMP on the LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv-WidowX simulation benchmarks as well as real-world experiments.LaMP consistently outperforms evaluated VLA baselines across LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and SimplerEnv-WidowX benchmarks, achieving the highest reported average success rates under the same training budgets. On LIBERO-Plus OOD perturbations, LaMP shows improved robustness with an average 9.7\% gain over the strongest prior baseline.Our project page is available at https://summerwxk.github.io/lamp-project-page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: LaMP是一个双专家视觉-语言-动作框架，通过将密集3D场景流作为潜在运动先验嵌入，提升机器人操作策略性能。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和SimplerEnv-WidowX仿真基准及真实实验中，LaMP以相同训练预算取得了最高平均成功率，并在LIBERO-Plus分布偏移下相比最强基线平均提升9.7%。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型直接从2D语义特征回归动作，隐式学习复杂3D物理交互，在陌生空间动态下性能退化。
Method: 提出双专家架构：运动专家通过流匹配生成一步部分去噪的3D场景流，其隐藏状态通过门控交叉注意力条件化动作专家，无需完整多步重建。
Result: 在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus和SimplerEnv-WidowX上一致优于VLA基线，达到最高平均成功率；在LIBERO-Plus分布偏移下平均提升9.7%。
Conclusion: 将3D场景流作为潜在运动先验能有效提升VLA策略的泛化性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: WAFT-Stereo: Warping-Alone Field Transforms for Stereo Matching
papers.abstract_en: We introduce WAFT-Stereo, a simple and effective warping-based method for stereo matching. WAFT-Stereo demonstrates that cost volumes, a common design used in many leading methods, are not necessary for strong performance and can be replaced by warping with improved efficiency. WAFT-Stereo ranks first on ETH3D (BP-0.5), Middlebury (RMSE), and KITTI (all metrics), reducing the zero-shot error by 81% on ETH3D, while being 1.8-6.7x faster than competitive methods. Code and model weights are available at https://github.com/princeton-vl/WAFT-Stereo.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WAFT-Stereo，一种基于warping的立体匹配方法，证明无需代价体积（cost volumes）即可达到强性能。该方法在ETH3D、Middlebury和KITTI基准上取得最高排名，零样本误差降低81%，速度提升1.8-6.7倍。
Motivation: 现有立体匹配方法普遍依赖代价体积，但代价体积计算成本高，本文探索用warping替代代价体积以提高效率。
Method: 提出WAFT-Stereo，完全基于warping操作进行立体匹配，避免显式构建代价体积。
Result: 在ETH3D (BP-0.5)、Middlebury (RMSE)和KITTI (所有指标)上排名第一，零样本误差降低81%，速度比竞争方法快1.8-6.7倍。
Conclusion: WAFT-Stereo表明warping方法可以高效地替代代价体积，实现立体匹配的强性能，同时大幅提升速度。

summary_sections.method: 提出WAFT-Stereo，完全基于warping操作进行立体匹配，避免显式构建代价体积。
summary_sections.result: 在ETH3D (BP-0.5)、Middlebury (RMSE)和KITTI (所有指标)上排名第一，零样本误差降低81%，速度比竞争方法快1.8-6.7倍。
summary_sections.conclusion: WAFT-Stereo表明warping方法可以高效地替代代价体积，实现立体匹配的强性能，同时大幅提升速度。

papers.title: SpectralSplats: Robust Differentiable Tracking via Spectral Moment Supervision
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time, photorealistic novel view synthesis, making it a highly attractive representation for model-based video tracking. However, leveraging the differentiability of the 3DGS renderer "in the wild" remains notoriously fragile. A fundamental bottleneck lies in the compact, local support of the Gaussian primitives. Standard photometric objectives implicitly rely on spatial overlap; if severe camera misalignment places the rendered object outside the target's local footprint, gradients strictly vanish, leaving the optimizer stranded. We introduce SpectralSplats, a robust tracking framework that resolves this "vanishing gradient" problem by shifting the optimization objective from the spatial to the frequency domain. By supervising the rendered image via a set of global complex sinusoidal features (Spectral Moments), we construct a global basin of attraction, ensuring that a valid, directional gradient toward the target exists across the entire image domain, even when pixel overlap is completely nonexistent. To harness this global basin without introducing periodic local minima associated with high frequencies, we derive a principled Frequency Annealing schedule from first principles, gracefully transitioning the optimizer from global convexity to precise spatial alignment. We demonstrate that SpectralSplats acts as a seamless, drop-in replacement for spatial losses across diverse deformation parameterizations (from MLPs to sparse control points), successfully recovering complex deformations even from severely misaligned initializations where standard appearance-based tracking catastrophically fails.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SpectralSplats，一种鲁棒的3D高斯溅射跟踪框架，通过将优化目标从空间域转移到频率域，利用全局复数正弦特征（谱矩）构建吸引域，解决标准光度目标因严重相机错位导致的梯度消失问题。论文还推导了频率退火调度，从全局凸性平滑过渡到精确空间对齐。实验表明，该方法在多种变形参数化下能成功恢复复杂变形，即使初始化严重错位，而标准方法则失败。
Motivation: 3D高斯溅射跟踪中，标准光度目标依赖空间重叠，当相机严重错位时，梯度完全消失，导致优化无法进行。
Method: 将优化目标从空间域转移到频率域，监督渲染图像与目标图像的全局谱矩，构建全局吸引域；并基于第一性原理推导频率退火调度，避免高频导致的周期性局部最小值。
Result: 在多种变形参数化（从MLP到稀疏控制点）下，该方法能恢复复杂变形，即使从严重错位的初始化开始，而标准外观跟踪则彻底失败。
Conclusion: SpectralSplats可作为空间损失的即插即用替代，适用于不同变形参数化，显著提升3DGS跟踪的鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: End-to-End Efficient RL for Linear Bellman Complete MDPs with Deterministic Transitions
papers.abstract_en: We study reinforcement learning (RL) with linear function approximation in Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) satisfying \emph{linear Bellman completeness} -- a fundamental setting where the Bellman backup of any linear value function remains linear. While statistically tractable, prior computationally efficient algorithms are either limited to small action spaces or require strong oracle assumptions over the feature space. We provide a computationally efficient algorithm for linear Bellman complete MDPs with \emph{deterministic transitions}, stochastic initial states, and stochastic rewards. For finite action spaces, our algorithm is end-to-end efficient; for large or infinite action spaces, we require only a standard argmax oracle over actions. Our algorithm learns an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy with sample and computational complexity polynomial in the horizon, feature dimension, and $1/\varepsilon$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究具有确定性转移、随机初始状态和随机奖励的线性Bellman完备马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中的强化学习。作者提出了一种计算高效的算法，对于有限动作空间具有端到端效率，对于大或无限动作空间仅需标准argmax oracle。该算法能够以样本和计算复杂度（关于horizon、特征维度和1/ε的多项式）学习ε-最优策略。
Motivation: 线性Bellman完备MDP是线性函数近似强化学习的基础设定，但现有计算高效算法要么限于小动作空间，要么要求强oracle假设。本文旨在克服这些限制，提供更通用的高效算法。
Method: 提出一种针对确定性转移的线性Bellman完备MDP的计算高效算法。对于有限动作空间，算法是端到端高效的；对于大或无限动作空间，仅需标准argmax oracle。
Result: 算法以关于horizon、特征维度和1/ε的多项式的样本和计算复杂度学习ε-最优策略。
Conclusion: 本文展示了在确定性转移下线性Bellman完备MDP中实现端到端计算效率的可能性，仅需标准oracle假设。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DetPO: In-Context Learning with Multi-Modal LLMs for Few-Shot Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Multi-Modal LLMs (MLLMs) demonstrate strong visual grounding capabilities on popular object detection benchmarks like OdinW-13 and RefCOCO. However, state-of-the-art models still struggle to generalize to out-of-distribution classes, tasks and imaging modalities not typically found in their pre-training. While in-context prompting is a common strategy to improve performance across diverse tasks, we find that it often yields lower detection accuracy than prompting with class names alone. This suggests that current MLLMs cannot yet effectively leverage few-shot visual examples and rich textual descriptions for object detection. Since frontier MLLMs are typically only accessible via APIs, and state-of-the-art open-weights models are prohibitively expensive to fine-tune on consumer-grade hardware, we instead explore black-box prompt optimization for few-shot object detection. To this end, we propose Detection Prompt Optimization (DetPO), a gradient-free test-time optimization approach that refines text-only prompts by maximizing detection accuracy on few-shot visual training examples while calibrating prediction confidence. Our proposed approach yields consistent improvements across generalist MLLMs on Roboflow20-VL and LVIS, outperforming prior black-box approaches by up to 9.7 mAP. Our code and optimized prompts are available at https://ggare-cmu.github.io/DetPO/
papers.comment: This work has been accepted to the European Conference on Computer Vision (ECCV) 2026. Project Page: https://ggare-cmu.github.io/DetPO/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DetPO，一种针对多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的黑盒提示优化方法，用于少样本目标检测。DetPO 在测试时通过梯度自由优化，仅优化文本提示，最大化在少样本视觉训练样本上的检测精度并校准置信度。在 Roboflow20-VL 和 LVIS 基准上，该方法一致提升通用 MLLMs 的性能，比先前黑盒方法提高最多 9.7 mAP。
Motivation: 当前 MLLMs 在少样本目标检测中，上下文提示（in-context prompting）往往比仅使用类别名称的提示精度更低，且前沿模型仅能通过 API 访问，开源模型微调成本高。因此需要一种黑盒提示优化方法提升少样本检测性能。
Method: 提出检测提示优化（DetPO），一种无需梯度的测试时优化方法，通过最大化在少样本视觉训练样本上的检测精度并校准预测置信度，来精炼仅文本提示。
Result: 在 Roboflow20-VL 和 LVIS 基准上，DetPO 在多个通用 MLLMs 上取得一致提升，相比先前黑盒方法最高提升 9.7 mAP。
Conclusion: DetPO 是一种有效的黑盒提示优化方法，能提升 MLLMs 在少样本目标检测中的泛化能力，且无需访问模型内部参数或进行昂贵微调。

papers.title: Drop-In Perceptual Optimization for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: Despite their output being ultimately consumed by human viewers, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) methods often rely on ad-hoc combinations of pixel-level losses, resulting in blurry renderings. To address this, we systematically explore perceptual optimization strategies for 3DGS by searching over a diverse set of distortion losses. We conduct the first-of-its-kind large-scale human subjective study on 3DGS, involving 39,320 pairwise ratings across several datasets and 3DGS frameworks. A regularized version of Wasserstein Distortion, which we call WD-R, emerges as the clear winner, excelling at recovering fine textures without incurring a higher splat count. WD-R is preferred by raters more than $2.3\times$ over the original 3DGS loss, and $1.5\times$ over the current best method Perceptual-GS. WD-R also consistently achieves state-of-the-art LPIPS, DISTS, and FID scores across various datasets, and generalizes across recent frameworks, such as Mip-Splatting and Scaffold-GS, where replacing the original loss with WD-R consistently enhances perceptual quality within a similar resource budget (number of splats for Mip-Splatting, model size for Scaffold-GS), and leads to reconstructions being preferred by human raters $1.8\times$ and $3.6\times$, respectively. We also find that this carries over to the task of 3DGS scene compression, with $\approx 50\%$ bitrate savings for comparable perceptual metric performance.
papers.comment: Accepted as a conference paper at ECCV'26. Project page: https://apple.github.io/ml-perceptual-3dgs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统探索3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的感知优化策略，通过大规模人类主观研究（39,320对评分）发现正则化Wasserstein Distortion（WD-R）损失在恢复精细纹理方面显著优于现有损失，且不增加splat数量。WD-R在多个数据集上取得LPIPS、DISTS、FID的SOTA，并泛化至Mip-Splatting和Scaffold-GS等框架，在人眼偏好上分别提升1.8倍和3.6倍；在3DGS场景压缩中可节省约50%码率。
Motivation: 现有3DGS方法依赖像素级损失组合导致渲染模糊，缺乏针对人类视觉感知的系统优化。
Method: 通过搜索多种失真损失进行大规模人类主观实验，提出正则化Wasserstein Distortion（WD-R）作为感知损失。
Result: WD-R在人类偏好上优于原始3DGS损失2.3倍、优于Perceptual-GS 1.5倍；在LPIPS、DISTS、FID上达到SOTA；替换Mip-Splatting和Scaffold-GS的损失后分别获得1.8倍和3.6倍的人眼偏好提升，并在场景压缩中节省约50%码率。
Conclusion: 摘要指出WD-R能在不增加资源消耗的前提下持续提升感知质量，并有效泛化至多种3DGS框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: EpiMask: Leveraging Epipolar Distance Based Masks in Cross-Attention for Satellite Image Matching
papers.abstract_en: The deep-learning based image matching networks can now handle significantly larger variations in viewpoints and illuminations while providing matched pairs of pixels with sub-pixel precision. These networks have been trained with ground-based image datasets and, implicitly, their performance is optimized for the pinhole camera geometry. Consequently, you get suboptimal performance when such networks are used to match satellite images since those images are synthesized as a moving satellite camera records one line at a time of the points on the ground. In this paper, we present EpiMask, a semi-dense image matching network for satellite images that (1) Incorporates patch-wise affine approximations to the camera modeling geometry; (2) Uses an epipolar distance-based attention mask to restrict cross-attention to geometrically plausible regions; and (3) That fine-tunes a foundational pretrained image encoder for robust feature extraction. Experiments on the SatDepth dataset demonstrate up to 30% improvement in matching accuracy compared to re-trained ground-based models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 EpiMask，一种针对卫星图像的半稠密图像匹配网络。通过引入面片级仿射相机模型、基于极线距离的注意力掩码以及微调预训练编码器，提升了卫星图像匹配的准确性。在 SatDepth 数据集上，匹配准确率相比重新训练的地面模型提升高达 30%。
Motivation: 现有基于深度学习的图像匹配网络主要针对地面图像（针孔相机几何）优化，直接用于卫星图像（线扫描成像几何）时性能次优。
Method: EpiMask 网络：(1) 采用面片级仿射近似建模相机几何；(2) 在交叉注意力中引入基于极线距离的掩码，限制注意力在几何合理区域；(3) 微调预训练的基础编码器以提取鲁棒特征。
Result: 在 SatDepth 数据集上，匹配准确率相比重新训练的地面模型提升高达 30%。
Conclusion: 论文提出的极线距离掩码与仿射相机建模有效适配卫星图像几何特性，显著提升匹配性能。

papers.title: Pretrained Video Models as Differentiable Physics Simulators for Urban Wind Flows
papers.abstract_en: Designing urban spaces that provide pedestrian wind comfort and safety requires time-resolved Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations, but their current computational cost makes extensive design exploration impractical. We introduce WinDiNet (Wind Diffusion Network), a pretrained video diffusion model that is repurposed as a fast, differentiable surrogate for this task. Starting from LTX-Video, a 2B-parameter latent video transformer, we fine-tune on 10,000 2D incompressible CFD simulations over procedurally generated building layouts. A systematic study of training regimes, conditioning mechanisms, and VAE adaptation strategies, including a physics-informed decoder loss, identifies a configuration that outperforms purpose-built neural PDE solvers. The resulting model generates full 112-frame rollouts in under a second. As the surrogate is end-to-end differentiable, it doubles as a physics simulator for gradient-based inverse optimization: given an urban footprint layout, we optimize building positions directly through backpropagation to improve wind safety as well as pedestrian wind comfort. Experiments on single- and multi-inlet layouts show that the optimizer discovers effective layouts even under challenging multi-objective configurations, with all improvements confirmed by ground-truth CFD simulations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WinDiNet，一个基于预训练视频扩散模型LTX-Video微调的可微物理模拟器，用于城市风流CFD模拟。在10000个2D不可压缩CFD数据集上微调后，模型可在1秒内生成112帧完整仿真，并利用端到端可微性通过梯度下降优化建筑布局以改善风舒适性和安全性。实验表明优化器在单/多入口布局中均能发现有效方案，经真实CFD验证。
Motivation: 传统CFD模拟计算成本高昂，难以用于城市空间设计的广泛探索，需要快速且可微的代理模型。
Method: 基于2B参数的LTX-Video视频扩散模型，通过物理信息解码器损失等策略微调，使其成为可微CFD代理，并利用其可微性进行梯度反传的逆优化。
Result: 模型生成112帧仿真耗时小于1秒，优化器在风舒适性和安全性多目标优化中有效改善建筑布局，且结果经真实CFD验证。
Conclusion: 预训练视频扩散模型可作为快速可微物理模拟器，为工程反问题提供新范式，但当前限于2D不可压缩流。

papers.title: On Optimizing Multimodal Jailbreaks for Spoken Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As Spoken Language Models (SLMs) integrate speech and text modalities, they inherit the safety vulnerabilities of their LLM backbone while introducing an expanded attack surface. SLMs have been previously shown to be susceptible to jailbreaking, where adversarial prompts induce harmful responses. Yet existing attacks largely remain unimodal, optimizing either text or audio in isolation. We explore gradient-based multimodal jailbreaks by introducing JAMA (Joint Audio-text Multimodal Attack), a joint multimodal optimization framework combining Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) for text and Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) for audio, to simultaneously perturb both modalities. Evaluations across four state-of-the-art SLMs and four audio types demonstrate that JAMA surpasses unimodal jailbreak rate by 1.5x to 20x. We analyze the operational dynamics of this joint attack and show that a sequential approximation method makes it 4x to 6x faster. Our findings suggest that unimodal safety is insufficient for robust SLMs. The code and data are available at https://repos.lsv.uni-saarland.de/akrishnan/multimodal-jailbreak-slm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 JAMA（联合文本-音频多模态攻击），一种结合文本 GCG 和音频 PGD 的梯度优化方法，用于同时扰动两种模态实现越狱。在四种口语语言模型和四种音频类型上，JAMA 超越单模态越狱率 1.5 倍至 20 倍，并利用顺序近似方法将攻击速度提升 4 至 6 倍。结果表明单模态安全不足以防御多模态越狱。
Motivation: 口语语言模型（SLM）集成语音和文本模态，继承了 LLM 的安全漏洞并扩大了攻击面，但现有越狱攻击主要针对单模态，缺乏联合优化两种模态的方法。
Method: 提出 JAMA 框架，联合使用文本的贪心坐标梯度（GCG）和音频的投影梯度下降（PGD）进行梯度优化，同时扰动文本和音频输入；并采用顺序近似方法加速计算。
Result: 在四个 SLM 和四种音频类型上，JAMA 比单模态攻击的越狱成功率提升 1.5 倍至 20 倍，顺序近似方法使攻击速度提升 4 至 6 倍。
Conclusion: 单模态安全不足以保证 SLM 的鲁棒性，需要联合考虑多模态攻击。
