papers.title: Layout-Conditioned Autoregressive Text-to-Image Generation via Structured Masking
papers.abstract_en: Although autoregressive (AR) models have demonstrated remarkable success in image generation, extending these models to layout-conditioned generation remains challenging due to the sparse nature of layout conditions and the risk of feature entanglement. We present \textbf{S}tructured \textbf{M}asking for \textbf{AR}-based \textbf{L}ayout-to-\textbf{I}mage (SMARLI), a novel framework that effectively integrates spatial layout constraints into the AR generation process. To equip AR models with layout control, a structured masking strategy is applied to the attention computation to govern the interaction among the global prompt, layout, and image tokens. This design prevents the misassociation of different regions with their corresponding descriptions while enabling the sufficient injection of layout constraints into the generation process. To alleviate the exposure bias of AR models and further enhance generation quality and layout accuracy, we incorporate a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training scheme. We adapt it to the next-set-based paradigm and introduce a specifically designed layout reward, which is coordinated with an image quality reward to guide policy optimization in a balanced manner. Experimental results demonstrate that SMARLI seamlessly integrates layout tokens with text and image tokens without compromising generation quality, and the proposed masking strategy and post-training scheme can also be transferred to standard next-token-based AR models. The proposed framework achieves superior layout control while maintaining the structural simplicity and generation efficiency of AR models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SMARLI框架，通过结构化掩码（Structured Masking）将空间布局约束集成到自回归图像生成中，并利用组相对策略优化（GRPO）后训练缓解曝光偏差，提升布局精度和生成质量。实验表明该方法在不损害生成质量的前提下实现优越的布局控制，且掩码策略和GRPO可迁移至标准自回归模型。
Motivation: 自回归模型在布局条件生成中面临布局条件稀疏和特征纠缠问题，现有方法难以有效整合空间约束。
Method: 提出结构化掩码策略，在注意力计算中控制全局提示、布局和图像令牌的交互，防止区域描述错误关联；并引入适应下一集（next-set）范式的GRPO后训练，联合布局奖励和图像质量奖励进行平衡策略优化。
Result: 实验表明SMARLI无缝集成布局令牌，在保持生成质量的同时实现更好的布局控制，且掩码和GRPO方案可迁移至标准自回归模型。
Conclusion: 所提框架在保持自回归模型结构简单性和生成效率的前提下，实现了优越的布局控制能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multipole Semantic Attention: A Fast Approximation of Softmax Attention for Pretraining
papers.abstract_en: Pretraining transformers on long sequences (entire code repositories, collections of related documents) is bottlenecked by quadratic attention costs. We present Multipole Semantic Attention (MuSe), which accelerates 64k-context pretraining by 36% while matching baseline loss, requiring no architectural changes. MuSe clusters queries and keys separately in representation space. This yields query-specific summaries that substantially outperform spatial blocking at matched sparsity, while also enabling drop-in compatibility with existing pretrained models; we validate on Llama 3.1-8B and 3.2-1B without retraining. We pretrain language models up to 1B parameters at 64k context on code and scientific documents, confirming that MuSe preserves quality and long-context utilization during training.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Multipole Semantic Attention (MuSe) 是一种快速近似 softmax 注意力的方法，用于加速长序列（64k 上下文）上的 Transformer 预训练，而不改变架构。该方法通过在表示空间中分别聚类查询和键，生成查询特定的摘要，在匹配稀疏度下优于空间分块，并与预训练模型（如 Llama 3.1-8B 和 3.2-1B）兼容。实验表明，在 1B 参数模型上，预训练速度提升 36%，同时保持质量和长上下文利用率。
Motivation: 长序列（如整个代码仓库或相关文档集合）上的 Transformer 预训练受限于二次注意力成本，需要更高效的注意力机制。
Method: 提出 Multipole Semantic Attention (MuSe)，在表示空间中分别聚类查询 (queries) 和键 (keys)，生成查询特定的摘要，实现快速近似 softmax 注意力，支持即插即用。
Result: 在 64k 上下文预训练中加速 36%，且损失与基线持平；在 Llama 3.1-8B 和 3.2-1B 上无需重新训练即可兼容；在 1B 参数代码和科学文档模型上验证了质量和长上下文保持。
Conclusion: MuSe 提供了一种高效的注意力近似方法，无需架构更改即可加速长序列预训练，并兼容现有预训练模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: The flow matching has rapidly become a dominant paradigm in classical generative modeling, offering an efficient way to interpolate between two complex distributions. We extend this idea to the quantum realm and introduce the Quantum Flow Matching (QFM), a quantum-circuit realization that offers efficient interpolation between two density matrices. QFM offers systematic preparation of density matrices and generation of samples for accurately estimating observables, and can be realized on quantum computers without the need for costly circuit redesigns. We validate its versatility on a set of applications: (i) generating target states with prescribed magnetization and entanglement entropy, (ii) estimating nonequilibrium free-energy differences to test the quantum Jarzynski equality, and (iii) expediting the study on superdiffusion. These results position QFM as a unifying and promising framework for generative modeling across quantum systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子流匹配（Quantum Flow Matching, QFM），将经典生成建模中的流匹配方法扩展到量子领域，通过量子电路实现在两个密度矩阵之间高效插值。QFM无需昂贵的电路重新设计即可在量子计算机上制备密度矩阵并生成样本，用于精确估计可观测量。在三个应用上验证了其有效性：生成具有指定磁化强度和纠缠熵的目标态、估计非平衡自由能差以检验量子Jarzynski等式、以及加速超扩散研究。
Motivation: 经典流匹配在生成建模中效果显著，但尚未被推广到量子系统。现有量子生成方法常需重新设计电路，缺乏统一高效的插值框架。
Method: 提出QFM，一种基于量子电路的流匹配方案，通过参数化量子门族实现密度矩阵之间的连续插值，无需针对不同任务重新设计电路。
Result: 在三个任务上验证：成功生成具有特定磁化强度和纠缠熵的目标态；准确估计非平衡自由能差，验证了量子Jarzynski等式；加速了超扩散现象的模拟研究。
Conclusion: QFM为量子系统中的生成建模提供了一个统一且高效的框架，有望推动量子态制备、热力学量估算及量子多体动力学的研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: L-SR1: Learned Symmetric-Rank-One Preconditioning
papers.abstract_en: End-to-end deep learning has achieved impressive results but often relies on large labeled datasets, exhibits limited generalization to unseen scenarios, and incurs substantial computational cost. Classical optimization methods, in contrast, are more data-efficient and lightweight but frequently suffer from slow convergence. Learned optimizers aim to bridge this gap, yet existing approaches have focused primarily on first-order methods, while learned second-order optimization has received much less attention. We introduce L-SR1, a learned second-order optimizer inspired by the classical Symmetric Rank-One (SR1) method. At its core, L-SR1 employs a Projection-Guided Secant Mechanism (PGSM) that generates positive semi-definite preconditioners and biases meta-training toward the quasi-Newton secant relation. Through controlled analytic benchmarks, we study stability, generalization across problem dimensions, and search direction quality, and further evaluate L-SR1 on Monocular Human Mesh Recovery (HMR), where it outperforms both classical and learned optimization-based baselines. With a compact model and no reliance on task-specific fine-tuning or annotated data, L-SR1 demonstrates strong generalization and can be integrated into a broad range of iterative optimization problems to accelerate convergence and reduce the required number of iterations.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). Project page: https://gallif.github.io/lsr1/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 L-SR1，一种受经典对称秩一（SR1）方法启发的学习型二阶优化器。其核心是投影引导割线机制（PGSM），生成半正定预处理器并偏置元训练朝向拟牛顿割线关系。在控制分析基准上研究稳定性、泛化能力和搜索方向质量，并在单目人体网格重建（HMR）任务中优于经典和学习型优化基线。
Motivation: 端到端深度学习依赖大量标注数据、泛化有限且计算成本高；经典优化方法数据高效但收敛慢。学习型优化器旨在弥合差距，但现有工作主要关注一阶方法，学习型二阶优化研究不足。
Method: L-SR1 采用投影引导割线机制（PGSM）生成半正定预处理器，并利用元学习训练偏向拟牛顿割线关系，模型紧凑且无需任务特定微调或标注数据。
Result: 在控制分析基准上验证了稳定性、跨问题维度泛化能力和搜索方向质量；在单目人体网格重建（HMR）任务中优于经典和学习型优化基线。
Conclusion: L-SR1 展现出强泛化能力，可集成到广泛的迭代优化问题中，加速收敛并减少迭代次数。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Dataset Construction for Training LLM to Learn Analog Circuit Knowledge
papers.abstract_en: This paper constructs a textual dataset for training large language models (LLMs) to learn analog circuit knowledge and customizes LLM training techniques. For dataset construction, high-quality textbooks are collected and decomposed into fine-grained learning nodes, which are then used to construct structured question-thinking-solution-answer (QTSA) quadruples using a multi-agent framework to capture both final answers and thought processes. The resulting dataset consists of 7.26M tokens of unlabeled data for continual pre-training (CPT) and 112.65M tokens of labeled data for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). We customize the training techniques including initial model selection, training paradigms, regularization techniques, and practical implementation references. Instruct models are identified as suitable training initialization points, an SFT-centric training paradigm is established (finding that CPT provides marginal benefits compared with SFT due to imbalanced data distribution), and SFT with KL divergence regularization can achieve a 2.71 percentage-point improvement over SFT alone. A practical training implementation method is provided for resource-constrained scenarios. Experiments demonstrate that the dataset and training techniques enhance LLMs' analog circuit knowledge. The trained 32B instruct model achieves 84.59% accuracy on the AMSBench-TQA benchmark, showing a 15.67 percentage-point improvement over the initial model. The trained model also shows capability in the operational amplifier design task based on the Atelier framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文构建了一个用于训练大语言模型（LLM）学习模拟电路知识的文本数据集，并定制了训练技术。数据集通过收集高质量教科书并分解为细粒度学习节点，使用多智能体框架构建结构化问题-思维-解答-答案（QTSA）四元组，包含726万无监督token和1.1265亿有监督token。训练技术包括初始模型选择、SFT为中心的训练范式，以及KL散度正则化（相比纯SFT提升2.71个百分点）。在32B指导模型上，数据集和训练技术使其在AMSBench-TQA基准上达到84.59%准确率，较初始模型提升15.67个百分点。
Motivation: 现有LLM在模拟电路知识方面缺乏专门的高质量文本数据集和定制训练技术，限制了其在该领域的应用能力。
Method: 通过收集教科书并分解为学习节点，利用多智能体框架生成结构化的QTSA四元组；采用以监督微调（SFT）为核心的训练范式，并引入KL散度正则化技术。
Result: 数据集规模为7.26M无监督token和112.65M有监督token。训练后的32B指导模型在AMSBench-TQA上准确率达84.59%，相较初始模型提升15.67个百分点；SFT+KL正则化比纯SFT提升2.71个百分点。
Conclusion: 所提出的数据集和训练技术能有效提升LLM对模拟电路知识的掌握，并提供资源受限场景下的实用实现参考。

papers.title: VGGSounder: Audio-Visual Evaluations for Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: The emergence of audio-visual foundation models underscores the importance of reliably assessing their multi-modal understanding. The VGGSound dataset is commonly used as a benchmark for evaluation audio-visual classification. However, our analysis identifies several limitations of VGGSound, including incomplete labelling, partially overlapping classes, and misaligned modalities. These lead to distorted evaluations of auditory and visual capabilities. To address these limitations, we introduce VGGSounder, a comprehensively re-annotated, multi-label test set that extends VGGSound and is specifically designed to evaluate audio-visual foundation models. VGGSounder features detailed modality annotations, enabling precise analyses of modality-specific performance. Furthermore, we reveal model limitations by analysing performance degradation when adding another input modality with our new modality confusion metric.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) 2025
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现VGGSound数据集在标注完整性、类别重叠和模态对齐方面存在缺陷，导致音频-视觉基础模型的评估失真。为此，作者提出了VGGSounder，一个经过全面重新标注的多标签测试集，并引入模态混淆指标来揭示模型在添加输入模态时的性能退化。
Motivation: 现有VGGSound数据集存在标注不完整、类别部分重叠和模态不对齐等问题，影响音频-视觉基础模型评估的可靠性。
Method: 对VGGSound测试集进行重新标注，构建多标签测试集VGGSounder，并设计模态混淆指标以分析模态特定性能。
Result: 通过详细模态标注和模态混淆指标，揭示了模型在添加另一输入模态时的性能退化。
Conclusion: VGGSounder能更准确地评估音频-视觉基础模型的多模态理解能力，并暴露现有模型的局限性。

papers.title: Physics-Constrained Fine-Tuning of Flow-Matching Models for Generation and Inverse Problems
papers.abstract_en: We present a framework for fine-tuning flow-matching generative models to enforce physical constraints and solve inverse problems in scientific systems. Starting from a model trained on low-fidelity or observational data, we apply a differentiable post-training procedure that minimizes weak-form residuals of governing partial differential equations (PDEs), promoting physical consistency and adherence to boundary conditions without distorting the underlying learned distribution. To infer unknown physical inputs, such as source terms, material parameters, or boundary data, we augment the generative process with a learnable latent parameter predictor and propose a joint optimization strategy. The resulting model produces physically valid field solutions alongside plausible estimates of hidden parameters, effectively addressing ill-posed inverse problems in a data-driven yet physicsaware manner. We validate our method on canonical PDE benchmarks, demonstrating improved satisfaction of PDE constraints and accurate recovery of latent coefficients. Our approach bridges generative modelling and scientific inference, opening new avenues for simulation-augmented discovery and data-efficient modelling of physical systems.

papers.title: Registering the 4D Millimeter Wave Radar Point Clouds Via Generalized Method of Moments
papers.abstract_en: 4D millimeter wave radars (4D radars) are new emerging sensors that provide point clouds of objects with both position and radial velocity measurements. Compared to LiDARs, they are more affordable and reliable sensors for robots' perception under extreme weather conditions. On the other hand, point cloud registration is an essential perception module that provides robot's pose feedback information in applications such as Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM). Nevertheless, the 4D radar point clouds are sparse and noisy compared to those of LiDAR, and hence we shall confront great challenges in registering the radar point clouds. To address this issue, we propose a point cloud registration framework for 4D radars based on Generalized Method of Moments. The method does not require explicit point-to-point correspondences between the source and target point clouds, which is difficult to compute for sparse 4D radar point clouds. Moreover, we show the consistency of the proposed method. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets show that our approach achieves higher accuracy and robustness than benchmarks, and the accuracy is even comparable to LiDAR-based frameworks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对4D毫米波雷达点云稀疏且噪声大的问题，提出基于广义矩方法（Generalized Method of Moments）的点云配准框架。该方法无需显式点对点对应，适用于稀疏雷达点云，并证明了其一致性。实验表明，在合成和真实数据集上，该方法精度和鲁棒性优于现有基准，甚至可与基于LiDAR的配准框架媲美。
Motivation: 4D雷达点云比LiDAR点云更稀疏、噪声更大，传统点云配准方法难以直接应用，需要一种不依赖显式对应点匹配的配准算法。
Method: 基于广义矩方法（Generalized Method of Moments）进行点云配准，通过矩匹配隐式对齐源点云和目标点云，无需建立点对点对应关系。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，所提方法在精度和鲁棒性上均优于基准方法，且精度与LiDAR框架相当。
Conclusion: 该方法为4D雷达点云配准提供了一种有效且一致的解决方案，尤其适合稀疏、噪声场景下的机器人定位与建图。

papers.title: Disentangling Reasoning Logic to Resolve Explicit Knowledge Conflicts
papers.abstract_en: Explicit knowledge conflicts, occurring when retrieved contexts contain contradictory information, pose a fundamental challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs) as they integrate increasingly diverse data sources. The core difficulty lies in the complexity of entangled narratives and heterogeneous conflict patterns, which frequently exceeds the reasoning capacity of standard backbone architectures. We propose \textbf{\textsc{Kcr}} (Knowledge Conflict Reasoning), a framework that adjudicates contradictions by systematically structuring their underlying logic. \textsc{Kcr} disentangles conflicting contexts into discrete sets of reasoning traces, utilizing a hybrid representation of text and graphs to facilitate systematic comprehension. It then employs a Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) paradigm to instill a reasoning policy that maximizes logical consistency while suppressing spurious paths derived from contradictory evidence. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that \textsc{Kcr} yields substantial performance gains. Notably, a 7B model enhanced by \textsc{Kcr} achieves adjudication capabilities that significantly outperform leading proprietary models, including GPT-4o and GPT-5.1, on complex tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/zhengxianda/KCR.

TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型在检索矛盾信息时面临的知识冲突问题，提出KCR框架。该框架通过将冲突上下文解耦为离散推理轨迹，并利用文本-图混合表示和基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）来训练推理策略，从而提升逻辑一致性。实验表明，7B模型在复杂任务上超越GPT-4o和GPT-5.1等专有模型。
Motivation: 现有大语言模型在处理检索到的矛盾信息时，由于叙事纠缠和冲突模式复杂，标准架构的推理能力不足，导致难以有效裁决知识冲突。
Method: 提出KCR框架，首先将冲突上下文解耦为离散的推理轨迹集合，采用文本和图混合表示促进系统理解；然后利用基于可验证奖励的强化学习范式训练推理策略，最大化逻辑一致性并抑制基于矛盾证据的虚假路径。
Result: 摘要报告KCR带来显著性能提升，其中7B模型在复杂任务上的裁决能力显著超越GPT-4o和GPT-5.1等领先专有模型。
Conclusion: KCR通过系统性地结构化矛盾上下文背后的逻辑，有效解决了显式知识冲突问题，为LLM处理多源异质信息提供了新范式。

papers.title: Hierarchical Message-Passing Policies for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) methods allow for learning scalable multi-agent policies, but suffer from partial observability and induced non-stationarity. These challenges can be addressed by introducing mechanisms that facilitate coordination and high-level planning. Specifically, coordination and temporal abstraction can be achieved through communication (e.g., message passing) and Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) approaches to decision-making. However, optimization issues limit the applicability of hierarchical policies to multi-agent systems. As such, the combination of these approaches has not been fully explored. To fill this void, we propose a novel and effective methodology for learning multi-agent hierarchies of message-passing policies. We adopt the feudal HRL framework and rely on a hierarchical graph structure for planning and coordination among agents. Agents at lower levels in the hierarchy receive goals from the upper levels and exchange messages with neighboring agents at the same level. To learn hierarchical multi-agent policies, we design a novel reward-assignment method based on training the lower-level policies to maximize the advantage function associated with the upper levels. Results on relevant benchmarks show that our method performs favorably compared to the state of the art.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种层次化消息传递策略用于多智能体强化学习（MARL），采用封建HRL框架和层次图结构，上层向下层设定目标，下层与同层邻居交换消息。设计了一种基于上层优势函数训练下层策略的奖励分配方法，在基准任务上表现优于现有方法。
Motivation: 分散式MARL方法面临部分可观测性和非平稳性，现有通信与层次强化学习结合不充分，优化问题限制了层次策略在多智能体系统中的应用。
Method: 提出层次化消息传递策略，采用封建HRL框架和层次图结构；下层接收上层目标并与同层邻居交换消息；设计基于上层优势函数的奖励分配方法训练下层策略。
Result: 在相关基准任务上，该方法优于现有技术。
Conclusion: 该方法有效结合了通信与层次强化学习，克服了分散式MARL的挑战，性能领先。

papers.title: LLM-Aided Joint Secrecy Precoding and Trajectory for RSMA-Based Heterogeneous UAV Networks
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates secure communications in rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) enabled heterogeneous UAV networks, where multiple UAVs collaboratively serve ground terminals in the presence of eavesdroppers. By jointly considering secrecy rate maximization and propulsion energy consumption minimization, we formulate a multi-objective optimization problem involving UAV trajectory design, service association, power allocation, and secrecy precoding under mobility, collision-avoidance, service-capacity, and communication constraints. The formulated problem is highly non-convex due to the coupling among UAV trajectories, RSMA transmission variables, and secrecy constraints. To address the resulting non-convex and highly coupled optimization problem, we propose a hierarchical optimization framework. The inner layer uses a semidefinite relaxation (SDR)-based S2DC algorithm combining penalty functions and difference-of-convex (D.C.) programming to solve the secrecy precoding problem with fixed UAV positions. The outer layer introduces a Large Language Model (LLM)-guided heuristic multi-agent reinforcement learning approach (LLM-HeMARL) for trajectory optimization. LLM-HeMARL efficiently incorporates LLM-generated expert heuristic policy, enabling UAVs to learn energy-aware, security-driven trajectories without the inference overhead of real-time LLM calls. The simulation results show that our method outperforms existing baselines in secrecy rate and energy efficiency, with consistent robustness across varying UAV swarm sizes and random seeds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究RSMA异构无人机网络中的安全通信问题，联合优化保密率与推进能耗，提出层次化优化框架：内层基于SDR的S2DC算法求解保密预编码，外层使用LLM引导的启发式多智能体强化学习（LLM-HeMARL）优化轨迹。仿真表明在保密率和能量效率上优于基线。
Motivation: 现有工作未同时考虑RSMA异构无人机网络中的保密率最大化与推进能耗最小化，且轨迹、预编码等变量高度耦合导致问题非凸。
Method: 提出层次化优化框架：内层通过SDR、惩罚函数和D.C.规划求解固定位置下的保密预编码；外层用LLM生成的专家启发式策略指导多智能体强化学习，避免实时LLM推理开销。
Result: 仿真结果表明，该方法在保密率和能量效率上优于现有基线，且对不同无人机群规模和随机种子具有鲁棒性。
Conclusion: LLM引导的启发式策略可有效优化无人机轨迹，在保证安全通信的同时降低能耗。

papers.title: When few labeled target data suffice: a theory of semi-supervised domain adaptation via fine-tuning from multiple adaptive starts
papers.abstract_en: Semi-supervised domain adaptation (SSDA) seeks to achieve accurate predictions in a target domain with limited labeled target data by exploiting abundant source and unlabeled target data. We study this problem under structural causal models (SCMs), which provide a statistical framework to describe distribution shifts between source and target domains as interventions in the data-generating process rather than ad hoc changes in model parameters. The central phenomenon is that, under low-dimensional interventions, source and unlabeled target data can help identify the high-dimensional shared structure, leaving only a low-dimensional target-specific correction to be learned from limited labeled target data. We formalize this principle for three canonical intervention models and propose the corresponding SSDA methods FT-DIP, FT-OLS-Src and FT-CIP. Under each intervention model, we demonstrate how extending an unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) method to SSDA can achieve minimax-optimal target performance with limited target labels, with the labeled-target sample complexity scaling with the intervention dimension rather than the ambient dimension. When the distribution shift is underspecified, we propose the Multi-Adaptive-Start Fine-Tuning (MASFT) algorithm, which fine-tunes from multiple adaptive starts and selects among them using a small target validation set, incurring only logarithmic overhead in the number of starts. We validate the effectiveness of our proposed methods through simulated and real data experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究半监督域适应（SSDA）问题，在结构因果模型（SCMs）框架下，证明当分布偏移由低维干预引起时，源域和未标记目标域数据可帮助识别高维共享结构，仅需少量标记目标样本学习低维目标特定校正。提出三种干预模型下的方法FT-DIP、FT-OLS-Src和FT-CIP，以及多自适应起点微调算法MASFT。理论表明标记目标样本复杂度与干预维度而非环境维度成比例，实验验证了有效性。
Motivation: 现有SSDA方法缺乏对分布偏移因果机制的理论理解，难以保证在有限标记目标样本下的性能。本文旨在利用结构因果模型形式化低维干预下的SSDA，并给出样本复杂度的最优理论边界。
Method: 基于三种典型干预模型（DIP、OLS-Src、CIP），将无监督域适应方法扩展到SSDA，并设计对应的参数估计方法；对于未指定干预模型的情况，提出MASFT算法，从多个自适应起点微调并通过少量目标验证集选择最优模型。
Result: 理论证明在低维干预假设下，标记目标样本的复杂度与干预维度同阶，而非环境维度，且所提方法达到最小最大最优性（minimax-optimal）。模拟和真实数据实验验证了方法的有效性。
Conclusion: 本文为半监督域适应提供了严格的因果理论框架，表明少量标记目标数据在低维干预下即足够。MASFT算法在干预模型不确定时仍能高效运作。局限可能在于对因果模型假设的依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conformalized Regression for Continuous Bounded Outcomes
papers.abstract_en: Regression problems with bounded continuous outcomes frequently arise in statistical and machine learning applications, such as the analysis of rates and proportions. A central challenge in this setting is predicting the response at a new covariate value. Most of the existing literature has focused either on point prediction or on interval prediction based on asymptotic approximations. We develop conformal prediction intervals for bounded outcomes within the framework of transformation regression models, encompassing widely used models such as beta regression and logit-normal regression. We construct non-conformity scores based on model-aligned residuals and identify a quantile-residual score that is particularly well suited to bounded outcomes, bridging normalized conformal prediction and distributional conformal prediction. This score accounts for both the heteroscedasticity inherent in such data and the asymmetry that emerges near the boundaries of the response space. We establish marginal validity and asymptotic conditional validity for both full and split conformal prediction, holding under model misspecification. A comprehensive simulation study confirms that both methods empirically attain valid finite-sample coverage, including cases under model misspecification. A real-data application demonstrates their practical performance against bootstrap-based alternatives.

TL;DR: 本文针对有界连续结果回归问题，提出基于变换回归模型的共形预测区间，重点设计了一种分位数残差非一致性得分，可处理异方差性和边界不对称性。理论证明边际有效性和渐近条件有效性，模拟和实际数据验证了有限样本覆盖性能。

Conclusion: 该方法为有界连续结果的回归预测提供了有效的共形推断工具，且对模型误设定具有鲁棒性。

papers.title: Robust 3D-Masked Part-level Editing in 3D Gaussian Splatting with Regularized Score Distillation Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in 3D neural representations and instance-level editing models have enabled the efficient creation of high-quality 3D content. However, achieving precise local 3D edits remains challenging, especially for Gaussian Splatting, due to inconsistent multi-view 2D part segmentations and inherently ambiguous nature of Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) loss. To address these limitations, we propose RoMaP, a novel local 3D Gaussian editing framework that enables precise and drastic part-level modifications. First, we introduce a robust 3D mask generation module with our 3D-Geometry Aware Label Prediction (3D-GALP), which uses spherical harmonics (SH) coefficients to model view-dependent label variations and soft-label property, yielding accurate and consistent part segmentations across viewpoints. Second, we propose a regularized SDS loss that combines the standard SDS loss with additional regularizers. In particular, an L1 anchor loss is introduced via our Scheduled Latent Mixing and Part (SLaMP) editing method, which generates high-quality part-edited 2D images and confines modifications only to the target region while preserving contextual coherence. Additional regularizers, such as Gaussian prior removal, further improve flexibility by allowing changes beyond the existing context, and robust 3D masking prevents unintended edits. Experimental results demonstrate that our RoMaP achieves state-of-the-art local 3D editing on both reconstructed and generated Gaussian scenes and objects qualitatively and quantitatively, making it possible for more robust and flexible part-level 3D Gaussian editing. Code is available at https://janeyeon.github.io/romap.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出RoMaP框架，用于3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）的局部部件级编辑。通过3D-GALP生成鲁棒的3D掩码，以及正则化SDS损失（含SLaMP编辑和L1锚点损失），实现精确且剧烈的局部编辑，避免多视图不一致和SD损失模糊问题。实验在重建和生成的场景/物体上均达到SOTA。
Motivation: 现有局部3D编辑方法在多视图2D分割不一致和SDS损失固有歧义下效果不佳，尤其对高斯泼溅表示难以实现精确局部修改。
Method: 提出3D-GALP（利用球谐系数建模视图依赖标签变化和软标签属性）生成一致部件分割掩码；提出正则化SDS损失，结合标准SDS和L1锚点损失（通过SLaMP编辑生成高质量部件编辑2D图像），以及高斯先验移除等正则项，配合鲁棒3D掩码防止意外编辑。
Result: 在重建和生成的高斯场景/物体上，RoMaP在定性和定量上均达到局部3D编辑的SOTA。
Conclusion: RoMaP实现了更鲁棒和灵活的部件级3D高斯编辑，代码已开源。

papers.title: Reasoning in machine vision by learning fast and slow thinking
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning is a hallmark of human intelligence, enabling adaptive decision-making in complex unfamiliar scenarios. In contrast, machine intelligence remains bound to training data, unable to dynamically refine solutions at inference. While recent advances have explored machine reasoning - trading inference-time compute for improved performance - they focus on verbal domains such as mathematical problem-solving where explicit rules govern step-by-step solution generation. Many tasks lack sufficient labelled data and require alternative performance improvement mechanisms, such as inference-time compute. Here we present a paradigm for machine reasoning in vision, enabling performance improvements with increasing thinking time (inference-time compute), even with limited labelled data. Our approach is inspired by dual-process theories of human cognition, integrating a fast-thinking System I module for generating and verifying solutions in familiar tasks, with a slow-thinking System II module that iteratively refines predictions using self-play reinforcement learning, even when task-specific data is limited. This paradigm involves proposing, competing over, and refining solutions until convergence. We demonstrate that extended inference-time compute yields superior performance compared to large-scale supervised learning, foundation models, and human experts in vision tasks. These include computer-vision benchmarks and cancer localisation across five organs, highlighting the potential of inference-time compute for data-scarce problems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种受人类认知双系统理论启发的机器视觉推理范式，将快速直觉系统(System I)与慢速分析系统(System II)结合，通过自博弈强化学习在推理阶段逐步优化预测。实验表明，在有限标注数据下，增加推理时间计算能在计算机视觉基准和五器官癌症定位任务上超越大规模监督学习、基础模型和人类专家。
Motivation: 现有机器智能缺乏在推理阶段动态优化解决方案的能力，尤其是对于标注数据稀缺的视觉任务。作者希望利用推理时间计算来提升性能，摆脱对大量标注数据的依赖。
Method: 受双重过程理论启发，设计快速思考系统I用于快速生成和验证解决方案，以及慢速思考系统II通过自博弈强化学习迭代精化预测，直到收敛。该范式涉及提出、竞争和修正解决方案。
Result: 在计算机视觉基准和跨五个器官的癌症定位任务上，扩展推理时间计算相比大规模监督学习、基础模型和人类专家获得了更优性能。
Conclusion: 该工作突出了推理时间计算在数据稀缺问题中的潜力，为视觉任务提供了一种无需大量标注数据的性能提升机制。

papers.title: Step-by-Step Video-to-Audio Synthesis via Negative Audio Guidance
papers.abstract_en: We propose a step-by-step video-to-audio (V2A) generation method that provides finer control over the generation process and more realistic audio synthesis. Inspired by traditional Foley workflows, our approach enables incremental generation of complementary sounds, allowing users to author multiple sound events induced by a video. To avoid the need for costly multi-reference video-audio datasets, each generation step is formulated as a negatively guided V2A process that discourages duplication of sounds already present in previously generated tracks. The guidance model is trained by finetuning a pre-trained V2A model on audio pairs from non-overlapping segments of the same video, encouraging it to leverage acoustic context while remaining visually grounded, and enabling training with standard single-reference audiovisual datasets. Objective and subjective evaluations demonstrate that our method enhances the separability of generated sounds at each step and improves the overall quality of the final composite audio, outperforming existing baselines. Our project page is available at: https://ahykw.github.io/sbsv2a/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种逐步生成视频对应音频的方法，受传统 Foley 工作流程启发，通过负音频引导避免重复已生成的音轨，从而支持多个声音事件的增量合成。方法基于预训练的 V2A 模型微调，在标准单参考视听数据集上训练，客观和主观评价显示生成声音的可分离性和整体音频质量优于基线。
Motivation: 现有视频到音频生成缺乏对多个声音事件的细粒度控制，难以逐步添加互补声音，且需要昂贵的多参考视听数据集。
Method: 基于负音频引导的逐步 V2A 生成，通过微调预训练 V2A 模型使其在非重叠音频对上学习声学上下文和视觉基础，从而避免声音重复。
Result: 客观和主观评价表明，该方法增强了每一步生成声音的可分离性，并提高了最终合成音频的整体质量，优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 该方法实现了类似 Foley 的增量音频合成，无需多参考数据集，并提升了音轨合成质量。

papers.title: From Multimodal Perception to Strategic Reasoning: A Survey on AI-Generated Game Commentary
papers.abstract_en: The advent of artificial intelligence has propelled AI-Generated Game Commentary (AI-GGC) into a rapidly expanding research area, offering advantages such as scalable availability and personalized narration. However, existing studies remain fragmented, and a systematic survey that unifies prior efforts is still lacking. To bridge this gap, our survey introduces a unified framework that systematically organizes the AI-GGC landscape. We present a novel taxonomy focused on three core commentator capabilities: Live Observation, Strategic Analysis, and Historical Recall, and further categorize commentary into three corresponding types: Descriptive Commentary, Analytical Commentary, and Background Commentary. Building on this structure, we provide an in-depth review of methods, datasets, and evaluation metrics, analyzing their strengths and limitations. Finally, we highlight key challenges and point out promising directions for future research in AI-GGC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一框架系统梳理AI生成游戏评论（AI-GGC）的研究领域，包括三种核心评论能力（实时观察、战略分析、历史回忆）和三种评论类型（描述性、分析性、背景评论），并对方法、数据集和评估指标进行了综述。

papers.title: MetricHMSR:Metric Human Mesh and Scene Recovery from Monocular Images
papers.abstract_en: We introduce MetricHMSR, a novel framework for recovering metric human meshes and 3D scenes from a single monocular image. Existing methods struggle to recover metric scale due to monocular scale ambiguity and weak-perspective camera assumptions. Moreover, their fully coupled feature representations make it difficult to disentangle local pose from global translation, often requiring multi-stage pipelines that introduce accumulated errors. To address these challenges, we propose MetricHMR (Metric Human Mesh Recovery), which incorporates a bounding camera ray map representation to provide explicit metric cues for human reconstruction,together with a Human Mixture-of-Experts (HumanMoE) that dynamically routes image features to specialized experts, enabling the disentangled perception of local human pose and global metric position. Leveraging the recovered metric human as a geometric anchor, we further refine monocular metric depth estimation to achieve more accurate 3D alignment between humans and scenes.Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both human mesh recovery and metric human-scene reconstruction. Project Page: https://Metaverse-AI-Lab-THU.github.io/MetricHMSR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MetricHMSR框架，从单目图像恢复度量级人体网格和3D场景。通过引入有界相机射线图表示提供度量线索，并设计人体专家混合模型（HumanMoE）解耦局部姿态和全局位置，再利用恢复的人体作为几何锚点优化深度估计，实现精确的人-场景3D对齐。实验表明该方法在人体网格恢复和度量人-场景重建任务上达到当前最优。
Motivation: 现有方法因单目尺度模糊和弱透视相机假设难以恢复度量尺度，且耦合的特征表示难以解耦局部位姿与全局平移，多阶段管线易累积误差。
Method: 提出MetricHMSR，包含MetricHMR（有界相机射线图+HumanMoE动态路由特征到专门专家）和基于度量人体的单目深度细化模块。
Result: 在人体网格恢复和度量人-场景重建上达到最先进性能。
Conclusion: 该框架通过显式度量线索和解耦特征设计有效恢复度量尺度，并利用人体几何锚点提升场景对齐精度。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Private Rate-Constrained Optimization with Applications to Fair Learning
papers.abstract_en: Many problems in trustworthy ML can be expressed as constraints on prediction rates across subpopulations, including group fairness constraints (demographic parity, equalized odds, etc.). In this work, we study such constrained minimization problems under differential privacy (DP). Standard DP optimization techniques like DP-SGD rely on objectives that decompose over individual examples, enabling per-example gradient clipping and noise addition. Rate constraints, however, depend on aggregate statistics across groups, creating inter-sample dependencies that violate this decomposability. To address this, we develop RaCO-DP, a DP variant of Stochastic Gradient Descent-Ascent (SGDA) that solves the Lagrangian formulation of rate constraint problems. Through careful design, the extra privacy cost incurred by incorporating these constraints in our approach is limited to that of privately estimating a histogram over each mini-batch at every step. We prove the convergence of our algorithm through a novel analysis of SGDA that leverages the linear structure of the dual parameter. Empirical results show that our method Pareto-dominates existing private learning approaches under group fairness constraints and also achieves strong privacy-utility-fairness performance on neural networks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 RaCO-DP，一种差分隐私下的随机梯度下降-上升 (SGDA) 变体，用于解决带有率约束（如群体公平约束）的优化问题。通过拉格朗日对偶形式，将约束的额外隐私代价限制为每步对每个小批量的直方图私有估计。理论证明算法收敛，实验表明在群体公平约束下帕累托优于现有私有学习方法，并在神经网络上实现强隐私-效用-公平权衡。
Motivation: 标准 DP 优化方法（如 DP-SGD）要求目标函数在单个样本上可分解，而率约束（如人口平等、均等化几率）依赖于跨子群的聚合统计，引入样本间依赖，破坏了可分解性。
Method: 开发 RaCO-DP，一种 DP 版本的 SGDA，求解率约束问题的拉格朗日形式。通过精心设计，将约束引入带来的额外隐私成本限制为每步对每个小批量进行直方图的私有估计。
Result: 经验结果显示，该方法在群体公平约束下帕累托支配现有的私有学习方法，并在神经网络上实现了强隐私-效用-公平性能。

papers.title: Improved Immiscible Diffusion: Accelerate Diffusion Training by Reducing Its Miscibility
papers.abstract_en: The substantial training cost of diffusion models hinders their deployment. Immiscible Diffusion recently showed that reducing diffusion trajectory mixing in the noise space via linear assignment accelerates training by simplifying denoising. To extend immiscible diffusion beyond the inefficient linear assignment under high batch sizes and high dimensions, we refine this concept to a broader miscibility reduction at any layer and by any implementation. Specifically, we empirically demonstrate the bijective nature of the denoising process with respect to immiscible diffusion, ensuring its preservation of generative diversity. Moreover, we provide thorough analysis and show step-by-step how immiscibility eases denoising and improves efficiency. Extending beyond linear assignment, we propose a family of implementations including K-nearest neighbor (KNN) noise selection and image scaling to reduce miscibility, achieving up to >4x faster training across diverse models and tasks including unconditional/conditional generation, image editing, and robotics planning. Furthermore, our analysis of immiscibility offers a novel perspective on how optimal transport (OT) enhances diffusion training. By identifying trajectory miscibility as a fundamental bottleneck, we believe this work establishes a potentially new direction for future research into high-efficiency diffusion training. The code is available at https://github.com/yhli123/Immiscible-Diffusion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出改进的“不混溶扩散”方法，通过降低扩散轨迹的混溶性来加速扩散模型训练。在继承原工作线性分配的基础上，作者将其推广到任意层的混溶性降低，并提出K近邻噪声选择和图像缩放等实现，实现高达4倍以上的训练加速，适用于无条件/条件生成、图像编辑和机器人规划等任务。此外，文章还分析了不混溶性如何简化去噪过程，并从轨迹混溶性的角度为最优传输提升扩散训练提供了新视角。
Motivation: 扩散模型训练成本高，原不混溶扩散通过线性分配降低噪声空间中的轨迹混合以加速训练，但线性分配在高批次大小和高维下效率低下，需要更通用的方法。
Method: 将混溶性降低从线性分配推广到任意层和任意实现，提出一系列实现包括K近邻(KNN)噪声选择和图像缩放，并证明去噪过程的双射性质保证了生成多样性。
Result: 在多种模型和任务（无条件/条件生成、图像编辑、机器人规划）中实现高达4倍以上的训练加速，且不损失生成质量。
Conclusion: 轨迹混溶性是扩散训练效率的根本瓶颈，降低混溶性可显著加速训练，为高效扩散训练提供了新方向。

papers.title: A Reproducible Benchmark of Lightweight CNNs: Accuracy, Efficiency, and the Impact of Pretrained Initialization
papers.abstract_en: Lightweight convolutional neural networks are often compared using results obtained with different training recipes, input settings, and pretrained checkpoints. Such differences make architecture rankings difficult to interpret. This study presents a reproducible benchmark of seven established CNNs across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny ImageNet under one common fine-tuning protocol. The evaluation reports top-1 accuracy, macro F1, top-5 accuracy, parameter count, FP32 parameter storage, and multiply-accumulate operations. EfficientNetV2-S records the highest observed top-1 accuracy on all three datasets, reaching 97.57%, 86.98%, and 78.73%. EfficientNet-B0 remains within 0.85 percentage points of EfficientNetV2-S across the three datasets while requiring only about 21% of its parameters and 14% of its multiply-accumulate operations on Tiny ImageNet. It therefore offers a favorable general balance between predictive performance and computational demand. MobileNetV3-Small is a strong candidate for ultra-low-resource settings. It uses about 40% of the parameters and 15% of the multiply-accumulate operations of EfficientNet-B0 while retaining competitive accuracy. A matched comparison of ImageNet-pretrained and randomly initialized EfficientNet-B0 and MobileNetV3-Small models shows that the pretrained advantage is substantially larger on CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet than on CIFAR-10 under the fixed protocol. The results provide a focused reference for selecting established lightweight CNNs when predictive quality, parameter storage, and theoretical computation must be considered together.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过统一的微调协议，在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet上可重复地评测了七种轻量级卷积神经网络（包括EfficientNetV2-S、EfficientNet-B0、MobileNetV3-Small等），报告了top-1准确率、宏F1、top-5准确率、参数量、FP32参数存储和乘加操作数。EfficientNetV2-S在所有三个数据集上取得了最高的top-1准确率（分别为97.57%、86.98%、78.73%），而EfficientNet-B0在保持接近性能的同时仅需约21%的参数和14%的乘加操作数（Tiny ImageNet上），提供了预测性能与计算需求之间的良好平衡。MobileNetV3-Small在超低资源场景下具有竞争力。此外，在固定协议下，使用ImageNet预训练相比随机初始化的优势在CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet上远大于CIFAR-10。
Motivation: 轻量级CNN之间常因训练配方、输入设置和预训练检查点的不同而难以比较，导致架构排名不清晰。本文旨在提供一个统一的、可重复的基准，以公平比较这些网络。
Method: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet上，采用相同的微调协议，对七种轻量级CNN进行评测，并报告多项指标。同时比较了ImageNet预训练和随机初始化对EfficientNet-B0和MobileNetV3-Small的影响。
Result: EfficientNetV2-S在三个数据集上取得最高top-1准确率（97.57%、86.98%、78.73%）。EfficientNet-B0的性能差距在0.85个百分点以内，但参数量仅为EfficientNetV2-S的21%左右，乘加操作数为14%（Tiny ImageNet）。MobileNetV3-Small使用约40%参数和15%乘加操作数即达到竞争性准确率。预训练优势在CIFAR-100和Tiny ImageNet上比CIFAR-10上大得多。
Conclusion: 本文为在综合考虑预测质量、参数存储和理论计算时选择轻量级CNN提供了聚焦的参考基准。

papers.title: Tailored minimal reservoir computing: on the bidirectional connection between nonlinearities in the reservoir and in data
papers.abstract_en: We study how the degree of nonlinearity in the input data affects the optimal design of reservoir computers, focusing on how closely the model's nonlinearity should align with that of the data. By reducing minimal RCs to a single tunable nonlinearity parameter, we explore how the predictive performance varies with the degree of nonlinearity in the reservoir. To provide controlled testbeds, we generalize to the fractional Halvorsen system, a novel chaotic system with fractional exponents. Our experiments reveal that the prediction performance is maximized when the reservoir's nonlinearity matches the nonlinearity present in the data. In cases where multiple nonlinearities are present in the data, we find that the correlation dimension of the predicted signal is reconstructed correctly when the smallest nonlinearity is matched. We use this observation to propose a method for estimating the minimal nonlinearity in unknown time series by sweeping the reservoir exponent and identifying the transition to a successful reconstruction. Applying this method to both synthetic and real-world datasets, including financial time series, we demonstrate its practical viability. Finally, we transfer these insights to classical RC by augmenting traditional architectures with fractional, generalized reservoir states. This yields performance gains, particularly in resource-constrained scenarios such as physical reservoirs, where increasing reservoir size is impractical or economically unviable. Our work provides a principled route toward tailoring RCs to the intrinsic complexity of the systems they aim to model.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究储层计算中非线性程度与数据非线性程度的匹配关系，通过将最小储层计算简化为单一可调非线性参数，利用分数阶Halvorsen系统作为可控测试平台，发现预测性能在储层非线性匹配数据非线性时最优。当数据包含多种非线性时，匹配最小非线性可正确重建相关维数。基于此提出一种通过扫描储层指数估计未知时间序列最小非线性的方法，并在合成和真实金融数据上验证。最后将洞察迁移到经典储层计算，通过引入分数阶广义储层状态提升资源受限场景下的性能。
Motivation: 现有储层计算设计缺乏引导原则，未考虑数据非线性程度对最优模型配置的影响，导致资源浪费或性能欠佳。
Method: 将储层计算缩减至单一可调非线性参数，利用分数阶Halvorsen系统生成不同非线性度的混沌数据，系统扫描储层指数并评估预测精度，基于相关维数重建提出估计最小非线性的方法。
Result: 实验表明储层非线性与数据非线性匹配时预测性能最优；数据含多种非线性时，匹配最小非线性可正确重建信号的相关维数；估计方法在合成和金融时间序列上有效；经典储层计算中引入分数阶状态可提升资源受限场景下的性能。
Conclusion: 提供了根据数据内在非线性定制储层计算的原则性方法，尤其适用于物理储层等资源受限场景。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: TraCeS: Learning Per-Timestep Constraint-Violation Credit from Sparse Trajectory-Level Labels
papers.abstract_en: Ensuring safe behavior in reinforcement learning (RL) is challenging when safety constraints are implicit and cannot be densely measured. In many settings, supervision is limited to coarse approvals or rejections of whole trajectories (e.g., whether a rollout remained within an unknown safety threshold). We propose TraCeS (Trajectory-based Constraint Estimation for Safety), a method for learning per-timestep violation credit from such sparse trajectory-level labels. TraCeS trains a sequential violation estimator whose per-step credits factorize the predicted probability that a trajectory has not yet violated the constraint, and integrates this learned signal into constrained policy optimization. The method requires neither a known cost function nor a known threshold, and remains compatible with standard continuous-control algorithms. We provide a theoretical analysis of the approximation gap introduced by the learning objective, and demonstrate empirically that TraCeS improves constraint satisfaction and feedback efficiency over baselines across multiple continuous-control benchmarks, including long-horizon tasks and settings with noisy or inconsistent labels.
papers.comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Code available at https://github.com/siowmeng/TraCeS
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: TraCeS 提出一种从稀疏轨迹级标签（如整条轨迹是否违反安全约束）中学习每个时间步约束违反信用分配的方法。该方法训练一个序列化违反估计器，其逐步信用分解轨迹尚未违反约束的预测概率，并将该学习信号集成到约束策略优化中。实验表明，TraCeS 在多个连续控制基准上提高了约束满足度和反馈效率，包括长视界任务和噪声/不一致标签场景。
Motivation: 安全强化学习中，安全约束往往隐式且无法密集测量，监督信号仅为整条轨迹的粗粒度批准或拒绝（例如，轨迹是否超限）。现有方法依赖已知成本函数或阈值，但在许多实际场景中这些信息不可得。
Method: TraCeS 训练一个序列违反估计器，其逐步信用因子分解轨迹尚未违反约束的预测概率，并将该学习信号用于约束策略优化。方法无需已知成本函数或阈值，兼容标准连续控制算法，并提供理论上的近似间隙分析。
Result: 在多个连续控制基准上，TraCeS 相比基线提升了约束满足度和反馈效率，尤其是在长视界任务和标签噪声/不一致性场景中有效。
Conclusion: TraCeS 提供了一种从稀疏轨迹级标签学习密集约束违反信号的有效方案，无需预先定义成本或阈值，并开源代码。

papers.title: SAGE: A Search-AuGmented Evaluation of Large Language Models on Free-Form QA
papers.abstract_en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly used for question-answering (QA), relying on static, pre-annotated references for evaluation poses significant challenges in cost, scalability, and completeness. Meanwhile, using LLMs themselves as evaluators without external grounding remains unreliable for objective tasks, as they systematically over-accept incorrect answers, fabricate supporting rationales, and degrade sharply on questions that fall outside their training data. We propose Search-AuGmented Evaluation (SAGE), a framework to assess LLM outputs without fixed ground-truth answers. Unlike conventional metrics that compare to static references or depend solely on LLM-as-a-judge knowledge, SAGE acts as an agent that actively retrieves and synthesizes external evidence. It iteratively generates web queries, collects information, summarizes findings, and refines subsequent searches through reflection. By reducing dependence on static reference-driven evaluation protocols, SAGE offers a scalable and adaptive alternative for evaluating the factuality of LLMs. Experimental results on multiple free-form QA benchmarks show that SAGE achieves substantial to perfect agreement with human evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出搜索增强评估（SAGE）框架，用于评估大语言模型在自由形式问答中的输出事实性，无需固定参考答案。SAGE通过迭代检索和综合外部证据，生成网页查询、收集信息、总结发现并反思细化搜索，在多个自由形式问答基准上实现了与人类评估高度一致的结果。
Motivation: 现有LLM评估依赖静态标注参考答案，成本高、扩展性差且不完整；而直接用LLM作为评估者缺乏外部依据，容易过度接受错误答案并编造支持理由，尤其在训练数据外的问题上表现急剧下降。
Method: 提出搜索增强评估（SAGE）框架，作为代理主动检索和综合外部证据，迭代生成网页查询、收集信息、总结结果并通过反思细化后续搜索，减少对静态参考评估协议的依赖。
Result: 在多个自由形式问答基准上，SAGE与人类评估实现了从实质性到完美的一致性。
Conclusion: SAGE提供了一种可扩展且自适应的替代方案，用于评估LLM的事实性，摆脱了固定参考答案的限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gulf Stream contribution to recent North Pacific warming
papers.abstract_en: Recent unprecedented ocean warming has produced coherent sea surface temperature (SST) anomalies across the Northern Hemisphere extratropics. While the tropical Pacific is a natural source of North Pacific variability, the influence of the midlatitude North Atlantic has remained poorly understood. Here we show that Gulf Stream SST variability remotely modulates Kuroshio variability, explaining 13% of internal Kuroshio SST variance in climate model simulations, with no significant reverse influence. Positive Gulf Stream SST anomalies excite a Northern Annular Mode (NAM)-like atmospheric circulation response, weakening the Aleutian Low over the North Pacific. The resulting northward shift of the Kuroshio Extension enhances northward warm-water transport and favors positive SST anomalies in the western midlatitude North Pacific. We also show that a high-resolution ocean model is required to properly capture this SST-NAM coupling, suggesting the importance of representations of western boundary currents and associated SST fronts for this interbasin pathway. These findings reveal the Gulf Stream-Kuroshio linkage through which North Atlantic variability has measurably contributed to the recent exceptional North Pacific warming, implying a previously underrecognized source of decadal climate predictability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该研究通过气候模式模拟发现，湾流海表温度异常能远程调制黑潮变率，解释黑潮内部SST方差的13%；湾流增暖激发类似北半球环状模（NAM）的大气响应，削弱阿留申低压，使黑潮延伸体北移并增强暖水输送，导致北太平洋中纬度西部SST正异常。研究强调高分辨率海洋模式对捕捉这种SST-NAM耦合的必要性，揭示了北大西洋变率对近期北太平洋异常增暖的可测量贡献。
Motivation: 北大西洋中纬度对北太平洋变率的影响尚不明确，尤其是湾流-黑潮的联系未被充分认识。
Method: 使用气候模式模拟和耦合分析，包括高低分辨率海洋模式的对比实验，分析湾流SST异常通过大气环流（NAM）远程影响黑潮的机制。
Result: 湾流SST异常可解释黑潮内部SST方差的13%；湾流增暖导致阿留申低压减弱，黑潮延伸体北移，引起北太平洋西部增暖。高分辨率海洋模式才能正确再现这一耦合。
Conclusion: 北大西洋变率通过湾流-黑潮链接对北太平洋近期增暖有显著贡献，这为年代际气候可预测性提供了此前被低估的来源。

papers.title: Artificial Intelligence in Sports: Insights from a Quantitative Survey among Sports Students in Germany about their Perceptions, Expectations, and Concerns regarding the Use of AI Tools
papers.abstract_en: Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or Gemini have a crucial impact on academic research and teaching. Empirical data on how students perceive the increasing influence of AI, which different types of tools they use, what they expect from them in their daily academic tasks, and their concerns regarding the use of AI in their studies are still limited. The manuscript presents findings from a quantitative survey conducted among sports students of all semesters in Germany using an online questionnaire. It explores aspects such as students' usage behavior, motivational factors, and uncertainties regarding the impact of AI tools on academia in the future. Furthermore, the social climate in sports studies is being investigated to provide a general overview of the current situation of the students in Germany. Data collection took place between August and November 2023, addressing all sports departments at German universities, with a total of 262 students participating. Our Findings indicate that students have a strong interest in using AI tools in their studies, expecting them to improve their overall academic performance, understand the complexity of scientific approaches, and save time. They express confidence that the proliferation of AI will not compromise their critical thinking skills. Moreover, students are positive about integrating more AI-related topics into the curriculum and about lecturers adopting more AI-based teaching methods. However, our findings also show that students have concerns about plagiarism, lecturer preparedness and their own skills and future skill development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于2023年对德国262名体育学生的问卷调查，分析他们对生成式AI工具（如ChatGPT、Copilot、Gemini）在学业中的使用行为、期望和担忧。结果显示学生普遍愿意使用AI以提高学术表现和节省时间，并认为AI不会损害批判性思维，但存在对抄袭、教师准备度和自身技能发展的担忧。
Motivation: 关于学生对AI工具如何影响学术研究的具体感知、使用类型、期望和担忧的实证数据仍然有限，尤其是针对体育专业学生群体。
Method: 采用在线问卷形式，于2023年8月至11月对德国所有大学体育系的学生进行定量调查，最终收集262份有效问卷，分析使用行为、动机因素以及对AI未来影响的看法。
Result: 学生强烈希望使用AI工具提升学业表现，理解科学方法复杂性并节省时间；相信AI不会削弱批判性思维；支持课程中增加AI相关内容和教师采用AI教学法；但同时对抄袭、教师准备度和自身技能发展存在担忧。
Conclusion: 研究提供了德国体育学生对AI工具的态度概览，指出积极态度与具体担忧并存，对学术机构在教学中整合AI具有参考价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Compositional Concept-Based Neuron-Level Interpretability for Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has successfully addressed many complex control problems. However, the neural networks representing policies or values remain opaque, undermining trust in high-stakes applications. While concept-based methods have shown promise in deciphering internal representations in computer vision, applying them to DRL is impeded by the absence of pre-defined semantic concepts in continuous state spaces. In this work, we propose a novel concept-based explanation framework designed to provide fine-grained, neuron-level insights into DRL models. Unlike previous approaches that rely on manual feature engineering, our framework automatically aligns neuron activations with logical formulas composed of semantic predicates. To bridge the gap between continuous signals and symbolic reasoning, we introduce a value-sensitive discretization mechanism that transforms raw state features into interpretable atomic concepts. This ensures that the vocabulary used for explanation captures strategic decision boundaries relevant to the agent's value assessment. By composing these interpretable concepts and matching them with neuron behaviors, we derive explicit explanations for the network's internal representations. Experimental results on both continuous and discrete environments demonstrate that our method effectively identifies meaningful decision-making patterns, offering faithful explanations that align with human intuition.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于概念组合的神经元级可解释性框架，用于深度强化学习（DRL）模型。该框架自动将神经元激活与由语义谓词组成的逻辑公式对齐，通过值敏感离散化机制将连续状态特征转换为可解释的原子概念，从而提供细粒度解释。实验在连续和离散环境中验证了该方法能有效识别有意义的决策模式，并提供符合人类直觉的忠实解释。
Motivation: 深度强化学习的神经网络策略或价值函数缺乏透明度，阻碍了高风险应用中的信任。现有概念可解释性方法多用于计算机视觉，但DRL的连续状态空间缺乏预定义语义概念，难以直接应用。
Method: 提出一个基于概念组合的框架：首先通过值敏感离散化将连续状态特征转换为可解释的原子概念，然后将这些概念与神经元激活自动对齐，形成逻辑公式，从而导出网络内部表示的显式解释。
Result: 在连续和离散环境中的实验表明，该方法能有效识别有意义的决策模式，解释忠实性符合人类直觉。
Conclusion: 该框架为DRL提供了神经元级别的细粒度可解释性，但所提概念基于原子谓词组合，可能无法覆盖复杂任务中的所有语义关系。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Filterless Snapshot Hyperspectral Imaging using Guided Patch Diffusion
papers.abstract_en: We consider the problem of reconstructing a HxWx31 hyperspectral image from a $H\times W$ grayscale snapshot measurement that is captured using only a single diffractive lens and a filterless panchromatic photosensor. This problem is severely ill-posed, but we present a model that produces high-quality results in simulation and experiment. We make efficient use of limited training data by creating a conditional denoising diffusion model that operates on small patches in a shift-invariant manner. During inference, we synchronize per-patch hyperspectral predictions using guidance by physical consistency with the system's optical point spread function. Our experiments reveal that the patch size can be as small as the point spread function, with local optical cues being the main source of information about complete spectra. Also, by drawing multiple samples, our model provides per-pixel uncertainty estimates that strongly correlate with reconstruction error.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种方法从HxW灰度快照测量（仅用单个衍射透镜和无滤光片全色传感器）重建HxWx31高光谱图像。通过条件去噪扩散模型在shift-invariant小patch上操作，并利用系统光学点扩散函数的物理一致性进行指导。实验表明patch可小至PSF，局部光学线索是完整光谱的主要信息来源，且多采样提供与重建误差强相关的不确定性估计。
Motivation: 快照高光谱成像通常需要滤光片或色散元件，本文探索仅用衍射透镜和无滤光片传感器的极端简化设置，但重建严重病态，需要强大先验。
Method: 构建条件去噪扩散模型，在shift-invariant小patch上训练，推理时使用系统光学点扩散函数的物理一致性同步每个patch的高光谱预测。
Result: 在模拟和实验中实现高质量重建；patch size可小至点扩散函数；多采样提供与重建误差强相关的不确定性估计。
Conclusion: 本文证明了在无滤光片快照高光谱成像中，局部光学线索足以提供完整光谱信息，且扩散模型结合物理指导可有效解决严重病态问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Stealthy Multi-Task Adversarial Attacks
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks are highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, raising serious safety concerns in the real-world systems. While prior work mainly explores single-task attacks or jointly degrading all tasks in multi-task models, practical scenarios often demand more selective and stealthy attack strategies. To address this challenge, we propose Stealthy Multi-Task Adversarial Attack (SMTA$^{2}$), a novel framework that selectively degrades a targeted task while strictly preserving the performance of non-targeted tasks. We formulate this objective as a constrained multi-objective optimization problem and design task-aware adversarial perturbations that maximize degradation on the targeted task without causing collateral damage on non-targeted tasks. To enhance practicality, we further introduce an automated loss-weight tuning strategy that dynamically balances attack and preservation objectives. Experiments on two multi-task benchmarks NYUv2 and Cityscapes demonstrate that SMTA$^{2}$ achieves strong attack performance on targeted tasks while maintaining non-targeted tasks intact on both undefended and adversarially trained models, establishing the first systematic framework for stealthy and selective multi-task attack framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Stealthy Multi-Task Adversarial Attack (SMTA²) 框架，用于在保持非目标任务性能的同时，选择性地降低多任务模型中特定目标任务的性能。该方法通过约束多目标优化和自适应损失权重调整策略，在 NYUv2 和 Cityscapes 基准上实现攻击效果。
Motivation: 现有对抗攻击多关注单任务或全面降低多任务模型性能，缺乏对特定任务的选择性攻击，难以满足实际场景中隐蔽攻击的需求。
Method: 将目标形式化为约束多目标优化问题，设计任务感知对抗扰动，最大化目标任务退化而不损害非目标任务，并引入自动损失权重调整策略动态平衡攻击与保持目标。
Result: 在 NYUv2 和 Cityscapes 两个多任务基准上，SMTA² 在未防御和对抗训练模型上均实现对目标任务的有效攻击，同时保持非目标任务性能不变。
Conclusion: 该工作是首个系统性的隐蔽选择性多任务攻击框架，为多任务模型安全性研究提供新方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.result: 在 NYUv2 和 Cityscapes 两个多任务基准上，SMTA² 在未防御和对抗训练模型上均实现对目标任务的有效攻击，同时保持非目标任务性能不变。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作是首个系统性的隐蔽选择性多任务攻击框架，为多任务模型安全性研究提供新方向。

papers.title: Learning by Surprise: Adaptive Mitigation of Model Collapse in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: As AI-generated content increasingly populates the web, generative AI models are at growing risk of being trained on their own outputs, a process known as AI autophagy. This feedback loop has been shown to induce model collapse, typically characterized by a loss of diversity in generated content. However, existing work offers a limited understanding of this phenomenon and relies on mitigation strategies that assume access to human-authored data. In this paper, we conduct extensive simulations across multiple datasets and LLMs to address key gaps in the study of model collapse. First, we introduce model-intrinsic measures based on next-token probability distributions, showing that model collapse corresponds to an increasing concentration of probability mass on a small set of tokens. Second, we demonstrate that model collapse is also associated with a loss of common sense, as measured by a decline in commonsense inference accuracy. Third, we identify perplexity (a measure of model "surprise") as a key driver of collapse: fine-tuning on the least "surprising" documents leads to more severe degeneration. Building on this insight, we propose a perplexity-based filtering strategy that prioritizes high-surprise documents during fine-tuning. Unlike existing approaches, our method does not require distinguishing between human-authored and AI-generated content. Across datasets and LLM families, this strategy consistently mitigates model collapse, achieving performance comparable to, and in some cases better than, human-data baselines, while substantially reducing the concentration of next-token probabilities. Overall, our results provide a unified, model-centric understanding of model collapse and suggest practical, scalable strategies for training generative AI systems in increasingly synthetic environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在自生成数据上训练导致的模型崩溃现象，提出基于困惑度的过滤策略来缓解。摘要显示，模型崩溃表现为token概率分布集中和常识推理能力下降，作者发现困惑度（模型'惊讶'程度）是关键因素，并据此设计策略，无需区分人类与AI数据，性能接近或超过使用人类数据的基线。
Motivation: 现有研究对模型崩溃理解有限，且缓解策略依赖人工数据。本文旨在填补这些空白，并探索不依赖人工数据的缓解方法。
Method: 通过多数据集和多LLM模拟，提出基于next-token概率分布的模型内在度量，发现模型崩溃对应概率质量集中；并发现困惑度是崩溃的关键驱动因素；据此提出基于困惑度的过滤策略，优先选择高惊喜度的文档进行微调。
Result: 该策略在多个数据集和LLM家族上持续缓解模型崩溃，性能与使用人类数据的基线相当甚至更好，并显著降低next-token概率集中度。
Conclusion: 本文提供了统一、以模型为中心的理解，并提出了在实际合成环境中训练生成式AI的可扩展策略。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Collaborative Knowledge Distillation via a Learning-by-Education Node Community
papers.abstract_en: A novel Learning-by-Education Node Community framework (LENC) for Collaborative Knowledge Distillation (CKD) is presented, which facilitates continual collective learning through effective knowledge exchanges among diverse deployed Deep Neural Network (DNN) peer nodes. These DNNs dynamically and autonomously adopt either the role of a student, seeking knowledge, or that of a teacher, imparting knowledge, fostering a collaborative learning environment. The proposed framework triggers knowledge transfer via autonomous teacher discovery and stream-driven DNN distillation as needed, while enhancing their learning capabilities and promoting their collaboration. LENC addresses the challenges of handling diverse training data distributions and the limitations of individual DNN node learning abilities. \hl{It enables the exploitation of selected peer-teacher knowledge upon learning a new task and mitigates catastrophic forgetting in DNN nodes.} \hl{Additionally, it supports task-boundary-free continual adaptation in distributed settings via autonomous role assignment and modular forgetting mitigation, as DNN nodes receive no explicit task-boundary metadata during deployment.} Experimental evaluation on a proof-of-concept implementation demonstrates the LENC framework's functionalities and benefits across multiple DNN learning and inference scenarios. The conducted experiments showcase its ability to gradually improve the average test accuracy of the community of interacting DNN nodes in image classification problems, by appropriately leveraging the collective knowledge of all node peers. The LENC framework achieves strong performance in on-line unlabelled CKD.
papers.comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence, 2026, Corresponding author: Ioannis Mademlis
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为LENC（Learning-by-Education Node Community）的协作知识蒸馏框架，允许分布式DNN节点在社区中动态扮演学生或教师角色，通过自主教师发现和流驱动蒸馏实现持续集体学习。框架支持无任务边界的在线适应，并内建模块化遗忘缓解机制。实验表明，在图像分类任务中，LENC能逐步提升节点社区的平均测试准确率，并在无标签在线场景下表现良好。
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏方法多依赖预定义的师生关系或集中式训练，难以适应分布式、动态变化的部署环境，且无法有效处理节点间数据分布差异和个体学习能力限制。
Method: LENC框架使DNN节点在社区中自主选择学生或教师角色，通过自主教师发现触发知识转移；采用流驱动蒸馏实现持续学习，并结合模块化遗忘缓解策略，支持无明确任务边界的在线适应。
Result: 在概念验证实验中，LENC在图像分类问题上逐步提高了交互DNN节点社区的平均测试准确率，并在在线无标签协作知识蒸馏场景下取得强性能。
Conclusion: LENC通过协作知识蒸馏促进了分布式DNN节点的持续集体学习，有效应对灾难性遗忘和数据分布差异挑战；但摘要未明确讨论扩展性或局限性。

papers.title: PSHuman: Photorealistic Single-image 3D Human Reconstruction using Cross-Scale Multiview Diffusion and Explicit Remeshing
papers.abstract_en: Detailed and photorealistic 3D human modeling is essential for various applications and has seen tremendous progress. However, full-body reconstruction from a monocular RGB image remains challenging due to the ill-posed nature of the problem and sophisticated clothing topology with self-occlusions. In this paper, we propose PSHuman, a novel framework that explicitly reconstructs human meshes utilizing priors from the multiview diffusion model. It is found that directly applying multiview diffusion on single-view human images leads to severe geometric distortions, especially on generated faces. To address it, we propose a cross-scale diffusion that models the joint probability distribution of global full-body shape and local facial characteristics, enabling detailed and identity-preserved novel-view generation without any geometric distortion. Moreover, to enhance cross-view body shape consistency of varied human poses, we condition the generative model on parametric models like SMPL-X, which provide body priors and prevent unnatural views inconsistent with human anatomy. Leveraging the generated multi-view normal and color images, we present SMPLX-initialized explicit human carving to recover realistic textured human meshes efficiently. Extensive experimental results and quantitative evaluations on CAPE and THuman2.1 datasets demonstrate PSHumans superiority in geometry details, texture fidelity, and generalization capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PSHuman，一种从单张RGB图像重建逼真3D人体网格的框架。利用多视角扩散先验，提出跨尺度扩散模型联合建模全局身体和局部面部特征，并结合SMPL-X参数模型保证多视角一致性。通过显式人体雕刻从生成的多视角法向和彩色图像恢复纹理网格。在CAPE和THuman2.1数据集上，该方法在几何细节、纹理保真度和泛化能力上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 单目RGB图像的全方位3D人体重建由于问题的病态性以及复杂衣物拓扑和自遮挡而极具挑战。
Method: 提出跨尺度扩散模型，建模全局身体形状和局部面部特征的联合概率分布，实现无几何畸变的身份保持新视角生成；同时以SMPL-X参数模型作为条件，增强跨视角身体形状一致性。最后利用SMPL-X初始化的显式人体雕刻从生成的多视角图像恢复纹理网格。
Result: 在CAPE和THuman2.1数据集上的实验表明，该方法在几何细节、纹理保真度和泛化能力方面均优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 所提框架结合了多视图扩散先验和参数化人体模型，有效解决了单视图人体重建中的几何畸变和一致性问题。

papers.title: 2DGH: 2D Gaussian-Hermite Splatting for High-quality Rendering and Better Geometry Features
papers.abstract_en: 2D Gaussian Splatting has recently emerged as a significant method in 3D reconstruction, enabling novel view synthesis and geometry reconstruction simultaneously. While the well-known Gaussian kernel is broadly used, its lack of anisotropy and deformation ability leads to dim and vague edges at object silhouettes, limiting the reconstruction quality of current Gaussian splatting methods. To enhance the representation power, we draw inspiration from quantum physics and propose to use the Gaussian-Hermite kernel as the new primitive in Gaussian splatting. The new kernel takes a unified mathematical form and extends the Gaussian function, which serves as the zero-rank special case in the updated general formulation. Our experiments demonstrate that the proposed Gaussian-Hermite kernel achieves improved performance over traditional Gaussian Splatting kernels on both geometry reconstruction and novel-view synthesis tasks. Specifically, on the DTU dataset, our method yields more accurate geometry reconstruction, while on datasets such as MipNeRF360 and our customized Detail dataset, it achieves better results in novel-view synthesis. These results highlight the potential of the Gaussian-Hermite kernel for high-quality 3D reconstruction and rendering.
papers.journal_ref: IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics, vol. 32, no. 2, pp. 1513-1524, Feb. 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出使用高斯-埃尔米特核（Gaussian-Hermite kernel）替代传统高斯核作为高斯溅射（Gaussian Splatting）的新基元，用于3D重建和新型视图合成。该核具有统一数学形式，扩展了高斯函数（零阶特例），在DTU数据集上提升了几何重建精度，在MipNeRF360和自建Detail数据集上改善了渲染质量。
Motivation: 传统高斯核缺乏各向异性和形变能力，导致物体轮廓处边缘模糊，限制了高斯溅射方法的重建质量。
Method: 从量子物理中汲取灵感，提出将高斯-埃尔米特核作为高斯溅射的新基元，其数学形式统一且可视为高斯函数的推广（零阶特例）。
Result: 在DTU数据集上获得更精确的几何重建；在MipNeRF360和自建Detail数据集上取得更好的新型视图合成效果。
Conclusion: 高斯-埃尔米特核在高质量3D重建和渲染中具有潜力。

papers.title: PoseGravity: Pose Estimation from Points and Lines with Axis Prior
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a new algorithm to estimate absolute camera pose given an axis of the camera's rotation matrix. Current algorithms solve the problem via algebraic solutions on limited input domains. This paper shows that the problem can be solved efficiently by finding the intersection points of a hyperbola and the unit circle. The solution can flexibly accommodate combinations of point and line features in minimal and overconstrained configurations. In addition, the two special cases of planar and minimal configurations are identified to yield simpler closed-form solutions. Extensive experiments validate the approach.
papers.comment: New linear algebra formulation with fast iterative solution, 14 pages
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种新的绝对相机姿态估计算法，已知相机旋转矩阵的一个轴，通过寻找双曲线与单位圆的交点高效求解，能灵活处理点与线特征的组合，并给出平面和最小配置的闭式解。
Motivation: 现有算法仅在有限输入域上通过代数求解，缺乏一种能同时处理点、线特征且支持过约束配置的高效通用方法。
Method: 将问题转化为求双曲线与单位圆的交点，并识别出平面和最小配置两种特殊情况，导出更简单的闭式求解公式。
Result: 大量实验验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未报告具体数值指标。
Conclusion: 该方法在已知旋转轴先验下，能以统一框架处理点、线特征，并支持过约束配置。

papers.title: A Realistic Protocol for Evaluation of Weakly Supervised Object Localization
papers.abstract_en: Weakly Supervised Object Localization (WSOL) allows training deep learning models for classification and localization (LOC) using only global class-level labels. The absence of bounding box (bbox) supervision during training raises challenges in the literature for hyper-parameter tuning, model selection, and evaluation. WSOL methods rely on a validation set with bbox annotations for model selection, and a test set with bbox annotations for threshold estimation for producing bboxes from localization maps. This approach, however, is not aligned with the WSOL setting as these annotations are typically unavailable in real-world scenarios. Our initial empirical analysis shows a significant decline in LOC performance when model selection and threshold estimation rely solely on class labels and the image itself, respectively, compared to using manual bbox annotations. This highlights the importance of incorporating bbox labels for optimal model performance. In this paper,a new WSOL evaluation protocol is proposed that provides LOC information without the need for manual bbox annotations. In particular, we generated noisy pseudo-boxes from a pretrained off-the-shelf region proposal method such as Selective Search, CLIP, and RPN for model selection. These bboxes are also employed to estimate the threshold from LOC maps, circumventing the need for test-set bbox annotations. Our experiments with several WSOL methods on challenging natural and medical image datasets show that using the proposed pseudo-bboxes for validation facilitates the model selection and threshold estimation, with LOC performance comparable to models selected using GT bboxes on the validation set and threshold estimation on the test set. It also outperforms models selected using class-level labels, and then dynamically thresholded with only LOC maps.
papers.journal_ref: WACV 2025: IEEE/CVF Winter Conf. on Applications of Computer Vision, Arizona, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对弱监督目标定位（WSOL）中评估协议依赖人工边框标注的问题，提出一种新协议，使用预训练的区域提议方法（如Selective Search、CLIP、RPN）生成的噪声伪边框进行模型选择和阈值估计。实验表明该方法在自然和医学图像数据集上的定位性能与使用真实边框标注的方法相当，且优于仅依赖类标签的方法。
Motivation: 现有WSOL评估需要边框标注进行模型选择和阈值估计，这与实际场景中缺乏边框标注的情况不符。初始实验显示仅依赖类标签和图像本身会导致定位性能显著下降。
Method: 提出新评估协议，利用预训练的区域提议方法生成伪边框，替代真实边框标注用于模型选择，并基于这些伪边框估计定位图的阈值，从而避免人工标注。
Result: 在多个WSOL方法和数据集上的实验表明，使用伪边框的验证和阈值估计得到的定位性能与使用真实边框标注的结果相当，并优于仅使用类标签和动态阈值的方法。
Conclusion: 该协议使得WSOL评估更贴近现实应用，无需手工边框标注即可获得接近真实标注的性能。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.method: 提出新评估协议，利用预训练的区域提议方法生成伪边框，替代真实边框标注用于模型选择，并基于这些伪边框估计定位图的阈值，从而避免人工标注。
summary_sections.result: 在多个WSOL方法和数据集上的实验表明，使用伪边框的验证和阈值估计得到的定位性能与使用真实边框标注的结果相当，并优于仅使用类标签和动态阈值的方法。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该协议使得WSOL评估更贴近现实应用，无需手工边框标注即可获得接近真实标注的性能。

papers.title: Perturbation Effects on Robustness and Individual Fairness
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks are vulnerable to adversarial perturbations that can simultaneously degrade prediction robustness and individual fairness across diverse application settings. However, existing evaluation protocols typically assess these dimensions in isolation, thereby obscuring critical failure modes. To bridge this gap, we formalize Robust Individual Fairness (RIF): under semantic-preserving (truth-condition-preserving) perturbations, predictions should remain both correct with respect to the ground truth and invariant across semantically equivalent individuals. To surface RIF violations in practice, we introduce RIFair, a black-box adversarial framework that leverages a decoupled perturbation strategy to construct semantically preserved yet unrobust and/or unfair instance pairs. Experiments across multiple model architectures and real-world textual datasets show that robustness-only or fairness-only metrics often miss Robust Biased and Unrobust Fair behaviors. RIFair}reliably exposes these hidden vulnerabilities, supporting RIF as a necessary criterion for trustworthy model assessment. The experimental code is publicly available at https://github.com/Xuran-LI/RIFair.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度神经网络在对抗性扰动下的鲁棒性与个体公平性，发现现有评估协议通常分别衡量这两个维度，掩盖了关键失败模式。作者形式化定义了鲁棒个体公平性（RIF），并提出了黑盒攻击框架RIFair，通过解耦扰动策略构造语义保持但不鲁棒和不公平的实例对。实验表明，仅关注鲁棒性或公平性的指标会遗漏鲁棒偏见和不鲁棒公平行为，RIFair能可靠地暴露这些隐藏漏洞。
Motivation: 现有评估协议将模型的预测鲁棒性和个体公平性分开评估，忽略了二者之间的相互影响，导致关键失败模式被掩盖。
Method: 形式化定义了鲁棒个体公平性（RIF）标准，要求语义保持扰动下预测既正确又对等价个体不变。提出RIFair黑盒攻击框架，采用解耦扰动策略构造语义保持的对抗样本对，用于检测RIF违反。
Result: 在多种模型架构和真实文本数据集上的实验表明，仅关注鲁棒性或公平性的指标经常遗漏鲁棒偏见和不鲁棒公平行为。RIFair可靠地暴露了这些隐藏漏洞，支持RIF作为可信模型评估的必要标准。
Conclusion: RIF是一个必要的可信模型评估准则，RIFair能够有效揭示模型在鲁棒性和公平性上的联合脆弱性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Multiple Testing of Linear Forms for Noisy Matrix Completion
papers.abstract_en: Many important tasks of large-scale recommender systems can be naturally cast as testing multiple linear forms for noisy matrix completion. These problems, however, present unique challenges because of the subtle bias-and-variance tradeoff of and an intricate dependence among the estimated entries induced by the low-rank structure. In this paper, we develop a general approach to overcome these difficulties by introducing new statistics for individual tests with sharp asymptotics both marginally and jointly, and utilizing them to control the false discovery rate (FDR) via a data splitting and symmetric aggregation scheme. We show that valid FDR control can be achieved with guaranteed power under nearly optimal sample size requirements using the proposed methodology. Extensive numerical simulations and real data examples are also presented to further illustrate its practical merits.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模推荐系统中常出现的噪声矩阵补全下多重线性形式检验问题，提出了一种新方法。通过引入具有尖锐渐近性质的个体检验统计量，并利用数据分割和对称聚合方案控制错误发现率（FDR），该方法在近乎最优的样本量需求下实现了有效的FDR控制和有保证的检验功效。数值模拟和真实数据示例验证了其实用性。
Motivation: 噪声矩阵补全中的多重线性形式检验面临偏差-方差权衡和低秩结构带来的估计条目间复杂依赖性的挑战，现有方法难以有效控制FDR。
Method: 开发了基于新统计量的个体检验方法，这些统计量在边际和联合上具有尖锐渐近性质；通过数据分割和对称聚合方案来控制FDR。
Result: 证明在所提方法下，可以在近乎最优的样本量需求下实现有效的FDR控制和有保证的检验功效。
Conclusion: 该方法为噪声矩阵补全中的多重检验问题提供了通用框架，理论性质和实证表现均良好，但摘要未明确提及局限性或适用范围。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Regulation Has Memory: Hysteresis and Control Burden in Artificial Agency
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive agents are usually judged by what they do, but an agent can appear stable while the internal effort required to keep it stable is increasing. This hidden regulatory burden matters for artificial agents operating under noise, delay, or changing demands: two systems may reach similar internal states while one requires much more corrective control to get there. Here, we study whether that burden depends on history. Using a computational model of adaptive uncertainty regulation, we drive an artificial agent through a continuous change in its uncertainty target and then reverse the change without resetting the agent. This creates a simple test for carryover: does the controller respond only to the current target, or does the path by which the agent reached that target still matter? The simulations show a clear history-dependent effect. The adaptive gain required to regulate the agent forms a reproducible hysteresis loop, meaning that the same target can require different levels of control depending on whether the agent is moving toward or returning from a more demanding regime. The timing of regulation also matters. When stabilization is available before disturbance exposure, the agent generally requires less adaptive gain than when it can only recover after disturbance has already acted. The state-level coherence measure also shows path dependence, but the timing effect is much clearer in regulatory gain. The main difference is therefore not that anticipatory regulation produces a completely different state. Rather, it reaches comparable regulated behavior with lower modeled control demand. These results suggest that adaptive agents should be evaluated not only by whether they remain organized, but by how much regulation they must recruit to do so.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过自适应不确定性调节的计算模型，研究人工代理在噪声、延迟和变化需求下，达到稳定状态所需的调控负担是否依赖于历史路径。模拟显示调控增益形成可重复的滞后回线，即相同目标在不同路径下需要不同控制强度；预测性稳定化比事后恢复所需增益更低。评估代理时应考虑调控负担而非仅看行为稳定性。
Motivation: 传统上仅根据代理的行为表现评判其稳定性，忽略了内部调控负担可能随历史累积而增加，两个系统可能达到相似状态但所需控制不同。本文旨在揭示历史路径对调控负担的影响。
Method: 使用自适应不确定性调节的计算模型，驱动代理经历不确定性目标的连续变化并逆转，测量调控增益和状态相干性，检验是否存在历史依赖和滞后效应。
Result: 模拟显示调控增益形成可重复的滞后回线；相同目标下，代理朝向或背离更苛刻区间会导致不同控制需求；预测性稳定化（先稳定后扰动）比事后恢复所需增益更低，状态相干性的路径依赖较弱。
Conclusion: 评估自适应代理时，不仅应看是否保持组织状态，还应考虑达成该状态所需调控的多寡；历史路径和调控时机（预测性 vs. 恢复性）是关键因素。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: AgentBound: Verifiable Behavioral Governance for Autonomous AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous AI agents increasingly perform consequential actions on behalf of human principals, including financial transactions, external communications, and enterprise workflows. Existing agent infrastructure relies on identity federation and delegated authorization to authenticate workloads and control resource access, but it cannot determine whether an authorized action should be executed under the current behavioral and operational context. We present AgentBound, a runtime governance framework that provides verifiable behavioral oversight for autonomous AI agents. AgentBound evaluates each proposed action using three independent authorities: delegated authorization, owner-signed behavioral constitutions, and site action contracts. Their judgments are conservatively composed through a formal decision model to determine whether an action should be permitted, reviewed, or denied before execution. To provide accountability, AgentBound generates cryptographically verifiable governance receipts that bind every action to the exact delegation, policy, and semantic artifacts governing the decision, enabling independent replay verification and policy provenance. The framework also introduces standing delegation for long-running agents, allowing periodic workloads to operate under continuously refreshed governance policies while preserving revocability and bounded authority. We present the formal foundation, system architecture, governance receipt protocol, and AgentBound-Bench, a benchmark framework for evaluating governance correctness, authority composition, and accountability. Rather than replacing model alignment, AgentBound complements it by providing a deterministic governance layer between authorization and execution, transforming governance from a process that must be trusted into one that can be independently verified.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AgentBound，一个为自主AI代理提供可验证行为治理的运行时框架。它结合授权、行为宪法和站点行动合同三种独立权威，通过正式决策模型判断行动是否允许，并生成可加密验证的治理收据，支持独立回放验证和政策溯源。还引入了持续委托机制用于长期运行代理。框架与模型对齐互补，在授权与执行之间提供确定性治理层。
Motivation: 现有代理基础设施能认证工作负载和控制资源访问，但无法在行为与运行上下文中判断授权行动是否应执行，缺乏可验证的治理机制。
Method: 提出AgentBound框架，包含三个独立权威（授权、所有者签名的行为宪法、站点行动合同）的组合决策模型，以及可加密验证的治理收据协议，并引入持续委托支持长期代理。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验数据，但提出了AgentBound-Bench基准框架用于评估治理正确性、权威组合和问责性。
Conclusion: 框架不替代模型对齐，而是通过确定性治理层将治理从需要信任的过程转变为可独立验证的过程。

papers.title: PhotoQuilt: Training-Free Arbitrary-Resolution Photomosaics via Bootstrapped Tiled Denoising
papers.abstract_en: Photomosaics are large images whose local regions are seen as independent tiles while their overall arrangement forms a coherent scene. Generating them at high resolution, with every tile convincing in its own right, is computationally expensive, since the canvas must hold many detailed tiles at once. We present PhotoQuilt, a training-free framework that generates photomosaics at arbitrary resolution. Diffusion models struggle to satisfy both scales at once, as direct high-resolution generation is costly and tends toward one smooth image rather than a mosaic, while patch-based tiling keeps local detail but loses global structure. PhotoQuilt resolves this with a bootstrapped tiled denoising procedure. We first produce a global composition at low resolution to fix the layout, then upscale it in latent space and re-inject noise to restore generative capacity. Denoising proceeds within fixed tiles, so each forms its own image while the shared global structure holds them in one layout. Because tile generation is handled separately, PhotoQuilt scales to large canvases without quadratic attention cost. Experiments show that PhotoQuilt outperforms current baselines on both global structure and local realism.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PhotoQuilt，一个无需训练的框架，用于生成任意分辨率的光马赛克（photomosaics）。通过自举分块去噪（bootstrapped tiled denoising），先低分辨率生成全局构图，再放大并重新注入噪声，在固定分块内去噪，使每个分块形成独立图像同时保持全局布局。实验证明在全局结构和局部真实感上优于现有基线。
Motivation: 高分辨率光马赛克生成需要同时兼顾局部细节和全局结构，现有方法要么直接高分辨率生成成本高且易产生平滑图像，要么分块生成失去全局一致性。
Method: 提出自举分块去噪：首先生成低分辨率全局图，在潜在空间放大并添加噪声恢复生成能力，然后对固定分块进行去噪，每个分块独立形成图像，共享全局结构。该方法避免了二次注意力成本，可扩展到大画布。
Result: 实验表明PhotoQuilt在全局结构和局部真实感上均优于当前基线，支持任意分辨率且计算高效。
Conclusion: PhotoQuilt通过分块自举去噪有效解决了高分辨率光马赛克生成中分辨率扩展与局部保真度的矛盾。
