papers.title: HyPOLE: Hyperproperty-Guided Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observation
papers.abstract_en: Formal specification is a powerful tool to guide the learning process and provides significant advantages over reward shaping: (1) mathematical rigor; (2) expressiveness to specify objectives and constraints, and (3) the ability to define tactics to achieve objectives. However, these benefits remain largely unexplored in the context of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL). This paper introduces HyPOLE, a novel framework for MARL under partial observability, where learning is guided by the expressive power of the so-called hyperproperties and, in particular, the temporal logic HyperLTL. We integrate Centralized Training for Decentralized Execution (CTDE) techniques with HyPOLE to synthesize decentralized policies, and our evaluation on SMAC, MessySMAC, and WildFire benchmark demonstrates clear advantages over baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: HyPOLE是一个利用超性质（hyperproperties）和HyperLTL逻辑指导多智能体强化学习（MARL）的框架，针对部分可观测环境，结合集中训练分散执行（CTDE）合成分布式策略。在SMAC、MessySMAC和WildFire基准上，该方法优于基线。
Motivation: 形式化规约在单智能体强化学习中具有优势，但在MARL中尚未充分利用。本文旨在利用超性质的表达能力来更有效地指导多智能体系统的学习过程。
Method: 提出HyPOLE框架，使用HyperLTL（一种表达超性质的时序逻辑）来指定目标和约束，并结合CTDE技术，在部分可观测环境下学习分散策略。
Result: 在SMAC、MessySMAC和WildFire基准上的评估显示，HyPOLE相较于基线方法具有明显优势。
Conclusion: 超性质指导的MARL方法能够提升学习效果，为形式化规约在复杂多智能体系统中的应用提供了新思路。

papers.title: Loc2Repair: A Framework for Evaluating the Impact of File-Level Issue Localization in Repo-Level LLM Repair
papers.abstract_en: Repository-grounded automated repair is often reported as a single end-to-end capability, which hides distinct failure modes such as poor file targeting, incorrect patch synthesis, and failed iterative debugging. We present Loc2Repair, a modular evaluation framework for controlled analysis of repository-grounded repair pipelines, and use it to isolate file-level issue localization as an upstream variable. Loc2Repair decouples localization and repair under a shared runtime, artifact schema, and evaluation harness, allowing researchers to combine different localization models and repair backbones under matched conditions. Using three repair backbones on SWE-bench Verified, we compare baseline repair without explicit localization, repair guided by predicted localization from two localizers, and repair guided by gold modified-file sets. Explicit localization consistently improves resolved rate across all backbones: pooled performance increases from 44.7% for baseline repair to 48.9% and 49.1% with predicted localization, and to 52.4% with gold localization. Localization also reduces mean elapsed time overall: in pooled paired analysis, mean elapsed time decreases by 100.94 s and 52.25 s for the two predicted-localization settings, and by 154.45 s with gold guidance, although token effects remain heterogeneous across models. Overall, Loc2Repair shows file-level localization is a consistent repair lever, improving effectiveness and mean latency in pooled analysis, while gold-guided failures expose headroom beyond localization.
papers.comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the Generative Code Intelligence Workshop (GeCoIn 2026), co-located with the 35th International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence (IJCAI-ECAI 2026), Bremen, Germany, August 15--17, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Loc2Repair 是一个用于评估仓库级代码修复管线中文件级问题定位影响的模块化框架。它通过将定位和修复解耦，支持在共享运行时、工件模式和评估工具下组合不同的定位模型和修复主干。在 SWE-bench Verified 上使用三个修复主干进行实验，显式定位在所有主干上一致提升修复成功率，从基线的44.7%提升至预测定位的48.9%和49.1%，以及黄金定位的52.4%。定位还平均减少了总耗时（如预测定位减少100.94秒和52.25秒），但令牌效应在不同模型间存在异质性。
Motivation: 现有仓库级自动化修复通常被报告为单一端到端能力，掩盖了文件定位错误、补丁合成失败和迭代调试失败等不同故障模式。
Method: 提出 Loc2Repair 模块化评估框架，解耦定位和修复步骤，在统一运行时、工件模式和评估工具下组合不同定位模型和修复主干。
Result: 在 SWE-bench Verified 上，显式定位使平均修复成功率从基线44.7%提升至预测定位48.9%/49.1%和黄金定位52.4%；平均总耗时减少100.94秒（预测定位）和154.45秒（黄金定位）。
Conclusion: 文件级定位是仓库级修复的一致杠杆，可提升有效性和平均延迟；黄金定位下的失败表明定位之外仍有改进空间。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ElemeNet: Multiscale Molecular Machine Learning with Uncertainty Quantification Across the Periodic Table
papers.abstract_en: Advances in deep learning architectures and representations have enabled ML-driven chemical property prediction, but state-of-the-art (SOTA) models have remained largely confined to independent codebases and lack support for diverse chemical species. This work introduces ElemeNet, a unified, general-purpose software package for molecular machine learning. The ElemeNet software package enables the training of advanced ML models for diverse properties and datasets with an enlarged range of elemental compositions. We define molecular representations compatible with elements 1-100, supporting diverse organometallic and biological systems in addition to organic chemistry already well-served by the Chemprop ML toolkit. As well as more common atom-, bond-, and molecule-level predictions, we introduce moiety predictions. We also natively define optional conditioning on charge and spin states. Advanced E(3)-equivariant and transformer architectures are supported, as well as classical 2D models, with all classes including built-in uncertainty quantification through deterministic and statistical measures. We benchmark our protocols for ML model training against representative datasets from organic, inorganic, coordination, and biological chemistry, achieving competitive and SOTA performance relative to literature baselines and favorable scaling to millions of molecules. The entire workflow is exposed through a concise command-line interface, lowering the barrier to entry for non-expert users. We anticipate ElemeNet will empower non-computational researchers to leverage modern deep learning methods across the chemical and physical sciences.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ElemeNet是一个统一的分子机器学习软件包，支持元素1-100的分子表示，涵盖有机、有机金属和生物化学体系，并集成了E(3)-等变和Transformer架构以及不确定性量化。该软件包还支持基于电荷和自旋状态的预测，并在有机、无机、配位和生物化学数据集上达到了与文献基线相当或更优的性能。
Motivation: 现有分子机器学习模型多局限于独立的代码库，且缺乏对多样化化学元素的支持，这限制了其在非传统化学体系中的应用。
Method: ElemeNet定义了对元素1-100兼容的分子表示，支持多种预测任务（原子、键、分子和基团预测），并内置了确定性及统计性的不确定性量化方法。软件包集成了E(3)-等变网络、Transformer以及经典2D模型，并通过命令行界面提供简洁的工作流。
Result: 在有机、无机、配位和生物化学的代表性数据集上，ElemeNet达到了与文献基线竞争甚至更优的性能，并展示了扩展到数百万分子的良好能力。
Conclusion: ElemeNet通过统一框架降低了非计算研究人员使用现代深度学习方法的门槛，有望推动化学与物理科学中机器学习方法的普及。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Exponential-Family Tensor Completion via Nonconvex Dual Total-Variation Regularization
papers.abstract_en: With the emergence of various tensor data, tensor completion from partial measurements has attracted widespread attention in data science and signal processing. Total Variation (TV) has been widely used as an effective regularization technique for tensor completion; however, theoretical studies on TV regularization in this context remain limited. In this work, we present a rigorous theoretical analysis of TV regularization for tensor completion. Specifically, we consider tensor completion under exponential-family noise, which generalizes the standard settings such as Gaussian and Poisson tensor completion. To handle exponential-family tensor completion, we propose a family of dual-TV (DTV) regularizers based on the transformed L1 function, which simultaneously capture sparsity and low-rank structures in the gradient tensor. Moreover, we establish the theoretical upper bounds on the recovery error of the proposed estimator. In certain cases, these upper bounds can attain the convergence order of $\mathcal{O}\big( n_3 r_t\big(\max_{k} s_k^2\big) \log\big((n_1+n_2)n_3\big) /n \big)$, and the minimax lower bound analysis is further presented to show that the upper-bounds can approach the lower bound with the gap of order $\mathcal{O}(\max_k s_k^2/max(n_1, n_2))$ up to a logarithmic factor. Finally, multiple groups of experiments on synthetic, image and video tensor data sets are conducted to support our theoretical results and demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对指数族噪声下的张量补全问题，提出了一种基于变换L1函数的对偶全变差（DTV）正则化器，可同时捕捉梯度张量的稀疏性和低秩结构，并给出了恢复误差的理论上界和极小化下界分析。实验表明该方法在合成、图像和视频张量数据上有效。
Motivation: 全变差（TV）正则化在张量补全中被广泛使用，但相应的理论研究仍然有限，尤其是对于指数族噪声的通用场景。
Method: 提出了一类基于变换L1函数的对偶TV（DTV）正则化器，用于指数族张量补全，结合稀疏性和低秩结构约束。
Result: 建立了估计器的恢复误差理论上界，在某些情况下收敛阶为O(n_3 r_t (max_k s_k^2) log((n_1+n_2)n_3)/n)；极小化下界分析表明上界与下界之差为O(max_k s_k^2 / max(n_1, n_2))（忽略对数因子）。
Conclusion: 本文为TV正则化在张量补全中提供了严格的理论支撑，并验证了所提DTV正则化器的有效性。

papers.title: Neuro-Bayesian-Symbolic Residual Attention Shallow Network: Explainable Deep Learning for Cybersecurity Risk Assessment
papers.abstract_en: We introduce the Neuro-Bayesian-Symbolic Residual Attention Shallow Network (NBS-RASN), a hybrid neural architecture for explainable cybersecurity risk assessment in open-source ecosystems. Unlike deep models that trade interpretability for accuracy, our shallow network encodes domain knowledge, causal reasoning, and expert judgment as differentiable components. It uses 80 interpretable neurons across 12 layers, including a gatekeeper that enforces five epistemological axioms - precision, causality, falsifiability, transparency, and completeness - as hard constraints before propagation. Despite limited depth, the network exhibits deep-learning traits via residual attention and feedback loops, learning complex risk patterns without becoming a black box. It produces fully decomposable scores: a deterministic weighted component plus an expert adjustment, with each adjustment traceable to named amplifiers (blast radius, propagation speed, structural nature, default exposure, exploitation pattern, institutional criticality). We validate on 20 open-source projects covering all OWASP Top 10:2025 categories and language risk classes, achieving confidence scores of 0.79-0.97, and show that explainability is guaranteed by design, not by a training algorithm. This challenges the assumption that deep learning requires deep networks, proving that shallow networks with deep reasoning can outperform opaque models in high-stakes cybersecurity, where interpretability is essential.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出神经-贝叶斯-符号残差注意力浅层网络（NBS-RASN），一种用于开源生态系统网络安全风险评估的可解释混合神经架构。该网络仅用80个可解释神经元和12层，通过门控机制强制执行精确性、因果性、可证伪性、透明性和完整性五个认识论公理作为硬约束。在覆盖OWASP Top 10:2025的20个开源项目上验证，置信分数0.79-0.97，证明可解释性由设计保证，挑战了深度学习需要深层网络的假设。
Motivation: 现有深度学习模型在网络安全风险评估中为了准确性牺牲了可解释性，而高风险场景下可解释性至关重要。
Method: 提出NBS-RASN，一种混合架构，编码领域知识、因果推理和专家判断为可微组件；使用12层80个可解释神经元，包含门控机制强制执行五个认识论公理；通过残差注意力和反馈循环实现类深度学习特性。
Result: 在20个开源项目（覆盖OWASP Top 10:2025所有类别）上评估，置信分数0.79-0.97，每个调整可追溯到命名的放大器（如爆炸半径、传播速度等）。
Conclusion: 证明浅层网络结合深度推理可以在高风险网络安全任务中胜过不透明模型，且可解释性由设计保证而非训练算法，挑战了深度学习需要深层网络的传统观念。

papers.title: Learning Where to Look: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Robust Micro-Ultrasound Prostate Cancer Detection
papers.abstract_en: Micro-ultrasound ($μ$US) is a new, emerging, and promising imaging modality for prostate cancer (PCa) detection, but accurate identification of suspicious tissue remains highly dependent on clinical experience, leading to substantial inter-observer variability. Machine-learning assistance can reduce this variability; however, training reliable deep models is challenging because supervision is sparse and noisy -- typically limited to core-level histopathology outcomes (e.g., cancer grade and its percentage in a biopsy core) without pixel-level lesion annotations and under severe class imbalance. We introduce Prost-RL, which reframes $μ$US PCa detection as a spatially aware, policy-driven inference problem by learning where to look before decoding. Prost-RL integrates a lightweight reinforcement-learning policy into a foundation-model encoder-decoder to generate interpretable spatial attention maps that act as soft prompts for both cancer-likelihood heatmap prediction and image-level classification. We further propose Adaptive Policy Optimization (APO) to stabilize hybrid supervised-RL training and a noise-robust objective combining symmetric cross-entropy with negative-entropy regularization to mitigate weak-label noise and encourage sharp localization. On a cohort of 6,607 biopsy cores from 693 patients across five clinical sites, Prost-RL achieves $79.0\pm3.5$ AUROC with $64.6\pm6.3$% sensitivity at 80% specificity for core-level detection (+2.1 AUROC and +4.5 sensitivity points over the strongest baseline), and $79.3\pm5.8$ AUROC for clinically significant cancer classification. The learned policy highlights biopsy-aligned regions, providing transparent, spatially grounded evidence alongside quantitative risk predictions. Code is available at: https://github.com/DeepRCL/Prost-RL.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Prost-RL，一种将微超声前列腺癌检测重新定义为空间感知、策略驱动推理问题的强化学习框架。该框架集成轻量级强化学习策略到基础模型编码器-解码器中，生成可解释的空间注意力图作为软提示，用于癌症热力图预测和图像级分类。在 6607 个活检核心（693 名患者，5 个中心）的数据集上，核心级检测 AUROC 达到 79.0±3.5，80% 特异性下敏感性 64.6±6.3%，临床显著性癌症分类 AUROC 为 79.3±5.8。
Motivation: 微超声前列腺癌检测高度依赖临床经验，存在显著观察者间差异；机器学习辅助虽可减少变异，但训练面临标签稀疏、噪声大（仅核心级病理标签，无像素级标注）以及严重类别不平衡的挑战。
Method: 提出 Prost-RL，通过强化学习策略与基础模型编码器-解码器结合生成空间注意力图；提出自适应策略优化（APO）稳定混合监督-RL 训练；采用噪声鲁棒目标函数（对称交叉熵加负熵正则化）缓解弱标签噪声并促进定位锐度。
Result: 在 6607 个活检核心（693 名患者，5 个临床站点）上，核心级检测 AUROC 为 79.0±3.5，80% 特异性下敏感性 64.6±6.3%（比最强基线分别提高 2.1 和 4.5 个百分点）；临床显著性癌症分类 AUROC 为 79.3±5.8。

papers.title: AgRefactor: Self-Evolving Agentic Workflow for HLS Compatibility and Performance
papers.abstract_en: High-Level Synthesis (HLS) provides a fast path from concepts to silicon, but converting real-world software into synthesizable HLS code remains challenging due to restrictive language support and the gap between software and hardware programming practices. Existing automated and LLM-based refactoring approaches partially address this problem, yet they often lack flexibility, struggle to scale, and incur high computational costs. We introduce AgRefactor, an LLM-based multi-agent workflow for refactoring software into HLS-compatible programs. AgRefactor incorporates a self-evolving memory system that accumulates and retrieves factual and strategic knowledge across tasks, improving robustness and efficiency on unseen programs. To reduce cost and enhance scalability, it integrates automated refactoring tools, enabling agents to balance LLM-driven rewrites with efficient tool-based transformations. On 9 out of 11 challenging real-world benchmarks, which are 5-10x longer than the most complex cases studied in prior work, AgRefactor outperforms or matches the state-of-the-art automated refactoring tool and a strong LLM-based baseline built on the same framework backbone. Further agentic performance optimization yields a 6.51x geometric mean speedup over the SoTA pragma tuning tool and a 1.20x speedup over optimized open-source designs with less than 20% extra resources. AgRefactor is fully-automated and open-sourced.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AgRefactor 是一个基于 LLM 的多智能体工作流，用于将真实世界软件重构为 HLS 兼容的程序。它引入自进化记忆系统，积累并检索跨任务的事实和策略知识，并集成自动化重构工具以降低成本和提升可扩展性。在 11 个挑战性基准中的 9 个上，AgRefactor 优于或匹配现有方法，并实现了 6.51 倍的几何平均加速。
Motivation: 将真实世界软件转换为 HLS 代码仍具挑战性，现有自动化和 LLM 方法缺乏灵活性、扩展性差且计算成本高。
Method: 提出 LLM 驱动的多智能体工作流，包含自进化记忆系统和自动化重构工具，平衡 LLM 改写与基于工具的转换。
Result: 在 11 个基准中的 9 个上优于或匹配最先进的自动化重构工具和 LLM 基线；几何平均加速 6.51 倍，额外资源少于 20%。
Conclusion: AgRefactor 是全自动开源框架，有效提升了 HLS 兼容性和性能。

papers.title: Motion Planning in Compressed Representation Spaces
papers.abstract_en: Deep learning methods have vastly expanded the capabilities of motion planning in robotics applications, as learning priors from large-scale data has been shown to be essential in capturing the highly complex behavior required for solving tasks such as manipulation or navigation for autonomous vehicles. At the same time, model-based planning algorithms based on search or optimization remain an essential tool due to their flexibility, efficiency, and the ability to incorporate domain knowledge via expert-designed algorithms and objective functions. We propose a new generative framework to unify these two paradigms. First, we learn an autoencoder with a high compression ratio and a latent space of hierarchically ordered, discrete-valued tokens. Leveraging both the dimensionality reduction and the hierarchical coarse-to-fine structure learned by this autoencoder, we then perform motion planning by directly searching in the latent space of tokens. This search can optimize arbitrary objective functions specified at test time, providing a large degree of flexibility while maintaining efficiency and producing realistic solutions by relying on the generative capabilities of the highly compressed autoencoder. We evaluate our method on nuPlan and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, showing how latent space search can be used for a variety of guided behavior generation tasks, achieving strong performance for closed-loop motion planning and multi-agent guided scenario synthesis without requiring any task-specific training.
papers.comment: To appear in the Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种生成式框架，将深度学习与基于模型的运动规划结合。通过学习高压缩率自编码器，将运动规划问题转化为在层次化离散令牌的潜空间中的搜索，从而在保持灵活性的同时生成逼真解。在nuPlan和Waymo Open Motion Dataset上验证了闭环运动规划和多智能体场景合成的有效性。
Motivation: 深度学习在运动规划中展现了强大能力，但模型基算法（如搜索或优化）因灵活性和领域知识集成能力仍不可或缺。现有方法两者分离，缺乏统一框架。
Method: 学习一个高压缩率自编码器，其潜空间由层次化离散令牌组成。利用该空间的结构，直接在令牌空间中进行搜索以优化任意测试时指定的目标函数，无需特定任务训练。
Result: 在nuPlan和Waymo Open Motion Dataset上，该方法在闭环运动规划和多智能体引导场景合成任务中取得了强性能。
Conclusion: 潜空间搜索能够结合生成模型的真实感与基于搜索的灵活性，为运动规划提供统一框架，且无需针对每个任务重新训练。

papers.title: No Adaptation Without Observation: Observability-Constrained Test-Time Prompt Tuning for LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR semantic segmentation often degrades under real-world deployment due to evolving sensing conditions, while collecting new annotations for retraining is impractical. Test-time adaptation (TTA) updates model parameters online using pseudo-label supervision, but directly applying standard TTA strategies to LiDAR data is challenging. Because pseudo-label reliability is spatially heteroscedastic under range-dependent sparsity and occlusion, uniform updates on globally shared parameters can inject unstable gradients and destabilize adaptation. We propose a geometry-constrained test-time prompt tuning framework for LiDAR semantic segmentation. Our method estimates per-location sensing reliability from depth-consistent beam terminations and neighborhood support, and uses it to reweight spatial supervision. Adaptation is confined to lightweight prompt adapters inserted into a frozen backbone, with spatial gating to prevent unreliable regions from perturbing globally shared representations. A temporally smoothed prototype alignment strategy further stabilizes online updates by accumulating reliable semantic evidence over time. Experiments on standard LiDAR benchmarks demonstrate improved adaptation stability and segmentation performance under deployment variations without additional annotations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对LiDAR语义分割在部署时因传感条件变化而性能下降的问题，提出一种几何约束的测试时提示调优框架。通过逐位置感知可靠性估计和空间门控，将适应限制在轻量级提示适配器内，避免不可靠区域干扰全局表示。时间平滑的原型对齐策略进一步稳定在线更新。在标准LiDAR基准上验证了改进的适应稳定性和分割性能。
Motivation: LiDAR语义分割在实际部署中常因传感条件变化而退化，但重新收集标注不现实。现有测试时适应方法直接用于LiDAR数据时，伪标签可靠性在空间上非均匀，导致全局参数更新不稳定。
Method: 提出几何约束的测试时提示调优：从深度一致的波束终止和邻域支持估计每位置传感可靠性，并用于加权空间监督；冻结骨干网络，仅更新插入的轻量级提示适配器，并通过空间门控防止不可靠区域扰动全局表示；采用时间平滑的原型对齐策略累积可靠语义证据。
Result: 在标准LiDAR基准上，该方法在部署变化下提升了适应稳定性和分割性能，且无需额外标注。
Conclusion: 本文强调通过显式建模感知可靠性和约束适应范围，可以稳定LiDAR语义分割的测试时适应。

papers.title: Physics-informed Conditional Normalizing Flows for Angles-only Cislunar Orbit Determination
papers.abstract_en: Generative Astrodynamics is advanced in this work by extending generative modelling to an orbit determination problem in the cislunar environment. The task is formulated as conditional density estimation, aiming to infer the probability distribution of the initial state from angles-only measurements over short observation arcs. A normalising flow is trained on perturbed topocentric observations from Near Rectilinear Halo Orbits, enabling a flexible and potentially multimodal posterior representation. Given new measurements, the learned density is sampled to generate statistically consistent and physics-informed state hypotheses. These estimates are refined via nonlinear least-squares minimisation, providing a competitive warm start for classical algorithms.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将生成式模型应用于地月空间（cislunar）中仅角度观测的轨道确定问题，使用条件归一化流（conditional normalizing flow）从短弧段角度测量中推断初始状态的概率分布，并通过非线性最小二乘进行精化。
Motivation: 地月环境中的轨道确定面临观测弧段短、测量类型单一（仅角度）的挑战，传统方法难以有效捕获后验分布的多峰性。
Method: 采用归一化流（normalizing flow）作为条件密度估计器，训练数据来自近直线晕轨道（NRHO）上的摄动地心角度观测，生成物理信息一致的状态假设，再通过非线性最小二乘优化得到最终估计。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但表明该方法能为经典算法提供有竞争力的热启动，并生成统计一致且物理信息的状态假设。
Conclusion: 该工作将生成式建模扩展到地月空间轨道确定，展示了归一化流在条件密度估计中的有效性，尤其适用于短弧段、仅角度观测场景。

papers.title: ShardNet: Training Neural Controllers with Hard, Non-Convex Constraints
papers.abstract_en: While neural network control policies are powerful, their deployment on safety critical systems depends on ensuring that they obey strict constraints. Existing work often treats safety as a metric to optimize for, which competes with other performance objectives, if training converges at all. Instead, we introduce ShardNet, a neural network architecture that strictly enforces unions of polyhedral constraints by construction, using a differentiable projection layer parameterized by a classification network. The key insight is to embed safety into the neural network's structure, allowing performance to be optimized independently because formal safety guarantees are always given. In contrast with existing neural architectures that can only enforce simple convex constraints, ShardNet enables the first safe-by-construction synthesis of forward-invariant neural network controllers on closed-loop systems where safety constraints are expressed as nonconvex unions of polyhedras or learned value function level sets. To support this, we also introduce a technique to verify and train such value functions correctly as rectified linear unit (ReLU) networks, which has not previously been possible. On double integrator benchmarks drawn from the literature, ShardNet policies maintain 100% safety on verified sets and achieves significantly lower objective loss compared to existing formal methods. Furthermore, our value function training technique also produces safe sets more than 3 times larger than existing verification approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ShardNet是一种神经网络架构，通过可微投影层严格强制执行多面体约束的并集，实现安全关键系统中的控制器合成。该方法首次实现了非凸约束下闭环系统的前向不变性神经网络控制器合成，并在双积分器基准上保持100%安全性且损失更低。
Motivation: 现有方法通常将安全性作为优化指标，与性能目标竞争且训练不稳定；缺乏严格满足非凸约束的神经网络架构。
Method: 提出ShardNet架构，包含一个分类网络参数化的可微投影层，将多面体约束的并集直接嵌入网络结构；同时引入验证和训练ReLU值函数的技术。
Result: 在双积分器基准上，ShardNet策略在验证集上保持100%安全性，目标损失显著低于现有形式化方法；值函数训练技术产生的安全集比现有验证方法大3倍以上。
Conclusion: 通过将安全性嵌入网络结构，ShardNet实现了性能优化与形式化安全保证的解耦，适用于非凸约束的闭环控制。

papers.title: Quality-Aware Modulation for Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Modern text-to-image diffusion models, such as diffusion transformers (DiT), rely on timestep or prompt embeddings to modulate the strength of the denoising process in each timestep. While this modulation communicates the current noise level, it does not provide any quality-aware information, which can lead to generated images that are unaligned, visually inconsistent, and lacking in fidelity. In this paper, we propose the Quality Representation Module (QRM), a lightweight transformer module that learns a quality-aware representation based on existing model inputs, and produces a set of vectors $M_{qrm}$. These vectors adjust the adaptive LayerNorm modulation within the DiT transformer blocks, thereby injecting a quality-sensitive signal into the denoising parameters. The QRM introduces no significant changes to the sampling schedule or diffusion backbone. Experiments include ablations on QRM training losses and architectures, as well as empirical results demonstrating consistent image quality improvements over baseline DiT-based models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对扩散变换器（DiT）在文本到图像生成中依赖时间步或提示嵌入进行调制，缺乏质量感知信息导致生成图像不一致的问题，提出质量表示模块（QRM）。QRM是一个轻量级transformer模块，从现有模型输入学习质量感知表示，生成向量集M_qrm，用于调整DiT变换器块中的自适应层归一化调制，从而将质量敏感信号注入去噪参数。实验表明QRM能在不改变采样调度或扩散主干的情况下，持续提升图像质量。
Motivation: 现有扩散变换器使用时间步或提示嵌入调制去噪强度，但缺乏质量感知信息，导致生成图像在对齐性、视觉一致性和保真度方面不足。
Method: 提出质量表示模块（QRM），一个轻量级transformer模块，基于现有模型输入学习质量感知表示，输出向量集M_qrm，用于调整DiT变换器块中的自适应层归一化调制，注入质量敏感信号。
Result: 消融实验研究了QRM的训练损失和架构，实证结果表明在基线DiT模型上持续提升了图像质量。
Conclusion: QRM可以有效提升扩散变换器的图像生成质量，且无需改变采样调度或扩散主干。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Personalizing Marketplace Policies with Competing Objectives and Constrained Experiments: Evidence from a Job Marketplace
papers.abstract_en: Two-sided marketplaces connect distinct user groups whose interests often conflict -- improving outcomes on one side could degrade the other side's experience. To address this challenge, we deploy an integrated framework for personalizing free-value thresholds -- a policy governing the scope of complimentary services for job listings -- across a two-sided job marketplace connecting millions of employers and job seekers. Our personalized policy delivers statistically significant and economically sizable lift in the target metric while respecting engagement guardrail constraints. Direct application of standard uplift methods proves insufficient here for two reasons. First, cross-side externalities demand multi-objective optimization: maximizing employer-side metrics risks harming job seeker engagement, with effects varying substantially across job segments. Second, marketplace interference necessitates cluster-level randomization, limiting us to few discrete treatment levels -- effectively a form of positivity violation that rules out methods designed for continuous treatments. We contribute an integrated framework with three components. Our ensemble-based hybrid ranking models target and guardrail metrics separately, cutting guardrail risk by over 10% for equivalent target gains compared to single-objective approaches. A treatment effect extrapolation method extends our estimates from limited experimental variation to untested policy levels, relying on monotonicity assumptions that we validate empirically. Finally, we present production deployment, where post-launch data confirms both extrapolation accuracy and guardrail compliance. Our deployed system demonstrates that principled methodology can enable meaningful personalization even when experiments are severely constrained and different objectives compete -- common conditions that characterize many real-world marketplaces.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at ACM SIGKDD 2026 (Applied Data Science Track)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对双面市场中不同用户群体利益冲突的问题，在职位招聘平台上部署了一个集成框架，用于个性化定价阈值，在满足参与度约束的同时提升目标指标。由于跨边外部性和市场干扰，标准提升方法不适用，作者提出了包含混合排名模型、处理效应外推和部署验证的框架。
Motivation: 双面市场中雇主和求职者利益冲突，现有方法难以同时优化多目标，且实验约束（聚类随机化、少数离散处理水平）限制了个性化策略的应用。
Method: 提出三组件集成框架：1) 集成混合排名模型分别预测目标指标和警戒指标，相比单目标方法对等目标收益降低10%以上警戒风险；2) 基于单调性假设的处理效应外推方法，将有限实验变差扩展到未测试的政策水平；3) 生产部署验证外推准确性和警戒合规。
Result: 个性化政策在目标指标上带来统计显著且经济显著的提升，同时遵守参与度约束。部署后数据确认了外推准确性和警戒合规。
Conclusion: 即使实验严重受限且目标竞争（真实市场常见条件），原则性方法也能实现有意义的个性化。摘要强调了该框架在双面市场中的有效性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RoPoLL: Robust Panel of LLM Judges
papers.abstract_en: The LLM Jury, a Panel of LLM Evaluators (PoLL) reporting consensus scores, has become a practical alternative to single-judge LLM evaluation, yet its statistical behavior remains poorly understood. We formalize the LLM Jury under the Huber contamination model and show that PoLL incurs unbounded bias under any positive contamination, regardless of jury size, whenever a single judge fails in a biased, LLM-typical way (mode collapse, sycophancy, safety refusal). Framing jury consensus as classical robust mean estimation, we propose RoPoLL (Robust Panel of LLM-as-Judge), which preserves the PoLL panel but replaces the aggregation function with a robust mean estimator, instantiated with the geometric median (GM): tuning-free, with the optimal finite-sample breakdown point 1/2. A finite-sample error bound and a matching information-theoretic minimax lower bound agree on the parametric rate sigma*sqrt(d/N) and differ on the breakdown floor by a factor of sqrt(d), a statistical-computational gap that polynomial-time RoPoLL pays relative to the intractable Tukey halfspace median. Across 13 open-weight judges (4B-675B), three reward-model benchmarks, and four corruption regimes at rates up to 50%, RoPoLL dominates PoLL on every biased corruption type: by about 19% on cross-dimensional attacks at matched compute, and by orders of magnitude on heavy-tailed Byzantine adversaries. A 3-judge RoPoLL committee at 38B beats Mistral-Large-3 (675B) by 1.31x on HelpSteer-2 under 30% bimodal-random corruption, an 18x parameter advantage at better accuracy; a Noisy-GT control confirms the premium is paid against biased contamination, not benign imprecision.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了RoPoLL，一种鲁棒的LLM陪审团评估方法。作者在Huber污染模型下形式化LLM陪审团，证明传统平均聚合在单法官失效时会导致无界偏差。RoPoLL使用几何中位数作为鲁棒均值估计，具有最优有限样本崩溃点1/2，并提供了有限样本误差界和匹配的极小极大下界。实验表明，在多种有偏腐败类型上，RoPoLL显著优于传统PoLL，例如在cross-dimensional attacks上提升约19%，在重尾拜占庭对手下提升数个数量级。
Motivation: 现有LLM陪审团（PoLL）的统计行为未被充分理解，当单个法官以典型LLM失效模式（模式崩溃、谄媚、安全拒绝）产生有偏错误时，传统平均聚合会导致无界偏差，无论陪审团规模多大。
Method: 将陪审团共识问题重新定义为鲁棒均值估计，用几何中位数替换平均聚合函数，无需调参且具有最优有限样本崩溃点1/2。推导了有限样本误差界，并与不可解的Tukey halfspace中位数对比，揭示了统计计算差距。
Result: 在13个开源法官（4B-675B）、三个奖励模型基准和四种腐败机制（最高50%污染率）下，RoPoLL在每种有偏腐败类型上均优于PoLL：cross-dimensional attacks提升约19%，重尾拜占庭对手提升数个数量级。3法官RoPoLL委员会（38B）在HelpSteer-2上以30%双峰随机腐败下超过Mistral-Large-3（675B）1.31倍，参数效率优势18倍。
Conclusion: RoPoLL通过鲁棒均值估计有效缓解了LLM陪审团中的有偏污染问题，理论与实验一致，但存在统计计算差距。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SGD at the Edge of Stability: Stochastic Stabilization with Large Learning Rates
papers.abstract_en: Modern deep learning has been shown to operate at the edge of stability, routinely using learning rates far larger than those justified by classical optimization theory. Most prior analyses of the edge of stability phenomenon focus on deterministic gradient descent, leaving the stochastic setting largely unexplored. In this work, we provide sharp convergence guarantees for Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) applied to the multiclass cross-entropy loss, for both linear classifiers and two-layer neural networks. We show that the stochasticity of SGD may cause the dynamics to alternate between an edge-of-stability regime that is dominated by curvature-driven oscillations, and a stable regime in which the expected loss decreases at a controlled rate. Despite that, we prove that SGD self-stabilizes the dynamics, ensuring that the iterates return to stability in a fixed number of iterations and allowing convergence in the best-iterate sense even with large learning rates. Experiments validate our theoretical findings and illustrate the benefits of SGD in the large-stepsize regime.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究随机梯度下降（SGD）在多类交叉熵损失下的大学习率行为，证明SGD能够自我稳定，在边缘稳定性（edge of stability）和稳定状态之间交替，并在最佳迭代意义下收敛。理论结果适用于线性分类器和两层神经网络，实验验证了理论发现。
Motivation: 经典优化理论无法解释现代深度学习中使用的大学习率，且先前对边缘稳定性现象的分析主要集中于确定性梯度下降，随机情况尚待探索。
Method: 提供SGD应用于多类交叉熵损失的收敛保证，通过分析随机性导致曲率驱动振荡和期望损失可控下降的交替，证明SGD在固定迭代次数内自我稳定。
Result: 理论证明SGD在大学习率下以最佳迭代意义收敛，实验验证了自我稳定特性和大步长下的优势。
Conclusion: SGD的随机性足以在边缘稳定性附近实现动态自稳定，确保收敛，扩展了优化理论对大学习率情况的理解。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Behavior Cloning is Not All You Need: The Optimality of On-Policy Distillation for Noisy Expert Feedback
papers.abstract_en: Imitation Learning is a natural framework for learning in sequential decision-making systems and has emerged as the dominant paradigm through which we understand language model training. A central puzzle is that, while in theory offline IL can be horizon-free and optimal, in practice online methods such as on-policy distillation often outperform offline methods such as supervised fine-tuning. We propose a noisy expert model to explain this gap, in which the learner only has access to a noisy version of the expert's policy, but wishes to compete against the reward achieved by a clean expert, motivated by the fact that in many applications, e.g. training language models to perform long chains of thought, the expert is often imperfect. In this setting, we show a sharp separation between offline and online IL. Offline learning from noisy trajectories is fundamentally hard: to compete with the clean expert, the sample complexity must grow exponentially, in contradistinction to the clean expert setting where no explicit horizon dependence exists. In contrast, we prove that online interaction with the noisy expert via a novel variant of OPD enables polynomial dependence on the horizon in general. We further show that, under a natural condition on the expert noise distribution, which we show to be necessary for any horizon-free sample complexity, one can obtain such a guarantee, although our proposed algorithm sacrifices statistical efficiency in its dependence on the size of the policy class. Our analysis leads to an alternative loss function that is commonly considered empirically for LM training. We further provide algorithms and lower bounds, and extend our results to the more realistic setting of unknown corruption when the clean expert is deterministic, thereby providing a theoretical foundation for why OPD can outperform SFT when training language models from imperfect teachers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出噪声专家模型来解释在线模仿学习（如on-policy distillation）为何优于离线方法（如SFT）。理论证明，离线学习噪声轨迹的样本复杂度随水平指数增长，而在线方法（OPD变体）能达到多项式依赖，从而为语言模型训练中OPD优于SFT提供理论依据。
Motivation: 现有模仿学习理论认为离线方法可达到无水平依赖的最优性，但实践中在线方法（如on-policy distillation）往往更优。本文通过引入噪声专家模型来弥合这一理论与实践的差距。
Method: 定义噪声专家模型，其中学习器只能访问有噪声的专家策略，但目标是与干净专家的奖励竞争。提出OPD的变体算法，并理论分析其样本复杂度；同时针对干净专家为确定性的未知腐败场景进行扩展。
Result: 离线学习噪声轨迹需要指数级样本复杂度（与干净专家设置的无水平依赖形成对比），而在线OPD变体在一般条件下实现多项式依赖，但统计效率依赖于策略类别大小。
Conclusion: 本文为在线模仿学习（OPD）优于离线方法（SFT）提供了理论解释，尤其适用于不完美教师训练语言模型的场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Conditional Tropical Cyclogenesis Rates via Rare-Event Sampling in a Neural Weather Emulator
papers.abstract_en: We couple Forward Flux Sampling (FFS), a non-equilibrium rare-event technique from statistical mechanics, to a neural weather emulator (SDL-WXFormer, 1° grid spacing) to estimate conditional tropical cyclogenesis rates, or how often a tropical cyclone achieves a hurricane-level central pressure, without modifying model dynamics. Tropical cyclogenesis rates vary by orders of magnitude across regimes, yet direct ensemble sampling cannot resolve this variability at operationally feasible ensemble sizes. FFS decomposes the rare disturbance to mature cyclone intensification path into a flux through an initial interface pressure and a product of conditional crossing probabilities across four intermediate interface pressures. We use the 1° emulator because FFS requires O(10^4) model trajectories per initial condition, and because the model's calibrated stochastic layers provide the necessary exploratory spread. Applied to 98 Atlantic basin initial conditions spanning 21 August - 8 October 2022, FFS resolves genesis rates spanning nearly three orders of magnitude, capturing a seasonal cycle qualitatively consistent with observations. A self-consistency check comparing FFS rates to independent direct-sampling rates yields a mean ratio of 1.03 +/- 0.15 across all initial conditions. Computational enhancement factors range from 3X (most active environment) to 140X (most suppressed), with a geometric mean of 14X. Three case studies illustrate the physical diagnostics the method provides: the rate-limiting step is initial tropical organization for the Earl environment, uniformly high crossing probabilities for the Fiona precursor environment, and a compound barrier at the final intensification stages for the Ian environment. More efficient emulators would enable application of FFS to finer resolutions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文将非平衡罕见事件采样方法 (Forward Flux Sampling, FFS) 与神经天气模拟器 (SDL-WXFormer, 1°分辨率) 耦合，估计条件热带气旋生成率（即热带气旋达到飓风级中心气压的频率）。FFS 将罕见发展路径分解为初始界面通量和中间界面条件穿越概率的乘积，在 98 个大西洋初始条件下，FFS 解析出跨越近三个数量级的生成率，与季节观测定性一致，计算加速因子平均 14 倍。
Motivation: 热带气旋生成率在不同环境中变化巨大，但直接系综采样在业务可行的系综规模下无法解析这种变化，需要更高效的方法。
Method: 使用 Forward Flux Sampling (FFS) 将罕见扰动到成熟气旋的增强路径分解为初始界面压力通量和四个中间界面压力的条件穿越概率，耦合至 1° 分辨率的神经天气模拟器 SDL-WXFormer，利用其校准的随机层提供探索性扩散。
Result: 在 98 个 2022 年 8-10 月大西洋初始条件下，FFS 解析出近三个数量级的生成率，季节循环与观测定性一致；自洽性检查显示 FFS 与独立直接采样比值为 1.03±0.15；计算加速因子从 3 倍 (最活跃环境) 到 140 倍 (最抑制环境)，几何平均 14 倍。三个案例显示不同速率限制步骤。
Conclusion: FFS 能以低成本估计热带气旋生成率，效率提升显著，但需要更高效的模拟器以实现更高分辨率应用。
Relevance: 45

papers.title: Budget-Adaptive Routing: Skipping the Weak When the Strong Answers Anyway
papers.abstract_en: Edge-cloud inference collaborations are often designed with a routing estimator that decides whether to offload each frame from weak models at the edge to stronger models in the cloud. Existing systems place the routing estimator after the weak detector, so the weak forward pass still runs even on frames that are later offloaded. In this paper, we argue that this weak-conditioned design can be suboptimal when the offload budget varies. First, we present a competitive weak-skipping estimator (0.153 GFLOPs, about 29x lighter than the weak detector at 4.49 GFLOPs) that extracts routing signal from raw pixels, outperforming the common after-weak placement weak-conditioned baselines. Second, we show that neither weak-skipping nor weak-conditioned placement dominates across the full operating curve, and we propose budget-adaptive routing, which selects between them by offload budget via two offline-tuned thresholds. On PASCAL VOC, our budget-adaptive router traces the upper accuracy envelope of both fixed placements across the operating range. Our method reduces per-frame latency by up to 19.1 ms (about 30% lower at rho = 0.9). Besides outperforming SOTA methods, it is surprisingly stronger than the strong model (+1.7 pp over the strong model's peak mAP) at some operating points with far less compute. Artifacts are available at https://github.com/ViGeng/bgt-ada
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. To appear in the ACM SIGCOMM 2026 Workshop on Networks for AI Computing (NAIC '26), Denver, CO, USA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出预算自适应路由（budget-adaptive routing），在边缘-云推理系统中根据卸载预算动态切换弱跳过（weak-skipping）和弱条件（weak-conditioned）两种放置策略。该方法包含一个轻量级弱跳过估计器（0.153 GFLOPs），直接从像素提取路由信号，并通过两个离线阈值自适应选择策略。在PASCAL VOC上，该路由方法能追踪两种固定放置的准确率上界，帧延迟降低最多19.1ms（约30%），并在某些操作点上比强模型峰值mAP高1.7个百分点。
Motivation: 现有边缘-云推理系统将路由估计器置于弱检测器之后，导致即使要卸载的帧也需运行弱前向传播，这在卸载预算变化时效率低下。
Method: 提出一个29倍轻量级（0.153 GFLOPs）的弱跳过估计器，直接从原始像素预测卸载必要性；进一步提出预算自适应路由，通过两个离线调优的阈值根据卸载预算动态选择弱跳过或弱条件放置。
Result: 在PASCAL VOC上，预算自适应路由能追踪两种固定放置的准确率上界；相比固定策略，帧延迟降低最多19.1ms（约30%）；在某些操作点上，比强模型（strong model）峰值mAP高1.7个百分点，且计算量更少。
Conclusion: 预算自适应路由通过轻量级弱跳过估计器和动态阈值选择，在准确率和延迟之间实现了比固定放置策略更优的平衡，甚至在某些情况下超越强模型。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Why Solve It Twice? Hierarchical Accumulation of Skills for Transfer-Efficient ML Engineering
papers.abstract_en: ML engineering agents waste compute rediscovering known techniques because every competition is a cold start. We present HASTE, a hierarchical multi-agent system that organizes cross-competition knowledge into three scope tiers (global, domain, and competition-specific), each coupled to a matching agent level. An orchestrator coordinates domain specialists and promotes learning between tiers via LLM-driven abstraction. A controlled ablation provides evidence for scoped loading: holding a 159-skill inventory constant across 8 competitions, tiered loading achieves a 100% medal rate while flat loading reaches only 62.5%, the same medal rate as loading no skills, and consumes 2x the output tokens. On the full MLE-Bench Lite benchmark (22 Kaggle competitions), HASTE reaches a medal rate of 77.3% using Claude Sonnet 4.6 at 12h per competition. In a cold-start run, the system begins with no accumulated skills. In warm-start runs, it reloads skills learned from earlier competitions, using only global and domain-level skills for transfer across competitions. Warm starts use 52% fewer refinement iterations, and the fraction of proposed changes kept by the agent rises from 42% at low inventory to 85% once 50+ skills are available. These results suggest that better knowledge organization can partly substitute for model strength and compute budget in ML-engineering agents.
papers.comment: 19 pages. Accepted at the ICML 2026 Workshop on Deep Learning for Code (DL4C)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出HASTE，一种分层多智能体系统，用于ML工程代理在跨竞赛中高效积累和复用技能。系统将知识组织为三个层级（全局、领域、竞赛特定），通过编排器协调领域专家并利用LLM驱动抽象促进层级间学习。在MLE-Bench Lite基准上，HASTE使用Claude Sonnet 4.6达到77.3%的奖牌率，且热启动相比冷启动减少52%的改进迭代次数，表明更好的知识组织可以部分替代模型强度和计算预算。
Motivation: ML工程代理在每次竞赛中从头开始，浪费计算资源重复发现已知技术；现有方法缺乏有效的跨竞赛知识积累与迁移机制。
Method: 提出分层多智能体系统HASTE，包含三个作用域层级（全局、领域、竞赛特定）及对应的智能体层级；编排器协调领域专家，通过LLM驱动抽象促进层级间技能迁移。
Result: 在159个技能的固定库存下，分层加载在8个竞赛中达到100%奖牌率，而平面加载仅62.5%且消耗2倍输出令牌。在完整MLE-Bench Lite基准（22个Kaggle竞赛）上，HASTE奖牌率为77.3%（Claude Sonnet 4.6，每竞赛12小时）。热启动使用52%更少的改进迭代，且智能体保留的变更比例从低库存时的42%升至50+技能时的85%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调更好的知识组织可以部分替代模型强度和计算预算，提高ML工程代理的迁移效率和性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Investigating Multi-Agent Deliberation in Law
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence is increasingly applied to the field of law, and has the potential to increase access to justice. One particular movement that is gaining traction is that of agentic AI, wherein AI agents, based on Large Language Models (LLMs) can take autonomous actions. In particular, multi-agent approaches in the legal domain remain largely unexplored. In this paper, we investigate multi-agent deliberation methods for legal reasoning tasks using LLMs. We explore multi-agent deliberation (MAD) and introduce two novel multi-agent frameworks inspired by courtroom procedures and legal argumentation. Our experiments on both legal and non-legal benchmarks reveal that multi-agent frameworks achieve comparable overall performance to baseline large language models, but produce significantly distinct answers. Notably, these approaches can successfully solve cases that the baseline fails to address, and vice versa. We conduct a qualitative evaluation and highlight scenarios where multi-agent frameworks outperform monolithic approaches. For example, multi-agent approaches appear better suited for answering questions that require critical thinking from multiple perspectives. Our work positions multi-agent systems as a promising direction for AI in the legal domain, while demonstrating the potential of law-inspired multi-agent approaches for deliberation.
papers.comment: This manuscript has been accepted for presentation at the AIDA2J Workshop during the 21st International Conference of AI & Law in Singapore, June 8 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多智能体商议（MAD）方法在法律推理任务中的应用，提出两种受法庭程序和法律论证启发的新框架。实验表明，多智能体框架在整体性能上与基线大语言模型相当，但生成显著不同的答案，且能成功解决基线无法解决的问题。定性评估显示，多智能体方法在需要多角度批判性思考的问题上表现更优。
Motivation: 多智能体方法在法律领域尚未被充分探索，本文旨在探究其潜力以填补这一空白。
Method: 提出两种新的多智能体商议框架，分别模拟法庭程序和法律论证过程，基于大语言模型（LLM）代理进行多轮商议。
Result: 在法律和非法律基准上，多智能体框架的整体性能与基线LLM相当，但输出答案显著不同，且能互补地解决基线失败的问题。定性分析表明，多智能体方法更擅长需要多视角批判性思考的问题。
Conclusion: 多智能体系统是AI在法律领域的有前途方向，法律启发的多智能体商议方法具有进一步研究的价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Human Feedback Shapes AI-generated Community Notes
papers.abstract_en: Community Notes, a bridging-based crowd-sourced fact-checking system, has emerged as a new mechanism for moderating misleading information on social media and has been adopted by major platforms including X, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and TikTok. Since its introduction, there has been an open question about what role AI could play in scaling and optimizing the system. Recently, X extended its Community Notes system by introducing Collaborative Notes: notes initially drafted by an LLM and iteratively refined based on feedback from human contributors. In this work, we systematically analyze the complete corpus of 19,146 collaborative notes and 211,850 instances of human feedback. First, we develop a taxonomy of human suggestions for improving AI-generated note drafts and find that suggestions involving factual corrections and additional context are most likely to be incorporated, while subjective policy judgments rarely are. Second, we examine changes in helpfulness across versions of collaborative notes and find that human feedback leads to more helpful notes, with the greatest impact coming from suggestions that challenge the main claim in the previous draft, particularly when submitted by more active contributors. Finally, we find that although collaborative notes improve through human feedback, they reach helpful status and are shown on the platform at lower rates than human-only or AI-only notes, with limited human participation emerging as a key bottleneck. Nevertheless, rather than serving as a weaker substitute, collaborative notes tend to play a complementary role, predominantly targeting posts that do not attract human-only or AI-only notes. Our analysis provides an initial description of efforts to use AI to improve crowdsourced content moderation in a real-world moderation system and outlines pathways for future improvements to such features.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统分析了X平台引入的协作笔记（Collaborative Notes）机制，即由LLM草拟、人工反馈迭代优化的AI辅助事实核查系统。基于19,146条协作笔记和211,850次人类反馈，建立了改进建议分类体系，发现事实修正和补充上下文更易被采纳，主观政策判断则很少。人类反馈能提升笔记的有用性，但协作笔记达到有用状态并在平台上展示的比例低于纯人工或纯AI笔记，且人工参与不足是瓶颈。协作笔记主要补充覆盖无人工或AI笔记的帖子。
Motivation: 自社区笔记系统推出以来，AI如何扩展和优化该机制一直是一个开放问题。需要系统评估X平台刚推出的协作笔记（LLM起草+人工反馈）的实际效果和瓶颈。
Method: 收集完整的协作笔记语料（19,146条笔记和211,850次反馈），开发改进建议的编码分类体系，量化不同建议被采纳的概率；通过版本对比分析人类反馈对笔记有用性的影响；并比较协作笔记与纯人工、纯AI笔记的展示率和参与情况。
Result: 事实修正和补充上下文的建议最容易被采纳；挑战主论断的建议对提升有用性贡献最大，尤其来自活跃贡献者。协作笔记达到有用状态并被展示的比例低于纯人工或纯AI笔记，但主要覆盖其它两种笔记未覆盖的帖子，起互补作用。
Conclusion: 基于真实世界数据揭示了AI辅助社区笔记的优势（利用人类反馈改进）和局限（参与度低导致展示率低），并为未来改进提供了方向。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 基于真实世界数据揭示了AI辅助社区笔记的优势（利用人类反馈改进）和局限（参与度低导致展示率低），并为未来改进提供了方向。

papers.title: Structure-Regularized Interpretable TCR-Epitope Prediction
papers.abstract_en: T cell receptor (TCR)-epitope binding prediction is essential for understanding adaptive immunity and developing immunotherapies. Existing sequence- and structure-based models often generalize poorly to unseen epitopes and provide limited interpretability. Furthermore, the impact of generated structures on model learning remains unclear. We present TCR-SRIM, a structure-regularized interpretable-by-design model that combines protein language model embeddings with interpretable contact prototypes to capture residue-level TCR-epitope interactions. TCR-SRIM achieves state-of-the-art predictive performance and improved interpretation quality on the TCR-XAI benchmark. Using its inherent interpretability, we further evaluate the effect of generated structures on model learning. While structures predicted by AlphaFold3, TCRModel2, and tFold-TCR yield competitive performance, they lead to less accurate interaction patterns and reduced binding-site diversity than experimentally-resolved structures. Our results highlight limitations of current structure prediction models for TCR-epitope learning and demonstrate the value of interpretable-by-design models for studying generated biological structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TCR-SRIM，一种结构正则化、可解释的TCR-表位结合预测模型，结合蛋白质语言模型嵌入与可解释接触原型，在TCR-XAI基准上达到最优预测性能和更好的解释质量。通过模型内在可解释性，发现AlphaFold3等预测的结构虽然预测性能不错，但导致比实验解析结构更不准确的相互作用模式和更低的结合位点多样性，揭示了当前结构预测模型在TCR-表位学习中的局限性。
Motivation: 现有TCR-表位结合预测模型对未见表位泛化能力差且可解释性有限，生成结构对模型学习的影响不明确。
Method: TCR-SRIM结合蛋白质语言模型嵌入与可解释接触原型，通过结构正则化捕获残基级相互作用，设计为内在可解释。
Result: 在TCR-XAI基准上达到最优预测性能并提升解释质量；使用AlphaFold3等预测结构时，性能与实验结构相当，但相互作用模式准确性和结合位点多样性降低。
Conclusion: 当前结构预测模型用于TCR-表位学习存在局限性，强调了可解释性模型在研究生成本结构中的价值。

papers.title: GRAPE: Graph-Augmented Prototype Explanations for Interactive Medical Image Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Prototype-based medical image classifiers present three clinical limitations: they treat findings as independent, silently amplify unsafe physician feedback, and require full retraining whenever a new finding is needed. We present GRAPE (Graph-Augmented Prototype Explanations), a unified architecture that addresses all three challenges. First, a Graph Attention Task Head models anatomical concept co-occurrence, boosting macro-F1 by +13.8,pp over the prototype baseline on TBX11K. Second, a Concept-Mismatch Safety Check - the first such mechanism in prototype-based medical classifiers - warns when the model's dominant finding inside a doctor-drawn region conflicts with the claimed label, catching 85% of erroneous annotations versus 51% for MC-Dropout with no extra inference cost. Third, Open-Vocabulary Prototype Anchoring aligns visual prototypes to clinical text, allowing a new finding to be added from a single labeled image without modifying any other component. On NIH ChestX-ray14, one Effusion example recovers full-supervision localization accuracy; on TBX11K, prototype maps achieve 2.6x better lesion localization than end-to-end baselines. All three capabilities add only +1~ms latency at interactive batch size. The project page is https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/GRAPE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GRAPE（图增强原型解释）架构，解决原型医学图像分类器的三个临床限制：独立处理发现、放大不安全医生反馈、新发现需完全重训练。通过图注意力任务头建模解剖概念共现，在TBX11K上macro-F1提升+13.8；概念不匹配安全检查可捕获85%错误标注；开放词汇原型锚定允许从单张标注图像添加新发现。
Motivation: 原型医学图像分类器将发现视为独立、静默放大不安全医生反馈，且每次添加新发现需完全重训练，限制了临床实用性和安全性。
Method: GRAPE包含三个组件：图注意力任务头建模概念共现；概念不匹配安全检查检测模型主导发现与标签冲突；开放词汇原型锚定将视觉原型与临床文本对齐。
Result: 在TBX11K上macro-F1提升+13.8 points；安全检测捕获85%错误标注（对比MC-Dropout的51%）；单张Effusion示例恢复全监督定位精度；原型图定位性能比端到端基线好2.6倍，仅增加1ms延迟。
Conclusion: GRAPE统一解决了原型分类器的三个问题，无需额外计算成本即可提升性能和安全性。

papers.title: Curvature-Guided Module Localization for Low-Rank Detoxification of Backdoored Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Backdoor attacks pose a serious threat to large language models (LLMs) by causing otherwise benign systems to produce attacker-specified malicious behavior when a hidden trigger is present. In this work, we study post hoc detoxification of backdoored LLMs in a practical setting where the defender has access to the poisoned model but does not wish to retrain the full network from scratch. We propose a mechanistically guided weight-space repair framework that first localizes modules involved in propagating trigger-induced behavior using activation patching and Fisher/K-FAC curvature analysis, and then applies targeted low-rank repair to only the most influential modules. We evaluate the method on poisoned variants of \texttt{Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct} with triggers inserted at the beginning, middle, and end of otherwise benign prompts. Results show that the proposed approach substantially suppresses trigger-conditioned malicious responses while preserving benign model behavior. These findings suggest that backdoor removal in LLMs can be formulated as a localized structural repair problem rather than only a broad behavioral alignment problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型的后门攻击，提出一种曲率引导的模块定位与低秩修复的解毒方法。通过激活修补和Fisher/K-FAC曲率分析定位传播触发行为的模块，仅对关键模块进行低秩修复，在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct上有效抑制触发条件下的恶意响应，同时保持良性行为。
Motivation: 后门攻击使大语言模型在隐藏触发条件下产生恶意行为，而现有解毒方法需要重训练或全局微调，不适用于仅可访问中毒模型且不想重训练的场景。
Method: 提出机械引导的权重空间修复框架：先使用激活修补和Fisher/K-FAC曲率分析定位参与传播触发行为的模块，然后仅对最相关模块进行目标低秩修复。
Result: 在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct的中毒变体上（触发器置于提示开头、中间、末尾），该方法显著抑制触发条件下的恶意响应，同时保持良性行为。
Conclusion: 研究表明大语言模型的后门移除可以形式化为局部结构修复问题，而不仅是广泛的行为对齐问题。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Knowledge-Driven Dimension Estimation from a Single Image -3D Asset Generation Technology for Digital Twin Construction
papers.abstract_en: In the verification of in-vehicle cameras, simulation technology using virtual spaces has advanced, enabling pre-evaluation of false detections and missed detections in various scenarios. However, discrepancies in the scale of the object being verified between the virtual and real environments can lead to a decrease in camera recognition performance. For traffic signs installed at high altitudes, distance measurement using LiDAR or stereo cameras is difficult, requiring size estimation from monocular images. This paper proposes a method for estimating the scale of an object by decomposing it into multiple structural elements and integrating external knowledge regarding design rules, geometric relationships, and conventional dimensions. Specifically, this method detects each component from a monocular image and estimates the size of each component by considering its structural relationships and dimensional consistency with surrounding elements. Furthermore, it generates a 3D asset of the object by reconstructing the estimated components. This method makes it possible to place 3D assets with a scale approximating the real environment within a digital twin space and is expected to contribute to improving the verification accuracy of in-vehicle cameras for autonomous driving in virtual environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种从单目图像估计物体尺度并生成3D资产的方法，用于数字孪生构建。方法将物体分解为结构元素，融合设计规则、几何关系和尺寸一致性等外部知识，从单目图像中检测各部件并估计尺寸，再重建为3D资产。应用目标是改善自动驾驶中车载相机在虚拟环境中的验证精度。
Motivation: 虚实环境中验证对象的尺度差异会导致相机识别性能下降，而高空交通标志难以用LiDAR或立体相机测距，需要从单目图像估计尺寸。
Method: 将物体分解为多个结构元素，从单目图像检测每个部件，利用设计规则、几何关系和周围元素的尺寸一致性来估计各部件尺寸，最后重建为3D资产。
Result: 摘要未报告具体数值结果，但声称该方法能生成尺度接近真实环境的3D资产，有望提高车载相机的验证精度。
Conclusion: 该方法可在数字孪生空间中放置尺度近似真实的3D资产，有助于提升自动驾驶虚拟环境中的相机验证准确性。

papers.title: Dynamic Prediction of Alternating Recurrent Events via Neural Network
papers.abstract_en: Alternating recurrent events -- event-times of a specific nature that trigger a secondary refractory period -- occur in a wide-range of fields, including behavioral science, criminal justice, and biostatistics. Analysis of these events requires careful attention to the statistical nuance, including correlated observations and repeated outcomes subject to potential censoring. We develop an online dynamic prediction framework appropriate for predicting subsequent alternating recurrent events, by developing neural network theory for a statistical audiences and applying inverse probability weighted pseudo-observations. The proposed model is applied to dynamically predict alternating recurrent event-free time, showing good performance in simulation, and outstanding capability in application to predicting periods of low mood for first-year medical residents. We close with a discussion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对交替复发事件（alternating recurrent events）的在线动态预测问题，开发了一个适用于统计受众的神经网络框架，结合逆概率加权伪观测方法。在模拟和实际应用（预测一年级医学生低情绪期）中展示了良好性能。
Motivation: 交替复发事件广泛存在于行为科学、刑事司法和生物统计等领域，其分析需处理相关观测和潜在删失，现有方法缺乏在线动态预测框架。
Method: 提出在线动态预测框架，利用神经网络理论并应用逆概率加权伪观测（inverse probability weighted pseudo-observations）来预测后续交替复发事件。
Result: 模拟实验显示良好性能，在实际应用中预测一年级医学生低情绪期的表现突出。
Conclusion: 该框架适用于交替复发事件的动态预测，但讨论部分未提及局限性或未来方向。

papers.title: Training Therapeutic Judges and Multi-Agent Systems for Human-Aligned Mental Health Support
papers.abstract_en: Large language models show promise for mental health support, yet therapeutic quality improves only when evaluation functions as an actionable control signal rather than a passive metric. We introduce a framework that formulates therapeutic response generation as a decision-refinement problem driven by multi-dimensional, human-aligned evaluation. In Stage I, we introduce TheraJudge, an open-source therapeutic evaluator trained via preference-based optimization on human-annotated data to produce reliable judgments across 7 psychological dimensions. In Stage II, we introduce TheraAgent, which operationalizes TheraJudge's evaluations through a coordinated refinement process with specialized Critic, Coach, and Therapist roles that translate evaluative signals into targeted response revisions. Empirically, TheraJudge achieves strong agreement with clinician ratings, with intraclass correlation coefficients (ICC = 0.87-0.95), surpassing supervised baselines and strong closed-source judges, particularly on critical dimensions such as Safety, Relevance, and Empathy. Acting on these evaluations, TheraAgent yields a +0.43 improvement in human-rated therapeutic quality (on a 5-point scale) under blind evaluation, with 96\% clinician inter-rater reliability. Low-quality responses ($\leq 3$) improve by +2.45 points with a 94\% recovery rate, demonstrating targeted correction of unsafe outputs. Overall, our results indicate that effective alignment of mental-health LLMs stems from acting on human-aligned evaluation, rather than relying solely on stronger generation. We release code at https://github.com/vis-nlp/TheraAlign.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段框架，通过多维度人类对齐评估来改进心理健康支持中的语言模型回复质量。第一阶段训练开源评估器TheraJudge，在7个心理维度上实现高可靠性评估（ICC=0.87-0.95）；第二阶段构建TheraAgent多智能体系统，利用Critic、Coach、Therapist角色协同优化回复。盲评显示，该方法使人类评定的治疗质量提升+0.43（5分制），且低质量回复（≤3分）提升+2.45分，恢复率94%。
Motivation: 现有大型语言模型在心理健康支持中缺乏可操作的评估反馈机制，导致治疗质量提升受限。作者旨在将评估从被动指标转化为可控控制信号。
Method: 采用两阶段框架：Stage I通过基于人类标注数据的偏好优化训练开源评估器TheraJudge，覆盖安全、相关、共情等7个心理维度；Stage II构建TheraAgent多智能体系统，包含Critic（评估）、Coach（指导）、Therapist（生成）三个角色，将评估信号转化为针对性回复修订。
Result: TheraJudge与临床医生评分的一致性高（ICC=0.87-0.95），超越监督基线及闭源强评估器。TheraAgent在盲评中使人类评定的治疗质量提升+0.43（5分制），临床医生间信度96%；低质量回复（≤3分）平均提升+2.45分，94%恢复率。
Conclusion: 研究表明，心理健康LLM的对齐效果依赖于将人类对齐评估作为行动信号而非仅靠更强生成模型。代码已开源。

summary_sections.method: 采用两阶段框架：Stage I通过基于人类标注数据的偏好优化训练开源评估器TheraJudge，覆盖安全、相关、共情等7个心理维度；Stage II构建TheraAgent多智能体系统，包含Critic（评估）、Coach（指导）、Therapist（生成）三个角色，将评估信号转化为针对性回复修订。
summary_sections.result: TheraJudge与临床医生评分的一致性高（ICC=0.87-0.95），超越监督基线及闭源强评估器。TheraAgent在盲评中使人类评定的治疗质量提升+0.43（5分制），临床医生间信度96%；低质量回复（≤3分）平均提升+2.45分，94%恢复率。
summary_sections.conclusion: 研究表明，心理健康LLM的对齐效果依赖于将人类对齐评估作为行动信号而非仅靠更强生成模型。代码已开源。

papers.title: A Systematic Approach to Multi-Agent AI from Advanced Regulatory Control Theory: Safe and Auditable LLM Operator Agents for Process Control
papers.abstract_en: Recent literature shows that large language models (LLMs) are useful for general-purpose tasks yet perform poorly on specific domain ones. One reason is the difficulty of supplying narrow context to a general-purpose model and of bounding the task it is asked to perform. It is possible to hypothesise that a multi-agent reformulation under process-control principles offers a route to address those points, since control theory provides a discipline of decomposing a system into elements of contained scope, each defending one controlled variable, with conflicts resolved by structural priority: MIN/MAX selector networks for CV-CV switching and split-range (split-parallel) logic for MV-MV switching. The present work proposes such a reformulation, derived from Advanced Regulatory Control (ARC) theory. Each feedback loop in the ARC chain is mapped to one specialised LLM operator agent carrying the loop's control-theoretic context (controlled variable, setpoint, chain priority, selector kind). The chain's interaction logic (MIN/MAX selectors, override paths) is encapsulated as a single orchestrator agent. Two orchestrator variants are tested: a deterministic rule chain, and a Claude-based LLM orchestrator at a slower tier. The control principles limit each agent's task and inform how its limitations are handled. The multi-agent system inherits the safety property of the ARC chain: every constraint conflict is resolved deterministically by the orchestrator, regardless of the LLM output. Evaluated on a dairy-barn ventilation case over a 4-day mixed-season scenario, Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct operator agents running offline on a 24 GB consumer GPU at a 5-minute cadence produce auditable trajectories, each paired with an operator-voice rationale that supports a control campaign logbook.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于先进调节控制（ARC）理论的多智能体 LLM 系统，用于过程控制。每个反馈回路被映射为一个专门的 LLM 操作员代理，承载控制理论上下文（控制变量、设定点、优先级、选择器类型），交互逻辑由编排器代理封装。在奶牛场通风案例中，使用 Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct 模型在 24GB 消费级 GPU 上以 5 分钟周期运行，产生可审计的轨迹和操作员语音理由。
Motivation: LLM 在通用任务上表现良好，但在特定领域任务中表现不佳，原因在于难以提供狭窄上下文并约束任务范围。多智能体重构结合过程控制原则有望解决这些问题。
Method: 基于 ARC 理论，将每个反馈回路映射为专门的 LLM 操作员代理，包含控制理论上下文；交互逻辑（MIN/MAX 选择器、覆盖路径）封装为编排器代理。测试了确定性规则链和基于 Claude 的 LLM 编排器两种变体。
Result: 在奶牛场通风案例（4天混合季节场景）中，Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct 代理离线运行于 24GB 消费级 GPU，以 5 分钟为周期，产生可审计的轨迹，每条轨迹附带操作员语音理由，支持控制活动日志。
Conclusion: 控制原则限制了每个代理的任务并处理其局限性；多智能体系统继承了 ARC 链的安全属性，所有约束冲突由编排器确定性地解决，与 LLM 输出无关。

papers.title: The Label Imitation Game: Turing Test Network for Zero-Shot Pseudo-Label Pruning
papers.abstract_en: Foundation model pseudo-labeling - labeling data strictly via zero-shot inference - enables massive scale, but performance is undermined by hallucinations that evade standard thresholds. To eliminate these errors, we introduce the Turing-inspired Label Imitation Game (LIG), a framework that formalizes pseudo-label pruning as an adversarial interrogation. Rather than filtering labels via isolated thresholds, we use the LIG to train a Turing Test Network (TTN), a task-agnostic "judge" that evaluates candidate pseudo-labels within a dataset-wide context. Experiments across four diverse datasets demonstrate the TTN's robustness, consistently enhancing label accuracy for three state-of-the-art vision-language models without costly supervision or retraining. Crucially, we demonstrate that learned semantic-contextual logic is a robust alternative to spatial-geometric verification, enabling a unique zero-shot task transfer capability - a TTN trained strictly on image classification datasets can effectively prune complex object detection pseudo-labels. This pruning yields F1-score gains of 28% for the worst-performing baseline categories and 44% with task-specific fine-tuning. Significantly, we also observe Category Revival, where the TTN pruning "detoxifies" the training signal for downstream models and enables them to recover from zero recall on transfer-vulnerable classes. The pre-trained TTN models and code are available at https://github.com/voxel51/ttn.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出标签模仿游戏（LIG）框架，将零样本伪标签修剪形式化为对抗式审讯，并训练一个任务无关的评判器（TTN）来评估候选伪标签。实验表明，TTN能在不依赖监督或重训练的情况下提升三个视觉-语言模型的标签准确性，并实现零样本任务迁移，例如图像分类训练的TTN可有效修剪目标检测伪标签，使F1分数提升28%（基线最差类别）和44%（任务微调后）。
Motivation: 基础模型伪标签方法通过零样本推理实现大规模标注，但存在幻觉标签问题，且标准阈值难以消除此类错误。
Method: 提出LIG框架，将伪标签修剪形式化为对抗式审讯，训练一个任务无关的图灵测试网络（TTN）作为评判器，在数据集上下文中评估候选伪标签。
Result: 在四个数据集上，TTN一致提升三个SOTA视觉-语言模型的标签准确性；图像分类训练的TTN可修剪目标检测伪标签，F1提升28%（最差类别）和44%（微调后）；观察到类别复兴现象。
Conclusion: 本文证明学习到的语义-上下文逻辑是空间-几何验证的鲁棒替代方案，且TTN具有独特的零样本任务迁移能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond expert users: agents should help users construct preferences, not just elicit them
papers.abstract_en: Agents typically assume an expert user -- one with well-formed preferences about what they want -- and default to clarifying questions whenever the task is underspecified. We argue this assumption is unrealistic. Users often lack the domain knowledge to have completely specified preferences; if asked about their preference on some feature, the user may be unable to answer without the agent helping the user to learn some domain knowledge needed to form a preference for that feature, e.g., via examples or explanations. To formalize these principles, we draw on the Search-Experience-Credence framework from Information Economics to introduce CoPref, a model of how users construct preferences based on agent dialog actions. We then study these ideas concretely in agentic recommender systems, proposing CoShop, an interactive benchmark. In CoShop, an agent converses with and makes recommendations for a CoPref user. The agent's performance depends on whether it can help the user gain the knowledge needed to specify the task well. Evaluating five frontier models, we find that no agent exceeds 56% accuracy on CoShop despite five turns of interaction. Failures stem not from agents' ability to find items, but from how little the interaction expands what users know about what they want.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文批评现有智能体系统默认用户具有完善偏好，提出用户往往缺乏领域知识，需要智能体通过例子或解释帮助用户构建偏好。作者借鉴信息经济学的搜索-体验-信任框架，提出CoPref模型形式化用户偏好构建过程，并开发交互式基准CoShop。在CoShop上评估五个前沿模型，即使经过五轮交互，准确率也不超过56%，失败主因是交互未能有效扩展用户对自身需求的理解。
Motivation: 现有智能体假设用户是专家，拥有完善偏好，但现实中用户常因缺乏领域知识而无法直接表达偏好，智能体需要帮助用户学习知识以形成偏好。
Method: 基于信息经济学的搜索-体验-信任框架，提出CoPref模型描述用户如何通过智能体对话动作构建偏好，并构建CoShop交互式基准，其中智能体与CoPref用户对话并进行推荐。
Result: 在CoShop基准上，五个前沿模型经过五轮交互后准确率均不超过56%，智能体失败主因不是物品查找能力不足，而是交互未能充分扩展用户对自身需求的知识。
Conclusion: 智能体需超越偏好获取，主动帮助用户构建偏好，CoShop基准显示当前模型在此方面表现有限。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Does Learning to Stop Help? A Cost-Aware Study of Early Exits in Reasoning Models
authors: Zhe Dong (University of Maine at Presque Isle)
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning models spend different amounts of useful computation across instances, but it remains unclear when a learned stopping rule improves over simple confidence or convergence thresholds. We study this question with LearnStop, a hidden-state-free checkpoint stopper for reasoning language models. At fixed budget checkpoints, LearnStop probes a short answer from the current reasoning prefix and predicts prefix correctness from online features such as answer confidence, entropy, prefix vote share, answer stability, and backtracking-marker density. Across 18 task-model settings spanning GSM8K, MATH-500, MMLU-Pro, AIME-90, GPQA, Qwen3, and DeepSeek-R1 distillations, the answer is task-dependent. On free-form math, learned multi-feature stopping improves the fixed-budget frontier and often beats scalar exits: on GSM8K with Qwen3-32B, the empirical frontier reaches a post-hoc peak adapt gain of +0.157, validation-selected operating points preserve positive gains, and the paired gain over the strongest scalar baseline is +0.028. On multiple-choice and very hard settings, scalar confidence, entropy, or stability rules are competitive or stronger. We therefore frame learned stopping not as a universal replacement for scalar exits, but as a tool whose value depends on trajectory structure. We further provide validation-selected operating points, paired bootstrap tests, finite-grid lost-correct risk calibration, cost accounting under KV-fork, prefix-cache, and black-box regimes, H100 serving profiles, checkpoint-schedule sweeps, transfer analyses, and robustness checks. The main practical finding is that learned stopping is useful when many questions become correct before full budget but do not exhibit a single reliable scalar stopping signal; its benefits largely disappear when confidence or answer convergence already solves the stopping problem.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在推理语言模型中学习停止规则（learned stopping rule）何时比简单的置信阈值或收敛阈值更有效。通过提出的LearnStop方法，在多个任务和模型上评估了基于多种在线特征的提前退出策略，发现其效用高度依赖于任务：在自由形式数学问题上表现较好，但在多项选择和极难设置中，标量退出规则更具竞争力。
Motivation: 推理模型在不同实例上花费不同计算量，但学习停止规则何时优于简单阈值尚不明确。
Method: 提出LearnStop，一种无需隐藏状态的检查点停止器，利用固定预算检查点处的答案置信度、熵、前缀投票份额、答案稳定性和回溯标记密度等在线特征预测前缀正确性。
Result: 在GSM8K、MATH-500等18个任务设置上，学习停止在自由形式数学中提升固定预算前沿，例如GSM8K with Qwen3-32B上后验峰值自适应增益+0.157，验证选择点保留正增益，配对增益+0.028；但在多项选择和极难设置中，标量规则更强。
Conclusion: 学习停止并非通用替代标量退出，而是工具，其价值取决于轨迹结构；当许多问题在完整预算前变正确但缺乏单一可靠标量信号时有用，否则收益消失。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Test-Time Verification for Text-to-SQL via Outcome Reward Models
papers.abstract_en: Improving the reliability of large language models (LLMs) at inference time is a central challenge in structured reasoning tasks such as Text-to-SQL. Common test-time inference strategies, including Best-of-N sampling and Majority Voting, rely on heuristic signals such as execution success or output frequency, which provide limited semantic discrimination across candidate outputs. In this work, we study Outcome Reward Models (ORMs) as learned semantic scoring functions for test-time verification in Text-to-SQL. While ORMs have been previously explored for test-time scaling and alignment, their application to structured query generation remains underexplored. We introduce GradeSQL, a scalable framework for training task-specific ORMs via automated candidate generation and execution-based labeling, enabling verifier training without manual annotation. We integrate ORMs into a verification-driven Best-of-N pipeline and evaluate our approach on the BIRD and Spider benchmarks across multiple open-source LLM families. ORM-based selection consistently outperforms execution-based Best-of-N and Majority Voting, with gains of up to +4.33% on BIRD and +2.10% on Spider. We further show that ORMs scale effectively with larger candidate sets and yield stronger improvements on complex queries. Overall, our results demonstrate that ORM-based verification provides a simple, effective, and scalable alternative to heuristic test-time selection strategies for Text-to-SQL. Code datasets and models are publicly available.
papers.comment: Accepted to the SURGeLLM Workshop at ACL 2026, San Diego, US
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GradeSQL框架，使用结果奖励模型（ORM）作为Text-to-SQL的测试时验证信号，替代基于执行成功或输出频率的启发式策略。在BIRD和Spider基准上，ORM-based选择一致优于执行式Best-of-N和多数投票，最高提升4.33%（BIRD）和2.10%（Spider）。
Motivation: 现有的Text-to-SQL测试时推理策略（如Best-of-N、多数投票）依赖启发式信号，缺乏语义判别能力，难以区分候选查询的质量。
Method: 提出GradeSQL框架，通过自动候选生成和执行标签训练任务特定的ORM，无需人工标注；将ORM集成到验证驱动的Best-of-N流水线中。
Result: 在BIRD和Spider基准上，ORM选择优于执行式Best-of-N和多数投票，分别提升+4.33%和+2.10%；ORM随候选集增大有效扩展，在复杂查询上改进更显著。
Conclusion: 结果奖励模型为Text-to-SQL提供了一种简单、有效且可扩展的测试时验证替代方案，优于启发式策略。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有的Text-to-SQL测试时推理策略（如Best-of-N、多数投票）依赖启发式信号，缺乏语义判别能力，难以区分候选查询的质量。
summary_sections.method: 提出GradeSQL框架，通过自动候选生成和执行标签训练任务特定的ORM，无需人工标注；将ORM集成到验证驱动的Best-of-N流水线中。
summary_sections.result: 在BIRD和Spider基准上，ORM选择优于执行式Best-of-N和多数投票，分别提升+4.33%和+2.10%；ORM随候选集增大有效扩展，在复杂查询上改进更显著。
summary_sections.conclusion: 结果奖励模型为Text-to-SQL提供了一种简单、有效且可扩展的测试时验证替代方案，优于启发式策略。

papers.title: BayesBench: Evaluating LLM Belief Trajectories Under Multi-Turn Evidence Accumulation
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are typically deployed in multi-turn conversations, where each turn provides new evidence that should reduce epistemic uncertainty about their environment. Acting rationally then requires inferring the unobserved quantities that govern it and updating beliefs about them as evidence accumulates. Yet most evaluations only score the model's final-turn answer in a single-turn format, leaving this process unexamined. We ask how closely LLMs' belief updates match those of a rational Bayesian reasoner in multi-turn settings, and introduce BayesBench, a suite of simulation environments that probe this across three progressively complex tasks: (i) Bayesian estimation, where the model infers an unknown parameter from sequential evidence; (ii) Bayesian prediction, where the model turns inferred beliefs about a latent variable into outcome forecasts; and (iii) latent-framed Bayesian prediction, where observations are filtered through a user-persona framing, requiring joint inference over the latent state and the persona. Across seven LLMs (3B--70B), scaling improves latent inference and evidence accumulation, with updates occasionally matching the Bayesian posterior. However, these gains do not reliably carry over to downstream prediction, exposing a gap between inferring latent structure and using it to rationally update beliefs about the target outcome.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 BayesBench，一套用于评估大语言模型（LLM）在多轮对话中信念更新是否接近理性贝叶斯推理的基准环境。基准包含三个渐进复杂任务：贝叶斯估计、贝叶斯预测和潜在框架贝叶斯预测。在 7 个规模从 3B 到 70B 的 LLM 上，发现模型规模提升有助于潜在推理和证据积累，但这一优势并未可靠地传递到下游预测任务，揭示了推理潜在结构与理性更新目标信念之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 评估多聚焦于单轮最终答案，忽略了多轮对话中模型如何利用新证据更新信念这一关键过程。
Method: 设计 BayesBench，通过三个生存环境（贝叶斯估计、预测、潜在框架预测）系统性地衡量 LLM 信念更新与理性贝叶斯推理的匹配程度。
Result: 在 7 个 LLM（3B–70B）上，规模提升改善了潜在推理和证据积累，偶尔匹配贝叶斯后验；但这些改进并未可靠地转化为下游预测性能。
Conclusion: 当前 LLM 在推理潜在结构后，未能将其用于理性地更新目标信念，存在推理与利用之间的鸿沟。

papers.title: SyncCache: Exploiting Asymmetric Dynamics for Fast Audio-Driven Portrait Animation
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have significantly advanced audio-driven portrait animation, but their high computational cost leads to substantial inference latency. Although training-free diffusion caching accelerates inference significant, existing methods are primarily developed for text-conditioned generation and overlook the spatial and modality imbalances inherent in audio-driven portrait animation. In this paper, we propose SyncCache, a training-free caching acceleration method tailored for DiT-based portrait animation that explicitly exploits asymmetric dynamics. Specifically, high-frequency dynamics driven by audio conditions and concentrated in human regions are more challenging and critical to cache and reuse than the low-frequency visual background in portrait animation. First, we introduce Spatially-Asymmetric Probing to prioritize error sensitivity in dynamic human region. Second, through Modality-Decoupled Caching, we bypass heavy DiT block by reusing stable inter-block residuals, while continuously recomputing lightweight audio blocks to preserve precise lip synchronization. Furthermore, we introduce a cache ratio to control cache capacity and formulate memory-adaptive cache selection as an offline dynamic programming problem without online overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SyncCache achieves superior speed-quality trade-offs, delivering up to 4.12x acceleration on HunyuanVideo-Avatar and 3.75x on Wan-S2V with near-lossless visual fidelity and precise audio alignment.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SyncCache 是一种针对 DiT（Diffusion Transformer）的免训练缓存加速方法，专门用于音频驱动的肖像动画。它利用空间和模态的非对称动态特性，通过空间不对称探测优先处理动态人体区域的误差敏感度，并通过模态解耦缓存重用稳定的块间残差，同时持续计算轻量音频块以保持唇同步。实验在 HunyuanVideo-Avatar 和 Wan-S2V 上分别实现了高达 4.12x 和 3.75x 的加速，且视觉保真度近无损，音频对齐精确。
Motivation: 现有 DiT 在音频驱动肖像动画中计算成本高，推理延迟大；而现有的免训练缓存方法主要为文本条件生成设计，忽视了音频驱动任务中的空间和模态不平衡。
Method: 提出 SyncCache，包含三个核心组件：空间不对称探测（优先动态人体区域误差）、模态解耦缓存（重用稳定块间残差，跳过重 DiT 块，保留唇同步）、以及基于离线动态规划的缓存比率控制与记忆自适应选择。
Result: 在 HunyuanVideo-Avatar 和 Wan-S2V 上，SyncCache 分别实现 4.12x 和 3.75x 加速，视觉质量近无损，音频对齐精确。
Conclusion: SyncCache 在速度和质量之间实现了优越的权衡，为音频驱动肖像动画提供了高效的免训练加速方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How Can AI Find My Model? A Model-Finding Experimental Study Considering Data Formats, Embeddings, and Retrieval Strategies
papers.abstract_en: Discovering simulation models for reuse remains a fundamental challenge in Modeling and Simulation (M&S). When many models coexist, identifying those that align with a given modeling intent remains difficult. Recent advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly retrieval-based approaches, offer a promising pathway to operate at this semantic layer. In this paper, we present an experimental study investigating the impact of data representation, transformer-based embedding models, and retrieval strategies on the discovery of simulation models using natural language queries. We evaluated performance across multiple query types using standard information retrieval metrics, including recall@5 and nDCG@5. Results show that data representation matters, open-source embedding models can achieve high performance, and reranking methods are important, especially as query complexity increases. This work provides a baseline for AI-driven model discovery and discusses its role in advancing toward AI-driven composability and interoperability.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Proceedings of the 2026 Winter Simulation Conference (WSC 2026). The final published version will appear in IEEE Xplore
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过实验研究数据表示、Transformer嵌入模型和检索策略对基于自然语言查询的仿真模型发现的影响。使用标准信息检索指标（recall@5和nDCG@5）评估不同查询类型下的性能。结果表明数据表示至关重要，开源嵌入模型可达到高性能，且重排序方法随查询复杂度增加而重要性提升。该工作为AI驱动的模型发现提供基准，并讨论其在实现AI驱动的可组合性和互操作性中的作用。
Motivation: 在多个仿真模型共存时，识别与建模意图相符的模型是一项基本挑战。现有方法难以在语义层面有效检索模型，亟需利用AI技术提升模型发现能力。
Method: 设计实验研究数据表示格式、基于Transformer的嵌入模型以及多种检索策略（包括重排序方法）对模型发现性能的影响。使用自然语言查询，在仿真模型数据集上评估recall@5和nDCG@5。
Result: 数据表示对性能有显著影响；开源嵌入模型能达到与专有模型相当的高性能；重排序方法在查询复杂度增加时尤为重要。
Conclusion: 该研究为AI驱动的仿真模型发现建立了基线，并指出数据表示、嵌入模型和检索策略是影响性能的关键因素，有助于推动AI驱动的模型可组合性和互操作性的发展。

papers.title: A Transferable Learned Temporal Prior for Transmission Reconstruction and Decision-Relevant Uncertainty in Real Outbreak Labels
papers.abstract_en: Outbreak transmission reconstruction treats epidemiological timing and transmission labels as deterministic ground truth; neither has been systematically evaluated. We trained a logistic regression temporal prior on eleven disease families, locked all parameters before accessing any target outbreak data, and applied it without refitting to a strict Andes virus (ANDV) parent-ranking benchmark of 29 tasks. The locked prior achieved mean reciprocal rank (MRR) 0.571 versus 0.274 and Top-1 accuracy 37.9% versus 13.8% against the best source-trained parametric baseline (permutation p <= 0.0002; 7-8 reversals to lose MRR significance). A phylogenetic concordance audit of 75 NYC mpox inter-host pairs - independent label-reliability evidence rather than a prior validation - found that 54.67% (exact 95% CI: 42.75-66.21%) were genomically unresolved or unsupported. Retaining uncertain edges in ANDV and Guangdong Delta graphs shifted top-5 source-priority sets (Jaccard 0.429-0.667). Transmission-label uncertainty was measurable in the outbreak evidence modules examined, and retaining uncertain links changed which source cases were prioritized for intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文挑战了疫情传播重建中标签作为确定性真值的假设，提出一种可迁移的时序先验（temporal prior），在11种疾病家族上训练后冻结参数，直接应用于安第斯病毒（ANDV）传播重建，取得了比参数基线更好的MRR和Top-1准确率。同时通过系统发育一致性审计发现mpox人际传播链中超过半数缺乏基因组支持，表明传播标签存在可量化的不确定性。
Motivation: 现有疫情传播重建方法将时序和传播标签视为确定性真值，从未系统评估其可靠性，导致后续干预决策可能基于不准确的信息。
Method: 训练一个基于逻辑回归的时序先验，在11种疾病家族上学习传播时间分布模式，所有参数在接触目标疫情数据前冻结，直接应用于ANDV传播重建任务而不重新拟合。
Result: 该冻结先验在29个ANDV任务上取得MRR 0.571 vs 基线0.274，Top-1准确率37.9% vs 13.8%（置换检验p<=0.0002）。对75对纽约mpox人际传播的系统发育一致性审计显示54.67%（95% CI 42.75-66.21%）的传播链在基因组上未解决或不被支持。
Conclusion: 传播标签存在可测量的不确定性，保留不确定的传播链接会影响源头病例的优先干预排序，建议在流行病学模型中明确考虑标签不确定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Contrastive Reflection for Iterative Prompt Optimization
papers.abstract_en: LLM agents are becoming central to information retrieval: they issue retrieval queries, synthesize answers, and increasingly serve as judges for IR evaluation. Improving the prompts that control these agents is an optimization problem, but in applied IR settings it often looks less like blind search and more like debugging. Engineers need to know which behavior failed, which nearby behavior still worked, what distinguishes the two, and whether a prompt edit improves held-out quality without introducing regressions. We present Contrastive Reflection, an iterative prompt-optimization framework for agentic IR workflows. The framework starts from a task-centric quality definition: QA agents expose retrieval or reasoning traces, and grading agents expose dimension-level scores and rationales. These structured traces are used to identify error-anchored behavioral slices, add nearby successful examples from the same region, and ask a Teacher LLM to propose a targeted prompt edit. Candidate edits are accepted only when validation performance improves, optionally subject to regression checks. We instantiate the framework with a tree-based slice selector, but the contribution is the contrastive reflection loop rather than the tree itself. On a public HotpotQA retrieval-augmented QA setup, one tree-selected contrastive repair improves held-out exact-match accuracy from 51.4% to 60.4%. Failure-only and random-evidence variants improve less and break more previously correct examples. A light instruction-only comparison places the method near modern prompt optimizers: MIPROv2 reaches 59.4% and GEPA 57.0%. The result is an interpretable optimization loop for IR agents, aimed at making prompt repair more inspectable and validation-driven.
papers.comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. To appear at Agent4IR @ KDD 2026 (KDD 2026 Workshop on AI Agents for Information Retrieval)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Contrastive Reflection 框架，用于迭代优化信息检索（IR）场景中 LLM agent 的 prompt。该框架通过对比错误行为与邻近的成功示例，引导 Teacher LLM 生成有针对性的 prompt 编辑，并在验证性能提升时接受编辑。在 HotpotQA 上，单次修复将精确匹配准确率从 51.4% 提升至 60.4%，优于仅使用失败示例或随机证据的方法。
Motivation: 在应用型 IR 设置中，优化 LLM agent 的 prompt 更像调试而非盲目搜索：工程师需要知道哪个行为失败、哪些邻近行为仍然有效、两者的区别以及编辑是否会回退或导致回归。现有方法缺乏这种结构化的对比分析。
Method: 提出 Contrastive Reflection 迭代优化框架：首先通过 agent 的结构化轨迹（retrieval/reasoning traces 或评分维度与理由）识别错误锚定的行为切片，然后在该区域添加邻近的成功示例，最后让 Teacher LLM 提出有针对性的 prompt 编辑。编辑仅当验证性能提升时被接受，并可选择加入回归检查。实例化中使用了基于树的切片选择器。
Result: 在 HotpotQA 的检索增强 QA 实验中，单次对比修复将 held-out 精确匹配准确率从 51.4% 提高到 60.4%；仅使用失败示例或随机证据的变体改进较小且破坏了更多先前正确的示例。与 MIPROv2（59.4%）和 GEPA（57.0%）相比，本方法达到了具有竞争力的性能。
Conclusion: 该方法提供了一个可解释的优化循环，使 prompt 修复更加可检查和验证驱动，适用于 agentic IR 流程。
Relevance: 0
