summary_sections.method: 提出 Contrastive Reflection 迭代优化框架：首先通过 agent 的结构化轨迹（retrieval/reasoning traces 或评分维度与理由）识别错误锚定的行为切片，然后在该区域添加邻近的成功示例，最后让 Teacher LLM 提出有针对性的 prompt 编辑。编辑仅当验证性能提升时被接受，并可选择加入回归检查。实例化中使用了基于树的切片选择器。
summary_sections.result: 在 HotpotQA 的检索增强 QA 实验中，单次对比修复将 held-out 精确匹配准确率从 51.4% 提高到 60.4%；仅使用失败示例或随机证据的变体改进较小且破坏了更多先前正确的示例。与 MIPROv2（59.4%）和 GEPA（57.0%）相比，本方法达到了具有竞争力的性能。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该方法提供了一个可解释的优化循环，使 prompt 修复更加可检查和验证驱动，适用于 agentic IR 流程。

papers.title: A Stationary-Distribution Theory for Triplet-Based Plateau Search in Random Forest Ensemble-Size Selection
papers.abstract_en: The number of trees is a central computational parameter in Random Forests: increasing it reduces finite-ensemble variability but increases training and prediction cost. Plateau-based tuning adapts this parameter through local comparisons of out-of-bag scores at a geometric triplet of tree counts. After the remaining hyperparameters have stabilized, however, the central triplet point need not converge to a deterministic value; instead, it fluctuates around a stationary regime. This paper develops a stationary-distribution theory for this process. The central ensemble size $B_t$ is modeled as a birth-death Markov chain on a geometric grid, and its stationary distribution is derived through local balance. Under a leading centered folded-normal approximation, equilibrium equations are obtained for the original update rule and a symmetric modified variant, implying that the stationary center $B_*=O(\varepsilon^{-2})$ as $\varepsilon\downarrow 0$. The stationary spread is also characterized. A local Gaussian approximation and a Fokker-Planck interpretation give grid-level variance constants. After conversion to the ensemble-size scale, $σ_{B,*}=O(\varepsilon^{-2})$, while the variance is $O(\varepsilon^{-4})$. The leading relative spread is independent of $\varepsilon$ and controlled by the scale factor and update rule. These results interpret plateau-based Random Forest tuning as a stochastic process rather than a deterministic stopping rule.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对随机森林中基于三元组的平台调优（plateau-based tuning）过程，建立了平稳分布理论。将中心集成大小建模为几何网格上的生灭马尔可夫链，通过局部平衡推导其平稳分布，并利用折叠正态近似得到均衡方程。结果表明中心集成大小 B_* = O(ε^{-2})，方差 σ_{B,*} = O(ε^{-2})，相对展宽与 ε 无关，由尺度因子和更新规则控制。
Motivation: 平台调优在其余超参数稳定后，中心三元组点并不收敛到确定值，而是围绕一个平稳状态波动，需要理论解释这一随机行为。
Method: 将中心集成大小 B_t 建模为几何网格上的生灭马尔可夫链，通过局部平衡推导平稳分布；采用中心折叠正态近似和 Fokker-Planck 方程获得网格级方差常数，并转换到集成大小尺度。
Result: 推导出平稳中心 B_* = O(ε^{-2})（ε↓0），平稳方差 σ_{B,*} = O(ε^{-2})，方差为 O(ε^{-4})；相对展宽独立于 ε，由尺度因子和更新规则控制。
Conclusion: 平台调优应被视为一个随机过程而非确定性停止规则，理论结果解释了其统计行为。

papers.title: Partition-Guided Distance Saliency: Bridging Decision and Objective Spaces in Many-Objective Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Explainability in Many-Objective Optimization (MaO) is currently hindered by the escalating complexity of the Pareto front, which renders the relationship between high-dimensional decision variables and objective outcomes increasingly opaque. As the number of objectives exceeds the limits of traditional visualization, decision-makers encounter a ``cognitive drought'' in identifying relevant trade-offs or specifying target regions without a priori knowledge. To bridge this interpretability gap, we introduce the {Partition-Guided Distance Saliency (PGDS)} framework, a novel XAI approach designed for continuous optimization landscapes. Our framework automates the explanation process through a three-stage pipeline that prioritizes geometric intuition over abstract rules. First, we employ a surrogate model that learns how geometric distances in the decision space map to proximity in the objective space. Second, to address the difficulty of manual target selection in high dimensions, the framework automatically partitions the objective landscape into distinct regions and identifies local ``Dominating Points'' to serve as automated targets for improvement. Third, we quantify how sensitive a solution's position is to each decision variable by measuring the distance shifts induced by perturbations to each variable. This allows PGDS to categorize features as either ``Drivers'' which facilitate convergence toward preferred regions, or ``Blockers'' which represent geometric constraints hindering further progress. Validation on 10-objective benchmarks and a physics-informed engineering problem (Welded Beam) demonstrates that PGDS provides differentiated, actionable insights that traditional visualization and rule-based XAI methods fail to provide.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多目标优化中帕累托前沿复杂度导致决策变量与目标关系不透明的问题，提出分区引导距离显著性（PGDS）框架，一种可解释人工智能方法。该框架通过代理模型学习决策空间几何距离到目标空间近似的映射，自动划分目标景观并识别局部支配点，通过扰动敏感度量化将变量分类为“驱动者”或“阻碍者”。在10目标基准测试和焊接梁工程问题上的验证表明，PGDS提供了传统可视化和规则方法无法提供的差异化、可操作的见解。
Motivation: 多目标优化中高维多目标场景下帕累托前沿复杂，传统可视化失效，决策者难以识别相关权衡或指定目标区域，存在可解释性缺口。
Method: 提出三阶段流水线：1）训练代理模型学习决策空间几何距离到目标空间近似的映射；2）自动分区目标景观并识别局部支配点作为自动化改进目标；3）通过扰动各变量测量距离变化，将特征分类为“驱动者”（促进收敛）或“阻碍者”（几何约束）。
Result: 在10目标基准测试和物理信息工程问题（焊接梁）上，PGDS提供了传统可视化和基于规则的XAI方法无法提供的差异化、可操作见解。
Conclusion: PGDS框架桥接了多目标优化中决策空间与目标空间的可解释性鸿沟，优先使用几何直觉而非抽象规则。

papers.title: Geometric Dyson Brownian Motions and the Free Log-Normal Limit for a Non-Square Product of Random Matrices
papers.abstract_en: We study the squared singular value spectrum of a product of non-square random matrices, a setting that also corresponds to the feature covariance eigenvalues of a deep linear neural network at initialization. We first take a proportional depth-width $d,n$ limit with the number of data points $m$ held fixed, and show that the resulting covariance eigenvalue process satisfies a geometric version of Dyson Brownian motion. We then take a second, sequential mean-field limit corresponding to the scaling $dm/n\to\barτ$, and show that the limiting $T$-transform of the spectrum solves a Burgers equation. In the identity-start case this equation yields the free log-normal law, and the general limit is obtained by free multiplicative convolution with the free log-normal. We further obtain the free log-normal support formula, a fixed-point iteration for numerical evaluation, and a formal small-time Marchenko--Pastur approximation. We also use the limiting spectral law to predict a toy random-feature regression risk, finding close agreement with a finite-dimensional simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究非方随机矩阵乘积的平方奇异值谱，该设定对应深度线性神经网络初始化时的特征协方差特征值。在比例深度-宽度极限下，协方差特征值过程满足几何Dyson布朗运动；在顺序平均场极限下，谱的T-变换满足Burgers方程，并从单位阵起始得到自由对数正态分布，一般情形通过自由乘法卷积得到。
Motivation: 现有随机矩阵理论多关注方阵或同规范形，对非方乘积矩阵的谱动态及其在神经网络初始化中的应用缺乏刻画。
Method: 分两步极限：先取比例深度-宽度极限（数据点m固定），证明协方差特征值过程满足几何Dyson布朗运动；再取顺序平均场极限（dm/n→τ），推导谱T-变换的Burgers方程，并求解自由对数正态分布。
Result: 得到自由对数正态分布的支持公式、数值计算的不动点迭代、以及小时间Marchenko-Pastur近似。用极限谱预测玩具随机特征回归风险，与有限维模拟吻合良好。
Conclusion: 该工作建立了非方随机矩阵乘积谱的极限理论，并通过自由概率论得到闭式分布，为深度线性网络初始化研究提供工具。

papers.title: Separation Capacity of Scattering Networks
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we attempt to enhance the theoretical understanding of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) as feature extractors in classification tasks by analyzing them through the lens of Cover's function-counting theory. Specifically, our focus lies on the notion of separation capacity, a combinatorial quantity derived from counting the number of realizable dichotomies (i.e., binary label assignments). Our contributions are threefold. First, we extend Cover's framework by establishing a conceptually insightful and practically useful formulation for the separation capacity. Second, leveraging this formulation, we identify the factors governing the separation capacity of feature extractors that employ a specific CNN architecture, so-called scattering networks, in terms of their network building blocks. Third, we provide practical insights for scattering network design.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过Cover的函数计数理论，研究卷积神经网络作为特征提取器时的分离容量（separation capacity），即实现二分划的可实现数目。作者提出分离容量的新公式，分析散射网络（scattering networks）的分离容量与其网络组件的关系，并为散射网络设计提供实践见解。
Motivation: 增强对CNN作为分类任务特征提取器的理论理解，特别是通过Cover的函数计数理论分析其分离容量。
Method: 扩展Cover框架，建立分离容量的新公式；利用该公式分析散射网络的分离容量，识别其受网络构建块影响的因素。
Result: 给出了散射网络分离容量的理论刻画，揭示了网络组件对分离容量的影响。
Conclusion: 为散射网络的设计提供了理论指导，但未涉及实际应用场景。

papers.title: Mind the Residual Gap: Probabilistic Downscaling under Real-World Bias
papers.abstract_en: Probabilistic downscaling is the task of modeling the conditional distribution of high-resolution fields given coarse inputs, and is a central challenge to atmospheric science, climate modeling, and other multiscale physical systems. A widely used paradigm decomposes the problem into a deterministic mean predictor followed by a stochastic residual generator. While effective in idealized settings, this mean--residual approach frequently produces biased and under-dispersive ensembles in real-world applications. Is this merely generic predictive uncertainty miscalibration? We show that the root cause is more fundamental: residual target misspecification, the residual distribution induced during training differs systematically from the one required at test time due to downscaling bias. To close this gap, we introduce ReMatch (Residual Distribution Matching). ReMatch aligns the training residual distribution toward the test-time regime via optimal transport in a low-dimensional PCA space. This preserves the statistical benefits of the mean--residual framework while reducing the train--test mismatch in the residual targets seen by the stochastic generator. On a controlled synthetic benchmark with varying bias levels and a real-world HRRR--ERA5 wind field downscaling task, ReMatch substantially reduces under-dispersion, improves calibration (SSR and CRPS), and outperforms strong baselines, including the standard mean--residual model and its variants, as well as state-of-the-art super-resolution models. Our code is available at https://github.com/sdean-group/ReMatch.git.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示了概率降尺度中“均值-残差”框架在实际应用中产生偏差和欠离散的根本原因是残差目标误设（residual target misspecification），即训练与测试时残差分布的系统性差异。提出ReMatch方法，通过PCA空间中的最优传输对齐训练和测试残差分布，在合成基准和真实HRRR-ERA5风场降尺度任务中显著改善校准并优于多种基线。
Motivation: 现有均值-残差降尺度方法在实际应用中常产生有偏和欠离散的集合，但此前仅归因于校准问题。论文指出根本原因是训练与测试的残差分布不一致，即残差目标误设。
Method: 提出ReMatch（Residual Distribution Matching），在低维PCA空间中使用最优传输将训练残差分布对齐到测试分布，从而保持均值-残差框架的统计优势并减少训练-测试不匹配。
Result: 在可变偏差水平的合成基准和真实HRRR-ERA5风场降尺度任务中，ReMatch显著减少欠离散，改善SSR和CRPS等校准指标，超过标准均值-残差模型及其变体以及超分辨率模型。
Conclusion: 残差目标误设是实际降尺度中欠校准的关键因素，ReMatch通过分布匹配有效缓解该问题，适用于存在系统偏差的多尺度物理系统。

papers.title: AI-Generated PowerShell Malware: An Experimental Framework and Dataset
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI has emerged as a significant cybersecurity threat, with several recent attack campaigns leveraging LLMs to generate code for malicious purposes via scripting languages such as PowerShell. Consequently, for cybersecurity analysts, it is imperative to investigate the offensive capabilities of AI code generators. In this paper, we propose an experimental framework to assess LLM-generated PowerShell malware, which comprises a novel sandbox approach for dynamic analysis of AI-generated malware. Furthermore, we present a novel, manually curated dataset of real-world PowerShell malware, annotated in natural language to assist the training and evaluation of LLMs. Finally, this study evaluates permissive, open-weight LLMs adapted to PowerShell malware generation. Our results reveal a high degree of similarity between real malware and LLM-generated ones in terms of triggered OS malicious events, with a median Jaccard index of 84.5% and 48.4% of instances achieving complete overlap.

papers.title: When transformers learn "impossible" languages, what do they learn?
papers.abstract_en: Recent work suggests that transformer language models show a bias towards human languages over unnatural ("impossible") languages argued to be unacquirable by humans. However, this literature has largely based these claims on differences in sample efficiency and test-set perplexity, rather than on direct evaluations of the linguistic capacities that could plausibly explain non-attestation in human languages. We evaluate two theoretically motivated linking hypotheses: impossibility arising from deficiencies in grammatical sensitivity or generative production. Using GPT-2 style models trained on perturbed "impossible" variants of English, we measure sensitivity to grammaticality using BLiMP minimal pairs, finding that model performance exhibits only gradual degradation, mediated by the language's information locality. In contrast, these models exhibited pronounced failures in generation, producing substantially fewer high-quality sentences at longer lengths. Together, these results suggest generative deficiency and transmission failures as a plausible linking hypothesis between language model behaviour and non-attestation of impossible languages.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究Transformer语言模型在训练于“不可能”语言（违反人类语言普遍性的语言）时的表现。通过BLiMP测试语法敏感性和生成质量，发现语法敏感性逐渐下降，但生成能力显著受损，生成长句时质量下降明显。提出生成缺陷和传输失败是模型行为与不可能语言未获人类认可之间的合理联系。
Motivation: 现有研究声称Transformer对人类语言有偏好，但仅基于样本效率和困惑度，缺乏对语言能力的直接评估。本文旨在通过语法敏感性和生成能力两个理论假设，理解模型如何学习不可能语言。
Method: 采用GPT-2风格模型，训练于经过扰动的英语“不可能”变体，使用BLiMP最小对测试语法敏感性，并评估生成句子的质量（如长度、可接受性）。
Result: 语法敏感性仅逐渐下降，受信息局部性调节；生成能力显著失败，长句中高质量句子大幅减少。
Conclusion: 模型的行为更可能源于生成缺陷和传输失败，而非语法敏感性不足，为语言模型偏好人类语言提供了新解释。

papers.title: Gradient Smoothing: Coupling Layer-wise Updates for Improved Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks with repeated architectural blocks, such as transformers, often exhibit structured relationships across layers that emerge during training. Motivated by this observation, we introduce \emph{Depth-wise Gradient Augmentation}, a general optimization paradigm in which the update applied to each layer is obtained by transforming the collection of block-wise optimizer updates along the depth dimension. Within this framework, we study \emph{Gradient Smoothing}, a family of depth-wise smoothing methods, and instantiate it with a simple local \emph{Window Smoothing} operator. The resulting method operates directly on block-wise updates produced by arbitrary base optimizers (e.g., SGD, Adam, Muon), incurs minimal computational overhead, and is compatible with existing optimization pipelines. We evaluate Gradient Smoothing across a diverse set of architectures and training regimes, including language model pretraining, RL post-training of LLMs for reasoning, diffusion modeling, and image classification with Vision Transformers. Across these settings, Gradient Smoothing consistently improves optimization and generalization performance without modifying model architectures or training objectives. We further show that it promotes more structured representation evolution across depth, consistent with its interpretation as a structured depth-wise preconditioning method. Together, these results establish Depth-wise Gradient Augmentation as a promising framework for exploiting cross-depth structure in optimization and demonstrate Gradient Smoothing as a simple and broadly applicable instantiation.
papers.comment: Published in the Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出深度梯度增强（Depth-wise Gradient Augmentation）优化范式，利用深度神经网络跨层的结构化关系，并实例化为梯度平滑（Gradient Smoothing）。该方法使用窗口平滑算子对沿深度维度的优化器更新进行变换，可适配SGD、Adam、Muon等基础优化器。在语言模型预训练、强化学习后训练、扩散模型和Vision Transformer图像分类等任务中，梯度平滑一致提升了优化与泛化性能，且不改变模型架构或训练目标。
Motivation: 深度神经网络中的重复架构块（如Transformer）在训练中会自然形成跨层结构化关系，现有的逐层独立更新方式未充分利用这一结构。
Method: 提出深度梯度增强框架，将每层的更新计算为对沿深度维度的块级优化器更新集的变换；具体实例化为梯度平滑，使用局部窗口平滑算子对更新进行平滑处理，计算开销小且兼容现有优化流程。
Result: 在语言模型预训练、RL后训练、扩散模型和ViT图像分类等多种设置中，梯度平滑一致改善了优化和泛化性能，并促进表示沿深度更结构化地演化。
Conclusion: 深度梯度增强提供了一个利用跨层结构优化的有效框架，梯度平滑作为其简单而通用的实例，展示了广泛的应用前景。

papers.title: AVTok: 1D Unified Tokenization for Holistic Audio-Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-video generation has recently gained unprecedented research attention, aiming to synthesize high-quality sounding video content with fine-grained synchronization and semantic alignment between the auditory and visual components. The preceding methods predominantly adopt a dual-branch design with separate tokenization and generation modules per modality, neglecting the representation gap while necessitating intensive computational resources for proper training. Inspired by recent advancements in one-dimensional visual tokenization, we present \textbf{AVTok}, a novel unified tokenizer designated for holistic audio-video generation. AVTok features a dual-stream transformer-based architecture with shared encoder-decoder and modal-specific learnable queries to efficiently and effectively encode an audio-video pair into a compact one-dimensional latent representation with a unified codebook. To cope with the heterogeneous information imbalance that hinders AVTok from exploiting aligned audio-visual information, we devise a hierarchical training strategy to progressively realize reconstruction capabilities for each modality. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AVTok excels both in audio-video reconstruction and when integrated into downstream pipelines for audio-to-video, video-to-audio, and class-conditional joint audio-video generation. AVTok paves the way for the challenge of joint audio-video tokenization and provides a potential direction to build unified large multimodal models for audio-video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AVTok，一种统一的 1D 分词器，用于整体音频-视频生成。它采用双流 Transformer 架构，共享编码器和解码器，并通过模态特定的可学习查询将音视频对编码为紧凑的 1D 潜在表示，使用统一的码本。通过分层训练策略处理异构信息不平衡，实验表明在重建和下游生成任务中表现优异。
Motivation: 现有音频-视频生成方法多采用双分支设计，每个模态独立分词和生成，忽略了表示差距且需要大量计算资源。
Method: 提出 AVTok 统一分词器，包含双流 Transformer 架构、共享编码器-解码器、模态特定的可学习查询和统一码本，并采用分层训练策略逐步实现各模态的重建能力。
Result: 实验证明 AVTok 在音频-视频重建以及音频到视频、视频到音频和类别条件联合生成等下游任务中表现优异。
Conclusion: AVTok 为联合音频-视频分词提供了可行方案，并为构建统一的大规模多模态模型奠定了基础。

papers.title: GaussLite: Online Task-Conditioned 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Robotic Mapping
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) systems distribute representation capacity uniformly across a scene, ignoring the fact that many downstream robotic tasks engage only a fraction of the reconstructed geometry. This causes valuable onboard compute to be allocated towards optimizing irrelevant parts of the scene, either limiting online capacity or under-optimizing the most relevant parts of the scene. We introduce GaussLite, a task-driven 3DGS mapping system that conditions its representation density on a natural-language task specification. Given a posed RGB-D stream and a task such as "prepare to pick up the object on the desk," GaussLite uses a one-shot LLM parser to extract target and anchor objects, which are grounded per-frame by an open-vocabulary detector and segmented to produce per-pixel relevance masks in real time. The mapper allocates seeding density, gradient flow and scaling by task relevance. At matched Gaussian budget and real-time mapping at 4 Hz on resource-constrained hardware, GaussLite outperforms baselines on ROI PSNR on the Replica Dataset by an average +2.72 dB and on a real-hardware demonstration in indoor and outdoor settings by +2.23 dB. We further show that two task-specialized agents' maps can be fused into a single shared map via per-voxel voting on active-optimization counts in real time, outperforming concatenation by +3.42 dB while only sharing an average 7.08% of the map.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GaussLite，一种任务驱动的 3D 高斯泼溅 (3DGS) 建图系统。该系统根据自然语言任务规格（如“准备拿起桌上的物体”）动态调整表示密度，利用 LLM 解析器和开放词汇检测器生成实时的逐像素相关性掩码，从而将计算资源集中到任务相关的区域。在 Replica 数据集上，GaussLite 在感兴趣区域 (ROI) 的 PSNR 上平均比基线高 2.72 dB，在真实硬件上的室内外场景中高 2.23 dB。
Motivation: 现有 3DGS 系统均匀分配表示容量，忽略了下游机器人任务只关注部分重建几何的事实，导致宝贵的机载计算被用于优化无关场景区域，限制了在线容量或对关键区域的优化不足。
Method: GaussLite 由一个单次 LLM 解析器从任务描述中提取目标和锚点对象，通过开放词汇检测器逐帧定位并分割生成逐像素相关性掩码；建图模块根据任务相关性分配种子密度、梯度流和缩放，实现资源的高效分配。
Result: 在匹配的高斯预算和资源受限硬件上实时建图（4 Hz）时，GaussLite 在 Replica 数据集上 ROI PSNR 平均提升 +2.72 dB，在真实室内外硬件演示中提升 +2.23 dB；此外，通过逐体素投票融合两个任务专用智能体的地图，比简单拼接提升 +3.42 dB，且仅共享平均 7.08% 的地图。
Conclusion: GaussLite 证明了任务驱动的 3DGS 建图可以在有限计算资源下显著提升任务相关区域的渲染质量，并支持多任务地图的高效实时融合。

papers.title: Off the Rails: Hijacking the Scoring Head in Generative End-to-End Driving Planners with Safety-Violating Adversarial Perturbations
papers.abstract_en: Generative models have recently seen rapid adoption in End-to-End (E2E) autonomous driving (AD), with diffusion-based denoising and vocabulary-based retrieval becoming the dominant trajectory-decoding paradigms. Despite their architectural diversity, current generative AD planners share a common inference pattern: a fixed set of candidate trajectories (anchors, vocabulary entries, or proposal queries) is scored by one or more learned heads conditioned on the Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) features, and the highest-scored candidate is returned as the final trajectory. Under this design, the scoring head is the only barrier between perception and the motion command, and its decision margins between competing candidates are often small. We introduce \textsc{Derail}, an adversarial framework that exploits this scoring-head attack surface. Evaluated on various generative planners, \textsc{Derail} flips the trajectory selection from a safe to an unsafe candidate, with score drops of $39$--$80\%$ and collision rates of up to $50\%$, consistently outperforming generic loss-maximization and feature-divergence attacks. Our analysis suggests that safety-violating objectives govern attack effectiveness against generative AD planners, and that the scoring-head inference pattern itself is a recurring attack surface worth explicit defensive consideration.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现生成式端到端自动驾驶规划器共享一个共同推理模式：由评分头（scoring head）对候选轨迹打分，选最高分轨迹作为最终输出。作者提出 Derail 对抗框架，利用评分头的决策边界小、易翻转的特性，通过对抗扰动将轨迹选择从安全候选翻转为不安全候选，导致评分下降39%-80%，碰撞率高达50%。分析表明安全违规目标主导攻击有效性，评分头推理模式本身是一个可重复的攻击面。
Motivation: 当前生成式端到端自动驾驶规划器（如扩散模型、词汇检索）虽然架构多样，但都依赖评分头从候选轨迹中选出最高分者，该评分头是感知与运动命令之间的唯一屏障，且竞争候选之间的决策边界往往很小，构成潜在攻击面。
Method: 提出 Derail 对抗框架，通过针对评分头的对抗扰动（而非通用损失最大化或特征散度攻击），翻转轨迹选择结果。在多种生成式规划器上评估，包括基于扩散和词汇检索的模型。
Result: 在多种生成式规划器上，Derail 将评分下降39%-80%，碰撞率高达50%，持续优于通用损失最大化和特征散度攻击。
Conclusion: 安全违规目标主导攻击有效性，评分头推理模式本身是一个值得防御关注的攻击面。

summary_sections.tldr: 本文发现生成式端到端自动驾驶规划器共享一个共同推理模式：由评分头（scoring head）对候选轨迹打分，选最高分轨迹作为最终输出。作者提出 Derail 对抗框架，利用评分头的决策边界小、易翻转的特性，通过对抗扰动将轨迹选择从安全候选翻转为不安全候选，导致评分下降39%-80%，碰撞率高达50%。分析表明安全违规目标主导攻击有效性，评分头推理模式本身是一个可重复的攻击面。
summary_sections.motivation: 当前生成式端到端自动驾驶规划器（如扩散模型、词汇检索）虽然架构多样，但都依赖评分头从候选轨迹中选出最高分者，该评分头是感知与运动命令之间的唯一屏障，且竞争候选之间的决策边界往往很小，构成潜在攻击面。
summary_sections.method: 提出 Derail 对抗框架，通过针对评分头的对抗扰动（而非通用损失最大化或特征散度攻击），翻转轨迹选择结果。在多种生成式规划器上评估，包括基于扩散和词汇检索的模型。
summary_sections.result: 在多种生成式规划器上，Derail 将评分下降39%-80%，碰撞率高达50%，持续优于通用损失最大化和特征散度攻击。
summary_sections.conclusion: 安全违规目标主导攻击有效性，评分头推理模式本身是一个值得防御关注的攻击面。

papers.title: Using AI Agents to Automate Black-Box Audits of Personalization Algorithms at Scale
papers.abstract_en: Personalization algorithms determine what content users encounter on online platforms. Auditing these systems is difficult because independent auditors have only black-box access to the algorithms, while personalization depends on users' attributes, behavior, and evolving interaction histories. Existing auditing methods face a tradeoff: studies with real users capture realistic behavior but are costly and hard to control, whereas sock-puppet audits scale more easily but often rely on scripted behavior that limits realism. Beyond this, both approaches struggle to decouple user attributes from user behavior, limiting our ability to causally understand personalization. To address this gap, we introduce a framework for black-box audits of personalization algorithms using generative AI agents as behavioral engines for synthetic accounts. Each agent is instantiated with a fixed persona, grounded in demographic and political survey data, and interacts with a platform's content by reasoning about it and choosing actions. Because behavior is fixed within each persona while platform-visible signals such as age, gender, or location can be experimentally perturbed, our design enables counterfactual auditing of how platforms respond to user attributes. As a case study, we deploy 1,120 agents on X shortly after the 2024 U.S. election, spanning 14 personas and three counterfactual conditions, collecting over 200,000 content exposures. We find that X's algorithmic feed amplifies toxic, polarizing, political, and right-leaning content relative to the chronological feed, with amplification varying sharply by user ideology. Counterfactual analyses show that demographic signals affect content delivery in persona-dependent ways: pooled effects are largely null, while subgroup-level effects vary in direction and magnitude. Our work establishes GenAI-based agents as a new tool for algorithmic auditing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本论文提出利用生成式AI代理作为行为引擎，对在线平台个性化算法进行黑箱审计。代理基于固定人设（人口统计学和政治调查数据）与平台内容互动，通过扰动平台可见信号（如年龄、性别、位置）实现反事实审计。在2024年美国大选后，在X平台部署1120个代理，覆盖14种人设和三种反事实条件，收集超过20万次内容曝光。发现X的算法推荐相比时间线推荐加剧了毒性、两极分化、政治化和右倾内容，且放大效应因用户意识形态而异；反事实分析显示人口统计信号对内容递送的影响因人设而异，汇总效应多为零，但子群体效应方向与幅度不同。
Motivation: 现有审计方法存在权衡：真实用户研究成本高且难以控制，而模拟账户（sock-puppet）审计可扩展但脚本行为缺乏真实感；两者都难以分离用户属性与行为，限制了对个性化因果机制的理解。
Method: 提出框架：将生成式AI代理实例化为固定人设（基于调查数据），使其推理平台内容并选择行动；通过实验扰动平台可见信号（年龄、性别、位置）进行反事实审计。案例研究在X平台部署1120个代理，涵盖14种人设和三种反事实条件。
Result: X的算法推荐相比时间线推荐显著放大毒性、两极分化、政治化和右倾内容，放大效应因用户意识形态而异。反事实分析显示人口统计信号对内容递送的影响在汇总层面几乎为零，但子群体层面方向和幅度不同。
Conclusion: 本工作确立了基于GenAI的代理作为算法审计的新工具，能够实现可控、可扩展且具备反事实能力的黑箱审计。

papers.title: Simple Supervision Is Hard to Beat: A Bitter Lesson from Sparse Target Labels in Domain-Adaptive Object Detection
papers.abstract_en: Source-free domain adaptive object detection adapts a source-trained detector to an unlabeled target domain, typically through teacher-student self-training with pseudo-labels. We revisit this setting when a small, uniformly sampled subset of target images is labeled. We introduce Random-Target Supervised Mixing (RTSM), a simple anchor that incorporates these annotations through a supervised detection loss while leaving the original unlabeled adaptation branch unchanged. Across evaluations spanning four SFDA-OD methods, two object detectors, multiple adaptation tasks, and target-label budgets from 1% to 10%, RTSM consistently improves pure SFDA by 1.7 to 18.3 AP50. We then examine whether the same annotations can provide further gains by steering unlabeled self-training. To this end, we evaluate ten sparse-label feedback plugins covering pseudo-label selection, object completion, and optimization control, which yield limited and method-dependent gains over RTSM. These results reveal a bitter lesson for sparse-label SFDA-OD: simple supervision is hard to beat. RTSM therefore provides a simple yet effective anchor for sparse-label SFDA-OD.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究源无关领域自适应目标检测（SFDA-OD）中，当目标域有少量均匀采样标注时的设定。提出随机目标监督混合（RTSM），通过监督检测损失引入这些标注，保留原始无标签自适应分支。实验表明，在多种SFDA-OD方法、检测器、任务和1%-10%标签预算下，RTSM比纯SFDA提升1.7至18.3 AP50；而额外十个稀疏标签反馈插件带来的增益有限且依赖方法。结论是简单监督难以被击败。
Motivation: 现有SFDA-OD通常假设目标域完全无标注，但实际中可能获得少量标注。本文探究少量均匀采样标注能否显著提升性能，并考察更复杂的标注利用策略是否超越简单监督。
Method: 提出Random-Target Supervised Mixing (RTSM)，将少量标注目标图像通过标准监督检测损失加入训练，与原有的无标签教师-学生自训练分支并行，无需修改自适应流程。
Result: 在多种SFDA-OD方法、检测器、任务和1%-10%标注预算下，RTSM相较纯SFDA提升1.7至18.3 AP50；评估的十个稀疏标签反馈插件（如伪标签选择、目标补全、优化控制）仅带来有限且依赖方法的增益。
Conclusion: 简单监督（RTSM）在稀疏标签SFDA-OD中表现强劲，难以被更复杂的策略超越。RTSM可作为该设定下的有效基线。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Indi-RomCoM: Code-Mixed Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs on Romanized Indic-English Instructions
papers.abstract_en: Romanized Code Mixing (RCM), where bilingual speakers fluidly blend local languages with English in Roman script, has emerged as the dominant form of communication across multilingual communities. While Large Language Models (LLMs) perform strongly on monolingual and native-script benchmarks, their ability to follow instructions and reason over RCM-based content remains largely unexplored. To this end, we introduce the Indi-RomCoM benchmark for facilitating systematic evaluation on Indic Romanized Code-Mixed instructions. Our benchmark spans seven instruction-following tasks, four widely spoken Indic languages, and three controlled code-mixing intensity levels. We extensively evaluate a suite of LLMs covering proprietary, open-weight, and Indic-focused models under zero- and few-shot settings. LLMs consistently underperform on RCM instructions, with performance degrading as code-mixing density increases. Furthermore, reasoning tasks suffer less degradation than detection tasks (e.g., Toxicity) because the generated explanations offer necessary context. We believe Indi-RomCoM helps the community in developing inclusive multilingual systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Indi-RomCoM 基准，用于系统评估大语言模型 (LLM) 在印度语罗马化混合语言 (RCM) 指令上的表现。该基准涵盖七个指令跟随任务、四种印度语言和三种混合强度级别，评估了多种专有、开源和印度语模型。实验发现 LLM 在 RCM 指令上持续表现不佳，性能随混合密度增加而下降，但推理任务比检测任务退化更少。
Motivation: 尽管 LLM 在单语和母语脚本基准上表现良好，但它们处理罗马化混合语言 (RCM) 内容的能力尚未被系统评估。
Method: 构建 Indi-RomCoM 基准，包含七个指令跟随任务、四种印度语言和三种受控混合强度级别，并在零样本和少样本设置下评估多种 LLM。
Result: LLM 在 RCM 指令上持续表现不佳，性能随混合密度增加而下降；推理任务比检测任务退化更少，因为生成的解释提供了必要上下文。
Conclusion: Indi-RomCoM 有助于开发包容性多语言系统。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Predictable GRPO: A Closed-Form Model of Training Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has become a standard tool for improving the reasoning ability of large language models, yet its training dynamics are still described empirically: reward trajectories are fit with low-parameter functional forms whose constants carry no mechanistic meaning, and hyperparameter choices remain a matter of trial and error. We develop a first-principles reduced-order model of these dynamics. The reduction has three consequences. First, it subsumes the empirical single-exponential saturation law as its overdamped limit, recasting the fitted plateau, timescale, and size exponent as the fixed point, inverse stiffness, and curvature-scaling exponent of the underlying potential, and adding, through the retained inertial term, the slow-start phase the single exponential cannot represent. Second, it yields predictions tied to independently measurable quantities rather than fitted ones: group-size invariance of the deterministic trajectory with a $1/G$ stationary fluctuation, a sharp stability threshold in the refresh interval, and an overdamped-to-oscillatory transition. Third, it furnishes diagnostics that separate failure modes a reward curve alone conflates -- reward hacking, advantage degeneracy, policy concentration, and dynamical instability. Across three models and two group sizes, the closed-form trajectory fits training reward to $R^2 \geq 0.91$ and the predicted group-size invariance holds on both the reward curve and out-of-distribution transfer to eight math benchmarks. The stability and oscillatory predictions are exercised in a controlled exact-reduction setting where the mean-field assumption holds exactly: a softmax-bandit reduction reproduces the predicted overdamped-to-oscillatory transition and locates the refresh-interval stability threshold at the independently measured stiffness, with a deep-network demonstration left to future work.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从第一性原理推导了GRPO训练动力学的降阶模型，该模型统一了经验单指数饱和律并引入惯性项以描述慢启动阶段。模型预测群体大小不变性、刷新间隔稳定性阈值和过阻尼到振荡转变，并在三个模型上拟合训练奖励R²≥0.91，群体大小不变性在八个数学基准上成立。
Motivation: GRPO的训练动力学目前仅被经验性地描述，超参数选择依赖试错，缺乏机理理解。
Method: 从第一性原理建立降阶模型，将经验单指数饱和律解释为过阻尼极限，并引入惯性项；模型预测基于独立可测量量（如势能固定点、刚度、曲率标度指数）而非拟合参数。
Result: 闭式轨迹拟合训练奖励R²≥0.91；群体大小不变性在奖励曲线和八个数学基准的分布外迁移上成立；软max赌博机简化设置验证了过阻尼到振荡的转变和刷新间隔稳定性阈值。
Conclusion: 该模型提供了区分奖励曲线本身混淆的失败模式（奖励破解、优势退化、策略集中、动态不稳定）的诊断工具，但深度网络演示留待未来工作。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Revocable Learned State via Process Sidecars
papers.abstract_en: Language models are often adapted in stages: a public skill phase, a private memory phase, and a later safety phase that learns to refuse outputs tied to the remembered entities. Revoking the memory after the safety phase is not the same problem as subtracting the memory update: the later safety optimizer has transported the memory direction. We introduce process sidecars, a two-coefficient edit family $\hatθ(λ,γ)=θ_{\mathrm{AMS}}-λΔ_{\mathrm{M}}-γ\hat{R}_{\mathrm{S}\leftarrow\mathrm{M}}$, with $\hat{R}_{\mathrm{S}\leftarrow\mathrm{M}}=\hat{J}_{\mathrm{S},\varepsilon}(Δ_{\mathrm{M}})-Δ_{\mathrm{M}}$, where $\hat{J}_{\mathrm{S},\varepsilon}$ is a centered secant through the realized future AdamW safety-training process. The implementation uses $\varepsilon=1$ at the natural memory-edit scale; it reuses $θ_{\mathrm{AMS}}$ as the positive endpoint and computes one additional safety trace at $θ_{\mathrm{A}}-Δ_{\mathrm{M}}$. We prove two things. First, the exact sidecar, using the true transported direction $R_{\mathrm{S}\leftarrow\mathrm{M}}$ rather than the secant estimate, at $(λ,γ)=(1,1)$ recovers the counterfactual safety-only oracle $θ_{\mathrm{AS}}$ up to second order; the proof treats AdamW as an augmented-state map over parameters, first moments, and second moments. Second, this process information is necessary: whenever future safety training bends the memory direction, every scalar task-arithmetic edit leaves first-order counterfactual error, while the process-sidecar edit is second-order accurate. Across three models, the validation-selected 2D edit improves held-out refusal closure over naive task arithmetic in all trials, and over the $γ=λ$ process-JVP subfamily, the diagonal slice of the cached 2D grid, in all paired trials.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对语言模型安全阶段后记忆方向被迁移的问题，提出基于过程侧车（process sidecars）的双系数编辑族，在验证选定的二维编辑上优于朴素任务算术。
Motivation: 语言模型在安全阶段后尝试撤销记忆时，安全优化器已改变了记忆方向，导致简单的任务算术编辑失效。
Method: 提出过程侧车编辑族，使用两个系数λ和γ，以及通过安全训练过程估计的迁移方向R̂，利用中心割线近似未来AdamW安全训练过程。
Result: 证明在精确迁移方向下，该编辑族可恢复反事实安全仅用oracle的二阶精度，且实验表明验证选定的二维编辑在所有试验中优于朴素任务算术。
Conclusion: 过程侧车信息是必要的，因为未来安全训练改变记忆方向时，标量任务算术编辑存在一阶误差，而过程侧车编辑达到二阶精度。

summary_sections.method: 提出过程侧车编辑族，使用两个系数λ和γ，以及通过安全训练过程估计的迁移方向R̂，利用中心割线近似未来AdamW安全训练过程。
summary_sections.result: 证明在精确迁移方向下，该编辑族可恢复反事实安全仅用oracle的二阶精度，且实验表明验证选定的二维编辑在所有试验中优于朴素任务算术。
summary_sections.conclusion: 过程侧车信息是必要的，因为未来安全训练改变记忆方向时，标量任务算术编辑存在一阶误差，而过程侧车编辑达到二阶精度。

papers.title: Security--Fidelity Tradeoffs: The Hidden Cost of Prompt Injection Defense
papers.abstract_en: We identify a security-fidelity tradeoff in defending LLMs against indirect prompt injection: defenses resist injected instructions largely by suppressing untrusted text, which corrupts tasks that must preserve it, such as translation and document editing. Attack-success metrics cannot see this, because a model that ignores an injection and one that faithfully processes it as data score identically. We introduce SecFid, a benchmark built so that executing an injection, processing it as data, and ignoring it produce distinguishable outputs. This makes fidelity measurable and exposes a frontier: across 1,168 examples and 48 configurations, no model or defense achieves both objectives. The highest-fidelity model reaches 96.5% fidelity at 47.8% security, while the most secure defenses invert this, at 99.3% security but only 71.0%-73.9% fidelity. Even defenses with identical security differ in how they earn it: some repair hijacks into faithful processing, others simply suppress benign content. A decision-theoretic analysis shows why no fixed choice can be right everywhere: the correct behavior is not a property of the defense but of the deployment, set by its relative cost of a hijack versus a dropped span. Security alone therefore measures only half of robustness, and reporting it without fidelity hides the price at which it was bought.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026). 34 pages, 4 figures
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文发现LLM防御间接提示注入时存在安全-保真度权衡：防御机制主要通过抑制不可信文本来抵抗注入，但这会破坏需要保留文本的任务（如翻译、文档编辑）。现有攻击成功指标无法区分忽略注入和正确将注入作为数据处理的情况。作者引入SecFid基准，使得执行注入、作为数据处理、忽略三种行为产生可区分输出，从而可衡量保真度。实验表明，在1168个示例和48种配置下，没有模型或防御能同时达到高安全和高保真。
Motivation: 现有提示注入防御只关注安全指标，忽略了保真度；安全指标无法区分模型是忽略了注入还是正确将注入作为数据处理，导致低保真度的代价被隐藏。
Method: 提出SecFid基准，设计任务使得对注入的三种不同响应（执行、作为数据处理、忽略）产生可区分的输出，从而同时测量安全性和保真度。
Result: 最高保真度的模型达到96.5%保真度但只有47.8%安全；最安全的防御达到99.3%安全但保真度仅71.0%-73.9%。不同防御即使安全性相同，其实现机制也不同（有些将劫持修复为正确处理，有些简单抑制良性内容）。
Conclusion: 安全性只度量了鲁棒性的一半，不报告保真度就隐藏了取得安全的代价。正确行为不是防御的属性，而是部署环境的属性，取决于劫持与丢失文本片段的相对成本。

papers.title: Detecting Audio Deepfakes on the Edge:Lightweight SSL-Based Detection in a Browser Plugin
papers.abstract_en: Audio deepfakes are a growing challenge for the general public, as well as for journalists and fact-checkers. The latter need reliable tools to verify the authenticity of their sources, while at the same time keeping their information private. Commercial deepfake detection solutions rely on cloud-based processing, which raises privacy concerns. To solve this problem, we propose an on-device audio deepfake detection model. We show that a truncated self-supervised backbone with a simple logistic classifier is both very fast and often more accurate than existing solutions. Our solution outperforms the baseline AASIST by 10% and improves inference speed by 40%. We integrate this model into a browser plug-in, which allows journalists and fact-checkers to detect deepfakes easily and securely. Code for the plugin is available at https://github.com/OctavianPascu97/Audio-Deepfakes-Browser-Plugin.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对音频深度伪造检测的隐私和效率问题，提出一种轻量级设备端检测方法，使用截断的自监督骨干网络（truncated SSL backbone）结合逻辑回归分类器，在保持高精度的同时大幅提升推理速度，并集成到浏览器插件中以供记者和事实核查员使用。
Motivation: 现有音频深度伪造检测依赖云端处理，存在隐私泄露风险，且不能满足记者和事实核查员对数据隐私的需求。
Method: 采用截断的自监督预训练骨干网络作为特征提取器，后端仅使用简单的逻辑回归分类器，构成轻量级模型；并部署为浏览器插件实现设备端推理。
Result: 在检测准确率上比AASIST基线提升10%，推理速度提升40%。
Conclusion: 本文证明了自监督模型经过适当截断后结合简单分类器即可在边缘设备上实现高效且准确的音频深度伪造检测，为隐私敏感场景提供可行方案。

papers.title: ReactionAtlas: Ab origine exploration of chemical reaction networks with machine learning
papers.abstract_en: Mapping a chemical reaction network, the graph of minima and transition states (TS) and the elementary reactions connecting them, is the natural language of chemistry, from catalysis to combustion to the origin of life. Constructing such a reaction network for a given chemistry has been impractical: it requires finding and characterizing tens of thousands of TS, a task for which traditional methods such as density functional theory (DFT) are typically prohibitively slow and require reactant and product as input. We introduce ReactionAtlas, which builds a reaction network $\textit{ab origine}$ from a handful of seed molecules and without hand-crafted rules. Specifically, our machine-learned generative model proposes reactions from kinetically sampled candidate compounds and a DFT-trained machine learned force field (MLFF) filters them to valid TS, the resulting products of which enter the search as new seeds. Starting from eight pre-biotic seeds (CH$_2$O, H$_2$O, OH$^-$, H$_3$O$^+$, CO$_2$, H$_2$CO$_3$, HCO$_3^-$, H), ReactionAtlas discovers $\sim$47,000 reactions among $\sim$12,000 compounds. The MLFF TSs match the PBE0 references within 0.5 Å RMSD in 85% of the cases and can be easily brought to the PBE0 level. Thus, ReactionAtlas maps small carbohydrate chemistry up to C$_4$H$_8$O$_4$ at unprecedented scale and accuracy, including charge and stereo information. It enables novel insights into many well-studied reaction paths, including the formose cycle, which we highlight for its centrality to the chemical origins of life. Notably, our framework also allows establishing alternative reaction pathways for formose chemistry.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: ReactionAtlas 是一个机器学习驱动的化学反应网络构建框架，从少量种子分子出发，无需手工规则即可自动发现反应路径。它结合生成模型和 DFT 训练的机器学习力场，从动力学采样候选化合物中提议反应并筛选出有效过渡态。以 8 个前生命种子分子为例，ReactionAtlas 发现了约 47,000 个反应和约 12,000 个化合物，并在小分子碳水化合物化学中达到前所未有的规模和精度。
Motivation: 传统方法如密度泛函理论（DFT）在构建化学反应网络时需要大量计算资源，通常需要以反应物和产物作为输入，难以用于大规模探索。
Method: ReactionAtlas 采用机器学习生成模型从动力学采样的候选化合物中提议反应，再用 DFT 训练的机器学习力场（MLFF）筛选出有效过渡态，产物作为新种子进入搜索，实现从种子分子开始的自动反应网络构建。
Result: 从 8 个前生命种子分子出发，发现了约 47,000 个反应和约 12,000 个化合物；MLFF 预测的过渡态结构在 85% 的情况下与 PBE0 参考值的 RMSD 在 0.5 Å 以内，并可轻松提升至 PBE0 精度水平。
Conclusion: ReactionAtlas 实现了小分子碳水化合物化学（最高 C4H8O4）的大规模精确反应网络映射，包括电荷和立体信息，为研究前生命化学中的反应路径（如福尔摩斯循环）提供了新见解。

papers.title: Unveiling Transferability in Trajectory Prediction via Latent Scene Embeddings
papers.abstract_en: The growing availability of trajectory datasets has fueled major advances in data-driven motion prediction. Yet, models trained on one dataset often fail to generalize beyond their training domain as a result of differences in scene layouts, agent behaviors, and sensing conditions. A framework that learns latent representations of datasets and quantifies their similarity using distributional metrics is presented. This large-scale study covers 24 major datasets, including the most widely used motion-prediction benchmarks, and shows that the resulting transferability scores strongly correlate with cross-dataset model performance. The results provide practical guidance for dataset selection, pretraining, and large-scale foundation models for motion prediction, paving the way toward more generalizable and robust predictive systems.

papers.title: A Single Rewrite Suffices: Empirical Lessons from Production Skill Description Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Enterprise AI agents route user queries to specialized skills by matching queries against natural language skill descriptions. When two skills share overlapping descriptions, the routing LLM misroutes queries, a failure we term skill collision. As agents scale to dozens of skills, manually tuning descriptions to maintain routing accuracy becomes a significant engineering bottleneck. We deploy an automated description optimization pipeline on a production enterprise group chat agent (9 skills, 372 regression cases). The pipeline produces descriptions averaging 79.2% F1, matching manually tuned descriptions at 79.4% F1 (average per-skill difference -0.20%, within the 0.78% multi-seed noise floor), while reducing per-skill engineering effort from 120 minutes to 3.8 minutes (32 times speedup). We then examine which pipeline components actually drive this match. Systematic ablation on both the production system and ToolBench (16k tools) reveals that a single LLM rewrite using any available false-positive and false-negative cases captures most of the available improvement. Other design choices we tested (iteration budget, feedback signal composition, dual editing of confused pairs, and training set size) each affect final F1 by less than 0.5%. Description optimization addresses skill collisions caused by overlapping descriptions but cannot resolve cases where two skills intended scopes genuinely overlap. We identify a diagnostic (a large train-validation F1 gap) that flags the latter cases for architectural rather than text-level intervention.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究企业AI代理中技能描述重叠导致的路由错误（技能碰撞），提出自动化描述优化管线。在生产系统（9个技能、372个回归用例）上，管线生成的描述平均F1为79.2%，接近人工调优的79.4%，同时将每个技能的工程耗时从120分钟降至3.8分钟。消融实验表明，单次LLM改写即可捕获大部分改进，其他设计选择影响小于0.5%。
Motivation: 企业AI代理中技能描述重叠会导致路由错误（技能碰撞），随着技能数量增加，人工调优描述成为工程瓶颈。
Method: 部署自动化描述优化管线，利用LLM重写技能描述，并使用假阳性和假阴性案例进行反馈。
Result: 管线生成的描述平均F1为79.2%，接近人工调优的79.4%（差异-0.20%），工程效率提升32倍。消融实验显示单次LLM改写即可获得主要收益。
Conclusion: 描述优化解决了因描述重叠导致的技能碰撞，但无法处理技能本身意图重叠的情况。提出训练-验证F1差距作为诊断指标，指示需要架构级干预。

papers.title: What Drives Interactive Improvement from Feedback?
papers.abstract_en: We study when natural-language feedback produces improvement beyond the gains obtainable from repeated attempts alone. In multi-turn language agent setting, higher final accuracy can reflect useful feedback, but it can also arise from resampling, format correction, or additional test-time computation. To separate these effects, we introduce a controlled student-teacher protocol across Omni-MATH, Codeforces, BBEH Linguini, and ARC-AGI1, evaluating thirteen open-weight models in both student and teacher roles. We compare external feedback, self-feedback, and unguided self-refinement, while varying interaction history, task difficulty, and teacher access to privileged task information. Across settings, we find that multi-turn improvement is often not evidence of feedback use: self-generated feedback adds little beyond unguided self-refinement, whereas the strongest external teachers produce substantially larger feedback-specific gains, suggesting that useful feedback must provide guidance beyond generic retry. Dense student-teacher interaction matrices further show that interactive gains are driven more by the student's ability to use feedback than by the teacher's identity, although teacher choice remains important for a fixed student. These results suggest that feedback-based agents should be evaluated against repeated-attempt baselines, and that ability to act on feedback, not merely feedback availability, is a central bottleneck for interactive improvement. We release our controlled student-teacher evaluation framework at https://j-lojek.github.io/feedback-generation-is-a-bottleneck/.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过受控的学生-教师协议实验，分离了自然语言反馈与重复尝试本身带来的性能提升。研究表明，自我生成的反馈几乎没有额外增益，而强外部教师的反馈才带来显著提升，且交互改进更多地取决于学生利用反馈的能力而非教师身份。
Motivation: 多轮语言智能体中，更高的最终准确性可能来自有用反馈，但也可能来自重采样、格式修正或额外测试时计算，现有方法难以区分这些因素。
Method: 提出受控的学生-教师评估框架，在Omni-MATH、Codeforces、BBEH Linguini和ARC-AGI1四个基准上，对13个开源模型（作为学生和教师）比较外部反馈、自我反馈和无指导的自我修正，并变化交互历史、任务难度和教师对特权信息的访问。
Result: 多轮改进通常不能证明反馈被有效利用：自我生成反馈相比无指导自我修正增益甚微，而强外部教师产生的反馈带来显著增益。学生-教师交互矩阵表明，交互增益主要由学生利用反馈的能力而非教师身份驱动。

papers.title: Diffusion-warm sampling of the XY model enables fast thermalization at scale
papers.abstract_en: We introduce a novel technique for scalable sampling of spin-system states with continuous symmetries using diffusion models. By applying our approach to the XY model, a fundamental continuous-spin model in condensed matter physics, we show that our technique addresses the shortfalls of the Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) in generalization to varying system sizes. More specifically, we show that training a temperature-conditioned diffusion model on smaller-size XY model lattices enables the generation of accurate samples in larger lattice sizes. By tracking physically important observables of the model, such as spin correlations, our experiments demonstrate that diffusion sampling followed by a few MCMC steps reduces the thermalization time by an order of magnitude relative to the standard MCMC with random initialization. Our study provides valuable insight as to how generative models can be used to study continuous-state condensed matter systems at scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出利用扩散模型（diffusion model）对具有连续对称性的自旋系统状态进行可扩展采样，应用于XY模型。通过在小尺寸XY模型格点上训练温度条件扩散模型，可生成大尺寸格点的准确样本。实验表明，扩散采样后接少量MCMC步骤能将热化时间降低一个数量级。
Motivation: 标准马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）在推广到不同系统尺寸时存在泛化不足的问题，需要更高效的采样技术来加速热化。
Method: 在小尺寸XY模型格点上训练温度条件扩散模型，利用其生成大尺寸格点的样本，随后辅以少量MCMC步骤以精细化采样。
Result: 扩散采样加少量MCMC将热化时间降低一个数量级，并能准确追踪自旋关联等物理可观测量。
Conclusion: 生成模型可用于大规模连续态凝聚态系统的高效采样，为相关研究提供新思路。

papers.title: Understanding and Evaluating Claw-like Agent Security Through a Computer-Systems Lens
papers.abstract_en: Claw-like AI agents (e.g., OpenClaw) are always-on processes with persistent access to credentials, files, tools, and external services. They take on system-level responsibilities -- installing packages, maintaining state, scheduling subtasks, and mediating I/O -- making security failures far more severe than in other agents. Yet existing benchmarks focus on model responses and tool calls, leaving cross-component failure modes largely unmeasured. We adopt a computer-system analogy: treating a Claw-like agent as an agentic computer system whose gateway runtime plays an OS-like mediation role, whose Skills resemble user-installed applications, and whose Plugins resemble loadable extensions with runtime privileges. Each component has a classical counterpart whose protection mechanisms -- refined over decades of cybersecurity research -- are absent on the agent side. From this perspective, we develop SafeClawArena, a benchmark of 406 adversarial tasks across four attack surfaces (Skill Supply-Chain Integrity, Persistent State Exploitation, Cross-Boundary Data Flow, and Indirect Prompt Injection), executed in containerized replicas of real agent platforms with canary-marked credentials and evaluated via automated taint tracking across nine output channels. We evaluate three platforms (OpenClaw, NemoClaw, SeClaw) and five frontier LLMs. The highest attack success rate reaches 70%; malicious Plugins succeed in 100% of cases regardless of the LLM. SeClaw cuts GPT-5.4's attack success rate from 70% to 22%, partly through utility-security tradeoffs rather than active defenses, while Claude-Opus-4.6 already sits near a 22% floor on every platform. These results expose the inadequacy of current defenses and suggest directions for future hardening. Code and data: https://github.com/sunblaze-ucb/SafeClawArena.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种计算机系统视角来理解类爪（Claw-like）AI代理的安全问题，将代理类比为操作系统，其技能和插件分别对应应用程序和可加载扩展。基于此视角，开发了SafeClawArena基准测试，包含406个对抗性任务，覆盖四个攻击面，在三个代理平台和五个前沿LLM上评估。结果显示最高攻击成功率达70%，恶意插件100%成功，而SeClaw通过效用-安全权衡将GPT-5.4的攻击成功率从70%降至22%。
Motivation: 现有基准主要关注模型响应和工具调用，忽略了跨组件故障模式。类爪代理具有持久访问权限和系统级责任，安全失败后果更严重，因此需要系统化的安全评估方法。
Method: 采用计算机系统类比，将代理网关运行时视为操作系统，技能视为用户安装的应用程序，插件视为具有运行时权限的可加载扩展。基于此构建SafeClawArena，包含406个对抗性任务，覆盖技能供应链完整性、持久状态利用、跨边界数据流和间接提示注入四个攻击面，在容器化真实代理平台上通过自动污点追踪评估。
Result: 最高攻击成功率达70%；恶意插件在所有情况下100%成功；SeClaw将GPT-5.4的攻击成功率从70%降至22%，部分通过效用-安全权衡而非主动防御；Claude-Opus-4.6在所有平台上接近22%的基线。
Conclusion: 当前防御措施不足，需要进一步加固。

papers.title: Streaming Gaussian Encoding for 4D Panoptic Occupancy Tracking
papers.abstract_en: Camera-based 4D panoptic occupancy tracking (4D-POT) is a promising paradigm for holistic scene understanding from multi-view imagery, enabling joint reasoning about geometry, semantics, and object identities across time. Recent mask-based pipelines achieve strong performance by propagating instance queries across frames. However, their underlying volumetric representations are typically recomputed at each timestep, limiting geometric temporal consistency, particularly under occlusion and for static scene elements. To address this limitation, we propose a streaming Gaussian encoder that maintains a persistent volumetric scene representation for 4D-POT. Our method models the scene as a fixed-size set of latent Gaussian queries that are propagated via ego-motion compensation and refreshed under a confidence-guided budget constraint. Crucially, we shape Gaussian opacities through depth-based supervision to serve as proxy for visibility, enabling confidence to accumulate as a temporally aggregated measure of persistent scene support. Together with a warmup-based multi-frame training strategy, this yields representation-level temporal coherence beyond decoder-only tracking. Extensive experiments on Occ3D-extended nuScenes and Waymo establish a new state-of-the-art for camera-based 4D-POT, improving tracking consistency with negligible computational overhead while remaining fully compatible with existing mask-based pipelines. We provide code and models at https://sge.cs.uni-freiburg.de.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种流式高斯编码器，用于摄像头4D全景占据跟踪。它维护一个持久化的体积场景表示，通过自运动补偿传播固定大小的潜在高斯查询，并在置信度引导的预算约束下刷新。深度监督用于塑造高斯不透明度作为可见性代理，结合多帧训练策略，实现表示级别的时间一致性。在Occ3D扩展的nuScenes和Waymo数据集上达到新SOTA，跟踪一致性提升，计算开销可忽略。
Motivation: 现有基于掩码的4D-POT管道通常在每个时间步重新计算体积表示，限制了几何时间一致性，尤其是在遮挡和静态场景元素下。
Method: 提出流式高斯编码器：场景表示为固定大小的潜在高斯查询集，通过自运动补偿进行传播，并在置信度引导的预算约束下刷新。利用深度监督塑造高斯不透明度作为可见性代理，使置信度累积为时间聚合的持久场景支持度量。结合预热的多帧训练策略。
Result: 在Occ3D扩展的nuScenes和Waymo数据集上，该方法在所有指标上达到新的最佳性能，尤其提升了跟踪一致性，且计算开销可忽略。
Conclusion: 流式高斯编码器实现了表示级别的时间一致性，超越了纯解码器跟踪方法，并且与现有基于掩码的管道完全兼容，具有实用价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Hierarchical Global Attention (HGA)
papers.abstract_en: Hierarchical Global Attention (HGA) is a drop-in replacement for dense causal attention in pretrained long-context transformers. HGA preserves the original checkpoint parameters: the pretrained $W_Q$, $W_K$, $W_V$, and $W_O$ projections remain unchanged, no calibration parameters are introduced, and no retraining is required. Applied to Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8 on a single RTX~5090 (32GB), the patched model runs out of the box at a 64K-token context, where token-level K/V storage is not feasible on this hardware. Unlike previous sparse-attention methods, HGA performs hierarchical two-level routing. It first retrieves relevant chunks using compact RoPE-aware summaries and then refines the selection by routing only the most relevant groups before performing exact token-level attention. This hierarchical retrieval significantly reduces the number of fetched tokens while preserving exact attention over the retrieved token set, making RAM- and NVMe-backed storage practical. The full historical token K/V resides in host RAM or NVMe storage, while only a small routed working set is transferred to GPU memory during attention. Consequently, GPU memory consumption depends primarily on model weights and the routed working set rather than on the total context length. Across all tested context lengths (4K - 64K tokens), routed attention remains within approximately $0.01$--$0.02$ nats of dense attention while the sparsity used is just about 3%. These results suggest that the approximation introduced by hierarchical routing is small, and that the remaining quality gap is likely dominated by long-context positional encoding rather than by the routing algorithm itself.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出分层全局注意力（HGA），一种可替代密集因果注意力的方法，适用于预训练的长上下文Transformer。HGA无需修改预训练参数或重新训练，通过分层两级路由实现高效注意力计算。在Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507-FP8模型和单个RTX5090（32GB）上，HGA支持64K token上下文，GPU内存消耗仅取决于模型权重和路由工作集而非上下文总长度。实验显示，在4K至64K上下文长度下，路由注意力与密集注意力的KL散度约为0.01-0.02 nats，稀疏度仅约3%。
Motivation: 长上下文Transformer在处理超长序列时，token级别K/V存储在GPU上不可行，导致内存瓶颈。现有稀疏注意力方法可能引入较大近似误差或需要大量校准和重训练。
Method: HGA执行分层两级路由：首先使用紧凑的RoPE感知摘要检索相关块，然后仅将最相关组路由到精细选择阶段，最后对检索到的token集执行精确注意力计算。完整历史token的K/V存储在主机RAM或NVMe中，仅少量路由工作集传输到GPU内存。
Result: 在所有测试上下文长度（4K-64K）下，HGA与密集注意力的KL散度保持在0.01-0.02 nats内，稀疏度约3%。该模型在单张RTX 5090上可开箱即用地处理64K上下文，而传统方法在此硬件上无法存储全部token级K/V。
Conclusion: 分层路由引入的近似误差很小，剩余质量差距可能主要来自长上下文位置编码，而非路由算法本身。HGA是一种实用的、无需重训练的稀疏注意力替代方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Why Do Few-Step Text Latents Fail When Image Latents Work? Non-Commitment at Sharp Categorical Readouts
papers.abstract_en: Deterministic few-step generation succeeds on continuous image latents but collapses to incoherent text on continuous text latents, and we show the cause is geometric rather than a training or scaling deficiency: a smooth, regularity-limited deterministic map cannot resolve a discrete branch choice before a sharp categorical readout, so few-step failure is governed by decoder sharpness, not transport accuracy. In the overlapping regime of real text autoencoders, we prove (Theorem 3) that the posterior-mean terminal step flips tokens at the rate of the latent mass in an $O(s(t))$ tube around decision boundaries. Two diagnostics, DABI (readout sharpness) and CCI (categorical commitment), measured on published checkpoints show that four independently built continuous-text decoders amplify a boundary-aligned perturbation far beyond a norm-matched isotropic one (DABI from $5\times10^{2}$ to $>10^{5}$), while image decoders have DABI $\approx 1$. Two mechanisms escape the continuous bound: categorical commitment (autoregressive decoders succeed despite sharper readouts) and stochastic re-injection (deterministic ODE at $K=4$ gives PPL 294 versus SDE 50 on the same model). In the idealized separated regime we prove matching sharp transport laws, including a dimension phase diagram: the deterministic stiffness needed to separate $M$ modes grows as $Θ(\sqrt{\log M})$ once the latent dimension is $Ω(\log M)$ (and as $M^{1/n}$ in fixed dimension), with a depth-$B$ hierarchy giving a $\sqrt{B}$-smaller per-step peak (Theorems 5-7); a coarea identity links these to the overlapping tube (Theorem 17). The result is an accuracy-depth-stiffness tradeoff: within the deterministic-continuous class the cost is irreducible, and both escapes step outside it.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究为何确定性少步生成在连续图像潜变量上成功，但在连续文本潜变量上失败。作者证明原因是几何性质的：平滑的确定性映射无法在尖锐的解码器读出前解决离散分支选择。提出两个诊断指标 DABI（读出尖锐度）和 CCI（类别承诺），显示独立构建的连续文本解码器对边界对齐扰动的放大倍数远大于各向同性扰动（DABI 从5×10²到>10⁵），而图像解码器的 DABI ≈1。两种逃逸方式：自回归解码器（尽管读出更尖锐却成功）和随机重新注入（K=4 时确定性ODE的PPL为294 vs SDE的50）。
Motivation: 现有确定性少步生成在图像任务上成功，但在文本任务上产生无意义输出。作者质疑这是否源于训练或规模不足，并试图从几何角度解释这一差异。
Method: 通过理论分析（定理3）证明后验均值终端步在决策边界附近的管状区域内翻转令牌的速率与潜变量质量相关。提出诊断指标 DABI（读出尖锐度）和 CCI（类别承诺），并在已发布的检查点上测量。证明了匹配的尖锐传输定律，包括维度相图（定理5-7）和 coarea 恒等式（定理17）。
Result: 确定性少步生成在文本潜变量上崩溃，根本原因是解码器的尖锐度而非传输精度。四种独立构建的连续文本解码器的 DABI 值远大于图像解码器。两种有效逃逸方法：使用自回归解码器（即使更尖锐）或引入随机性（从确定性ODE切换到SDE可大幅降低PPL）。
Conclusion: 在确定性连续类中，精度-深度-刚度折衷的成本是不可消除的；要解决文本少步生成问题，必须跳出该类（如采用自回归或随机注入）。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Search to Synthesis: Training LLMs as Zero-Shot Workflow Generators
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) excel across a wide range of tasks, yet their instance-specific solutions often lack the structural consistency needed for reliable deployment. Workflows that encode recurring algorithmic patterns at the task level provide a principled framework, offering robustness across instance variations, interpretable traces for debugging, and reusability across problem instances. However, manually designing such workflows requires significant expertise and effort, limiting their broader application. While automatic workflow generation could address this bottleneck, existing methods either produce instance-specific solutions without learning task-level patterns, or cannot generalize beyond their training configurations. We present MetaFlow, which casts workflow generation as a meta-learning problem: given a task and an operator set, the model learns to compose solution strategies. MetaFlow trains in two stages: supervised fine-tuning on synthetic workflow data, followed by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) that uses execution feedback across problem instances in the task to improve end-to-end success. The resulting model produces effective workflows for trained tasks and exhibits strong generalization to untrained tasks and novel operator sets. Across benchmarks in question answering, code generation, and mathematical reasoning, MetaFlow achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art baselines on in-domain tasks with single inference, while demonstrating remarkable zero-shot generalization capabilities on out-of-domain tasks and operator sets.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MetaFlow，将工作流生成建模为元学习问题：给定任务和算子集合，模型学习合成解决方案策略。两阶段训练（监督微调 + 强化学习）使模型能在单个推理中生成任务级工作流，在问答、代码生成和数学推理基准上达到与强基线相当的性能，并展现出对未见任务和新算子集合的零样本泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 多为实例级解决方案，缺乏结构一致性；手动设计任务级工作流需大量专业知识，自动生成方法要么只产生实例级解，要么无法泛化到新配置。
Method: MetaFlow 两阶段训练：先在合成工作流数据上监督微调，再通过可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）利用跨实例执行反馈改进端到端成功率。
Result: 在问答、代码生成和数学推理基准上，单次推理即可达到与 SOTA 基线相当的内域性能，并在域外任务和算子集合上表现出强零样本泛化。
Conclusion: MetaFlow 证明了通过学习任务级工作流模式，LLM 能高效、可重用且可解释地应用于结构化任务，泛化能力强。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Accelerometry-Derived Digital Biomarkers for Cardiometabolic Risk: A Population-Representative Tabular Benchmark with Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Structured tabular data dominates clinical medicine, yet existing benchmarks fail to reflect real-world properties like complex survey sampling, demographic oversampling, and subgroup fairness. We introduce the NHANES Accelerometry Cardiometabolic Benchmark, derived from NHANES 2003-2006, comprising 1,381 adults with hip-worn accelerometry, fasting laboratory biomarkers, dietary intake, and anthropometrics. We evaluate three tabular learning methods -- ridge regression, XGBoost, and the foundation model TabPFN v2 -- to predict glycated haemoglobin (HbA1c), fasting triglycerides, and C-reactive protein (CRP) from activity phenotypes and lifestyle covariates. TabPFN v2 achieves the best overall performance (HbA1c R^2=0.156, CRP R^2=0.383), while triglycerides remain largely unpredictable (R^2 < 0.05), consistent with known genetic dominance. We apply split conformal prediction to generate distribution-free 90% prediction intervals and evaluate demographic coverage equity across sex and race/ethnicity subgroups. Marginal coverage aligns with the 90% target for CRP and HbA1c but falls below for triglycerides. At the subgroup level, we observe localized undercoverage (e.g., HbA1c for Mexican American participants), illustrating the gap between marginal guarantees and the conditional coverage required for clinical fairness. Code and data are at https://github.com/felizzi/nhanes-accel-cardiometabolic-benchmark.
papers.comment: Accepted at the SD4H Workshop at ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文基于NHANES 2003-2006数据构建加速度计心脏代谢基准，评估岭回归、XGBoost和TabPFN v2三种方法预测HbA1c、甘油三酯和CRP。TabPFN v2性能最优（HbA1c R²=0.156, CRP R²=0.383），但甘油三酯几乎不可预测（R²<0.05）。利用分裂共形预测生成90%预测区间，发现边际覆盖在CRP和HbA1c上达标，但甘油三酯不足；子组水平出现局部欠覆盖（如墨西哥裔美国人的HbA1c），揭示边缘覆盖保证与临床公平所需条件覆盖之间的差距。
Motivation: 现有表格数据基准未能反映真实世界的复杂调查抽样、人口统计过采样和子组公平性等特性，亟需一个更能代表临床实际的数据集和评估框架。
Method: 从NHANES 2003-2006中筛选1,381名成人，整合髋部加速度计数据、空腹实验室生物标志物、饮食摄入和人体测量指标，构建基准。比较岭回归、XGBoost和TabPFN v2三种表格学习方法，并应用分裂共形预测（split conformal prediction）生成分布无关的90%预测区间，评估性别和种族/族裔子组的覆盖公平性。
Result: TabPFN v2在HbA1c（R²=0.156）和CRP（R²=0.383）上取得最佳性能，而甘油三酯预测R²<0.05。预测区间边际覆盖对CRP和HbA1c接近90%目标，但甘油三酯低于目标。子组分析发现墨西哥裔美国人在HbA1c上存在局部欠覆盖。
Conclusion: 摘要强调边缘覆盖保证不足以确保临床公平，子组水平的条件覆盖差异（如墨西哥裔美国人的HbA1c）表明需要更精细的校准方法。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: An AI-Based Solution for Secure Service Provisioning in IoT
papers.abstract_en: As the Internet of Things (IoT) continues its rapid expansion, the attack surface grows accordingly, with emerging threats targeting smart objects and their interactions. In this evolving landscape, securing service provisioning is crucial to ensure the proper functioning, security, and reliability of the IoT ecosystem. Service provisioning encompasses key tasks such as device registration, configuration, authentication, authorization, and software deployment, all of which are essential for seamless and secure IoT operations. In this paper, we present a comprehensive framework designed to select the most suitable smart objects to deliver a target service within a given IoT environment while also monitoring the behavior of the entities involved during the service provisioning phase. To achieve this, we employ a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) approach in which an intelligent agent learns, through interaction with a complex, dynamic environment, how to adapt to changes while adhering to predefined security constraints. For behavioral monitoring, we leverage Federated Learning (FL) to develop a global Behavioral Fingerprinting (BF) model that is fully distributed and can analyze how IoT devices interact within the network. In addition, the BF is used to compute a reliability score for each service provider, reflecting its degree of compliance with the defined security constraints. This score is then incorporated into the service provisioning process, allowing smart objects to select providers not only according to functional suitability but also to their reliability level. Finally, we conduct an extensive experimental evaluation to assess the robustness and scalability of our approach. The results demonstrate that our solution can be effectively deployed even on resource-constrained IoT devices, making it a viable and scalable security-enhancing mechanism for modern IoT ecosystems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对物联网（IoT）环境中的安全服务提供问题，提出一个基于深度强化学习（DRL）和联邦学习（FL）的综合框架。该框架通过DRL智能体动态选择最合适的智能对象来交付服务，并利用FL构建分布式行为指纹（BF）模型监控设备交互，计算提供者的可靠性分数以优化选择。实验证明该方案能在资源受限的IoT设备上有效部署，提升安全性与可扩展性。
Motivation: 随着IoT快速扩展，攻击面增加，服务提供（如设备注册、认证、授权等）的安全保障对生态系统可靠性至关重要，现有方法缺乏同时考虑功能适配和可靠性的动态选择机制。
Method: 提出一个结合深度强化学习（DRL）和联邦学习（FL）的框架：DRL智能体在动态环境中学习适应变化并遵守安全约束以选择服务提供者；FL用于训练全局分布式行为指纹（BF）模型，监控设备交互并计算每个提供者的可靠性分数，将此分数融入服务提供选择过程。
Result: 实验评估表明，该方案在资源受限的IoT设备上也能有效部署，展现出鲁棒性和可扩展性，可作为现代IoT生态系统中可行的安全增强机制。
Conclusion: 该框架通过DRL和FL的集成，实现了兼顾功能适配与可靠性评估的智能服务选择，为IoT安全服务提供提供了新思路，但摘要未提及具体性能数值或与基线对比。

papers.title: BEST-RQ-2: Contextualize-Then-Predict, a Two-Step Approach for Self-Supervised Audio Representations
papers.abstract_en: Self-supervised learning enables audio representations that transfer across domains and tasks. We present BEST-RQ-2, an evolution of BEST-RQ that retains frozen randomprojection-based discrete targets while introducing a two-step contextualize-then-predict pretraining scheme. A ViT context encoder processes only the unmasked spectrogram regions, and a lightweight predictor infers targets for the masked regions; the predictor is discarded after pretraining. Replacing the original Conformer encoder with a ViT shifts performance across domains, slightly reducing speech performance while improving music and environmental sounds, with comparable average scores. The main improvement comes from decomposing masked prediction into separate contextualization and prediction stages. On the X-ARES and XARES-LLM benchmarks, BEST-RQ-2 consistently outperforms one-stage baselines in overall transfer while keeping inference compute unchanged. Code and model checkpoints are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: BEST-RQ-2 是对 BEST-RQ 的改进，采用双阶段“上下文化-再预测”自监督预训练方案，使用 ViT 编码器仅处理未掩码频谱区域，轻量预测器推断掩码区域目标，预训练后丢弃预测器。在 X-ARES 和 X-ARES-LLM 基准上，BEST-RQ-2 在多域迁移中一致优于单阶段基线，且推理计算量不变。
Motivation: 改进 BEST-RQ 框架，通过解耦掩码预测中的上下文编码和预测阶段，提升自监督音频表征的跨域迁移能力。
Method: 提出双阶段预训练：ViT 上下文编码器仅编码未掩码频谱区域，轻量预测器预测掩码区域的目标（基于冻结随机投影的离散目标），预测器在预训练后丢弃。
Result: 在 X-ARES 和 X-ARES-LLM 基准上，BEST-RQ-2 在整体迁移性能上一致优于单阶段基线；ViT 相比 Conformer 在语音上略有下降，但在音乐和环境声音上提升，平均分数相当。
Conclusion: 解耦上下文化和预测阶段能有效提升自监督音频表征的泛化性，且不增加推理计算开销；代码和模型已公开。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Joint discovery of governing partial differential equations from multi-source datasets by competitive optimization
papers.abstract_en: Discovering governing equations directly from observational data is a key step towards interpretable scientific machine learning. Current data-driven approaches typically operate on a single dataset, inherently limiting their performance when faced with restricted observations. In practice, multiple datasets are often available for the same physical system, distinguished only by distinct initial conditions or boundary configurations. Here, we present a competitive optimization framework designed to discover shared partial differential equations (PDEs) from multi-source datasets, termed MCO-PDE. The framework first trains independent neural surrogates for each data source, and then employs a soft-competitive weighting mechanism to dynamically assess dataset credibility and aggregate a consensus global coefficient. Integrated with a genetic algorithm for structural search, this approach simultaneously identifies the functional forms and parameters of the governing laws. We demonstrate that fusing as few as 50 observations per dataset across seven cases recovers canonical equations with high accuracy. The framework inherently handles two- and three-dimensional domains characterized by irregular boundaries and heterogeneous coefficients, and successfully extracts physically meaningful laws from real-world wave-tank experiments. Overall, this work establishes a promising route for automated scientific discovery via heterogeneous data fusion.

papers.title: LUMOS: A Semantic Operating-System Layer for Accessibility-Grounded AI Agents
papers.abstract_en: Current operating systems expose interfaces optimized for human users but not for AI agents. Humans benefit from pixels, icons, windows, visual grouping, mouse movement, and keyboard shortcuts; AI agents instead need compact semantic state, grounded actions, and reliable feedback. As a result, many computer-use agents are forced to interpret screenshots, OCR output, and visual crops, introducing high token costs, visual ambiguity, latency, and coordinate uncertainty. This paper introduces LUMOS (Language Model Unified Machine-Readable Operating-System Semantics), a semantic interaction layer between AI agents and operating systems. LUMOS converts native accessibility metadata and browser UI structures into machine readable semantic blueprints with stable identifiers, roles, names, values, bounds, and action affordances. It also supports live semantic pointer grounding by querying the UI element under or near the cursor through operating-system automation APIs. An LLM then acts through an accessibility grounded observe act loop using constrained visible-UI primitives rather than application-specific scripts. LUMOS does not claim to replace visual agents; instead, it reduces dependence on screenshots when operating systems already provide semantic structure. These results suggest a path toward AI-native operating systems and machine-readable interaction layers.
papers.comment: The LUMOS repository is available at https://github.com/thotayogeswarreddy/Lumos.git
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LUMOS，一个语义操作系统层，将可访问性元数据和浏览器UI结构转换为机器可读的语义蓝图，使AI代理能通过观察-行动循环使用受限的可见UI原语，减少对截图的依赖。
Motivation: 当前操作系统为人类用户设计的界面（像素、图标、窗口）对AI代理不友好，导致代理需依赖截图、OCR等，带来高token成本、视觉歧义和延迟。
Method: LUMOS通过操作系统自动化API将可访问性元数据和UI结构转换为带有稳定标识符、角色、名称、值、边界和动作能力的语义蓝图，并支持实时语义指针定位，使LLM通过受限UI原语执行观察-行动循环。
Result: LUMOS降低了对截图的依赖，但未声称取代视觉代理，而是利用操作系统已有的语义结构。
Conclusion: LUMOS展示了向AI原生操作系统和机器可读交互层发展的路径。

papers.title: ViTL: Temporal Logic-Guided Zero-Shot Natural Language Navigation via Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Enabling robots to follow natural language commands to complete zero-shot long-horizon tasks remains challenging. It requires extracting implicit temporal and logical constraints from natural language commands and executing multiple sub-tasks accordingly. Recent zero-shot object navigation methods use vision-language models (VLMs) to guide frontier-based exploration in unknown environments, but they are limited to single-target tasks. Real-world commands such as "Clean either the chair or the couch, then turn on the tv." require navigating to multiple targets in a temporally constrained order, which no existing zero-shot system can handle. We present ViTL, a framework that addresses this gap at two levels. At the task level, we use a large language model (LLM) to compile natural language commands into Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) formulas, which are then converted into Deterministic Finite Automata~(DFA) that coordinate multi-channel value maps and trigger dynamic replanning when new objects are detected. At the navigation level, we introduce directional score: rather than producing a direction-agnostic value across the entire field of view, we label frontier directions on the observation image and extract per-direction scores from the VLM. Experiments on Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) show that the full framework enables zero-shot long-horizon completion of natural language navigation tasks with temporal constraints, and that directional score improves single-target navigation accuracy and efficiency over the baseline.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ViTL框架，利用大语言模型将自然语言指令编译为线性时序逻辑公式，再转换为确定性有限自动机来协调多通道价值图，实现零样本长时域导航任务。在导航层面引入方向评分，从VLM中提取每个前沿方向的分数，替代全局方向无关评分。实验在HM3D上验证了框架在含时序约束的自然语言导航任务中的有效性。
Motivation: 现有零样本导航方法仅限于单一目标任务，无法处理包含时序顺序和逻辑约束的多目标自然语言指令（如“先清洁椅子或沙发，然后打开电视”）。
Method: 任务层：用LLM将指令编译为LTL公式，再转为DFA协调多通道价值图并触发动态重规划。导航层：在观测图像上标注前沿方向，用VLM提取每个方向的分数（方向评分）。
Result: 在HM3D上，完整框架实现了含时序约束的零样本长时域自然语言导航任务；方向评分相比基线提升了单目标导航的准确率和效率。
Conclusion: ViTL首次实现了含时序约束的零样本多目标自然语言导航，方向评分是提升导航性能的关键组件。

papers.title: Modeling Cell-Cycle-Aware Single-Cell Drug Perturbation Responses
papers.abstract_en: Single-cell drug perturbation models should predict not only transcriptional response magnitude, but also whether a treatment alters the proliferative state of a cell. This is challenging because cell-cycle variation is often treated as nuisance variation, and benchmark pipelines rarely treat drug-induced phase changes as a primary prediction target. We introduce scCycleMol, a cell-cycle-aware perturbation prediction framework built on a curated 24-hour SciPlex3 benchmark with standardized molecule identities, dose and cell-line metadata, and gene expression with cell-cycle supervision derived from treated states. Instead of using cell-cycle state as an input covariate, scCycleMol derives supervision from predicted treated expression and propagates it through a learnable full-expression cell-cycle head with circular G1/S/G2M phase targets. We evaluate marker-based supervision, molecular representations, and pretraining strategies to isolate sources of improvement. Across a SciPlex3 benchmark with over 600k cells, 186 perturbation conditions, multiple cancer cell lines, and thousands of genes, scCycleMol improves out-of-distribution expression prediction compared with conditional perturbation baselines. The best LINCS-pretrained circular model achieves 0.9093 expected all-gene r squared and 0.6843 expected differentially expressed gene r squared, compared with 0.6800 and 0.5400 for LINCS-pretrained ChemCPA. Closed-loop cell-cycle supervision improves phase accuracy by about 0.5 to 0.6 points while maintaining nearly unchanged expression prediction. A Tahoe-pretrained variant reaches 0.9609 phase accuracy, highlighting the benefit of explicit cell-cycle-aware supervision in perturbation modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出scCycleMol，一种细胞周期感知的单细胞药物扰动响应预测框架。该模型通过可学习的全表达细胞周期头从预测的受处理表达中推导监督信号，而非将细胞周期状态作为输入协变量。在覆盖60万细胞、186种扰动条件的SciPlex3基准上，scCycleMol在分布外表达预测上优于条件扰动基线，LINCS预训练模型实现0.9093的全基因决定系数，细胞周期阶段准确性提升0.5-0.6点。
Motivation: 单细胞药物扰动模型需预测转录响应幅度及治疗是否改变细胞增殖状态，但现有方法常将细胞周期变异视为噪声，且基准管线很少将药物诱导的细胞周期变化作为预测目标。
Method: 构建24小时SciPlex3基准，包含标准化分子身份、剂量和细胞系元数据及带细胞周期监督的基因表达。scCycleMol从预测的受处理表达中通过循环G1/S/G2M阶段目标的全表达细胞周期头传播监督，而非作为输入协变量。
Result: 在SciPlex3基准上（超60万细胞、186种扰动、多种细胞系、数千基因），scCycleMol提升分布外表达预测。最佳LINCS预训练模型达到0.9093预期全基因R²和0.6843预期差异表达基因R²（对比ChemCPA的0.6800和0.5400），闭环细胞周期监督提升阶段准确性约0.5-0.6点，Tahoe预训练变体达到0.9609阶段准确性。
Conclusion: 显式细胞周期感知监督能有效提升扰动建模中的细胞周期阶段预测准确性，同时保持表达预测性能。

papers.title: DSIP: A Dynamic Coordination Planner for Signal-Free Intersections using Diffusion-Model-Based Multi-Agent Motion Planning
papers.abstract_en: Traffic signal control at urban intersections inherently introduces stop-and-go behavior, resulting in increased delays and reduced traffic efficiency, especially under high traffic demand. With the emergence of connected and automated vehicles (CAVs), trajectory-level coordination has emerged as a high-potential strategy to augment or transcend conventional phase-based management. This paper proposes DSIP (Diffusion-model-based Signal-free Intersection Planner), a multi-agent motion planning framework driven by a generative diffusion process. DSIP shifts the intersection management paradigm from discrete temporal phasing to continuous multi-vehicle trajectory optimization. This work evaluates the theoretical upper-bound performance of this coordination strategy under idealized communication and execution conditions to isolate the core benefits of the diffusion-driven approach. Using the SUMO platform, we evaluate DSIP across diverse four-leg intersection configurations. Experimental results demonstrate that DSIP significantly reduces average delay and maintains higher average speed compared to both fixed-time signal control and state-of-the-art reinforcement-learning-based controllers, particularly in medium- to high-density traffic. These findings suggest that diffusion-based trajectory planning provides a scalable and robust foundation for future autonomous intersection management. By unlocking latent intersection capacity through software-defined coordination, this approach offers a cost-effective pathway to improve urban traffic flow efficiency without requiring physical infrastructure expansion.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DSIP，一种基于扩散模型的多智能体运动规划框架，用于无信号灯交叉口的连续轨迹优化。在 SUMO 仿真中，DSIP 在中等至高密度交通流下显著降低平均延迟并保持更高平均速度，优于固定时间信号控制和强化学习控制器。
Motivation: 传统信号灯控制导致停车-启动行为，增加延迟，降低效率，尤其在交通需求高时。
Method: DSIP 利用生成式扩散过程进行多车辆轨迹协同优化，将交叉口管理从离散相位调度转变为连续轨迹优化。
Result: 在 SUMO 多种四路交叉口配置下，DSIP 显著降低平均延迟并保持更高平均速度，尤其在中等至高密度交通下。
Conclusion: 基于扩散的轨迹规划为未来自主交叉口管理提供了可扩展且鲁棒的方案，通过软件协调释放潜在交叉口容量，无需物理基础设施扩建。

papers.title: MIMFlow: Integrating Masked Image Modeling with Normalizing Flows for End-to-End Image Generation
papers.abstract_en: Normalizing Flows (NFs) are powerful generative models capable of exact density estimation and sampling. However, their strict invertibility often forces the model to exhaust its capacity on low-level pixel details, hindering the capture of high-level semantic structures. While Masked Image Modeling (MIM) has excelled in representation learning, its integration into generative pipelines has remained largely modular and disjointed. In this paper, we propose MIMFlow, a unified end-to-end framework that jointly optimizes latent semantics, pixel reconstruction, and generative flow. By employing a VAE encoder to infer semantic latent from masked images, MIMFlow achieves a principled decoupling of the generative task: the Normalizing Flow focuses on modeling a simplified, low-frequency semantic manifold, while a specialized decoder handles high-frequency synthesis. This design effectively resolves the inherent capacity bottleneck of NFs, allowing the model to prioritize global structural coherence over redundant noise. Empirical results on ImageNet 256$\times$256 show that MIMFlow-L reaches 71.3\% linear probing accuracy and an FID of 2.50. Despite using only 128 tokens (50\% fewer than standard models), it yields a 32.8\% performance gain over similar-scale NF baselines. Our code is available at https://github.com/MCG-NJU/MIMFlow.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MIMFlow，一个统一的端到端框架，将掩码图像建模 (MIM) 与归一化流 (Normalizing Flows) 结合用于图像生成。通过 VAE 编码器从掩码图像中推断语义潜变量，归一化流建模简化的低频语义流形，而专用解码器处理高频合成，解决了归一化流的容量瓶颈。在 ImageNet 256×256 上，MIMFlow-L 达到了 71.3% 的线性探测准确率和 2.50 的 FID，仅使用 128 个 token（比标准模型少 50%），性能比同类规模的归一化流基线提升 32.8%。
Motivation: 归一化流因严格可逆性被迫将容量浪费在低级像素细节上，难以捕捉高层语义结构；而掩码图像建模在表示学习中表现出色，但与生成流程的集成通常是模块化的、不连贯的。本文旨在统一两者，实现端到端的图像生成。
Method: 提出 MIMFlow 框架，使用 VAE 编码器从掩码图像中提取语义潜变量，然后让归一化流仅建模简化的低频语义流形，同时使用专用解码器负责高频细节合成，从而实现任务解耦。
Result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，MIMFlow-L 达到 71.3% 线性探测准确率和 2.50 FID。仅用 128 个 token（减少 50%）便比类似规模的归一化流基线提升 32.8% 的性能。
Conclusion: MIMFlow 通过将归一化流专注于语义流形、解码器处理高频细节，有效缓解了归一化流的容量瓶颈，在图像生成任务上取得了显著改进。
