papers.title: Quantization Inflates Reasoning: Token Inflation as a Hidden Cost of Low-Bit Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is widely used to reduce the inference cost of large language models, but its effect on reasoning models is not fully captured by final-answer accuracy or per-token latency. We show that low-bit post-training quantization can introduce a hidden test-time compute cost: quantized reasoning models often generate longer chains of thought even when they still answer correctly. Across mathematical reasoning, code generation, scientific question answering, and agentic tool-use benchmarks, we find that INT4/INT3 quantization can preserve accuracy but increase reasoning-token usage, offsetting the expected per-token speedup. To measure this effect, we introduce the CoT Token Inflation Ratio, which compares reasoning length between quantized and full-precision models averaged across all evaluation benchmarks. We further show that token inflation is accompanied by behavioral changes in the reasoning trace, including more intermediate steps and greater semantic repetition. These changes translate into measurable end-to-end real-world serving penalties. Finally, we evaluate mitigation strategies and find that prompting and decoding-time sampling offer inconsistent accuracy-length trade-offs, while quantization-aware training shows more promise in reducing both accuracy degradation and token inflation. Our results suggest that reasoning-token usage should be reported alongside accuracy when evaluating quantized reasoning models.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文揭示低比特后训练量化（INT4/INT3）虽然能保持推理模型的准确性，但会导致推理链变长，增加 token 使用量，从而抵消预期的每 token 加速。作者引入 CoT Token Inflation Ratio 指标，并发现 token 膨胀伴随行为变化，如更多中间步骤和语义重复。量化感知训练在减少准确率下降和 token 膨胀方面更有前景。
Motivation: 已有研究主要关注量化对最终准确率或逐 token 延迟的影响，但忽略了量化可能增加推理链长度，从而增加测试时计算成本。
Method: 通过后训练量化将模型权重降至 INT4/INT3，在数学推理、代码生成、科学问答和智能体工具使用等基准上评估，并引入 CoT Token Inflation Ratio 度量推理长度变化。
Result: 实验表明 INT4/INT3 量化在保持准确率的同时，推理 token 使用量显著增加，导致实际服务中的端到端惩罚。Token 膨胀伴随更多中间步骤和语义重复。
Conclusion: 评估量化推理模型时应同时报告推理 token 使用量和准确率。提示和采样策略无法一致地平衡准确率与长度，量化感知训练更有前景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Brevity is the Soul of Inference Efficiency: Inducing Concision in VLMs via Data Curation
papers.abstract_en: Inference efficiency is typically pursued by shrinking the model: distillation, pruning, quantization, and sparse routing each lower per-token cost while treating token count as fixed. But output length has been inflating, and it is precisely the component the standard toolkit leaves untouched. Here, we argue that brevity is the missing inference-efficiency lever, and that pretraining data curation is a practical way to pull it: a model trained on concise, correct data learns to answer in fewer tokens; i.e. it has a lower Cost-of-Pass. We apply our VLM curation pipeline to the MAmmoTH-VL single-image subset, and compare models trained on our curated data, the standard MAmmoTH-VL data, and external open-weight frontier VLMs. On a controlled 20-evaluation set and 14 VLMs at 1B-4B activated parameters, we hold output length fixed with a per-model regression, separating brevity from quality, and price models in FLOPs per correct answer. Curation buys a 35x Cost-of-Pass advantage over the most verbose 4B comparator (Qwen3.5-4B) within $\sim$1 pp of accuracy (0.41 vs 14.58 TFLOPs per correct answer; 0.691 vs 0.704 mean accuracy). Curation also buys a +17.55-percentage-point matched-length accuracy gain over the uncurated baseline that grows with model scale (from +16.7 pp at 1B to +21.2 pp at 4B). This brevity improvement concedes no quality: generic verbosity buys no accuracy at any capability or scale, and the window where reasoning-structured verbosity still earns its tokens shrinks from 4 of 8 capability groups at 2B to 1 of 8 at 4B. Per example, the concise model even reaches correct answers the verbose reasoning model misses, marking reasoning as a distinct curation target rather than something brevity gives up. Inference efficiency in this regime is a tokens-per-correct problem, and brevity is the lever that targets it directly.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通过预训练数据策展来诱导视觉语言模型（VLM）输出简洁性，从而降低推理成本。作者对MAmmoTH-VL单图像子集进行策展，训练1B-4B参数的模型，对比标准数据和外部队列模型。策展数据在固定输出长度下获得35倍每正确答案FLOPs优势（0.41 vs 14.58 TFLOPs），准确率相近（0.691 vs 0.704）；策展还比未策展基线提升17.55个百分点匹配长度准确率，且随规模增长。简洁性不牺牲质量，通用冗长不提高准确率。
Motivation: 现有推理效率方法（蒸馏、剪枝等）关注减小模型规模，但输出长度不断增长且未被触及。作者认为输出长度是关键效率杠杆，而预训练数据策展是实用手段。
Method: 对MAmmoTH-VL单图像子集应用数据策展管道，训练VLM；通过回归模型固定输出长度，分离简洁性与质量，以每正确答案FLOPs评估成本。
Result: 策展在4B参数下对比最冗长模型Qwen3.5-4B获得35倍成本优势（0.41 vs 14.58 TFLOPs/正确答案），准确率相近（0.691 vs 0.704）。策展比未策展基线提升+17.55百分点匹配长度准确率（1B到4B +16.7至+21.2 pp）。通用冗长不提升准确率；推理式冗长收益窗口随规模缩小（2B下4/8能力组→4B下1/8）。
Conclusion: 推理效率在此场景下是每正确输出token问题，简洁性是直接杠杆。策展诱导的简洁性不牺牲质量，甚至能给出冗长推理模型遗漏的正确回答。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Real vs. Complex Spectral Bases for Neural Operators: The Role of Green's Function Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) learn solution operators of partial differential equations by parameterizing global convolutions in the complex Fourier domain. For real-valued PDE solutions, the complex FFT carries representational redundancy through conjugate symmetry. We introduce the Hartley Neural Operator (HNO), the exact real-valued mirror of FNO: it replaces the FFT with the purely real Discrete Hartley Transform and learns a single real multiplier per retained spectral mode, with no complex arithmetic. Because the real Hartley spectrum is not halved by conjugate symmetry, HNO retains twice as many frequency corners as FNO but one real weight where FNO carries a complex pair, so the two operators are iso-parametric at equal width and differ only in spectral basis. Our central thesis is that the best basis is a property of the operator. Self-adjoint elliptic operators (Poisson, biharmonic) have real, symmetric Green's functions that the real Hartley multiplier diagonalizes exactly, and HNO is favored there. Time-dependent operators carry phase, from oscillation in the wave equation to transport in advection, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, which a real diagonal multiplier cannot represent, so FNO is favored there, and increasingly so with the operator's phase content, leaving the phaseless heat equation as the borderline case. Training both operators identically and benchmarking across PDE classes, initial-condition families, and boundary conditions, we find an elliptic-versus-time-dependent split that is monotone in operator phase content and matches the Green's-function theory we develop. Rather than a universal winner, our findings give a predictive rule: match the spectral basis to the symmetry of the solution operator.
papers.comment: Submitted to/in consideration for the 62nd Allerton Conference on Communication, Control, and Computing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Hartley Neural Operator (HNO)，作为 Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) 的实值镜像，用实值 Discrete Hartley Transform 替代复数 FFT。研究发现最佳谱基取决于算子的格林函数对称性：自伴椭圆算子（如 Poisson、biharmonic）更适合 HNO，而时间依赖算子（如波动、Burgers、Navier-Stokes）因相位成分更适合 FNO。实验结果单调符合该预测规则。
Motivation: FNO 在处理实值 PDE 解时，复数 FFT 通过共轭对称性引入冗余，而实值神经网络算子的谱基选择缺乏理论指导。
Method: 将 FNO 中的复数 FFT 替换为纯实数的离散 Hartley 变换，每个保留的谱模式学习单个实值权重（而非复数对），使得两个算子在等宽时参数相同但谱基不同。
Result: 在不同 PDE 类别、初始条件和边界条件下，自伴椭圆算子（Poisson、biharmonic）上 HNO 优于 FNO，时间依赖算子（波动、Burgers、Navier-Stokes）上 FNO 优于 HNO，且差距随算子相位含量单调变化。
Conclusion: 最佳谱基应匹配解算子的对称性——而非存在通用最优基，为神经算子设计提供了基于格林函数对齐的预测规则。
Relevance: 15

papers.title: One Year Later...The Harms Persist, But So Do We!
papers.abstract_en: General-purpose large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for mental health-related conversations, yet safety guardrails remain inadequate and inconsistent across clinical conditions. This study evaluates eight proprietary LLMs across 16 DSM-5 conditions using four adversarial attack variants, introducing an eight-dimension harm taxonomy and a multi-dimensional evaluation framework. Results show that safeguards hold reliably only for suicide and self-harm, while conditions such as eating disorders, substance use disorder, and major depressive disorder exhibit failure rates of up to 100\%. We argue that ethical design and deployment of these LLMs demand clearly defined harm categories across clinical conditions and implementation of safeguards accordingly. Until such safeguards are in place, these models pose significant risks to vulnerable populations, making their growing integration into publicly available settings (e.g., schools, search engines, and consumer chatbots) are particularly concerning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了8个专有大型语言模型（LLMs）在16种DSM-5心理健康条件下的安全性，使用4种对抗攻击变体，并引入8维伤害分类框架。结果显示，除自杀和自伤外，其他条件（如进食障碍、物质使用障碍、重度抑郁症）的安全护栏失败率高达100%。作者认为，这些模型在安全措施到位前对弱势群体构成重大风险，尤其令人担忧的是它们正越来越多地被整合到公共可访问的场所（如学校、搜索引擎和消费者聊天机器人）中。
Motivation: 通用大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于心理健康相关对话，但安全护栏在临床条件下仍然不足且不一致，需要系统评估和分类。
Method: 研究评估了8个专有LLMs在16种DSM-5条件下，使用4种对抗攻击变体，并引入一个8维伤害分类和多维评估框架。
Result: 除自杀和自伤外，其他条件（如进食障碍、物质使用障碍、重度抑郁症）的安全护栏失败率高达100%。
Conclusion: 需要明确定义跨临床条件的伤害类别并相应实施安全措施；在此之前，这些模型对弱势群体构成显著风险。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: RigorBench: Benchmarking Engineering Process Discipline in Autonomous AI Coding Agents
papers.abstract_en: Agentic coding harnesses - such as Agent-Skills, Superpowers, and Agent-Rigor - are increasingly deployed to augment underlying LLMs for real-world software engineering tasks. Existing benchmarks evaluate these agents almost exclusively on outcome correctness: whether generated code passes tests or resolves issues. We argue that this outcome-only lens is insufficient: an agent that arrives at a correct solution through reckless trial-and-error, without planning, verification, or graceful recovery, is fundamentally less reliable than one that follows sound engineering discipline. We introduce RigorBench, the first benchmark designed to measure process discipline in AI coding agents. RigorBench evaluates these harnesses across five pillars: Planning Fidelity, Verification Coverage, Recovery Efficiency, Abstention Quality, and Atomic Transition Integrity. A composite RigorScore aggregates these dimensions into a single metric via a weighted sum. We curate a suite of 30 tasks spanning five categories - Plan-Then-Build, Verify-Or-Die, Doom Loop Gauntlet, Know When to Fold, and Don't Break the Build-and evaluate leading harnesses in a controlled with/without experimental design against baseline coding assistants. Our results show that structured process discipline not only improves process quality scores by an average of 41% but also raises downstream outcome correctness by 17%, providing the first quantitative evidence that how agents code matters as much as what they produce. We release the full benchmark, scoring rubrics, and trajectory analysis tools as open-source artifacts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: RigorBench 是首个评估 AI 编码代理过程纪律的基准，涵盖规划、验证、恢复等五个维度，通过 RigorScore 综合评分。实验表明，结构化的过程纪律将过程质量提升 41%，下游正确性提升 17%。
Motivation: 现有基准仅评估代码生成结果是否正确，忽略了代理在过程中是否遵循工程纪律（如计划、验证、恢复）。这可能导致看似正确但不可靠的代理被高估。
Method: 提出 RigorBench，包含五个支柱：规划保真度、验证覆盖率、恢复效率、放弃质量和原子转换完整性，通过加权和得到 RigorScore。构建 30 个任务（五类），采用有/无实验设计评估主流 harness。
Result: 结构化过程纪律将过程质量平均提升 41%，下游任务正确性提升 17%。首次定量证明编码过程与结果同等重要。
Conclusion: RigorBench 为评估 AI 编码代理的工程纪律提供了首个标准，并公开了基准、评分细则和分析工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Improving Reasoning in Vision-Language Models via Perception Verified Self-Training
papers.abstract_en: Achieving human-like reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remains a long-standing challenge. Recent approaches leverage Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rationales generated by human annotators or proprietary models, which are costly and difficult to scale. Self-training offers a promising alternative but often suffers from visual hallucinations and language shortcuts because rationales are filtered only by answer correctness without verifying visual perception. We propose a perception-verified self-training framework that enforces visually grounded reasoning. Our method employs a CoT template (caption-reasoning-conclusion) that disentangles perception from reasoning, enabling independent verification of visual understanding. To compensate for the absence of ground-truth captions, we introduce PerceptEval, an unsupervised method that evaluates caption quality based on its alignment with visual and textual elements in the image. Using caption verification together with answer correctness, we partition the data into easy, medium, and hard subsets and design a two-stage curriculum learning strategy. Stage 1 trains on easy samples, while Stage 2 enhances medium samples by regenerating reasoning conditioned on verified captions and retaining only those with correct conclusions. This ensures training is performed exclusively on perceptually grounded reasoning, reducing hallucinations and language shortcuts. Extensive experiments across diverse domains and models demonstrate improvements of up to 16% over standard self-training baselines, showing that our framework provides a scalable and cost-effective solution for advancing multimodal reasoning without manually annotated CoT rationales.
papers.comment: Accepted at The European Conference on Computer Vision 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种感知验证自训练框架，通过Chain-of-Thought模板（描述-推理-结论）分离感知与推理，并引入PerceptEval无监督方法评估描述质量。结合描述验证与答案正确性将数据分为易、中、难子集，设计两阶段课程学习策略，确保训练仅基于感知正确的推理。实验表明，该方法在多个领域和模型上比标准自训练基线提升最多16%。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖人工或专有模型生成CoT推理，成本高且难以扩展；自训练虽廉价但常因仅依靠答案正确性过滤而出现视觉幻觉和语言捷径，缺乏对视觉感知的验证。
Method: 提出感知验证自训练框架：使用CoT模板（描述-推理-结论）分离感知与推理；引入无监督方法PerceptEval评估描述与图像的对齐质量；基于描述验证和答案正确性将数据分为易、中、难三档；设计两阶段课程学习，第一阶段训练易样本，第二阶段基于已验证描述重新生成推理并保留正确结论的中等样本。
Result: 在多个领域和模型上的实验表明，该方法比标准自训练基线提升最高16%。
Conclusion: 该框架无需人工标注CoT推理，可扩展且经济有效，为推进多模态推理提供可行方案。

papers.title: Protein contacts are already in the attention: a single-forward-pass alternative to the Categorical Jacobian
papers.abstract_en: The Categorical Jacobian of Zhang et al. (2024) reads protein contacts from a language model by perturbing every residue with every alternative amino acid, about $19L$ forward passes. We show the signal it reconstructs is already concentrated in a small subset of attention heads: averaging the top-$K$ contact-relevant heads -- selected on as few as 10 labeled proteins, with no fitted per-pair or per-head weights -- recovers contacts in a single forward pass and matches or beats the Categorical Jacobian for every bidirectional model where it is defined (bar the smallest, 8M). Our primary test is leakage-clean: on a CAMEO split where neither selection nor evaluation touches data the models have plausibly memorized, the head readout beats the Categorical Jacobian on ESM-2-650M by +9pp ($N = 29$, $p < 0.001$), with the within-model margin reproducing across architectures. Ablations localize the gain to labeled head selection, not to averaging: at a matched label budget the unweighted mean ties a supervised $L_1$ logistic regression on the same heads. Both methods fall 30-36pp from their in-distribution Zhang numbers to the leakage-clean split, which we read as an upper bound on how much prior numbers reflect pretraining overlap. We additionally introduce representation-CJ, a hidden-state generalization of the Jacobian to architectures without a masked-LM head (the output-head-independent analogue of logit-CJ), agreeing with the Categorical Jacobian where both are defined (per-protein Pearson $r \approx 0.95$); show that the optimal $K$ tracks how diffusely a model spreads its contact heads; and find both methods lose the signal on the two causal LMs we test, suggesting attention-encoded pair structure may depend on bidirectional pretraining.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现张等人（2024）提出的分类雅可比（Categorical Jacobian）方法通过扰动每个残基来预测蛋白质接触，其信号已集中在一小部分注意力头上。通过平均top-K最相关头（仅需10个标记蛋白），单次前向传播即可恢复接触，在所有双向模型中匹配或超越分类雅可比（最小8M模型除外）。在漏洁CAMEO分割上，ESM-2-650M的头读取方法比分类雅可比高9个百分点。
Motivation: 现有分类雅可比方法需要约19L次前向传播来预测蛋白质接触，效率低下。本文旨在利用预训练语言模型中已有的注意力头信号，实现更高效的单次前向传播接触预测。
Method: 提出基于注意力头的接触读取方法：在少量标记蛋白上选择top-K接触相关注意力头，取其未加权平均，一次前向传播即可预测接触。还引入representation-CJ，将雅可比推广到无遮蔽语言模型头的架构。
Result: 在漏洁CAMEO分割上，ESM-2-650M的头读取方法比分类雅可比高9个百分点（N=29，p<0.001），且跨架构复现。最佳头数K追踪模型接触头扩散程度。两种方法在因果LM上失效。
Conclusion: 注意力头读取方法可替代分类雅可比，效率更高且性能相当。研究表明接触信号依赖于双向预训练。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeXposure-Claw: An Agentic System for DeFi Risk Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Decentralized finance exposes supervisors to fast-moving, networked credit risks. General-purpose LLM agents fit this setting poorly: they over-read weak evidence and recommend high-stakes interventions, while existing evaluations offer no regulator-aligned way to measure the resulting false alarms. We introduce DeXposure-Claw, a forecast-grounded agentic supervision system that routes LLM decisions through structured evidence: (1) DeXposure-FM, a graph time-series foundation model, forecasts future exposure networks; (2) deterministic monitors and stress scenarios then turn those forecasts into typed alerts, attribution signals, and scenario evidence; and (3) data-health and confidence gates constrain escalation before DeXposure-Claw emits auditable supervisory tickets with rationales. We further develop DeXposure-Bench, a six-axis evaluation harness, whose decision axis scores tickets against a regulator-aligned absolute-loss ground truth and an explicit false-intervention rate. Experiments on five years of weekly real data fully support our system. Code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/DeXposure-Claw.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DeXposure-Claw，一个基于预测的代理监管系统，用于去中心化金融（DeFi）的风险监管。系统通过图时间序列基础模型DeXposure-FM预测未来风险网络，结合确定性监控和压力情景生成警报，并通过数据健康与置信度门控控制升级。实验基于五年真实数据验证了系统有效性。
Motivation: 通用LLM代理在DeFi风险监管中表现不佳，容易过度解读弱证据并推荐高风险干预，而现有评估缺乏符合监管标准的误报衡量方法。
Method: DeXposure-Claw系统包括三个组件：1) DeXposure-FM，一种图时间序列基础模型，预测未来风险网络；2) 确定性监控和压力情景，将预测转化为类型化警报、归因信号和情景证据；3) 数据健康与置信度门控，控制升级过程，最终生成可审计的监管工单。同时开发DeXposure-Bench评估框架，包含六个评估轴，其中决策轴使用监管对齐的绝对损失真实值和显式误报率评分工单。
Result: 在五年周级真实数据上的实验完全支持系统有效性。
Conclusion: 系统通过结构化证据路由LLM决策，结合预测模型和门控机制，实现了符合监管标准的DeFi风险监管。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Size Doesn't Matter: Cosine-Scored Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) detect features via inner product, so a feature's activation scales with both its directional alignment and the input's norm. Features that fire on token norm therefore claim dictionary slots regardless of content alignment. This matters because sublayer normalization has already discarded the magnitude the score measures, so the encoder detects a quantity the model does not read. We replace the score with a learned blend of cosine similarity and input magnitude, letting the optimizer choose how much norm to use; a per-feature extension lets each feature decide independently. In both regimes, training is free to recover inner product but never does, with no feature ever choosing more than half-magnitude dependence. At matched reconstruction, the cosine encoder learns features that align with human-recognizable concepts far more often than standard, filling dictionary slots that inner product wastes on norm detectors. Loss reweighting that equalizes gradients barely closes the gap, confirming forward-pass score geometry as the lever. The advantage is not universal across tasks or depths, but we believe cosine scoring should be the default for dictionary learning on normalized representations.
papers.journal_ref: ICML 2026, Spotlight at the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出标准稀疏自编码器使用内积评分会导致特征激活受输入范数影响，从而浪费字典槽位学习与语义无关的范数检测器。作者提出用余弦相似度与输入幅度的可学习混合替代内积，并允许每个特征独立选择依赖程度。实验表明，在匹配重构损失时，余弦评分编码器学习的特征更常对齐人类可识别的概念，且内积评分从未被优化器重新选择。
Motivation: 标准SAE通过内积检测特征，其评分同时依赖于方向对齐和输入范数，导致特征在token范数上激活，占用字典槽位却缺乏语义内容。由于层归一化已丢弃幅值信息，内积评分检测的是模型实际不读取的量。
Method: 将评分函数替换为余弦相似度与输入幅度的可学习混合（全局版本），并进一步扩展为每个特征独立学习混合系数（per-feature版本）。训练让优化器自动决定范数的使用程度。
Result: 在匹配重构损失下，余弦编码器学习的特征远更频繁地对齐人类可识别概念，且没有特征选择超过一半的幅度依赖。损失重加权（均衡梯度）几乎不能缩小差距，确认前向评分几何是主要因素。
Conclusion: 对于归一化表示的字典学习，余弦评分应成为默认方法，但优势并非在所有任务和深度上普遍成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Keep Policy Gradient in Charge: Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation for Long-Horizon Tool-Use Agents
authors: Juan Pablo De la Cruz Weinstein
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon tool-use reinforcement learning learns from outcome verification, but trajectory-level advantages are broadcast over reasoning, API, and answer tokens. Direct self-distillation can supply a denser signal, but in our experiments it can also destroy tool use by rehearsing teacher behavior without identifying which actions the verifier rewards. We introduce Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation (SGCD), which uses distillation for bounded credit weighting rather than as a competing actor loss. Dynamic sampling produces mixed successful and failed sibling rollouts; an external LLM summarizes their contrast into a training-only credit reference; and detached teacher/student divergence reshapes GRPO token advantages. The deployed student receives only the clean task prompt. Across AppWorld and tau^3-airline, SGCD reports higher held-out point estimates than GRPO-family comparators: AppWorld TGC improves from 42.9 to 45.6 on test_normal and from 24.7 to 27.0 on test_challenge, and tau^3-airline held-out evaluator score improves from 0.583 to 0.602. These results support a narrow design rule for long-horizon tool-use agents: use distillation to guide credit assignment while keeping policy gradient in charge of the actor update.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对长程工具使用智能体轨迹级信用分配稀疏的问题，提出Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation (SGCD)方法。该方法通过动态采样混合成功与失败的兄弟轨迹，借助外部LLM总结对比生成信用参考，并利用分离的教师/学生分歧重塑GRPO令牌优势。在AppWorld和tau^3-airline基准上，SGCD相较于GRPO系列方法取得提升：AppWorld test_normal上TGC从42.9提升至45.6，test_challenge从24.7至27.0；tau^3-airline评估分数从0.583增至0.602。
Motivation: 现有方法中轨迹级优势广播到所有令牌可能导致信用混淆，而直接自蒸馏可能破坏工具使用行为，需要更精确的信用分配机制。
Method: SGCD将蒸馏用于有界信用加权而非竞争演员损失。动态采样生成混合成功与失败的兄弟轨迹，外部LLM对比总结作为训练时信用参考，再利用分离的教师/学生分歧调整GRPO令牌优势，学生部署时仅使用干净任务提示。

papers.title: Online Shift Detection and Conformal Adaptation for Deployed Safety Classifiers
papers.abstract_en: Safety classifiers deployed in production operate under a stationarity assumption that fails silently: when input distributions drift, accuracy degrades with no error signal until ground-truth labels arrive. We present an online monitor that detects distributional shift in classifier scores via a sliding-window KS statistic with empirically calibrated alarm thresholds. In a pre-registered factorial evaluation (4 classifiers $\times$ 5 shift conditions $\times$ 20 seeds $\times$ 2 window sizes; 800 cells), the monitor achieves 86.6% valid detection (mean latency 39.5 steps) across synthetic-onset, real-jailbreak, and adversarial regimes; a classifier $\times$ shift interaction ($η^2 = 0.185$) shows that monitoring must be tuned per classifier. Attempting to recover post-detection coverage via weighted conformal prediction exposes a failure mode: density-ratio estimation collapses for generative classifiers because logistic regression separates source from target perfectly in 3584-4096-dimensional embedding space, clipping all importance weights to zero; projecting to $\leq 32$ dimensions restores coverage. We then extend the framework to gradient-based evasion and give the first threat-model characterisation of score-disagreement monitoring as a canary. We falsify three assumptions: that architectural diversity drives the signal (false, $η^2 = 0.011$), that it is generic out-of-distribution detection (false, GCG-specific, $p < 10^{-12}$), and that an adaptive attacker can suppress it (false while the canary is confident). We derive the exact security boundary, a confidence-gated equilibrium at which a monitor-aware attacker stalls at gap $= 1/(2λ)$, and provide a calibration-free scan martingale achieving false-alarm rate $\leq 1\%$ across all classifiers with no per-model tuning.
papers.comment: 30 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables. Code and pre-registration at https://github.com/junwenleong/safety-classifier-shift-monitor
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个在线监控器，用于检测部署的安全分类器中的分布偏移，通过滑动窗口KS统计量及经验校准的警报阈值。在预注册实验中（4个分类器×5种偏移条件×20个种子×2个窗口大小），监控器达到86.6%有效检测，平均延迟39.5步。尝试用加权共形预测恢复覆盖时，发现生成分类器中密度比估计因高维空间完美分离而崩溃，投影至≤32维后可恢复。进一步扩展到梯度逃避场景，首次刻画了分数差异监控的威胁模型，并证明三个常见假设不成立。最后推导出安全边界和一种无需校准的扫描martingale，在所有分类器上将误报率控制在1%以下。
Motivation: 生产环境中的安全分类器基于静态假设运行，当输入分布发生漂移时，分类精度会下降，但缺乏错误信号直到收到真实标签。需要一种在线方法检测偏移，并自适应恢复性能。
Method: 使用滑动窗口KS统计量检测分类器分数的分布变化，警报阈值通过经验校准。检测后，尝试用加权共形预测恢复覆盖，但发现生成分类器中logistic回归在高维嵌入空间（3584-4096维）完美分离源和目标，导致重要性权重归零；通过投影至≤32维可恢复覆盖。还提出一种基于扫描的martingale，无需针对每个模型调参即可实现低误报率。
Result: 预注册实验（800个实验单元）显示监控器有效检测率达86.6%，平均延迟39.5步。分类器与偏移条件之间存在交互效应（η²=0.185）。生成分类器中密度比估计失效，但低维投影后覆盖恢复。分数差异监控不是通用的OOD检测（GCG特异性，p<10⁻¹²），且自适应攻击者无法抑制。推导了精确安全边界：置信度门控均衡时停滞在gap=1/(2λ)。Martingale方法在所有分类器上误报率≤1%。
Conclusion: 摘要强调分布偏移监测需要针对具体分类器调优（分类器×偏移交互显著），生成分类器的高维密度比估计存在根本性失败，分数差异监控具有特定性，但通过无校准的扫描martingale可以实现鲁棒监控。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Comprehensive Inference-Time Augmentation Framework in Physiological Signals: Application to PPG-Based AF Detection
papers.abstract_en: Objective: Accurate classification of physiological signals in real-world deployments is challenged by sensor noise, motion artifacts, and distribution shifts between training and deployment data. Inference-time augmentation (ITA), which applies augmentations during inference rather than retraining, offers a simple, model-agnostic mechanism to improve robustness. However, ITA application to physiological signals has remained narrow in scope, relying on limited augmentation methods with fixed, unoptimized parameters. This work proposes a unified ITA framework to address that gap. Approach: The framework incorporates 13 augmentation methods spanning time-domain, amplitude-domain, frequency-domain, and artifact-injection transformations, with hyperparameters optimized via Bayesian optimization. We evaluate on atrial fibrillation (AF) detection from 30-second PPG signals using GPT-PPG and ResNet across five datasets comprising more than 400 patients and ${\sim}$9,800 hours of recording. Main results: Standard ITA consistently improved AUROC (up to 8.5% for GPT-PPG and 0.7% for ResNet) and AUPRC (up to 10.6% for GPT-PPG and 0.8% for ResNet). Selective ITA further reduced average FPR by up to 4.4% (GPT-PPG) and 1.3% (ResNet) on non-AF datasets. Significance: These findings establish ITA as a practical, model-agnostic approach for improving PPG-based AF classification reliability in deployment settings where retraining is not feasible, with broader applicability to physiological signal analysis.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables. Under review at Physiological Measurement
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个统一的推理时增强（ITA）框架，用于生理信号分类，特别是基于PPG的房颤检测。框架包含13种增强方法，通过贝叶斯优化超参数，在五个数据集上验证了ITA能显著提升模型鲁棒性。
Motivation: 真实部署中生理信号受到传感器噪声、运动伪影和分布偏移的影响，而现有ITA方法仅使用有限且参数固定的增强，缺乏统一框架。
Method: 提出包含13种时域、幅域、频域和伪影注入变换的ITA框架，使用贝叶斯优化超参数，并在GPT-PPG和ResNet模型上评估。
Result: 标准ITA将AUROC提升高达8.5%（GPT-PPG）和0.7%（ResNet），AUPRC提升10.6%和0.8%；选择性ITA进一步降低非AF数据集上的平均FPR达4.4%和1.3%。
Conclusion: ITA是一种实用且模型无关的方法，可在无法重训练时提升PPG房颤检测的可靠性，并具有更广泛的生理信号分析适用性。

papers.title: Learning All-Terrain Locomotion for a Planetary Rover with Actively Articulated Suspension
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents ERNEST, a four-wheeled planetary rover concept equipped with a two-degree-of-freedom Active Gimbal Suspension that combines yaw and roll actuation to enable wheel reconfiguration, steering, and active load redistribution. A single neural network controller, trained to track a desired path across challenging terrain, fully unlocks the capabilities of this actuated suspension system for autonomous obstacle negotiation. A reinforcement learning framework is developed using the high-fidelity DARTS simulation engine, which combines rigid-contact dynamics and Bekker-Wong terramechanics, enabling the emergence of locomotion strategies adapted to loose-soil conditions. To obtain a single unified controller across heterogeneous terrains, a policy consolidation strategy merges the experience of terrain-specialized agents into one neural network, eliminating the need for explicit terrain classification and controller switching. The resulting controller operates on a combination of proprioceptive and exteroceptive feedback, including sparse stereo-derived terrain elevation, chassis attitude, joint states, and force-torque measurements. Zero-shot transfer to the physical rover is achieved through domain randomization, sensor noise injection, and model-to-real system identification. Experimental results demonstrate autonomous traversal of rock fields, a Bickler trap (bump obstacle), a wheel-high step, sand ripples, and sandy slopes. On a 20° sandy slope, the learned controller reduces the cost of transport by 37% on dry sand despite the additional actuation, and achieves superior performance on wet sand where the passive suspension becomes completely immobilized. A video accompanying this paper is available at https://youtu.be/d684P5a3xMc
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ERNEST行星漫游车概念，采用二自由度主动万向悬挂（yaw和roll），通过强化学习训练单一神经网络控制器实现全地形自主导航。使用DARTS高保真仿真引擎结合Bekker-Wong地面力学，通过策略整合将地形专用智能体的经验合并，无需显式地形分类。通过域随机化和系统辨识实现零样本迁移到实车。实验在岩石场、Bickler陷阱、轮高台阶、沙波纹和沙坡上实现自主穿越，在20°沙坡上运输成本降低37%。
Motivation: 现有行星漫游车的被动悬挂在复杂地形（如松动土壤、陡坡）中易受限，需要主动悬挂系统来提升越野能力和自主障碍协商能力。
Method: 开发强化学习框架，使用DARTS仿真引擎（刚体接触动力学+Bekker-Wong地面力学），训练单一神经网络控制器；通过策略整合合并地形专用智能体的经验，结合本体感受（姿态、关节状态、力扭矩）和外感受（稀疏立体地形高程），利用域随机化和系统辨识实现零样本迁移。
Result: 在多种地形上实现自主穿越，包括岩石场、Bickler陷阱、轮高台阶、沙波纹和沙坡；在20°干沙坡上运输成本降低37%，湿沙坡上被动悬挂完全无法动弹而主动悬挂表现优异。
Conclusion: 主动悬挂结合强化学习可显著提升行星漫游车在极端地形下的机动性和效率，单一控制器能泛化到多种异构地形。

papers.title: Don't Gamble, GAMBLe: An Analytical Framework for AI-Driven Research Systems
papers.abstract_en: AI-Driven Research Systems (ADRS) -- systems coupling LLMs with automated evaluation to discover algorithms, proofs, and designs -- are being optimized and adopted across domains, but the tools to analyze them have not kept pace. ADRS performance depends on component interactions that are poorly understood, expensive to explore, and (as we show) not well captured by standard convergence guarantees. These guarantees rely on structural assumptions that do not hold under the ADRS process we formalize. We introduce GAMBLe, a framework that decomposes ADRS behavior into four parameters (generator $G$, assessor $\mathcal{A}$, discovery mechanism $\mathcal{M}$, budget $B$) and one compositional object, the effective landscape $L_{\text{eff}} = \mathcal{A} \circ G$, which reveals that distinct generator-assessor pairs induce structurally different per-problem optimization landscapes. We exercise the framework on 760+ replicated runs (>46,000 iterations) spanning generators from single LLMs to dynamically-adaptive ensembles, mechanisms from greedy selection to co-evolutionary meta-search, and three NP-hard problems whose assessors range from continuous scoring to cliff functions. The experiments reveal no total ordering of generators or mechanisms: frontier models can underperform open-source alternatives and the simplest mechanism sometimes outperforms state-of-the-art meta-search. Results show that even under limited budgets (60 iterations per run), the right component choices can improve performance by 13-67% and search efficiency by 6-39x.
papers.comment: Preprint. 23 pages (10 main, 13 appendix). 6 figures (2 in main, 4 in appendix)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出GAMBLe框架，用于分析AI驱动研究系统（ADRS），将系统行为分解为生成器、评估器、发现机制和预算四个参数，并引入有效景观概念。通过760+次复制实验（超过46000次迭代），在三个NP难问题上比较了不同生成器和机制，发现不存在全局最优的组件组合，简单的机制有时优于复杂的元搜索，且正确选择组件可在有限预算下将性能提升13-67%、搜索效率提升6-39倍。
Motivation: 现有分析工具无法捕捉ADRS的组件交互，标准收敛保证因结构假设不成立而失效，需要一种能够准确描述ADRS行为并指导组件选择的框架。
Method: 提出GAMBLe框架，将ADRS行为参数化为生成器G、评估器A、发现机制M和预算B，并定义有效景观L_eff = A∘G，用于揭示不同生成器-评估器组合所诱导的优化景观结构差异。
Result: 实验表明不存在对生成器或机制的完全排序：前沿模型可能不如开源替代方案，简单机制有时优于先进元搜索。在60次迭代的有限预算下，正确组件选择可带来13-67%的性能提升和6-39倍的搜索效率提升。
Conclusion: GAMBLe框架为理解和设计ADRS提供了系统化分析工具，强调了组件选择的关键影响，并揭示出性能表现高度依赖于问题本身的景观结构。

summary_sections.result: 实验表明不存在对生成器或机制的完全排序：前沿模型可能不如开源替代方案，简单机制有时优于先进元搜索。在60次迭代的有限预算下，正确组件选择可带来13-67%的性能提升和6-39倍的搜索效率提升。
summary_sections.conclusion: GAMBLe框架为理解和设计ADRS提供了系统化分析工具，强调了组件选择的关键影响，并揭示出性能表现高度依赖于问题本身的景观结构。

papers.title: Knowledge Graphs as the Missing Data Layer for LLM-Based Industrial Asset Operations
papers.abstract_en: LLM-based agents for industrial asset operations show limited accuracy when reasoning over flat document stores. AssetOpsBench (KDD 2026) establishes that GPT-4 agents achieve 65% on 139 industrial maintenance scenarios, and compares LLM orchestration paradigms (Agent-As-Tool vs. Plan-Execute) on a fixed data layer. We ask the orthogonal question: how much does the data model behind the tools matter? We treat a typed knowledge graph as a grounding substrate and route each question by how it is best answered: (i) LLM-generated Cypher for structured retrieval, which lifts the same GPT-4 model from 65% to 82-83%; (ii) native graph and optimization primitives, with no LLM, reaching 99% on graph-answerable scenarios; and (iii) generation-augmented knowledge (GAK) for answers absent from the data -- the engine's agent materializes the missing facts as provenance-tagged graph nodes, then answers. A recurring theme is inverted LLM usage: we constrain the LLM to query generation or one-shot enrichment from a typed schema and let the graph execute deterministically. On the 88 real AssetOpsBench failure-mode scenarios the benchmark itself flags non-deterministic -- ten equipment types absent from the graph -- GAK lifts answerability from zero to 100% of equipment types and answers 81.8% of scenarios, every materialized fact tagged source:LLM-derived for auditability. We also contribute 40 graph-native scenarios. For structured operational domains the data layer -- not the LLM orchestration -- is the primary lever, and a typed knowledge graph serves as a grounding substrate between raw industrial data and LLM reasoning.
papers.comment: v4: Accepted at Agents+Graph (AG2026) @ VLDB 2026. Corrects claims to reproduced ground truth: base graph 9 labels/5 edge types/12,647 nodes (extended schema 14/21); GAK materializes 106 failure-mode nodes; FailureSensorIQ noted as a separate IBM benchmark; 467 FMSR overlap with GAK disclosed. 20 pages, 4 figures. papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究类型化知识图谱作为LLM基础数据层对工业资产运维的影响，提出三种路由策略：LLM生成Cypher查询（提升GPT-4准确率从65%到82-83%）、纯图操作（图可达场景达99%）、生成增强知识（GAK）处理缺失事实（覆盖81.8%场景）。实验表明数据层比LLM编排更关键。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理在工业资产运维中因依赖平面文档存储而准确率有限，且以往研究聚焦于LLM编排范式，忽略了底层数据模型的影响。
Method: 构建类型化知识图谱作为基础，根据问题类型路由：结构化检索使用LLM生成Cypher，图原生问题使用确定性图算法，缺失知识通过GAK（引擎代理将缺失事实作为带来源标签的图节点实例化）补充。
Result: 在AssetOpsBench上，同一GPT-4模型由65%提升至82-83%；图原生场景达99%准确率；GAK覆盖原本零回答的88个故障场景中的81.8%，且所有事实标记为LLM衍生以确保可审计性。
Conclusion: 在结构化工业运维领域，数据层而非LLM编排是主要杠杆，类型化知识图谱可作为原始工业数据与LLM推理之间的可靠基础。

papers.title: Rethinking Continual Anomaly Detection on the Edge: Benchmarking Under Realistic Industrial Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Continual anomaly detection (CAD) addresses the need for industrial inspection systems to adapt to evolving production conditions, yet existing methods share three critical gaps: unrealistic evaluation, no systematic comparison, and no consideration of edge deployment constraints. We introduce a unified benchmark combining discrete-task evaluation on structural and logical anomalies, a novel continuous drift protocol, the first head-to-head comparison of all published CAD methods, and computational efficiency profiling on edge hardware. Our results reveal that existing CAD methods do not consistently outperform traditional approaches with simple experience replay. Thus motivated, we propose DINOSaur, a training-free method combining a frozen DINOv3 backbone with spatially-indexed coreset memory and neighborhood-restricted anomaly scoring. DINOSaur achieves zero forgetting by construction, outperforms all evaluated methods across all five protocols, and runs at sub-100\,ms inference on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano, with on-device adaptation to new tasks in under 30 seconds.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业边缘设备上的连续异常检测（CAD）提出统一基准，涵盖离散任务评估、持续漂移协议、所有已发表CAD方法的首次系统比较以及边缘硬件效率分析。结果发现现有CAD方法并未一致超越带简单经验回放的传统方法。作者提出DINOSaur，一种无训练方法，结合冻结的DINOv3骨干、空间索引的corest记忆和邻域限制的异常评分，在所有协议上超越对比方法，在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上推理时间低于100毫秒，设备上适应新任务在30秒内完成。
Motivation: 现有CAD方法存在三个关键空白：不现实的评估、缺乏系统比较以及未考虑边缘部署约束。
Method: 引入统一基准，包含结构性和逻辑异常的离散任务评估、新型连续漂移协议以及计算效率分析；提出DINOSaur方法，使用冻结的DINOv3骨干、空间索引corest记忆和邻域限制异常评分，无需训练。
Result: 现有CAD方法未一致优于传统经验回放；DINOSaur在所有五种协议上表现最佳，达到零遗忘，推理时间<100ms，设备适应新任务<30秒。
Conclusion: DINOSaur在工业边缘设备上实现了高效的连续异常检测，但方法局限于无训练场景，可能不适用于需要在线更新的复杂场景。

papers.title: Containment Verification: AI Safety Guarantees Independent of Alignment
papers.abstract_en: Agentic frameworks are the software layer through which AI agents act in the world. Existing safety methods intervene on the model and therefore remain conditional on unverifiable properties of learned behavior. We introduce containment verification, which locates safety guarantees in the agentic framework itself. Under havoc oracle semantics, the AI is modeled as an unconstrained oracle over the framework's typed action space, and the verified containment layer must enforce the boundary policy for every typed action value the AI can emit. For boundary-enforceable properties, expressed over modeled boundary events, action arguments, and state, we prove a universal guarantee by forward-simulation refinement and mechanize it in Dafny. We instantiate the paradigm by verifying PocketFlow, a minimalist agentic LLM framework, and use an agentic synthesis pipeline to generate the specification, operational model, and refinement proof under an information barrier against tautological specifications. To our knowledge, this is the first deductive formal verification of an agentic framework. The guarantee is independent of alignment because it quantifies over the framework's typed action boundary rather than over model behavior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“包含验证”（containment verification）方法，将AI安全保证从模型行为转移到智能体框架（agentic framework）本身。在混乱预言机语义（havoc oracle semantics）下，将AI视为框架类型化动作空间上的无约束预言机，通过前向模拟精化（forward-simulation refinement）证明边界属性，并在Dafny中机械化。该方法在最小化大语言模型智能体框架PocketFlow上实例化，据称是首个对智能体框架的演绎形式验证。保证独立于对齐（alignment），因为它对框架的类型化动作边界而非模型行为进行量化。
Motivation: 现有AI安全方法干预模型，因此依赖学习行为中不可验证的属性，存在根本性局限。需要一种不依赖于模型可验证属性的安全保证方法。
Method: 引入包含验证，将安全保证置于智能体框架本身。采用混乱预言机语义将AI建模为框架类型化动作空间上的无约束预言机，对边界可强制属性（由边界事件、动作参数和状态表达）通过前向模拟精化证明通用保证，并在Dafny中机械化。使用智能体合成流水线在信息壁垒下生成规范、操作模型和精化证明。
Result: 在PocketFlow（一个极简Agentic LLM框架）上实例化该范式，首次完成对智能体框架的演绎形式验证。
Conclusion: 该保证独立于对齐，因为它量化的是框架的类型化动作边界而非模型行为。方法适用于任何边界可强制属性。

papers.title: Shared Lexical Task Representations Explain Behavioral Variability In LLMs
papers.abstract_en: One of the most common complaints about large language models (LLMs) is their prompt sensitivity -- that is, the fact that their ability to perform a task or provide a correct answer to a question can depend unpredictably on the way the question is posed. We investigate this variation by comparing two very different but commonly-used styles of prompting: instruction-based prompts, which describe the task in natural language, and example-based prompts, which provide in-context few-shot demonstration pairs to illustrate the task. We find that, despite large variation in performance as a function of the prompt, the model engages some common underlying mechanisms across different prompts of a task. Specifically, we identify task-specific attention heads whose outputs literally describe the task -- which we dub lexical task heads -- and show that these heads are shared across prompting styles and trigger subsequent answer production. We further find that behavioral variation between prompts can be explained by the degree to which these heads are activated, and that failures are at least sometimes due to competing task representations that dilute the signal of the target task. Our results together present an increasingly clear picture of how LLMs' internal representations can explain behavior that otherwise seems idiosyncratic to users and developers.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）的提示敏感性，发现不同风格的提示（指令式和示例式）会调用共享的底层机制——特定的任务相关注意力头（lexical task heads），这些头的激活程度可以解释模型行为的变异性。
Motivation: LLM的提示敏感性导致其性能不可预测，用户和开发者难以理解模型行为。需要揭示这种变异的内部机制。
Method: 通过对比指令式提示和示例式提示，识别出任务特定的注意力头（lexical task heads），并分析其在不同提示下的激活模式。
Result: 发现不同提示风格共享相同的任务表示头，行为变异与这些头的激活程度相关，失败有时源于竞争任务表示稀释了目标信号。
Conclusion: 模型内部表示可以解释看似随机的行为变异，为理解LLM提示敏感性提供了机制性解释。

papers.title: Wasserstein Distributionally Robust Risk-Sensitive Estimation via Conditional Value-at-Risk
papers.abstract_en: We propose a distributionally robust approach to risk-sensitive estimation of an unknown signal x from an observed signal y. The observation and unknown signal are modeled as random vectors whose joint probability distribution is unknown, but assumed to belong to a given type-2 Wasserstein ball of distributions, termed the ambiguity set. The performance of an estimator is measured according to the conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) of the squared estimation error. Within this framework, we study the problem of computing affine estimators that minimize the worst-case CVaR over all distributions in the given ambiguity set. As our main result, we show that, when the nominal distribution at the center of the Wasserstein ball is finitely supported, such estimators can be exactly computed by solving a tractable semidefinite program. We evaluate the proposed estimators on a wholesale electricity price forecasting task using real market data and show that they deliver lower out-of-sample CVaR of squared error compared to existing methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Wasserstein分布鲁棒的风险敏感估计方法，以条件风险价值（CVaR）衡量估计误差。通过半定规划求解仿射估计器，并在电力价格预测中验证有效性。
Motivation: 现有估计方法未考虑分布不确定性下的风险敏感目标，尤其是尾部风险。
Method: 在类型-2 Wasserstein球（ambiguity set）下，最小化最坏情况CVaR，并证明当名义分布有限支撑时，问题可转化为可解半定规划。
Result: 在电力价格预测任务中，所提估计器在样本外CVaR方面优于现有方法。
Conclusion: 提供一种分布鲁棒风险敏感估计的可行计算方法，适用于有限支撑分布。

papers.title: Can VLMs Reason Robustly? A Neuro-Symbolic Investigation
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have been applied to a wide range of reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether they can reason robustly under distribution shifts. In this paper, we study covariate shifts in which the perceptual input distribution changes while the underlying prediction rules do not. To investigate this question, we consider visual deductive reasoning tasks, where a model is required to answer a query given an image and logical rules defined over the object concepts in the image. Empirically, we find that VLMs fine-tuned through gradient-based end-to-end training can achieve high in-distribution accuracy but fail to generalize under such shifts, suggesting that fine-tuning does not reliably induce the underlying reasoning function. This motivates a neuro-symbolic perspective that decouples perception from reasoning. However, we further observe that recent neuro-symbolic approaches that rely on black-box components for reasoning can still exhibit inconsistent robustness across tasks. To address this issue, we propose VLC, a neuro-symbolic method that combines VLM-based concept recognition with circuit-based symbolic reasoning. In particular, task rules are compiled into a symbolic program, specifically a circuit, which executes the rules exactly over the object concepts recognized by the VLM. Experiments on three simple visual deductive reasoning tasks with distinct rule sets show that VLC consistently achieves higher task accuracy on out-of-distribution data than other reasoning paradigms. Code is available at https://github.com/uiuctml/VLC.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究视觉语言模型在分布偏移下的稳健推理能力。通过在视觉演绎推理任务上实验，发现端到端微调能达到高分布内准确率但泛化差，而神经符号方法也存在鲁棒性问题。作者提出VLC方法，结合VLM概念识别与电路符号推理，在三个简单任务上取得更好的分布外准确率。
Motivation: 视觉语言模型在推理任务中是否能在分布偏移下稳健推理尚不明确，现有方法难以泛化。
Method: 提出VLC，一种神经符号方法，将任务规则编译成符号程序（电路），对VLM识别的概念执行精确推理。
Result: 在三个视觉演绎推理任务上，VLC在分布外数据上一致获得更高任务准确率。
Conclusion: 端到端微调不总能可靠地诱导出底层推理函数，而结合符号推理的神经符号方法（如VLC）在分布偏移下更稳健。

papers.title: T-QPM: Enabling Temporal Out-Of-Distribution Detection and Domain Generalization for Vision-Language Models in Open-World
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains a critical challenge in open-world learning, where models must adapt to evolving data distributions. While recent vision-language models (VLMS) like CLIP enable multimodal OOD detection through Dual-Pattern Matching (DPM), existing methods typically suffer from two major shortcomings: (1) They rely on fixed fusion rules and assume static environments, failing under temporal drift; and (2) they lack robustness against covariate shifted inputs. In this paper, we propose a novel two-step framework to enhance OOD detection and covariate distribution shift robustness in dynamic settings. We extend the dual-pattern regime into Temporal Quadruple-Pattern Matching (T-QPM). First, by pairing OOD images with text descriptions, we introduce cross-modal consistency patterns between ID and OOD signals, refining the decision boundary through joint image-text reasoning. Second, we address temporal distribution shifts by learning lightweight fusion weights to optimally combine semantic matching and visual typicality. To ensure stability, we enforce explicit regularization based on Average Thresholded Confidence (ATC), preventing performance degradation as distributions evolve. Experiments on temporally partitioned benchmarks demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms static baselines, offering a robust, temporally-consistent framework for multimodal OOD detection in non-stationary environments.

Motivation: 现有基于CLIP等视觉语言模型的OOD检测方法依赖固定融合规则，假设静态环境，无法应对时间漂移和协变量偏移。

Conclusion: 该工作针对非平稳环境下的多模态OOD检测，证明了时间自适应融合的重要性。

papers.title: AR-CoPO: Align Autoregressive Video Generation with Contrastive Policy Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Streaming autoregressive (AR) video generators combined with few-step distillation achieve low-latency, high-quality synthesis, yet remain difficult to align via reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). Existing SDE-based GRPO methods face challenges in this setting: few-step ODEs and consistency model samplers deviate from standard flow-matching ODEs, and their short, low-stochasticity trajectories are highly sensitive to initialization noise, rendering intermediate SDE exploration ineffective. We propose AR-CoPO (AutoRegressive Contrastive Policy Optimization), a framework that adapts the Neighbor GRPO contrastive perspective to streaming AR generation. AR-CoPO introduces chunk-level alignment via a forking mechanism that constructs neighborhood candidates at a randomly selected chunk, assigns sequence-level rewards, and performs localized GRPO updates. We further propose a semi-on-policy training strategy that complements on-policy exploration with exploitation over a replay buffer of reference rollouts, improving generation quality across domains. Experiments on Self-Forcing demonstrate that AR-CoPO improves both out-of-domain generalization and in-domain human preference alignment over the baseline, providing evidence of genuine alignment rather than reward hacking.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AR-CoPO框架，用于对齐自回归视频生成模型与人类偏好。通过分块级对比策略优化和半在线训练，在Self-Forcing模型上提升了跨域泛化和域内偏好对齐。
Motivation: 现有SDE-based GRPO方法在少步自回归视频生成中面临初始化噪声敏感和中间探索无效的问题，难以有效对齐。
Method: 提出AR-CoPO，采用分叉机制在随机块构建邻域候选，分配序列级奖励并进行局部GRPO更新，同时结合半在线策略利用回放缓冲区进行探索与利用。
Result: 在Self-Forcing上，AR-CoPO改进了跨域泛化和域内人类偏好对齐，避免了奖励黑客行为。
Conclusion: AR-CoPO为自回归视频生成提供了一种有效的对齐方法，避免了奖励作弊。

papers.title: Medical Image Spatial Grounding with Semantic Sampling
papers.abstract_en: Vision language models (VLMs) have shown significant promise in visual grounding for images as well as videos. In medical imaging research, VLMs represent a bridge between object detection and segmentation, and report understanding and generation. However, spatial grounding of anatomical structures in the three-dimensional space of medical images poses many unique challenges. In this study, we examine image modalities, slice directions, and coordinate systems as differentiating factors for vision components of VLMs, and the use of anatomical, directional, and relational terminology as factors for the language components. We then demonstrate that visual and textual prompting systems such as labels, bounding boxes, and mask overlays have varying effects on the spatial grounding ability of VLMs. To enable measurement and reproducibility, we introduce MIS-Ground, a benchmark that comprehensively tests a VLM for vulnerabilities against specific modes of Medical Image Spatial Grounding. We release MIS-Ground to the public at github.com/asy51/mis-ground. In addition, we present MIS-SemSam, a low-cost, inference-time, and model-agnostic optimization of VLMs that improves their spatial grounding ability with the use of Semantic Sampling. We find that MIS-SemSam improves the accuracy of Qwen3-VL-32B on MIS-Ground by 13.06%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言模型在医学图像空间定位中的挑战，提出MIS-Ground基准和MIS-SemSam优化方法，提升Qwen3-VL-32B准确率13.06%。
Motivation: 医学图像三维空间中的解剖结构定位存在独特挑战，现有VLM在模态、切片方向、坐标系以及解剖术语等方面表现不足。
Method: 提出MIS-Ground基准测试，涵盖多种医学图像空间定位模式；以及MIS-SemSam，一种低成本的推理时模型无关的语义采样优化方法。
Result: MIS-SemSam在MIS-Ground上将Qwen3-VL-32B的准确率提升13.06%。
Conclusion: 视觉和文本提示（标签、边界框、掩膜覆盖）对VLM空间定位能力有不同影响，语义采样是一种有效的优化手段。

papers.title: Event-Driven Video Generation
papers.abstract_en: Current text-to-video models can make individual frames look convincing while still getting simple interactions wrong: objects move before contact, an intended action is skipped, a placed object keeps drifting, or a support relation breaks. Our starting point is that standard frame-first denoising updates every latent region at every step, even when the prompt implies that only a local interaction should be active. We introduce Event-Driven Video Generation (EVD), a small DiT-compatible intervention that gives the sampler an explicit event signal. A lightweight head predicts token-level event activity; training losses tie that activity to latent state change; and event-gated sampling, with hysteresis and an early-step schedule, applies the update field mainly where an interaction is forming. On EVD-Bench, EVD improves human preference and VBench dynamics for state persistence, spatial accuracy, support relations, and contact stability, while keeping appearance quality comparable to the base model. The results suggest that a modest amount of event structure can correct several interaction failures that otherwise remain hidden behind good frame-level appearance.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. Project webpage: https://evd-project-website.pages.dev
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对文本生成视频模型中常见的交互错误（如物体提前移动、动作跳过、物体漂移、支撑关系断裂）提出事件驱动视频生成（EVD）方法。EVD 是一个轻量级的 DiT 兼容模块，通过预测 token 级事件活动并在采样时进行事件门控更新，使模型聚焦于正在形成的交互区域。在 EVD-Bench 上，该方法提升了人类偏好和 VBench 动态指标，同时保持外观质量与基线相当。
Motivation: 现有文本到视频模型在生成单帧外观时表现良好，但在处理简单物理交互时经常出错，例如物体在接触前移动或动作被跳过。这是因为标准去噪过程均匀更新所有隐层区域，忽略了交互的局部性。
Method: 提出事件驱动视频生成（EVD），在 DiT 架构中增加一个轻量级头部预测 token 级事件活动，并将该活动与隐状态变化通过训练损失绑定。在采样时采用事件门控策略（含迟滞和早期步骤调度），使得更新场主要作用于正在形成交互的区域。
Result: 在 EVD-Bench 上，EVD 在状态持久性、空间准确性、支撑关系和接触稳定性等指标上提升了人类偏好和 VBench 动态评分，同时外观质量与基线模型相当。
Conclusion: 结果表明，引入适度的事件结构可以有效纠正多个在帧级外观良好的情况下仍隐藏的交互失败问题。

papers.title: Entropy-Controlled Flow Matching
papers.abstract_en: Modern vision generators transport a base distribution to data through time-indexed measures, implemented as deterministic flows (ODEs) or stochastic diffusions (SDEs). Despite strong empirical performance, standard flow-matching objectives do not directly control the information geometry of the trajectory, allowing low-entropy bottlenecks that can transiently deplete semantic modes. We propose Entropy-Controlled Flow Matching (ECFM): a constrained variational principle over continuity-equation paths enforcing a global entropy-rate budget d/dt H(mu_t) >= -lambda. ECFM is a convex optimization in Wasserstein space with a KKT/Pontryagin system, and admits a stochastic-control representation equivalent to a Schrodinger bridge with an explicit entropy multiplier. In the pure transport regime, ECFM recovers entropic OT geodesics and Gamma-converges to classical OT as lambda -> 0. We further obtain certificate-style mode-coverage and density-floor guarantees with Lipschitz stability, and construct near-optimal collapse counterexamples for unconstrained flow matching.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出熵控制流匹配（ECFM），一种变分框架，通过对连续方程路径施加全局熵率约束来控制信息几何，以避免低熵瓶颈。方法等效于带有显式熵乘子的薛定谔桥，在纯传输情况下恢复熵最优传输，并给出模式覆盖和密度下界保证。
Motivation: 标准流匹配目标不直接控制轨迹的信息几何，允许低熵瓶颈暂时耗尽语义模式。
Method: 提出ECFM，一个在Wasserstein空间上的凸优化，带有KKT/Pontryagin系统，并具有随机控制表示，等价于带有显式熵乘子的薛定谔桥。
Result: 在纯传输情况下恢复熵最优传输，并随着lambda->0 Gamma收敛到经典最优传输。还提供了证明风格的模态覆盖和密度下界保证，以及无约束流匹配的接近最优的崩溃反例。
Conclusion: ECFM通过熵率约束改善了流匹配的信息几何，提供了理论保证。

papers.title: CoReLIN: Constraint-based Reasoning for Zero-shot Lifelong Interactive Navigation
authors: (2) IIT Kharagpur (3) DEVCOM Army Research Lab (4) National University of Singapore)
papers.abstract_en: Robot navigation typically assumes an obstacle-free path exists between start and goal. In real environments, however, clutter may block all routes. We introduce Lifelong Interactive Navigation, where a mobile robot with manipulation capabilities must move objects to forge paths and complete sequential object-placement tasks. Because environment modifications persist, decisions impact future navigability and task difficulty. We propose CoReLIN, an LLM-driven constraint-based reasoning framework with active perception. CoReLIN reasons over a structured scene graph to decide which objects to relocate, where to place them, and where to explore next. A standard motion planner executes reliable navigation and manipulation primitives. To evaluate long-horizon behavior, we introduce 2 new metrics - Long-term Efficiency Score (LES), a unified metric capturing success, execution efficiency, environment optimality, captured by Price of Clutter. In ProcTHOR-10k, CoReLIN outperforms best baseline by 16% under standard metrics and LES, and transfers to real-world hardware.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出终身交互导航任务，要求机器人在杂乱环境中移动物体以开辟路径并完成序列放置任务。CoReLIN 是一个基于 LLM 的约束推理框架，结合主动感知，利用结构化场景图决策物体重定位、放置位置和探索方向。在 ProcTHOR-10k 基准上，CoReLIN 在标准指标和提出的长期效率分数 (LES) 上均比最佳基线高出 16%，并成功迁移到真实硬件。
Motivation: 传统机器人导航假设起点与终点间存在无障碍路径，但现实环境中的杂乱可能阻塞所有可行路线。为此引入终身交互导航，其中环境修改持久化，决策影响后续导航可行性及任务难度。
Method: 提出 CoReLIN，一个 LLM 驱动的约束推理框架，结合主动感知。系统维护结构化场景图，通过推理决定哪些物体需要重定位、放置位置以及下一步探索区域，再由标准运动规划器执行可靠的导航和操作原语。
Result: 在 ProcTHOR-10k 上，CoReLIN 在标准指标和作者提出的长期效率分数 (LES) 上均比最佳基线提升 16%，并展示了到真实硬件平台的可迁移性。
Conclusion: CoReLIN 通过 LLM 约束推理和主动感知有效解决了长期交互导航中的物体重定位和路径规划问题。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: CoReLIN 通过 LLM 约束推理和主动感知有效解决了长期交互导航中的物体重定位和路径规划问题。

papers.title: Symmetry in language statistics shapes the geometry of model representations
papers.abstract_en: The internal representations learned by language models consistently exhibit striking geometric structure: calendar months organize into a circle, historical years form a smooth one-dimensional manifold, and cities' latitudes and longitudes can be decoded using a linear probe. To explain this neural code, we first show that language statistics exhibit translation symmetry (for example, the frequency with which any two months co-occur in text depends only on the time interval between them). We prove that this symmetry governs these geometric structures in high-dimensional word embedding models, and we analytically derive the manifold geometry of word representations. These predictions empirically match large text embedding models and large language models. Moreover, the representational geometry persists at moderate embedding dimension even when the relevant statistics are perturbed (e.g., by removing all sentences in which two months co-occur). We prove that this robustness emerges naturally when the co-occurrence statistics are controlled by an underlying latent variable. Our results indicate that these representational manifolds originate in the statistical symmetries of natural language.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明语言统计中的平移对称性（如月份共现频率仅依赖于时间间隔）决定了词嵌入模型中表示流形的几何结构。通过理论推导，作者在高维词嵌入模型中解析地得到了流形几何，并在大型文本嵌入模型和语言模型中经验验证。即使去除所有共现句子，该几何结构依然保持鲁棒，源于潜在变量控制的统计特性。
Motivation: 语言模型内部表示展现出的惊人几何结构（如月份循环、年份一维流形）缺乏统一的理论解释，本文旨在揭示其起源。
Method: 首先证明语言统计具有平移对称性，然后通过理论分析在高维词嵌入模型中推导流形几何，并利用潜在变量模型解释鲁棒性。
Result: 理论预测与大型文本嵌入模型及大型语言模型的经验结果一致；即使扰动相关统计（如去除所有月份共现句），几何结构仍然保持。
Conclusion: 表示流形的形成源于自然语言统计中的对称性，而非特定训练数据细节。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReplicatorBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Replicability in Social and Behavioral Sciences
papers.abstract_en: The literature has witnessed an emerging interest in AI agents for automated assessment of scientific papers. Existing benchmarks focus primarily on the computational aspect of this task, testing agents' ability to reproduce or replicate research outcomes when having access to the code and data. This setting, while foundational, (1) fails to capture the inconsistent availability of new data for replication as opposed to reproduction, and (2) lacks ground-truth diversity by focusing only on reproducible papers, thereby failing to evaluate an agent's ability to identify non-replicable research. Furthermore, most benchmarks only evaluate outcomes rather than the replication process. In response, we introduce ReplicatorBench, an end-to-end benchmark, including human-verified replicable and non-replicable research claims in social and behavioral sciences for evaluating AI agents in research replication across three stages: (1) extraction and retrieval of replication data; (2) design and execution of computational experiments; and (3) interpretation of results, allowing a test of AI agents' capability to mimic the activities of human replicators in real world. To set a baseline of AI agents' capability, we develop ReplicatorAgent, an agentic framework equipped with necessary tools, like web search and iterative interaction with sandboxed environments, to accomplish tasks in ReplicatorBench. We evaluate ReplicatorAgent across four underlying large language models (LLMs), as well as different design choices of programming language and levels of code access. Our findings reveal that while current LLM agents are capable of effectively designing and executing computational experiments, they struggle with retrieving resources, such as new data, necessary to replicate a claim. All code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/CenterForOpenScience/llm-benchmarking.
papers.comment: Accepted to KDD 2026 AI4Sciences Track, Camera-ready version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ReplicatorBench，一个用于评估 AI 智能体在社会科学和行为科学研究中复制能力的端到端基准，包括可复制和不可复制的研究声明。同时开发了 ReplicatorAgent 框架，在四项大语言模型上评估。结果表明当前 LLM 智能体在设计和执行计算实验方面有效，但在检索复制所需的新数据方面存在困难。
Motivation: 现有基准主要测试 AI 智能体在提供代码和数据时复现研究结果的能力，但未能捕捉复制过程中新数据的不一致可用性，且缺乏不可复制研究的多样性，导致无法评估智能体识别不可复制研究的能力。
Method: 提出 ReplicatorBench，包含人工验证的可复制和不可复制研究声明，覆盖复制三阶段：提取和检索复制数据、设计和执行计算实验、解释结果。开发 ReplicatorAgent，配备网页搜索和沙盒环境迭代交互等工具，用于在基准上完成任务。
Result: 在四个 LLM 上评估 ReplicatorAgent，发现当前 LLM 智能体在设计和执行计算实验方面表现良好，但在检索新数据等资源方面存在困难。
Conclusion: ReplicatorBench 提供了一个评估 AI 智能体复制能力的综合基准，揭示了智能体在数据检索阶段的不足，为未来研究指明了方向。

papers.title: Improved Upper Bounds for Slicing the Hypercube
papers.abstract_en: A collection of hyperplanes $\mathcal{H}$ slices all edges of the $n$-dimensional hypercube $Q_n$ with vertex set $\{-1,1\}^n$ if, for every edge $e$ in the hypercube, there exists a hyperplane in $\mathcal{H}$ intersecting $e$ in its interior. Let $S(n)$ be the minimum number of hyperplanes needed to slice $Q_n$. We prove that $S(n) \leq \lceil \frac{4n}{5} \rceil$, except when $n$ is an odd multiple of $5$, in which case $S(n) \leq \frac{4n}{5} +1$. This improves upon the previously known upper bound of $S(n) \leq \lceil\frac{5n}{6} \rceil$ due to Paterson reported in 1971. We also obtain new lower bounds on the maximum number of edges in $Q_n$ that can be sliced using $k<n$ hyperplanes. We prove the improved upper bound on $S(n)$ by constructing $8$ hyperplanes slicing $Q_{10}$ aided by the recently introduced CPro1: an automatic tool that uses reasoning LLMs coupled with automated hyperparameter tuning to create search algorithms for the discovery of mathematical constructions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究切割n维超立方体所有边所需的最少超平面数S(n)，将上界从Paterson的⌈5n/6⌉改进为⌈4n/5⌉（当n为5的奇数倍时加1）。证明依赖构造8个超平面切割Q_10，并借助CPro1工具（结合推理大语言模型与自动超参数调优）实现构造的自动搜索。
Motivation: 超立方体切片问题在组合几何中具有经典地位，原有上界已有50年未改进，存在理论突破空间。
Method: 通过构造8个超平面切割10维超立方体的具体实例，并利用CPro1工具——一种融合推理LLM与自动超参数调优的数学构造搜索算法——来辅助发现该构造。
Result: 证明S(n) ≤ ⌈4n/5⌉（n为5的奇数倍时为4n/5+1），并给出k<n个超平面时能切割的最大边数的新下界。
Conclusion: 该结果显著改进了超立方体切片问题的上界，同时展示了LLM辅助自动推理在数学构造发现中的潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: White-Box Sensitivity Auditing with Steering Vectors
papers.abstract_en: Algorithmic audits are essential tools for examining systems for properties required by regulators or desired by operators. Current audits of large language models (LLMs) primarily rely on black-box evaluations that assess model behavior only through input-output testing. These methods are limited to tests constructed in the input space, often generated by heuristics. In addition, many socially relevant model properties (e.g., gender bias) are abstract and difficult to measure through text-based inputs alone. To address these limitations, we propose a white-box sensitivity auditing framework for LLMs that leverages activation steering to conduct more rigorous assessments through model internals. Our auditing method conducts internal sensitivity tests by manipulating key concepts relevant to the model's intended function for the task. We demonstrate its application to bias audits in four simulated high-stakes LLM decision tasks. Our method consistently indicates substantial dependence on protected attributes in model predictions, even in settings where standard black-box evaluations suggest little or no bias. Our code is openly available at https://github.com/hannahxchen/llm-steering-audit
papers.comment: Accepted to Transactions on Machine Learning Research (TMLR)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种针对大语言模型的白盒敏感性审计框架，利用激活方向（steering vectors）操纵模型内部与任务相关的关键概念，从而进行更严格的内部敏感性测试。在四个模拟的高风险LLM决策任务中，该方法在标准黑盒评估显示几乎没有偏见时，仍检测到模型预测对受保护属性的显著依赖。
Motivation: 现有的大语言模型审计主要依赖黑盒评估，仅通过输入输出测试模型行为，但这种方法受限于输入空间，且许多社会相关属性（如性别偏见）抽象难以通过文本输入直接测量。
Method: 提出白盒敏感性审计框架，通过激活方向（activation steering）操纵模型内部与任务相关的关键概念，进行内部敏感性测试。
Result: 在四个模拟高风险LLM决策任务中，该方法持续检测到模型预测对受保护属性的显著依赖，即使在标准黑盒评估显示几乎没有或没有偏见的情况下。
Conclusion: 该方法能够揭示黑盒评估无法发现的内部偏见，为LLM审计提供更严格的工具。

papers.title: M3CoTBench: Benchmark Chain-of-Thought of MLLMs in Medical Image Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning has proven effective in enhancing large language models by encouraging step-by-step intermediate reasoning, and recent advances have extended this paradigm to Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). In the medical domain, where diagnostic decisions depend on nuanced visual cues and sequential reasoning, CoT aligns naturally with clinical thinking processes. However, current benchmarks for medical image understanding generally focus on the final answer while ignoring the reasoning path. Such opaque reasoning processes lack reliable bases for judgment, making it difficult to assist doctors in diagnosis. To address this gap, we introduce a new M3CoTBench benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the correctness, efficiency, impact, and consistency of CoT reasoning in medical image understanding. M3CoTBench features 1) a diverse, multi-level difficulty dataset covering 24 examination types, 2) 13 varying-difficulty tasks, 3) a suite of CoT-specific evaluation metrics (correctness, efficiency, impact, and consistency) tailored to clinical reasoning, and 4) a performance analysis of multiple MLLMs. M3CoTBench systematically evaluates CoT reasoning across diverse medical imaging tasks, revealing current limitations of MLLMs in generating reliable and clinically interpretable reasoning, and aims to foster the development of transparent, trustworthy, and diagnostically accurate AI systems for healthcare. Project page at https://juntaojianggavin.github.io/projects/M3CoTBench/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了 M3CoTBench，一个专门用于评估多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 在医学图像理解中思维链 (Chain-of-Thought, CoT) 推理的基准。该基准包含覆盖 24 种检查类型的多难度数据集、13 个不同难度的任务、一套针对临床推理的 CoT 评估指标（正确性、效率、影响和一致性），并对多个 MLLM 进行了性能分析。结果表明，当前 MLLMs 在生成可靠且临床可解释的推理方面存在局限性。
Motivation: 现有的医学图像理解基准通常只关注最终答案而忽略推理路径，导致推理过程不透明，难以辅助医生诊断。而 CoT 推理与临床思维过程自然契合，因此需要专门评估 CoT 推理质量的基准。
Method: 构建了 M3CoTBench 基准，包括：1) 多样化的多难度数据集（24 种检查类型）；2) 13 个不同难度的任务；3) 专门针对临床推理的 CoT 评估指标（正确性、效率、影响、一致性）；4) 对多个 MLLM 的系统性能分析。
Result: 系统评估揭示了当前 MLLMs 在生成可靠且临床可解释的推理方面的局限性。
Conclusion: M3CoTBench 旨在促进开发透明、可信且诊断准确的 AI 医疗系统。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Efficient Public Verification of Private ML via Regularization
papers.abstract_en: Training with differential privacy (DP) guarantees dataset members that they cannot be identified by users of the released model. However, those data providers, and, in general, the public, lack methods to efficiently verify that models trained on their data satisfy DP guarantees. The amount of compute needed to verify DP guarantees for current algorithms scales with the amount of computation required to train the model. In this paper we design the first DP algorithm with near optimal privacy-utility trade-offs but whose DP guarantees can be verified cheaper than training. We focus on DP stochastic convex optimization (DP-SCO), where optimal privacy-utility trade-offs are known. Here we show we can obtain tight privacy-utility trade-offs by privately minimizing a series of regularized objectives and only using the standard DP composition bound. Crucially, this method can be verified with much less compute than training. This leads to the first known DP-SCO algorithm with near optimal privacy-utility whose DP verification scales better than training cost, significantly reducing verification costs on large datasets.
papers.comment: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对差分隐私（DP）训练的验证效率问题，设计了首个近最优隐私-效用权衡的DP随机凸优化（DP-SCO）算法，其DP保证的验证成本低于训练成本。通过私有地最小化一系列正则化目标并结合标准DP组合界，实现了紧密的隐私-效用权衡。
Motivation: 现有DP训练算法缺乏高效方法验证模型是否满足DP保证，验证计算量通常与训练相当，阻碍了公众对模型隐私保证的信任。
Method: 提出一种新的DP-SCO算法，通过私有地最小化一系列正则化目标，并仅使用标准DP组合界来实现近最优隐私-效用权衡，核心是使DP验证的计算复杂度低于训练。
Result: 该算法取得了与已知最优DP-SCO算法相当的隐私-效用权衡，且DP验证成本随训练规模扩展时显著低于训练成本。
Conclusion: 本文展示了首个DP-SCO算法，其隐私验证效率高于训练，可显著降低大规模数据集上的验证负担。

papers.title: REMSA: Foundation Model Selection for Remote Sensing via a Constraint-Aware Agent
papers.abstract_en: Foundation Models (FMs) are increasingly integrated into remote sensing (RS) pipelines. These models include unimodal vision encoders and multimodal architectures. FMs are adapted to diverse perception tasks, such as image classification, change detection, and visual question answering. However, selecting the most suitable remote sensing foundation model (RSFM) for a specific task remains challenging due to scattered documentation, heterogeneous formats, and complex deployment constraints. To address this, we first introduce the RSFM Database (RS-FMD), the first structured and schema-guided resource covering over 160 RSFMs trained on various data modalities, spanning different spatial, spectral, and temporal resolutions, considering different learning paradigms. Built upon RS-FMD, we further present REMSA, a constraint-aware agent that enables automated RSFM selection from natural language queries. REMSA combines structured FM metadata retrieval with a task-driven decision workflow. In detail, it interprets user input, clarifies missing constraints, ranks models via in-context learning, and provides transparent justifications. Our system supports various RS tasks and data modalities, enabling personalized, reproducible, and efficient FM selection. To evaluate REMSA, we construct a benchmark of 100 expert-verified RS query scenarios. Each query is evaluated across 4 systems and 3 LLM backbones, with the top-3 selected models manually assessed by domain experts. This results in 3,000 expert-scored task--system--model configurations under our novel expert-centered evaluation protocol. REMSA outperforms multiple baselines, showing its practical utility in real decision-making applications. REMSA operates entirely on publicly available metadata of open source RSFMs, without accessing private or sensitive data.
papers.comment: Code and data available at https://github.com/be-chen/REMSA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对遥感领域中基础模型（FM）选择困难的问题，首先构建了结构化数据库RS-FMD，收录超过160个遥感基础模型（RSFM）的元数据，涵盖多种数据模态和学习范式。在此基础上提出了约束感知智能体REMSA，能够根据自然语言查询自动筛选并推荐合适的RSFM，其流程包括意图解析、缺失约束澄清、基于上下文学习的模型排序和透明解释。在包含100个专家验证查询的基准上，REMSA在多个系统和LLM骨干下均优于基线方法，验证了其实用性。
Motivation: 遥感基础模型选择面临文档分散、格式异构和部署约束复杂等挑战，用户难以针对特定任务找到最合适的模型。
Method: 构建RS-FMD数据库，采用结构化模式存储超过160个RSFM的元数据；在此基础上设计REMSA智能体，结合结构化检索和任务驱动决策流程，通过对话澄清约束、使用上下文学习排序模型并输出推荐理由。
Result: 在100个专家验证的查询场景上测试，每个查询在4个系统与3个LLM骨干下评估，专家对前3名模型进行评分，共3000个配置。REMSA在所有设置下优于多个基线方法。
Conclusion: REMSA基于完全公开的元数据实现了自动化的RSFM选择，无需访问私有数据，在真实决策中展现了实用性。

papers.title: Revisiting Audio-language Pretraining for Learning General-purpose Audio Representation
papers.abstract_en: Audio-language pretraining (ALP) holds promise for learning general-purpose audio representation, yet remains underexplored. Crucially, there is no consensus on whether audio-language models can build effective general-purpose audio encoders, nor a systematic understanding of how pretraining objectives behave across diverse tasks and scales. We identify three key barriers: limited scale of audio-text corpora, limited coverage of audio attributes in existing caption corpora, and lack of systematic exploration and evaluation. To fill this gap, we present the first principled empirical study of ALP. We first introduce CaptionStew, a 10.7M caption dataset aggregating open-source audio-text corpora across multiple domains and captioning focuses. We then conduct the first comprehensive evaluation comparing contrastive and captioning objectives for learning audio representation across speech, music, and environmental sound tasks. Our results not only demonstrate that ALP yields competitive, transferable representations, but reveal critical trade-offs: contrastive learning offers superior data efficiency, while captioning exhibits better scalability. Furthermore, we find that the benefits of supervised initialization often diminish at larger scales, challenging common practices. By grounding these claims in empirical evidence, we establish a viable pathway toward general-purpose audio representation learning, guiding future research.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对音频-语言预训练（ALP）进行系统的实证研究，首次在多领域任务中对比对比学习和字幕生成目标。作者构建了10.7M的CaptionStew数据集，发现对比学习数据效率更高，而字幕生成可扩展性更好，且监督初始化在大规模下优势减弱。
Motivation: 音频-语言预训练在通用音频表示学习上潜力巨大，但缺乏系统性理解和共识，包括预训练目标在不同任务和规模下的表现，以及音频-文本语料库规模有限、字幕覆盖不足等障碍。
Method: 1）构建CaptionStew（10.7M多领域音频-文本字幕数据集）；2）对对比学习（contrastive learning）和字幕生成（captioning）两种预训练目标在语音、音乐、环境声音任务上进行首次全面比较。
Result: ALP可产生有竞争力的可迁移表示；对比学习数据效率更优，字幕生成可扩展性更好；监督初始化在大规模下优势减弱。
Conclusion: 通过实证建立通用音频表示学习的可行路径，为未来研究提供指导。

papers.title: Multi-Channel Uncertainty-Weighted Score Matching for Conditional Diffusion in Medical UDA
papers.abstract_en: Robust medical image segmentation across modalities remains challenging due to severe domain shifts and the lack of target-domain labels. While diffusion models have been explored for cross-domain generation and augmentation, target-domain conditional diffusion training typically relies on highly noisy pseudo masks; naively conditioning on a single Arg-Max pseudo-label can corrupt diffusion training and downstream segmentation. We propose UPDiff-UDA, a unified UDA framework whose core is an uncertainty-guided training objective for target-domain conditional diffusion. Given an imperfect source-trained segmenter, we use its per-pixel softmax distribution to form ranked pseudo-label maps (Arg-Max, Arg-2nd, Arg-3rd, ...). Each map yields a conditional score estimate, and we aggregate them via pixel-wise confidence weighting to obtain an uncertainty-reweighted score for score matching, improving robustness to pseudo-label noise while leveraging alternative plausible labels in uncertain regions. We further provide a theoretical justification showing that confidence-weighted aggregation follows a minimum-MSE convex-combination principle under the segmenter-induced surrogate label distribution. To improve pseudo-condition quality, we also introduce a feature-guided, low-degree-of-freedom Bézier curve adaptation to reduce appearance gaps. Experiments on multiple public datasets and modality shifts show that UPDiff-UDA generates high-fidelity labeled target-style samples for augmentation and consistently outperforms strong UDA baselines. The code for this project is available at: https://github.com/superlc1995/Multi-Channel-Uncertainty-Diffusion-UDA
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出UPDiff-UDA框架，针对医学图像跨模态分割中的域漂移和无标签目标域问题，利用不确定性引导的条件扩散模型训练，通过多通道伪标签加权聚合和Bézier曲线适配，生成高质量目标域样本以增强分割性能。实验表明该方法优于现有UDA方法。
Motivation: 现有扩散模型用于跨域生成时，目标域条件扩散训练依赖噪声大的伪掩码，直接使用Arg-Max伪标签会损害训练和分割性能。
Method: 提出不确定性引导训练目标：利用源域训练的分割器输出的逐像素softmax分布，形成排序伪标签图（Arg-Max, Arg-2nd, ...），通过像素级置信度加权聚合得到不确定性重加权分数用于分数匹配；并引入特征引导的低自由度Bézier曲线适配减少外观差异。
Result: 在多个公共数据集和模态迁移实验上，UPDiff-UDA生成了高保真带标签目标域样本，并一致优于强UDA基线。
Conclusion: 框架通过不确定性加权聚合和Bézier适配提升了条件扩散模型的训练鲁棒性和生成质量，为医学图像UDA提供了有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: SPFSplatV2: Efficient Self-Supervised Pose-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Views
papers.abstract_en: We introduce SPFSplatV2, an efficient feed-forward framework for 3D Gaussian splatting from sparse multi-view images, requiring no ground-truth poses during training or inference. The framework employs a shared feature extraction backbone to jointly predict 3D Gaussian primitives and camera poses in a canonical space from unposed inputs. To enable efficient and accurate pose estimation, we introduce a masked attention mechanism for target-view pose prediction and a reprojection loss that enforces pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives, providing stronger geometric constraints. We further demonstrate the compatibility of our training framework with different reconstruction architectures, resulting in two model variants. Remarkably, despite the absence of pose supervision, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-domain and out-of-domain novel view synthesis, even under extreme viewpoint changes and limited image overlap. It also surpasses many methods that rely on geometric supervision in relative pose estimation. By eliminating dependence on ground-truth poses, our method offers the scalability to leverage larger and more diverse datasets. Code and pretrained models will be available on our project page: https://ranrhuang.github.io/spfsplatv2/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SPFSplatV2，一个高效的前馈框架，用于从稀疏多视图图像进行3D高斯泼溅，无需训练或推理时的真实相机姿态。框架通过共享特征提取骨干网络联合预测3D高斯原语和相机姿态，引入掩码注意力机制和重投影损失以增强几何约束。该方法在域内和域外新视图合成任务上达到最先进性能，甚至在极端视角变化和有限图像重叠下也表现优异，同时相对姿态估计也超过许多使用几何监督的方法。
Motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅方法通常依赖精确的相机姿态进行训练，限制了可扩展性。本文旨在消除对真实姿态的依赖，实现自监督的姿态自由框架。
Method: 采用共享特征提取骨干网络从无姿态输入联合预测3D高斯原语和相机姿态；提出掩码注意力机制用于目标视图姿态预测；引入重投影损失以提供像素级几何约束；框架兼容不同重建架构，产生两种模型变体。
Result: 在域内和域外新视图合成基准上达到最先进性能，包括极端视角变化和有限图像重叠场景；相对姿态估计优于许多使用几何监督的方法。
Conclusion: 消除对真实姿态的依赖，提升了可扩展性，能够利用更大更多样的数据集。

papers.title: Graph Coloring for Multi-Task Learning
papers.abstract_en: When different objectives conflict with each other in multi-task learning, gradients begin to interfere and slow convergence, thereby potentially reducing the final model's performance. To address this, we introduce SON-GOKU, a scheduler that computes gradient interference, constructs an interference graph, and then applies greedy graph-coloring to partition tasks into groups that align well with each other. At each training step, only one group (color class) of tasks are activated, and the grouping partition is constantly recomputed as task relationships evolve throughout training. By ensuring that each mini-batch contains only tasks that pull the model in the same direction, our method improves the effectiveness of any underlying multi-task learning optimizer without additional tuning. Since tasks within these groups will update in compatible directions, multi-task learning will improve model performance rather than impede it. Empirical results on six different datasets show that this interference-aware graph-coloring approach consistently outperforms baselines and state-of-the-art multi-task optimizers. We provide extensive theory showing why grouping and sequential updates improve multi-task learning, with guarantees on descent, convergence, and the ability to accurately identify what tasks conflict or align.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出SON-GOKU，一种基于图着色的多任务学习调度器，通过计算梯度干扰构建干扰图，并利用贪心图着色将任务分成互不干扰的组，每个训练步只激活一组任务，随着训练动态重组。理论证明分组和顺序更新可改善多任务学习的收敛性，实验在6个数据集上优于基线。
Motivation: 多任务学习中不同目标相互冲突时，梯度干扰会降低收敛速度和模型性能，现有方法未能有效解决动态任务关系下的分组问题。
Method: SON-GOKU调度器：计算任务间的梯度干扰，构建干扰图，应用贪心图着色将任务分成兼容的组（颜色类），每个训练步只激活一组，并不断重新计算分组以适应任务关系变化。
Result: 在6个数据集上，该方法一致优于基线及最新多任务优化器。理论提供了下降、收敛和冲突/对齐识别保证。
Conclusion: 干扰感知的图着色方法能有效减少梯度冲突，提升多任务学习效果，无需额外调参。

papers.title: GraphMend: Code Transformations for Fixing Graph Breaks in PyTorch 2
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents GraphMend, a compiler technique that automatically fixes FX graph breaks in PyTorch 2 programs. Although PyTorch 2 introduced TorchDynamo and TorchInductor to enable just-in-time graph compilation, certain code patterns still cause graph breaks that force execution to fall back to Python eager mode, introducing costly CPU-GPU synchronization and reducing optimization opportunities. Our investigation of 195 Hugging Face models reveals that 13.8% of models exhibit graph breaks. GraphMend automatically eliminates fixable breaks through source-level program analysis and transformations. It analyzes AST-level program structure to identify graph-break patterns and applies transformations only when their semantic preservation can be statically established. These transformations enable PyTorch to capture larger, uninterrupted FX graphs without manual refactoring by developers. We evaluate GraphMend on all 27 models found to exhibit graph breaks in our investigation. GraphMend eliminates 107 of 147 graph breaks (73%), fully fixing all breaks in 21 models. In our experiments on NVIDIA GPUs, GraphMend achieves up to 26x cold-start speedup, 5x on average, and up to 1.39x steady-state forward pass speedup. These results demonstrate that semantics-aware source-level analysis and transformation are effective complements to PyTorch's dynamic JIT compilation pipeline, substantially improving both usability and performance.
