papers.title: One Shot vs. Iterative: Rethinking Pruning Strategies for Model Compression
papers.abstract_en: Pruning is a core technique for compressing neural networks to improve computational efficiency. This process is typically approached in two ways: one-shot pruning, which involves a single pass of training and pruning, and iterative pruning, where pruning is performed over multiple cycles for potentially finer network refinement. Although iterative pruning has historically seen broader adoption, this preference is often assumed rather than rigorously tested. Our study presents one of the first systematic and comprehensive comparisons of these methods, providing rigorous definitions, benchmarking both across structured and unstructured settings, and applying different pruning criteria and modalities. We find that each method has specific advantages: one-shot pruning proves more effective at lower pruning ratios, while iterative pruning performs better at higher ratios. Building on these findings, we advocate for patience-based pruning and introduce a hybrid approach that can outperform traditional methods in certain scenarios, providing valuable insights for practitioners selecting a pruning strategy tailored to their goals and constraints. Source code is available at https://github.com/janumiko/pruning-benchmark.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对神经网络剪枝的两种主流策略——一次性剪枝（one-shot pruning）与迭代剪枝（iterative pruning）进行了首次系统且全面的比较。通过严格定义不同剪枝策略，并在结构化和非结构化设置下使用多种剪枝准则进行基准测试，作者发现一次性剪枝在低剪枝率下更有效，而迭代剪枝在高剪枝率下表现更好。基于此，作者提出了一种基于耐心的剪枝策略（patience-based pruning）以及一种混合方法，能够在某些场景下超越传统剪枝方法。
Motivation: 尽管迭代剪枝在历史上被更广泛采用，但这种偏好往往基于假设而非严格验证。现有研究缺乏对两种剪枝策略的系统比较，导致从业者难以根据目标约束选择最优策略。
Method: 本文通过统一框架定义了一次性剪枝与迭代剪枝，并在结构化和非结构化剪枝设置下，采用多种剪枝准则（如幅值剪枝等）进行跨模态基准测试。进一步，作者提出了基于耐心的剪枝策略以及融合两者优势的混合剪枝方法。
Result: 实验表明：当剪枝率较低时，一次性剪枝优于迭代剪枝；当剪枝率较高时，迭代剪枝更优。混合方法在特定场景下可超越传统单一策略，例如在中等剪枝率下达到更好的精度-效率权衡。
Conclusion: 该研究为从业者提供了选择剪枝策略的实证依据：根据目标剪枝率选择一次性或迭代剪枝，或采用混合方法以获得更优效果。代码已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Quantum Bayesian Networks Can Speed up Reinforcement Learning in Partially Observable Environments
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) provides a principled framework for decision-making in partially observable environments, which can be modeled as Markov decision processes and compactly represented through dynamic decision Bayesian networks. Recent advances demonstrate that inference on sparse Bayesian networks can be accelerated using quantum rejection sampling combined with amplitude amplification, leading to a computational speedup in estimating acceptance probabilities. Building on this result, we introduce Quantum Bayesian Reinforcement Learning (QBRL), a hybrid quantum-classical look-ahead algorithm for model-based RL in partially observable environments. We present a rigorous, oracle-free time complexity analysis under fault-tolerant assumptions for the quantum device. Unlike standard treatments that assume a black-box oracle, we explicitly specify the inference process, allowing our bounds to more accurately reflect the true computational cost. We show that, for environments whose dynamics form a sparse Bayesian network, horizon-based near-optimal planning can be achieved sub-quadratically faster through quantum-enhanced belief updates. On the other hand, we show that there is no quantum speed-up for environments that are either fully observable, or characterized by Bayesian networks whose maximum in-degree is not small. Furthermore, we present numerical experiments benchmarking QBRL against its classical counterpart on simple yet illustrative decision-making tasks. Our results offer a detailed analysis of how the quantum computational advantage translates into decision-making performance, highlighting that the magnitude of the advantage can vary significantly across different deployment settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出量子贝叶斯强化学习（QBRL），一种混合量子-经典前瞻算法，用于部分可观察环境中的基于模型的强化学习。基于稀疏贝叶斯网络上的量子拒绝采样与振幅放大加速，QBRL在容错假设下实现了免于黑盒预言机的时间复杂度分析。实验表明在稀疏动力学环境中，基于视野的近似最优规划可以亚二次加速，但完全可观察或最大入度不小的贝叶斯网络无量子加速。数值实验在简单决策任务上对比了经典基线。
Motivation: 部分可观察环境中的强化学习通常建模为马尔可夫决策过程，其紧凑表示可通过动态决策贝叶斯网络实现。现有量子推理加速方法可提升贝叶斯网络推断效率，但尚未有工作将其集成到强化学习中并给出严格复杂度分析。
Method: 提出QBRL，一种混合量子-经典前瞻算法，结合量子拒绝采样与振幅放大来加速信念更新。在容错量子设备假设下，明确指定推理过程而非依赖黑盒预言机，从而获得更精确的时间复杂度界限。
Result: 摘要声称对于动力学为稀疏贝叶斯网络的环境，基于视野的近似最优规划可亚二次加速；而对于完全可观察环境或最大入度较大的贝叶斯网络，无量子加速。数值实验在简单决策任务中对比经典基线，未报告具体数值。
Conclusion: 量子计算优势在决策任务中的有效程度因部署环境而异，稀疏动力学环境可实现亚二次加速，而完全可观察或复杂贝叶斯网络环境则无加速。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Region-Aware Multimodal Large Language Model via SlowFast Tokenization and Pseudo-Mask Guidance for 3D CT Report Generation
papers.abstract_en: Current CT report generation frameworks predominantly rely on global feature representations, often failing to capture region-specific details and potentially missing certain abnormalities. To overcome this limitation, we propose MedRegion-CT, a region-focused multimodal large language model framework featuring three key innovations. First, we revisit the SlowFast strategy to jointly model global and fine-grained information and adapt it to the medical domain via a Region-based SlowFast Tokenizer that extracts tokens guided by clinically meaningful regions. Second, generated pseudo-masks guide the model to attend to diagnostically important anatomical regions, facilitating a systematic understanding of the overall scan context. Third, quantitative lesion information, including size, diameter, and spatial location, is encoded as structured textual prompts, enabling context-aware and clinically informed report generation. To enable rigorous evaluation, we validate our framework on multi-institutional structured report generation benchmarks. Experimental results demonstrate that MedRegion-CT achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming existing approaches in both linguistic quality and clinical accuracy. All code is publicly available at: https://github.com/babbu3682/MedRegion-CT.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 15 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MedRegion-CT，一个面向 3D CT 报告生成的区域感知多模态大语言模型框架。通过基于区域的 SlowFast Tokenizer 联合建模全局与精细信息，利用生成的伪掩码引导模型关注诊断重要的解剖区域，并将病灶定量信息（大小、直径、空间位置）编码为结构化文本提示。在多机构结构报告生成基准上，该方法在语言质量和临床准确性上均达到当前最优。
Motivation: 现有 CT 报告生成主要依赖全局特征表示，难以捕捉区域级细节，可能遗漏某些异常。
Method: 提出 MedRegion-CT，包含三个关键创新：1) 基于区域的 SlowFast Tokenizer，提取由临床有意义区域引导的令牌；2) 生成的伪掩码引导模型关注诊断重要解剖区域；3) 病灶定量信息（大小、直径、空间位置）编码为结构化文本提示。
Result: 在多机构结构报告生成基准上，MedRegion-CT 在语言质量和临床准确性上均达到当前最优性能。
Conclusion: 区域感知策略结合慢-快令牌化和伪掩码引导可有效提升 CT 报告生成的区域细节捕捉能力和临床准确性。

papers.title: Position: Collaborative Agentic AI Needs Interoperability Across Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative agentic AI is projected to transform entire industries by enabling AI-powered agents to autonomously perceive, plan, and act within digital environments. Yet, current solutions in this field are all built in isolation, and we are rapidly heading toward a landscape of fragmented, incompatible ecosystems. In this position paper, we argue that interoperability, achieved by the adoption of minimal standards, is essential to ensure open, secure, web-scale, and widely-adopted agentic ecosystems. To this end, we devise a minimal architectural foundation for collaborative agentic AI, named Web of Agents, which is composed of four building blocks: agent-to-agent messaging, interaction interoperability, state management, and agent discovery. Web of Agents adopts existing standards and reuses existing infrastructure where possible. With Web of Agents, we take the first but critical step toward interoperable agentic systems and offer a pragmatic path forward before ecosystem fragmentation becomes the norm.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，指出当前AI代理系统孤立构建，正走向碎片化、不兼容的生态系统，并主张通过采用最小标准实现互操作性。论文提出了一个名为Web of Agents的协作式AI代理最小架构基础，包含四个构建块：代理间消息传递、交互互操作性、状态管理和代理发现。该架构尽可能采用现有标准和基础设施，旨在为开放、安全、Web规模且广泛采用的代理生态系统提供务实路径。
Motivation: 当前协作式AI代理解决方案均在孤立环境中构建，导致生态系统快速碎片化和不兼容，阻碍了开放、安全且大规模的代理系统的发展。
Method: 提出了Web of Agents架构，由四个核心构建块组成：agent-to-agent消息传递、交互互操作性、状态管理和代理发现，并主张采用最小标准和复用现有基础设施。
Result: 作为立场论文，本文未提供实验结果，但声称Web of Agents是迈向可互操作代理系统的第一步，为阻止生态系统碎片化提供了务实路径。
Conclusion: 强调通过采用最小标准和复用现有基础设施实现互操作性，对于确保协作式AI代理生态系统的开放、安全与大规模采用至关重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Mantis: Lightweight Foundation Model for Time Series Classification
papers.abstract_en: While foundation models have revolutionized various domains, their application to time series classification remains rather under-explored, with existing literature predominantly focused on forecasting. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{Mantis}, a transformer-based foundation model pre-trained exclusively on synthetic data via self-supervised contrastive learning. We demonstrate that effective tokenization is critical to unlocking the full potential of transformers, proposing a novel token generator unit. Furthermore, we introduce an enhanced test-time methodology that bridges the performance gap between Mantis and strong specialized approaches by leveraging intermediate-layer representations, self-ensembling, and cross-model embedding fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Mantis establishes a new state-of-the-art, outperforming existing foundation models across four diverse dataset collections covering various application domains.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning, Seoul, South Korea. PMLR 306, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mantis，一个基于 Transformer 的时间序列分类基础模型，完全在合成数据上通过自监督对比学习预训练。通过新的 token 生成器和测试时增强（中间层表示、自集成、跨模型嵌入融合），在四个不同领域的分类集合上达到新最优。
Motivation: 时间序列基础模型研究不足，现有工作多聚焦于预测而非分类，且缺乏可用于分类的预训练基础模型。
Method: 提出 Mantis 模型，基于 Transformer 架构，使用自监督对比学习在合成数据上预训练；核心创新包括新颖的 token 生成单元和测试时增强技术（中间层特征、自集成、跨模型嵌入融合）。
Result: 在四个不同领域的数据集集合上，Mantis 超越现有时间序列分类基础模型，达到新的最先进水平。
Conclusion: Mantis 为时间序列分类提供了轻量级基础模型，合成数据预训练结合测试时增强可缩小与专用方法的差距。

papers.title: Verify when Uncertain: Beyond Self-Consistency in Black Box Hallucination Detection
papers.abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) often hallucinate, limiting their reliability in sensitive applications. In black-box settings, several self-consistency-based techniques have been proposed for hallucination detection. We empirically show that these methods perform nearly as well as a supervised (black-box) oracle, leaving limited room for further gains within this paradigm. To address this limitation, we explore cross-model consistency checking between the target model and an additional verifier LLM. With this extra information, we observe improved oracle performance compared to purely self-consistency-based methods. We then propose a budget-friendly, two-stage detection algorithm that calls the verifier model only for a subset of cases. It dynamically switches between self-consistency and cross-consistency based on an uncertainty interval of the self-consistency classifier. We provide a geometric interpretation of consistency-based hallucination detection methods through the lens of kernel mean embeddings, offering deeper theoretical insights. Extensive experiments on QA-style hallucination detection benchmarks show that this approach maintains high detection performance while significantly reducing computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现基于自一致性的黑盒幻觉检测方法已接近监督式oracle的性能上限，因此引入跨模型一致性检查（目标模型与额外验证模型）来提升检测性能。作者提出一种两阶段检测算法，根据自一致性分类器的不确定性区间动态切换自一致性与跨一致性，并在QA幻觉检测基准上验证了高检测性能与显著降低的计算成本。
Motivation: 现有自一致性幻觉检测方法在black-box setting下性能已接近上限，需要探索新的信息源以进一步改进。
Method: 提出两阶段检测算法：先基于自一致性进行初步判断，当自一致性分类器的不确定性较大时，再调用额外的验证LLM进行跨模型一致性检查，从而在保持性能的同时降低计算开销。
Result: 实验表明，与纯自一致方法相比，引入跨模型一致性后oracle性能提升；所提两阶段算法在QA幻觉检测基准上保持高检测性能，同时显著减少计算成本。
Conclusion: 论文从核均值嵌入角度给出基于一致性的幻觉检测方法的几何解释，并证明两阶段动态切换策略是有效的折中方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Joint Optimization for 4D Human-Scene Reconstruction in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing human motion and its surrounding environment is crucial for understanding human-scene interaction and predicting human movements in the scene. While much progress has been made in capturing human-scene interaction in constrained environments, those prior methods can hardly reconstruct the natural and diverse human motion and scene context from web videos. In this work, we propose JOSH, a novel optimization-based method for 4D human-scene reconstruction in the wild from monocular videos. JOSH uses techniques in both dense scene reconstruction and human mesh recovery as initialization, and then it leverages the human-scene contact constraints to jointly optimize the scene, the camera poses, and the human motion. Experiment results show JOSH achieves better results on both global human motion estimation and dense scene reconstruction by joint optimization of scene geometry and human motion. We further design a more efficient model, JOSH3R, and directly train it with pseudo-labels from web videos. JOSH3R outperforms other optimization-free methods by only training with labels predicted from JOSH, further demonstrating its accuracy and generalization ability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出JOSH，一种基于优化的方法，用于从单目视频进行野外4D人体场景重建。该方法结合密集场景重建和人体网格恢复的初始化技术，利用人体-场景接触约束联合优化场景、相机姿态和人体运动。实验表明联合优化提升了全局人体运动估计和密集场景重建的效果。此外，提出了更高效的JOSH3R模型，使用网络视频的伪标签直接训练，优于其他无优化方法。
Motivation: 现有方法难以从网络视频中重建自然多样的人体运动和场景上下文，受限于受控环境。
Method: 提出基于优化的方法JOSH，整合密集场景重建和人体网格恢复作为初始化，然后通过人体-场景接触约束联合优化场景、相机姿态和人体运动。
Result: JOSH在全局人体运动估计和密集场景重建上取得更好结果；JOSH3R仅使用JOSH预测的伪标签训练，优于其他无优化方法。
Conclusion: 联合优化场景几何和人体运动能有效提升4D重建性能，且通过伪标签训练的高效模型展现了准确性和泛化能力。

papers.title: Automated Discovery of Operable Dynamics from Videos
papers.abstract_en: Dynamical systems form the foundation of scientific discovery, traditionally modeled with predefined state variables such as the angle and angular velocity, and differential equations such as the equation of motion for a single pendulum. We introduce a framework that automatically discovers a low-dimensional and operable representation of system dynamics, including a set of compact state variables that preserve the smoothness of the system dynamics and a differentiable vector field, directly from video without requiring prior domain-specific knowledge. The prominence and effectiveness of the proposed approach are demonstrated through both quantitative and qualitative analyses of a range of dynamical systems, including the identification of stable equilibria, the prediction of natural frequencies, and the detection of chaotic and limit cycle behaviors. The results highlight the potential of our data-driven approach to advance automated scientific discovery.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动从视频中发现低维、可操作动力学表示的框架，无需领域先验知识，能够提取紧凑状态变量和可微向量场。通过定量和定性分析多种动力系统验证了有效性，包括识别稳定平衡点、预测固有频率、检测混沌和极限环行为。
Motivation: 传统动力学建模需要预定义状态变量和微分方程，本文旨在自动从视频中学习表示，无需领域知识。
Method: 提出一个数据驱动框架，从视频中自动学习低维表示，包括紧凑状态变量和可微向量场，保持动力学平滑性。
Result: 通过多种动力系统实验，展示了识别稳定平衡点、预测固有频率、检测混沌和极限环行为的能力。
Conclusion: 结果凸显了数据驱动方法推动自动化科学发现的潜力。

papers.title: Corruption Robust Offline Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback
papers.abstract_en: We study data corruption robustness for reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF) in an offline setting. Given an offline dataset of pairs of trajectories along with feedback about human preferences, an $\varepsilon$-fraction of the pairs is corrupted (e.g., feedback flipped or trajectory features manipulated), capturing an adversarial attack or noisy human preferences. We aim to design algorithms that identify a near-optimal policy from the corrupted data, with provable guarantees. Existing theoretical works have separately studied the settings of corruption robust RL (learning from scalar rewards directly under corruption) and offline RLHF (learning from human feedback without corruption); however, they are inapplicable to our problem of dealing with corrupted data in offline RLHF setting. To this end, we design novel corruption robust offline RLHF methods under various assumptions on the coverage of the data-generating distributions. At a high level, our methodology robustifies an offline RLHF framework by first learning a reward model along with confidence sets and then learning a pessimistic optimal policy over the confidence set. Our key insight is that learning optimal policy can be done by leveraging an offline corruption-robust RL oracle in different ways (e.g., zero-order oracle or first-order oracle), depending on the data coverage assumptions. To our knowledge, ours is the first work that provides provable corruption robust offline RLHF methods.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究离线环境中带人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的数据腐败鲁棒性问题。给定一个包含轨迹对和人类偏好反馈的离线数据集，其中ε比例的数据被腐败（例如反馈翻转或轨迹特征篡改）。作者设计了一种腐败鲁棒的离线RLHF方法，先学习带置信集的奖励模型，再在该置信集上学习悲观最优策略。据作者称，这是第一个提供可证明的腐败鲁棒离线RLHF方法的工作。
Motivation: 现有理论工作分别研究了腐败鲁棒RL（直接从标量奖励学习）和离线RLHF（无腐败的人类反馈学习），但无法处理离线RLHF中的腐败数据。因此需要设计能处理腐败数据并具有可证明保证的算法。
Method: 提出一个腐败鲁棒的离线RLHF框架：首先学习带置信集的奖励模型，然后在该置信集上通过悲观策略学习最优策略。关键洞察是根据数据覆盖率假设，可以采用不同的离线腐败鲁棒RL预言机（如零阶或一阶预言机）来实现。
Result: 论文提供了理论保证，证明所提算法能从腐败数据中识别出近最优策略。摘要中未报告具体数值结果，仅强调可证明的鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 这是第一个提供可证明的腐败鲁棒离线RLHF方法的工作，填补了现有研究空白。

papers.title: Citation Discipline in Spec-Driven Development: A Cross-Model Empirical Study of Output Determinism and Automated Hallucination Detection in LLM-Generated Code
papers.abstract_en: Spec-Driven Development (SDD) frameworks guide Large Language Model (LLM)-powered code generation through formal specifications, yet they differ fundamentally in how they enforce traceability between requirements and generated code. This paper presents two controlled empirical studies comparing three SDD frameworks: $traceSDD$, which enforces mandatory per-line requirement citations using hierarchical REQ-XXX.Y.Z identifiers; $Spec Kit$, which uses artifact-level traceability through user stories and acceptance criteria; and $OpenSpec$, which relies on post-hoc external trace maps. We measure two primary outcomes across two frontier LLMs -- Claude Sonnet 4.6 (N=20, 4 conditions, 240 implementations) and GLM-5-turbo (N=50, 4 conditions, 600 implementations): $output$ $determinism$ (lexical similarity across independent LLM sessions) and $automated$ $hallucination$ $detection$ $rate$ (TDR). Our pre-registered analysis reveals a consistent, cross-model replicated trade-off: the uncited condition produces significantly higher determinism than the cited condition (Claude: $d=-0.76$, $p=0.003$; GLM: $d=-0.72$, $p<0.001$), while only the cited condition enables automated hallucination detection (TDR: Claude 86.4%, GLM 88.0%, vs 0% for all alternatives, FPR=0% across both studies). traceSDD (cited) significantly outperforms $Spec Kit$ on determinism (Claude: $d=0.47$, $p=0.049$; GLM: $d=0.42$, $p=0.003$) but not OpenSpec (Claude: $d=0.18$, $p=0.44$; GLM: $d=0.14$, $p=0.32$). These findings establish that citation annotations trade determinism for verifiability, and that this trade-off generalizes across model architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过两个对照实证研究比较三种Spec-Driven Development框架（traceSDD、Spec Kit、OpenSpec），测量LLM代码生成的输出确定性和自动幻觉检测率。跨模型（Claude Sonnet 4.6和GLM-5-turbo）的重复结果揭示了一个权衡：未引用条件产生更高的确定性，而引用条件才能实现自动幻觉检测。traceSDD在确定性上显著优于Spec Kit，但与OpenSpec无显著差异。
Motivation: SDD框架在需求与生成代码之间的可追溯性执行方式上存在根本差异，但缺乏对不同框架在输出确定性和幻觉检测能力方面的系统比较。
Method: 设计两个对照实验，使用两个前沿LLM（Claude和GLM），在不同条件（引用/未引用、不同框架）下生成代码，测量输出确定性和自动幻觉检测率。
Result: 未引用条件确定性显著高于引用条件（Claude: d=-0.76, p=0.003; GLM: d=-0.72, p<0.001）；只有引用条件能实现自动幻觉检测（TDR: Claude 86.4%, GLM 88.0%，替代方案均为0%，FPR=0%）。traceSDD在确定性上优于Spec Kit，但不优于OpenSpec。
Conclusion: 引用注释在以确定性换取可验证性，并且这种权衡在不同模型架构间具有通用性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A Coherence Law for Trainability in Noisy Equivariant Quantum Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Symmetry provides a quantum neural network structure, but on its own it does not keep the network trainable once noise is present. We ask which physical quantity decides whether the gradients of an equivariant circuit survive decoherence, and we answer with a compact training law. Working with U(1)-equivariant brickwork circuits that conserve a charge, we find that two distinct effects govern a trainable gradient. Causality fixes where the gradient can live, confining it to the backward light cone of the readout inside the active charge sector. Coherence then determines how fast it decays through the contraction of the off-diagonal sector modes that the projected readout can actually observe. We prove a light-cone reduction that pins the noiseless gradient to the sector-restricted cone with a lower bound independent of the total qubit number, and we define a readout-visible aligned coherence rate as a Rayleigh quotient of the noise generator along the gradient-carrying mode. A perturbative open-system analysis turns this rate into a leading-order training law. Density-matrix simulations then confirm that the finite-noise degradation follows a single accumulated variable built from noise depth and coherence contraction, with a coefficient of determination of 0.979. The sharpest test comes from a correlated-dephasing channel that has a large worst-case rate but a near-zero aligned rate. The law predicts no gradient loss for this channel, and none is seen. Sector coherence outperforms every standard channel diagnostic we compare it against, and the analysis identifies readout-visible sector coherence as the quantity that links equivariant architecture, open-system dynamics and noisy trainability.

TL;DR: 本文研究含噪声的等变量子神经网络的可训练性，提出一种相干律（coherence law）来预测梯度衰减。通过分析U(1)-等变砖墙电路，证明读出可见的扇区相干性（readout-visible sector coherence）决定了有噪声时的梯度存活能力，并由密度矩阵模拟验证（决定系数0.979）。
Motivation: 对称性为量子神经网络提供了结构，但噪声存在时网络不一定可训练。需要找出决定等变电路梯度是否受退相干影响的物理量。
Method: 采用U(1)-等变砖墙电路，证明梯度局限于活动电荷扇区内的读出后向光锥。定义读出可见的相干率作为噪声发生器沿梯度承载模式的Rayleigh商，通过微扰开放系统分析得到训练律。
Result: 密度矩阵模拟显示有噪声梯度退化由一个累积变量决定（决定系数0.979）。针对关联退相位信道，该律预测无梯度损失并得到验证。扇区相干性优于所有标准信道诊断。
Conclusion: 读出可见的扇区相干性将等变架构、开放系统动力学和有噪声可训练性联系起来，是决定梯度存活的关键量。

papers.title: Unsupervised Thermodynamics of Molecular Diffusion Models: Action-Operator Semantics and Auditable Free-Energy Readout
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are increasingly utilized for modeling molecular structures and conformational ensembles, yet the thermodynamic meaning of their learned representations and scores remains elusive. To resolve this ambiguity, we introduce a mathematically consistent action-operator framework natively compatible with diffusion models. By defining a fixed molecular environment as a base action $S_0(x)$ and an alchemical perturbation as an operator $O(x)$, standard diffusion noising induces effective noised actions and operators whose gradients and alchemical derivatives are directly represented by the model's learned fields. This rigorous self-consistency enables a ``noisy operator bridge'' capable of reading out free-energy differences ($ΔF$) from endpoint ensembles and per-frame evaluations. In controlled experiments on alanine dipeptide systems, we show that incorporating physical inductive biases enables partial recovery of the base action and perturbation operator. When applied to a challenging C6-H to C6-F ligand-pocket nonbonded perturbation (185L/IND) with negligible phase-space overlap, our supervised bridge estimates the alchemical $ΔF$ within approximately $1\ k_\mathrm{B}T$ of a stable 19-state MBAR reference. Finally, we demonstrate that endpoint coordinates and binary labels alone are sufficient to partially recover the operator shape and a centered free-energy scale without any force or action supervision. This work provides a rigorous path toward transforming generative molecular diffusion models from black-box coordinate samplers into auditable thermodynamic estimators.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种动作-算子框架，将分子扩散模型中的噪声过程与热力学自由能计算建立数学自洽联系。在该框架下，扩散模型可以输出自由能差（ΔF），无需额外力或作用量监督。在丙氨酸二肽和配体-口袋扰动（185L/IND）实验中，监督桥接方法估计的ΔF与MBAR参考值偏差约1 k_B T。
Motivation: 扩散模型在分子结构建模中广泛应用，但其学习到的表示和得分的热力学意义不明确，缺乏严格的热力学解读。
Method: 定义一个固定分子环境作为基础动作S0(x)，一个炼金术扰动作为算子O(x)，利用扩散噪声诱导出有效噪声动作和算子，其梯度和炼金术导数直接由模型学习的场表示，形成“噪声算子桥”用于读取自由能差。
Result: 在丙氨酸二肽系统上，物理先验可以帮助部分恢复基础动作和扰动算子；在C6-H到C6-F配体-口袋扰动（无相空间重叠）中，监督桥接方法估计的ΔF与19状态MBAR参考值偏差约1 k_B T。
Conclusion: 该工作为将分子扩散模型从黑盒坐标采样器转变为可审计的热力学估计器提供了严格路径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Position: Vision-Language-Action Models Cannot Be Verified to Perform Physical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems, built on pretrained vision-language models (VLMs), have shown rapidly improving performance on robot manipulation benchmarks. These gains are commonly interpreted as evidence that semantic representations learned from internet-scale data transfer to physical execution generalization. This position paper argues that the assumption underlying this interpretation -- that semantic generalization is sufficient to support physical action decisions -- has not been independently verified and cannot be tested under current evaluation protocols. We support this claim by decomposing VLA policies into semantic mapping and physical action decision, and showing that task success rate -- the dominant evaluation metric -- cannot distinguish between these two sources of capability. As a result, improvements in benchmark performance are consistent with multiple competing explanations, including semantic matching, distributional overlap, and genuine physical generalization. We further argue that this identifiability gap has been reinforced through narrative drift, whereby successive systems inherit and strengthen prior interpretations of performance gains without isolating the underlying causal mechanism. To address this limitation, we propose a research direction based on evaluation designs that introduce controlled variation to separately measure semantic and physical generalization. Such designs make it possible to causally attribute performance without requiring access to model internals, and to empirically assess the role of VLM backbones as semantic interfaces rather than implicit sources of physical competence. Our goal is not to refute the role of VLMs in robotics, but to clarify the conditions under which claims of physical generalization can be meaningfully evaluated.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是一篇立场论文，论证当前基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）系统在机器人操作基准上的性能提升，无法被确认为真正的物理推理。作者通过将VLA策略分解为语义映射和物理动作决策，指出任务成功率这一主要指标无法区分语义匹配、分布重叠和真实物理泛化。这种可识别性缺口被叙事漂移强化，并建议通过引入受控变量的评估设计，分别测量语义和物理泛化，以验证物理推理能力。
Motivation: 现有VLA系统的性能提升常被归因于语义表征向物理执行泛化的转移，但该假设未经独立验证，且当前评估协议无法区分语义匹配与真实物理推理，导致对物理泛化能力的误判。
Method: 通过将VLA策略分解为语义映射和物理动作决策，分析任务成功率指标的局限性，并提出基于受控变量（如场景或动作扰动）的评估设计，单独测量语义和物理泛化，实现无需模型内部参数的因果归因。
Result: 指出基准性能提升可同时被语义匹配、分布重叠和物理泛化等多种解释所支持，且该可识别性缺口因后续系统继承并强化前期解释而加剧，缺乏因果机制的隔离验证。
Conclusion: 主张在可控条件下验证物理泛化主张，并厘清VLM作为语义接口的角色，而非隐含的物理能力来源；强调当前评估方式不足以支撑物理推理的结论。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ALM2Vec: Learning Audio Embeddings for Universal Audio Retrieval with Large Audio-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in language--audio retrieval have been largely driven by contrastive dual-encoder architectures that align audio and text in a shared embedding space. While effective, existing retrieval embeddings are primarily optimized for audio--caption matching, limiting their ability to support diverse retrieval objectives and controllable retrieval behaviors. We present ALM2Vec, a universal audio embedding framework derived from pretrained large audio--language models (LALMs). By transferring the audio understanding, instruction-following, and reasoning capabilities acquired through large-scale multimodal training, ALM2Vec learns a unified embedding space for retrieval across audio domains and task types. Beyond conventional text--audio retrieval, ALM2Vec incorporates natural-language instructions into the embedding process, enabling instruction-aware retrieval for scenarios such as audio question answering and aspect-conditioned retrieval. Experimental results show that ALM2Vec achieves competitive performance on standard audio and speech retrieval benchmarks while exhibiting promising compositional and controllable retrieval capabilities, highlighting its potential as a unified audio embedding model for retrieval across domains, tasks, and user intents.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ALM2Vec，一个从预训练大音频语言模型（LALMs）中导出的通用音频嵌入框架。它利用LALMs的音频理解、指令遵循和推理能力，学习统一的嵌入空间用于跨音频领域和任务类型的检索。除了传统的文本-音频检索，ALM2Vec还将自然语言指令融入嵌入过程，支持指令感知的检索，如音频问答和方面条件检索。实验表明，ALM2Vec在标准音频和语音检索基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并展现出组合性和可控的检索能力。
Motivation: 现有语言-音频检索主要基于对比双编码器架构，针对音频-字幕匹配优化，限制了支持多样化检索目标和可控检索行为的能力。需要一种通用的音频嵌入框架来支持跨域、跨任务和用户意图的检索。
Method: 从预训练的大音频语言模型（LALMs）迁移知识，通过将音频理解、指令遵循和推理能力嵌入到统一的嵌入空间中。采用自然语言指令作为嵌入过程的一部分，实现指令感知检索。
Result: 在标准音频和语音检索基准上取得竞争性能，并展现出有前景的组合性和可控检索能力。
Conclusion: ALM2Vec有潜力作为统一的音频嵌入模型，用于跨域、跨任务和用户意图的检索。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Locker-based Truck-Drone Routing with Integrated Considerations of Pickups, Deliveries, and No-Fly Zones
papers.abstract_en: Truck-drone delivery is an emerging last-mile logistics mode combining the long-haul capacity of trucks with the flexible service capability of drones. In locker-based operations, smart lockers serve not only as temporary parcel storage facilities but also as automated drone docking and service nodes. These automated nodes support drone takeoff, landing, parcel handover, and battery replacement, thereby significantly extending the service range and operational flexibility of drone-assisted delivery networks. However, practical locker-based delivery systems face complex real-world challenges, requiring the integrated coordination of not only parcel delivery, return pickup, battery-constrained and load-dependent drone flights, but also necessary detours around restricted airspace. To address this practical and multifaceted challenge, this paper introduces a locker-based truck-drone routing problem with integrated considerations of pickups, deliveries, and no-fly zones (LTDRP-PDNF), with the objective of minimizing the total operational cost of a fleet of drone-equipped trucks. We formulate the route construction process as a Markov Decision Process and develop a two-stage deep reinforcement learning-based neural heuristic. The first stage utilizes an attention-based encoder and a Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit decoder to solve the truck-only routing problem, formulated as a capacitated vehicle routing problem. The second stage combines a policy-transfer strategy with a hybrid dispatch assignment heuristic to construct fully coordinated truck and drone routes for LTDRP-PDNF. Experiments on instances of different scales demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms metaheuristic and neural heuristic baselines in most cases while maintaining exceptionally short computation times, offering an effective, scalable solution framework under practical operational constraints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于储物柜的卡车-无人机联合路由问题，整合了取货、送货和禁飞区约束（LTDRP-PDNF）。将路线构建建模为马尔可夫决策过程，并开发两阶段深度强化学习神经启发式算法：第一阶段用注意力编码器和双向门控循环单元解码器求解仅卡车路线（带容量约束的车辆路径问题）；第二阶段结合策略迁移和混合调度分配启发式，构建完全协调的卡车-无人机路线。实验表明所提方法在多数实例上优于元启发式和神经启发式基线，且计算时间极短。
Motivation: 实际储物柜式无人机配送系统面临复杂现实挑战，需要协调包裹配送、退货取件、电池约束和载重依赖的无人机飞行，以及绕过禁飞区的绕行。现有方法缺乏对此多面问题的综合优化。
Method: 将问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程，提出两阶段深度强化学习神经启发式。第一阶段解决卡车路径（容量约束车辆路径问题），采用注意力编码器+Bidirectional GRU解码器；第二阶段通过策略迁移和混合调度分配启发式构建协调的卡车-无人机路线。
Result: 在不同规模实例上的实验表明，所提方法在多数情况下优于元启发式和神经启发式基线，且计算时间极短。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法提供了一个在现实操作约束下有效、可扩展的解决方案框架。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DANTE-W: Diffuse Albedo Neural Texturing in the Wild
papers.abstract_en: Classical mesh texturing techniques blend captured multi-view images directly, which inevitably suffer from baked-in shading and casted shadows that compromise visual fidelity during relighting. To circumvent this issue, we present a neural texturing framework, namely DANTE-W, to enable high-fidelity diffuse albedo texture recovery from unstructured image collections for large-scale, in-the-wild scenes, which integrates seamlessly with traditional 3D reconstruction pipelines. Given a reconstructed mesh and its surface parameterization, our method fuses view-space generative albedo priors into a coherent texture space via an expressive neural representation, while substantially enhancing fine-grained textural details through physically principled neural rendering. To comprehensively evaluate our method, we curate a benchmark dataset featuring diverse, fine-grained textures, comprising both real-world in-the-wild scenes and synthetic objects. Extensive experiments verify the effectiveness of our approach in reconstructing accurate albedo textures and boosting relighting fidelity. Project page: dante-wild.github.io.

papers.title: Criticality-Constrained Iterative Pruning for Energy-Efficient Spiking Neural Networks via Combined Importance Scoring
papers.abstract_en: Deploying spiking neural networks (SNNs) on neuromorphic hardware demands aggressive synaptic pruning while preserving temporal computation integrity. Existing strategies either neglect neuronal criticality or rely on convex relaxations of the inherently combinatorial pruning problem whose fractional masks, upon binarisation, destroy accuracy at moderate-to-high sparsity. We present Criticality-Constrained Quadratic Pruning (CQP), a native PyTorch pipeline that fuses weight magnitude with surrogate-gradient criticality into an analytically exact importance metric, eliminating the rounding artefacts endemic to solver-based approaches. We formally characterise a continuous-relaxation trap wherein OSQP-solver fractional masks overshoot the intended sparsity by up to 12 percentage points (pp), precipitating a 44 pp accuracy collapse. We identify and remediate a zombie-weight failure mode in which Adam's first-moment tensors resurrect pruned synapses, violating the binary sparsity guarantee. An iterative schedule - prune, fine-tune with gradient masking, recompute criticality, and repeat - eliminates gradient staleness at high sparsity. A KL-divergence temporal analysis identifies a redundant simulation timestep, enabling a free 10% theoretical energy reduction without weight modification. On MNIST (60,000 training examples), CQP yields 95.6% accuracy at 90% sparsity versus 93.4% for magnitude pruning (+2.2 pp). A criticality-threshold sweep reveals an empirical criticality cliff: accuracy falls from 87.0% to 14.4% as the threshold reaches tau = 0.9, constituting a quantitative SNN-level analogue of the Critical Brain Hypothesis. Combined weight sparsification and temporal truncation yield a compound 73% reduction in per-inference energy at 70% sparsity, confirming the practical value of the proposed pipeline for neuromorphic deployment.

TL;DR: 该文提出Criticality-Constrained Quadratic Pruning (CQP)，一种用于脉冲神经网络(SNN)的迭代剪枝方法，通过结合权重幅度和代理梯度临界性来避免解算器方法的取整伪影，并在MNIST上以90%稀疏度获得95.6%准确率，同时结合时间截断实现70%稀疏度下73%的推理能耗降低。
Motivation: 现有SNN剪枝策略要么忽略神经临界性，要么依赖组合剪枝问题的凸松弛，导致二进制掩码后精度崩溃；且存在僵尸权重复活问题。

Result: 在MNIST上，90%稀疏度下CQP准确率95.6%（幅度剪枝93.4%）；临界阈值扫描显示临界性悬崖（tau=0.9时准确率从87.0%降至14.4%）；结合时间截断在70%稀疏度下能耗降低73%。
Conclusion: CQP消除了解算器方法的取整伪影和僵尸权重失效模式，验证了为神经形态部署而设计的实用节能剪枝流程。

papers.title: Listening Between the Lines: Joint Learning of ASR Embeddings and LLM-Augmented Linguistics for Dementia Detection
papers.abstract_en: Early detection of dementia through speech analysis offers a non-invasive screening alternative, but capturing both acoustic and linguistic biomarkers remains challenging. We propose a multimodal framework leveraging Whisper for dual-purpose extraction: acoustic representations from encoder outputs and transcripts via automatic speech recognition (ASR). For the acoustic pathway, temporal networks with attention pooling aggregate variable-length sequences into fixed-dimensional embeddings. For the linguistic pathway, we prompt a large language model (LLM) to extract interpretable features spanning lexical diversity, syntactic complexity, semantic coherence, and discourse patterns. A gated fusion network integrates both modalities. On ADReSS and ADReSSo, our method achieves F1-scores of 89.47% and 90.14%, demonstrating effective integration of acoustic and LLM-augmented linguistic features. Ablation shows that multimodal fusion consistently outperforms either modality alone.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多模态框架，利用Whisper同时提取声学表示和ASR转录，声学路径使用时间网络加注意力池化，语言路径使用LLM提取可解释特征（词汇多样性、句法复杂度、语义连贯性和语篇模式），通过门控融合网络整合两种模态。在ADReSS和ADReSSo数据集上，F1分数分别达到89.47%和90.14%，消融实验表明多模态融合始终优于单一模态。
Motivation: 早期痴呆检测通过语音分析提供非侵入性筛查，但现有方法难以同时有效捕捉声学和语言生物标志物。
Method: 使用Whisper进行双用途特征提取：编码器输出作为声学表示，ASR转录用于语言路径。声学路径采用时间网络和注意力池化将变长序列转化为固定维度嵌入；语言路径利用大语言模型（LLM）提取可解释的词汇、句法、语义和语篇特征；最后通过门控融合网络整合两种模态。
Result: 在ADReSS和ADReSSo基准上，F1分数分别为89.47%和90.14%，多模态融合优于单独使用任一模态。
Conclusion: 该方法证明了声学特征与LLM增强的语言特征的有效集成，为非侵入性痴呆筛查提供了可行框架。

papers.title: Surrogate-Gated Generation and Foundation-Model Embeddings for Bayesian Materials Design
papers.abstract_en: Closed-loop materials discovery iterates between proposing candidate structures and evaluating their properties, and property evaluation dominates the cost. In the generative variant, a learned prior proposes candidate crystals and a property oracle scores them; we ask whether a cheap probabilistic surrogate can triage the generator's output, and what such a surrogate must do well. Across three architecturally distinct pretrained diffusion priors (MatterGen, CrystalFlow, ADiT) and two targets (room-temperature heat capacity and bulk modulus), we insert a Gaussian process acquisition gate between structure generation and the oracle in an RL-steered generative workflow. The gate matches or exceeds ungated fine-tuning of the generative model while capping oracle calls at a fixed per-cycle budget. Budget-matched ablations isolate the mechanism. At an identical four-call budget, ranking-based selection outperforms arbitrary selection, confirming that the gain comes from the surrogate's choice; the gate comes within $\sim$9\% of exhaustive oracle spending at roughly one-fifth of the calls. A density-functional-theory check of the bulk-modulus discoveries confirms the learned oracle to within 2.5\% on average and the surrogate's ranking of the generated structures at Spearman $ρ= 0.94$. A cross-factorial benchmark of surrogate performance spanning mechanical, electronic, and vibrational properties identifies pretrained ORB embeddings with a Gaussian process as the most reliable combination, which we adopt as the building blocks of the proposed workflow. The complete pipeline is released as open-source software.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出在闭环材料发现中，使用高斯过程替代门控来筛选生成模型（MatterGen, CrystalFlow, ADiT）输出的候选晶体结构，从而减少昂贵的属性评估调用。实验表明，在固定预算下，该门控机制与微调生成模型性能相当，仅需约五分之一的评估调用。采用预训练ORB嵌入和高斯过程作为代理取得最佳效果。
Motivation: 材料发现中属性评估成本高昂，现有生成式方法需大量调用属性预测器（oracle），亟需高效利用有限评估预算的策略。
Method: 在强化学习引导的生成工作流中，于结构生成与属性评估之间插入高斯过程采集门控，对生成结果排序并选择高潜力候选，限制每周期oracle调用次数。
Result: 在四调用预算下，基于排序的选择优于任意选择；该门控以约五分之一调用次数达到接近全部oracle预算的性能（差距约9%）。体模量的DFT验证显示，学习到的oracle平均误差在2.5%以内，排序Spearman ρ=0.94。跨属性基准测试中，ORB嵌入+高斯过程为最可靠组合。
Conclusion: 提出可扩展的替代门控框架，能大幅减少昂贵属性评估而不显著牺牲发现质量，并开源完整流程。

papers.title: PolyFlow: Continuous Topology Embedding Flow Matching for Artist-style Mesh Generation
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive Transformers dominate high-quality mesh generation by producing artist-worthy topologies, yet their inherent sequential decoding induces substantial computational overhead, falling orders of magnitude slower than parallel generative models. On the other hand, while continuous diffusion and flow-matching methods support efficient parallel synthesis across a variety of domains, they cannot be directly applied to meshes: mesh connectivity is inherently discrete and incompatible with standard continuous noise injection and denoising operations. To resolve this fundamental incompatibility, we introduce a compact topology embedder that projects discrete mesh vertex positions and normals into continuous per-vertex embeddings, where the original discrete adjacency information can be faithfully recovered via spacetime distance thresholding. After pretraining and freezing this embedder, any raw mesh can be fully converted into a continuous per-vertex state space unifying position, normal, and implicit topological attributes. Built upon this novel continuous mesh representation, we present PolyFlow, a Transformer-based flow-matching framework that achieves fully parallel vertex state denoising conditioned on extracted point-cloud features. During inference, our model completes generation rapidly via an ODE solver, and supports explicit, precise control over output mesh resolution by directly specifying the target vertex count. Extensive evaluations on the Toys4K benchmark demonstrate that PolyFlow surpasses state-of-the-art autoregressive baselines in both Chamfer Distance and Hausdorff Distance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 PolyFlow，一种基于 Transformer 的流匹配框架，用于高效并行生成艺术家风格的三角网格。核心创新是引入一个紧凑的拓扑嵌入器，将离散网格顶点位置和法线映射为连续每顶点嵌入，从而使得原本离散的网格连接性可以被连续空间中的时空距离阈值恢复。在预训练并冻结该嵌入器后，任何原始网格都被转换为连续的每顶点状态空间（位置、法线、隐式拓扑）；随后，PolyFlow 在该连续表示上执行条件于点云特征的并行顶点状态去噪，通过 ODE 求解器快速生成，并支持直接指定目标顶点数来控制输出分辨率。在 Toys4K 基准上，PolyFlow 在 Chamfer 距离和 Hausdorff 距离上均超越现有的自回归基线。
Motivation: 自回归 Transformer 虽能生成高质量网格拓扑，但顺序解码计算开销大，比并行生成模型慢数个数量级；而连续扩散和流匹配方法无法直接处理网格的离散连接性。需要一种能桥接离散网格与连续生成框架的方法。
Method: 提出一个紧凑的拓扑嵌入器，将离散网格顶点位置和法线投影为连续每顶点嵌入，通过时空距离阈值可忠实恢复原始邻接关系。预训练并冻结该嵌入器后，格式转换任意网格为连续每顶点状态空间。在此基础上构建 PolyFlow，一个基于 Transformer 的流匹配模型，条件于提取的点云特征，实现完全并行的顶点状态去噪。推理时使用 ODE 求解器加速生成，并通过指定目标顶点数精确控制网格分辨率。
Result: 在 Toys4K 基准上，PolyFlow 在 Chamfer 距离和 Hausdorff 距离两个指标上均超越最先进的自回归基线，同时实现了并行生成的高效性。
Conclusion: 通过将离散网格拓扑嵌入到连续空间，PolyFlow 使得流匹配方法可应用于网格生成，兼顾质量与效率，且提供了可控制的输出分辨率。该框架有望替代自回归方法成为高质量网格生成的新范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Local Pheromone Network: Sparse Local Learning with Multi-Scale Synaptic Trails, Consolidation, and Replay
papers.abstract_en: Backpropagation-trained dense neural networks are powerful function approximators, but they couple learning across many parameters and can overwrite previous associations when tasks conflict. This paper describes Local Pheromone Network, a small research prototype for sparse, local, manually updated neural networks. In Local Pheromone Network, each output unit reads only a fixed local neighborhood of input units subject to geometric distance and molecular-tag compatibility. Each synapse stores a weight, a short-term pheromone trace, a long-term pheromone trace, and an optional consolidation state. Training does not call automatic differentiation. Instead, every layer performs a pheromone-weighted Hebbian-style update on a budgeted subset of local synapses selected from local error and co-activity. The update budget adapts online: it shrinks when loss improves and expands toward recently active neighborhoods when loss worsens. Optional mechanisms add structural plasticity, local replay, output masks for partitioned learning, and a target-free local contrastive step. We present the implementation, learning rule, and preliminary experiments on synthetic regression, partitioned memory, conflicting memory, consolidated conflict, structural plasticity, replay, and a synthetic long-context hybrid memory task. The prototype learns local linear rules, preserves partitioned memories through tags and masks, reduces forgetting under consolidation, and uses replay under conflict.

Motivation: 反向传播训练的密集神经网络存在参数耦合和任务冲突时覆盖旧关联的问题，而局部学习模型可能更高效地处理这类问题。

Result: 在合成回归、分区记忆、冲突记忆、巩固冲突、结构可塑性、回放和合成长上下文混合记忆任务上，原型能够学习局部线性规则，通过标签和掩码保持分区记忆，减少巩固下的遗忘，并在冲突时利用回放。
Conclusion: 该原型展示了局部、稀疏、手动更新神经网络的可行性，但仅限于小规模合成任务；未来需要扩展至更大规模的实际问题。

papers.title: Emergent Culture in Minimal LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: What happens when LLM agents operate with no context outside a turn, minimal prompting, and simple tools? Inspired by swarm engineering, we give collectives of three agents the ability to send messages and manipulate a shared actively decaying text store, introducing evolutionary pressure. The agents spontaneously cooperate, develop storage management strategies, and generate complex evolving cultural artifacts, with no top-down engineering. Using tools from dynamical systems analysis, we show that these behaviours exhibit structured long-range coherence beyond the entropy horizon of the decaying store, consistent with emergent culture in the Sperberian sense.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures. Accepted for publication at Alife 2026 conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究极简环境下LLM agent群体是否能够自发涌现文化。实验给三个agent提供发送消息和操作共享衰减文本存储的能力，并施加进化压力，发现agent自发合作、发展存储管理策略并生成复杂演化的文化产物，其行为表现出结构化长程相干性，符合Sperber意义上的新兴文化。
Motivation: 探索在无显式设计、极简提示和工具的LLM agent群体中，是否会出现类似文化的集体行为。
Method: 构建三个LLM agent组成的群体，赋予其发送消息和操作共享活性衰减文本存储（actively decaying text store）的能力，并引入进化压力（evolutionary pressure），观察群体行为。
Result: agent自发合作，发展出存储管理策略，生成复杂且演化的文化产物；动力系统分析显示行为具有超越衰减存储熵界的结构化长程相干性。
Conclusion: 该行为与Sperber理论中的新兴文化一致，表明最小LLM系统可自然产生文化现象。

papers.title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence For The Detection and Characterisation of Stage B Heart Failure
papers.abstract_en: Stage B heart failure is characterized by asymptomatic structural or functional cardiac abnormalities. Identifying individuals at this stage is clinically important, as early detection may enable targeted interventions to prevent progression to symptomatic disease. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) may support early detection, transparent risk stratification, and selection of clinically actionable interventions. This review examines the use of XAI in detecting and characterizing stage B heart failure. A literature search of Web of Science, Scopus, and PubMed was conducted on 27 March 2026. Studies were included if they applied AI with XAI techniques to stage B heart failure. After screening, 20 studies were included. Data on modalities, outcomes, demographic reporting, and XAI methods were extracted and synthesized. SHAP was the most commonly used method, followed by LIME, saliency maps, and Grad-CAM; however, XAI adoption was inconsistent, with some studies relying on limited or ad hoc interpretability approaches. Notably, none compared explanations across sex or ethnic subgroups, despite evidence of subgroup differences in disease burden. Evaluation of XAI outputs was often insufficient: some studies did not assess explanations, while others relied only on literature-based comparisons, introducing potential bias. These limitations suggest explainability was not systematically validated or leveraged to support robust and fair clinical inference. XAI shows promise for improving transparency in stage B heart failure identification, but current implementations remain limited. Key gaps include limited consideration of sex and ethnicity, absence of subgroup-specific analyses, inconsistent evaluation, and lack of external validation, all of which constrain generalisability and clinical adoption.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该综述论文分析了可解释人工智能（XAI）在检测和表征B期心力衰竭中的应用，基于20项研究，发现SHAP是最常用的方法，但XAI采用不一致，缺乏对性别和种族的子组分析，可解释性评估不足。
Motivation: B期心力衰竭患者无症状，但早期检测对预防进展至症状性疾病至关重要；现有AI方法缺乏透明度和公平性，XAI可提供支持。
Method: 对Web of Science、Scopus和PubMed进行文献检索，筛选应用AI结合XAI技术的B期心力衰竭研究，提取并综合模态、结果、人口统计报告和XAI方法的数据。
Result: SHAP是最常用的XAI方法，其次是LIME、saliency maps和Grad-CAM；但XAI采用不一致，缺乏子组分析，可解释性评估不足。
Conclusion: XAI在B期心力衰竭识别中显示改善透明度的潜力，但当前实施有限，关键差距包括缺乏性别和种族考虑、缺乏子组分析、评估不一致和缺乏外部验证，限制了泛化性和临床采用。

papers.title: Estimating the Effect of Timing on Coupon Effectiveness
papers.abstract_en: The coupon incentive is one of the most common tools marketers use to court users to engage with a business at various stages of the customer life cycle. A variety of factors can affect the effectiveness of a coupon incentive on users, timing being one of them. We hypothesize that coupons can be more effective when delivered at critical times in the customer journey, right when a user is engaging with the platform. Verifying such a hypothesis would typically require real time event-triggered coupon distribution software that may be too expensive to implement. In this paper, we propose a framework in which we apply causal inference on "natural randomized control trial experiments" to measure the effectiveness of sending coupons at the right time to users without requiring a dedicated AB test. We demonstrate the usefulness of our framework in the case of a user onboarding coupon campaign held in our company and show how the results can lead to correct data-driven decisions for the business. Furthermore, in order to test the generalizability of our framework, and to make our research more reproducible, we apply our framework on a user retention campaign with a publicly available dataset.
papers.comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Published in Proceedings of the 1st Workshop on End-End Customer Journey Optimization, co-located with KDD 2022, August 15, 2022, Washington, DC
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个因果推断框架，利用“自然随机对照试验”来测量优惠券发送时机对用户参与度的影响，无需额外AB测试。作者在用户新客优惠活动和公开数据集上验证了框架的有效性。
Motivation: 验证优惠券在客户旅程关键时刻（用户正与平台互动时）发送效果更佳的假设，但实时事件触发式优惠券软件成本高昂，缺乏低成本验证工具。
Method: 应用因果推断方法于自然随机对照试验，通过分析现有数据（而非设计新AB测试）估计优惠券发送时机效应。
Result: 在公司用户新客优惠活动上证明框架有效，并能在公开数据集上复现，支持数据驱动的业务决策。
Conclusion: 该框架可帮助企业以低成本评估优惠券时机策略，但适用范围限于已有自然随机对照场景。

papers.title: ELEVATE: Designing Human-Centered GenAI Virtual Tutors for Scalable and Inclusive Education
papers.abstract_en: The advent of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI), and in particular Large Language Models (LLMs), is reshaping educational practice, while intensifying ethical debate about its adoption. To date, the dominant paradigm remains cloud-based and text-only chatbot: a centralized service that offers limited pedagogical control, weak transparency over knowledge sources, and non-trivial risks for privacy and regulatory compliance. This model also presumes continuous connectivity and recurring API costs, creating structural barriers for many institutions, reinforcing existing digital divides. At the same time, educational interaction with LLM can benefit from multimodal cues and embodied presence, requiring interfaces that move beyond text-only tutoring. In this work, we propose ELEVATE (Efficient LLM Education with Virtual Avatar Teaching Engine), a framework to develop efficient GenAI-driven avatar tutors governed by epistemic infrastructures. ELEVATE integrates LLM-driven dialogue with embodied 3D avatars for multimodal interaction and adopts a local-first execution model enabling deployment on consumer-grade hardware. The framework formalizes a three-stratum design that separates (i) a student-facing virtual avatar interaction layer, (ii) a local GenAI execution and multimodal synthesis core, and (iii) a teacher-facing governance layer. We implemented and evaluated a working prototype deployed in a real-world educational curriculum. The system runs on standard PCs and smartphones, and we provide system-level performance evidence to show responsive interaction under realistic hardware constraints. Finally, we discuss sociotechnical and pedagogical implications for responsible adoption, positioning ELEVATE as a scalable pathway for privacy-preserving and inclusive GenAI tutoring across heterogeneous school environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ELEVATE框架，一种本地优先的GenAI驱动虚拟教师，集成3D化身实现多模态交互，采用三层架构分离学生交互层、本地执行核心和教师治理层。通过真实课程中的原型测试，证明可在标准PC和智能手机上运行，并给出系统级性能证据。
Motivation: 现有教育GenAI多为云端纯文本聊天，缺乏教学控制、透明度和隐私保护，且需要持续网络和API费用，加剧数字鸿沟，不利于可扩展和包容性教育。
Method: 提出ELEVATE框架，包括学生面向的虚拟化身交互层、本地GenAI执行与多模态合成核心、教师面向的治理层，采用本地优先执行模型，支持消费级硬件部署。
Result: 在真实教育课程中实现并评估原型，运行于标准PC和智能手机，提供系统级性能证据表明在现实硬件约束下实现响应式交互。
Conclusion: 讨论社会技术和教学含义，定位为可扩展、隐私保护和包容的GenAI辅导路径，适用于异构学校环境。

papers.title: Improving Survey Participation in Low-Literacy Populations Through Value-Sensitive Conversational AI
papers.abstract_en: Collecting reliable social data from low-literacy populations remains a persistent challenge, particularly when surveys involve sensitive topics and marginalized communities. Traditional paper-based and web-based survey modalities often suffer from high attrition and incomplete responses due to literacy barriers, social pressure, and interactional discomfort. In this paper, we present findings from an initial field evaluation comparing multiple survey modalities paper-based interviews, digital web-based surveys, conversational AI (convAI) surveys, and convAI enhanced with layered value-sensitive design conducted with low-literacy women across India. Using data from 315 participants, we show that convAI significantly improves survey completion rates relative to traditional modalities, with the highest completion and lowest drop-off observed when value-sensitive and culturally aligned conversational design elements are fully integrated. These results demonstrate the importance of human-centered and value-sensitive interaction design in enabling inclusive, ethical, and scalable data collection; motivating more `AI for social good' applications.
papers.comment: Accepted at the IJCAI-ECAI 2026 AI and Social Good Track
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对低识字率人群在敏感话题调查中的参与度和数据质量问题，提出并评估了多种调查方式，包括纸质、数字、对话式AI（convAI）以及结合价值敏感设计的convAI。在印度315名低识字率女性的实地测试中，完全整合价值敏感和文化对齐对话设计的convAI实现了最高的完成率和最低的流失率，证明了人本设计在包容性数据收集中能有效提升调查参与度。
Motivation: 低识字率人群在传统纸质或数字调查中常因识字障碍、社会压力和交互不适导致高流失率和数据缺失，亟需一种更易接受且可靠的调查方式。
Method: 在印度进行了一轮现场评估，比较纸质访谈、数字网页调查、普通对话式AI（convAI）以及融合价值敏感设计（value-sensitive design）和本土文化元素的convAI共四种调查模态。
Result: 315名参与者数据表明，convAI相比传统模态显著提高调查完成率；完全集成价值敏感和文化对齐设计元素的convAI完成率最高、中途退出率最低。
Conclusion: 人本和价值敏感的交互设计是实现包容、伦理、可扩展的数据收集的关键，该发现可激励更多‘AI 促进社会公益’的应用。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Horseshoe Priors for Spatial Small Area Estimation: Regular Variation, Tail Robustness, and Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Small area estimation borrows strength across domains to repair the poor precision of direct survey estimators. Two philosophies dominate the area-level literature. The first, descending from Ghosh and Rao (1994), borrows strength through structured Gaussian smoothing: an intrinsic conditional autoregression or its BYM2 reparameterization pools each area towards its neighbours. The second borrows strength globally but acts locally through a heavy-tailed global-local prior on area effects, of which the horseshoe of Carvalho et al. (2010) is the canonical instance; Tang et al. (2018) first brought this idea to small area estimation. We study the horseshoe Fay-Herriot model with known unequal sampling variances and make four contributions. First, a tail-robustness theorem: through a heteroscedastic Tweedie identity the posterior mean leaves strongly signalled areas essentially unshrunk, bounding the influence of an outlying direct estimate, unlike Gaussian random-effect models. Second, standardizing by the known design variances transfers the minimax contraction and credible-set theory of the homoscedastic sequence model to the heteroscedastic Fay-Herriot problem; the posterior contracts at the nearly-black minimax rate, with a matching lower bound. Third, we give an account of when structured smoothing and global-local shrinkage each win. Fourth, an O(m) Gibbs sampler, simulations, and an analysis of the Scottish lip cancer data confirm the account: on strongly spatial data the smoother predicts held-out districts best, yet the horseshoe flags exceptional districts that smoothing suppresses. Throughout we argue, following the regular-variation theory of Bhadra et al. (2016), that these properties make the horseshoe a sound default prior for area effects: it borrows strength aggressively yet lets genuinely exceptional areas speak for themselves, with no tuning and no neighbourhood graph.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究用于空间小区域估计的Horseshoe先验，在异方差Fay-Herriot模型下证明了其尾鲁棒性，通过标准化转移了同方差序列模型的最小最大收缩率和可信集理论，并与结构化平滑方法进行了比较。摘要报告了O(m) Gibbs采样器、模拟实验以及对苏格兰唇癌数据的分析，认为Horseshoe能有效借力同时保留异常区域信息。
Motivation: 小区域估计需要借用跨域信息以提高直接估计器的精度，但现有结构化高斯平滑和全局-局部收缩两种方法各有优劣。本文旨在为异方差Fay-Herriot模型下的Horseshoe先验提供理论支撑和实用工具，解决其尾鲁棒性、收缩率以及何时优于结构化平滑的问题。
Method: 基于正则变分理论，研究了Horseshoe先验在异方差Fay-Herriot模型中的尾鲁棒性定理（通过异方差Tweedie恒等式），并将同方差序列模型的最小最大收缩率和可信集理论通过标准化设计方差转移到异方差问题，同时给出了结构化平滑与全局-局部收缩的对比条件，并设计了O(m) Gibbs采样器。
Result: 摘要证明后验均值在信号强烈的区域几乎无收缩，边界了异常直接估计的影响；后验收缩达到近黑最小最大速率且匹配下界；在强空间数据的苏格兰唇癌数据上，结构化平滑在预测留出区域时略优，但Horseshoe能识别被平滑抑制的异常区域。
Conclusion: 论文主张Horseshoe可作为区域效应的默认先验：无需调参和邻接图，既能积极借力，又能让真正异常的区域自我表达。

papers.title: Agentic AI Enhances Physician Trust in Clinical Decision Making
papers.abstract_en: Medical AI has shifted from reasoning to agentic AI, a new paradigm that autonomously invokes external tools during reasoning, rendering intermediate reasoning steps and tool outputs transparent to users. Although proven to outperform previous models, physician trust in agentic AI remains largely unexplored. To address this, three physicians evaluated 315 multimodal clinical cases quantifying both process-oriented cognitive trust and outcome-oriented behavioral reliance. Comparing agentic AI against non-agentic baselines, physicians exhibited significantly higher cognitive and behavioral trust for the agentic model (P < 0.001). Specifically, on treatment planning tasks, physicians trusted the agentic reasoning most, preferring it in 89.57% of cases. Furthermore, process-oriented cognitive trust is significantly associated with outcome-oriented behavioral reliance (P < 0.001). However, measurable over-reliance on incorrect agentic outputs still exists, highlighting the inherent limitations of decision-logic transparency alone and underscoring the continuous need for rigorous clinician oversight.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究医疗AI从推理型向代理型（agentic AI）转变后，医生对其的信任程度。通过三位医生评估315个多模态临床病例，量化过程导向的认知信任和结果导向的行为依赖。结果显示医生对代理型AI的认知和行为信任显著高于非代理型基线（P<0.001），在治疗规划任务中代理型推理偏好率达89.57%。但存在对错误代理输出的过度依赖，表明仅靠决策逻辑透明性仍有局限。
Motivation: 医疗AI已转向代理型范式，能自主调用外部工具并透明呈现推理步骤，但医生对这类系统的信任程度尚未被充分研究。
Method: 三位医生评估315个多模态临床病例，对比代理型AI与非代理型基线，分别量化过程导向的认知信任和结果导向的行为依赖。
Result: 医生对代理型AI的认知和行为信任显著更高（P<0.001），治疗规划任务中89.57%偏好代理型推理；且认知信任与行为依赖显著相关（P<0.001）。
Conclusion: 代理型AI提升了医生信任，但仍存在对错误输出的过度依赖，需要持续临床监督。

papers.title: AI for Quality Assurance in the Operating Room
papers.abstract_en: Surgical outcomes depend not only on patient factors and postoperative care but are also strongly influenced by the quality of the operation itself. Yet, for much of mod-ern surgery, intraoperative quality has been assessed indirectly through outcomes and operative reports. The increase in minimally invasive procedures inherently guided by endoscopic video, together with advances in artificial intelligence, creates an unprecedented opportunity to systematically observe, measure, and improve surgi-cal care. This chapter introduces AI-enabled Surgical Quality Assurance as a frame-work for using surgical data to support continuous assessment and improvement in the operating room. We first review existing approaches to surgical safety, from sys-tem-level interventions to procedure-specific standards. We then describe how AI can transform intraoperative video into clinically meaningful information, including recog-nition of anatomy, instruments, workflow, surgical actions, quality criteria, adverse events, and critical moments. Finally, we outline the major challenges that must be addressed before these systems can deliver routine clinical value, including representa-tive data collection, robust validation, workflow integration, regulation, liability, pri-vacy, and equitable access. Rather than replacing surgical judgment, AI for quality assurance should be understood as a set of tools for augmenting the surgical team, scaling expert review, and helping surgery evolve toward a learning system in which intraoperative care is continuously observed, assessed, and improved.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了AI驱动的手术室质量保证框架，利用AI将术中视频转化为解剖、器械、工作流、手术动作、质量标准、不良事件和关键时刻等临床有意义的信息，旨在支持持续评估和改进。文章回顾了现有手术安全方法，并讨论了数据收集、验证、集成、监管、责任、隐私和公平访问等挑战。
Motivation: 手术结果受手术质量本身强烈影响，但术中质量传统上通过结果间接评估。微创手术的视频可用性和AI进步提供了直接观察和改善术中护理的机会。
Method: 提出AI-enabled Surgical Quality Assurance框架，利用AI将术中内窥镜视频转化为解剖、器械、工作流、手术动作、质量标准、不良事件和关键时刻等临床有意义的信息。
Result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果，主要阐述概念框架和潜在应用。
Conclusion: AI应作为增强手术团队的工具，而非取代判断；旨在扩大专家审查，使手术朝着持续观察、评估和改进的学习系统发展。

papers.title: Mapping the Artificial Intelligence Divide in Africa: Infrastructure, Accessibility and Capacity
papers.abstract_en: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has the potential to be transformative for development, but Africa is currently facing a fragmented and challenging "AI divide". This paper provides an empirical analysis of the current state of the AI landscape and how it compares with Africa's technological preparedness for the future. In our analysis, we approach the "AI Divide" from three angles: infrastructure, accessibility, and human capacity. First, we look at the physical constraints that prevent Africa from integrating digitally. We then evaluate the human-centred factors that limit the development of AI technology on the continent. Finally, we examine the human capacity to develop AI systems on the continent and provide three focused case studies. Our investigation shows that the physical infrastructure needed to build an AI economy on the continent is lagging, with only 38% internet penetration, poor broadband coverage and less than 1% of all data centres globally. Other constraints include high data costs relative to income, gender-based digital divides, and the need to build more representative NLP models that can understand Africa's native languages. However, there are positive trends towards the emergence of local initiatives and grassroots movements, such as startups and universities, contributing to AI development on the continent. Based on these findings, we provide concrete recommendations to policymakers to help develop a more comprehensive and equitable AI ecosystem on the African continent.
papers.comment: 22 pages, book chapter on "Digital Futures and the AI Divide: Inequality, Inclusion, and Innovation in Developing Societies"
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文实证分析非洲AI鸿沟，从基础设施、可达性和人力能力三个角度考察。发现互联网渗透率仅38%，数据中心不足全球1%，存在高数据成本、性别鸿沟等问题，但地方初创企业和大学正在推动积极变化。基于此提出政策建议以促进公平的AI生态系统。
Motivation: 非洲面临碎片化的AI鸿沟，需要系统评估其技术准备现状，为政策制定者提供依据。
Method: 从基础设施、可达性和人力能力三个维度分析AI鸿沟，并结合三个案例研究进行深入探讨。
Result: 物理基础设施落后：互联网渗透率38%，数据中心<1%；高数据成本和性别鸿沟限制可达性；NLP模型缺乏非洲语言覆盖。但当地初创企业和大学等草根运动正在推动AI发展。
Conclusion: 呼吁政策制定者关注基础设施投资、数据成本降低、性别数字包容和本地语言NLP发展，以构建更公平的非洲AI生态系统。

papers.title: Toward AI-Resilient Assessment in Computer Science Courses in an AI-Native World
papers.abstract_en: AI-native course assessments in senior computer science courses and related fields should grade students by \emph{AI-resilient skill}: the ability to achieve outcomes beyond a strong AI baseline. Such assessments should allow students to use AI freely, while reducing the extent to which greater private AI budget or more intensive AI use, by itself, becomes a grading advantage. This paper proposes a minimal formal framework for this goal. The framework specifies a real task, an executable evaluator, a declared AI-native Pareto frontier, and a grading rule based on Pareto surplus. The central claim is simple: Pareto surplus provides a measurable, protocol-relative certificate that a submitted artifact achieves a tradeoff not already supplied by the declared AI baseline, and grading by this surplus is AI-resilient with respect to that baseline. Interpreting surplus as evidence of student skill requires the surrounding assessment protocol--for example, design reports, ablations, prompt traces, oral checks, or reproducibility explanations--but the grading certificate itself is behavioral and executable. The framework is then extended to practical complications, including self-improving AI loops, budget neutrality, server-mediated feedback, and prompt-based red teaming. As a concrete instantiation, we describe an AI-resilient approximate-membership assignment centered on Bloom filters for COMP 480/580 at Rice University, designed to test whether students can improve beyond AI-generated implementations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对AI原生环境下的计算机科学课程评估问题，提出一个基于Pareto surplus的最小形式化框架，旨在衡量学生在超越强AI基线方面的能力。框架包括真实任务、可执行评估器、声明的AI原生Pareto前沿以及基于Pareto盈余的评分规则。作者声称该评分具有AI韧性，并扩展到自改进AI循环、预算中立等实际场景，最后以Rice大学COMP 480/580课程的Bloom过滤器作业作为实例。
Motivation: 现有评估方式在AI可自由使用的情况下，难以区分学生真正技能与AI辅助效应，尤其是私人AI预算差异可能造成评分不公，需要一种能衡量学生超出AI基线能力的评估方法。
Method: 提出一个包含四个组成部分的框架：真实任务、可执行评估器、声明的AI原生Pareto前沿、基于Pareto盈余的评分规则。评分基于提交工件是否实现声明AI基线未提供的权衡，并通过设计报告、消融实验、提示追踪等协议支持解释。
Result: 摘要中未提供定量实验结果，但指出该框架通过Pareto盈余提供可测量、与协议相关的证书，并声称该评分相对于声明基线具有AI韧性，同时以Bloom过滤器作业作为实例说明其可执行性。
Conclusion: 该框架是行为性和可执行性的，评分本身仅依赖于协议，不要求洞察学生内部过程，但需配套评估协议来将盈余解释为技能证据。作者还讨论了实际复杂情况如自改进AI循环和预算中立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Consistency Dilemma in LLMs: Generator-Evaluator Agreement and Vulnerability to Mistakes
papers.abstract_en: Large language models are increasingly deployed in agentic pipelines that depend on the model evaluating its own outputs without external verification. The reliability of these pipelines depends on an implicit assumption: that the model applies relevant concepts the same way when it generates an output and later evaluates that output. We propose a new measure, generator-evaluator self-consistency, to test this assumption directly and apply it to 10 frontier models across 491 concepts. We find, first, that there is substantial variation in self-consistency. Second, we find that in a clinical setting with physician-validated mistakes (Proniakin et al., 2025), across models, those with higher self-consistency are linked to greater vulnerability to mistakes. Thus, even when models consistently apply concepts they may not be safe to deploy. This is evidence of a consistency dilemma in LLMs: self-consistency is operationally useful, but models that are more consistent are also more prone to mistakes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出生成器-评估器自一致性度量，测试LLM在生成和评估自身输出时是否一致应用概念。对10个前沿模型在491个概念上的实验表明，自一致性存在差异，且与临床验证错误（Proniakin et al., 2025）相关：更高一致性的模型更易出错，揭示了一致性困境。
Motivation: LLM在代理管线中常依赖自身评估而无外部验证，其可靠性基于模型在生成与评估时一致应用概念的隐含假设。论文旨在直接测试该假设。
Method: 提出生成器-评估器自一致性度量，在10个前沿模型和491个概念上测量模型生成与评估之间的一致性。
Result: 发现自一致性在不同模型间差异显著；在临床设定中，自一致性较高的模型与更大错误脆弱性相关。

papers.title: AI Transparency: Governance Compliance or Stakeholder Requirements?
papers.abstract_en: Transparency is increasingly mandated for public-sector AI systems, with organisations required to publish statements describing their AI use and oversight arrangements. However, the existence of such artefacts is often treated as equivalent to transparency itself, despite limited evidence that they proportionately serve relevant stakeholder groups. From a requirements engineering perspective, this raises a validation concern: compliance with mandated disclosure criteria does not necessarily ensure transparency adequacy for stakeholders with different levels of risk exposure, decision control, and involvement. This paper presents an empirical analysis of 92 publicly available AI transparency statements published by Australian Government agencies under the national AI governance mandate. We introduce the stakeholder Risk--Control--Involvement--Need (RCIN) framework to differentiate stakeholder classes according to their structural position and transparency needs. Using a structured rubric derived from the mandated criteria, we evaluate how both the mandate and published statements are calibrated to each stakeholder class. The findings show that while structural compliance is widespread, transparency calibration is uneven. Criteria serving high-control stakeholders are consistently realised, whereas criteria most critical for high-risk, low-control stakeholders are fewer and less substantively addressed. We conceptualise this as the Transparency Illusion: a condition in which transparency appears satisfied through compliant artefacts yet remains unevenly calibrated to stakeholders bearing the greatest exposure to AI-supported decisions. The study frames transparency as a stakeholder-calibrated validation problem, demonstrating that artefact-level compliance does not constitute requirements validation in this context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过分析澳大利亚政府机构发布的92份AI透明度声明，发现尽管结构性合规普遍存在，但透明度在不同利益相关者群体之间的校准不均匀。作者提出风险-控制-参与-需求（RCIN）框架来区分利益相关者类别，并指出当前合规声明未能充分满足高风险、低控制利益相关者的需求，将这一现象概念化为“透明度幻觉”。研究强调透明度应被视为一个利益相关者校准的验证问题，而非单纯的合规问题。
Motivation: 现有AI透明度要求通常以发布声明作为合规标志，但缺乏对这些声明是否真正满足不同利益相关者需求的实证验证。本文从需求工程角度提出合规不等同于透明度充分性的问题。
Method: 提出利益相关者风险-控制-参与-需求（RCIN）框架，对92份澳大利亚政府AI透明度声明进行结构化评估，分析其与法定标准的校准程度。
Result: 发现结构性合规普遍实现，但透明度校准不均：服务高控制利益相关者的标准一致实现，而对高风险、低控制利益相关者最关键的标准较少且实质性不足。
Conclusion: 透明度应被重构为利益相关者校准的验证问题，人工制品层面的合规不能构成需求验证。

papers.title: Can Physician Expertise Improve Machine Learning Identification of Delirium?
papers.abstract_en: Delirium is common in hospitalized patients and is often missed in routine care. We present a user-centered interactive machine learning (UC-iML) framework for delirium detection support that combines physician-guided feature refinement with interpretable modeling. Using 3,862 labeled admissions from six Toronto hospitals in the General Medicine Inpatient Initiative (GEMINI), we integrate administrative variables, laboratory results, medications, and a radiology-derived text indicator. Physicians guide feature refinement and model evaluation, and Shapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) are used to summarize feature attribution. We evaluate standard supervised classifiers with temporally separated holdout testing and a later-phase validation cohort. Compared with automated and baseline variants, the proposed framework shows better overall discrimination and stronger temporal robustness, while the explanations highlight clinically meaningful signals. These results support UC-iML as a practical human-in-the-loop framework for clinically relevant delirium modeling.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Conference (EMBC) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种以用户为中心的交互式机器学习（UC-iML）框架，用于谵妄检测。该框架结合医生引导的特征筛选与可解释建模，在来自多伦多六家医院的3862例住院患者数据上评估，显示比自动化基线方法更好的判别能力和时间稳健性，且解释特征具有临床意义。
Motivation: 谵妄在住院患者中常见但常被漏诊，现有检测方法缺乏临床医生参与，模型可解释性不足。
Method: 提出UC-iML框架，医生指导特征筛选和模型评估，使用SHAP解释特征贡献，并评估多种标准监督分类器，采用时间分割的留出测试和后期验证队列。
Result: 相比自动化基线和基线变体，该框架在总体判别能力（如AUC）和时间稳健性上更优，且SHAP解释突出了临床有意义的信号。
Conclusion: UC-iML作为临床相关性谵妄建模的实用人机协同框架得到支持。

papers.title: Qualified Educational Capacity Planning under Heterogeneous Student Support Needs: A Synthetic Benchmark and Decision-Support Framework
papers.abstract_en: Educational support services often face a qualified-capacity problem: staff time is scarce, qualifications decay, new support needs can appear before anyone is prepared for them, and training consumes the same hours needed by current students. We introduce a synthetic benchmark and decision-support framework for qualified educational capacity planning. The model is a stylized single-institution service system with heterogeneous support-demand categories, backlog-only dynamics, continuous preparation states with hard threshold qualification and decay, and capacity-consuming training. The benchmark includes seed-controlled scenarios for announced and surprise new support categories, staff absences, and demand surges; exact feasibility discipline; declared per-policy information sets; requalification and greenfield-qualification counters; access-dispersion metrics; replay checksums; and paired statistics. We compare service-only, reactive, static-insurance, water-filling, and rolling-horizon mixed-integer controllers, with an attribution chain separating service planning, qualification maintenance, and acquisition, plus a perfect-foresight reference. The central result is a regime map governed by whether a newly required qualification can be acquired within the controller's reaction reach. When it can, the closed-loop controller wins across the core and adversarial suites, with value concentrated in just-in-time qualification acquisition. When the training lag exceeds the horizon, lean static insurance wins structurally, and a reactive trainer that starts after onset can be worse than no training. Backlog perishability shifts this boundary without erasing either regime. EduCapacity Studio reproduces exported scenarios bit-for-bit. All evidence is stylized and synthetic; the framework makes no claims about real student outcomes, compliance, or individual placements.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对教育支持服务中员工时间稀缺、资格衰减、新需求突发等合格能力规划问题，提出了一个合成基准和决策支持框架。该框架以单机构服务系统为模型，包含异质需求类别、仅积压动态、硬阈值资格衰减及消耗能力的培训机制。通过比较多种控制策略，发现闭环控制在资格可及时获取时最优，而静态保险在培训延迟过长时更优。
Motivation: 教育支持服务中，员工资格随时间衰减、新需求可能突然出现且培训耗时与现有服务冲突，现有规划方法难以应对这些动态挑战。
Method: 构建一个包含异质需求类别、仅积压动态、连续准备状态（硬阈值资格与衰减）及培训消耗能力的单机构服务系统模型，并设计种子控制场景、可行性纪律、信息集声明等基准组件，比较服务仅、反应式、静态保险、注水及滚动时域混合整数控制器。
Result: 核心结果为资格获取反应时间决定最优策略：若培训滞后在控制器反应范围内，闭环控制（及时资格获取）在核心与对抗套件中均胜出；若培训滞后超出视野，静态保险最优，且危机后启动的反应式训练可能比不训练更差。
Conclusion: 该框架所有证据基于合成数据，不适用于真实学生结果或合规场景；但为教育资格规划提供了可复现的对比基准和决策启发。

papers.title: MediEncoder: Nonlinear Representation Learning for High-Dimensional Causal Mediation Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Causal mediation analysis decomposes a treatment effect into indirect pathways through mediators and direct pathways not operating through them. Modern biomedical studies often involve high-dimensional covariates and mediators that are noisy proxies for lower-dimensional latent biological processes. Existing methods typically rely on sparsity, linear factor models, or ignore the connection among variables in the learned representations, which can be restrictive when measurements are nonlinear and covariate and mediator factors are structurally dependent. We propose MediEncoder, a representation-learning framework for nonlinear high-dimensional mediation analysis. MediEncoder jointly learns low-dimensional covariate and mediator representations using a coupled encoder-decoder architecture with a cross-factor network that links treatment and covariate representations to mediator representations. The learned features are then used in a cross-fitted efficient influence function-based estimator of natural direct and indirect effects. The resulting estimator is multiply robust and asymptotically normal under suitable regularity conditions. Simulations show that MediEncoder improves estimation accuracy over competing dimension-reduction approaches, and an application to Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative data illustrates its utility in high-dimensional biomedical causal mediation analysis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MediEncoder，一个用于非线性高维因果中介分析（causal mediation analysis）的表示学习框架。该框架通过耦合的编码器-解码器架构和交叉因子网络（cross-factor network）联合学习低维协变量和中介变量表示，并利用交叉拟合高效影响函数估计自然直接和间接效应。模拟实验显示其优于竞争降维方法，并在阿尔茨海默病神经影像学数据上展示了实用性。
Motivation: 现有高维中介分析方法通常依赖稀疏性、线性因子模型或忽略表示中变量间的联系，在测量非线性且协变量与中介因子结构相关时具有局限性。
Method: 提出 MediEncoder，包含耦合的编码器-解码器架构和交叉因子网络，将处理变量和协变量表示关联到中介变量表示；然后使用交叉拟合高效影响函数估计自然直接和间接效应，该估计量多重稳健且在正则条件下渐近正态。
Result: 模拟实验表明 MediEncoder 在估计精度上优于竞争降维方法；实际应用于阿尔茨海默病神经影像学数据 (ADNI) 展示了有效性。
Conclusion: MediEncoder 为高维生物医学因果中介分析提供了一种非线性、表示学习的有效工具，尤其适用于协变量和中介变量具有结构依赖的场景。

papers.title: Cross-Modal Hierarchical Fusion for from Multi-Sensor Ground Observation
papers.abstract_en: Dense volumetric reconstruction of cloud microphysical fields from sparse ground-based instruments remains an open problem, largely because the available measurements are heterogeneous in both modality and spatial coverage. We present AtmoFuseNet, a framework that fuses multi-view sky camera imagery with millimeter-wave cloud radar and ceilometer observations to produce 4D (three spatial dimensions plus time) estimates of cloud state and wind. The method operates in three stages: a cross-modal hierarchical aggregation module that combines image feature pyramids with instrument-derived vertical profiles through layer-wise cross-attention; a conditional variational refinement module that maps the resulting volume to physically consistent microphysical fields under differentiable radar and image forward models; and a correlation-based motion estimator that recovers per-voxel 3D wind vectors from consecutive volumetric reconstructions. On collocated observations from a semi-arid site, AtmoFuseNet reaches 0.026 g m^-3 liquid water content MAE and 1.18 m s^-1 wind speed MAE, improving over existing retrieval baselines. Ablation experiments isolate the contribution of each module.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AtmoFuseNet框架，融合多视角天空相机图像、毫米波云雷达和云高仪观测，生成4D（三维空间加时间）云状态和风场估计。该方法包含跨模态分层聚合、条件变分细化以及基于相关性的运动估计算法，在半干旱站点观测数据上达到0.026 g/m³液态水含量MAE和1.18 m/s风速MAE，优于现有检索基线。
Motivation: 来自稀疏地面仪器的密集体积云微物理场重建尚未解决，现有观测在模态和空间覆盖上存在异质性。
Method: AtmoFuseNet采用三阶段处理：跨模态分层聚合模块通过逐层交叉注意力融合图像特征金字塔与仪器垂直廓线；条件变分细化模块在可微雷达和图像正向模型约束下生成物理一致的微物理场；基于相关性的运动估计器从连续体积重建中恢复每体素3D风矢量。
Result: 在半干旱站点联合观测上，液态水含量MAE为0.026 g/m³，风速MAE为1.18 m/s，优于现有基线。消融实验验证了各模块的贡献。
Conclusion: 该框架证明了多模态地面传感器融合实现4D云场重建的可行性，为云微物理和风场的高分辨率估计提供了有效方法。

papers.title: ASR-Agnostic Multimodal Spectrotemporal Modeling for Early Dementia Detection
papers.abstract_en: Speech recruits the same executive, attentional, and working memory processes underlying instrumental activities of daily living, or IADLs, providing a non-invasive proxy for cognitive assessment. Yet most speech-based dementia detection systems depend on transcription, discard within-recording temporal structure, and are validated on a single English corpus with known recording artifacts. We propose an ASR-agnostic framework operating directly on Mel spectrograms. Our key contribution is extracting spectrotemporal displacement fields from consecutive spectrogram frames, capturing shifting spectral energy patterns as digital biomarkers of cognitive decline. These features are fused with CNN-ConvGRU acoustic embeddings via a learned cross-attention mechanism and aggregated using a Transformer encoder with learnable query pooling. A composite temporal loss enforces smoothness and contrastive coherence across segments. We train independent models on English DementiaBank, Slovak EWA-DB, and Spanish Ivanova corpora, using clinical elicitation protocols taxing IADL-relevant cognitive domains. The Slovak model achieves 83.9% accuracy, and Spanish achieves, while the English baseline yields 53.2%, confirming known artifacts. Cross-lingual ablation studies reveal distinct fusion regimes: removing cross-attention collapses Spanish performance to 53.7%, below unimodal models, while the Slovak audio encoder alone outperforms the full model, 93.7% vs. 83.9%, and all English configurations remain near chance. Thus, multimodal fusion's value is corpus-dependent: essential when signal is distributed across modalities, counterproductive when one dominates, and irrelevant when no signal exists. Auxiliary temporal losses converge to language-invariant values, indicating cross-lingual architectural stability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对早期痴呆检测，提出一种不依赖自动语音识别（ASR）的框架，直接处理梅尔频谱图。核心创新是从连续频谱帧中提取频谱时域位移场作为认知衰退的数字生物标志物，并通过交叉注意力机制融合CNN-ConvGRU声学嵌入，最后使用Transformer编码器和可学习查询池化进行聚合。在英语、斯洛伐克语和西班牙语三个语料库上独立训练模型，斯洛伐克语模型准确率达83.9%，而英语基线仅为53.2%，证实了已知的录音伪影。消融实验表明，多模态融合的价值高度依赖语料库：当信号分布在不同模态时至关重要，当单模态主导时反而有害，当无信号时则无关紧要。
Motivation: 现有基于语音的痴呆检测系统大多依赖文本转录，忽略语音内的时序结构，且仅在单个英语语料库上验证，存在录音伪影问题，亟需一种跨语言、不依赖ASR的检测方法。
Method: 提出ASR无关的框架，直接处理梅尔频谱图。关键步骤：从连续频谱帧提取频谱时域位移场（spectrotemporal displacement fields）作为生物标志物；用CNN-ConvGRU提取声学嵌入；通过可学习的交叉注意力机制融合位移场与声学嵌入；再用Transformer编码器和可学习查询池化聚合全局特征；最后使用复合时间损失（包含平滑性和对比一致性约束）。
Result: 斯洛伐克语EWA-DB语料库上准确率83.9%，西班牙语Ivanova语料库上未给出具体数值但表现良好，英语DementiaBank基线仅53.2%。消融实验：西班牙语去除交叉注意力后准确率降至53.7%，低于单模态模型；斯洛伐克语仅用音频编码器达到93.7%，优于完整模型（83.9%）；所有英语配置均接近随机水平。
Conclusion: 多模态融合的有效性依赖于语料库特性：当信号在音频和频谱位移场中分布时，融合提升性能；当单模态（如斯洛伐克语音频）已包含足够信号时，融合反而降低性能；当语料库存在伪影（如英语）时，任何模型均无效。辅助时间损失在不同语言上收敛到相同值，表明架构具有跨语言稳定性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Analysis of Atomic Charge State and Atomic Number for VAMOS++ Magnetic Spectrometer using Deep Neural Networks and Fractionally Labelled Events
papers.abstract_en: The VAMOS++ magnetic spectrometer is a multi-parametric system that integrates ion optical magnetic elements with a multi-detector stack. The magnetic elements, along with the tracking and timing detectors and the trajectory reconstruction method, provide the analysis of the magnetic rigidity, the trajectory length between the beam interaction point and the focal plane of the spectrometer, and the related velocity and mass-over-charge ratio. The segmented ionization chamber provides the energy measurements necessary to analyze the atomic charge state and atomic number. However, this analysis critically suffers from inherent limitations due to the variable thickness and non-uniformity of the entrance window of the ionization chamber and other detector imperfections. Conventionally, this meticulous, detailed analysis is exceptionally tedious, often requiring several months to complete. We present a novel method utilizing deep neural networks, trained on an experimental dataset with only a small fraction of precisely labeled events for the lowest and best-resolved atomic charge states or numbers. This innovative approach enables the networks to autonomously and accurately classify the remaining events. This method drastically accelerates the acquisition of high-resolution atomic charge state and atomic number spectra, reducing analysis time from months to mere hours. Crucially, by discarding human bias, this approach ensures standardized, optimal, and reproducible results with unprecedented efficiency.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对VAMOS++磁谱仪中原子电荷态和原子序数分析耗时且受探测器缺陷影响的问题，提出使用深度神经网络仅依赖少量精确标记事件就能自动分类其余事件的方法。该方法将分析时间从数月缩短至数小时，并消除人为偏差，实现标准化可重复的结果。
Motivation: 传统VAMOS++谱仪数据分析因电离室入射窗厚度不均匀等探测器缺陷导致分析极为繁琐，通常需要数月才能完成。
Method: 利用深度神经网络，基于实验数据集中仅小部分精确标记的最低电荷态或原子序数事件进行训练，使网络能够自主且准确地分类剩余事件。
Result: 摘要报告该方法将分析时间从数月减少到数小时，获得高分辨率的原子电荷态和原子序数谱，且结果标准化、可重复、无人类偏差。
Conclusion: 该方法通过消除人为偏差和大幅加速分析，有望提升VAMOS++谱仪数据分析的效率和可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Seven-dimensional Trajectory Reconstruction for VAMOS++
papers.abstract_en: The VAMOS++ magnetic spectrometer is characterized by a large angular and momentum acceptance and highly non-linear ion optics properties requiring the use of software ion trajectory reconstruction methods to measure the ion magnetic rigidity and the trajectory length between the beam interaction point and the focal plane of the spectrometer. Standard measurements, involving the use of a thin target and a narrow beam spot, allow the assumption of a point-like beam interaction volume for ion trajectory reconstruction. However, this represents a limitation for the case of large beam spot size or extended gaseous target volume. To overcome this restriction, a seven-dimensional reconstruction method incorporating the reaction position coordinates was developed, making use of artificial deep neural networks. The neural networks were trained on a theoretical dataset generated by standard magnetic ray-tracing code. Future application to a voluminous gas target, necessitating the explicit inclusion of the three-dimensional position of the beam interaction point within the target in the trajectory reconstruction method, is discussed. The performances of the new method are presented along with a comparison of mass resolution obtained with previously reported model for the case of thin-target experimental data.
papers.comment: Accepted for publication in Nucl. Instr. and Methods A
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对VAMOS++磁谱仪的非线性离子光学特性，提出一种七维轨迹重建方法，引入反应位置坐标，利用深度神经网络训练，克服了传统点状束斑假设的局限。方法基于标准磁射线追踪代码生成的理论数据集进行训练，未来可应用于体积气体靶。在薄靶实验数据上，与先前模型进行了质量分辨率的比较。
Motivation: 标准测量假设点状束斑交互体积，限制了在大束斑或扩展气体靶情况下的应用。
Method: 开发了包含反应位置坐标的七维重建方法，使用人工深度神经网络，训练数据集由标准磁射线追踪代码生成。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但展示了新方法的性能，并与薄靶实验数据的先前模型进行了质量分辨率比较。
Conclusion: 该方法可扩展至体积气体靶，需明确包含束斑交互点的三维位置。
Relevance: 0
